abstract.text: Importance: The presence of management consultants in the US health care industry has increased dramatically in recent decades and is now higher than in most other sectors of the US economy. Hospitals hire management consultants to provide external expertise and advise on strategic planning, organizational change, cost cutting, and revenue-enhancement activities. Despite the prominence and influence of these firms, there is no empirical evidence in the US documenting either how much is spent on these services or whether that spending leads to measurable improvements. Objective: To quantify nonprofit hospitals' spending on management consultants and to evaluate changes in finances, operations, and quality of care following the initiation of a contract with a management consulting firm. Design, Setting, and Population: Observational study using a stacked difference-in-differences design to compare 306 US nonprofit hospitals that used a management consultant firm for the first time in 2010-2022 with 513 matched hospitals that did not use management consultants during 2009-2023. Exposure: First use of a management consulting firm. Main Outcomes and Measures: Financial performance (eg, revenues, expenses, margins, cash reserves, and fixed assets), operational measures (eg, inpatient utilization, staffing, executive and worker compensation, charity care, and community benefits), and quality-of-care measures (eg, claims-based 30-day mortality and readmission for acute myocardial infarction, pneumonia, and stroke). Results: More than 20% of nonprofit hospitals hired management consultants during the study period. Nonprofit hospitals that hired management consultants paid an average of $15.7 million for their services, and nonprofit hospitals collectively spent more than $7.8 billion on these services from 2009 to 2023. Despite this substantial investment, analyses of hospitals' financial performance, operational decisions, and claims-based patient outcomes revealed little evidence of substantial, statistically significant, or systematic improvements attributable to consulting engagements. Relative changes were estimated for financial measures, such as net patient revenue (-2.22%; 95% CI, -5.11% to 0.76%; P = .14), operating expenses (-1.07%; 95% CI, -3.56% to 1.49%; P = .41), fixed assets (2.05%; 95% CI, -6.54% to 11.42%; P = .65), bad debt (-6.31%; 95% CI, -19.82% to 9.48%; P = .41), days' cash on hand (-8.56%; 95% CI, -28.00% to 16.13%; P = .46), total margin (-0.19 [95% CI, -1.20 to 0.82] percentage points; P = .71), and operating margin (0.15 [95% CI, -0.94 to 1.23] percentage points; P = .79). Relative changes were estimated for operational measures, such as inpatient length of stay (1.71%; 95% CI, -0.34% to 3.81%; P = .10) and total inpatient days (0.29%; 95% CI, -2.57% to 3.23%; P = .85). Relative changes for quality-of-care outcomes were also generally not significant. The sole exception was 30-day readmission for patients with stroke (1.37 [95% CI, 0.14 to 2.61] percentage points; P = .03), which was not robust to alternative specifications. Conclusions and Relevance: Nonprofit hospitals expend substantial resources on management consultants, but there was no evidence of meaningful changes in hospital finances, operations, or quality of care. These findings raise questions about the net value that nonprofit hospitals receive from management consulting services and suggest the need to carefully examine the widespread use of management consultants by hospitals and other organizations across the health care industry.

10.1001/jama.2026.5027.abstractZh:
重要性：近几十年来，管理咨询公司在美国医疗保健行业的存在规模显著增长，目前其占比已超过美国经济其他大多数领域的水平。医院聘请管理咨询公司以提供外部专业知识和战略规划、组织变革、成本削减及收入提升方面的建议。尽管这些公司的地位和影响日益突出，但美国尚无实证数据表明这些服务所花费的资金数额，以及这些支出是否带来了可衡量的改善效果。  
目标：量化非营利医院在管理咨询方面的支出，并评估与管理咨询公司签订合同后，医院的财务状况、运营效率和护理质量的变化。  
设计、研究背景与对象：采用堆叠差异-差异设计进行观察性研究，比较2010-2022年间首次使用管理咨询公司的306家美国非营利医院，与2009-2023年间未使用管理咨询公司的513家医院。  
暴露因素：首次使用管理咨询公司。  
主要结果与指标：财务表现（如收入、支出、利润率、现金储备和固定资产）、运营指标（如住院利用率、人员配置、高管和员工薪酬、慈善护理和社区效益）以及护理质量指标（如基于索赔的30天死亡率、急性心肌梗塞、肺炎和中风的再入院率）。  
结果：在研究期间，超过20%的非营利医院聘请了管理咨询公司。使用管理咨询公司的非营利医院平均支出为1570万美元，而2009至2023年间，这些医院在管理咨询方面的总支出超过78亿美元。尽管投入了大量资金，但对医院财务绩效、运营决策以及基于索赔的患者治疗效果的分析显示，几乎没有证据表明咨询服务带来了显著的、统计学上显著的或系统性的改进。在财务指标上，如净患者收入（-2.22%；95%置信区间，从-5.11%到0.76%；P = 0.14）、运营费用（-1.07%；95%置信区间，从-3.56%到1.49%；P = 0.41）、固定资产（2.05%；95%置信区间，从-6.54%到11.42%；P = 0.65）、坏账损失（-6.31%；95%置信区间，从-19.82%到9.48%；P = 0.41）、现金周转天数（-8.56%；95%置信区间，从-28.00%到16.13%；P = 0.46）、总利润率（-0.19 [95%置信区间，从-1.20到0.82]个百分点；P = 0.71）以及运营利润率（0.15 [95%置信区间，从-0.94到1.23]个百分点；P = 0.79）等方面，均没有观察到显著的相对变化。在运营指标上，如住院天数（1.71%；95%置信区间，从-0.34到3.81%；P = 0.10）和总住院天数（0.29%；95%置信区间，从-2.57到3.23%；P = 0.85）等方面，也没有观察到显著的相对变化。在护理质量方面，也没有观察到显著的相对变化。唯一的例外是中风患者的30天再入院率（1.37 [95%置信区间，从0.14到2.61]个百分点；P = 0.03），但这一结果并不稳定，无法通过其他统计方法得到支持。结论与意义：非营利医院在管理咨询方面投入了大量资源，但并没有证据表明医院财务、运营或护理质量方面发生了有意义的改善。这些发现引发了关于非营利医院从管理咨询服务中获得的净价值的问题，并提示我们需要仔细审查医疗行业其他组织对管理咨询服务的广泛使用情况。

abstract.text: This JAMA Forum discusses the effects of higher-quality hospitals on patient outcomes, drivers of hospital quality, and the potential reasons why poorer-quality hospitals do not improve.

10.1001/jamahealthforum.2026.3727.abstractZh: 本JAMA论坛讨论了高质量医院对患者治疗效果的影响、医院质量的影响因素，以及为什么质量较差的医院难以改善的原因。

abstract.text: Importance: Cardiology services are among the most frequently used and costly services and procedures in US health care. Understanding price variation is essential for employers, patients, and policymakers to make informed decisions, contain costs, and promote value-based care. Objective: To assess the extent of variation in commercial insurance payment rates for common cardiology services across major US insurers and states using newly available Transparency in Coverage (TIC) data. Design, Setting, and Participants: This cross-sectional study used April 2025 TIC data from a third-party vendor reflecting 2023 contract year claims. The dataset included approximately 6.7 million professional and 104 563 facility price points for 32 common cardiology services across 4 major commercial insurers (Blue Cross Blue Shield, UnitedHealthcare, Aetna, and Cigna Healthcare), representing 78% of the commercial insurance market. The sample covered 51 568 physicians and 4128 facilities nationwide. Exposure: Negotiated allowed amounts paid by 4 major insurers for cardiology services, analyzed by Current Procedural Terminology code and grouped into categories such as diagnostic imaging, electrophysiology, and stress testing. Main Outcomes and Measures: Variation in allowed payment amounts for each cardiology service across insurers and states. Measures included median prices and IQRs, coefficients of variation, and volume-weighted price indices. Results: Facility negotiated price variation exceeded professional fee variation, with a median interquartile ratio of 2.56 across services. For example, median facility fees for implantable cardioverter-defibrillator (ICD) insertion ranged from $6674 (IQR, $3069-$11 402) to $36 269 (IQR, $18 673-$66 880) across insurers. Geographic variation was also substantial, with a median facility price for coronary angiography of $7683 (IQR, $4561-$10 101) across states. Blue Cross Blue Shield had the highest mean facility prices while Aetna had the lowest across most service categories. Conclusions and Relevance: In this cross-sectional study of commercial insurance payments for cardiology services, there was substantial variation across both insurers and states, particularly in facility fees. These findings reveal the influence of payer contracting strategies and market dynamics and underscore the need for greater transparency and regulatory oversight to promote efficient health care spending.

10.1001/jamanetworkopen.2026.23326.abstractZh:
重要性：心脏病学服务是美国医疗保健中最为常用且成本最高的服务与程序之一。了解价格差异对于雇主、患者和政策制定者来说至关重要，这有助于他们做出明智的决策、控制成本并促进基于价值的护理。  
目的：利用新获得的“覆盖透明度”数据，评估美国主要保险公司和州之间常见心脏病学服务在商业保险支付率上的差异程度。  
设计、背景和参与者：本研究采用第三方供应商在2025年4月提供的“覆盖透明度”数据，这些数据反映了2023年合同年度的理赔情况。数据集包含了约670万专业服务价格和104,563个设施价格点，涉及4家主要商业保险公司（蓝十字蓝盾、联合健康、艾特纳和西格纳医疗保健）的32种常见心脏病学服务，这些保险公司占据了商业保险市场的78%。样本涵盖了全国51,568名医生和4,128家设施。  
结果：分析了4家主要保险公司对心脏病学服务的允许支付金额，并按当前程序术语代码进行分类，包括诊断成像、电生理学和压力测试等类别。结果显示，不同保险公司和州之间各心脏病学服务的允许支付金额存在较大差异。测量指标包括中位数价格、四分位距、变异系数以及体积加权价格指数。地理差异也相当明显，各州的冠状动脉造影服务设施价格中位数为7683美元（四分位范围为4561美元至10101美元）。蓝十字蓝盾公司的平均设施价格最高，而艾特纳公司在大多数服务类别中的价格最低。结论与意义：在这项关于心脏病学服务商业保险支付的横断面研究中，不同保险公司和州之间的费用存在显著差异，尤其是在设施费用方面。这些发现揭示了支付方合同策略和市场动态的影响，并强调了提高透明度和加强监管监督的必要性，以促进高效的医疗保健支出。

abstract.text: Importance: Little is known about whether accountable care organizations (ACOs) in the Medicare Shared Savings Program (MSSP) have affected socioeconomic health care disparities. Objective: To investigate whether attribution to an ACO was associated with greater improvement in outcomes for patients with low vs higher income. Design, Setting, and Participants: This cohort study employed triple difference-in-differences analyses using 2010 to 2019 Medicare data to investigate whether quality differences between patients with low income and patients with higher income attributed to ACOs changed after ACO formation relative to patients at non-ACO practices or clinics. In exploratory analysis, we calculated 3-year outcomes (reflecting 1 ACO contract period) for each ACO and examined whether changes in disparities were associated with ACO characteristics such as size, rurality, inclusion of a hospital, share of patients with low income, presence of federally qualified health centers, and level of baseline disparities. Data analyses were performed between January 1, 2025, and February 27, 2026. Exposure: Attribution to a medical practice or clinic in an ACO during the first 2 years of ACO tenure. Main Outcomes and Measures: Differential changes in utilization-based quality metrics for patients with low vs higher income. Outcomes included potentially avoidable emergency department visits, ambulatory care-sensitive admissions, and 30-day unplanned hospital readmissions. Results: There were 585 ACOs in the study. Three years after ACO formation, there was no differential change in outcomes for patients with low vs higher income at ACOs compared with non-ACOs. However, there was considerable variation; 76 ACOs (13.0%) were associated with reduced outcomes disparities in at least 1 quality measure while maintaining or improving quality for patients with higher income; 68 ACOs (11.6%) were associated with worsened outcomes disparities on at least 1 quality measure while maintaining or worsening quality for patients with higher income. ACOs that were associated with reduced disparities had a 0.36 (95% CI, 0.17-0.56; P < .001) higher SD-level z score of baseline disparities (eg, a 16.2% higher disparity in preventable emergency department visits) compared with ACOs that were associated with increased disparities but were similar on other characteristics. Conclusions and Relevance: In this cohort study of MSSP ACOs, ACO formation was not associated with reductions in income-based disparities in quality of care during the program's first decade. However, the differences in quality of care narrowed for patients with low vs higher income at a subset of ACOs.

10.1001/jamanetworkopen.2026.29369.abstractZh: 重要性：关于Medicare共享节约计划中的责任护理组织是否影响了社会经济医疗差异，目前了解甚少。目的：研究将责任归属给某个ACO是否会导致低收入患者与高收入患者的治疗效果有更大改善。设计、背景与参与者：本研究采用三重差异分析，利用2010至2019年的Medicare数据，调查在ACO成立之后，低收入患者与高收入患者之间的质量差异是否因ACO而发生变化，并与非ACO医疗机构或诊所的患者进行比较。在探索性分析中，我们计算了每个ACO在3年内的结果（相当于一个ACO合同期），并研究了差异变化是否与ACO的特征有关，如规模、农村性、是否包含医院、低收入患者的比例、联邦认证健康中心的存在情况以及基线差异水平。数据分析在2025年1月1日至2026年2月27日期间进行。暴露因素：在ACO成立的前两年，将责任归属给某个医疗实践或诊所。主要结果与测量指标：低收入患者与高收入患者在基于利用的质量指标上的差异变化。结果：研究期间共有585个ACO。在ACO成立三年后，与非ACO相比，低收入患者与高收入患者在ACO中的结果没有差异。然而，存在相当大的差异；有76个ACO（占13.0%）在保持或改善高收入患者的医疗质量的同时，减少了至少一项质量指标上的结果差异；有68个ACO（占11.6%）在保持或改善高收入患者的医疗质量的同时，加剧了至少一项质量指标上的结果差异。与增加差异但其他特征相似的ACO相比，那些减少差异的ACO在基线差异的SD水平z分数上高出0.36（95%置信区间，0.17-0.56；P < .001），例如，在可预防的急诊就诊方面，差异高出16.2%。结论与意义：在这项针对MSSP ACO的队列研究中，ACO的成立并未在计划的前十年内减少基于收入的医疗质量差异。然而，在部分ACO中，低收入患者与高收入患者的医疗质量差异有所缩小。

abstract.text: Importance: In response to growing concerns about increasing hospital prices, Rhode Island placed caps on facility fee growth in 2010 through its Affordability Standards. Research found that the price growth caps successfully reduced hospital facility fees relative to other states. However, hospitals' response to revenue loss from the Affordability Standards-including seeking to acquire more clinicians and increasing nonregulated professional fees for affiliated clinicians-is unknown. Objective: To compare changes in vertical integration and changes in professional fees for evaluation and management services for clinicians affiliated with Rhode Island hospitals with such changes for clinicians affiliated with hospitals in other New England states. Design, Setting, and Participants: This cross-sectional study used January 1, 2013, through December 31, 2019, commercial claims data from the Health Care Cost Institute data contributors and data on vertically integrated clinicians. The analytic sample included 5 364 983 evaluation and management services performed by 10 352 hospital-affiliated clinicians in Rhode Island and other New England states. Analyses were performed from April 2024 through December 2025. Main Outcomes and Measures: Study outcomes included the share of vertically integrated clinicians and professional fees per evaluation and management encounter. Results: The study included 2 292 504 commercial enrollees (Rhode Island vs other New England states: female, 64.8% vs 59.6%; and age ≥65 years, 6.8% vs 6.4%). In 2013, vertically integrated clinicians accounted for a smaller share in Rhode Island vs other New England states (32.0% vs 46.4%), as did mean (SD) professional fees per evaluation and management encounter ($105.8 [$37.9] vs $141.7 [$61.8]). Vertical integration increased more slowly in Rhode Island compared with neighboring states (-0.4 percentage points [95% CI, -0.7 to -0.1 percentage points]) and the annual change in professional fees for hospital-affiliated clinicians in Rhode Island was $1.55 (95% CI, -$2.02 to -$1.08) lower per service than for those in other New England states. Conclusions and Relevance: This cross-sectional study of vertical integration and professional fees in Rhode Island compared with surrounding New England states found that Rhode Island hospitals did not circumvent the Affordability Standards through increased vertical integration activity or professional fees among integrated clinicians. This research suggests that hospital facility fee regulations may limit hospital bargaining leverage and market power along with price increases more broadly.

10.1001/jamanetworkopen.2026.30849.abstractZh:
重要性：针对日益严重的医院价格上涨问题，罗德岛州在2010年通过“可负担性标准”对医院费用增长设置了上限。研究发现，这一价格增长上限成功降低了与其它州相比的医院费用。然而，医院对于“可负担性标准”带来的收入损失所采取的应对措施——包括寻求招聘更多临床医生以及提高附属临床医生的非监管专业费用——尚不明确。  
目的：比较罗德岛州医院附属临床医生的垂直整合变化以及专业费用的变化，与其他新英格兰州医院的临床医生进行比较。  
设计、背景与参与者：这项横断面研究使用了2013年1月1日至2019年12月31日来自医疗保健成本研究所的数据来源的商业索赔数据，以及垂直整合临床医生的数据。分析样本包括罗德岛州和其他新英格兰州10,352家医院附属临床医生提供的5,364,983次评估和管理服务。分析时间跨度为2024年4月至2025年12月。  
主要结果与测量指标：研究结果包括垂直整合临床医生的占比以及每次评估和管理服务中的专业费用。  
结果：研究包括2,292,504名商业参保人员（罗德岛州与其他新英格兰州相比：女性比例分别为64.8%和59.6%；年龄≥65岁的比例分别为6.8%和6.4%）。2013年，罗德岛州垂直整合临床医生的比例低于其他新英格兰州（32.0% vs 46.4%），每次评估和管理服务的平均专业费用也较低（分别为$105.8和$141.7）。与邻近州相比，罗德岛的垂直整合进程增长更为缓慢（下降0.4个百分点[95%置信区间，介于-0.7至-0.1个百分点之间]），罗德岛医院附属临床医生的年度专业费用每服务一次比新英格兰其他州低1.55美元（95%置信区间，介于-2.02至-1.08美元之间）。结论与意义：这项关于罗德岛与周边新英格兰州在垂直整合和专业费用方面的横断面研究发现，罗德岛的医院并未通过增加垂直整合活动或提高附属临床医生的专业费用来规避可负担性标准。这项研究表明，医院费用规定可能会限制医院的议价能力和市场力量，同时也会进一步限制价格的上涨。

abstract.text: This paper examines the effect of robots on workplace injury benefits paid in South Korea. Using the administrative data on worker's compensation, I found that the increase in robot exposure contributes to the significant decline in the average benefit amount per covered worker, mainly driven by the reduction in the number of claims, rather than the size of claims. The effects are stronger, especially for serious cases such as permanent disability.

10.1002/hec.70033.abstractZh: 本文探讨了机器人对韩国工作场所伤害赔偿福利的影响。通过工人赔偿的行政数据分析，我发现机器人使用量的增加导致了每个受保工人的平均赔偿金额显著下降，这一变化主要源于索赔数量的减少，而非索赔金额的减少。这种影响在严重伤害案例（如永久性残疾）中更为明显。

abstract.text: We examine the causal effect of a French flu vaccination campaign on vaccination behavior. Individuals aged 65 and over receive an invitation letter with a voucher for a free flu shot, while those who are not eligible have to cover the costs themselves. Using a Fuzzy Regression Discontinuity Design, we find that receiving the invitation letter with the voucher leads to a significant increase in the likelihood of getting vaccinated. This effect is driven by individuals who are risk-averse. As illustrated in our theoretical model, for them, the costs of influenza infection outweigh the costs of the vaccine's side effects.

10.1002/hec.70037.abstractZh: 我们研究了法国流感疫苗接种活动对疫苗接种行为的因果效应。65岁及以上的个体会收到包含免费流感疫苗凭证的邀请函，而不符合资格条件的个体则需要自行承担费用。通过模糊回归不连续设计，我们发现收到包含凭证的邀请函会显著增加接种疫苗的可能性。这种效应主要由风险厌恶的个体所驱动。正如我们的理论模型所示，对他们来说，流感感染的成本超过了疫苗副作用的成本。

abstract.text: Previous research shows that choices are influenced by how probabilities are presented, that we value losses more than gains, and that we misunderstand cumulative probabilities over time. These factors are important when designing discrete choice experiments (DCEs) because almost all include some representation of probability over a time period. Contraceptive choice is one of the most common health choices and requires people to trade-off between efficacy, side effects, and modality. We used a DCE to explore whether people chose differently when faced with positive or negative framings of contraceptive effectiveness or valued 1-year or 3-year cumulative risks differentially. We developed a simple eight-task DCE with three attributes: effectiveness, administration frequency, and (non-)hormonal nature. Participants saw effectiveness as either positively or negatively, and with numerically equivalent 1-year and cumulative 3-year effectiveness values. We used mixed multinomial logistic regression models with interaction terms and explored preference heterogeneity. The negative frame increased sensitivity to effectiveness by 18% (p = 0.04) and sensitivity to cumulative effectiveness over 3 years was 10% less than over 1 year (p = 0.01). Preferences were heterogenous with respect to attributes but not framing effects. Attribute framing substantially affected preferences for effectiveness, and decisions around risk presentation should be reported transparently.

10.1002/hec.70039.abstractZh: 先前的研究表明，人们的决策受到概率呈现方式的影响，我们更重视损失而非收益，并且对时间推移中的累积概率存在误解。这些因素在设计离散选择实验时非常重要，因为几乎所有实验都涉及对一段时间内概率的某种表示方式。避孕选择是最常见的健康选择之一，人们需要在效果、副作用和避孕方式之间进行权衡。我们采用了一个离散选择实验来探讨，当人们面对避孕效果的积极或消极表述时，是否会做出不同的选择，或者他们对1年或3年的累积风险会有不同的评估。我们设计了一个包含三个属性的简单八项选择实验：效果、使用频率以及是否采用激素避孕。参与者将效果分为积极或消极两类，并且1年和3年的效果数值相当。我们使用混合多项逻辑回归模型，并考虑了交互项，以探究偏好异质性。消极表述使人们对效果的敏感度增加了18%（p = 0.04），而对3年累积效果的敏感度则比1年低了10%（p = 0.01）。不同参与者在属性偏好上存在差异，但表述方式对偏好没有影响。属性表述对效果的偏好有显著影响，因此在风险呈现方面的决策应透明地报告。

abstract.text: Children born with severe congenital conditions in low-income countries rank among the most disadvantaged among the global ultra-poor. We study the impact of clubfoot and its treatment across multiple dimensions of human flourishing on data collected from 564 children in Ethiopia. Working with Hope Walks, an organization that funds clubfoot interventions in numerous countries, we use a quasi difference-in-differences approach that generates counterfactual outcomes from the nearest-age siblings of children born with clubfoot, nested within a family-level fixed effect. We find that clubfoot status (early treatment) results in an impairment (restoration) of -1.44 σ$\sigma $ (0.91 σ$\sigma $ ) in physical mobility, -1.17 σ$\sigma $ (0.79 σ$\sigma $ ) in mental health, -1.07 σ$\sigma $ (0.64 σ$\sigma $ ) in social inclusion, -0.48 σ$\sigma $ (0.98 σ$\sigma $ ) in an education index, -0.76 σ$\sigma $ (0.42 σ$\sigma $ ) in religious faith, and -1.32 σ$\sigma $ (0.94 σ$\sigma $ ) in an aggregate index of human flourishing (all p<0.05$p< 0.05$ ). We attribute the large, broad, and significant impacts from clubfoot treatment to (i) a highly effective medical intervention that is (ii) carried out in an impoverished setting with scarce existing support for children born with disabilities, which (iii) broadly generates spillover effects across key development outcomes.

10.1002/hec.70040.abstractZh: 在低收入国家，患有严重先天性疾病的孩子属于全球最贫困群体中的弱势人群之一。本研究探讨了马蹄内翻足及其治疗对564名埃塞俄比亚儿童的影响，这些儿童的数据涵盖了人类发展的多个维度。我们与Hope Walks组织合作，该组织在许多国家资助马蹄内翻足的干预项目。我们采用了一种准差异-差异方法，从患有马蹄内翻足的儿童的最近年龄兄弟姐妹中生成反事实结果，这些结果嵌套在家庭层面的固定效应中。研究发现，马蹄内翻足的状态（早期治疗）导致身体活动能力下降1.44σ$\sigma$（0.91σ$\sigma$），心理健康状况下降1.17σ$\sigma$（0.79σ$\sigma$），社会融入程度下降1.07σ$\sigma$（0.64σ$\sigma$），教育指数下降0.48σ$\sigma$（0.98σ$\sigma$），宗教信仰下降0.76σ$\sigma$（0.42σ$\sigma$），以及人类发展综合指数下降1.32σ$\sigma$（0.94σ$\sigma$）。我们认为，马蹄内翻足治疗带来的巨大、广泛且显著的影响归因于以下几点：(i) 一种非常有效的医疗干预措施；(ii) 在贫困环境中实施，而针对残疾儿童的现有支持非常有限；(iii) 这种干预措施在关键发展成果上产生了广泛的溢出效应。

abstract.text: This paper reports the first large-scale longitudinal links between one of the least known dimensions of wellbeing-hope-and long-term outcomes in a range of life arenas. Hope has agentic properties which are relevant to people's future outcomes. Following 25,000 randomly sampled Australian adults over a period of 14 years from 2007 to 2021 (N > 115,000), we find a strong link between hope and better contemporary and future outcomes. Individuals with high levels of hope had improved later wellbeing, education, economic and employment outcomes, perceived and objective health, and are less likely to be lonely. Hope is associated with higher resilience, ability to adapt, and internal locus of control. It also serves as a psychological buffer during bad times. Respondents with high levels of hope were less likely to be influenced by negative life events and adapted more quickly and completely after these major events. Better understanding the drivers and consequences of hope can ultimately inform public policy to improve people's lives.

10.1002/hec.70041.abstractZh: 本文首次系统地探讨了幸福感、希望与多种生活领域长期结果之间的关联。希望具有与人们未来结果相关的能动性特征。通过对2007至2021年间随机抽取的25,000名澳大利亚成年人进行14年的跟踪研究（样本量超过115,000人），我们发现希望与当前及未来的更好结果之间存在密切关联。希望水平较高的个体在后续的幸福感、教育、经济与就业状况、感知与客观健康方面表现更好，且孤独感较低。希望还与更高的韧性、适应能力以及内在控制感相关。在困难时期，希望还能起到心理缓冲的作用。希望水平较高的受访者更不容易受到负面生活事件的影响，并在这些重大事件后能够更快、更全面地恢复。深入理解希望的驱动因素及其后果，有助于为改善人们生活的公共政策提供依据。

abstract.text: This study investigates geographical disparities in the implementation and effectiveness of the Affordable Care Act (ACA) by linking them to the historical legacy of racial oppression in the American South. Using a cross-border regression discontinuity design that leverages variations in racial oppression intensity, we find that bordering counties in states with less oppressive regime experienced significantly greater benefits from the ACA compared to neighboring counties in more oppressive states. This divergence in insurance outcomes, which did not exist before the ACA, underscores the influence of historical racial regimes on contemporary policy efficacy. Furthermore, we demonstrate that political preferences from the Jim Crow era are correlated with the observed variations in ACA effectiveness. Our findings suggest that the racialization of the ACA is deeply rooted in the historical context of racial oppression in the American South.

10.1002/hec.70042.abstractZh: 本研究通过将《平价医疗法案》的实施与效果中的地理差异与美国南部历史上的种族压迫传统联系起来，进行了探讨。采用基于种族压迫强度差异的跨境回归断点设计，我们发现，在种族压迫程度较低的州，与邻近的压迫性较强的州相比，相关县的《平价医疗法案》受益程度明显更高。这种保险结果上的差异在《平价医疗法案》实施之前并不存在，这凸显了历史种族制度对当代政策效果的影响。此外，我们还发现，从吉姆·克劳时代延续下来的政治偏好与《平价医疗法案》效果的差异之间存在关联。我们的研究结果表明，《平价医疗法案》的种族化特征深深植根于美国南部历史上的种族压迫背景之中。

abstract.text: With populations aging, long-term care (LTC) needs and costs rise, intensifying the reliance on informal care. Since spouses predominantly provide such care, it is crucial to understand the transition dynamics from widowhood to institutional LTC, which is the main driver of the public LTC costs in most OECD countries. Our study examines the causal effect of widowhood on the onset of needs for institutional LTC. For this we use recently developed event-time models that accommodate for variation in treatment time and dynamic effects of treatment. Our results show that partner loss significantly increases the need for institutional LTC. The average effect of partner loss on the need for institutional LTC peaks at a 1.5 percentage point rise 3 months after widowhood and disappears after 10 months. The effect is strongest for individuals with psycho-geriatric disorders, the oldest old and the frail. Addressing the immediate need for institutional LTC after widowhood remains critical for effective aging-in-place strategies.

10.1002/hec.70043.abstractZh: 随着人口老龄化，长期护理的需求和成本不断增加，使得人们对非正式护理的依赖程度加剧。由于配偶通常承担此类护理工作，因此了解从丧偶到接受机构化长期护理的过渡过程至关重要，这是大多数经合组织国家公共长期护理成本的主要驱动因素。本研究探讨了丧偶对机构化长期护理需求发生的影响。为此，我们采用了最近开发的事件时间模型，以处理治疗时间的差异以及治疗的动态效应。研究结果表明，伴侣的丧失显著增加了对机构化长期护理的需求。伴侣丧失对机构化长期护理需求的影响在丧偶后3个月达到峰值，上升1.5个百分点，并在10个月后消失。这一效应在患有心理老年病、年龄最大的老年人以及身体虚弱的人群中最为明显。解决丧偶后对机构化长期护理的即时需求对于有效的老龄化生活策略至关重要。

abstract.text: This paper explores the evolving role of health economics within economic research and publishing over the past 30 years. Historically, largely a niche field, health economics has become increasingly prominent, with the share of health economics papers in top journals growing significantly. We aim to identify the factors behind this rise. Using a combination of bibliometric methods and natural language processing (NLP), we classify abstracts to define health economics. Adapting NLP methods to evaluate the novelty, impact, and quality of academic papers, we demonstrate that the mainstreaming of health economics is driven by innovative, high-quality research, with two notable waves in quality ratings that highlight the emergence and impact of distinct subfields within the discipline. We find a strong positive correlation between citations and quality ratings, with health economics papers receiving fewer citations for their quality compared to other economics fields. Pandemic-related research received a high number of citations during 2020 and 2021; however, our findings indicate that this work was not systematically more novel or impactful than prior studies within the same subfield.

10.1002/hec.70044.abstractZh: 本文探讨了过去30年间健康经济学在经济研究和出版领域中的角色演变。历史上，健康经济学主要是一个小众领域，但如今其重要性日益凸显，顶级期刊中健康经济学论文的比例显著上升。我们旨在找出这一变化的背后因素。通过结合文献计量方法和自然语言处理技术，我们对摘要进行了分类，以定义健康经济学。利用自然语言处理技术评估学术论文的新颖性、影响力和质量，我们发现健康经济学的主流化是由创新性强、质量高的研究推动的。在质量评级方面，出现了两次明显的波动，这凸显了该学科内不同子领域的出现及其影响。我们发现，引用次数与质量评级之间存在强烈的正相关关系，与健康经济学论文相比，其他经济学领域的论文在质量方面获得的引用次数较少。与疫情相关的研究在2020年和2021年获得了大量引用；然而，我们的研究结果表明，这些研究在创新性或影响力上并不比同一子领域内的先前研究更为突出。

abstract.text: We study the effects of cognitive, noncognitive, and social skills on alcohol consumption, measured through total quantity, frequency, typical quantity, and binge drinking. Using the data from the NLSY79, we find that cognitive skills increase drinking frequency but reduce binge drinking and typical quantity. Noncognitive skills negatively impact frequency, typical quantity, and binge drinking, whereas social skills positively affect all measures of alcohol consumption. We present a framework and employ parametric causal mediation analysis to explore transmission channels, identifying mental wellness, future planning, and occupation prestige as significant mediators. However, the direction of this influence varies, highlighting the heterogeneity of the transmission channels.

10.1002/hec.70046.abstractZh: 我们研究了认知技能、非认知技能和社会技能对酒精消费的影响，通过总摄入量、饮酒频率、典型摄入量以及酗酒情况来衡量。利用NLSY79的数据，我们发现认知技能会增加饮酒频率，但会减少酗酒和典型摄入量。非认知技能对饮酒频率、典型摄入量和酗酒有负面影响，而社会技能则对所有酒精消费指标都有积极影响。我们提出了一个框架，并采用参数化因果中介分析来探索影响机制，发现心理健康、未来规划和职业声望是重要的中介因素。然而，这些影响的方向各不相同，这凸显了影响机制的异质性。

abstract.text: This paper examines the impacts of the Nitrogen Oxide Budget Program (NBP), a program that created a cap-and-trade market to regulate ozone pollution, on infant health outcomes. I employ the universe of birth records in the US from 1995 to 2008 and estimate how in-utero exposure to the NBP affected infant health using a triple-differences strategy. I find that exposure to the NBP improved infant health. Full exposure to the NBP reduces the incidence of low birth weight and very preterm birth by about 5.5% and 13%, respectively. Heterogeneity analyses suggest larger effects among Black mothers, low-educated mothers, and single mothers. I provide empirical evidence suggesting that endogenous changes in fertility behavior are unlikely to confound the estimates. A series of event studies do not support concerns that the effects reflect pre-existing trends in birth outcomes. Finally, I discuss the economic significance of the results in light of other exposures and their later-life impacts.

10.1002/hec.70047.abstractZh: 本文探讨了氮氧化物预算计划（NBP）对婴儿健康影响的研究。该计划通过设立排放限额交易市场来管控臭氧污染。本文利用1995至2008年美国出生记录数据，采用三重差分法分析子宫内暴露于NBP对婴儿健康的影响。研究发现，暴露于NBP有助于改善婴儿健康，其中完全暴露于NBP可使低出生体重和极早出生率分别降低约5.5%和13%。异质性分析表明，黑人母亲、教育水平较低的母亲以及单亲母亲受到的影响更为显著。实证数据表明，生育行为的内生变化不太可能干扰研究结果。一系列事件研究也表明，这些影响并不反映出生结果中已存在的趋势。最后，本文还讨论了这些结果的经济意义，以及它们对其他暴露因素及后期生活影响的潜在影响。

abstract.text: This paper examines the causal effect of crowding in maternity wards on medical treatment and health outcomes. To address endogeneity concerns, I focus on mothers and their newborns in Norwegian maternity wards and use the number of women with the same due date in a local area as an instrument for crowding. Using detailed administrative data covering all births in Norway over multiple years, I find that crowding-measured as a higher admission level- causes fewer unplanned readmissions and improved APGAR scores. On crowded days, mothers receive fewer inductions and other medical interventions, and no corresponding increase in reported complications. The instrumental variable strategy addresses potential endogeneity biases inherent in fixed-effects models and yields qualitatively similar estimates.

10.1002/hec.70048.abstractZh: 本文探讨了产科病房拥挤程度对医疗治疗及健康结果的影响。为了解决内生性问题的困扰，我重点关注挪威产科病房中的母亲及其新生儿，并采用同一预产期女性数量作为拥挤程度的衡量指标。通过利用涵盖挪威多年所有分娩情况的详细行政数据，我发现，以较高入院率为指标的拥挤程度能够减少计划外再入院现象，并提升婴儿阿普加评分。在拥挤的日子里，母亲接受的各种医疗干预措施减少，而报告的并发症数量也没有相应增加。采用工具变量策略能够解决固定效应模型中存在的内生性偏差问题，并得出与之前结果类似的结论。

abstract.text: The U.S. paid-sick-leave (PSL) mandates allow private-sector workers to take time off for their own or family members' illnesses. However, the impacts of these laws on workers' care seeking and provision activities are relatively understudied. We address this gap by exploiting cross-state variation in mandate enactment between 2012 and 2019. Using data from the American Time Use Survey, our difference-in-differences estimates show little evidence that PSL mandates affect the probability of spending time on overall care provision at the population level. However, we find a positive association between the mandates and care provided to adults by workers in industries with larger exposure to the policies. Our results provide empirical support for the potential of paid leave policies to help workers who otherwise have limited access to the benefit reconcile workplace responsibilities and caregiving.

10.1002/hec.70049.abstractZh: 美国的带薪病假规定允许私营部门的员工因个人或家庭成员的疾病而休假。然而，这些法律对工人寻求和提供护理活动的影响相对较少被研究。我们通过分析2012年至2019年间各州对这项规定的实施差异来填补这一空白。利用美国时间使用调查的数据，我们的差异比较估计显示，带薪病假规定对整体护理提供的时间分配几乎没有影响。不过，我们发现，对于那些受该政策影响较大的行业，工人提供的护理服务与带薪病假规定之间存在正相关关系。我们的研究结果为带薪休假政策在帮助那些原本难以获得此类福利的工人平衡工作责任与护理需求方面提供了实证支持。

abstract.text: Patient cost-sharing can lead to delays in necessary care, especially among low-income populations. In this study, we examine the impact of health insurance coverage for chronic disease treatments in outpatient care, using recent administrative insurance claims dataset from a low-income population in an underdeveloped city in China. Employing a propensity score matching and difference-in-differences approach, we find that outpatient coverage for certain chronic diseases increased outpatient utilization and expenses among patients with these conditions. Interestingly, these patients also increased their use of inpatient services, despite no changes in the cost-sharing for inpatient care. Our findings suggest the presence of delayed care, where outpatient visits helped patients recognize the severity of their diseases and increased the demand for inpatient care. These results have important implications for the implementation of universal health coverage and the dynamics of healthcare costs in low- and middle-income countries.

10.1002/hec.70050.abstractZh: 患者费用分担可能导致必要治疗的延误，尤其是在低收入人群中。本研究利用中国一个欠发达城市低收入人群的最新行政保险索赔数据集，探讨了健康保险覆盖对慢性病治疗门诊护理的影响。通过倾向评分匹配和差异-差异方法，我们发现，对某些慢性病的门诊覆盖增加了患有这些疾病的患者的门诊使用率和费用。有趣的是，尽管住院护理的费用没有变化，这些患者也增加了住院服务的使用。我们的研究结果表明，存在治疗延误的情况，门诊就诊帮助患者认识到疾病的严重性，从而增加了对住院护理的需求。这些结果对实现全民健康覆盖以及低收入和中等收入国家医疗成本的动态变化具有重要意义。

abstract.text: This paper examines the effects of increased trade between Japan and the U.S. on mortality rates in the U.S. using a shift-share instrumental variables approach. Overall, we find that an increase in Japanese imports is associated with higher rates of cardiovascular disease (CVD) mortality and lower rates of mortality from accidents. Effects of Japanese imports on deaths of despair are inconsistent, but there is a positive association between imports and drug-related deaths. These effects exhibit significant racial disparities. Specifically, a $1000 increase in import competition is associated with a 3.0% increase in CVD deaths per 100,000 Black individuals aged 20-64 years old, while there is no statistically significant effect among whites. Additionally, a $1000 increase in import competition is associated with a 13.5% increase in drug-related deaths per 100,000 Black individuals aged 20-64 years old compared to a 7.8% increase among white individuals. Effects on mortality rates from accidents are driven by deaths among whites. Our findings also indicate that the rise in CVD and drug-related mortality is concentrated among males and in regions with relatively high shares of employment in the automobile or computer industries.

10.1002/hec.70051.abstractZh: 本文采用转移份额工具变量方法，研究了日本与美国之间贸易增加对美国死亡率的影响。总体来看，我们发现日本进口增加与心血管疾病死亡率上升以及事故死亡率下降有关。日本进口对绝望导致的死亡的影响并不一致，但进口与药物相关死亡之间存在正相关关系。这些影响在种族层面表现出显著的差异：进口竞争每增加1000美元，20-64岁黑人个体的心血管疾病死亡率将增加3.0%，而白人群体则没有统计学上的显著影响。此外，进口竞争每增加1000美元，20-64岁黑人个体的药物相关死亡率将增加13.5%，而白人群体则增加7.8%。事故死亡率的变化则主要由白人群体的死亡情况所驱动。我们的研究还表明，心血管疾病和药物相关死亡的上升主要集中在男性以及就业比例较高的汽车或计算机行业地区。

abstract.text: While the labor market effects of industrial robots have been extensively studied, their broader health implications, particularly on chronic diseases, remain unexplored. This study fills this gap by linking China's national-industry robot adoption data to individual health records from the China Health and Nutrition Survey (CHNS). Employing a city-level Bartik-type instrumental variable strategy, our Two-Stage Least Squares (2SLS) estimates reveal that an increase of one robot per thousand workers in a city reduces local probability of individuals having chronic diseases by 8.67%. The mechanisms driving these health benefits include better working conditions, better physical and mental well-being, and healthier lifestyle choices. A cost-benefit analysis suggests these health benefits are substantial, significantly outweighing the robots' acquisition costs. Our findings from China highlight a crucial, yet overlooked, positive externality of automation on public health in developing economies.

10.1002/hec.70052.abstractZh: 虽然工业机器人的劳动力市场效应已经得到了广泛研究，但它们对健康的更广泛影响，尤其是对慢性病的影響，仍然未被充分探讨。本研究通过将中国的全国工业机器人采用数据与《中国健康与营养调查》中的个人健康记录联系起来，填补了这一空白。采用城市级别的Bartik型工具变量策略，我们的两阶段最小二乘法估计显示，在一个城市中，每千名工人增加一台机器人，可以使得个体患慢性病的概率降低8.67%。推动这些健康益处的机制包括更好的工作条件、更好的身体和心理健康，以及更健康的生活方式选择。成本效益分析表明，这些健康益处非常显著，其价值远远超过机器人的购置成本。我们在中国的研究结果表明，自动化在发展中国家对公共健康具有一个至关重要且被忽视的积极外部性。

abstract.text: We analyze the short- and long-term impacts of maternity ward closures using registry data on every delivery in Norway from 1981 through 2019. Among those directly experiencing a closure, we find a small decline in 5-minute Apgar score and increased probability of birth outside institution. Since this drop in Apgar is not reflected across the other indicators, we hypothesize it reflects different institutional scoring standards as opposed to a health effect. For long-term outcomes, we find treatment as an infant increases the likelihood of beginning high school by 1 percentage point, but has no effect on graduating. Furthermore, for infants assigned female at birth, we find early-life treatment does not change the probability of giving birth as an adult or experiencing negative health conditions during pregnancy. We hypothesize robust prenatal care and health and social services may mitigate the impact of closures and thus account for a limited treatment effect.

10.1002/hec.70053.abstractZh: 我们利用1981年至2019年间挪威所有分娩的登记数据，分析了产科病房关闭对短期和长期的影响。在直接受到关闭影响的群体中，我们发现5分钟Apgar评分略有下降，且在非医疗机构分娩的概率增加。由于Apgar评分的下降并未在其他指标中体现出来，我们假设这反映了不同的机构评分标准，而非对健康产生负面影响。从长期结果来看，我们发现婴儿接受早期治疗会使开始上高中的可能性增加1个百分点，但对毕业率没有影响。此外，对于出生时被指定为女婴的婴儿，我们发现早期治疗并不会改变成年后分娩的概率或孕期出现不良健康状况的概率。我们假设完善的产前护理以及健康和社会服务可能能够减轻关闭带来的影响，从而解释有限的治疗效果。

abstract.text: Health and well-being in the family context can be affected by care giving arrangements. Following parental care and daycare, grandparents are the third most important care givers for children in many Western societies. Despite the relevance of grandparental care, there is little evidence on the causal effects of this care mode on the next generations' health and well-being. In this paper, we fill this gap by investigating the causal impact of regular grandparental care on the self-reported health and (domain-specific) satisfaction of both parents and children. To do so, we exploit geographic distance to grandparents as a source of arguably exogenous variation and use representative German panel data for families with children under the age of 11. Our results suggest positive effects on parental satisfaction with the child care situation, as well as mothers' satisfaction with their leisure time. However, we also find negative effects on children's health, particularly for elementary school aged children and for boys.

10.1002/hec.70054.abstractZh: 家庭环境中的健康与福祉可能受到照料安排的影响。在父母照料和日间照料之后，祖父母在许多西方社会中是第三重要的儿童照料者。尽管祖父母照料具有重要意义，但关于这种照料模式对下一代健康与福祉的因果效应，目前缺乏足够的证据。本文通过研究定期接受祖父母照料对父母及儿童自我报告的健康状况以及（特定领域的）满意度的影响，来填补这一空白。为此，我们利用了祖父母与子女之间的地理距离作为潜在的外生变量，并使用了有11岁以下儿童的家庭的代表性德国面板数据。我们的研究结果表明，定期接受祖父母照料对父母对儿童照料的满意度以及母亲对闲暇时间的满意度都有积极影响。然而，我们也发现，这种照料模式对儿童的健康有负面影响，尤其是在小学阶段和男孩身上。

abstract.text: This study examines the impact of enhanced social care provided through the Australian National Disability Insurance Scheme (NDIS) on subsidized healthcare utilisation for people with disability. Using linked administrative datasets from 2011 to 2020, we employed a Difference-in-Difference model and the staggered rollout of the NDIS to assess its effects on healthcare services, focusing on visits to general practitioners (GP), mental healthcare providers, allied health professionals, specialists, and mental health prescriptions. The results show that the NDIS reduced subsidized mental health services and allied health services in the six quarters after enrollment. However, it did not significantly affect visits to GP, specialists, or mental health prescriptions. These effects were most pronounced among individuals aged 0-24 years, males, and those living in major cities. The findings suggest that services available from NDIS may substitute for subsidized healthcare services by providing non-clinical care through social care channels. Further research is needed to investigate the long-term effects and health outcomes of the NDIS.

10.1002/hec.70055.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了通过澳大利亚国家残疾保险计划提供的加强社会关怀对残疾人群体补贴性医疗保健使用的影响。我们利用2011至2020年的关联行政数据集，采用差异模型以及NDIS的分阶段实施策略，评估其对医疗服务的影响，重点关注对全科医生、心理健康服务提供者、辅助健康专业人员、专科医生以及心理健康处方的访问情况。研究结果显示，在注册后的六个季度中，NDIS减少了补贴性心理健康服务和辅助健康服务的提供。然而，它对全科医生、专科医生的访问次数以及心理健康处方的使用并未产生显著影响。这些影响在0-24岁年龄组、男性以及居住在大城市的人群中最为明显。研究结果表明，NDIS提供的服务可能通过社会关怀渠道提供非临床护理，从而替代补贴性医疗保健服务。需要进一步的研究来探讨NDIS的长期影响及健康结果。

abstract.text: A substantial proportion of alcohol related fatalities and their consequences are preventable, prompting policymakers to implement measures aimed at reducing these deaths. I exploit time and geographic variation in the adoption of zero-tolerance laws in a difference-in-differences design to study the impact of these regulations on traffic-related incidents. Using county-level data, I find no sizable reductions in fatalities and an increase in injury counts after the adoption of such laws. I do not find significant changes in several measures of alcohol consumption, consistent with the lack of reduction in driving fatalities.

10.1002/hec.70056.abstractZh: 与酒精相关的死亡事件及其后果中有很大一部分是可以预防的，这促使政策制定者采取措施以减少这些死亡事件。我采用差异-差异设计，利用时间和地理差异来研究零容忍法律在减少交通事故方面的效果。通过县级数据分析，我发现这些法律实施后，死亡人数并没有显著减少，而受伤人数却有所增加。此外，我并未发现酒精消费方面的显著变化，这与驾驶死亡事件减少的情况一致。

abstract.text: This study investigates the long-term health effects of early childhood exposure to the U.S. Child and Dependent Care Tax Credit (CDCTC). Using longitudinal data from the Child Development Supplement of the Panel Study of Income Dynamics, we examine the connection between early-life CDCTC exposure and health outcomes for children aged 6-18. The findings reveal varied effects depending on maternal education: children of mothers with more than a high school education experience adverse physical and mental health outcomes. In contrast, children of mothers who have a high school education or less show improvements in their mental health. These results indicate that, despite its intention to aid working families, the CDCTC may have complex effects on children's health, influenced by socio-economic factors. This study highlights the need for careful policy designs that consider the varying needs of families with different socio-economic statuses.

10.1002/hec.70058.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了儿童早期接触美国儿童及抚养者税收抵免政策对长期健康影响的情况。通过《收入动态面板研究》中的儿童发展补充数据，我们考察了儿童在6至18岁期间接触该政策与健康状况之间的关联。研究发现，母亲的教育水平对儿童的健康影响存在差异：拥有高中学历以上母亲的子女在身体和心理健康方面面临不良后果；而拥有高中或更低学历母亲的子女则表现出心理健康方面的改善。这些结果表明，尽管该政策旨在帮助有工作的家庭，但其对儿童健康的复杂影响可能受到社会经济因素的影响。本研究强调了需要制定细致的政策设计，以考虑不同社会经济地位家庭的不同需求。

abstract.text: Doctor and non-doctor visit frequencies are key indicators of healthcare access, utilization and individual health-seeking behavior. While doctor visits reflect engagement with formal medical services, non-doctor visits, such as to nurses, physiotherapists or alternative providers, offer insights into patient preferences and system adaptability. Modeling these outcomes separately can hide relevant interdependencies and hence lead to incomplete conclusions. To address this, we employ a copula additive distributional regression framework to jointly model doctor and non-doctor visits as flexible functions of demographic, socioeconomic and health-related covariates. The estimation approach allows all the distributional parameters, including location, scale and the dependence structure, to vary with covariates via additive predictors. Application of the model to data from the 2012 Medical Expenditure Panel Survey reveals key determinants of physician and non-physician visits, such as age, income and health status. Importantly, the method allows for the modeling of shared unobserved heterogeneity and effectively captures how changes in one type of utilization influence the other, thereby yielding a deeper understanding of healthcare behavior.

10.1002/hec.70059.abstractZh: 医生和非医生就诊频率是评估医疗获取、利用和个人健康寻求行为的关键指标。虽然医生就诊反映了与正式医疗服务的互动，而非医生就诊，如向护士、物理治疗师或其他替代服务提供者就诊，则能揭示患者的偏好以及医疗系统的适应性。分别建模这些结果可能会忽略相关的相互依赖性，从而导致结论不完整。为此，我们采用Copula加性分布回归框架，将医生和非医生就诊作为人口统计、社会经济和健康相关协变量的灵活函数进行联合建模。该估计方法允许所有分布参数，包括位置、规模和依赖结构，通过加性预测因子随协变量而变化。将模型应用于2012年医疗支出调查的数据，可以揭示医生和非医生就诊的关键决定因素，如年龄、收入和健康状况。重要的是，该方法能够建模共享的未观测异质性，并有效捕捉一种利用方式的变化如何影响另一种利用方式，从而更深入地理解医疗行为。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the impact of medical care delays on infant and maternal health by leveraging Medical Procedure Delay Orders (MPDOs) issued by over 30 U.S. states at the onset of the COVID-19 pandemic and analyzing a large national claims dataset. I find that in utero exposure to MPDOs increases the likelihood of being diagnosed with newborn disorders related to adverse birth outcomes by 13%. Women exposed to MPDOs during pregnancy-particularly in the first and second trimesters-experience delays in critical prenatal care, such as ultrasounds and the detection of gestational health conditions. These disruptions likely contribute to the observed increase in adverse birth outcomes. The findings highlight the intergenerational and long-term consequences of interrupted maternal care.

10.1002/hec.70060.abstractZh: 本文通过利用美国30个州在COVID-19疫情爆发期间发布的医疗程序延迟指令，并分析一个大型全国索赔数据集，研究了医疗护理延迟对婴儿和母亲健康的影响。研究发现，在怀孕期间暴露于医疗程序延迟指令的女性，被诊断出与不良出生结果相关的新生儿疾病的可能性增加了13%。特别是在怀孕的第一和第二季度，这些女性会面临关键的产前护理延迟，如超声波检查以及妊娠健康状况的检测。这些中断可能导致不良出生结果的增加。研究结果强调了中断母亲护理所带来的代际和长期影响。

abstract.text: Monetary incentives for vaccination may undermine intrinsic motivation, but evidence on this effect remains scarce. We conducted an experiment among 513 vaccine-hesitant adults to test whether priming individuals with a monetary incentive reduces their willingness to vaccinate against COVID-19. Our findings show that one in seven were willing to vaccinate without an incentive but declined the vaccine when asked to consider a payment. Additionally, priming participants lowered their perceptions of vaccine safety by 9 pp and prosocial attitudes toward vaccination by 10 pp. These negative effects were concentrated among men, racial and ethnic minorities, and participants with lower preexisting trust in the vaccine. Our results highlight an unintended consequence of vaccine incentives.

10.1002/hec.70061.abstractZh: 货币激励可能会削弱人们的内在动机，但关于这一效应的证据仍然很少。我们在513名不愿接种疫苗的成年人中进行了实验，以测试用货币激励来促使人们接种疫苗是否会降低他们的接种意愿。研究发现，有七分之一的人在没有激励的情况下愿意接种疫苗，但在被要求考虑支付报酬时，他们放弃了接种。此外，激励措施还降低了参与者对疫苗安全性的认知，降低了他们对接种疫苗的积极态度。这些负面效应主要集中在男性、少数族裔以及那些对疫苗信任度较低的参与者身上。我们的研究结果揭示了疫苗激励带来的一个意外后果。

abstract.text: Using comprehensive U.S. drug claims data, we show that adherence to asthma control medication declined during the COVID-19 pandemic. We find that young children exhibited a 40 percent decrease in adherence by the end of 2020. The responses were less negative for older children and positive for adults. We provide additional evidence that parental attention played a role in driving this decrease, based on heterogeneity by pre-pandemic mail order usage and number of parental scripts. Policy implications for improving pediatric adherence are discussed.

10.1002/hec.70062.abstractZh: 通过利用全面的美国药品索赔数据，我们发现，在COVID-19疫情期间，儿童对哮喘控制药物的依从性有所下降。研究发现，到2020年底，幼儿的依从性下降了40%。而较大年龄儿童的依从性下降幅度较小，成人的依从性则有所提升。我们还发现，基于疫情前的邮购使用情况和父母处方数量的不同，父母的关注在导致这种下降中起到了一定作用。文章还讨论了改善儿童药物依从性的政策建议。

abstract.text: We propose a method for studying the value of insurance. For this purpose, we analyze the well-being of the same individuals, comparing sick and healthy years, using German panel survey data on life satisfaction. We impose structure on the income-well-being gradient by fitting a flexible utility function to the data, focusing on the differences in marginal utility in the sick and the healthy states. Notably, our empirical specification allows for a "fixed cost of sickness." We find a higher marginal utility of income in the sick state. We use our estimates to gauge the value of sickness insurance for Baily-Chetty-type optimal policy calculations.

10.1002/hec.70063.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种研究保险价值的方法。为此，我们分析了相同个体的福祉状况，比较了患病与健康年份的情况，并使用了关于生活满意度的德国面板调查数据。我们通过拟合一个灵活的效用函数来构建收入与福祉之间的关系模型，重点关注患病与健康状态下边际效用的差异。值得注意的是，我们的实证分析假设了“疾病固定成本”的存在。我们发现，在患病状态下，收入的边际效用更高。我们利用这些估计结果来评估疾病保险在Baily-Chetty型最优政策计算中的价值。

abstract.text: Primary medical care has traditionally been provided by small organisations. Recent policy developments in many countries have encouraged larger practices in the hope of benefiting from increasing returns to scale, but there is little research evidence to support this. Using monthly data from 6149 primary care practices in England between August 2022 and July 2024, we applied a Generalized Linear Model with a logarithmic link and Poisson distribution to examine the relationship between staffing levels and appointment volumes. At the median level of administrative staffing, the estimated marginal productivity of doctors and other clinical staff on total appointments are 223 and 152 per month, respectively. The marginal effects of all types of staff on appointment volumes increase with staffing levels. We plot the isoquant and isocost curves at the median level of production and examine the implications of our findings for skill-mix and patient access. The current ratios of doctors to other clinical staff and nurses to Direct Patient Care (DPC) staff are lower than cost optimal, though this is less of an issue for larger practices who benefit more from DPC roles. Additional clinical staff improve patient access more when employed in larger practices.

10.1002/hec.70064.abstractZh: 传统上，初级医疗主要由小型组织提供。许多国家最近的政策发展鼓励了更大规模诊所的设立，以期从规模经济中获益，但几乎没有研究证据支持这一观点。我们利用2022年8月至2024年7月期间英格兰6149家初级医疗诊所的月度数据，采用具有对数链接函数和泊松分布的广义线性模型，来研究人员配置水平与预约量之间的关系。在中等水平的行政人员配置下，医生和其他临床工作人员每月在总预约上的边际生产率分别约为223和152。各类工作人员对预约量的边际影响随着人员配置水平的增加而增加。我们绘制了中等生产水平下的等产量曲线和等成本曲线，并探讨了我们的发现对技能组合和患者获取的影响。目前，医生与其他临床工作人员以及护士与直接患者护理工作人员的比例低于成本最优水平，不过对于从直接患者护理工作中获得更多收益的较大规模诊所来说，这个问题就不那么严重了。在较大规模诊所中，额外的临床工作人员能更有效地改善患者的获取能力。

abstract.text: While extensive research has examined the impacts of fatal infectious diseases, relatively little attention has been devoted to neglected tropical diseases (NTDs), which are typically non-fatal but impose significant health, social, and economic burdens. This study investigates the effects of a comprehensive schistosomiasis prevention and control policy implemented in China in 2006 on disease prevalence, as well as on the health and educational outcomes of compulsory education age children who had in-utero exposure to the policy. Using the policy as a quasi-experiment, we employ a difference-in-differences (DID) identification strategy. We find that the policy reduced schistosomiasis prevalence and led to improvements in both health and educational outcomes among children with in-utero exposure. Heterogeneity analysis reveals that these effects are primarily driven by boys. The exploration of potential mechanisms indicates the policy improved family income and educational expenditure. The results of this study provide empirical support for the effectiveness of a comprehensive prevention and control policy targeting schistosomiasis and possibly many other NTDs.

10.1002/hec.70065.abstractZh: 虽然已有大量研究探讨了致命传染病的危害，但针对通常被认为非致命性但会给健康、社会和经济带来重大负担的被忽视热带疾病的研究却相对较少。本研究调查了2006年中国实施的全面血吸虫病预防和控制政策对疾病发病率的影响，以及那些在子宫内就暴露于该政策下的儿童在健康和教育方面的表现。通过将该政策作为准实验，我们采用了差异-差异识别策略。研究发现，该政策降低了血吸虫病的发病率，并改善了那些在子宫内就暴露于该政策的儿童的健康和教育状况。异质性分析表明，这些效果主要由男孩所体现。对潜在机制的探讨表明，该政策提高了家庭收入和教育支出。本研究的结果为针对血吸虫病及其他可能被忽视的热带疾病实施全面预防和控制政策的有效性提供了实证支持。

abstract.text: Low birth weight and preterm birth are key indicators of neonatal health, influencing both immediate and long-term infant outcomes. While low birth weight may reflect fetal growth restrictions, preterm birth captures disruptions in gestational development. Ignoring the potential interdependence between these variables may lead to an incomplete understanding of their shared determinants and underlying dynamics. To address this, a copula distributional regression framework is adopted to jointly model both indicators as flexible functions of maternal characteristics and geographic effects. Applied to female birth data from North Carolina, the methodology identifies shared factors of low birth weight and preterm birth, and reveals how maternal health, socioeconomic conditions and geographic disparities shape neonatal risk. The joint modeling approach provides a more nuanced understanding of these birth metrics, offering insights that can inform targeted interventions, prenatal care strategies and public health planning.

10.1002/hec.70067.abstractZh: 低出生体重和早产是新生儿健康的关键指标，它们影响着婴儿的直接和长期发展。虽然低出生体重可能反映了胎儿生长受限，但早产则反映了妊娠期间的发育中断。忽视这两个变量之间的潜在相互依赖性，可能会导致对它们共同决定因素和潜在动态的理解不完整。为了解决这个问题，采用了一种联合分布回归框架，将这两个指标作为母亲特征和地理效应的灵活函数进行联合建模。该方法应用于北卡罗来纳州的女性生育数据，识别出低出生体重和早产的共同因素，并揭示了母亲健康、社会经济条件和地理差异如何塑造新生儿风险。这种联合建模方法为这些生育指标提供了更细致的理解，为制定有针对性的干预措施、产前护理策略和公共卫生规划提供了重要启示。

abstract.text: This study investigates the impact of the Earned Income Tax Credit (EITC) on work disability and Social Security Disability Insurance (DI) claims among Americans. Utilizing the Panel Study of Income Dynamics, we examine the effects of EITC exposure from birth to mid-adulthood on work disability risk before retirement. Our analysis reveals that EITC exposure during adulthood significantly reduces the likelihood of work disability, potentially influencing DI trends. Specifically, a $10,000 increase in cumulative EITC exposure is associated with about a 1.25 percentage-point lower probability of any work limitation at ages 50-61 (a 0.94 percentage-point reduction in the likelihood of chronic/severe limitations) and a 0.84 percentage-point reduction in DI receipt, highlighting the EITC's potential role in reducing DI dependency and its broader implications for public policy and social welfare.

10.1002/hec.70068.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了劳动所得税收抵免对美国人工作残疾和社会安全残疾保险索赔的影响。通过收入动态面板研究，我们考察了从出生到成年中期接触劳动所得税收抵免对退休前工作残疾风险的影响。分析结果显示，成年期接触劳动所得税收抵免显著降低了工作残疾的可能性，可能对社会安全残疾保险的趋势产生重要影响。具体而言，累计劳动所得税收抵免增加10,000美元，与50-61岁时有约1.25个百分点的工作限制概率降低相关（即慢性/严重限制的可能性降低0.94个百分点），同时社会安全残疾保险领取金额减少0.84个百分点，这凸显了劳动所得税收抵免在减少社会安全残疾保险依赖方面的潜在作用，以及其对公共政策和社会福利的更广泛影响。

abstract.text: In France, the Couverture Maladie Universelle Complémentaire (CMU-C) scheme is a means-tested, state-financed, complementary health insurance program that fully covers healthcare. Using administrative claims data and a staggered difference-in-differences approach, we estimate the impact of enrollment in the program on healthcare utilization. To address selection into the program, we use health shocks at the family level to exogenize individual enrollment. The findings indicate that access to free healthcare significantly increases healthcare utilization at both intensive and extensive margins. This effect is driven primarily by individuals who are uninsured before enrolling in the CMU-C. Moreover, individuals with severe or chronic illnesses, who already receive additional public coverage for their conditions, experience significant gains from the CMU-C coverage. Finally, these effects persist throughout the coverage period.

10.1002/hec.70070.abstractZh: 在法国，补充全民健康保险计划（CMU-C）是一项基于经济状况、由国家资助的补充性健康保险计划，全面覆盖医疗保健服务。我们利用行政索赔数据以及差异中的差异方法，评估了该计划参保对医疗使用的影响。为了处理进入计划的选择效应，我们采用家庭层面的健康冲击来外生个体参保行为。研究结果表明，免费医疗保健的获取显著增加了医疗使用的频率，无论是在密集型还是广泛型医疗领域。这一效应主要源于那些在参保前没有保险的个人。此外，对于患有严重或慢性疾病且已获得额外公共保险覆盖的个体来说，CMU-C的覆盖带来了显著的收益。最后，这些效应在整个保险期间都持续存在。

abstract.text: This study estimates the effects on perinatal mental health of the state's minimum wage and earned income tax credit (EITC), controlling for other policies and state-level factors. Using data from the Pregnancy Risk Assessment Monitoring System for 2012-2018 births we find robust evidence that minimum wages and EITC levels reduce depression before pregnancy and suggestive evidence of minimum wages reducing postpartum depression, at least for married respondents. Our estimates suggest that a one dollar increase in the minimum wage ($100 increase in the state EITC) reduces pre-pregnancy depression by roughly 8.5% (1.5%). These findings stand up to standard robustness and falsification tests, including event study analyses, a wide array of alternative specifications, and finding no effect for those unlikely to benefit (e.g., college-educated respondents). A supplementary analysis using data from the Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System suggests that state EITC levels may reduce mental distress during pregnancy. We investigate possible mechanisms by providing a descriptive analysis of the income and work behavior of such households, which shows the wide reach of these policies, and investigating a broad set of outcomes from the PRAMS, such as financial stressors, health insurance and birth outcomes.

10.1002/hec.70071.abstractZh: 本研究通过控制其他政策和州级因素，评估了州政府规定的最低工资和劳动所得税收抵免对围产期心理健康的影响。利用2012-2018年出生的孕妇风险评估监测系统的数据，我们发现最低工资和劳动所得税收抵免水平能够降低怀孕前的抑郁症状，并且有证据表明最低工资能够降低产后抑郁，至少对于已婚受访者来说是这样。我们的估计表明，最低工资提高1美元（州劳动所得税收抵免增加100美元）可使怀孕前的抑郁症状减少约8.5%（即1.5%）。这些发现通过了标准稳健性和虚假检验，包括事件研究分析、多种替代模型分析，并且没有发现那些不太可能受益的人群（如受过大学教育的受访者）受到影响的证据。另外，利用行为风险因素监测系统的数据进行的补充分析表明，州劳动所得税收抵免水平可能有助于降低怀孕期间的心理健康问题。我们通过描述性分析这些家庭的收入和劳动行为，来探讨可能的机制，这显示了这些政策的广泛影响。同时，我们还从孕妇风险评估监测系统中收集了包括财务压力、健康保险和出生结果等广泛的结果。

abstract.text: We investigate how disability insurance (DI) generosity affects DI take-up and labor market participation in a setting where benefits can be cumulated with substantial labor earnings. Using rich administrative data on Italian private-sector workers and a Regression Discontinuity in Time design, we find a large behavioral response to DI generosity, with an elasticity of 1.26 in DI take-up, while employment effects are minor and concentrated among immigrants. Our identification strategy exploits a major social security reform that reduced the expected DI replacement rate and generated a clear income effect. To address unobserved heterogeneity and the unobservability of underlying disability, we focus on individuals affected by acute cardiovascular shocks whose DI eligibility is plausibly exogenous. Overall, our results suggest that when earnings cumulability is extensive, DI is widely perceived as a complement to labor income. This has important implications for the design of labor-inclusive DI schemes.

10.1002/hec.70072.abstractZh: 我们研究了残疾保险慷慨程度如何影响残疾保险的普及率和劳动力市场的参与情况，这种环境下，保险福利可以与可观的劳动报酬相叠加。通过利用意大利私营部门工人的丰富行政数据，并采用时间上的回归不连续设计，我们发现人们对残疾保险慷慨程度有显著的行为反应，其弹性为1.26，而就业效应则较为微弱，且主要集中在移民群体中。我们的识别策略利用了一次重大的社会保障改革，该改革降低了残疾保险的预期替代率，并产生了明显的收入效应。为了应对未观测到的异质性和残疾原因的不可观测性，我们重点关注了那些因急性心血管冲击而受到影响的个体，他们的残疾保险资格显然是外生的。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，当劳动报酬的叠加效应较为普遍时，残疾保险被广泛视为劳动收入的补充。这对设计包含劳动力的残疾保险方案具有重要意义。

abstract.text: This paper quantifies physician agency in China's prescription drug market by exploiting the structural shift created by the Zero-Markup Drug Policy. We find that physicians' prescribing decisions are about three times more sensitive to the hospital's profit margin than to the retail price faced by patients. The study provides several key findings. First, government policy exerts a strong influence on drug prices. Second, branded drugs are generally preferred over generics and display lower price elasticity. Third, the policy accounts for more than half of the observed decline in average wholesale prices. Finally, while the policy improves patient welfare, it reduces pharmaceutical firms' sales and profits, and a partial restoration of drug markups could increase overall social welfare.

10.1002/hec.70073.abstractZh: 本文通过分析零价格药品政策带来的结构变化，量化了我国处方药市场中医生的干预行为。研究发现，医生在处方决策时对医院利润率的敏感度是患者对零售价格敏感度的三倍左右。研究得出几个重要结论：首先，政府政策对药品价格有显著影响；其次，品牌药品通常比仿制药更受青睐，且价格弹性较低；第三，政策因素占平均批发价格下降幅度的一半以上；最后，虽然该政策提升了患者福利，但降低了制药企业的销售额和利润，部分恢复药品加价可能会提升整体社会福利。

abstract.text: Annually, countries allocate hundreds of millions of dollars to subsidize fossil fuels, often at the expense of public health and environmental sustainability. This undermines progress toward Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) 3 (Good Health and Well-Being) and 13 (Climate Action). Despite this, the impact of fossil fuel subsidies (FFS) on social protection expenditure, including health, remains poorly quantified. This study aimed to determine whether FFS crowd out health expenditure globally, using panel data from 126 countries covering the period 2015-2019. An instrumental variable approach, relying on countries' exposure to international energy trade and fluctuations in crude oil price, was employed to capture exogenous variation in FFS and estimate a causal relationship. The analyses revealed that in 2019, 17 countries spent more than five percent of GDP on FFS, with FFS expenditure exceeding health expenditure in 15 of those countries. Specifically, a 1% increase in FFS per capita, driven by rising international oil prices and weighted by countries' exposure to international energy trade, led to a 0.05% (95% CI -0.08% to -0.02%) decrease in domestic health expenditure per capita. These findings underscore the detrimental impact of FFS on health expenditure, presenting another reason to eliminate FFS to achieve SDG3 in addition to avoiding further dangerous climate heating.

10.1002/hec.70074.abstractZh: 每年，各国都会拨款数亿美元用于补贴化石燃料，这往往以牺牲公共健康和环境可持续性为代价。这阻碍了实现可持续发展目标3（良好的健康与福祉）和13（气候行动）的进展。尽管如此，化石燃料补贴对社会保护支出，包括健康领域的支出影响，仍然缺乏量化研究。本研究旨在利用2015-2019年间126个国家的面板数据，确定化石燃料补贴是否在全球范围内挤占健康支出。研究采用了工具变量方法，依据各国对国际能源贸易的依赖程度以及原油价格的波动，来捕捉化石燃料补贴的外生变化，并估算其因果关系。分析结果显示，2019年有17个国家将超过5%的GDP用于化石燃料补贴，其中15个国家的化石燃料补贴支出超过了健康支出。具体而言，由于国际油价上涨，人均化石燃料补贴每增加1%，会导致国内健康支出人均减少0.05%（95%置信区间：-0.08%至-0.02%）。这些发现凸显了化石燃料补贴对健康支出的负面影响，为消除化石燃料补贴以实现可持续发展目标3提供了另一个理由，同时也有助于避免进一步的气候变暖威胁。

abstract.text: We extend the Rothshild and Stiglitz (1976) model to two sources of risk -inpatient and outpatient risk- to better proxy real-world health insurance markets. We uncover an interesting theoretical possibility: Take individuals A and B, who are low risks in, say, the inpatient dimension but A is riskier in the outpatient dimension. Then, A may enjoy less coverage than B in the inpatient dimension (coverage reversal). This phenomenon indicates that when testing for adverse selection in a given dimension, one has to treat individuals who differ in the other dimension separately. With this insight in mind, we adapt the Chiappori and Salanié (2000) positive correlation test to this multi-dimensionality and use it to test for adverse selection using individual-level claims data for the privately insured in Chile. This empirical analysis indicates that overlooking the aforementioned need of separating samples can potentially lead to biased conclusions.

10.1002/hec.70075.abstractZh: 我们将Rothshild和Stiglitz（1976年）的模型扩展为包含两个风险来源——住院风险与门诊风险，以更好地模拟现实中的健康保险市场。我们发现了一个有趣的理论可能性：假设个体A和B在住院风险方面属于低风险，但在门诊风险方面A的风险更高。那么，在住院风险方面，A的保险覆盖程度可能会低于B（即覆盖度逆转）。这一现象表明，在检测某一风险维度的逆向选择问题时，必须分别对待在另一维度上存在差异的个体。基于这一见解，我们将Chiappori和Salanié（2000年）的正相关检验方法应用于这种多维度情况，并利用智利私人保险客户的个体级索赔数据来检测逆向选择现象。实证分析表明，忽视上述样本分离的需求可能会导致结论偏差。

abstract.text: How does individuals' health status evolve over time? Is this evolution characterized by any socio-economic gradient? To answer these questions, this paper proposes a new intuitive and normatively grounded criterion to assess and compare health dynamics over time accounting for population heterogeneities. Implementing this criterion to European data, this paper provides the first pan-European evidence on health dynamics and related heterogeneities from 2005 to 2019. It shows that socio-economic gradients have played an important role in shaping the health dynamics experienced by the European population. These dynamics appear progressive with respect to the pure economic status of individuals determined by their level of income. This feature is reverted when the economic conditions of individuals are widened to include non-pure monetary aspects such as professional condition and parental background.

10.1002/hec.70076.abstractZh: 个体的健康状况如何随时间演变？这种演变是否呈现出某种社会经济梯度特征？为了回答这些问题，本文提出了一种新的直观且基于规范性的标准，用于评估和比较随时间变化的健康动态，同时考虑人口的异质性。通过将这一标准应用于欧洲的数据，本文首次提供了2005至2019年间关于健康动态及相关异质性的全欧洲证据。研究表明，社会经济梯度在塑造欧洲人口的健康动态中发挥了重要作用。这些动态随着个体纯经济地位的改善而呈现进步趋势，而纯经济地位由收入水平决定。当个体的经济条件扩展到包括职业状况、家庭背景等非纯货币因素时，这一特征就会逆转。

abstract.text: In Japan, female suicide increased during the COVID-19 pandemic. This study evaluated how pandemic-related home confinement affected female suicide. We employed a shift-share instrumental variable design to assess whether differential exposure to the pandemic caused changes in suicide incidence. We found that suicide increased among females under 20 years of age as more people stayed at home. Counterfactual analyses showed that at least 35% of these suicides were attributed to home confinement. Our results suggest that a substantial part of the suicide increase among young females was driven by lifestyle changes during the pandemic.

10.1002/hec.70078.abstractZh: 在日本，COVID-19疫情期间女性自杀率上升。本研究评估了疫情相关的居家限制措施对女性自杀行为的影响。我们采用了转换分享工具变量设计，以分析疫情对不同群体的影响是否导致了自杀率的变动。研究发现，随着更多人居家，20岁以下的女性自杀率上升。反事实分析显示，至少35%的自杀事件可归因于居家限制措施。我们的结果表明，年轻女性自杀率上升的很大一部分是由疫情期间的生活方式变化所引发的。

abstract.text: We examine public funding for health research through the United States National Institutes of Health Fogarty International Center's AIDS International Training and Research Program, which sought to strengthen scientific capacity in AIDS-endemic countries by providing African researchers with training opportunities in the U.S. We use a difference-in-differences framework with information on scientists who participated in the program and the research activities of African scientists working at their home institutions in adjacent topics of neglected tropical diseases. Relative to comparable scientists, those at institutions with returning trainees subsequently publish more on HIV-related topics, receive more grant funding, engage in more clinical trials, and their work contributes to a greater number of policy documents. These patterns suggest that following the Fogarty program, research, innovation, and health policy related to the AIDS epidemic in African countries became more active.

10.1002/hec.70079.abstractZh: 我们研究了通过美国国立卫生研究院Fogarty国际中心艾滋病国际培训与研究计划对公共卫生研究的资金支持情况。该计划旨在为艾滋病流行国家的科学家提供在美国的培训机会，从而提升这些国家的科学能力。我们采用了差异-差异框架，收集了参与该计划的科学家的信息，以及在这些国家从事被忽视的热带病相关研究的非洲科学家的研究活动数据。与同类科学家相比，那些在设有返程培训项目的机构工作的科学家，在HIV相关领域发表的文章更多，获得的资助更多，参与的临床试验也更多，他们的研究成果也更多地体现在政策文件中。这些结果表明，在Fogarty计划实施后，非洲国家与艾滋病疫情相关的研究、创新以及卫生政策变得更加活跃。

abstract.text: Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) has been increasing rapidly in the United States despite government efforts to contain its spread. Both under-utilization and overuse of prescribed antimicrobials contribute to rising resistance. The introduction of Medicare Part D in 2006 expanded prescription drug coverage for the elderly, including coverage for antimicrobial medications. If cost barriers had previously led to under-utilization of prescriptions, then Medicare Part D could have mitigated AMR by improving access to antimicrobials. However, if Medicare Part D also encouraged excessive antibiotic use, it may have inadvertently contributed to greater resistance. Using data from the Nationwide Inpatient Sample (NIS), Healthcare Cost and Utilization Project (HCUP), Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality for January 2001 to September 2008, I estimate the causal impact of Medicare Part D on AMR-related hospital discharges using a difference-in-differences identification strategy. My findings suggest that Medicare Part D led to a slower increase in AMR-related inpatient discharges among the Medicare-eligible population.

10.1002/hec.70080.abstractZh: 尽管美国政府努力遏制抗菌药物的传播，但美国的抗菌素耐药性仍迅速上升。处方抗菌药物的未充分利用和过度使用都是导致耐药性增加的因素。2006年《医疗保险部分D》的引入为老年人扩大了处方药覆盖范围，其中包括抗菌药物的覆盖。如果成本障碍之前导致了处方药物的未充分利用，那么《医疗保险部分D》本可以通过改善对抗菌药物的获取来减轻抗菌素耐药性的问题。然而，如果《医疗保险部分D》还鼓励了过度使用抗生素的行为，那么可能会无意中加剧耐药性问题。利用2001年1月至2008年9月期间全国住院样本数据、医疗成本和利用项目以及医疗保健研究与质量局的数据，我采用差异-差异识别策略估计了《医疗保险部分D》对与抗菌素耐药性相关的医院出院人数的影响。我的研究结果表明，《医疗保险部分D》导致符合条件的参保人员中与抗菌素耐药性相关的住院出院人数增长放缓。

abstract.text: This paper examines the impacts of maternal education on her children's nutritional status in Kenya, utilizing six waves of nationally representative data from KDHS. To mitigate potential endogeneity issues and derive a causal relationship, we employ a change in the educational regime in 1985 as an instrument variable. The key findings can be summarized as follows. First, women under the new structure enhance their education by an average of 1.8 years. Second, an additional year of education attained by a mother is shown to have an impact on reducing the likelihood of her child experiencing stunting, underweight, and wasting by approximately 3.8, 2.6, and 1.2 percentage points, respectively. These findings withstand rigorous testing through a battery of robustness checks. Finally, to elucidate the underlying mechanisms behind these results, our study delves into various factors, encompassing women's fertility, female labor force engagement, women's information exposure, and their involvement in decision-making.

10.1002/hec.70081.abstractZh: 本文研究了肯尼亚母亲教育水平对其子女营养状况的影响，使用了来自肯尼亚健康调查数据的六波全国代表性数据。为了缓解潜在的内生性问题并确立因果关系，我们采用了1985年教育制度的变化作为工具变量。主要研究结果如下：首先，在新制度下，女性的平均教育年限增加了1.8年。其次，母亲每增加一年的教育水平，其子女出现生长迟缓、体重不足和消瘦的风险分别降低约3.8%、2.6%和1.2%。这些发现通过一系列稳健性检验得到了验证。最后，为了阐明这些结果背后的机制，我们的研究深入探讨了各种因素，包括女性的生育能力、女性劳动力参与情况、女性获取信息的机会以及她们在决策过程中的作用。

abstract.text: We examine whether a universal drug subsidy for seniors in Poland provided effective financial protection and whether it induced ex ante moral hazard. The policy eliminated out-of-pocket costs for prescription medications while leaving all other healthcare coverage unchanged. Using detailed household expenditure data and a sharp age-based eligibility threshold, we implement a difference-in-discontinuities design to estimate causal effects. The reform reduced average medication spending and lowered the incidence of catastrophic drug expenditures by 62%, with gains concentrated in the upper tail of the spending distribution-consistent with insurance against large health shocks. On the non-medical margin, we find suggestive evidence of a modest increase in spending on a category of unhealthy goods-consistent with reduced precautionary behavior at the household level. These results highlight that while public subsidies can meaningfully reduce financial risk, they may also induce behavioral responses that partially offset intended health benefits.

10.1002/hec.70083.abstractZh: 我们研究在波兰为老年人提供普遍药物补贴是否能够有效提供财务保护，以及是否会导致事前道德风险。该政策消除了处方药物的自付费用，同时其他所有医疗保健费用保持不变。利用详细的家庭支出数据和严格的年龄资格门槛，我们采用差异不连续设计来估计因果效应。该改革减少了平均药物支出，并将灾难性药物支出的发生率降低了62%，这些收益主要集中在支出分布的高端——这与针对重大健康冲击的保险措施一致。在非医疗领域，我们发现有一类不健康商品的支出略有增加——这与家庭层面减少预防性行为的行为一致。这些结果表明，虽然公共补贴可以显著减少财务风险，但它们也可能引发部分抵消预期健康益处的行为反应。

abstract.text: Using 43,817 parent-child pairs from 23 waves of the HILDA Survey, I study the intergenerational transmission of alcohol use within a rational model of trait transmission. Transmission is predominantly same-sex: the mother-daughter elasticity is 0.10 and the father-son elasticity is 0.09; there is no father-daughter effect. Influence peaks at ages 15-17 and re-emerges at 28-37 when offspring become parents; mothers also affect sons at both junctures. Comparisons with non-birth (adoptee-style) dyads show similar mother-daughter transmission, indicating norm-based rather than biological channels. Identification concerns are addressed with placebo reshuffling and copula-based corrections; estimates are robust across specifications. Men who remain childless are more likely to mirror maternal drinking, which-together with declining fertility and earlier alcohol-control policies-helps explain cohort declines in male drinking. The interpretation is that parental norms anchor behavior at identity-forming and role-transition ages, with strong persistence thereafter. Policy should target these windows with gender-specific, couple-level interventions alongside population levers on price, availability and marketing.

10.1002/hec.70084.abstractZh: 本研究基于HILDA调查23次调查中的43,817对亲子样本，通过理性特质传递模型探讨了酒精使用代际传递现象。研究发现，代际传递主要发生在同性之间：母女间的传递弹性为0.10，父子间的传递弹性为0.09；不存在父女间的传递效应。影响在15-17岁达到高峰，并在28-37岁时随着子女成为父母而重新出现；母亲在这两个时期都对儿子产生影响。与非出生关系（收养式）的配对样本进行比较后，发现母女间的传递模式相似，这表明传递机制基于社会规范而非生物学因素。通过安慰剂重新分组和基于共词修正的方法解决了识别问题；研究结果在不同参数设定下依然稳健。那些保持无子女状态的男性更有可能模仿母亲的饮酒行为，这与生育率下降以及早期酒精管控政策密切相关，这些因素共同解释了男性饮酒水平的下降。研究认为，父母的社会规范在身份形成和角色转变时期对行为起着锚定作用，并且这种影响在之后仍然持续存在。因此，政策应针对这些时期，采取针对性别的、以夫妻为对象的干预措施，同时采取价格、供应和市场营销方面的干预措施。

abstract.text: Some patients prescribed opioid pills fail to properly dispose of their unused pills, posing a risk for others. We report results from a pre-registered field experiment testing whether behaviorally informed reminder cards increase participation in a financial incentive program for returning unused opioid pills among U.S. Veterans. The cards incorporate principles from behavioral economics, including timely reminders, implementation intention prompts, and loss framing. Relative to a cash incentive alone, the reminder cards increase both the likelihood that patients return unused pills (the extensive margin) and the number of pills returned (the intensive margin). The intervention also improves cost-effectiveness, reducing both the cost per pill returned and the cost per participant who returns pills. These findings show that low-cost behavioral messaging can meaningfully enhance the effectiveness of existing financial incentive programs for safe opioid disposal.

10.1002/hec.70085.abstractZh: 一些被开具阿片类药物处方的患者未能妥善处理未使用的药物，这给其他人带来了风险。我们报告了一项预先注册的实地实验结果，该实验旨在测试基于行为经济学的提醒卡片是否能够提高美国退伍军人参与返还未使用阿片类药物的财务激励计划的比例。这些提醒卡片包含了行为经济学中的原则，包括及时的提醒、实施意图的引导以及损失框架的设定。与仅提供现金激励相比，提醒卡片不仅提高了患者返还未使用药物的可能性（即“广泛边际”），还增加了返还的药物数量（即“密集边际”）。该干预措施还提高了成本效益，降低了每枚返还药物的成本以及每位参与者返还药物的成本。这些发现表明，低成本的行为性信息传递可以有效提升现有财务激励计划在促进安全处理阿片类药物方面的效果。

abstract.text: Payments to healthcare providers are often based on the number of patients with a particular diagnosis or treatment with well known limitations. Payment based on health outcomes, a form of pay-for-performance, has long been advocated as a possible solution. We use a contract theory approach and illustrate how it can inform practical implementation of pay-for-performance schemes that reward health outcomes. The pricing rule suggests that the bonus should be set to reflect the difference between the provider's marginal cost of a health improvement before the policy intervention and the provider's marginal cost evaluated at the target health set by the purchaser. We provide estimates of the optimal bonus for hip and knee replacement under a range of assumptions about provider cost functions and the value of health improvements.

10.1002/hec.70086.abstractZh: 对医疗保健提供者的支付通常基于具有特定诊断或治疗的患者数量，但这存在众所周知的局限性。基于健康结果的支付，作为一种绩效付费形式，长期以来一直被提倡作为可能的解决方案。我们采用契约理论方法，说明如何将其应用于实际实施以健康结果为奖励的绩效付费方案。定价规则建议，奖金应设定为反映提供者在政策干预前改善健康的边际成本与购买者设定的目标健康水平下的边际成本之间的差异。我们针对髋关节和膝关节置换手术，在假设了提供者的成本函数以及健康改善的价值后，提供了最优奖金的估算结果。

abstract.text: This paper examines the impact of Targeted Regulation of Abortion Providers (TRAP) laws on the supply and composition of maternal healthcare providers, particularly obstetrician-gynecologists (OB/GYNs). We exploit the staggered enactment of TRAP laws across U.S. states from 2010 to 2021 using a propensity score matching and stacked difference-in-differences approach. Our analytic sample includes physician-, county- and state-level measures of OB/GYN supply, newly graduated OB/GYNs, medical school and residency program applicants, nurse practitioners (NPs) and physician assistants (PAs) who practice women's healthcare, as well as advanced practice nurse midwives. TRAP law enactment is associated with a statistically significant reduction of 2.09 in OB/GYN supply per 100,000 females aged 15-44 (6.6% relative to the baseline). This decline is particularly pronounced among OB/GYNs aged 55-64. For OB/GYNs under 34, the estimates suggest a decline but this finding should be interpreted cautiously given pre-trends. TRAP laws also are associated with a reduction in the supply of newly graduated OB/GYNs from lower-ranked medical schools. We find no evidence that NPs, PAs, or midwives substitute for the decline in OB/GYNs. Mechanism analyses provide suggestive evidence that the supply contraction operates through exit rather than relocation. These findings highlight unintended consequences of abortion restrictions on broader maternal healthcare provision.

10.1002/hec.70087.abstractZh: 本文探讨了针对堕胎服务提供者实施的规定性监管法案（TRAP）对孕产妇医疗保健提供者供应和构成的影响，尤其是妇产科医生。我们采用倾向评分匹配和堆叠差异-差异方法，分析了2010至2021年间美国各州TRAP法案的逐步实施情况。我们的分析样本包括医生、县和州级别的妇产科医生供应数据，新毕业的妇产科医生、医学院和住院医师项目的申请者，从事妇女医疗保健的护士执业资格人员和医师助理，以及高级执业护士助产士。TRAP法案的实施导致15-44岁女性中每100,000人中的妇产科医生数量减少了2.09人（相对于基线水平减少了6.6%）。这一下降在55-64岁的妇产科医生中尤为明显。对于34岁以下的妇产科医生，估计存在下降趋势，但鉴于前期趋势，这一发现需要谨慎解读。TRAP法案还导致来自排名较低的医学院的新毕业妇产科医生的供应减少。我们没有发现护士执业资格人员、医师助理或助产士能够替代妇产科医生的减少。机制分析表明，供应收缩是通过人员流失而非重新安置来实现的。这些发现凸显了堕胎限制对孕产妇医疗保健提供范围的非预期影响。

abstract.text: Previous research documents a strong association between gambling and substance use, suggesting that these seemingly distinct behaviors may share similar environmental, neurobiological, and genetic causes. However, there is a dearth of credible empirical evidence on whether gambling has a causal impact on substance use or vice versa. This paper estimates the impact of gambling on substance use making use of the rapid roll-out of sports betting laws across US states. Using data from the Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System and a difference-in-difference (DID) estimation strategy to assess the impact of legalizing sports betting on smoking and drinking behavior among adults, we find that the legalization of online sports betting has increased binge drinking frequency-at the intensive margin among young men by approximately 10 percent, but find no discernible impact on smoking. The results are consistent across traditional two-way fixed effects models as well as more recently developed DID methods designed for staggered treatment adoption.

10.1002/hec.70088.abstractZh: 先前的研究表明，赌博与物质使用之间存在密切关联，这表明这些看似不同的行为可能具有相似的环境、神经生物学和遗传原因。然而，关于赌博是否对物质使用产生因果影响，或者反之亦然，目前缺乏可靠的实证证据。本文利用美国各州迅速实施的体育博彩法律，估算了赌博对物质使用的影响。通过行为风险因素监测系统的数据，并采用差异对差异（DID）估计方法，评估体育博彩合法化对成年人吸烟和饮酒行为的影响。研究发现，在线体育博彩的合法化使年轻男性的酗酒频率增加了约10%，但对吸烟行为则没有明显影响。这些结果在传统的双向固定效应模型以及为应对分阶段实施而开发的DID方法中都是一致的。

abstract.text: Economic evaluations carried out from a societal perspective ought to account for the opportunity cost of a range of resources, including those committed by care recipients. People's time is such a resource: it is limited, valuable and it has an opportunity cost that should be reflected in cost calculations. Yet, when it comes to children and young people (CYP), there are few suggestions on how to value their time and include it in economic evaluations. Despite repeated calls for research, this remains a persistent gap in our methodology "playbook". In this paper, we look at the topic by bringing together seminal literature and recent research findings. We discuss key uncertainties that need to be resolved for the topic to move forwards, outline challenges and "frequently asked questions", offer our views on possible answers and solutions, and sketch out a roadmap for future research.

10.1002/hec.70089.abstractZh: 从社会角度进行的经济评估应当考虑到各种资源的机会成本，包括护理对象所投入的资源。人们的时间就是这样的资源：它是有限的、宝贵的，并且具有机会成本，这一成本应当反映在成本计算中。然而，在涉及儿童和年轻人时，关于如何评估他们的时间并将其纳入经济评估中的建议却很少。尽管多次呼吁进行相关研究，这一领域仍然是我们研究方法中的空白。在本文中，我们结合相关文献和最新研究成果来探讨这一话题。我们讨论了需要解决的关键不确定性，以便该领域能够取得进展，并提出了挑战及“常见问题”，提出了可能的解决方案，并规划了未来研究的方向。

abstract.text: The COVID-19 pandemic placed exceptional strain on essential services, raising urgent concerns about the mental well-being of workers in critical sectors. This study examines the short- and medium-term effects of the COVID-19 pandemic on the mental health of health and social care (HSC) workers in the UK relative to other occupational groups. Using data from the UK Household Longitudinal Study and measuring mental health via the General Health Questionnaire (GHQ), we apply a difference-in-differences strategy, where both groups could be treated only in the second period (a pre-post design), to investigate whether HSC workers experienced distinct mental health trajectories compared to other key workers (KWs) and workers in non-essential sectors (non-KWs). The results for the immediate post-pandemic period (April-November 2020) show no significant differences in mental health for HSC workers compared with either comparator worker groups. Medium-term outcomes remained statistically insignificant across occupational comparisons. Additional analyses of individual GHQ items and potential mechanisms (financial stability and social isolation) suggest limited heterogeneous effects for each worker group using yearly data.
