While all studied groups exhibited some deterioration in mental health after 2020, HSC workers' trajectories largely mirrored those of other KWs and non-KWs, suggesting that factors such as stable employment and financial security may have cushioned the psychological impact for this sector.

10.1002/hec.70090.abstractZh: COVID-19疫情给基本服务带来了巨大压力，使得人们对关键行业工作者的心理健康状况产生了紧迫的担忧。本研究探讨了COVID-19疫情对英国健康和社会护理工作者心理健康在短期和中期的影响，与其他职业群体进行了比较。通过英国家庭纵向研究的数据，并使用一般健康问卷来衡量心理健康状况，我们采用了差异-差异策略，即仅对两组在第二个时期进行比较（前测后测设计），以调查健康和社会护理工作者是否与其他关键工作者和非关键行业工作者相比，存在不同的心理健康轨迹。疫情刚结束后的时期（2020年4月至11月）显示，健康和社会护理工作者的心理健康状况与对照组相比没有显著差异。中期结果在职业比较中仍然没有统计学意义。对个别GHQ项目及潜在机制（财务稳定性和社交隔离）的进一步分析表明，使用年度数据时，每个工作群体的异质性效应有限。尽管所有研究群体在2020年后都表现出一定的心理健康状况恶化，但健康和社会护理工作者的轨迹与其他关键工作者和非关键行业工作者大致相同，这表明稳定的就业和财务安全等因素可能减轻了该行业的心理冲击。

abstract.text: Medicare Advantage (MA) enrollment more than doubled from 2013 to 2023, raising concerns about risk selection, spending, and the continued use of traditional Medicare (TM) spending as a benchmark for MA payment. This study examines trends in selection into MA from 2009 to 2020 using administrative and survey data from the Medicare Current Beneficiary Survey. For each survey year, we estimate a regression model of Part A and B spending among TM enrollees based on demographic characteristics, self-reported health status, limitations in activities of daily living, and enrollee group type (e.g., dual eligible, institutionalized, disabled). We apply this model to MA enrollees to estimate their predicted TM spending. We find that since 2017, MA enrollees have had higher predicted costs than TM enrollees-5-6% higher from 2017 to 2020-driven largely by the growing share of dual eligibles in MA. Within enrollee group type, however, we observe little evidence of differential selection. We further use the model results from just our baseline year, 2009, to predict both MA and TM spending in each subsequent year. We find that although MA enrollee characteristics did not trend observably healthier or sicker over this period, TM enrollees' characteristics appear to have shifted in ways associated with lower predicted spending over time. These findings suggest that the nature of selection into MA has qualitatively shifted over recent years and raises further questions about how well the current risk adjustment system reflects appropriate differences in risk as the enrollee characteristics in these groups continue to diverge.

10.1002/hec.70091.abstractZh: 从2013年到2023年，Medicare Advantage（MA）的注册人数翻了一番以上，这引发了关于风险选择、支出以及是否继续以传统Medicare（TM）的支出作为MA支付基准的担忧。本研究利用Medicare当前受益人调查中的行政数据和调查数据，分析了2009年至2020年间选择加入MA的趋势。对于每个调查年份，我们根据人口统计特征、自我报告的健康状况、日常生活活动的限制以及注册者群体类型（如双重符合条件者、机构化患者、残疾患者）来估计TM注册者的A部分和B部分支出。我们将这一模型应用于MA注册者，以估算他们预测的TM支出。研究发现，自2017年以来，MA注册者的预测成本高于TM注册者，在2017年至2020年间高出5-6%，这主要是由于MA中双重符合条件者的比例不断增加。然而，在注册者群体类型内部，我们几乎没有观察到选择上的差异。我们进一步使用仅基于2009年的模型结果来预测随后每年的MA和TM支出。我们发现，尽管在这段时间内MA注册者的特征并没有明显变得更健康或更病重，但TM注册者的特征似乎随着时间的推移而发生了变化，导致预测的支出减少。这些发现表明，近年来选择加入MA的本质已经发生了质的变化，并且进一步引发了关于当前风险调整系统能否有效反映这些群体注册者特征差异的问题。

abstract.text: The fiscal sustainability of healthcare systems is increasingly strained by aging populations with two competing hypotheses dominating the literature. The Red Herring Hypothesis suggests that healthcare expenditures are driven more by proximity to death than by chronological age, while the Steepening Hypothesis examines whether expenditures increase faster for older individuals over time. Nevertheless, these two frameworks have traditionally been studied independently rather than in conjunction. This paper offers a unified econometric model, allowing for a rigorous assessment of their concurrent validity and interaction. Using comprehensive register-based monthly somatic hospital expenditure data for the entire Danish population from 2002 to 2017, we provide robust evidence that both Red Herring and Steepening effects operate simultaneously. Although Red Herring effects modestly mitigate the expenditure burden of an increasingly older population, they are substantially outweighed by pronounced Steepening effects, which account for nearly 60% of hospital expenditure growth during the observation period. Through a novel decomposition method, we identify a previously unrecognized interaction between these phenomena, a Red Herring Steepening effect, which accelerates expenditure growth in the final years of life for older individuals. Our findings suggest that healthcare systems face considerably greater fiscal challenges from population aging than previously recognized under the Red Herring Hypothesis alone.

10.1002/hec.70092.abstractZh: 医疗系统的财政可持续性正因人口老龄化而面临越来越大的压力，现有文献中主要有两种相互竞争的假设。红移假说认为，医疗支出更多地受到与死亡距离的影响，而非年龄因素；而陡峭化假说则探讨的是，随着时间推移，老年个体的支出增长是否会更快。然而，这两种框架传统上被独立研究，而非结合考虑。本文提出了一个统一的计量经济模型，能够严格评估这两种假设的同时有效性及相互作用。通过利用2002年至2017年间丹麦全国范围内的月度躯体医院支出数据，我们发现红移效应和陡峭化效应同时存在。尽管红移效应在一定程度上减轻了老年人口支出的负担，但其影响被显著的陡峭化效应所大幅抵消，后者在观察期间占医院支出增长的近60%。通过一种新颖的分解方法，我们发现了这两种现象之间此前未被注意到的相互作用——红移陡峭化效应，它加速了老年个体生命最后几年的支出增长。我们的研究结果表明，医疗系统面临的财政挑战因人口老龄化而比仅基于红移假说的预测更为严重。

abstract.text: This study investigated the impact of providing feedback to respondents on a dominance-structured choice task on subsequent choice behavior in a discrete choice experiment (DCE). The DCE was conducted among 626 patients with heart failure. Respondents were given a dominance-structured choice task in which two devices (Device A and Device B) offered no benefits but carried risks compared to a "No Device" option. Among those who selected a device option (N = 340), half received feedback and an opportunity to revise their choice, while the other half did not. The effect of feedback on preference for the "No Device" option and choice consistency was examined using multinomial, heteroscedastic multinomial logit, and heteroscedastic latent-class logit models. Among those who received feedback (N = 170), 71% continued to choose the device options. Feedback recipients were more likely to choose the "No Device" option in subsequent questions (p < 0.01). Feedback led to a 25% reduction in choice consistency (p < 0.01) and an increased likelihood of choosing the "No Device" option. Impact on consistency varied across latent classes: feedback decreased consistency in the risk-sensitive class but increased consistency in the anti-device class, highlighting potential unintended consequences. Further research is needed to understand its effects in different contexts and samples.

10.1002/hec.70093.abstractZh: 本研究调查了在离散选择实验中，向受访者提供关于支配结构选择任务的反馈对其后续选择行为的影响。该实验在626名心力衰竭患者中开展，受访者被要求完成一个支配结构选择任务，其中两种设备（设备A和设备B）虽然无益处，但存在风险，而“无设备”选项则没有风险。在选择了某种设备选项的人群中（N=340），有一半的人获得了反馈并有机会修改自己的选择，而另一半人则没有。使用多项式模型、异方差多项式逻辑模型和异方差潜在类逻辑模型，研究了反馈对“无设备”选项偏好和选择一致性的影响。在获得反馈的人群中（N=170），71%的人继续选择设备选项。获得反馈的人在后续问题中选择“无设备”选项的可能性更高（p<0.01）。反馈使选择一致性降低了25%（p<0.01），并增加了选择“无设备”选项的可能性。不同潜在类别对一致性的影响不同：反馈在风险敏感类别中降低了一致性，但在反设备类别中提高了一致性，这凸显了潜在的意外后果。需要进一步的研究来了解其在不同情境和样本中的影响。

abstract.text: Public funding for pharmaceuticals often follows repeated negotiation between manufacturers and a public agency, yet little empirical work examines how the timing of agreement reflects the economic structure of these interactions. Using a duration model of negotiations in Australia from 2005 to 2018, we assess whether observed patterns of delay and agreement align with dynamic bargaining theory under incomplete information. Agreements from 634 submissions for 400 therapies required a median of 16 months, and 71% of negotiation rounds ended without agreement. Therapies with lower expected value to the agency-reflected in higher incremental cost per QALY, greater budget impact, or evidence uncertainty-experienced longer delays and lower agreement rates, while those with strong clinical importance, perceived need, or elevated public interest were listed more quickly. Delays also varied across therapeutic classes and with a therapy's position in the sequencing of available treatments. The observed patterns point to a systematic listing rule in which therapies are funded when expected health gains justify their opportunity costs. They also support the view that the timing of agreement reflects strategic negotiation under uncertainty, not simply procedural delay.

10.1002/hec.70095.abstractZh: 制药项目的公共资金供应通常需要经过制造商与公共机构之间的多次谈判，但很少有实证研究探讨协议达成的时间如何反映这些互动中的经济结构。通过研究2005至2018年澳大利亚的谈判持续时间模型，我们评估了观察到的延迟和协议达成模式是否符合不完全信息下的动态谈判理论。对于400种疗法的634项提交申请，平均需要16个月才能达成协议，且有71%的谈判回合未能达成协议。那些对公共机构预期价值较低的治疗，其增量成本每QALY更高、预算影响更大或证据不确定性的治疗，其谈判延迟时间更长，协议达成率也更低；而那些具有强烈临床重要性、被普遍认为有需求或受到公众高度关注的疗法，则更容易被列入清单。谈判延迟情况还因治疗类别以及治疗在可用治疗方案中的位置而有所不同。观察到的模式表明，存在一种系统性的清单编制规则，即只有当预期的健康收益能够弥补其机会成本时，这些治疗才会获得资金支持。这些结果也支持了这样的观点：协议达成的时间反映了在不确定性下的战略性谈判，而不仅仅是程序性的延迟。

abstract.text: Physician adoption of new information about a medical procedure can affect patient outcomes. Medical malpractice law may influence physician use of such information. We analyze how physician reactions to information shocks regarding vaginal births after cesarean sections (VBACs) in the 1990s were mediated by tort reform and the standard used in malpractice claims to determine a physician's duty of care to patients. Differentiating states according to whether they capped non-economic damages in malpractice claims (Caps) and whether they defined the duty of care using a national or a local reference point, we analyze how physicians under the four legal regimes reacted to a series of adverse information shocks regarding VBACs over the period. Our results suggest that physicians whose duty of care is determined by standard practices nationwide are less likely to adopt innovations which have not yet been incorporated into those practices and more likely to adopt innovations once they are incorporated into those practices. Caps may moderate these effects. Our results also suggest intuitive heterogeneity in the effects of legal regime on physician decisions.

10.1002/hec.70096.abstractZh: 医生对医疗程序相关新信息的采纳可能会影响患者的治疗效果。医疗事故法可能会影响医生对这些信息的使用。我们分析了20世纪90年代关于剖宫产后阴道分娩的信息冲击对医生的影响，以及这种影响是如何受到侵权改革和医疗事故索赔中用于确定医生对患者护理责任的标准的调节的。通过区分各州是否对医疗事故索赔中的非经济损失赔偿设定上限，以及是否以全国性或地方性的参考点为依据来确定护理责任，我们分析了在四种法律制度下，医生如何应对一系列关于剖宫产后阴道分娩的不利信息冲击。我们的研究结果表明，那些护理责任由全国标准实践决定的医生，不太可能采纳尚未被纳入这些实践中的创新措施，而一旦这些创新措施被纳入实践，他们就更有可能采纳这些创新措施。非经济损失赔偿上限可能会缓和这些效应。我们的研究结果还表明，法律制度对医生决策的影响存在直观的异质性。

abstract.text: States continue to impose E-Cigarette (EC) taxes without clear evidence of the cross-price elasticities between multiple EC types and between ECs and cigarettes. Moreover, existing literature focused on EC sales or prevalence outcomes instead of consumption units of various EC types. We examined how EC and cigarette consumption respond to prices and taxes and estimated own-price and cross-price elasticities for multiple EC types using a nationally representative volumetric choice experiment (VCE) of US adults who vaped ECs in the past 30 days. In the VCE, participants made purchases for monthly consumption in response to changing tax and price levels in 9 choice sets, and 700 people were recruited and answered VCE questions during 2023. Each choice set includes disposables, pod devices, pod refill packs, pod starter kits, tank devices, e-liquids, and cigarettes. Zero-inflated Poisson model was used to estimate price and tax impacts, as well as own- and cross-price elasticities of demand for these products. Increasing taxes and prices (e.g., minimum pricing floor) reduces EC consumption among US adults who vape, and different EC types are economic substitutes. Platform goods (e.g., tank devices and e-liquids, pod devices and refill packs) are economic complements. Increasing EC prices likely does not lead to higher cigarette consumption among the general adult EC-using population. The design of EC taxes by EC models and components may be needed given their complex economic relationships.

10.1002/hec.70097.abstractZh: 各州继续对电子香烟征收税费，但缺乏关于多种电子香烟类型之间以及电子香烟与香烟之间的交叉价格弹性的明确证据。此外，现有文献主要关注电子香烟的销售或普及情况，而非不同电子香烟类型的消费数量。我们研究了电子香烟和香烟的消费对价格和税费的反应，并通过一项全国代表性体积选择实验，对过去30天内使用电子香烟的美国成年人的消费行为进行了分析。在该实验中，参与者根据变化的税费水平在9个选择集中进行月度消费购买，共有700人在2023年期间参与了实验并回答了相关问题。每个选择集包括一次性电子香烟、雾化器、电子香烟 refill包、电子香烟入门套装、储液罐式电子香烟、电子液体以及香烟。我们使用零膨胀泊松模型来估计价格和税费对需求的影响，以及这些产品的自身价格和交叉价格弹性。提高税费（例如最低定价门槛）会减少使用电子香烟的美国成年人的消费，而不同电子香烟类型之间存在经济替代关系。平台商品（如储液罐式电子香烟和电子液体、雾化器及 refill包）则属于经济互补品。提高电子香烟的价格可能不会导致普通使用电子香烟的成年人增加香烟消费。鉴于电子香烟之间的复杂经济关系，可能需要根据不同类型的电子香烟及其组成部分来设计相应的税费政策。

abstract.text: There are large health inequalities between neighborhoods in many cities of the world. This paper studies individuals' sorting based on health amenities and exposes an important connection between health preferences and the housing market. I estimate a neighborhood choice model using geolocated data from a health survey in New York City and neighborhood characteristics from different data sources. I find that individuals with higher preferences for being healthy are more likely to choose neighborhoods close to health amenities such as parks, and this sorting explains a large part of observed geographical inequalities in health behaviors. Moreover, the model predicts that a higher demand for health amenities capitalizes into house prices and displaces poor individuals to neighborhoods further from these amenities. This implies that health awareness campaigns might actually worsen the inequality in access to public health amenities.

10.1002/hec.70098.abstractZh: 世界许多城市的各个社区之间存在严重的健康不平等现象。本文研究了个体基于健康设施的选择行为，并揭示了健康偏好与房地产市场之间的重要联系。我利用纽约市健康调查中的地理定位数据以及来自不同数据源的社区特征，建立了一个社区选择模型。研究发现，那些更重视健康的人更倾向于选择靠近公园等健康设施的社区，这种选择行为解释了部分观察到的健康行为地理不平等现象。此外，该模型预测，对健康设施的高需求会推高房价，并将贫困人群驱赶到距离这些设施更远的社区。这意味着，健康意识宣传活动实际上可能会加剧公共健康设施获取方面的不平等现象。

abstract.text: End-of-life (EOL) health spending imposes catastrophic financial burdens on elderly households, pushing them into poverty without corresponding improvements in health outcomes. Leveraging the quasi-experiment of China's public long-term care insurance (LTCI) pilot program, this study employs data from the China Longitudinal Healthy Longevity Survey to examine the impact of LTCI on catastrophic health spending (CHS) at the end of life. The findings indicate that over the 5-year EOL period, LTCI significantly decreases the probability of CHS by approximately 36.1-52.3 percentage points and reduces out-of-pocket health spending. Furthermore, the study demonstrates that LTCI reduces CHS without compromising EOL health by substituting aggressive medical interventions with sustained long-term care support, which leads to fewer severe-illness episodes, shorter hospital stays, and reduced dependency. These findings provide empirical evidence for the role of LTCI in facilitating value-based healthcare at the end of life, with significant implications for establishing universal LTCI systems in China and other countries.

10.1002/hec.70099.abstractZh: 临终健康支出给老年家庭带来了巨大的经济负担，使他们陷入贫困，而健康状况却没有相应改善。本研究利用中国公共长期护理保险试点项目的准实验数据，通过中国纵向健康长寿调查的数据来考察长期护理保险对临终阶段灾难性健康支出的影响。研究发现，在5年的临终阶段，长期护理保险显著降低了灾难性健康支出的概率，降幅约为36.1%至52.3%，并减少了个人承担的医疗费用。此外，研究还表明，长期护理保险通过用持续的长期护理支持替代激进的医疗干预措施，减少了临终阶段的严重疾病发作、住院时间以及依赖性，从而在不影响临终健康的情况下降低了灾难性健康支出。这些发现为长期护理保险在促进临终阶段基于价值的医疗保健方面的作用提供了实证依据，对中国及其他国家建立全民长期护理保险体系具有重要意义。

abstract.text: Syphilis, a sexually transmitted infection that can lead to serious health complications, was almost eliminated in the United States by 2000. But since then, its incidence began to increase, recently reaching a 60-year peak. We suggest that the introduction of the highly active antiretroviral therapy (HAART) drug regimen, which transformed HIV from a terminal condition into a manageable chronic disease, is partly responsible, as people living with and without HIV altered their sexual behavior after the introduction of HAART. To test this empirically, we exploit variation in HAART takeup based on spatial variation in pre-HAART AIDS prevalence, sex, and time in a triple differences framework. We find that a one standard deviation increase in the pre-HAART AIDS prevalence rate led to a 17.8 percent increase in the syphilis incidence rate, and that in the absence of HAART, there would have been 81 percent fewer syphilis cases between 1996 and 2008. These results highlight the need to consider unintended consequences that could stem from behavioral changes following the introduction of life-saving medical innovations.

10.1002/hec.70100.abstractZh: 梅毒是一种性传播感染疾病，可能导致严重的健康并发症。到2000年时，美国的梅毒发病率几乎被消除。但自那时起，其发病率开始上升，最近达到了60年来的最高水平。我们认为，高效抗逆转录病毒疗法（HAART）的引入在某种程度上导致了这一情况的变化。这种疗法将HIV从一种致命的疾病转变为一种可控制的慢性病。这是因为，在HAART引入后，无论是否感染HIV的人群都改变了他们的性行为。为了验证这一点，我们基于HAART普及率、性别和时间的空间差异，利用三重差异框架来研究这一现象。我们发现，在HAART普及率增加一个标准差的情况下，梅毒的发病率增加了17.8%。而在没有HAART的情况下，1996年至2008年间梅毒病例的数量将减少81%。这些结果强调了在引入救命的医疗创新后，需要考虑由此带来的意外行为变化。

abstract.text: This study examines the impact of a program designed to address the non-take-up of social benefits on healthcare utilization among targeted at-risk formerly self-employed workers in France. We test two main hypotheses: first, that sending a self-assessment questionnaire to the treated group can increase healthcare use; second, that personalized assistance from a social worker can enhance this effect. Utilizing a quasi-experimental framework (2014-2016) and synthetic difference-in-differences models to address selective entry into the various treatments, our results reveal that proactive information outreach alone increased healthcare utilization by 0.6%, while the combined approach with personalized assistance amplified this effect to 2%. In all configurations, access to services and healthcare consumption improved, while care pathways shifted, potentially toward preventive and early-stage treatments. Our findings support the use of multiple uptake strategies, such as targeting, proactive outreach, and tailored integrated benefit packages, in overcoming barriers to healthcare.

10.1002/hec.70101.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了针对法国部分高风险前个体经营者实施的社会福利推广计划对医疗利用的影响。我们检验了两个主要假设：首先，向受干预群体发送自我评估问卷能够增加医疗使用；其次，社会工作者的个性化协助能够增强这一效果。通过采用准实验框架（2014-2016年）和合成差异-差异模型来处理各种干预措施的选择性进入问题，我们的研究结果表明，仅通过主动的信息推广就能使医疗利用增加0.6%，而结合个性化协助的方法则使这一效果提升至2%。在所有情况下，服务的获取和医疗消费都有所改善，同时护理路径也发生了转变，可能更倾向于预防和早期治疗。我们的研究结果支持采用多种推广策略，如精准定位、主动信息推广以及定制化的综合福利方案，以克服医疗服务的障碍。

abstract.text: Evidence on the relationship between public health expenditure and health is mixed and particularly scarce for low-income countries. Existing studies overlook the subnational distribution of expenditure and rarely distinguish between sources and governance over funding. We estimated the relationship between three types of health expenditure across 121 districts in Mozambique and multiple outcomes from 2008 to 2015. We generated a unique dataset covering individual outcomes from Demographic and Health Surveys and district-level domestic and international health expenditure, channelled to local institutions via provincial budget support or earmarked projects. We related lagged expenditure to outcomes using logit regressions, controlling for time-varying mother, household, and district characteristics, and district and year fixed effects. Domestic expenditure was positively associated with institutional delivery, infant and child survival, budget support with infant and child survival, lower child anaemia, and higher vaccination, and earmarked projects with recommended antenatal care. Associations with health outcomes were driven by wealthier households, with institutional delivery by households closer to facilities and with vaccinations and antenatal care by households with lower service access. Domestic expenditure is essential to improve child health and to support international expenditure, which is more effective when managed by local governments through sustained and predictable funding schemes.

10.1002/hec.70102.abstractZh: 关于公共健康支出与健康状况之间关系的证据并不明确，尤其是在低收入国家中这类数据尤为稀缺。现有研究往往忽视了支出的地方分布，且很少区分资金来源和资金管理的机制。我们估算了2008至2015年间莫桑比克121个地区三种类型健康支出与多种健康结果之间的关系。我们生成了一个独特的数据集，涵盖了人口与健康调查中的个体结果，以及地区层面的国内和国际健康支出，这些支出通过省级预算支持或专项项目分配给当地机构。我们使用逻辑回归模型将滞后支出与结果联系起来，同时控制了随时间变化的母亲、家庭和地区特征，以及地区和年份的固定效应。国内支出与机构服务、婴儿和儿童存活率、预算支持与婴儿和儿童存活率、较低的儿童贫血率、较高的疫苗接种率呈正相关，而专项项目则与推荐的产前护理有关。与健康结果相关的关联因素包括：较富裕的家庭更重视机构服务；靠近医疗机构的家庭更重视机构服务；而服务获取较少的家庭则更重视疫苗接种和产前护理。国内支出对于改善儿童健康至关重要，同时也有助于支持国际层面的支出，而后者在地方政府通过持续且可预测的融资计划管理时效果更佳。

abstract.text: Suicide rates among older adults have been rising over time in the United States. At the same time, more individuals have been suffering with chronic pain and illness, which are often underlying risk factors for suicide. As self-medication with marijuana has become common, we ask whether access to legal marijuana for medical and recreational purposes reduces suicide rates among older individuals. We find that suicide rates among older age groups decline following the opening of recreational marijuana dispensaries, especially among older Whites, and middle-aged White males and females with low levels of education.

10.1002/hec.70104.abstractZh: 在美国，老年人群的自杀率随时间呈上升趋势。与此同时，越来越多的老年人遭受慢性疼痛和疾病的困扰，这些往往也是导致自杀的潜在风险因素。随着大麻作为自我用药方式的普及，我们探讨了为医疗和娱乐目的合法使用大麻是否有助于降低老年人群的自杀率。研究发现，随着娱乐性大麻店的开业，老年人群体的自杀率有所下降，尤其是在老年白人、教育水平较低的白人中年男性和女性中。

abstract.text: This paper examines the international variation in the prices of branded pharmaceuticals. We consider short-run profits, or quasi-rents, as representing each country's contribution toward the global public good of therapeutic information embodied in new pharmaceuticals. We characterize globally optimal contributions through the Samuelson-Lindahl criteria and contrast the resulting outcomes with the Nash noncooperative equilibrium as developed in the Olson-Zeckhauser theory of international alliances. That theory predicts both the undersupply of public goods and the "exploitation" of large countries by small ones. We calculate national contributions to the global public good with data from a recent RAND report. Other countries' contributions resulting from their prices are much lower than those in the United States, but their free riding is not complete. We also find that country size is a powerful determinant of contributions and that larger countries contribute disproportionately more. Finally, we suggest a cooperative policy approach that would move us closer to optimality with health benefits for all countries.

10.1002/hec.70105.abstractZh: 本文探讨了品牌药品价格的国际差异。我们认为，短期利润或准租金代表了每个国家对全球公共物品的贡献，这种公共物品就是体现在新药品中的治疗信息。我们通过萨缪尔森-林达尔标准来表征全球最优贡献，并将结果与奥尔森-泽克豪泽关于国际联盟理论中的纳什非合作均衡进行对比。该理论预测了公共物品的供应不足以及小国对大国的“剥削”现象。我们依据RAND公司最近的一份报告，计算了各国对全球公共物品的贡献。其他国家由于价格因素导致的贡献远低于美国，但它们的搭便车行为并未完全消失。我们还发现，国家规模是决定贡献程度的关键因素，规模较大的国家贡献比例更高。最后，我们提出了一种合作政策方案，旨在使所有国家的健康受益程度更接近最优状态。

abstract.text: This study investigates how hospital performance may be influenced by environmental ethics, measured by regional medical corruption cases. To address the endogeneity issue, we use corruption cases in non-medical sectors as instrumental variables for medical corruption in regions with hospital operations. Our analysis combines data on corruption investigations with hospital management and performance measures from the World Management Survey, covering more than 500 hospitals in China from 2014 to 2016. We found that a one-third increase in corruption cases in a region reduces management quality by 0.05 standard deviations, increases the complication rate by 3%, and increases the length of stay by 0.15 days. Subgroup analyses revealed that the negative effects of corruption are particularly pronounced for management quality in younger hospitals and for performance outcomes in older hospitals. Furthermore, we found that compared with corruption at the hospital-leader level, corruption among hospital staff has stronger negative effects on management quality and service outcomes. Our findings also show that corruption can distort the incentives and operational priorities within hospitals. Our work helps improve the understanding of the relationships between the ethical environment and hospital performance outcomes, offering insightful implications for better governance and policy settings in developing and transitional health systems.

10.1002/hec.70106.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了环境伦理对医院绩效的影响，通过地区性医疗腐败案件来衡量。为了解决内生性问题，我们使用非医疗领域的腐败案件作为工具变量，来研究有医院运营的地区中的医疗腐败现象。我们的分析结合了腐败调查数据以及《世界管理调查》中的医院管理和绩效指标，该调查涵盖了2014年至2016年间中国500多家医院的数据。研究发现，一个地区内腐败案件增加三分之一，管理质量会下降0.05个标准差，并发症率增加3%，住院时间增加0.15天。子组分析显示，腐败对年轻医院的管理质量以及老年医院绩效结果的负面影响尤为明显。此外，我们发现，与医院领导层的腐败相比，医院员工内部的腐败对管理质量和服务结果的影响更为严重。我们的研究还表明，腐败会扭曲医院内部的激励机制和运营优先级。这项工作有助于更好地理解伦理环境与医院绩效结果之间的关系，为发展中国家和转型期卫生系统的治理和政策制定提供有益的启示。

abstract.text: Governments frequently adopt austerity policies when facing economic crises, yet their long-term consequences for population health remain incompletely understood. This paper examines the impact of large-scale fiscal austerity on infant mortality by exploiting the Troika-led economic adjustment program implemented in Greece beginning in 2010 as a quasi-experimental shock. Using the synthetic control method, we construct a counterfactual for Greece based on OECD and Union for the Mediterranean countries that did not experience austerity of comparable depth or duration. Relative to this counterfactual, Greece experienced a sharp and persistent increase in infant mortality following the onset of austerity. The divergence emerges immediately after 2010, remains statistically significant throughout the post-intervention period, and shows little evidence of full reversion prior to the COVID-19 pandemic. The estimated effect corresponds to an average 43 percent increase in the infant mortality rate. Mortality effects are larger for boys than for girls and are concentrated in the neonatal period. Accounting explicitly for the fertility decline, we estimate approximately 854 excess infant deaths cumulatively from 2010 to 2020. Extensive robustness checks support the findings. The results identify the total effect of austerity and highlight the importance of protecting early-life health during fiscal consolidation.

10.1002/hec.70107.abstractZh: 政府在面临经济危机时常常采取紧缩政策，但其对人口健康的长期影响仍不完全清楚。本文通过利用自2010年起在希腊实施的由三部门主导的经济调整计划，作为准实验性冲击，来研究大规模财政紧缩对婴儿死亡率的影响。采用合成控制法，我们基于未经历类似深度或持续性的紧缩政策的经合组织国家和地中海联盟国家，构建了一个反事实情景。与这一反事实情景相比，希腊在紧缩政策实施后婴儿死亡率出现了急剧且持续的增加。这种差异在2010年之后立即出现，并在整个干预期间保持统计显著性，在COVID-19大流行之前几乎没有完全恢复的迹象。估计的效应相当于婴儿死亡率平均增加了43%。男孩的死亡率影响比女孩大，且主要集中在新生儿期。在明确考虑生育率下降因素后，我们估计从2010年到2020年间，累计有约854例婴儿死亡。广泛的稳健性检验支持了这些发现。这些结果揭示了紧缩政策的总体影响，并强调了在财政整顿期间保护早期生命健康的重要性。

abstract.text: High-quality prekindergarten (pre-K) programs can promote school readiness and generate lifetime benefits. However, little is known about how pre-K programs affect mothers. We examine the effects of New York City's universal pre-K program (UPK) on the health of low-income mothers enrolled in Medicaid. We use a difference-in-regression-discontinuities approach that exploits the introduction of UPK and cutoffs for participation of children, to address potential confounders. We compare mothers of children born just inside the eligibility cutoff and mothers of those born just outside the eligibility cutoff, before and after the initiation of UPK. We find that the effects of UPK differ between single and non-single mothers, and that the effects also differ between mothers whose 4-year-old is the youngest child in the household and those with other, younger children at home. Specifically, the introduction of UPK was associated with significant reductions in use of non-addictive pain-relief drugs and in use of hormones (e.g., for birth control and menstrual disorders) among (single) mothers whose eligible children were the youngest in the household. While we do not find evidence of the effects of UPK on other types of utilization, these results reveal a new dimension on which UPK may affect maternal wellbeing.

10.1002/hec.70108.abstractZh: 高质量的学前班项目可以促进孩子的入学准备，并带来终身受益。然而，关于学前班项目对母亲的影响，我们知之甚少。本研究考察了纽约市普及学前班项目对参加医疗补助计划的低收入母亲健康的影响。我们采用了差异回归不连续法，利用学前班项目的引入以及儿童参与时间的划分，来排除潜在的混杂因素。我们比较了在普及学前班项目启动前后，处于资格截止线内出生的母亲与处于资格截止线外出生的母亲的情况。研究发现，普及学前班项目对单身母亲与非单身母亲的影响不同，对家中4岁孩子是最小的母亲与其他孩子年龄较小的母亲的影响也各不相同。具体而言，普及学前班项目的引入与以下情况的显著减少有关：单身母亲中，其符合条件的孩子家中年龄最小时，非成瘾性止痛药物的使用以及激素类药物（如避孕药和月经失调药物）的使用都显著减少。虽然我们没有发现普及学前班项目对其他类型医疗服务的影响的证据，但这些结果揭示了普及学前班项目可能对母亲健康产生的新影响。

abstract.text: Does reducing interstate licensing barriers increase the supply of mental health providers? We study this question using the U.S. Psychology Interjurisdictional Compact (PSYPACT), which allows psychologists to practice across state lines via telemedicine without obtaining additional state licenses. Because interstate telemedicine entry is difficult to track using physical practice locations, we utilize data from a large mental health provider search platform, where providers choose which zipcodes they are listed in as search results. Leveraging states' staggered accession timings for identification, we find a nuanced supply response: although joining PSYPACT increases listings in a state by 7.7% within a year, the response is entirely driven by incumbent psychologists within a state listing for the first time. We find evidence consistent with incumbents responding to a perceived threat of entry, as states with ex ante high licensing costs exhibit the largest treatment effects, and incumbents choose to list in underserved, high-income areas within those states.

10.1002/hec.70110.abstractZh: 降低州际许可壁垒是否会增加心理健康服务提供者的供应？我们通过美国心理学跨州契约（PSYPACT）来研究这个问题。该契约允许心理学家通过远程医疗在州界之间执业，而无需获得额外的州级许可。由于难以通过物理执业地点追踪跨州远程医疗的进入情况，我们利用了大型心理健康服务提供者搜索平台的数据，这些平台让服务提供者选择他们希望被列在搜索结果中的邮政编码。利用各州在识别过程中的不同时间节点，我们发现了一个复杂的供应反应：虽然加入PSYPACT会使一个州的服务提供者列表在一年内增加7.7%，但这种增加完全是由该州现有的服务提供者首次参与该契约所驱动的。我们发现，现有服务提供者对进入威胁的反应与这一假设一致，因为那些在事前许可成本较高的州，其治疗效果最为显著，而现有服务提供者则倾向于在那些州内服务不足、收入较高的地区进行 listing。

abstract.text: The double burden of malnutrition-characterized by the coexistence of undernutrition and overnutrition-is an emerging public health challenge in many low- and middle-income countries, including Bangladesh. We examine the role of education in shaping long-term nutritional outcomes by leveraging the Female Secondary School Stipend Program (FSSSP), which provides stipends and tuition subsidies to rural girls. Using a difference-in-differences model that exploits variation in program exposure by birth cohort and rural residence, we show that the FSSSP led to substantial increases in secondary schooling among eligible cohorts. We also find that full exposure to the program reduced the probability of being underweight by 3 percentage points, and of being normal weight by 5.1 percentage points, while increasing the likelihood of being overweight and obese by 4.6 and 3.5 percentage points, respectively. These findings underscore the complex and sometimes unintended nutritional consequences of education programs in low-income settings undergoing rapid nutrition transitions.

10.1002/hec.70111.abstractZh: 营养不良的双重负担——即营养不良与超重并存的状况——是许多低收入和中等收入国家，包括孟加拉国，面临的一个新兴公共卫生挑战。我们通过利用女性中学津贴计划（FSSSP）来研究教育在塑造长期营养状况中的作用。该计划为农村女孩提供津贴和学费补贴。利用差异-差异模型，我们分析了不同出生队列和农村居住状况对计划参与程度的影响，发现FSSSP显著提高了符合条件的女孩的中学教育机会。我们还发现，完全参与该计划使体重过轻的概率降低了3个百分点，正常体重的概率降低了5.1个百分点，而超重和肥胖的概率分别增加了4.6个百分点和3.5个百分点。这些发现强调了在快速营养转型的低收入环境中，教育计划可能带来的复杂且有时意想不到的营养后果。

abstract.text: We investigate patients' price sensitivity for prescription (Rx) drugs with regards to patronizing online or brick-and-mortar pharmacies. In doing so, we exploit a policy change in Germany that prohibited online pharmacies from granting rebates to one part of the population, the members of the statutory health insurance scheme. This policy change created a natural experiment, allowing us to analyze its impact on the pharmaceutical market using Difference-in-Differences (DiD). Utilizing a novel dataset obtained from merchandize information systems, we find that the ban led to a shift in consumer behavior, increasing offline pharmacy Rx sales by 1.42%-1.67%. In a second step, we assess to what extent the policy change achieved its alleged goal of supporting brick-and-mortar pharmacies. Our findings indicate that pharmacies with low revenues, which are most exposed to market exit, saw only a minor increase in annual revenues of around € 1587. At the same time, pharmacies in the highest decile gained roughly four times that amount. This indicates that the policy change alone was insufficient to reverse the declining trend in pharmacy numbers in Germany. To strengthen the comprehensive supply of pharmaceuticals to the general population, additional reforms seem necessary.

10.1002/hec.70112.abstractZh: 我们研究了患者对处方药的价格敏感度，重点关注在线药店和实体药店之间的差异。为此，我们利用了德国的一项政策变化——该政策禁止在线药店向法定健康保险计划成员提供折扣。这一政策变化创造了一个自然实验，使我们能够使用差异分解法来分析其对药品市场的影响。通过利用从商品信息系统中获得的新颖数据集，我们发现这一禁令导致消费者行为发生了变化，使得实体药店的处方药销售额增加了1.42%至1.67%。在第二步中，我们评估了这一政策变化在多大程度上实现了其支持实体药店的目标。我们的研究发现，收入较低的药店，这些药店最容易退出市场，其年收入仅增加了约1587欧元。与此同时，收入最高的药店年收入增加了大约四倍。这表明，仅这一政策变化不足以扭转德国药店数量的下降趋势。为了加强药品对普通民众的供应，还需要进行更多的改革。

abstract.text: While extensive literature is available on the impact of early childhood nutritional food program on human capital gains, little we know about the impact of targeted nutritious food provisioning at a later stage on human capital gains. This paper fills this gap in the literature. We examine the causal impact of the Rajiv Gandhi Scheme for Empowerment of Adolescent Girls (SABLA), a nutrition-led multifaceted program for adolescent girls aged 11-18 years introduced by the central government in India in 2010, on girls' educational and learning outcomes. The implementation of this program provides us with enough variation in treatment. We glean data from multiple nationally representative datasets and employ difference-in-differences framework to estimate the causal impact of the SABLA program. Our results indicate that the program significantly improved enrollment and basic learning outcomes, including reading ability and math skills. We attribute the salutary effects of the program to significant improvement in health status (BMI and weight) of the adolescent girls exposed to the program and increased child-specific educational expenditure. Our findings are consistent across different datasets, and robust to potential confounding factors, and alternative empirical specifications.

10.1002/hec.70114.abstractZh: 虽然已有大量文献探讨了早期儿童营养计划对人类人力资本收益的影响，但关于在后期阶段提供有针对性的营养食品对人类人力资本收益的影响，我们知之甚少。本文填补了这一文献空白。我们研究了拉吉夫·甘地青少年女孩赋权计划（SABLA）的因果效应。该计划是由印度中央政府于2010年推出的一个以营养为重点的综合性计划，针对11至18岁的青少年女孩。该计划的实施为我们提供了足够的处理变量差异。我们从多个具有全国代表性的数据集中获取数据，并采用差异-差异框架来估计SABLA计划的因果效应。我们的研究结果表明，该计划显著提高了女孩的入学率和基本学习成果，包括阅读能力和数学技能。我们认为，该计划的有益效果主要源于参与计划的青少年女孩的健康状况（BMI和体重）显著改善，以及儿童教育支出的增加。我们的研究结果在不同数据集中保持一致，并且能够抵抗潜在的混杂因素和其他实证假设的干扰。

abstract.text: Economic policy can be a powerful instrument to influence food environments and support improved diets and health. Over the past 20 years, the use of fiscal policy to improve diets has increased dramatically. This paper reviews the trajectory of policy change, and explores the ways in which research has informed three different dimensions of economic policy change in relation to nutrition: policy paradigms, policy instruments and policy settings. The increasing use of fiscal policy contrasts to more limited use of other economic policy instruments, including trade policy, to shape food environments for improved nutrition. Insights from the case studies explored in this paper indicate the important role of research in supporting policy change, including through generating evidence that speaks to sectoral needs and priorities, which can enable policy makers to identify and support potential synergies, as well as providing evidence from real-world evaluations of policy measures. The case studies also highlight the importance of constructive engagement between nutrition and economic policy makers. Finally, the paper identifies three considerations for research moving forward related to policy innovation, knowledge equity, and gender.

10.1002/hec.70115.abstractZh: 经济政策可以成为影响食品环境、支持改善饮食和健康的强大工具。在过去的20年里，利用财政政策来改善饮食的做法显著增加。本文回顾了政策变化的轨迹，并探讨了研究如何为与营养相关的经济政策变化的三个不同维度提供指导：政策范式、政策工具和政策环境。财政政策的使用日益增多，而其他经济政策工具，包括贸易政策，在塑造有利于营养改善的食品环境方面则使用较为有限。本文所探讨的案例研究表明，研究在支持政策变化方面发挥着重要作用，包括提供符合行业需求和优先事项的证据，这有助于政策制定者识别并支持潜在的协同效应，同时还能为政策措施的现实评估提供证据。案例研究还强调了营养政策与经济政策制定者之间建设性合作的重要性。最后，本文指出了未来研究在政策创新、知识公平和性别方面需要考虑的三个因素。

abstract.text: Low-income elderly consumers, often overlooked in studies of public financial assistance programs, may face challenges in managing resources to maintain dietary health. This study examines how the payment frequency of an unconditional cash transfer program impacts dietary behaviors among low-income elderly populations in Colombia. Using nationally representative data from a federal financial assistance program, we implement a Multivalued Treatment Model with Propensity Score Matching and Augmented Inverse Probability Weighting to assess the effects of monthly versus bi-monthly payments on food expenditures, dietary diversity, and diet quality. Results show that monthly payments enhance dietary diversity and diet quality by supporting healthier food purchases compared to bi-monthly payments. Subgroup analyses revealed that older seniors and males benefit most from monthly payments. Mechanisms explored include consumption smoothing and subjective wealth perceptions, with findings suggesting that more frequent and predictable income flows may foster greater perceived financial stability. The study advances consumer behavior theory by linking payment frequency to dietary outcomes and offers practical implications for optimizing financial assistance programs. While bi-monthly payments reduce administrative costs, monthly payments are recommended to improve dietary health. These findings contribute to understanding income timing's role in fostering healthier consumer behavior.

10.1002/hec.70116.abstractZh: 低收入老年消费者在公共财政援助计划的研究中往往被忽视，他们在维持饮食健康方面可能会面临资源管理的挑战。本研究探讨了无条件现金转移计划的支付频率对哥伦比亚低收入老年人群饮食行为的影响。利用来自联邦财政援助计划的全国代表性数据，我们采用了多值处理模型、倾向评分匹配和增强逆概率加权法，来评估每月与双月支付对食物支出、饮食多样性和饮食质量的影响。结果显示，每月支付通过支持更健康的食品购买，提升了饮食多样性和饮食质量，而双月支付则未能达到这一效果。子组分析表明，老年老年人和男性从每月支付中获益最多。研究探讨的机制包括消费平滑和主观财富感知，研究发现更频繁且可预测的收入流动可能会增强对财务稳定性的感知。本研究通过将支付频率与饮食结果联系起来，推进了消费者行为理论的发展，并为优化财政援助计划提供了实际意义。虽然双月支付可以降低行政成本，但建议采用每月支付以改善饮食健康。这些发现有助于理解收入时间选择在促进更健康消费者行为中的作用。

abstract.text: Even though data on hospital admissions are widely used in health research, hospitalization-related estimands measured using these data are not always clearly conceptualized. Consequently, estimators of these quantities can have unclear rationales and undesirable properties. We evaluate three "rate" estimators for measuring hospitalization-related estimands. Using the Grossman human capital model, we motivate the importance of measuring healthy time. We show that an upper bound on healthy time can be calculated using lengths of hospital stay without assumptions about health status outside the hospital. We illustrate the empirical value of these bounds. Next, we find that an admission rate conventionally used in clinical research is a patient follow-up time weighted average that lacks a clear basis for the weights. We propose an alternative estimator with more desirable properties and weaker assumptions. We assess its performance using a model of hospital admissions and death. Finally, we evaluate the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) use of risk-standardized readmission rates to penalize hospitals by showing that risk-standardized rates can be sensitive to patient case mix, potentially leading to hospital rankings that do not reflect hospital quality. We propose treating hospital specific intercepts in the CMS risk-standardization model as a measure of quality.

10.1002/hec.70117.abstractZh: 尽管医院入院数据在健康研究中被广泛使用，但利用这些数据计算出的与住院相关的指标并不总是具有清晰的概念化。因此，这些量的估计方法可能缺乏明确的理由，并且存在不良特性。我们评估了三种用于衡量与住院相关的指标的“比率”估计方法。利用Grossman人力资本模型，我们强调了衡量健康时间的重要性。我们展示了无需对医院外的健康状况做出假设，就可以根据住院时间来计算健康时间的上限。我们还举例说明了这些上限的实证价值。接下来，我们发现临床研究中常用的入院率实际上是一个基于患者随访时间的加权平均值，而这一加权平均值缺乏明确的权重依据。我们提出了一种具有更理想特性和更弱假设的替代估计方法。我们通过一个医院入院和死亡模型来评估其性能。最后，我们评估了Medicare和Medicaid服务局（CMS）使用风险标准化再入院率来惩罚医院的做法，结果表明风险标准化率可能对患者病例组合敏感，可能导致医院排名无法反映医院质量。我们建议将CMS风险标准化模型中的医院特定截距视为质量的衡量标准。

abstract.text: Adolescent mental health has become a growing public health concern. This study examines the impact of teacher quality, proxied by teacher experience, on student mental health. To address potential endogeneity concerns and identify causal effects, we exploit data from a sample of schools where students and teachers are plausibly randomly assigned to classes. Our results indicate that students assigned to head teachers with greater experience exhibit significantly improved mental health. By contrast, we find no such effects for subject teachers who are solely responsible for academic instruction. The mechanism analysis suggests that more experienced head teachers strengthen teacher-student relationships, engage more with parents, report higher work satisfaction, and promote more supportive peer interactions. Our results highlight the important role of school environments in determining adolescents' mental health and offer actionable insights for interventions.

10.1002/hec.70118.abstractZh: 青少年心理健康已成为一个日益严重的公共卫生问题。本研究探讨了教师素质（以教师经验为代理变量）对学生心理健康的影响。为了解决潜在的内生性问题并识别因果效应，我们利用了来自一些学校的样本数据，在这些学校中，学生和教师被合理地随机分配到不同的班级中。研究结果表明，被分配到经验更丰富的班主任手中的学生，其心理健康状况明显更好。相比之下，那些仅负责学术教学的学科教师则没有显示出类似的效应。机制分析表明，经验更丰富的班主任能够加强师生关系，更多地与家长互动，表现出更高的工作满意度，并促进更有支持的同伴互动。我们的研究结果强调了学校环境在决定青少年心理健康方面的重要作用，并为干预措施提供了有价值的见解。

abstract.text: Outpatient specialist physicians in France can work either in the regulated sector, where they charge the regulated fee, or in the unregulated sector, where they set their own fees above the regulated fee. This context provides a unique opportunity to estimate the extent to which patients value services provided under balance billing. In January 2021, we carried out a contingent valuation method (CVM) survey on a sample of 1051 individuals who were representative of France's adult population. Results highlighted that willingness-to-pay (WTP) for a specialist consultation in the unregulated sector was higher than for a consultation in the regulated sector, with a significant WTP difference of €4.30 (almost 15% of the regulated fee). This difference was significant across all respondent subgroups (i.e., gender, age, education level, marital status, income, health status, insurance coverage, and area of residence) and was not fully driven by differences in income. Moreover, this preference for the unregulated sector was associated with the perception that specialists in this sector provide better quality medical care, better quality non-medical services, and that making an appointment with them is easier. Finally, we estimated the patient net welfare gain generated by specialist consultations in the unregulated sector in France at approximately €165 million per year. This is the first study to provide an estimation of patients' benefits associated with balance billing.

10.1002/hec.70119.abstractZh: 在法国，门诊专科医生可以在受监管的领域工作，收取规定的费用，也可以在不受监管的领域工作，自行设定高于规定费用的费用。这一背景为评估患者在平衡计费下对服务的重视程度提供了独特的机会。2021年1月，我们对1051名代表法国成年人口的个体进行了意愿支付调查。结果显示，在不受监管的领域进行专科咨询的意愿支付高于在受监管的领域进行咨询的意愿支付，差异显著，为4.30欧元（约占规定费用的15%）。这一差异在所有受访者子群体中均显著存在（如性别、年龄、教育水平、婚姻状况、收入、健康状况、保险覆盖情况以及居住区域），且并非完全由收入差异所驱动。此外，这种对不受监管领域的偏好与认为该领域的专科医生能提供更高质量的医疗服务、更优质的非医疗服务，以及预约更为方便的看法有关。最后，我们估计了法国不受监管领域专科咨询每年为患者带来的净福利增益约为1.65亿欧元。这是第一项对平衡计费带来的患者利益进行估算的研究。

abstract.text: Tobacco 21 (T21) laws effectively reduce youth tobacco use by preventing initiation. This study examines their impact on body weight among young adults aged 18-20. Using 2009-2019 Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System data and a two-way fixed-effects difference-in-differences (DID) design, we find limited evidence of broad weight changes in either direction across the BMI distribution. Obesity declines due to modest weight reductions concentrated near the upper BMI threshold, with no significant changes in overweight status or average BMI. Event study shows that the obesity decline emerges in the first post-T21 year and attenuates afterward. Results are robust to alternative specifications, including an imputation DID approach addressing staggered adoption. Effects are driven by "never smokers", consistent with a prevention-based pathway, and are more pronounced among males and non-White individuals, with heterogeneity observed across education levels in the upper BMI tail. Supplemental analyses using Youth Risk Behavior Survey data show reduced adverse weight outcomes among high schoolers aged 18+. T21 laws increase exercise, improve diets, and reduce sedentary behavior, underage drinking, marijuana use, and mental distress. Overall, T21 laws avoid the typical cessation-related weight gain and modestly improve weight outcomes among at-risk young adults, suggesting broader public health benefits beyond tobacco prevention.

10.1002/hec.70120.abstractZh: 《烟草21法案》（T21）通过阻止青少年开始使用烟草，有效减少了青少年的烟草使用行为。本研究探讨了该法案对18-20岁年轻人群体重的影响。利用2009-2019年的行为风险因素监测系统数据，采用双向固定效应差异-差异（DID）设计，我们发现BMI分布范围内体重变化的方向较为有限。肥胖率因体重的适度减少而下降，这种减少主要集中在较高的BMI阈值附近，而超重状态和平均BMI则没有显著变化。事件研究表明，肥胖率的下降在T21法案实施后的第一年开始显现，并随后有所减弱。研究结果在采用不同模型分析时依然稳健，包括采用插补DID方法处理逐步采纳问题。这些影响主要由“从未吸烟者”产生，这与基于预防的路径理论一致，并且在男性和非白人人群中更为明显，且在较高BMI群体的教育水平差异中也观察到了异质性。使用青少年风险行为调查数据的补充分析显示，18岁以上的高中生因T21法案而减少了不良体重状况的发生。总体而言，T21法案增加了运动量、改善了饮食，并减少了久坐行为、未成年人饮酒、大麻使用以及心理困扰。总之，T21法案避免了典型的戒烟相关体重增加问题，并适度改善了高风险年轻人群的体重状况，表明其具有更广泛的公共卫生效益，而不仅仅是烟草预防方面的作用。

abstract.text: This paper quantifies the impact of prenatal exposure to lead in drinking water on infant health at birth by exploiting a quasi-experiment in Jackson, Mississippi. This setting provides a unique context where behavioral changes to avoid lead-contaminated water are limited due to delayed water testing and dissemination of information about lead contamination. We apply synthetic control using other US cities and Mississippi counties as donors to identify the effect of lead exposure on birth outcomes. We find that prenatal lead exposure in Jackson increased the incidence of low birth weight by approximately 1.5 percentage points, relative to a synthetic Jackson.

10.1002/hec.70121.abstractZh: 本文通过密西西比州杰克逊市的一项准实验，量化了饮用水中铅的产前暴露对婴儿出生健康的影響。該環境具有特殊性，因為由于水质检测的延迟以及关于铅污染信息的传播不足，人们难以采取行为改变来避免接触含铅水。我們采用合成控制法，利用美国其他城市和密西西比州的其他县作为对照组，以確定铅暴露對出生結果的影響。研究發現，杰克逊市在产前暴露于铅的情況下，低出生體重的发生率增加了約1.5個百分點。

abstract.text: This study is the first to estimate the effects of unemployment insurance (UI) benefit contractions on mental health. We leverage a unique quasi-natural experiment: early termination of the Federal Pandemic Unemployment Compensation (FPUC) and Pandemic Unemployment Assistance (PUA) programs across more than 20 states during the summer of 2021. Using high-frequency data from the Census Bureau's Household Pulse Survey (HPS), our difference-in-differences estimates suggest that early withdrawal from FPUC and PUA increases the probability of reporting anxiety symptoms among working-age adults without a college degree, a group particularly vulnerable to unexpected income shocks. The adverse effects are more pronounced among racial and ethnic minorities, older individuals, and women. However, the increase in anxiety symptoms is short-lived, persisting for about 1 month after the benefit cessation. Finally, we find evidence that financial hardship is a likely mechanism underlying these findings.

10.1002/hec.70122.abstractZh: 本研究首次评估了失业保险福利缩减对心理健康的影响。我们利用了一次独特的准自然实验：2021年夏季，超过20个州提前终止了联邦疫情失业救济和疫情失业援助计划。通过人口普查局的家庭脉搏调查数据，我们的差异估计表明，提前终止这些福利会增加没有大学学位的劳动年龄成年人报告焦虑症状的概率，这一群体特别容易受到意外收入冲击的影响。这种负面影响在少数族裔、老年人和女性中更为明显。然而，焦虑症状的增加是短暂的，在福利停止后大约持续一个月。最后，我们发现经济困难可能是导致这些现象发生的潜在机制。

abstract.text: Compulsory licensing is a legal mechanism that allows governments the use of patented medicines without the owner's consent, subject to conditions and compensation, to meet public-health needs. Despite its policy relevance and increasing use, empirical evidence on its market effects remains limited. This study examines the association between compulsory licensing and the commercial accessibility and affordability of HIV medications across 11 countries from 2002 to 2022. We combine quarterly data on drug sales and prices from IQVIA with implementation dates from the TRIPS Flexibilities Database, focusing on 21 HIV drugs subject to at least one compulsory license. Using a staggered difference-in-differences design, we estimate the average treatment effect on the treated (ATT) of compulsory licensing on drug consumption and prices, under a parallel trends assumption. We find an economically meaningful increase in retail and hospital sales following the implementation of compulsory licenses, amounting to approximately 21% of a standard deviation in the countries that implemented them. In addition, we estimate a reduction in prices of approximately 19% of a standard deviation. These associations are consistent with compulsory licenses having contributed to improved availability of HIV drugs through commercial channels, with meaningful effects on prices. Our estimates do not capture-and therefore cannot rule out-potential additional effects on access via public importation or production, donations, or NGO-led supply chains.

10.1002/hec.70123.abstractZh: 强制许可是一种法律机制，允许政府在未经专利权人同意的情况下使用专利药品，但需满足一定条件和支付补偿，以满足公共卫生需求。尽管强制许可具有政策重要性且使用日益广泛，但关于其市场影响的实证证据仍然有限。本研究考察了2002年至2022年间11个国家中强制许可与HIV药物商业可及性和价格可负担性之间的关联。我们结合了IQVIA提供的季度药品销售和价格数据，以及TRIPS灵活性数据库中的实施日期信息，重点关注至少受到一次强制许可的21种HIV药物。采用分阶段差异估计方法，我们在平行趋势假设下，估算了强制许可对药物消费和价格的平均处理效应。研究发现，在强制许可实施后，零售和医院销售量显著增加，幅度约为实施国家标准差的21%。此外，我们还估计了价格下降约19%标准差。这些结果表明，强制许可有助于通过商业渠道提高HIV药物的可用性，并对价格产生了显著影响。我们的估计未能捕捉到——因此也无法排除——通过公共进口、生产、捐赠或非政府组织主导的供应链对获取渠道产生的潜在额外影响。

abstract.text: Limited utilization of healthcare services remains a persistent challenge for poor populations in many countries. This study examines the impact of China's Poverty Alleviation Relocation Program (PARP) on healthcare utilization, utilizing panel data from rural households in 16 counties across eight provinces. Employing a difference-in-differences (DID) framework, we find that relocation leads to a 24.6% increase in clinic visits and a 36.9% increase in hospital visits per household, helping prevent minor illnesses from escalating. Despite higher utilization, relocation does not significantly raise total medical expenditure, out-of-pocket medical costs, or reimbursement levels, due to reduced per-visit costs. Mechanism analysis suggests that relocation improves access to healthcare facilities and boosts household income. Our findings highlight the critical role of combining housing mobility with healthcare system improvements to promote healthcare equity, offering important insights for the design of poverty alleviation strategies in other developing country contexts where access to healthcare remains a critical constraint.

10.1002/hec.70124.abstractZh: 在许多国家，贫困人群对医疗服务的利用仍然受到限制，这一挑战一直存在。本研究利用来自8个省份16个县的农村家庭面板数据，考察了中国扶贫搬迁计划对医疗利用的影响。通过差异-差异模型分析，我们发现搬迁使每户家庭的门诊就诊次数增加24.6%，住院次数增加36.9%，有助于防止小病恶化。尽管医疗利用增加，但由于每次就诊的成本降低，搬迁并未显著增加总医疗费用、个人医疗支出或报销水平。机制分析表明，搬迁改善了医疗设施的获取性，并提升了家庭收入。我们的研究强调了将住房流动与医疗系统改善相结合在促进医疗公平中的关键作用，为其他发展中国家设计扶贫策略提供了重要启示，这些国家的医疗获取仍然是一个重要制约因素。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the effects of a 2014 policy reform on paid sick leave in Denmark. The reform shortened the eligibility period from 56 to 26 weeks for paid sick leave and introduced a mandatory return-to-work activation program for individuals whose benefits were not extended. The reform initially led to a temporary increase in returns to employment, as individuals on sick leave resumed work to avoid entering the mandatory activation program. However, this effect fades in the long run, and no sustained employment improvements were observed.

10.1002/hec.70126.abstractZh: 本文研究了2014年丹麦政策改革对带薪病假的影响。该改革将带薪病假的资格期限从56周缩短至26周，并引入了针对未享受福利人员的强制复工计划。改革初期导致复工人数暂时增加，因为休病假的人为了避免进入强制复工计划而重新工作。然而，这种效应在长期内逐渐减弱，并未观察到持续的就业改善。

abstract.text: Gender incongruence in trans and nonbinary ("trans") populations is often associated with psychological distress and increased demand for mental healthcare. Gender-affirming hormone therapy (GAHT) is a key component of care for many trans people, yet long-term evidence around its cost implications remains limited despite increasing uptake and policy attention worldwide. We provide the first population-based evidence on the healthcare costs of GAHT initiation using longitudinal administrative data from 32,313 trans Australians who initiated testosterone-based GAHT (tGAHT) or estradiol-based GAHT (eGAHT) between 2013 and 2024. Employing a dynamic difference-in-differences design, we estimate the impacts on government expenditure and patient out-of-pocket costs in the 6 years after initiation, using future initiators as controls. We find that initiating tGAHT leads to an additional AUD$3119 (USD$2246) in government expenditure and AUD$143 (USD$103) in out-of-pocket costs over 6 years; corresponding estimates were AUD$8348 (USD$6011) and AUD$1269 (USD$914) for eGAHT recipients. For tGAHT recipients, both government and out-of-pocket costs declined after initiation, with mental healthcare reductions exceeding ongoing hormone therapy expenditure after 6 years. For eGAHT recipients, costs also fell but remained above baseline, driven by sustained prescription spending. Taken together with quality-of-life benefits, our results suggest GAHT is likely to be cost-effective.

10.1002/hec.70127.abstractZh: 跨性别和非二元群体中的性别不一致往往与心理困扰以及对心理健康服务的增加需求相关。性别确认激素疗法是许多跨性别者护理的关键组成部分，然而，尽管全球范围内对该疗法的接受度和政策关注不断增加，关于其成本影响的长期证据仍然有限。我们利用来自32,313名在2013年至2024年间开始使用睾酮基性别确认激素疗法或雌二醇基性别确认激素疗法的澳大利亚跨性别者的纵向行政数据，首次提供了关于性别确认激素疗法启动的医疗费用的人口学证据。采用动态差异-差异设计，我们估计了启动后6年内对政府支出和患者自付费用的影响，以未来的启动者为对照组。研究发现，启动睾酮基性别确认激素疗法在6年内会导致政府支出增加3119澳元（2246美元），自付费用增加143澳元（103美元）；对于接受雌二醇基性别确认激素疗法的患者，相应的估计值分别为8348澳元（6011美元）和1269澳元（914美元）。对于睾酮基性别确认激素疗法的接受者，启动后政府费用和自付费用均有所下降，其中心理健康服务的减少幅度超过了持续进行的激素疗法支出。对于雌二醇基性别确认激素疗法的接受者，费用也有所下降，但仍高于基线水平，这主要是由于持续的药剂支出。综合来看，我们的结果表明性别确认激素疗法可能是具有成本效益的。

abstract.text: We study the effect of rural-urban migration on the well-being of older adults who remain in rural communities in China, a country that is experiencing extensive rural-urban migration and rapid population aging. We exploit China's historic "sent-down youth" program which temporarily relocated millions of urban youth to rural villages and created lasting social ties between sending cities and receiving villages. These ties coupled with present-day variation in urban growth create exogenous variation in present-day rural-urban migration rates, which we use in an instrumental variables framework to identify the causal effects of migration on health. Results suggest that migration negatively affects the physical, cognitive, and emotional health of older adults that remain behind.

10.1002/hec.70128.abstractZh: 我们研究了农村向城市迁移对中国农村社区中老年人口福祉的影响。中国正处于农村向城市迁移的广泛时期，人口老龄化进程也日益加快。我们利用了中国历史上“下乡青年”计划这一举措，该计划曾将数百万城市青年临时安置到农村村庄，从而在输出城市与接收村庄之间建立了持久的社会联系。这些联系与当前城市发展的变化相结合，导致了农村向城市迁移率的差异。我们在工具变量框架中利用这些差异来识别迁移对健康的影响。研究结果表明，迁移对留守老年人的身体、认知和情绪健康产生了负面影响。

abstract.text: As an increasing number of states legalize recreational cannabis, it is increasingly important to understand the optimal tax design for recreational cannabis. Currently, various tax bases (weight, potency, price) and rates are used. However, the empirical evidence on the impact of tax-related attributes (pre-tax prices, tetrahydrocannabinol [THC] levels, tax bases, and tax rates) and their interactions on consumption is limited. To address this evidence gap, this study utilizes a split-sample volumetric choice experiment to understand the impact of pre-tax prices, tax bases, tax rates, and THC levels on cannabis consumption and THC intake by US adult users. We further estimated the own- and cross-price elasticities for four cannabis forms (legal flower, illegal flower, edibles, and vaping concentrates). We collected a nationally representative sample of N = 1525 US adults aged 21+ who reported the past 30-day use of recreational cannabis in June and July 2024. Participants were randomized into seeing one of the three different tax bases, and each person answered 9 choice questions where they were given varying combinations of pre-tax prices, tax rates, and THC levels of the four cannabis products. Zero-inflated negative binomial regressions were used to estimate the impacts of varying factors on the cannabis consumption (units and THC) and own- and cross-price elasticities. The interactions between tax bases and their targeted attributes were explored using a linear model accounting for individual fixed effects. Higher pre-tax prices and tax rates significantly reduce consumption, whereas higher THC levels increase consumption. Compared to a tax rate of 60% of pretax prices or equivalent, an 80% rate does not induce further consumption reduction. The overall price elasticities of cannabis demand range from -0.4 to -0.5, with form- or product-specific price elasticities ranging between -0.2 and -0.4. Illegal and legal flowers are substitutes for each other. Edibles and cartridges are complements for each other. In addition, illegal flowers are substitutes for legal cartridges, and edibles are complements to flowers. While increases in the prices of legal products significantly reduce their consumption, 89% of this reduction may be offset by switching to illegal products. While tax bases do not significantly impact consumption, a potency tax base reduces the consumption of higher potency products, and a price tax base reduces the consumption of higher-priced products. If the illegal market is restricted, policymakers can expect increasing cannabis prices using excise taxes to reduce both unit and THC consumption, while generating tax revenues. However, given the sizable illegal market, a large portion of the consumption reduction due to taxes may be offset by switching to illegal products. Tax rates reduce consumption in addition to base prices. There is room to increase cannabis tax rates to 60% of pretax prices or equivalent to counter the decreasing prices. While tax bases are not effective in reducing overall consumption, they can shift the preference of products with the attributes that they target (e.g., high potency or high price); therefore, they could be a useful tool to shift product choices. Capping THC levels also has a direct impact on reducing consumption.

10.1002/hec.70129.abstractZh: 随着越来越多的州将娱乐性大麻合法化，了解娱乐性大麻的最优税收设计变得越来越重要。目前，采用了多种税收基础（重量、效力、价格）和税率。然而，关于税收相关属性（税前价格、四氢大麻酚[THC]含量、税收基础和税率）及其对消费影响的实证证据有限。为了填补这一证据空白，本研究利用分割样本体积选择实验，来研究税前价格、税收基础、税率和THC含量对美国成年用户的大麻消费和THC摄入量的影响。我们还估算了四种大麻产品的自身价格弹性和交叉价格弹性（合法大麻花、非法大麻花、食用大麻和雾化浓缩物）。我们收集了1525名21岁及以上的美国成年人的全国代表性样本数据，这些人在2024年6月和7月报告了过去30天内使用娱乐性大麻的情况。参与者被随机分配到三种不同的税收基础之一，每个人回答了9个选择问题，其中包含了四种大麻产品的不同税前价格、税率和THC含量组合。使用零膨胀负二项回归来估计不同因素对大麻消费（单位和THC）以及自身价格和交叉价格弹性的影响。通过线性模型并考虑个体固定效应，探讨了税收基础与其目标属性之间的相互作用。较高的税前价格和税率显著减少了消费，而较高的THC含量则增加了消费。与税前价格的60%或相应的税率相比，80%的税率并没有进一步减少消费。大麻需求的整体价格弹性介于-0.4到-0.5之间，而特定形式或产品的价格弹性则在-0.2到-0.4之间。非法和合法的大麻产品可以相互替代。食用大麻制品和针管则是对立关系。此外，非法大麻产品可以替代合法针管，而食用大麻制品则与大麻产品形成互补关系。虽然合法产品的价格上涨会显著减少其消费，但89%的减少量可以通过转向非法产品来弥补。虽然税收基数对消费影响不大，但浓度较高的产品会受到税收的影响而减少消费，而价格较高的产品则会被价格税抑制消费。如果限制非法市场，政策制定者可以通过消费税来降低单位消费和THC消费，同时增加税收收入。然而，鉴于非法市场的规模，由于税收导致的消费减少部分可能会被转向非法产品所抵消。税率除了影响价格外，还会减少消费。有空间将大麻的税率提高到税前价格的60%，或者达到与价格下降相平衡的水平。虽然税收基数在减少整体消费方面效果有限，但它们可以改变消费者对于特定属性的产品的偏好（例如，高浓度或高价产品），因此，它们可以成为调整产品选择的有效工具。限制THC含量也能直接减少消费。

abstract.text: Air pollution is a significant environmental issue with widespread impacts on public health. Evidence on the causal effect of air pollution control policies on weight-related outcomes remains limited. This study fills this gap by leveraging the Air Pollution Prevention and Control Action Plan as a quasi-natural experiment, combining four waves (2010, 2012, 2014, 2016) of panel data from the China Family Panel Studies (CFPS). Employing a difference-in-differences framework, we find that implementing this policy significantly reduces overweight risk among residents. Mechanism analyses indicate that the policy primarily lowers overweight risk by increasing physical exercise frequency and alleviating depressive symptoms. Further heterogeneity analyses show this impact is particularly pronounced among urban residents, young adults, females, and individuals with lower educational attainment. Our findings clarify the causal link between environmental regulation and population health, and provide actionable insights for policymakers to design coordinated interventions that leverage air quality improvements to advance public health goals.

10.1002/hec.70130.abstractZh: 空气污染是一个重要的环境问题，对公共健康有广泛的影响。关于空气污染控制政策对体重相关结果的影响的实证研究仍然有限。本研究通过利用《空气污染预防与控制行动计划》作为准自然实验，结合中国家庭追踪调查（CFPS）的四波数据（2010年、2012年、2014年、2016年），填补了这一空白。采用差异-差异框架分析后，我们发现实施该政策显著降低了居民的超重风险。机制分析表明，该政策主要通过增加体育锻炼频率和缓解抑郁症状来降低超重风险。进一步的异质性分析显示，这种影响在城市居民、年轻人、女性以及教育程度较低的个体中尤为明显。我们的研究结果阐明了环境监管与人群健康之间的因果关系，并为政策制定者提供了可操作的建议，以设计协调一致的干预措施，利用空气质量改善来推进公共卫生目标。

abstract.text: This research investigates the displacement and substitution effects of installing physical barriers in metro stations for suicide prevention. Although physical barriers are considered effective at reducing suicides at a given metro station, it remains unexplored whether their installation actually decreases suicide attempts at the macro level. Exploiting the timing of the installation and using platform-level novel data on suicide attempts, we find new evidence showing that installing physical barriers at metro stations causes (1) displacement to other lines without barriers in the same station, (2) displacement to other single-line stations, and (3) substitution to other suicide methods.

10.1002/hec.70131.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了在地铁站安装物理屏障以预防自杀的位移效应和替代效应。尽管物理屏障被认为能在特定地铁站有效减少自杀行为，但其在宏观层面上是否真的减少了自杀企图，目前尚未得到证实。通过研究屏障安装的时机，并利用关于自杀企图的新型平台级数据，我们发现新的证据表明，在地铁站安装物理屏障会导致以下现象：(1) 将自杀者转移到同一站内没有屏障的其他线路上；(2) 将自杀者转移到其他单线路站点上；(3) 促使自杀者采用其他自杀方式。

abstract.text: We analyse the impact of the construction of medical schools and associated university hospitals in Japan during the 1970s, which was primarily driven by 'One Prefecture, One Medical School Policy' (OPOMS). We find that the number of physicians increased significantly in prefectures where a medical school was built, and this effect persisted for more than 20 years. Moreover, we uncover suggestive evidence that the establishment of university hospitals may lead to a reduction in the overall mortality rate, especially among the elderly. Our results also indicate that the improvement in health outcomes is likely attributed to access to high-quality care resulting from the opening of university hospitals, rather than an overall increase in the utilisation of healthcare services.

10.1002/hec.70132.abstractZh: 我们分析了20世纪70年代日本医学院建设及相关大学医院建设的影响，这一进程主要由“一县一医学院政策”推动。研究发现，在建立医学院的县，医生数量显著增加，且这一效应持续了20多年。此外，我们发现了一些有启发性的证据，表明大学医院的建立可能会降低整体死亡率，尤其是在老年人中。我们的结果还表明，健康状况的改善可能归因于大学医院的开办带来了高质量的医疗服务，而非医疗服务利用的整体增加。

abstract.text: Although flexible employment policies can help employed individuals balance caregiving and paid work, limited evidence has been devoted to examining the effect of working flexibly on the supply of care to older adults. In this paper, we study the impact of flexible working conditions on the supply of informal adult care and mental health. We exploit variation from the 2014 expansion of the Right to Request Flexible Work (RRFW) to employees in the UK. Our findings point to a gendered response to increased employment flexibility. We document a 1.3-percentage-point increase in the likelihood that men provide informal care within the household, alongside less regular daytime work, greater control over working hours, and higher engagement in home production. In contrast, among potential female caregivers, we find that the reform reduced the probability of high-intensity caregiving, which is typically incompatible with employment or related activities. We document that the increased workplace flexibility not only encourages caregiving but also helps reduce gender disparities in unpaid care. We additionally find suggestive evidence of improved mental health outcomes, particularly among men.

10.1002/hec.70133.abstractZh: 尽管灵活的就业政策可以帮助有工作的个体平衡照顾工作与有偿工作，但关于灵活工作对老年人护理供应影响的实证研究却相对较少。本文研究了灵活工作条件对非正式成人护理和心理健康的影响。我们利用了2014年英国“灵活工作权”法案实施后的数据进行分析。研究发现，男性在提供家庭内非正式护理方面的可能性增加了1.3个百分点，同时他们白天的工作时间变得不那么规律，对工作时间的控制能力增强，并且更积极参与家庭生产活动。相比之下，女性潜在照顾者则发现，这项改革降低了她们进行高强度护理的可能性，因为高强度护理通常与就业或相关活动不相容。研究还发现，增加的工作灵活性不仅促进了照顾行为的实施，还有助于减少无偿护理方面的性别差异。此外，我们还发现了一些迹象表明，灵活工作条件有助于改善心理健康状况，尤其是在男性中。

abstract.text: Investigating the impact of healthcare expenditure on health is crucial for optimizing public resource allocation. This can inform the value of expanding healthcare budgets and provide a benchmark for allocations within healthcare systems. However, empirical evidence remains mixed. The potential causes of mixed results-reverse causality and unobservable confounders-need to be addressed through robust empirical methods. This study assesses the South Korean public healthcare cost of producing one quality-adjusted life year (QALY) by using conversion factors-elements in the pricing formula of healthcare services determined by negotiations-as the instrument, with two-way fixed effects. Moreover, since morbidity significantly affects health, it is crucial to estimate the impact of healthcare expenditure on morbidity using credible data. We use a unique dataset of directly measured regional EQ-5D indices from 240 municipalities for the period 2008-2019, which is unavailable in other countries. We estimate that $12,847 of public healthcare expenditure is required to gain one QALY. Sensitivity analyses using alternative calculation methods, data, and models produce estimates ranging from $8850 to $17,674 per QALY. Our findings suggest that the healthcare cost of producing one QALY is substantially lower than the GDP per capita and the willingness-to-pay for health in South Korea.

10.1002/hec.70134.abstractZh: 研究医疗支出对健康的影响对于优化公共资源配置至关重要。这有助于了解扩大医疗预算的价值，并为医疗系统的资源配置提供基准。然而，实证结果仍然参差不齐。这种结果的混杂性可能由反向因果关系和不可观测的混杂因素引起，需要通过严谨的实证方法来解决。本研究使用通过谈判确定的医疗服务定价公式中的转换因子作为工具，采用双向固定效应模型来评估韩国公共医疗支出产生一个质量调整生命年（QALY）的成本。此外，由于发病率对健康有显著影响，因此使用可信数据来估计医疗支出对发病率的影响至关重要。我们使用了来自2008-2019年期间240个市镇的经直接测量的区域EQ-5D指数数据集，这一数据集在其他国家并不常见。我们的估计结果显示，要获得一个QALY，需要12,847美元的公共医疗支出。使用不同的计算方法、数据和模型进行的敏感性分析表明，每个QALY的成本范围在8,850美元到17,674美元之间。我们的研究结果表明，产生一个QALY所需的医疗成本远低于韩国的人均GDP以及人们愿意为健康支付的费用。

abstract.text: Surgical treatments are offered more widely than ever before, increasingly to older and high-risk patients. However, it is unclear whether patients making surgical decisions are fully informed about the risks of surgery and the available non-surgical treatments. Especially for high-risk patients, unrecognized elevated post-surgery risks may make non-surgical treatments particularly relevant. In this paper, we study the role of information provision and the availability of non-surgical treatments for high-risk patients considering hip replacement surgery in the UK. We develop a discrete choice model of incorrect beliefs about post-surgery outcomes and limited availability of non-surgical treatments, which we estimate using an online choice experiment. In the experiment, participants take the perspective of a hypothetical high-risk patient; we elicit their beliefs about post-surgery outcomes and randomize additional information about these outcomes and the availability of physiotherapy. We find that beliefs differ systematically from predicted post-surgery outcomes and that the provision of additional information has heterogeneous effects on belief accuracy. We show that excluding physiotherapy from the available treatments accounts for four-fifths of the participants' total welfare loss, while incorrect beliefs about post-surgery outcomes account for the remainder. We find evidence that education is a strong predictor of welfare loss from incorrect beliefs.

10.1002/hec.70135.abstractZh: 如今，外科手术的治疗方式比以往任何时候都更为普遍，尤其是针对老年和高风险患者。然而，目前尚不清楚做出手术决策的患者是否充分了解手术的风险以及可用的非手术治疗方法。特别是对于高风险患者而言，未被识别出的术后风险可能会使非手术治疗方法变得尤为重要。在本文中，我们研究了信息提供与非手术治疗方法的可获得性对英国考虑进行髋关节置换手术的高风险患者的影响。我们建立了一个离散选择模型，模拟了关于术后结果的错误认知以及非手术治疗方法有限的可获得性，并通过在线选择实验进行了验证。在实验中，参与者以假设的高风险患者的视角参与，我们收集了他们对术后结果的认知，并随机分配了关于这些结果以及物理治疗可用性的额外信息。研究发现，参与者的认知与预测的术后结果存在系统性差异，而提供额外信息对认知准确性的影响则有所不同。我们指出，将物理治疗排除在可选治疗方法之外可以解释参与者总福利损失的四分之三，而关于术后结果的错误认知则占据了剩余部分。我们还发现，教育程度是预测因错误认知导致的福利损失的一个重要因素。

abstract.text: This study investigates the relationship between economic preferences and COVID-19 vaccination readiness using two representative samples of the German population (N > 5000). We elicited altruism, patience, risk-taking and trust using validated survey questions. We find robust, positive relationships between vaccination readiness and both patience and trust. The positive association between altruism and vaccination readiness vanishes when controlling for the other preference dimensions. No consistent effect emerges for risk-taking. Our results underscore the importance of accounting for the interrelated nature of economic preferences when analyzing their connection with field behavior.

10.1002/hec.70136.abstractZh: 本研究通过德国人口的两个代表性样本（样本量超过5000人），探讨了经济偏好与COVID-19疫苗接种意愿之间的关系。我们使用经过验证的调查问卷来测量利他主义、耐心、风险承担和信任等经济偏好维度。研究发现，疫苗接种意愿与耐心和信任之间存在稳健的正相关关系。而当控制其他偏好维度后，利他主义与疫苗接种意愿之间的正相关关系消失。对于风险承担而言，则没有发现一致性的影响。我们的研究结果强调了在分析经济偏好与行为之间的关系时，考虑其相互关联性的重要性。

abstract.text: Choosing a hospital for elective inpatient care is a complex decision due to pervasive information asymmetries and multidimensional quality attributes. Online reviews provide an accessible and salient source of hospital quality information that could influence patient choices. Using the universe of hospital Yelp reviews and inpatient claims data for elective procedures in Florida (2012-2017), we exploit exogenous variation in online ratings to estimate the causal effect of online reviews on hospital selection. Depending on the underlying condition, we find that patients are willing to travel 7.9% farther for labor and delivery and 33.5% farther for orthopedic surgery for a one-standard-deviation increase in a hospital's rating percentile rank within its market, which is roughly a half-star increase. The larger response for orthopedic procedures is consistent with greater reliance on online information when provider relationships are weaker. Falsification tests on emergency admissions yield null results, confirming that online reviews influence elective rather than urgent decision-making. Our findings highlight the role of consumer-generated information in healthcare markets and suggest that online platforms can meaningfully shape provider competition.

10.1002/hec.70138.abstractZh: 选择一家医院进行择期住院护理是一个复杂的决策，因为信息的不对称普遍存在，且医院的质量属性具有多维度特征。在线评论提供了易于获取且显著的医院质量信息来源，这可能会影响患者的选择。我们利用佛罗里达州（2012-2017年）医院Yelp评论和择期手术的患者索赔数据，利用在线评分中的外部变异来估计在线评论对医院选择的影响。根据患者所患疾病的不同，我们发现患者愿意为了分娩手术多旅行7.9%，为了骨科手术多旅行33.5%，以换取医院评分等级上升一个标准差，这大约相当于提高半星等级。骨科手术的这种较大反应表明，在医疗服务提供者关系较弱的情况下，患者更依赖在线信息。对急诊入院情况的 falsification 测试结果为阴性，证实在线评论主要影响择期而非紧急决策。我们的研究结果强调了消费者生成的信息在医疗市场中的作用，并表明在线平台能够显著影响医疗服务提供者的竞争。

abstract.text: Multidimensional patient-reported outcome measures (PROMs) are increasingly used to compare the performance of health care providers. Meaningful comparisons require the data to be adjusted for differences in case-mix. The common approach in the literature is to aggregate PROM data into univariate summary scores prior to case-mix adjustment. In this paper, we extend the work by McCarthy (2015, 2016) to develop a dimension-specific adjustment methodology for performance assessment. This method permits to model the influence of patient characteristics separately for each dimension while retaining the maximum amount of information to inform different stakeholders. We conduct a simulation study to compare the performance of both methods in terms of their ability to identify provider performance, and to identify context-specific factors that should guide the choice of methodology in applied research. We follow this up with a real-world case study of knee replacement surgery in the English NHS. We find that the domain-specific approach outperforms the summary score approach in most cases but the differences are small. We conclude that the choice of method ought to consider not just performance but also ease of implementation and retention of decision-relevant granular information.

10.1002/hec.70139.abstractZh: 多维患者报告结局指标（PROMs）越来越多地被用于比较医疗保健提供者的表现。要进行有意义的比较，需要调整数据以考虑病例组合的差异。文献中常见的做法是在进行病例组合调整之前，将PROM数据汇总为单变量总结分数。在本文中，我们扩展了McCarthy（2015年，2016年）的工作，开发了一种针对每个维度进行性能评估的调整方法。该方法允许分别对每个维度的患者特征的影响进行建模，同时保留尽可能多的信息，以便为不同利益相关者提供信息。我们通过模拟研究来比较这两种方法在识别提供者表现方面的能力，以及识别在应用研究中应选择哪种方法时应考虑的特定情境因素。随后，我们以一个英国NHS的膝关节置换手术案例研究为例。我们发现，在特定领域的方法在大多数情况下优于总结分数方法，但差异很小。我们得出结论，选择方法时应考虑性能、实施难度以及保留与决策相关的详细信息等因素。

abstract.text: Waiting times for planned health care treatments have been increasing in England and other OECD countries. One policy to reduce the impact of waiting times on patients' health is for doctors to prioritise patients according to their health status. This study tests the extent to which publicly-funded patients in poorer health are prioritised on the list, and whether prioritisation differs between public and private providers. We use hospital administrative data in 2015-2021 on hip replacements in England. Our results provide evidence of inpatient waiting-time prioritisation (from specialist addition to list to admission for surgery) based on pre-operative health with a difference of at least 15 days between patients with lowest and highest pre-operative health. The gradient becomes steeper as waiting times increase, and much steeper during COVID-19. While outpatient waiting times (from referral to specialist visit) comprise a substantial proportion of total time waited (inpatient plus outpatient), we find limited evidence of outpatient waiting time prioritisation. Differences in inpatient waiting-time prioritisation between public and private providers are mostly due to different casemix and shorter average waiting times by private providers. We also simulate the effect of prioritisation policies that reduce inpatient waiting times for patients with low pre-operative health by 20% while simultaneously increasing it for those with high pre-operative health. We find that these policies could generate health gains of 183 QALYs in a given year. We conclude that there is scope for improving prioritisation of patients on the waiting list.

10.1002/hec.70140.abstractZh: 英格兰及其他经合组织国家的计划性医疗治疗等待时间持续增加。一项旨在减轻等待时间对患者健康影响的政策是，医生根据患者的健康状况对其进行优先处理。本研究探讨了公共资金资助且健康状况较差的患者在优先处理名单中的比例，以及公立和私立医疗机构在优先处理方面的差异。我们使用了2015-2021年英格兰髋关节置换手术的医院行政数据。研究结果表明，住院等待时间的优先处理是基于患者术前健康状况进行的，术前健康状况最低的患者与最高患者的等待时间相差至少15天。随着等待时间的增加，这种差异变得更加明显，在COVID-19疫情期间这一差异更为显著。尽管门诊等待时间（从转诊到专科就诊）占总等待时间的重要部分，但我们发现关于门诊等待时间优先处理的证据有限。公立和私立医疗机构在住院等待时间优先处理方面的差异主要源于病例组合的不同以及私立医疗机构平均等待时间的较短。我们还模拟了优先处理政策的效果：该政策可使术前健康状况较差的患者等待时间减少20%，同时使术前健康状况较好的患者等待时间延长。研究发现，这些政策每年可带来183个健康相关生命年值的收益。我们得出结论，在等待名单上的患者优先处理方面仍有改进空间。

abstract.text: Many previous studies have used cross-cohort comparisons and a focus on in utero exposure to document the lingering effects of the 1918 influenza pandemic on survivors' outcomes later in life. A subset has examined impacts on old-age health and mortality, finding mixed results. This paper contributes to the literature by extending the analysis to evaluate early-life and childhood exposure to the pandemic on old-age longevity along with a set of candidate mechanisms. We employ Social Security Administration death records linked to the full-count 1940 census and employ event-study and difference-in-difference regressions to compare longevity of cohorts with different age-at-exposure who were born in cities with high versus low exposure based on 1918 influenza-related mortality. Our treatment-on-treated calculations suggest that cohorts with age-at-exposure of 0-5 and 6-11 experience 7.2 and 10.9 months reductions in old age longevity; importantly, we note that these cohorts are often used as "controls" in the broader literature. While our main analysis focuses on males due to data constraints, supplementary results suggest similar effects for females. An analysis of census data suggests reductions in health, education and socioeconomic scores as potential mechanisms. The findings of this paper have important policy implications for interventions and identifying the populations at higher risks of adverse long-term outcomes during major pandemics.

10.1002/hec.70141.abstractZh: 许多先前的研究通过跨队列比较和关注子宫内暴露来研究1918年流感大流行对幸存者后期生活影响的持续影响。部分研究探讨了其对老年健康和死亡率的影响，但结果不一。本文通过扩展分析，评估了早期生活和儿童时期暴露于该大流行对老年寿命的影响，并提出了一些可能的机制。我们利用了与1940年人口普查相关的社会保障管理局死亡记录，并使用事件研究和差异回归方法，比较了在不同暴露年龄、出生在1918年流感相关死亡率较高或较低城市的队列的寿命。我们的处理组与对照组比较结果显示，在0-5岁和6-11岁的暴露年龄队列中，老年寿命分别减少了7.2个月和10.9个月；值得注意的是，这些队列在更广泛的文献中常被用作“对照组”。虽然我们的主要分析由于数据限制而主要关注男性，但补充结果显示女性也受到类似的影响。对人口普查数据的分析表明，健康、教育和社会经济状况的下降可能是潜在的机制。本文的研究结果对于制定干预措施以及识别在重大疫情中面临长期不良后果的高风险人群具有重要的政策意义。

abstract.text: A near majority of states have now passed recreational marijuana laws (RMLs), but their impact on labor market behavior remains unclear. This study provides new causal evidence on the relationship between RMLs and workplace absence. Using a generalized difference-in-differences framework to exploit the staggered rollout of RMLs, I first document that the onset of legal recreational sales is accompanied by a 50% increase in the prevalence of prior-month adult marijuana use in treated states relative to control states. Next, I show that retail market access leads to a 14% increase in the incidence of prior-week workplace absence. Supplemental analyses of health outcomes suggest that part of the effect may be driven by increases in self-reported mental health problems following the opening of recreational dispensaries. These findings suggest that marijuana legalization may affect labor market outcomes along margins not typically captured by employment status alone.

10.1002/hec.70142.abstractZh: 目前，近半数州已经通过了娱乐性大麻法律，但这些法律对劳动力市场行为的影响仍不清楚。本研究提供了关于娱乐性大麻法律与工作场所缺勤之间关系的新证据。通过采用广义差异比较框架，利用娱乐性大麻法律逐步实施的特性，我首先发现，在合法化实施后的一个月内，实验组州的成年人大麻使用率比对照组州增加了50%。接下来，我指出，零售市场的开放导致过去一周的工作场所缺勤率增加了14%。对健康结果的补充分析表明，部分影响可能是由于娱乐性大麻店开放后，人们自我报告的心理健康问题有所增加。这些发现表明，大麻合法化可能会影响劳动力市场的结果，而这些影响并非仅由就业状况单独决定。

abstract.text: We expand the literature on marginal returns to birth interventions by studying a common intervention: early induction of labor for a growing share of pregnancies, high-Body Mass Index (BMI) women. We exploit Danish guidelines which recommend routine induction at 7 days after the expected due date instead of 10-13 days after for mothers with a pre-pregnancy BMI of at least 35. Our results show that early labor induction improves immediate maternal and neonatal health, reduces universal nurse visits during the child's first year of life, as well as maternal postpartum depression risks (suggestive).

10.1002/hec.70143.abstractZh: 我们通过研究一种常见的干预措施来扩展关于分娩干预的边际回报的文献研究：对BMI较高的孕妇，在妊娠比例逐渐增加的情况下，提前引产。我们参考了丹麦的指南，该指南建议对孕前BMI至少达到35的孕妇在预产期后7天进行常规引产，而不是在预产期后10-13天。我们的研究结果表明，提前引产可以改善孕妇和新生儿的即时健康状况，减少孩子出生后的第一年需要接受护士护理的次数，同时降低孕妇产后抑郁的风险。

abstract.text: Agency theory suggests that variation in providers' quality of care may be explained by their heterogeneous motivations. We provide novel empirical evidence on the links between different sources of provider motivation and quality of care by combining a unique 4-year survey dataset on Danish general practitioners' motivations with quality indicators and control variables from rich register data. Using a within-between regression specification, we estimate the associations between two key sources of motivation (financial motivation and non-paternalistic altruism toward patients) and seven quality indicators related to accreditation standards in general practice. We find that providers' financial motivation is associated with high-quality care that relates to remunerated services. We further find that non-paternalistic altruism toward patients associates with lower-quality prescribing for drugs that may be highly demanded by patients and fewer annual control visits for chronic disease. These links are mostly found when we compare heterogeneously motivated practices (between estimates) rather than when we look at changes within the same practices over time (within estimates). The findings can help policymakers address agency problems that may arise from patient demands and design policies that motivate delivery of high-quality care.
