10.1002/hec.70144.abstractZh: 代理理论指出，医疗服务提供者质量差异可能由他们不同的动机所解释。我们通过结合一项为期4年的丹麦全科医生动机调查数据集，以及丰富的登记数据中的质量指标和控制变量，提供了关于不同医疗服务提供者动机来源与服务质量之间关系的创新性实证证据。采用组内-组间回归模型，我们估计了两种关键动机来源（财务动机和对患者的非家长式利他主义）与七个与全科医生认证标准相关的服务质量指标之间的关联。我们发现，医疗提供者的财务动机与高质量的服务相关，这些服务涉及有偿服务。此外，我们发现对非患者的非家长式利他主义与较低质量的药物处方相关，而患者可能非常需要这些药物；同时，与慢性疾病的年度随访次数也较少。这些关联主要出现在比较不同动机的诊所时（组间估计），而不是在同一诊所内随时间的变化（组内估计）中观察到。这些发现有助于政策制定者解决可能由患者需求引发的代理问题，并设计能够激励提供高质量服务的政策。

abstract.text: This paper estimates the causal effect of Berkeley's sugar-sweetened beverage (SSB) tax on beer purchases and prices using retail scanner data from 2014 to 2015. Applying both synthetic control and difference-in-differences (DID) approaches, we find that the tax reduced beer purchases within Berkeley by 8.9%, while having a negligible effect on beer prices. Mechanism analysis indicates that the decline in beer sales is driven primarily by cross-border shopping rather than a reduction in overall beer consumption.

10.1002/hec.70145.abstractZh: 本文利用2014至2015年的零售扫描数据，估计了伯克利对含糖饮料征税对啤酒购买量和价格的影响。通过应用合成控制和差异中差异（DID）方法，我们发现该征税使伯克利的啤酒购买量减少了8.9%，而对啤酒价格的影响则微乎其微。机制分析表明，啤酒销售量的下降主要源于跨境购物行为，而非整体啤酒消费量的减少。

abstract.text: Diet-related morbidity and mortality now exceed those associated with hunger worldwide. Although risk and time preferences are correlated with dietary behavior, evidence from the Global South remains limited. In particular, the role of human-capital risk-distinct from health risk-in shaping dietary choices has not been systematically examined. This study addresses this gap using incentivized lab-in-the-field experiments and 2024 survey data from Mekelle city, northern Ethiopia. A control-function approach accounts for potential health-status endogeneity, Oster's coefficient stability test assesses sensitivity to unobserved heterogeneity, and double Lasso tests the exclusion of insignificant variables while controlling for structural errors. Results show that impatience, impulsivity, and risk aversion are generally negatively associated with demand for healthy dietary components, although associations vary by outcome. Risk-averse subjects report stronger healthy-eating intentions but exhibit comparatively lower observed investment in healthy foods, consistent with concerns about human-capital risk.

10.1002/hec.70146.abstractZh: 与饮食相关的发病率和死亡率现已超过全球因饥饿导致的疾病。尽管风险偏好与饮食行为之间存在关联，但来自全球南方的相关证据仍然有限。特别是，人力资本风险——与健康风险不同——在塑造饮食选择中的作用尚未得到系统研究。本研究通过实验室与实地相结合的激励实验，以及来自埃塞俄比亚北部Mekelle市2024年的调查数据，来填补这一空白。研究采用了控制函数方法处理潜在的健康状况内生性问题，Oster系数稳定性测试评估了对未观测异质性的敏感性，而双重Lasso检验则在控制结构误差的情况下排除不显著的变量。研究结果表明，急躁、冲动性和风险厌恶通常与健康饮食成分的需求呈负相关，尽管这种关联因结果而异。风险厌恶的受试者表现出更强的健康饮食意愿，但在健康食品上的实际投入相对较低，这与对人力资本风险的担忧一致。

abstract.text: We use restricted-access birth records from the National Vital Statistics System (NVSS) to document the full age and parity fertility effects of the Colorado Family Planning Initiative (CFPI). The CFPI provided access to every FDA approved method of contraception for free to anyone living below approximately 200% of the federal poverty line from 2009 to 2015. Previous research has demonstrated important effects on fertility at ages 15-29. We estimate the statewide fertility effect of the CFPI for all age groups (15-44) and for all births and for first and non-first births using the synthetic control method. We find large and statistically significant reductions in birth rates for 15-24-year-olds that largely line up with other recent studies, but we find important heterogeneity across parity. For teenagers, we find reductions in first birth rates of about 9%, but much larger reductions in non-first birth rates of 17%-25%. We also find reductions in overall fertility for 20-24 and 25-29-year-olds, but these are entirely driven by reductions of 5%-9% in non-first birth rates, with no significant changes in first births. For 30-39-year-olds, we find small but statistically significant reductions in fertility of 3%-7% across parity levels, and we find a 6% reduction in fertility for 40-44-year-olds. We also conduct inference using synthetic difference-in-differences (SDID) and placebo-based methods. When we do this, our coefficient estimates are similar, though confidence intervals are wider, with specifications on older age groups no longer statistically significant.

10.1002/hec.70147.abstractZh: 我们利用国家生命统计系统的限制访问出生记录，来研究科罗拉多计划生育计划对全年龄组和不同生育阶段生育率的影响。该计划为生活在联邦贫困线200%以下的人群免费提供所有经FDA批准的人工避孕方法，时间跨度从2009年到2015年。先前的研究已经表明，该计划对15-29岁人群的生育率产生了重要影响。我们使用合成控制方法，估计了该计划在全州范围内对所有年龄组（15-44岁）以及所有出生情况（包括首次生育和非首次生育）的生育率影响。研究发现，15-24岁人群的出生率显著下降，这一结果与其他近期研究一致；但不同生育阶段的效应存在显著差异。对于青少年群体，首次生育率下降了约9%，而非首次生育率则下降了17%-25%。此外，20-24岁和25-29岁人群的总体生育率也有所下降，但这些下降主要归因于非首次生育率的下降，而首次生育率则没有显著变化。对于30-39岁人群，我们发现不同生育阶段的生育率均下降了3%-7%，而40-44岁人群的生育率则下降了6%。我们还采用了合成差异-差异方法和安慰剂对照方法进行了分析。这些分析得出的系数估计值相似，尽管置信区间较宽，且对年龄较大群体的影响已不再具有统计学意义。

abstract.text: Medical brain drain poses a major challenge for health systems, reducing physician supply and undermining public investment in medical training. Prior work examined migration flows and their macroeconomic determinants. This study uses a discrete choice experiment to assess how individual background and personality traits shape medical student intentions to migrate and whether job attributes are valued differently at home and abroad. We surveyed 527 senior medical students from 12 Italian universities between November 2020 and July 2021, using Italy as a pertinent case given high physician emigration and limited inflow of foreign-trained doctors. We find that students require compensation of around 30% of physicians' average starting salary to accept a job abroad rather than at home. Those from higher-quality schools or medical families, and those who are more altruistic, competitive, and risk-tolerant, require less compensation to migrate. Valuations of several job attributes also differ by location: at home, students value permanent contracts and professional development; abroad, they are willing to accept temporary contracts but reject under-skilling. These findings suggest that emigration may disproportionately involve the best-trained students. Policy simulations show that improving working conditions, job security, or professional development opportunities each substantially increases the predicted probability of choosing a domestic job, with salary increases having the largest effects.

10.1002/hec.70148.abstractZh: 医疗人才流失对医疗系统构成了重大挑战，导致医生供应减少，并削弱了对医学培训的公共投资。先前的研究探讨了移民流动及其宏观经济决定因素。本研究采用离散选择实验方法，评估个人背景和人格特质如何影响医学学生的移民意愿，以及工作属性在国内外是否受到不同评价。我们在2020年11月至2021年7月期间，对12所意大利大学的527名高年级医学学生进行了调查。考虑到意大利医生大量外流且外国培养的医生流入有限，意大利作为研究案例具有代表性。研究发现，学生需要约30%的医生平均起薪作为补偿才能接受国外工作而非国内工作。来自质量更高的学校或医学家庭的学生，以及那些更无私、更具竞争力且能容忍风险的学生，所需的补偿较少。不同地区的就业属性评价也有所不同：在国内，学生重视长期合同和职业发展；在国外，他们愿意接受临时合同，但拒绝低技能的工作。这些发现表明，移民可能主要涉及最优秀的学生。政策模拟显示，改善工作条件、提高工作安全性或增加职业发展机会，都能显著增加选择国内工作的可能性，其中薪资提升的效果最为显著。

abstract.text: Increasing the state pension (SP) age in the Netherlands from 65 years in 2012 to 67 in 2024 has been shown to cause individuals to work longer. This study addresses a concern regarding possible adverse health effects of an increased SP-age, for example, because individuals trade health investments for working time. We empirically investigated the effects of individuals' SP-age on their annual probability of dying (mortality)-our health measure-by using data for the period 2012-2022 of 1.6 million individuals born in the years 1950-1957. For estimating causal effects we used a regression discontinuity framework which exploited that individuals' SP-age depends on their year and month of birth. Our empirical findings show negative associations of mortality with the SP-age and work, and do not support a causal effect of the SP-age on mortality, nor a causal effect of work on mortality. These findings hold for both genders, across socioeconomic groups, and for different causes of death. Hence, our findings suggest null effects of the SP-age on mortality.

10.1002/hec.70149.abstractZh: 荷兰将国家养老金领取年龄从2012年的65岁提高到2024年的67岁，这一变化被证明会使人们工作年限延长。本研究关注了提高养老金领取年龄可能带来的健康负面影响，例如，人们可能会牺牲健康来换取工作时间。我们通过使用2012年至2022年间出生的160万人的数据，实证分析了个人养老金领取年龄对其年度死亡概率的影响——这是我们的健康指标。为了估计因果效应，我们采用了回归不连续框架，该框架利用了个人养老金领取年龄取决于其出生年份和月份这一特点。我们的实证结果发现，死亡概率与养老金领取年龄和工作时间之间存在负相关关系，但并未发现养老金领取年龄对死亡概率或工作对死亡概率有因果影响。这些发现适用于不同性别、社会经济群体以及不同死因的情况。因此，我们的研究结果表明，养老金领取年龄对死亡概率没有显著影响。

abstract.text: The high cost of health insurance and health care services in the US is affecting not only the uninsured and lower income households, but is beginning to reach into the middle class. Current health insurance benefit designs often fail to address two forms of market failure: poor consumer information and distorted prices. These market failures distort the market for health care services, and contribute to unaffordable health insurance. When combined with the pooling function of health insurance, those sources of market failure also result in income redistributions that arguably are unfair. Using data from the 2019-2022 Medical Expenditure Panel Survey, we provide a detailed analysis of the population experiencing affordability problems. We then explain how existing health insurance benefit designs fail to address those sources of market failure. Finally, we describe a novel benefit design that improves information by telling consumers where to find providers with lower total cost of care and reduces price distortions by sharing the savings with consumers who choose lower cost providers. These steps improve the efficiency of the health care services market and reduce interpersonal subsidies of consumers who prefer higher cost providers.

10.1002/hec.70151.abstractZh: 美国健康保险和医疗服务的高昂成本不仅影响了没有保险和低收入家庭，也开始影响到中产阶级。当前的健康保险福利设计往往无法解决两种市场失灵问题：消费者信息不足和价格扭曲。这些市场失灵扭曲了医疗服务的市场，导致保险费用难以承受。结合健康保险的共济功能，这些市场失灵的根源还会导致收入的不公平分配。通过2019-2022年医疗支出调查的数据，我们对面临支付困难的人群进行了详细分析。接着，我们解释了现有健康保险福利设计如何未能解决这些市场失灵问题。最后，我们提出了一种创新的福利设计方案，该方案通过向消费者提供更低总成本医疗服务提供者的信息来改善信息获取，并通过与选择低成本医疗服务者的消费者分享节省下来的费用来减少价格扭曲。这些措施提高了医疗服务的市场效率，并减少了消费者因选择更高成本医疗服务而承受的额外负担。

abstract.text: Healthcare decision-making often requires selecting among multiple treatment options under budget constraints, particularly when one option is more effective but also more costly. Cost-effectiveness analysis (CEA) provides a framework for evaluating whether the health benefits of a treatment justify its additional costs. A key component of a CEA is the estimation of treatment effects on both health outcomes and costs, which becomes challenging when using observational data, due to potential confounding. While advanced causal inference methods exist for use in such circumstances, their adoption in CEAs remains limited, with many studies relying on overly simplistic methods such as linear regression or propensity score matching. In this paper, we address this gap by introducing cost-effectiveness researchers to modern nonparametric regression models, with a particular focus on Bayesian Additive Regression Trees (BART). We provide guidance on how to implement BART in CEAs, including code examples, and discuss its advantages in producing more robust and credible estimates from observational data.

10.1002/hec.70153.abstractZh: 在医疗决策中，常常需要在预算限制下从多个治疗方案中选择，尤其是当某个方案虽然效果更好，但成本也更高时。成本效益分析为评估某种治疗方案的健康效益是否值得其额外成本提供了框架。成本效益分析的一个关键部分是估计该治疗方案对健康和成本的影响，而使用观察性数据来进行这一估计时，由于可能存在混杂因素，会面临挑战。虽然存在适用于此类情况的先进因果推断方法，但在成本效益分析中的应用仍然有限，许多研究仍然依赖于线性回归或倾向得分匹配等过于简单的方法。在本文中，我们通过将现代非参数回归模型引入成本效益分析领域来填补这一空白，特别关注贝叶斯加性回归树。我们提供了如何在成本效益分析中实施贝叶斯加性回归树的指导，包括代码示例，并讨论了其在从观察性数据中获得更稳健和可信估计方面的优势。

abstract.text: Can maternal health-seeking behavior change with subsequent births? Using two rounds of India's National Family Health Survey and within-mother comparisons, we document a decline in institutional delivery, skilled attendance, and antenatal care after the first birth. We distinguish between learning about individual-specific risk, learning about average childbirth risk through experience and information, and efficient response to biomedical differences across children at different birth orders as potential reasons behind the birth order gradient. The gradient is attenuated among mothers with adverse early birth experiences and among those informed about complications during antenatal care, consistent with belief updating. However, it cannot be fully explained by differences in biomedical risk. Exploiting plausibly exogenous improvements in road connectivity and financial access, we show that credit and supply constraints can amplify the gradient, and improved infrastructure attenuates it.

10.1002/hec.70154.abstractZh: 母性健康寻求行为是否会随着后续分娩而改变？通过印度国家家庭健康调查的两轮数据以及母亲之间的比较，我们发现首次分娩后，机构式分娩、熟练护理和产前护理的数量有所下降。我们将这些差异归因于以下几个因素：了解个体特定的风险、通过经验和信息了解平均分娩风险，以及对不同分娩顺序的婴儿在生物医学方面的差异做出有效反应。对于那些在初次分娩时有不良经历的母亲，以及那些在产前护理过程中了解并发症的母亲来说，这种梯度效应有所减弱，这与信念更新的观点一致。然而，这种差异不能完全由生物医学风险的不同来解释。通过利用道路连通性和经济获取能力方面的改善，我们发现信贷和供应限制可能会放大这种梯度效应，而基础设施的改善则能够减弱这种效应。

abstract.text: This study reviews the literature on the impacts of Certificate-of-Need (CON) laws on outcomes related to hospitals. CON laws require the approval of states' health planning agencies for health care providers to engage in regulated actions such as opening or expanding facilities or purchasing equipment. Economic theory suggests that barriers to entry should reduce competition, leading to higher prices, greater per-firm quantity but lower market quantity, and larger net revenues for incumbent providers. However, defenders of CON laws argue that they ensure high quality standards for new entrants, while also offsetting distortions that disadvantage hospitals and put some at risk of closure. The preponderance of available evidence points toward CON laws restricting entry of new competitors, which in turn increases the number of procedures per hospital. At the same time, CON laws also appear to inhibit hospital expansion, and there is little evidence of increased prices or higher hospital profitability. Studies on hospital efficiency and quality of care for procedures performed exclusively at hospitals mostly point to null or negative effects, but evidence on quality is more mixed for services that can be provided outside of hospitals. With that said, there is a need for new research that utilizes the latest tools for identifying causal effects and better accounts for the wide variation in CON laws across states.

10.1002/hec.70155.abstractZh: 本研究回顾了关于需求认证法案对医院相关结果影响的文献。需求认证法案要求各州的卫生规划机构批准医疗服务提供者进行诸如开设或扩建设施、购买设备等受监管行为。经济理论表明，进入壁垒应降低竞争，导致价格上升、企业数量增加但市场总量减少，现有医疗服务提供者的净收入增加。然而，需求认证法案的拥护者认为，该法案确保了新进入者的高质量标准，同时消除了对医院不利的扭曲现象，并降低了某些医院关闭的风险。现有证据大多表明，需求认证法案限制了新竞争者的进入，从而增加了每家医院的手术数量。同时，需求认证法案似乎也抑制了医院的扩张，几乎没有证据表明价格上升或医院盈利能力提高。关于仅在医院进行的手术的效率与质量的研究大多表明没有或只有负面影响，但对于可以在医院外提供的服务，关于质量的研究结果则更为复杂。尽管如此，仍需要新的研究来利用最新的工具来确定因果效应，并更好地解释各州需求认证法案的广泛差异。

abstract.text: While psychological well-being and life satisfaction have been widely studied, the mental health effects of political events remain understudied. This paper examines how the ideological distance between individuals and their government affects well-being and mental health. We use 11 years of panel data from the SHARE survey across 21 European countries, merged with cabinet ideology data from ParlGov. A two-way fixed-effects model reveals that greater ideological distance negatively impacts life satisfaction and mental health, and, to a lesser extent, overall well-being, especially in polarized countries, among left-leaning individuals after a right-wing shift in the government, among younger adults in our sample (50-66 years) and when government identity is least predictable ex ante.

10.1002/hec.70157.abstractZh: 虽然心理幸福感和生活满意度已经得到了广泛研究，但政治事件对心理健康的影响却尚未得到充分探讨。本文研究了个体与政府之间的意识形态差异如何影响幸福感和心理健康。我们使用了来自21个欧洲国家的SHARE调查数据，这些数据涵盖了11年的时间跨度，并结合了ParlGov提供的内阁意识形态数据。通过双向固定效应模型分析发现，在右翼政府上台后，特别是在意识形态差异较大的国家，左翼倾向的个体在整体幸福感和心理健康方面受到负面影响；此外，在样本中的年轻成年人（50-66岁）中，这种影响更为明显，而当政府身份在事前难以预测时，这种影响更为显著。

abstract.text: The U.S. maternal health crisis disproportionately affects Black women, who face nearly twice the risk of severe maternal morbidity (SMM) compared with White women. Using 2016-2022 Texas hospital discharge data and a validated obstetric comorbidity score, the analysis first documents that the prevalence of SMM increased by 18% between 2016 and 2022, whereas maternal comorbidity burden increased by 42% over the same period. To better assess the role of comorbidities, the comorbidity score is disaggregated into underlying health and pregnancy-specific conditions. Oaxaca-Blinder decompositions indicate that the former accounts for the largest share-49 to 53%-of the Black-White SMM gap, while the latter accounts for an additional third of the disparity. After accounting for these factors, a residual Black-White SMM gap of 17%-20% persists across and within hospitals, including among women treated by the same physician. Overall, the findings underscore the critical need to improve women's health well before childbirth hospitalization and throughout the reproductive life course, while also strengthening prenatal care to prevent and effectively manage conditions that arise during pregnancy.

10.1002/hec.70158.abstractZh: 美国的孕产妇健康危机对黑人女性的影响尤为严重，她们面临严重孕产妇发病率的风险几乎是白人女性的两倍。通过利用2016至2022年德克萨斯州医院出院数据以及经过验证的产科合并症评分，分析显示，2016至2022年间，严重孕产妇发病率的患病率增加了18%，而孕产妇合并症负担在同一时期增加了42%。为了更准确地评估合并症的作用，将合并症评分分解为基础健康状况和妊娠-specific状况。Oaxaca-Blinder分解结果显示，基础健康状况占黑人与白人之间严重孕产妇发病率差异的49%至53%，而妊娠-specific状况则进一步增加了三分之一的差异。在考虑这些因素后，黑人与白人之间仍然存在17%至20%的剩余严重孕产妇发病率差异，这种差异存在于医院内部以及同一位医生治疗的女性之间。总体而言，这些发现强调了在分娩前、住院期间以及整个生育过程中改善女性健康的紧迫性，同时还需要加强产前护理，以预防并有效管理妊娠期间出现的各种状况。

abstract.text: We investigate how donors respond to symbolic incentives, specifically medals, tied to donation intensity and duration. To this aim, we employ panel data encompassing the entire population of blood and plasma donors affiliated with the primary donor association (AVIS) in Tuscany, Italy, covering the period from 2008 to 2019. The structure of the award scheme adopted by AVIS enables us to examine the impact of two distinct characteristics of the symbolic incentives: the assignment as either private or public and the criterion of assignment based exclusively on the number of donations (donation-only) or, under less demanding donation requirements, also on the years of membership (donation-and-membership). After controlling for time-constant unobservable individual traits that may influence the level and the evolution of performance over a donor's career, we find that (i) these symbolic awards do not affect behavior before their obtainment, (ii) receiving an award through the donation-and-membership criterion leads to a subsequent increase in donation frequency, and (iii) receiving an award through the donation-only criterion, regardless of whether it is announced publicly or privately, does not boost donors' performance. These findings suggest that symbolic awards are effective when bestowed upon less accomplished donors by making their attainment not solely contingent on performance but also on membership, and are related to community identification and self-image concerns rather than status-seeking behavior.

10.1002/hec.70159.abstractZh: 我们研究了捐赠者对象征性激励的反应，特别是与捐赠强度和持续时间相关的奖牌。为此，我们采用了涵盖意大利托斯卡纳地区主要捐赠者协会（AVIS）所有血液和血浆捐赠者的面板数据，时间跨度从2008年到2019年。AVIS采用的奖励机制结构使我们能够考察象征性激励的两个不同特征的影响：奖励的归属性质，即私人或公开；以及奖励的分配标准，仅基于捐赠次数（仅捐赠标准），或在较低的捐赠要求下，也基于会员年限（捐赠与会员标准）。在控制了可能影响捐赠者职业生涯中表现水平和演变的恒定时间不可观测的个人特征后，我们发现：(i) 这些象征性奖励在获得之前并不会影响捐赠者的行为；(ii) 通过捐赠与会员标准获得奖励会随后增加捐赠频率；(iii) 通过仅捐赠标准获得奖励，无论该奖励是公开还是私下宣布，都不会提升捐赠者的表现。这些发现表明，当象征性奖励授予那些表现稍逊的捐赠者时，这些奖励之所以有效，是因为它们的获得不仅取决于表现，还取决于会员身份，并且与社区认同和自我形象问题有关，而非追求地位的行为。

abstract.text: Certificate-of-Need laws in 35 US states require healthcare providers to obtain government approval before building new facilities or expanding services. Their stated goal is to ensure a genuine community need and avoid redundant services, with the aim of controlling healthcare costs and distributing resources fairly, although their effectiveness is debated. Our study differs from previous literature as we present the causal effects of repealing Certificate-of-Need laws on various healthcare expenses using modern difference-in-differences techniques and event studies. Our findings suggest that repealing Certificate-of-Need laws can reduce the burden of healthcare spending.

10.1002/hec.70160.abstractZh: 美国35个州的“需求认证”法案要求医疗服务提供者在进行新设施建设或扩展服务之前获得政府批准。该法案的初衷是确保确实存在社区需求，避免重复建设，从而控制医疗成本并公平分配资源，不过其效果仍有争议。我们的研究不同于以往的研究，采用现代差异比较方法和事件研究，探讨了废除“需求认证”法案对各种医疗开支的因果影响。研究发现，废除该法案有助于减轻医疗开支负担。

abstract.text: This paper studies the utilization of dental services during the recent implementation of an adult (age 21 and over) Medicaid dental benefit in West Virginia. We analyze claims data and find: (1) before implementation, quarterly utilization of preventative and restorative services falls from 8% at age 20 to virtually 0% at age 21; (2) post-implementation, utilization falls from 8% at age 20 to 5% at age 21, implying a net increase of 50% of baseline utilization; (3) the net effect of the dental benefit is significantly larger in counties with a larger number of oral health care provider practices. Our results provide evidence that public health insurance expansions are dampened in markets with a limited supply of provider practices.

10.1002/hec.70161.abstractZh: 本文研究了西弗吉尼亚州在实施成人（21岁及以上）医疗补助牙科福利期间牙科服务的利用情况。我们通过分析索赔数据发现：(1)在实施之前，20岁人群的预防性及修复性服务利用率从8%下降到21岁时的几乎为零；(2)实施之后，这一利用率从20岁时的8%下降到21岁时的5%，意味着基线利用率净增加了50％；(3)在口腔护理服务提供者数量较多的县，牙科福利的净效应更为显著。我们的研究结果表明，在服务提供者供应有限的市场中，公共健康保险扩展的影响会减弱。

abstract.text: Population health is a central input into social welfare, but health itself is complex and multidimensional. Mapping multiple dimensions of health into a single population health index may require strong assumptions about how to aggregate and weight across dimensions. This study adopts a novel nonparametric approach to rank individual health as a function of seven biomarkers associated with major domains of physiological health: body mass index (BMI), glycohemoglobin (HbA1c), total cholesterol, alanine aminotransferase (ALT), estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR), systolic blood pressure (SBP), and white blood cell (WBC). This approach avoids arbitrary weighting while requiring only monotonicity and quasi-concavity. Using NHANES data from 1988 to 2018, we document a significant deterioration in the U.S. health distribution, with declines concentrated in the lower tail. Counterfactual decompositions show that one-third of the negative shift can be attributed to an aging, more racially and ethnically diverse population, leaving a remaining portion unexplained by observed factors. The findings highlight the value of distribution-sensitive multidimensional health measures for monitoring health inequality and targeting preventive care.

10.1002/hec.70162.abstractZh: 人口健康是社会福利的核心要素，但健康本身具有复杂性和多维度特征。将健康的多个维度汇总到单一的人口健康指数中，可能需要对如何整合和加权这些维度做出合理的假设。本研究采用一种新颖的非参数方法，根据与生理健康主要领域相关的七个生物标志物对个体健康进行排名：体质指数（BMI）、糖化血红蛋白（HbA1c）、总胆固醇、丙氨酸氨基转移酶（ALT）、估算的肾小球滤过率（eGFR）、收缩压（SBP）和白细胞（WBC）。这种方法避免了任意的加权方式，仅要求数据具有单调性和准凹性。利用1988年至2018年的NHANES数据，我们发现美国的健康状况显著恶化，尤其是低尾部群体的健康状况下降更为明显。反事实分析表明，这种负面变化的三分之一可以归因于人口老龄化以及种族和族裔的多样性增加，而剩余部分则无法用现有因素来解释。这些发现强调了使用分布敏感的多维健康指标来监测健康不平等和针对性提供预防保健的重要性。

abstract.text: In theory, there are several reasons why physician organizational form might affect the price, quantity, and quality of physician services. In this paper, we examine the association between three aspects of physician organizational form and opioid prescribing: solo versus group practice; integration with a hospital versus independent practice; and the average age of the other physicians in the physician's group. We present three key findings. First, physicians who switch from solo to group practice, particularly large-group practice, significantly reduce their prescribing relative to those who stay in solo practice. Conversely, physicians who switch from group to solo practice significantly increase their prescribing by approximately the same amount. Second, physicians who switch from independent to hospital-integrated practice (and those who switch from integrated to independent practice) generally do not significantly change their prescribing. Third, among group-practice physicians, there are significant differences in prescribing by the average of age of physicians in the group, holding constant the physician's own age and other characteristics of the group, the physician, and the physician's patients. Physicians in groups with a higher average age (excluding the index physician) prescribe more intensively and are more likely to write inappropriate opioid prescriptions than physicians in younger groups-holding other factors constant.

10.1002/hec.70163.abstractZh: 理论上，医师组织形式可能会影响医师服务的价格、数量和质量，原因有多种。本文探讨了医师组织形式与阿片类药物处方之间的三个方面的关联：单人执业与团队执业；与医院整合的执业模式与独立执业模式；以及医师所在团队中其他医师的平均年龄。我们得出三个主要结论：首先，从单人执业转为团队执业的医师，尤其是大型团队执业的医师，其处方量显著减少；相反，从团队执业转为单人执业的医师，其处方量也显著增加，但增幅大致相同。其次，从独立执业转为医院整合执业的医师，以及从整合执业转为独立执业的医师，其处方量通常没有显著变化。第三，在团队执业的医师中，即使其他因素保持不变，不同团队中医师的平均年龄对处方量也有显著影响。在平均年龄较高的团队中，除指数医师外，其他医师的处方更为密集，且更有可能开具不适当的阿片类药物处方。

abstract.text: We investigated the causal effects of a college education on smoking, drinking alcohol, sleeping, and site-specific cancer-screening behaviors in Japan. To adjust for endogeneity, we leveraged a unique instrument-demographic distortion caused by a behavior based on a superstition. A superstition held by some Japanese people caused a demographic shift in 1967 that led to an increase in college educational attainment among a certain cohort. Using a recursive bivariate probit approach, we found that having a college education reduced smoking and increased some types of cancer-screening behaviors. Additionally, we found that the causal relationship may be mediated by an improvement in economic and social resources.

10.1002/hec.70164.abstractZh: 我们研究了大学教育对日本人在吸烟、饮酒、睡眠以及特定地区癌症筛查行为方面的因果效应。为了调整内生性问题，我们利用了一种由基于迷信行为引起的独特工具变量——这种迷信行为在1967年导致了一组特定人群中的大学教育程度上升。通过递归双变量Probit模型分析，我们发现拥有大学教育可以减少吸烟行为，并增加某些类型的癌症筛查行为。此外，我们还发现这种因果关系可能通过经济和社会资源的改善而得到中介。

abstract.text: This paper examines the causal impact of health shocks on time spent in home production among retired individuals. Two channels with opposite predictions motivate the analysis: health shocks may tighten household budgets, inducing substitution toward home-produced goods (income effect), or they may reduce the physical and functional capacity to perform domestic tasks (impairing effect). Using longitudinal data from the Health and Retirement Study, I estimate condition-specific causal effects of ten health conditions on home production in a staggered difference-in-differences design. Conditions that impair functional capacity, such as psychiatric conditions, depression on the Center for Epidemiological Studies Depression (CES-D) scale, and adverse self-reported health, reduce home production substantially. Psychiatric conditions reduce weekly home production by 3.2 hours, a 16% decline; CES-D depression and self-reported health shocks each reduce it by approximately 1 hour per week. Conditions that raise out-of-pocket medical costs but impose modest functional limitations produce no increase. The evidence therefore supports the impairing effect and gives no support to the income effect. The decline is not fully offset by increased help utilization or by spending on market substitutes such as housekeeping services, prepared meals, and yard work. Health shocks thus impose welfare costs beyond what monetary measures alone capture, with direct implications for the design of home- and community-based support services for retirees.

10.1002/hec.70165.abstractZh: 本文探讨了健康冲击对退休人士家庭生产时间影响的因果关系。两种具有相反预测结果的渠道引发了分析：健康冲击可能会紧缩家庭预算，导致人们转向购买家庭自产商品（收入效应），或者会降低进行家务劳动的体力和功能能力（损害效应）。利用《健康与退休研究》的纵向数据，我采用分阶段差异差分设计，估计了十种健康状况对家庭生产的特定条件性因果效应。那些损害功能能力的状况，如精神疾病、流行病学研究中心抑郁量表上的抑郁症状以及自我报告的不良健康状况，都会显著减少家庭生产。精神疾病使每周的家庭生产减少3.2小时，降幅达16%；抑郁症状和自我报告的健康状况冲击则分别使每周的家庭生产减少约1小时。那些增加个人医疗成本但功能限制较小的状况，并未导致家庭生产增加。因此，这些证据表明存在损害效应，而收入效应则未被证实。这种减少并未被增加的帮助利用或市场替代品（如家务服务、预制餐食和庭院工作）的支出所完全抵消。因此，健康冲击带来的福利成本超出了单纯货币计量的范围，这对设计针对退休人士的家庭和社区支持服务具有直接意义。

abstract.text: Primary healthcare systems worldwide face a shortage of General Practitioners and Nurses. One response by the English Health System to combat this shortage is to expand the role of non-traditional roles in primary care, often shifting away tasks from Nurses. Non-traditional practitioners, though less taxing on budgets, tend to have less formal training than Doctors and Nurses, which may affect quality of care. Using data from 614,115 respondents to a survey of primary care patients in England between 2018 and 2022, we assess the extent to which non-traditional practitioners meet patients' needs in primary care appointments. Patients who see a non-traditional provider have a 12.6 percentage points lower probability that their care needs were met, relative to those seeing a Nurse. Findings are consistent across linear, probit and instrumented recursive bivariate probit models, and concentrated amongst patients aged 35-54.

10.1002/hec.70166.abstractZh: 全球初级医疗体系面临着全科医生和护士短缺的问题。英国医疗体系为应对这一短缺，采取了扩大非传统医疗角色的作用，通常将一些任务从护士手中转移出去。虽然非传统医疗人员的成本较低，但他们的培训程度通常不如医生和护士，这可能会影响护理质量。通过对比2018年至2022年间英格兰614,115名初级医疗患者调查数据，我们评估了非传统医疗人员在初级医疗预约中满足患者需求的程度。与看护士的患者相比，看非传统医疗人员的患者，其护理需求得到满足的概率低12.6个百分点。研究结果在线性模型、Probit模型以及工具变量递归双变量Probit模型中均保持一致，且主要集中在35-54岁年龄段的患者中。

abstract.text: This paper investigates how rising women's education and exposure to economic and social globalization jointly shape the Double Burden of Malnutrition (DBM), defined as the coexistence of maternal overweight and child stunting within the same household. Drawing on Demographic and Health Surveys (DHS) spanning 1992-2017 across 38 low- and middle-income countries, we first apply a sub-national (DHS region) bivariate statistical decomposition framework that teases apart two forces: "structure effects", which capture changes in how household characteristics relate to DBM while holding their distribution fixed, and "composition effects", which isolate how shifts in the distribution of household characteristics affect DBM while holding their association with DBM constant. In a second-stage analysis, structure effects show that as social globalization deepens, the protective role of women's education against DBM is attenuated and becomes positively associated with DBM, especially in more urbanized regions. Composition effects further reveal that where economic globalization is already advanced, gains in women's education are associated with higher DBM prevalence. Taken together, this empirical evidence suggests that women's education alone may be insufficient to counteract the nutritional risks linked to globalization, underscoring the need for complementary institutional, regulatory, and dietary interventions.

10.1002/hec.70167.abstractZh: 本文探讨了女性教育水平的提高以及经济和社会全球化的影响如何共同塑造了“营养不良的双重负担”（DBM），即同一家庭中同时存在母亲超重和儿童生长迟缓的现象。通过利用1992年至2017年间在38个低收入和中等收入国家进行的人口与健康调查数据，我们首先采用了一种次国家级（DHS区域）的双变量统计分解框架，将两种力量区分开来：“结构效应”，即家庭特征变化对DBM的影响，同时保持其分布不变；“组成效应”，即家庭特征分布变化对DBM的影响，同时保持其与DBM的关联不变。在第二阶段分析中，结构效应表明，随着社会全球化的深入，女性教育对DBM的保护作用减弱，反而与DBM呈正相关，尤其是在城市化程度较高的地区。组成效应进一步显示，在经济全球化已经较为发达的地区，女性教育的提升与更高的DBM发生率相关。综合这些实证证据可以看出，仅靠女性教育可能不足以抵消全球化带来的营养风险，因此还需要辅以制度性、监管性和饮食方面的干预措施。

abstract.text: Do people experiencing depression form accurate expectations about losing their jobs? Linking Estonian panel survey data to administrative employment, diagnosis, and prescription records, I track within-person changes in expected job loss and subsequent realized job loss as individuals move into and out of depression and depression medication. Using individual fixed effects and controls for depression severity and physical health, I find that as the same worker enters the medicated depression state from no depression, expected job loss falls by 3.6 percentage points while realized job loss rises by 5.1 percentage points. The resulting 8.7 percentage-point fall in the forecast error is split almost evenly between less over-prediction among workers who keep their jobs and more under-prediction among workers who lose them. This shift toward optimism is larger for medication classes more closely linked to reward-related pathways and is absent when prescribed medication is not purchased. The welfare implications are two-sided: more optimistic beliefs may reduce worry about job loss, but workers who understate rising risk may prepare less for a separation.

10.1002/hec.70168.abstractZh: 经历抑郁的人是否会形成关于失业的准确预期？通过将爱沙尼亚的面板调查数据与行政就业、诊断和处方记录相结合，我追踪了个体在抑郁和抑郁药物治疗期间对失业预期的变动以及实际失业情况的变化。利用个体固定效应并控制抑郁严重程度和身体健康状况，我发现当同一劳动者从无抑郁状态转变为有抑郁症状时，其预期失业率下降3.6个百分点，而实际失业率则上升5.1个百分点。由此产生的8.7个百分点的预测误差中，保持工作的劳动者对失业的过度预测减少，而失业的劳动者对失业的低估则有所减少。这种向乐观转变的趋势在与奖励相关通路更为紧密联系的药物类别中更为明显，而在未购买处方药物的情况下则不存在这种转变。这种乐观态度的变化具有双重影响：更乐观的信念可能会减少人们对失业的担忧，但低估风险上升的劳动者可能会减少对离职的准备。

abstract.text: We investigate the causal effect of increased elderly welfare expenditure in South Korea on the suicide rate among older adults, using predicted expenditure changes induced by the Basic Pension reform as an instrumental variable. Our findings show that higher welfare spending explains 74.5% of the decline in the suicide rate among individuals aged 65+ between 2013 and 2019, with especially large reductions among men aged 80+. Household-level evidence indicates that while total income remained stable, consumption increased following the reform, particularly in transportation and leisure. We further show that the reform reduced unmet medical needs and stress and increased participation in community and leisure activities, while leaving depressive symptoms unchanged. Overall, the results are consistent with the interpretation that stronger public income transfer programs reduce income uncertainty and expand opportunities for consumption, leisure, and social participation, thereby contributing to lower elderly suicide rates.

10.1002/hec.70169.abstractZh: 我们研究了韩国增加老年人福利支出对老年人自杀率的因果效应，使用由基本养老金改革引发的支出变化作为工具变量。研究发现，2013年至2019年间，65岁及以上人群的自杀率下降了74.5%，其中80岁以上的男性下降幅度尤为显著。家庭层面的数据显示，尽管总收入保持稳定，但改革后消费有所增加，尤其是在交通和休闲方面的消费。此外，改革减少了未满足的医疗需求和压力，增加了参与社区和休闲活动的机会，而抑郁症状则没有变化。总体而言，这些结果支持了这样的解释：更强大的公共收入转移计划能够减少收入不确定性，扩大消费、休闲和社会参与的机会，从而降低老年人的自杀率。

abstract.text: A substantial body of behavioral economics literature links obesity to time preferences, notably impatience-a time-consistent preference for earlier rewards-and present bias-the disproportionate overweighting of immediate payoffs that leads to dynamic inconsistency. Unlike much previous literature, which asks whether time preferences predict weight in broader populations, we examine whether they predict subsequent weight loss among adults who already have overweight or obesity. Using clinically measured outcomes and incentivized preference data from 287 adults with obesity and pre-diabetes enrolled in a 12-month randomized lifestyle-intervention trial, we find that neither impatience nor present bias predicts reductions in body fat or BMI. These findings are robust to alternative measurement strategies and are not explained by the impatience-related attrition that we uncover. To strengthen external validity, we replicate the null relationship using self-reported time preference measures in a nationally representative sample of 7277 adults with overweight or obesity. As baseline impatience meaningfully reduces the likelihood of trial completion, we conclude that impatience affects adherence to medically recommended programs but does not directly impede weight-loss success among those who remain engaged. Interventions targeting impatience or self-control alone may therefore be insufficient to promote weight loss in clinical populations.

10.1002/hec.70172.abstractZh: 大量行为经济学文献将肥胖与时间偏好联系起来，尤其是急躁——一种对早期奖励的时间一致偏好——以及当下偏差——即过分重视即时收益，导致动态不一致性。与许多先前的研究不同，这些研究探讨的是时间偏好是否会影响人群的体重，而我们则研究在已经超重或肥胖的成年人中，时间偏好是否会影响其后续的体重减轻。通过采用临床测量结果以及来自287名超重或肥胖且患有糖尿病前期的成年人的激励性偏好数据，我们发现在12个月的随机生活方式干预试验中，无论是急躁还是当下偏差，都无法预测体脂或BMI的减少。这些发现不受其他测量策略的影响，并且无法用我们发现的与急躁相关的流失现象来解释。为了增强外部有效性，我们在7277名超重或肥胖的成年人中，使用自我报告的时间偏好指标重复了这一研究。结果显示，基线上的急躁显著降低了试验完成的可能性，因此我们认为急躁会影响对医学推荐项目的遵守，但并不会直接阻碍那些持续参与者的体重减轻效果。因此，单独针对急躁或自我控制的干预措施可能不足以促进临床人群的体重减轻。

abstract.text: The use of low-value care practices is extensive. Clinical guidelines and alignment in prescribing practice can facilitate a reduction in related medical practices by physicians as part of de-implementation strategies. Peer influence within physicians' networks can significantly impact clinical behaviors, including the adoption or abandonment of certain prescribing practices. We examine the physicians prescribing alignment related to de-implementing low-value psychotropics prescribing to people with dementia. Using Finnish prescription register data (2014-2020), we identified patient-sharing networks and applied instrumental variable estimation to account for reflection and endogeneity. We instrument patient-sharing network prescribing using peers' peers' prescribing behavior-physicians who share patients with a focal physician's peers but not with the focal physician themselves-to isolate peer effects on psychotropic prescribing to dementia patients. We found that a one percentage point higher share of psychotropic prescribing within physicians' patient-sharing network was associated with a 1.5 percentage point increase in the physician's psychotropic prescribing when controls and time-invariant physician characteristics were fixed. Our findings underscore the need for consensus among physicians to facilitate the de-implementation of low-value care in the context of dementia care.

10.1002/hec.70173.abstractZh: 低价值护理实践的使用非常普遍。临床指南和处方实践的协调可以促使医生减少相关医疗行为，这是去实施策略的一部分。医生网络中的同行影响可以显著地影响临床行为，包括采用或放弃某些处方实践。我们研究了与去实施低价值精神药物处方给痴呆症患者相关的医生处方行为。利用芬兰的处方登记数据（2014-2020年），我们识别出患者共享网络，并采用工具变量估计方法来考虑反射效应和内生性问题。我们通过使用同行对同行处方行为作为工具变量来研究患者共享网络中的处方行为——即与某个医生有患者共享关系的医生，但与该医生本身没有患者共享关系——以分离出同行对痴呆症患者精神药物处方的效应。我们发现，在控制其他变量和固定不变的医生特征后，医生患者共享网络内精神药物处方的比例每提高一个百分点，医生对痴呆症患者的精神药物处方比例就会增加1.5个百分点。我们的研究结果强调了医生之间达成共识的必要性，以促进在痴呆症护理背景下低价值护理的去实施。

abstract.text: We investigate the long-term impacts of participation in the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) before age 18 on adult mental health outcomes. Utilizing data from the Panel Study of Income Dynamics (PSID) spanning 1968-2019, we link adult individuals to their parental households to source early-life experiences, parental information, and adulthood mental health outcomes. To identify the causal impacts of early-life SNAP participation on mental health, we employ a regression discontinuity design (RDD) that exploits state-level gross income eligibility thresholds for SNAP enrollment during early life as the cutoff. Results reveal that early-life SNAP participation reduces the probability of being diagnosed with mental illnesses in adulthood by nearly two percentage points (or 19.6% in relative terms), primarily driven by reductions in depression, mania, schizophrenia, drug or alcohol abuse, and obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD). This effect is most pronounced among individuals who participated in SNAP before the age of six and is greater for females than for males. Additionally, early-life SNAP participants are diagnosed with mental health conditions about 3.7 years earlier than non-participants.

10.1002/hec.70174.abstractZh: 我们研究了在18岁之前参与补充营养援助计划（SNAP）对成年心理健康结果的长期影响。利用1968-2019年的收入动态面板研究数据，我们将成年个体与其父母家庭联系起来，以获取早期生活经历、父母信息以及成年后的心理健康结果。为了确定早期参与SNAP对心理健康的影响，我们采用了回归不连续设计，利用各州在早年参与SNAP的总收入资格门槛作为划分标准。研究结果显示，早期参与SNAP使成年后被诊断出患有精神疾病的几率降低近两个百分点（相对比例约为19.6%），这一效果主要体现在抑郁症、躁狂症、精神分裂症、药物或酒精滥用以及强迫症方面的减少。这种效应在6岁之前参与SNAP的个体中最为明显，且女性比男性更为显著。此外，早期参与SNAP的个体在心理健康问题被诊断出来的时间比未参与该计划的人早约3.7年。

abstract.text: Many major mental health conditions first emerge in childhood, when early intervention can produce both immediate and long-term benefits. The United States has no federal paid sick leave (PSL) policy, but 18 states have implemented PSL mandates that give employees job-protected, paid time off to address their own health needs or those of a dependent. We study the effects of these mandates on children's mental healthcare use, combining data from the 2016 to 2024 National Survey of Children's Health with difference-in-differences and event-study methods. We find suggestive evidence that children's mental healthcare use increases following PSL mandate implementation, though the difference-in-differences estimate is imprecise. Event-study analyses suggest a short-run increase in use that dissipates over time. The increases are particularly pronounced among children ages 5 to 11. These findings suggest that PSL mandates may help parents obtain mental healthcare for their children and make other investments in their children.

10.1002/hec.70176.abstractZh: 许多主要的心理健康问题在儿童时期首次出现，此时进行早期干预可以带来即时的和长期的好处。美国没有联邦层面的带薪病假政策，但18个州已经实施了带薪病假规定，为员工提供有工作保障的带薪休假时间，以便他们能够照顾自己的健康需求或受抚养人的需求。我们研究了这些规定对儿童心理健康医疗服务使用的影响，结合了2016年至2024年《全国儿童健康调查》的数据，并采用了差异比较和事件研究的方法。我们发现，带薪病假规定的实施确实增加了儿童的心理健康医疗服务使用，不过差异比较的估计结果不够精确。事件研究分析表明，这种使用量的增加在短期内有所体现，但随着时间的推移会逐渐消失。这种增加在5至11岁的儿童中尤为明显。这些发现表明，带薪病假规定可能有助于父母为子女获得心理健康医疗服务，并为其子女做出其他投资。

abstract.text: The infamous agricultural pest, the boll weevil, spread across southern US counties between 1892 and 1920. It had devastating impacts on cotton production, a highly child-labor-intensive crop. This study examines how the arrival of the boll weevil and the subsequent reductions in child labor affect later-life mortality outcomes. Using Social Security Administration death records linked with the 1940 census, we document that the staggered spread of the boll weevil improved the longevity of exposed male children. Full exposure to the boll weevil is associated with an intent-to-treat effect of 1-3 months of higher longevity. We show that the estimated effects are robust across a wide array of specifications, are not driven by sociodemographic and socioeconomic compositional change in the final sample, and are not associated with pre-existing trends in the outcome. Further, we find larger impacts among Blacks, children of lower educated mothers, whose fathers work in the farming industry, and those born in high cotton intensity counties. Moreover, the effects appear to be substantially larger among children in states with less restrictive child labor policies, implying the role of these policies in reducing the adverse effects of child labor in the absence of the boll weevil in cotton production counties. Affected children are more likely to migrate, and their destination counties are more likely to be urban and have higher socioeconomic scores. The 1940 census suggests that the exposed children attain higher levels of education and have higher socioeconomic scores. We discuss the policy implications of these results in relation to child labor and school attendance policies in developing countries.

10.1002/hec.70177.abstractZh: 臭名昭著的农业害虫——棉铃虫，在1892年至1920年间在美国南部各州蔓延。这种害虫对棉花生产造成了毁灭性的影响，而棉花生产是一个高度依赖童工的产业。本研究探讨了棉铃虫的入侵以及随后童工减少现象对儿童晚年死亡率的影响。通过结合1940年人口普查数据的社会保障死亡记录，我们发现棉铃虫的逐步扩散提高了接触棉铃虫的男性儿童的寿命。完全接触棉铃虫与1-3个月的额外寿命延长有关。我们的研究表明，这些效应在不同条件下仍然显著，并不受最终样本中的社会人口学和社会经济结构变化的影响，也不与结果的预先存在的趋势相关。此外，我们发现黑人儿童、受教育程度较低的母亲所生的孩子、在农业行业工作的父亲所生的孩子，以及出生在棉花种植密度较高的县里的孩子，受到的影响更大。在那些童工政策较为宽松的州，这种影响更为显著，这表明这些政策在棉铃虫缺席的情况下，能够减少童工带来的负面影响。受影响的儿童更有可能迁移，而他们迁移的目的地往往为城市地区，且社会经济状况较好。1940年人口普查数据显示，接触棉铃虫的儿童受教育程度更高，社会经济状况也更好。我们讨论了这些结果对于发展中国家童工政策和学校出勤政策的影响。

abstract.text: Value of information methods provide an approach to quantify the expected value of resolving uncertainty in a decision. It provides a quantitative basis to assess the expected value of clinical research projects and to understand the health impact of granting accelerated access to innovative medicines with uncertain benefits. Information generated from a clinical trial can be used to inform decisions for patients in the present and in the future. This means that when estimating the expected value of research we must make a judgment about how long the research will be valuable for, which we define as T. Despite its large impact on results, there is scant research, theoretical or empirical, to inform this judgment. We provide a general approach to estimating T reflecting treatment entry and price changes. In our case study we find T ranges between 13 years and infinity. The specific value depends on the type of parameter (whether it is treatment specific or not), the rate of innovation in the indication of interest and the magnitude of price reduction associated with generic entry. For the first time, this provides a method and starting point for analysts to justify the choice of T in applied contexts.

10.1002/hec.70178.abstractZh: 信息价值分析可以量化消除决策不确定性的预期价值，从而评估临床研究项目的预期收益，也帮助判断提前使用疗效尚不确定的创新药物会带来怎样的健康影响。一项临床试验产生的信息既可用于当下，也可用于未来的患者。因此，估算研究的预期价值时，需要判断这些信息能在多长时间内保持价值。我们将这一期限记为 T。尽管 T 对结果影响很大，可供判断的理论和实证依据都很有限。我们提出一种通用估算方法，把新疗法进入市场和价格变化考虑在内。在案例研究中，T 从 13 年到无穷大不等。具体数值取决于所估参数是否针对特定疗法、相关适应证领域的创新速度，以及仿制药进入后的降价幅度。作者指出，这为应用研究者说明如何选取 T 提供了方法和起点。

abstract.text: This study traces the trajectories of children before and after their first involvement with Child Welfare Services (CWS), comparing outcomes for those placed in foster care with those who received home-based services. Leveraging administrative data covering more than 2 decades, we follow these children from infancy through childhood and into adulthood, tracking outcomes in health, education, crime, welfare dependence, and labor market participation. We follow children around the time of their initial CWS contact. We show that children placed in foster care are substantially more likely to receive mental health treatment in the years following the first intervention, with the increase substantially larger for girls than for boys. In contrast, we observe only modest later differences between the two groups across other outcomes. Using geographical variation in the likelihood of being assigned to foster care, we corroborate the finding that foster care placement increases mental healthcare use. One interpretation of this pattern is that foster care placement compensates for childhood adversity by improving access to mental health care services.

10.1002/hec.70179.abstractZh: 本研究追踪了儿童在首次接触儿童福利服务前后的发展轨迹，比较了被安置在寄养家庭与接受家庭服务的儿童的结果。通过利用涵盖20多年时间的行政数据，我们跟踪了这些儿童从婴儿期到成年期的健康状况、教育水平、犯罪率、对福利的依赖程度以及劳动力市场参与情况。我们发现，被安置在寄养家庭的儿童在首次干预后的几年内接受心理健康治疗的可能性显著更高，且这一增长在女孩中更为明显。相比之下，其他方面的差异则较为温和。通过考察被分配到寄养家庭的可能性在不同地区的差异，我们进一步证实了寄养安置确实会增加心理健康服务的使用。这一模式的一种解释是，寄养安置通过改善儿童获得心理健康服务的机会，从而弥补了儿童时期的逆境经历。

abstract.text: BACKGROUND: The state of São Paulo pioneered the adoption of Social Health Organisations (SHOs) under Complementary Law No. 846/1998 that would allow private non-profit organisations to manage hospitals and health services under government contracts with the aim of gaining efficiency and improving quality of care. Our study evaluates whether the management of hospitals by SHOs is associated with improvements in system performance for patients diagnosed with breast, prostate and colorectal cancer. METHODS: We analysed 652,734 registered breast, prostate, and colorectal cancer cases diagnosed from 2000 to 2023 across an 80-hospital analytic roster. The primary staggered difference-in-differences analysis compared SHO adopters with directly administered public hospitals, used hospital-quarter observations with equal hospital weighting, and applied outcome-specific mortality follow-up restrictions. RESULTS: The restricted primary analyses included 23-24 public hospitals, depending on the outcome. SHO adoption was associated with imprecise changes in diagnosis-to-treatment time (-155.3 days; 95% CI -350.0 to 39.4), consultation-to-diagnosis time (-96.3 days; 95% CI -237.7 to 45.1), 30-day mortality (0.8 percentage points; 95% CI -4.0 to 5.5), 1-year mortality (2.5 percentage points; 95% CI -21.7-26.8), and 5-year mortality (29.6 percentage points; 95% CI -3.6 to 62.8). Estimates changed materially with the control group and weighting approach. CONCLUSION: The study did not provide precise evidence that SHO adoption improved cancer-care processes or mortality. However, the small number of hospitals, incomplete long-term follow-up, sensitivity to weighting and control definitions, and the inability to estimate a joint pre-trends test mean that clinically important effects in either direction cannot be excluded.

10.1002/hpm.70143.abstractZh:
背景：圣保罗州率先根据第846/1998号补充法采纳了社会健康组织，允许私人非营利组织根据政府合同管理医院和医疗服务，以提高效率并改善护理质量。本研究评估了由社会健康组织管理医院是否与乳腺癌、前列腺癌和结直肠癌患者的系统性能改善有关。  
方法：我们分析了2000年至2023年间在80家医院中登记的652,734例乳腺癌、前列腺癌和结直肠癌病例。主要采用分阶段差异分析，比较了采用社会健康组织的医院与直接由公共部门管理的医院，使用医院季度数据，并采用特定结果的死亡率随访限制。  
结果：根据结果的不同，限制性主要分析涉及23-24家公共医院。社会健康组织的采用与诊断到治疗时间的缩短（-155.3天；95%置信区间-350.0至39.4）、从咨询到诊断的时间缩短（-96.3天；95%置信区间-237.7至45.1）、30天死亡率降低（0.8个百分点；95%置信区间-4.0至5.5）、1年死亡率降低（2.5个百分点；95%置信区间-21.7至26.8）以及5年死亡率降低（29.6个百分点；95%置信区间-3.6至62.8）有关。估计值随着对照组和加权方法的变化而显著变化。  
结论：本研究未能提供确切证据来证明社会健康组织的采用改善了癌症护理过程或死亡率。然而，由于医院数量较少、长期随访不完整、对加权和控制定义的敏感性，以及无法估计联合趋势测试，因此无法排除任何方向上的临床重要效应。

abstract.text: Older adult opioid overdose deaths have increased over the past two decades in the United States. Methadone, one of three medications approved for opioid use disorder (OUD) treatment, was not covered by Medicare - the primary insurer of older Americans - for OUD until 2020. We study the response of opioid treatment programs (OTPs), the only healthcare providers that can dispense methadone for the treatment of OUD in the U.S., to this policy change using administrative data and a difference-in-differences framework. We find an increase in Medicare acceptance by OTPs and in the number of methadone treatment episodes post-policy. Further, we document spillovers to other insurance markets and changes in (non-methadone) treatment services offered by OTPs, suggesting that Medicare's entrance into this market has implications for all OUD patients receiving methadone treatment in OTPs.

10.1002/pam.70106.abstractZh: 在过去二十年里，美国老年人群中的阿片类药物过量死亡事件有所增加。美沙酮是三种被批准用于治疗阿片类药物使用障碍的药物之一，但在2020年之前，美沙酮并未被美国老年人的主要保险机构——医疗保险覆盖。我们利用行政数据和差异-差异框架，研究了美国唯一能够提供美沙酮治疗服务的阿片类治疗项目对这一政策变化的反应。研究发现，美沙酮治疗项目的医疗保险接受度有所提高，政策实施后的美沙酮治疗次数也有所增加。此外，我们还观察到这一政策变化对其他保险市场的影响，以及美沙酮治疗项目所提供的其他治疗服务的变化，这表明医疗保险进入这一市场对接受美沙酮治疗的阿片类药物使用障碍患者产生了影响。

abstract.text: This open access book introduces social aspects of explainable AI (XAI), authored by leading researchers from the interdisciplinary research fields.

10.1007/978-981-96-5290-7.abstractZh: 这本开放获取书籍介绍了可解释人工智能（XAI）的社会层面，由来自跨学科研究领域的顶尖研究人员撰写。

abstract.text: This chapter examines multimodality in the context of explaining AI agent behavior and reasoning. Both embodied (like robots) and unembodied (like Alexa, including text-based systems) AI systems require effective explanatory mechanisms to help users understand their functions and decisions. The analysis reveals striking similarities between design elements used for encouraging user collaboration with AI systems and those employed in creating multimodal explanations. Despite the considerable advantages offered by multimodality-based sXAI, these design choices may produce unintended negative effects on users receiving the explanations. To address this challenge, the chapter draws on philosophical research regarding emotion co-construction. By integrating methodological approaches and theoretical insights from the philosophy of science with current sXAI studies, designers can create explanations that emerge collaboratively between the explainer and explainee. Such explanations recognize how emotions influence both how humans think and how they make decisions. The path toward more effective multimodal explanations requires recognizing how users’ emotional responses shape their understanding of AI systems. Through careful design considerations, explanatory systems can acknowledge this emotional dimension while still delivering technically accurate information about AI behavior.

10.1007/978-981-96-5290-7_24.abstractZh: 本章探讨了在解释人工智能代理行为和推理过程中多模态性的应用。无论是具有实体化的智能系统（如机器人）还是非实体化的智能系统（如Alexa以及基于文本的系统），都需要有效的解释机制来帮助用户理解它们的功能和决策过程。分析发现，用于促进用户与智能系统协作的设计元素与创造多模态解释的设计元素之间存在显著的相似性。尽管基于多模态性的智能系统具有诸多优势，但这些设计选择可能会给用户带来意想不到的负面影响。为了应对这一挑战，本章借鉴了关于情感共同构建的哲学研究。通过将科学哲学的方法论方法和理论见解与当前的智能系统研究相结合，设计师可以创造出由解释者与被解释者共同构建的解释。这样的解释能够认识到情感如何影响人类的思维方式和决策过程。要实现更有效的多模态解释，就需要认识到用户的情感反应如何塑造他们对智能系统的理解。通过精心设计的考虑，解释系统可以在提供关于人工智能行为的技术准确信息的同时，也考虑到情感维度。

abstract.text: This paper evaluates the recovery of elective admissions in Italian hospitals following the disruptions caused by the COVID-19 pandemic, with a particular focus on the dynamics between the public and private healthcare sectors. Employing a recovery metric that compares elective admission volumes in 2021 and 2022 to pre-pandemic levels, we observe significant regional variability in recovery rates, as well as disparities between public and private hospitals. Our analysis reveals that public hospitals experienced slower recovery rates, and suggests that the proximity of private healthcare providers further hindered their recovery capacity. Higher staffing intensity is positively associated with recovery, while hospitals serving older populations show weaker recovery performance. By quantifying recovery patterns and examining these influencing factors, this study enhances our understanding of healthcare system resilience. The findings highlight critical disparities in recovery across sectors and provide actionable insights for policymakers to improve coordination between public and private providers, thereby strengthening healthcare system preparedness for future crises.

10.1007/s00181-025-02845-7.abstractZh: 本文评估了意大利医院在COVID-19大流行造成的中断后，择期入院情况的恢复情况，特别关注公共医疗与私人医疗部门之间的动态变化。通过采用一种恢复指标，将2021年和2022年的择期入院数量与疫情前的水平进行比较，我们发现各地区的恢复速度存在显著差异，同时公共医院与私人医院之间也存在差距。分析显示，公共医院的恢复速度较慢，且私人医疗服务提供商的地理位置距离也进一步限制了其恢复能力。较高的人员配置强度与恢复情况呈正相关，而服务老年群体的医院则表现出较弱的恢复表现。通过量化恢复模式并研究这些影响因素，本研究加深了我们对医疗系统韧性的理解。研究结果揭示了各医疗部门在恢复速度上的关键差异，并为政策制定者提供了可操作的建议，以加强公共与私人医疗服务提供者之间的协调，从而提升医疗系统应对未来危机的能力。

abstract.text: Patient selection remains a major challenge in evaluating hospital performance. We exploit the quasi-random assignment of patients to hospitals, based on a rotation schedule between hospitals in the Upper Austrian capital of Linz. In an instrumental variable (IV) framework, we use high-quality administrative data and estimate hospital performance with respect to in-hospital mortality, 30-day mortality, and 30-day readmission. We contrast these results with those of traditional risk adjustment models based on patient observables. We find that the assessment of hospital performance is sensitive to the inclusion of patient observables and that increasing the number of socio-economic covariates to better control for patient risk profiles does not always help bring risk-adjusted estimates closer to IV estimates. The divergence between methods is most pronounced for readmissions, where risk-adjustment models imply large and statistically significant differences between hospitals, whereas IV estimates are substantially smaller and not statistically significant. Our results suggest that common risk adjustment does not adequately control for patient differences between hospitals and that hospital quality indicators based on common administrative data should be interpreted with caution. The trend toward personalized medicine may support the process of collecting more clinical information at the individual level, thus allowing for better quality comparisons between hospitals.

10.1007/s10198-026-01936-1.abstractZh: 在评估医院绩效时，患者选择仍然是一个重大挑战。我们利用了基于上奥地利州首府林茨医院之间轮换安排的患者随机分配机制。在工具变量框架中，我们使用高质量的行政数据，对医院在院内死亡率、30天死亡率和30天再入院率方面的绩效进行了评估。我们将这些结果与基于患者可观测变量的传统风险调整模型的结果进行了对比。我们发现，医院绩效的评估对于是否包含患者可观测变量非常敏感，而增加社会经济协变量以更好地控制患者风险特征，并不总能使风险调整后的估计值更接近工具变量估计值。在再入院率方面，两种方法之间的差异最为明显：风险调整模型显示医院之间的差异较大且统计上显著，而工具变量估计值则小得多且统计上不显著。我们的结果表明，常见的风险调整方法无法充分控制医院间患者的差异，基于常见行政数据构建的医院质量指标应谨慎解读。个性化医疗的趋势可能有助于收集更多个体层面的临床信息，从而允许医院之间进行更有效的质量比较。

abstract.text: Why do public sector reforms often fail or backfire? Using survey data from 127 English hospital trusts, we demonstrate that organizational capabilities function as interdependent systems where partial development harms performance. While organizations combining functional, adaptive, and positional capabilities show significant performance gains, those developing strong internal capabilities without external stakeholder support perform worse than those making no changes. This “premature optimization trap” occurs when internal improvements lack support and legitimacy, wasting resources and generating cynicism. These findings challenge best-practice approaches and contribute to explain reform failures. Effective public sector improvement requires orchestrating complementary capabilities, not implementing isolated interventions.

10.1007/s11115-025-00977-z.abstractZh: 为什么公共部门改革常常失败或产生反效果？通过对127家英国医院信托机构的调查数据进行分析，我们发现组织能力以相互依赖的方式运作，部分发展的改进会损害整体绩效。虽然结合了功能性、适应性和位置性能力的组织能够显著提升绩效，但那些在没有外部利益相关者支持的情况下发展强大内部能力的组织，其表现不如不进行任何改变的团队。这种“过早优化陷阱”发生在内部改进缺乏支持和合法性时，会导致资源浪费并引发怀疑。这些发现挑战了传统的最佳实践方法，并为解释改革失败的原因提供了依据。有效的公共部门改进需要协调互补的能力，而不是实施孤立的干预措施。

abstract.text: We exploit the introduction of the Hospital Consumer Assessment of Healthcare Providers and Systems (HCAHPS) survey to examine whether mandatory patient-experience reporting alters U.S. hospitals’ resource allocation. Using a difference-in-differences design, we find that hospitals subject to the mandate reduce the share of spending devoted to clinical care, implying a 0.6% decline in clinical spending share. This equates to approximately $1 million annually for a mid-sized hospital. Consistent with multitasking theory, greater emphasis on patient experience induces a reallocation of financial resources and managerial attention away from clinical care. Clinical spending per discharge also declines, indicating reduced clinical intensity. Treated hospitals subsequently exhibit worse inpatient mortality outcomes, 0.15–0.25 percentage points relative to a 2.3% baseline rate, representing a 7%–10% deterioration compared to unaffected hospitals. Mediation and cross-sectional analyses link resource reallocation to inpatient mortality. These effects emerge prior to public disclosure, suggesting responses to measurement and anticipated reporting.

10.1007/s11142-026-09973-0.abstractZh: 我们利用医院消费者评估医疗服务提供者与系统调查（HCAHPS）的引入，来研究强制性的患者体验报告是否改变了美国医院的资源分配。通过差异-差异设计，我们发现受该规定约束的医院减少了用于临床护理的支出比例，临床支出比例下降了0.6%。这相当于一家中等规模医院每年损失约100万美元。与多任务理论一致，对患者体验的更多关注导致财务资源和管理资源的重新分配，这些资源从临床护理中转移出去。每次出院的临床支出也有所下降，表明临床强度有所降低。受影响的医院随后出现了更差的住院死亡率，相对于2.3%的基线率，死亡率下降了0.15%至0.25个百分点，与未受影响的医院相比，死亡率下降了7%至10%。中介分析和横断面分析将资源重新分配与住院死亡率联系起来。这些效应在公开披露之前就已经出现，表明医院对测量和预期报告的反应。

abstract.text: We study the interplay of extrinsic and intrinsic motivations regarding the quality of care physicians provide. In particular, we analyze the role of personality traits in explaining the heterogeneity in responses to common physician payment systems. We utilize data from several behavioral experiments (659 subjects) on physician payment systems and from post-experimental surveys on personality traits. The experiments use equivalent health framings and decision situations with either fee-for-service (FFS) or capitation (CAP) as baseline payments. Blended payment systems—performance pay and mixed systems—are introduced at a within-subject level to complement the baseline payments. We find that personality traits contribute to explaining some heterogeneity in behavioral responses to payment incentives. Under baseline systems, more agreeable individuals provide higher quality of care. Blended payment systems enhance the aggregate treatment quality. Nevertheless, we observe a moderation effect in CAP-based blended systems: by Conscientiousness in mixed schemes, and by Conscientiousness and Agreeableness under performance pay. Quality increases are smaller for individuals higher in these traits. The moderation can be mainly explained by a ceiling effect, though we also observe a quality reduction/crowding-out effect. Our findings emphasize the importance of the interplay between financial incentives, physician provision behavior, and personality traits and inform the discussion on the design of tailored physician payment systems.

10.1007/s11238-025-10107-2.abstractZh: 我们研究了外在动机与内在动机在医生提供护理质量方面的相互作用。具体而言，我们分析了人格特质在解释对常见医生支付系统反应差异中的作用。我们利用了多项关于医生支付系统的行为实验数据（659名受试者）以及实验后关于人格特质的调查数据。这些实验采用了等效的健康框架和决策情境，以按服务收费（FFS）或按人头收费（CAP）作为基准支付方式。在受试者层面引入了混合支付系统——包括绩效奖励和混合支付系统——以补充基准支付方式。我们发现，人格特质有助于解释对支付激励行为反应的一些差异。在基准支付系统下，更顺从的个体会提供更高质量的护理。混合支付系统则提升了整体护理质量。然而，我们观察到基于CAP的混合支付系统存在适度效应：在混合方案中，尽责性起到了调节作用；而在绩效奖励下，尽责性和顺从性共同起作用。具有较高这些特质个体的护理质量提升幅度较小。这种适度效应主要可以归因于天花板效应，尽管我们也观察到了质量下降或排斥效应。我们的发现强调了财务激励、医生提供行为以及人格特质之间相互作用的重要性，并为设计个性化的医生支付系统提供了依据。

abstract.text: Hospitals differ along several dimensions, including ownership structure, strategic objectives, and resource capacity, while patients vary in illness severity, comorbidities, and other factors affecting their healthcare needs. Available empirical evidence of patient selection by hospitals, however, is rather limited. In this paper, we develop a theoretical model of quality competition under regulated prices that incorporates provider heterogeneity-such as distinctions between public and private hospitals-and patient heterogeneity in terms of illness severity. In our framework, hospitals are not allowed to track patients at the admission and face capacity constraints which induces congestion costs to patients. We show that, even in the absence of explicit patient screening, differences in hospital case mix can arise endogenously through rational patient choice. Moreover, the extent of this case mix differentiation increases with the degree of heterogeneity among agents in the market. Our findings suggest that observed disparities in patient composition across hospitals do not, in themselves, constitute evidence of opportunistic selection. Rather, they may reflect equilibrium outcomes driven by quality differences, capacity constraints, and heterogeneous patient preferences.

10.1016/j.ehb.2026.101599.abstractZh: 医院在多个维度上存在差异，包括所有权结构、战略目标和资源能力。而患者则因疾病严重程度、合并症以及其他影响其医疗需求的因素而有所不同。然而，关于医院对患者选择的现有实证证据却相当有限。在本文中，我们建立了一个理论模型，用于分析在管制价格下的质量竞争，该模型考虑了医疗服务提供者的异质性（如公立医院与私立医院之间的差异）以及患者在疾病严重程度方面的异质性。在我们的框架中，医院不允许在患者入院时对其进行追踪，并且面临容量限制，这导致患者需承担拥堵成本。我们表明，即使在没有明确的患者筛选机制的情况下，医院病例组合的差异仍可以通过理性的患者选择内生地产生。此外，这种病例组合差异的程度随着市场中各主体异质性的增加而增大。我们的研究发现表明，医院之间患者构成的差异本身并不构成机会选择的证据。相反，这些差异可能反映了由质量差异、容量限制以及异质患者偏好所驱动的均衡结果。

abstract.text: BACKGROUND: Slovakia adopted a comprehensive hospital network reform in 2021 (Act 540/2021 Coll.) under its Recovery and Resilience Plan (RRP), motivated by a fragmented network of small, low-volume hospitals and limited transparency on services, quality and waiting times. REFORM CONTENT: The reform reorganises hospitals into five statutory levels, each defined by a portfolio of medical programmes, maximum waiting times, minimum case volumes and quality indicators. This paper provides a policy and regulatory overview of the reform's design, its content and the trajectory of its implementation. EXPECTED RESULTS: The reform aims to concentrate complex care, improve clinical outcomes, reduce variation, shorten waiting times and improve efficiency. Although the legislative architecture was largely in place by end-2023, core operational pillars are still unfinished: the quality-indicator decree was only adopted in mid-2025, with first availability for categorisation in 2027; staffing-norm legislation has yet to enter the legislative process; minimum-volume thresholds have been repeatedly revised downward; and no provider has so far been excluded from the network on volume grounds. POLICY IMPLICATIONS: The roll-out has been affected by political interference, repeated amendments, delays and politically driven re-categorisations, illustrating the gap between a legalistic design and its political execution. Policy implications stress the importance of aligned payment systems, sustained stakeholder engagement and systematic evaluation against the reform's stated objectives. Outcomes for efficiency, waiting times and treatable mortality will be the subject of future quantitative research as administrative data become available.

10.1016/j.healthpol.2026.105798.abstractZh:
背景：斯洛伐克在2021年根据其复苏与韧性计划，通过了全面的医院网络改革（第540/2021 Coll号法案），该改革是由于小型、低容量医院的分散网络以及服务、质量和等待时间的透明度不足所引发的。  
改革内容：改革将医院重组为五个法定级别，每个级别都有一系列医疗项目、最大等待时间、最低病例数量和质量指标。本文对改革的设计、内容以及实施进程进行了政策与监管方面的概述。  
预期结果：改革旨在集中复杂护理资源、改善临床效果、减少差异、缩短等待时间并提高效率。尽管到2023年底，立法架构基本完成，但核心运营支柱仍待完善：质量指标法令直到2025年中期才通过，分类标准则于2027年首次实施；人员配置标准法规尚未进入立法程序；最低病例数量阈值多次下调；目前尚未有医疗机构因病例数量问题被排除在网络之外。  
政策影响：改革的实施受到了政治干预、多次修改、延迟以及政治驱动的重新分类的影响，这凸显了法律设计与实际执行之间的差距。政策建议强调需要统一的支付系统、持续的利益相关者参与以及针对改革目标进行系统的评估。随着行政数据的获取，关于效率、等待时间和可治疗死亡率的成果将成为未来定量研究的重点。

abstract.text: BACKGROUND: European health systems have expanded patients' right to choose their family doctor to shorten waiting times, but whether the benefits reach all socioeconomic groups is largely untested. Spain's regions replaced default assignment with free choice of general practitioner (GP). OBJECTIVE: To assess whether patients who choose their family doctor wait less for public specialist care, and whether gains are equally distributed across socioeconomic groups. METHODS: Cross-sectional regression analysis of referred patients in the 2010 and 2011 Healthcare Barometer waves, the only waves recording whether respondents chose or were assigned their GP, with region and specialty fixed effects, machine-learning robustness checks, tests of group differences, and mediation analysis. RESULTS: Patients who chose their GP waited 11.3 per cent less for specialist care, roughly 9 days at a mean of 83. Gains rose with income: none for low-income choosers, 13 per cent shorter waits for mid-income choosers, and larger still at the top, the only socioeconomic difference that formal tests support. University-educated choosers waited 24 per cent less, but not significantly less than other choosers. In exploratory analyses, gains concentrated where choice extends region-wide rather than within the local health area. Higher-quality referrals and better coordination between primary and specialist care, not private-care use, mediated about a quarter of the association. CONCLUSIONS: The waiting-time benefits associated with GP choice accrue disproportionately to advantaged patients and risk widening socioeconomic gaps in specialist access; choice reforms should be paired with navigation support and standardised referral protocols.

10.1016/j.healthpol.2026.105812.abstractZh:
背景：欧洲的医疗体系扩大了患者选择家庭医生的权利，以缩短等待时间，但这一措施是否惠及所有社会经济群体尚未得到充分验证。西班牙的部分地区将默认分配改为患者自由选择全科医生。  
目的：评估选择家庭医生的患者在获得公共专科医疗服务方面的等待时间是否缩短，以及这种收益是否在不同社会经济群体间均匀分布。  
方法：对2010年和2011年《医疗状况调查》中的转诊患者进行横断面回归分析，该调查是唯一记录受访者是否选择或被分配全科医生的调查。研究中考虑了地区因素和专科因素，并采用了机器学习方法验证结果的稳健性，同时进行了群体差异检验和中介效应分析。  
结果：选择全科医生的患者在获得专科医疗服务方面的等待时间缩短了11.3%，平均缩短9天，等待时间平均为83天。收益随着收入的增加而上升：低收入群体的选择者没有收益，中等收入群体的等待时间缩短了13%，而最高收入群体的等待时间缩短幅度更大，这是唯一得到正式检验支持的社会经济差异。受过大学教育的患者等待时间缩短了24%，但这一差异并不比其他选择者显著。探索性分析显示，这种收益在地区范围内广泛分布，而非仅限于当地医疗区域。高质量的转诊服务以及全科医生和专科医生之间的更好协调，而非私人医疗服务的使用，解释了约四分之一的关联效应。  
结论：选择全科医生带来的等待时间缩短的益处主要惠及优势群体，可能会加剧社会经济群体在专科医疗服务获取方面的差距；因此，选择改革应与导航支持和标准化转诊流程相结合。

abstract.text: Background: Quality monitoring ensures quality standards and improvement, while public reporting aims to inform patient choice. In Switzerland, quality monitoring and public reporting have fallen short of stakeholder expectations due to a misalignment with needs. Objectives: This study explores stakeholder needs in inpatient and outpatient care for public reporting and quality monitoring in Switzerland. Methods: In 2023, nine focus groups with 50 stakeholders from in- and outpatient somatic care were conducted. The data underwent qualitative content analysis to identify themes related to the purpose, challenges, and drivers of public reporting and quality monitoring, as well as indicator selection criteria. Results: Public participants emphasised accessible quality information to guide decisions, especially in chronic or serious illness. A major gap was a single point of contact for navigating care and shared decision-making. Public and expert views diverged on who should access and interpret quality data. Experts prioritised monitoring for internal improvement. Both groups cited administrative burden and system fragmentation as key barriers. Conclusion: While patients seek more involvement and access to data, expert reluctance to share quality information persists. Advancing public reporting requires recognising the public as a core audience and addressing data challenges through a national strategy.

10.1016/j.hpopen.2026.100191.abstractZh:
背景：质量监控旨在确保质量标准的达成与提升，而公开报告则旨在为患者提供信息以辅助其决策。在瑞士，由于与需求不匹配，质量监控和公开报告未能达到利益相关者的期望。  
目标：本研究探讨了瑞士住院和门诊护理领域利益相关者在公开报告和质量监控方面的需求。  
方法：2023年，对来自住院和门诊躯体护理领域的50名利益相关者进行了九次焦点小组讨论。通过定性内容分析，识别出与公开报告和质量监控的目的、挑战及驱动因素相关的主题，以及指标选择标准。  
结果：公众参与者强调需要易于获取的质量信息来指导决策，尤其是在慢性或严重疾病的情况下。一个主要的问题是缺乏一个统一的联系点来协调护理管理和共同决策。公众与专家在谁应该访问和解读质量数据的问题上存在分歧。专家认为质量监控主要用于内部改进。两组人士均认为行政负担和系统碎片化是主要障碍。  
结论：尽管患者希望获得更多的参与权和数据访问权限，但专家仍不愿分享质量信息。推进公开报告需要认识到公众作为核心受众的重要性，并通过国家战略来解决数据方面的挑战。

abstract.text: This study analyzes hospital competition within narrow network health insurance products. We characterize the implications of provider mergers when narrow networks are present. The existence of narrow network insurance plans can lead merger-induced price effects through competitive restraint, leading to merger effects beyond those due to direct, head-to-head competition. We empirically apply these findings to a proposed acquisition that was investigated by the Federal Trade Commission and find evidence suggesting that accounting for narrow networks generates substantially larger price effects.

10.1016/j.ijindorg.2026.103271.abstractZh: 本研究分析了在狭窄网络健康保险产品中的医院竞争现象。我们探讨了在狭窄网络环境下，医疗服务提供者合并所带来的影响。狭窄网络保险计划的存在可能导致合并引发的定价效应通过竞争约束机制发挥作用，从而产生超出直接正面竞争的合并效应。我们通过实证分析将这一发现应用于一项已被联邦贸易委员会调查的交易案例，发现考虑狭窄网络因素能够显著增强定价效应。

abstract.text: Objectives Medicaid is the largest payer of nursing home (NH) care in the United States, yet Medicaid payments are not required to cover the full cost of care. Little is known about the relationship between Medicaid payment adequacy and Care Compare's star ratings. This study examined the association between Medicaid payment rate and whether Medicaid payment covered the cost of care and NH 5-star ratings. Design Cross-sectional study using facility-level national data. Setting and participants The analytic sample included 9473 freestanding NHs across 44 states in 2019. Methods Facility-level Medicaid payment rates were collected from states and matched with Medicaid-related costs to calculate Medicaid payment-to-cost ratios. These measures were linked to Care Compare 5-star ratings (overall, health inspection, quality measures, total staffing) and facility/resident characteristics. Multivariate regressions with state fixed effects and bivariate analysis assessed the relationship between Medicaid payments and Medicaid payment-to-cost ratios and 5-star ratings. Results Bivariate and regression findings indicate that higher Medicaid payment rates were associated with increased probability of NHs receiving 4- or 5-star ratings for the overall, health inspection, and staffing domains. Bivariate statistics found that higher Medicaid payment-to-cost ratios were associated with lower star ratings, but regression analysis found that Medicaid payment-to-cost ratios close to or exceeding 1.0 had a high probability of receiving 4 or 5 stars on the overall and health inspection star ratings. Neither Medicaid payment measure showed a consistent relationship with the quality measure rating. Conclusions and implications Medicaid payment levels and payment-to-cost ratios were associated with Care Compare's 5-star ratings. Findings suggest that inadequate Medicaid payment rates undermine NH quality and that nursing homes need to subsidize Medicaid losses with profits from other sources. Policymakers should consider the adequacy of Medicaid payment when seeking to improve quality of care for long-stay residents, as payment policy remains a critical lever for strengthening NH performance.

10.1016/j.jamda.2025.106042.abstractZh:
目标：医疗补助是美国护理院护理的最大支付者，但医疗补助的支付并不要求覆盖护理的全部成本。关于医疗补助支付充足性与Care Compare星级评级之间的关系，目前了解甚少。本研究探讨了医疗补助支付率与医疗补助支付是否覆盖护理成本以及护理院获得5星级评级之间的关系。

设计：采用设施层面的全国数据进行的横断面研究。

研究环境及参与者：2019年，分析了44个州中的9473家独立运营的护理院数据。

方法：从各州收集设施层面的医疗补助支付率，并将其与医疗补助相关成本进行匹配，以计算医疗补助支付与成本的比率。将这些指标与Care Compare的5星级评级（包括整体评级、卫生检查、质量指标、总人员配备）以及设施/居民特征进行关联。通过带有州固定效应的多变量回归分析以及双变量分析，评估医疗补助支付与医疗补助支付与成本比率以及5星级评级之间的关系。

结果：双变量分析和回归分析表明，较高的医疗补助支付率与护理院在整体评级、卫生检查及人员配备领域的4星或5星评级概率增加有关。双变量统计数据显示，较高的医疗补助支付与成本比率与较低的星级评级相关，但回归分析发现，医疗补助支付与成本比率接近或超过1.0时，护理院获得4星或5星评级的概率较高。两种医疗补助支付指标与质量指标评级之间均未显示出一致的关系。

结论与意义：医疗补助支付水平与支付与成本比率与Care Compare的5星级评级之间存在关联。研究结果表明，不充分的医疗补助支付率会削弱新罕布什尔州的服务质量，而疗养院需要通过其他来源的收入来弥补医疗补助的亏损。政策制定者在寻求提高长期住院患者护理质量时，应考虑医疗补助支付的充分性，因为支付政策仍然是提升新罕布什尔州服务绩效的关键手段。

abstract.text: Objectives To evaluate how changes in assisted living (AL) capacity influence the prevalence of nursing home (NH) residents with dementia. Design This is a panel study. We used state AL licensing data for 2019, 2021, and 2023, linked with NH data from LTCFocus.org. The outcome was the percentage of residents with a dementia diagnosis in each NH. The main exposure variable was the number of AL beds within a 15-mile radius of a given NH. Setting and participants 11,030 NHs in the contiguous United States operating in 2019, 2021, and 2023 with data on residents' dementia diagnoses. Methods We used linear probability models with year and facility fixed effects to examine the relationship between changes in AL capacity and memory care AL capacity and the percentage of NH residents with dementia, adjusting for market and time-varying NH characteristics. Results On average, dementia prevalence in NHs decreased from 50.8% (SD = 14.6) of residents to 44.6% (SD = 14.6) over the study period. Within markets, total AL beds increased averagely from 2897.8 to 3202.2 between 2019 and 2023; the average number of memory care beds increased from 993.3 to 1222.0. In the adjusted model, a 100-bed increase in AL capacity corresponded with a 0.1 (SE = 0.02)-percentage point reduction in the prevalence of NH residents with dementia (P < .001). A 100-bed increase in memory care AL capacity was associated with a lower, but not statistically significant, share of NH residents with dementia (β = -0.02, SE = 0.02; P = .2). Conclusions and implications Findings suggest that increased AL capacity-but not memory care-may postpone entry or divert NH placement among people living with dementia. Future research should explore how AL expansion affects health outcomes, care quality, and lived experiences for individuals with dementia.

10.1016/j.jamda.2025.106068.abstractZh:
研究目的：评估辅助生活设施容量变化对养老院居民痴呆症患病率的影响。  
研究设计：本研究为面板研究。我们使用了2019年、2021年和2023年的辅助生活设施许可数据，并结合了LTCFocus.org提供的养老院数据。研究结果显示了每个养老院中患有痴呆症居民的比例。主要变量是特定养老院15英里半径范围内的辅助生活设施床位数量。  
研究环境与参与者：研究涵盖了2019年、2021年和2023年在美国运营的11,030家养老院，这些养老院拥有居民痴呆症诊断数据。  
研究方法：我们使用线性概率模型，结合年份和设施固定效应，来探讨辅助生活设施容量变化与记忆护理设施容量变化之间的关系，同时调整了市场和随时间变化的养老院特征。  
研究结果：在研究期间，养老院中痴呆症患病率从50.8%（标准差=14.6%）下降到44.6%（标准差=14.6%）。在不同市场中，辅助生活设施床位总数从2019年的2897.8张增加到2023年的3202.2张；记忆护理设施的平均数量从993.3张增加到1222.0张。在调整后的模型中，辅助生活设施床位增加100张，痴呆症患病率下降0.1个百分点（标准误=0.02；P<0.001）。记忆护理设施床位增加100张，痴呆症患者的比例有所下降，但差异不显著（β=-0.02，标准误=0.02；P=0.2）。  
结论与意义：研究结果表明，增加辅助生活设施容量可能有助于推迟痴呆症患者的入住或转移，但记忆护理设施容量的增加并未产生类似效果。未来的研究应探讨辅助生活设施扩展对痴呆症患者健康结果、护理质量和生活体验的影响。

abstract.text: This paper examines the effect of nurse shortages on healthcare production. Employing novel high-frequency data, we examine what effect the absence of nursing staff has on inpatient mortality and other outcomes associated with nursing care. We find significant adverse mortality impacts of shortages of nurses with degree-level qualifications: for the average ward, the absence of a nurse with university degree-equivalent level training increases the odds of a patient death by approximately 10%, while there is no effect of shortages of less qualified nursing assistants. For qualified nurses, there are returns to firm (hospital) specific human capital: increasing the average firm-specific experience among degree qualified nurses by one year is associated with an 8% reduction in the odds of a patient death, the equivalent to adding three-quarters of an extra qualified nurse to the ward. Adverse mortality impacts of shortages are particularly concentrated among patients of relatively low, rather than high, clinical severity. The largest impacts are for those diagnosed with sepsis, a condition where early detection is important for survival and where nurses have a central role in detection and subsequent control.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2025.103082.abstractZh: 本文探讨了护士短缺对医疗生产的影响。通过采用新颖的高频数据，我们研究了护士缺失对住院死亡率及其他与护理相关的结果的影响。我们发现，具有学位资格的护士短缺对死亡率有显著的负面影响：对于平均病房而言，缺少具有大学学位水平培训的护士会使患者死亡的概率增加约10%，而较低资格级的护理助理短缺则没有这种影响。对于具备资格的护士来说，医院特定的人力资本具有回报效应：将具有学位资格的护士的平均医院特定经验增加一年，可使患者死亡的概率降低8%，这相当于为病房增加三名具备资格的护士。护士短缺对死亡率的负面影响尤其集中在临床严重程度较低的患者身上，而非较高的患者。影响最为显著的是那些被诊断为败血症的患者，早期发现对于败血症患者的生存至关重要，而护士在疾病的检测及后续控制中起着核心作用。

abstract.text: The financing of long-term care services and supports (LTSS) relies heavily on self-insurance in the form of housing or financial wealth. Exploiting both local market variation in housing prices and individual-level variation in stock market wealth from 1996 to 2016, we show that exogenous wealth shocks significantly reduce the probability of LTCI coverage, without altering Medicaid eligibility among people with housing and financial assets. The effect of shocks to liquid wealth strongly dominates the effect of housing wealth changes. A $100 K increase in housing (financial) wealth reduces the likelihood of LTCI coverage by 1.24 (3.22) percentage points.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2025.103086.abstractZh: 长期护理服务和支持的融资在很大程度上依赖于以住房或金融财富形式的自我保险。通过研究1996年至2016年间当地市场房价的变化以及个人在股市中的财富变化，我们发现外部财富冲击显著降低了获得长期护理保险的可能性，但并未改变拥有住房和金融资产的人的医疗补助资格。流动性财富冲击的影响远远大于住房财富变化的影响。住房（金融）财富增加10万美元，会使获得长期护理保险的可能性降低1.24至3.22个百分点。

abstract.text: We study the impact of telemedicine technology on antibiotic prescription rates using linked administrative data from Australia on physicians and their patients. We classify physicians by their relative use of virtual consultations after the introduction of government-subsidised telemedicine services and compare their antibiotic prescribing rates before and after telemedicine services became available. We find that more intense telemedicine adopters prescribe less antibiotics while keeping prescribing quality unchanged. Our results are not explained by patient sorting, doctor shopping, or changes in the intensity of consultations.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2025.103096.abstractZh: 我们研究了远程医疗技术对抗生素处方率的影响，使用了来自澳大利亚的关联行政数据，这些数据涉及医生及其患者。我们根据医生在政府补贴的远程医疗服务引入后相对使用虚拟咨询的情况对医生进行分类，并比较了在远程医疗服务可用前后医生的抗生素处方率。我们发现，更积极采用远程医疗服务的医生处方抗生素的数量减少，但处方质量保持不变。我们的结果无法用患者筛选、医生转诊或咨询强度的变化来解释。

abstract.text: Global concerns over rising drug prices have led to regulatory efforts in the pharmaceutical industry targeting price transparency and distribution efficiency. This study examines the impact of China's Two-Invoice System (TIS), a 2016 reform aimed at reducing drug costs by streamlining the pharmaceutical distribution chain and enhancing price transparency. With a theoretical model, we examine the decision-making for pharmaceutical manufacturers and distributors on pricing and promotion activities. We predict competing effects on drug prices: while intermediary markups inflated by double marginalization are reduced, the removal of efficient distributors may elevate supply chain expenses. Using a staggered difference-in-differences approach with procurement data from 2015 to 2019, we find that the implementation of TIS led to a 1.9% increase in average drug prices, contrary to policy expectations. Price increases were more pronounced for lower-priced drugs and in wealthier regions, for which the supply chain markups are limited and the effect of efficiency disruption might dominate. We also document a significant increase in sales and marketing expenses of the manufacturers, who are supposed to have absorbed a considerable amount of promotional costs previously borne by distributors.
