These findings underscore the unintended inefficiencies of regulatory reforms, highlighting the need for a balanced policy design that considers both cost control and market dynamics in healthcare.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2025.103097.abstractZh: 全球对药品价格上涨的担忧促使制药行业采取监管措施，旨在提高价格透明度和分销效率。本研究探讨了中国的“双发票制度”的影响，该制度是一项2016年的改革措施，旨在通过简化药品分销链和提高价格透明度来降低药品成本。通过理论模型，我们分析了制药制造商和分销商在定价和促销活动方面的决策。我们预测了药品价格的不同影响：虽然因双重边缘化导致的中间商加价有所降低，但去除效率较高的分销商可能会导致供应链费用上升。利用2015年至2019年的采购数据，我们发现“双发票制度”的实施导致平均药品价格上升了1.9%，这与政策预期相反。价格上涨在价格较低的药品和富裕地区更为明显，因为这些地区的供应链加价有限，效率中断的影响可能更为显著。我们还发现，制造商的营销费用显著增加，而此前这些费用主要由分销商承担。这些发现凸显了监管改革带来的非预期效率低下问题，强调了需要制定平衡的政策，同时考虑成本控制和医疗市场的动态变化。

abstract.text: There has been a sustained rise in cash transfer programs to the poor, and burgeoning interest in interventions promoting early childhood development. We draw together these trends to study whether open enrolment interventions targeting cash transfers to pregnant mothers unintentionally induce those not pregnant to accelerate birth timing in order to start receiving the cash. Our study context is rural Northern Nigeria, where households have high demand for liquidity because they are reliant on volatile earnings from agriculture, are subject to frequent natural and man-made aggregate shocks, and reside in communities with imperfect credit markets. Our evidence comes from an evaluation of an intervention providing high-valued unconditional cash transfers to pregnant mothers, with four years of open enrolment. We examine how this impacts pregnancy timing among 1700 women not pregnant at baseline. We document relatively weak distortionary impacts on pregnancy timing over the four year period of open enrolment. The reasons are women retain full control over the use of cash transfers, they have productive investment opportunities in their own businesses, and they choose to invest in those rather than transfer cash to husbands. This constellation of factors allows women to internalize the marginal benefits and costs of accelerating birth timing, and place a brake on the incentives households otherwise have to accelerate birth timing. On external validity, we draw together 45 DHS surveys to classify countries into those more or less likely to see distortionary effects on birth timing from open enrolment interventions targeting cash transfers to pregnant mothers.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2025.103098.abstractZh: 针对贫困人口的现金转移项目持续增加，同时人们对促进儿童早期发展的干预措施也表现出越来越浓厚的兴趣。我们结合这两种趋势，研究以现金转移为目标的开放入学干预措施是否无意中促使未怀孕的女性提前生育，以便开始接受现金援助。我们的研究背景位于尼日利亚北部的农村地区，这些地区的家庭对流动资金的需求很高，因为他们的收入依赖于不稳定的农业活动，且经常受到自然和人为的综合性冲击，同时这些社区的信贷市场并不完善。我们的研究数据来自一项对向孕妇提供高价值无条件现金转移的干预措施的评估，该干预措施持续了四年，期间实施了开放入学政策。我们研究了这一政策对1700名未怀孕女性在生育时间上的影响，发现在这四年期间，该政策对生育时间的扭曲影响相对较弱。原因在于，女性完全能够自主决定如何使用现金转移资金，她们在自己的企业中拥有生产性的投资机会，因此她们选择投资这些机会，而不是将现金转移给丈夫。这一系列因素使得女性能够理解提前生育的边际收益和成本，从而抑制了家庭加速生育的动机。在外部有效性方面，我们整合了45项人口与健康调查的数据，将各国划分为那些更有可能受到针对孕妇现金转移开放入学干预措施对生育时间产生扭曲影响的国家。

abstract.text: This paper studies the effects of a large-scale exit of doctors on population health outcomes, health production inputs, outputs, and health system adaptation in Brazil. Identification exploits the exogenous timing of the Cuban exit from municipalities that relied more versus less on Cuban doctors within the More Doctors Program. We find persistent reductions in the care of chronic diseases, while service utilization for conditions requiring immediate care, such as maternal-related services and infections, quickly recovered. Reductions in utilization did not translate into changes in health outcomes. Supply-side response and demand diversion helped mitigate major adverse repercussions for population health at the market level.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2025.103099.abstractZh: 本文研究了医生大规模离职对巴西人口健康结果、健康生产投入、产出以及卫生系统适应性的影响。研究通过对比在“更多医生计划”中依赖古巴医生较多的市镇与较少依赖这些市镇的市镇，来识别离职的影响。研究发现，慢性病的护理服务持续减少，而需要紧急护理的病症服务，如孕产妇相关服务和感染疾病的治疗，则迅速恢复。服务利用率的下降并未导致健康结果的变化。供应端的应对措施和需求的转移有助于缓解市场层面对人口健康的重大负面影响。

abstract.text: This paper examines the impact of individualized funding for disability supports on autism diagnoses. We identify these effects using the staggered roll out of the National Disability Insurance Scheme (NDIS), which provides individualized funding for non-medical disability interventions. We find compelling evidence that the introduction of the NDIS has led to a 32 % increase in reported autism prevalence and accounts for 47 % of new diagnoses since the introduction of the scheme. We find a significant reduction in diagnoses from government subsided healthcare professionals, accompanied by an increase in diagnoses from disability service providers. A lower threshold for autism recognition appears more consistent with our results than catch-up in historically underdiagnosed groups.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2025.103100.abstractZh: 本文探讨了个性化残疾支持资金对自闭症诊断的影响。我们通过分阶段实施国家残疾保险计划（NDIS）来识别这些影响，该计划为非医疗性残疾干预提供个性化资金。我们发现，NDIS的引入导致报告的自闭症患病率增加了32%，并且自该计划实施以来，自闭症新诊断病例中47%与NDIS有关。我们发现，政府资助的医疗保健专业人员的诊断数量显著减少，而残疾服务提供者的诊断数量则有所增加。与历史上被漏诊的群体相比，较低的自闭症识别门槛似乎更符合我们的研究结果。

abstract.text: Over a third of women in the United States experience intimate partner violence (IPV); existing research demonstrates that household finances are one important driver of such violence. We study the effects of rent control on IPV to develop understanding of the financial causes of IPV. Rent control may lessen financial stressors within a relationship and decrease strain that leads to violence. Conversely, it may make leaving the relationship more costly, shifting the bargaining power in the relationship and leading to more violence. We leverage the 1994 expansion of rent control in San Francisco as a natural experiment to study this question. This expansion created variation across ZIP codes in the number of rental units that were newly rent controlled. We exploit this variation in a continuous difference-in-difference design. We estimate an elasticity of -0.08 between the number of newly rent controlled units and assaults on women resulting in hospitalization. This effect translates to a nearly 10% decrease in assaults on women for the average ZIP code. This relationship is not explained by changes in neighborhood composition or overall crime, consistent with the effects being driven by individual level changes in IPV.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2025.103101.abstractZh: 在美国，超过三分之一的女性遭受过亲密伴侣暴力侵害；现有研究表明，家庭财务状况是这种暴力行为的一个重要诱因。我们研究了租金管制对亲密伴侣暴力的影响，以了解其财务方面的成因。租金管制可能会减轻关系中的财务压力，减少导致暴力的紧张局势。相反，它可能会使离开关系变得更加昂贵，改变双方之间的谈判力量，从而导致更多的暴力行为。我们利用1994年旧金山实施租金管制改革作为一个自然实验来研究这个问题。这一改革导致不同邮政编码区的被新纳入租金管制的租赁单位数量存在差异。我们利用这种差异，采用连续差异设计进行研究。我们估计，新纳入租金管制的租赁单位数量与导致女性住院的袭击事件数量之间的弹性为-0.08。这意味着平均每个邮政编码区的女性袭击事件数量减少了近10%。这种关系无法用社区构成的变化或整体犯罪率的变化来解释，这与这种影响是由个体层面的亲密伴侣暴力行为变化所驱动的观点一致。

abstract.text: To improve access to affordable mental healthcare, Australia introduced a national, publicly-funded program in 2006 to subsidise psychological services, which were previously privately funded. Theory suggests that by increasing demand, subsidies should incentivise providers to expand supply, either by entering the workforce or by increasing hours. However, expansion depends on supply constraints, particularly in non-metropolitan areas with pronounced workforce shortages. This study examines the program's effects on the size, work hours, demographic composition, location, and earnings of psychologists. Using an event-study design with administrative tax records and census data, we find that the program: (1) increased the supply of psychologists, with minimal effect on average hours worked per psychologist; (2) increased the likelihood of psychologists working in non-metropolitan areas, supporting broader access to mental healthcare; and (3) raised psychologists' annual personal incomes.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2025.103102.abstractZh: 为了改善人们获得负担得起的心理医疗服务的机会，澳大利亚在2006年推出了一个由国家资助的全国性计划，以补贴此前由私人机构提供的心理服务。理论表明，通过增加需求，补贴可以激励服务提供者扩大服务范围，包括进入劳动力市场或增加工作小时数。然而，这种扩展取决于供应限制，尤其是在劳动力短缺的非都市地区。本研究考察了该计划对心理学家数量、工作小时数、人口构成、工作地点以及收入的影响。通过利用行政税务记录和人口普查数据，我们发现该计划：（1）增加了心理学家的数量，但对每位心理学家平均工作小时数的影响较小；（2）增加了心理学家在非都市地区工作的可能性，从而促进了心理医疗服务的更广泛覆盖；（3）提高了心理学家的年度个人收入。

abstract.text: The overutilization of costly hospital and emergency care and the underutilization of primary care is considered a key driver of wasteful health spending. We study how a shift toward community-based primary care reshapes care patterns across levels of the health system in El Salvador. Using data on outpatient consultations and hospitalizations across 254 municipalities, we exploit the staggered introduction of community health teams (CHTs) between 2010 and 2013 using an event-study design. We find that CHTs increased preventive care, reduced curative consultations for conditions amenable to effective primary care, and lowered preventable hospitalizations. We also document improved primary-care coverage for previously unattended chronic conditions. Together, these results suggest that strengthening primary care through CHTs can meaningfully improve the organization of care and bolster health system performance.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103110.abstractZh: 过度使用昂贵的医院和急诊服务，而初级保健的利用率不足，被认为是浪费性医疗支出的主要因素。我们研究了向社区为基础的初级保健转变如何改变萨尔瓦多整个医疗系统的护理模式。通过利用2010年至2013年间254个市镇的门诊咨询和住院数据，并采用事件研究设计，我们发现社区健康团队的增加提高了预防性护理，减少了适合有效初级保健处理的医疗咨询，并降低了可预防的住院率。我们还发现，对于之前未得到处理的慢性疾病，初级保健的覆盖范围也有所改善。综上所述，这些结果表明，通过社区健康团队加强初级保健，可以显著改善护理组织效率并提升医疗系统的整体表现。

abstract.text: This paper explores the effect of increased competition on pharmacies induced by a regime change in two Swiss cities allowing physicians to self-dispense drugs. By merging detailed sales and survey data at the pharmacy level, a difference-in-differences estimation shows a significant and permanent loss of market share in prescribed drug revenue and profits. The decline is driven by drugs used for acute illnesses and is less pronounced for larger pharmacies. While generic drug sales decrease significantly, the more expensive brand-name drugs remain largely unaffected. I find evidence that pharmacies respond to increased competition by diversifying toward health services. Adding administrative physician data shows that the reform caused approximately CHF 19.5M in additional drug costs per year. My results demonstrate that more competition can result in higher drug costs for society.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103111.abstractZh: 本文探讨了瑞士两个城市政权更迭后，竞争加剧对药店的影响。这两个城市允许医生自行配药。通过合并药店层面的详细销售数据和调查数据，差异-差异估计显示，处方药收入和利润的市场份额出现了显著且持久的下降。这种下降主要源于用于急性疾病的药物，而大型药店的下降幅度较小。虽然仿制药销量显著下降，但价格较高的品牌药则基本未受影响。我发现，药店为了应对竞争加剧，开始向健康服务领域拓展。补充行政医生数据后，发现该改革每年导致药物成本增加约1950万瑞士法郎。我的研究结果表明，更多的竞争可能会导致社会药物成本上升。

abstract.text: Expanding health insurance can either increase or decrease pregnancies and births, depending on how it affects access to contraception and the financial costs of childbearing. I study the Affordable Care Act's Medicaid expansion using difference-in-differences models and state-level data on contraceptive provision, births, and abortions, synthesizing analysis of these outcomes to distinguish the role of subsidized contraception. The expansion led to a substantial increase in contraceptive provision, particularly for short-acting hormonal methods. Teen birth rates fell significantly by 5%, a reduction that owes to increased parental eligibility, while effects on overall birth rates are not distinguishable from zero. Estimated effects on abortion are imprecise but suggestive of reductions for teens. Simulations based on contraceptive provision imply that subsidized contraception led to reductions in the pregnancy and birth rate of approximately 1% to 2%. These findings indicate that Medicaid's contraceptive subsidies modestly reduced pregnancies, abortions, and births, but also suggest that financial barriers to reproductive health care are not a primary driver of fertility behavior overall.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103112.abstractZh: 扩大医疗保险的覆盖范围可能会增加或减少怀孕和出生数量，这取决于其对避孕手段获取的影响以及生育的财务成本。我使用差异-差异模型以及各州关于避孕措施、出生和堕胎的数据，对《平价医疗法案》中的医疗补助扩展政策进行了研究，综合分析这些结果以区分补贴避孕措施的作用。该政策导致避孕措施的提供量大幅增加，尤其是短效激素避孕方法。青少年出生率显著下降了5%，这一下降主要得益于父母获得避孕措施的资格增加，而对整体出生率的影响则难以区分。对堕胎影响的估计并不精确，但似乎青少年堕胎数量有所减少。基于避孕措施提供的模拟结果显示，补贴避孕措施使怀孕和出生率降低了约1%到2%。这些发现表明，医疗补助的避孕补贴在一定程度上减少了怀孕、堕胎和出生数量，但也表明，生殖健康护理的财务障碍并非生育行为的主要驱动因素。

abstract.text: Minimum supervised driving hours (MSDH) are a key component of Graduated Driver Licensing (GDL) policy. GDL has been shown to reduce motor vehicle accidents, but its optimal design is far from clear. Exploiting two discrete MSDH changes in New South Wales (the largest state in Australia), we estimate causal effects of various MSDH options, providing evidence on driver safety under different regimes. Increasing MSDH from zero to 50 h lowered the risk of a motor vehicle accident in the first year of unsupervised driving by around 23%. Further increasing the mandate to 120 h had no additional benefit.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103113.abstractZh: 最低监督驾驶时长（MSDH）是渐进式驾照颁发政策的关键组成部分。渐进式驾照颁发政策已被证明可以减少机动车事故，但其最佳设计尚不清楚。通过对澳大利亚最大的州——新南威尔士州的两种不同MSDH政策进行分析，我们估算了各种MSDH政策下的因果效应，为不同政策下的驾驶安全提供了证据。将MSDH从零增加到50小时，可显著降低第一年无监督驾驶时的机动车事故风险，约23%。而将要求增加到120小时则没有额外的好处。

abstract.text: We propose a theoretical model to study individual lifestyle choices related to calorie intake and physical activity, depending on personal fitness and body weight. The model builds on the rational eating literature and can generate a variety of behaviors that are consistent with the empirical evidence. In particular, we show that engaging in periods of a sedentary lifestyle can be a rational, utility-maximizing decision-a finding that is not present in the existing literature but is empirically widespread. Additionally, we show the possible existence of multiple equilibria and multiple indifferent lifestyles. The former justifies policy interventions to help individuals exit a self-reinforcing, but unhealthy equilibrium; the latter provides a theoretical basis for remediation plans that compensate for earlier unhealthy behaviors.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103114.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个理论模型，用于研究与个人健康状况和体重相关的卡路里摄入及体力活动有关的个人生活方式选择。该模型基于理性饮食理论，能够生成与实证证据一致的各种行为模式。具体而言，我们发现，采取久坐的生活方式可能是一种理性的、能最大化效用的决策——这一发现并未在现有文献中提及，但在实际中却普遍存在。此外，我们还揭示了可能存在多种均衡状态和多种不同的生活方式。前者为政策干预提供了依据，以帮助个体摆脱这种自我强化但不健康的行为模式；后者则为针对早期不健康行为的矫正计划提供了理论支持。

abstract.text: Immunotherapy is a breakthrough innovation in cancer care, but it is also among the most expensive treatments, with costs exceeding $150,000 per patient. We study the introduction of immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs), the most widely used class of immunotherapy drugs. In 2022, ICIs accounted for 44% of the $17.5 billion Medicare Part B cancer drug spending. We focus on metastatic melanoma, the first approved indication for ICIs. While overall cancer mortality rates declined since the 1990s, melanoma mortality rates increased through the early 2010s. Following the first ICI approvals in 2011 and 2014, melanoma mortality declined sharply. Using traditional Medicare claims, we estimate the impact of the introduction of ICIs on healthcare utilization, costs, and 1-year survival for patients with metastatic melanoma, relative to metastatic colorectal cancer (CRC), where ICIs were not approved until 2017. Variation in approval timing allows us to isolate the effect of ICIs from broader cancer care trends. We find that ICIs reduced 1-year mortality by 6.2%. Since about 1 in 5 metastatic melanoma patients received ICIs, this implies a 28.0% reduction among treated patients. The introduction of ICIs also reduced chemotherapy and radiation use, but increased Medicare spending by 59.3% or about 260% among ICI-treated patients. Accounting for life expectancy gains beyond one year, the benefits of ICIs for melanoma patients appear comparable, or potentially even greater, than the substantial added Medicare costs. Nonetheless, ICI use remains relatively low given large survival benefits and few alternative treatments, suggesting that costs and other barriers limit patient access.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103115.abstractZh: 免疫疗法是癌症治疗领域的一项突破性创新，但也是成本最高的治疗方法之一，每位患者的治疗费用超过15万美元。我们研究了免疫检查点抑制剂的引入情况，这类药物是最常用的免疫疗法药物。在2022年，免疫检查点抑制剂占Medicare Part B癌症药物支出的44%，总额达175亿美元。我们重点关注转移性黑色素瘤，这是免疫检查点抑制剂首次被批准用于的适应症。虽然自1990年代以来，整体癌症死亡率有所下降，但转移性黑色素瘤的死亡率在2010年代初有所上升。在2011年和2014年首次批准免疫检查点抑制剂后，转移性黑色素瘤的死亡率显著下降。通过传统的Medicare报销数据，我们估算了免疫检查点抑制剂的引入对转移性黑色素瘤患者医疗利用、成本以及1年生存率的影响，与未获批准免疫检查点抑制剂的转移性结直肠癌相比，免疫检查点抑制剂的引入带来了显著的效果。免疫检查点抑制剂的引入时间差异使我们能够将其效果与更广泛的癌症治疗趋势区分开来。我们发现，免疫检查点抑制剂使1年死亡率降低了6.2%。由于大约五分之一的转移性黑色素瘤患者接受了免疫检查点抑制剂治疗，这意味着接受治疗的患者1年死亡率降低了28.0%。免疫检查点抑制剂的引入还减少了化疗和放疗的使用，但在接受免疫检查点抑制剂治疗的患者中，Medicare支出增加了59.3%，即约260%。考虑到一年后的预期寿命有所提高，免疫检查点抑制剂对黑色素瘤患者的益处似乎与巨大的Medicare支出相当，甚至可能更大。尽管如此，鉴于巨大的生存益处和较少的替代治疗方法，免疫检查点抑制剂的使用仍然相对较低，这表明成本和其他障碍限制了患者的使用。

abstract.text: Electronic nicotine delivery systems (ENDS) use among lesbian, gay, bisexual, and questioning (LGBQ) teenagers is nearly 50 percent higher than among their heterosexual counterparts. Yet little is known about how recent efforts to curb nicotine vaping through tobacco control policies impact sexual minorities. The minority stress hypothesis (MSH) suggests that LGBQ teens may use nicotine to mediate unique stressors, which could lead LGBQ teens to be less responsive to state policies designed to curtail use of nicotine products. This study explores this question using data from the 2015-2023 State Youth Behavior Surveys and a generalized difference-in-differences identification strategy. We consider the importance of four common policies in the U.S.: ENDS taxes, cigarette taxes, ENDS minimum legal sales ages, and ENDS flavor bans. We document heterogeneous responses to ENDS taxes and MLSA laws that are consistent with the MSH: ENDS taxes and MLSA laws reduce vaping among heterosexual youth but not among LGBQ youth, despite substantially higher baseline ENDS use in the latter group. We also find that LGBQ teens without mental health stressors respond strongly to ENDS taxes and flavor bans, whereas those with such stressors do not, also consistent with the MSH. Cigarette taxes are largely unrelated to ENDS use among teens.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103116.abstractZh: 电子尼古丁输送系统（ENDS）在女同性恋、男同性恋、双性恋和跨性别青少年中的使用率比异性恋青少年高出近50%。然而，关于最近通过烟草控制政策来限制尼古丁电子烟使用的努力对性少数群体的影响，我们知之甚少。少数群体压力假说（MSH）指出，LGBQ青少年可能利用尼古丁来缓解独特的压力源，这可能导致LGBQ青少年对旨在限制尼古丁产品使用的州政策反应较弱。本研究利用2015-2023年州青少年行为调查的数据，采用广义差异识别策略来探讨这一问题。我们考虑了美国四项常见政策的重要性：ENDS税收、香烟税收、ENDS最低合法销售年龄以及ENDS口味禁令。我们发现，与MSH一致，ENDS税收和最低合法销售年龄法律减少了异性恋青少年的电子烟使用，但并未减少LGBQ青少年的使用，尽管后一组青少年的基线ENDS使用率明显更高。我们还发现，没有心理健康压力源的LGBQ青少年对ENDS税收和口味禁令反应强烈，而有此类压力源的青少年则没有，这也符合MSH的假设。香烟税收与青少年使用ENDS之间几乎没有关联。

abstract.text: A large body of literature demonstrates that exposure to major adverse events such as natural disasters affects physical and mental health. Less is known about health consequences of long-term exposure to smaller, recurring shocks such as mining-induced earthquakes. Leveraging data from the Dutch Lifelines Cohort Study and Biobank and the Royal Netherlands Meteorological Institute, we examine mental health effects of frequent earthquakes generated by the extraction of natural gas, which was a major source of economic revenue for the Netherlands. Long-term exposure is captured by the accumulated peak ground acceleration. We employ individual-level fixed effects models to deal with selective exposure. We find that exposure increases depression and anxiety symptoms. Our results are robust to selective migration and to varying the exposure indicator. The results support a reassessment of the societal costs of the mining of natural gas.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103118.abstractZh: 大量文献表明，遭遇重大突发事件，如自然灾害，会对身心健康产生负面影响。而对于长期暴露于较小且频繁发生的冲击事件，例如采矿引发的地震，其健康影响则知之甚少。本研究利用荷兰Lifelines队列研究和生物库的数据，以及荷兰皇家气象研究所的数据，探讨了频繁发生的地震对心理健康的影响。这些地震是荷兰经济收入的重要来源。长期暴露的影响可以通过累积的地面加速度来体现。我们采用个体层面的固定效应模型来处理选择性暴露的问题。研究发现，暴露会增加抑郁和焦虑症状。我们的研究结果在考虑选择性迁移和改变暴露指标的情况下仍然保持稳定。这些结果支持重新评估天然气开采带来的社会成本。

abstract.text: We examine the labour supply response of doctors in England to a reform to public sector pensions that increased the link between current labour supply and pension value. Exploiting the staggered rollout of the reform across narrowly defined birth cohorts, we find that mid-career doctors increased their labour supply to the public healthcare system by just under 4% four years after exposure. This was driven by increases on the extensive margin of working in the public healthcare system. Our results imply an extensive margin labour supply elasticity with respect to the link between current labour supply and pension value of 0.04. Taking into account current pay we estimate an extensive margin labour supply elasticity with respect to total remuneration of 0.29. This is similar to estimates of doctor labour elasticities with respect to pay in other contexts, and suggests that delayed remuneration can be an effective tool for hospital systems to affect mid-career doctor labour supply.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103119.abstractZh: 我们研究了英格兰医生对公共部门养老金改革的反应，该改革增强了当前劳动力供应与养老金价值之间的联系。通过分析改革在不同出生队列中的逐步实施情况，我们发现，在接触该改革四年后，职业生涯中的医生将他们为公共医疗系统提供的劳动力供应增加了近4%。这一变化主要源于在公共医疗系统工作的广泛边际的增加。我们的研究结果表明，当前劳动力供应与养老金价值之间的联系对广泛边际劳动力供应弹性的影响为0.04。考虑到当前的薪酬水平，我们估计了与总薪酬相关的广泛边际劳动力供应弹性为0.29。这一结果与在其他情况下对薪酬变化的医生劳动力弹性的估计相似，表明延迟薪酬发放可以成为医院系统影响职业生涯中医生劳动力供应的有效手段。

abstract.text: This study examines the long-term effects of the Rockefeller Sanitary Commission's (RSC) hookworm eradication campaign, initiated in the American South in the 1910s, on old-age longevity. Utilizing Social Security Administration death records linked to the 1940 full-count census, we employ a two-way fixed effect approach to examine the effects of early-life exposure to the eradication campaign on later-life outcomes. We find that individuals exposed to the RSC campaign during in-utero and early life experience an increase of approximately 1.3 months in longevity for a one-standard-deviation increase in county-level treatment intensity. The effects are substantially larger among nonwhites, children of illiterate mothers, and those born in urban areas. Moreover, we provide evidence of dynamic complementarity in the effects of hookworm eradication on longevity, with larger effects observed in counties exposed to the Rosenwald school construction movement and in states with more stringent child labor laws. Using the 1940 census and World War II enlistment data, we provide suggestive evidence of improvements in educational attainment, income, and cognitive ability as possible pathways. Our findings contribute to the literature on the lasting effects of early-life public health interventions and underscore the importance of such programs in addressing present-day global health challenges.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103120.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了洛克菲勒卫生委员会（RSC）在1910年代于美国南部发起的钩虫根除运动对老年人寿命的长期影响。我们利用与1940年人口普查相关的社会保障管理局死亡记录，采用双向固定效应模型来分析早年接触该根除运动对后期生活结果的影响。研究发现，在子宫内和早年接触RSC运动的个体，其寿命平均延长约1.3个月，且这一效应随着县级治疗强度的增加而增强。在非白人群、文盲母亲所生的儿童以及城市地区出生的个体中，这种效应更为显著。此外，我们还发现了钩虫根除运动对寿命的影响存在动态互补性，即在受到罗森沃尔德学校建设运动影响的县以及实施更严格的童工法律的州，这种效应更为明显。通过1940年人口普查和第二次世界大战征兵数据，我们进一步提出了教育水平、收入和认知能力提升可能是影响寿命的因素。我们的研究结果为关于早年公共卫生干预措施长期影响的文献提供了支持，并强调了此类项目在应对当今全球健康挑战中的重要性。

abstract.text: The Nurse Practitioner (NP) workforce expanded rapidly from 2010-2023, especially in rural counties, where patients today are nearly as likely to receive care from an NP as from a physician. At the same time, rural health outcomes and access to health care continue to worsen relative to urban areas. Empirical research on how NPs interact with or substitute for physicians remains limited. This paper exploits county-level openings of graduate nursing programs to test how they impact the local supply of NPs and primary care physicians. Using data from the Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System and Area Health Resource Files, we estimate staggered difference-in-differences frameworks. We show that new graduate programs lead to large increases in the local NP supply and find positive spillover effects for nearby rural counties and counties with low provider to population ratios. We find that over the decade after a program first graduates students, up to 30% of students become licensed NPs in the same county, and for rural programs, the majority of graduates add to the regional supply of NPs. We find no adverse impact of local NP increases on the number of primary care physicians, suggesting that broader access to NP education boosts the local supply of providers overall. This paper illustrates the importance of rural medical education in increasing local access to primary care providers and in addressing existing inequities in access to care.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103121.abstractZh: 从2010年到2023年，执业护士的队伍迅速扩大，尤其是在农村县，如今患者几乎同样可能从执业护士那里获得医疗服务，而不是从医生那里获得。与此同时，农村地区的健康成果和医疗保健获取情况相对于城市地区仍然在恶化。关于执业护士如何与医生互动或替代医生的研究仍然有限。本文利用县级研究生护理项目的开设情况，来测试它们如何影响当地执业护士和初级保健医生的供应。通过整合的大学教育数据系统和地区健康资源文件的数据，我们采用了分阶段差异框架的估计方法。我们发现，新的研究生项目显著增加了当地执业护士的供应，并且对附近的农村县以及医生与人口比例较低的县产生了积极的溢出效应。我们发现，在项目首次培养学生后的十年内，有多达30%的学生在同一县成为执业护士，对于农村项目来说，大多数毕业生增加了当地的执业护士供应。我们没有发现当地执业护士的增加对初级保健医生数量产生负面影响，这表明更广泛的执业护士教育能够总体上增加当地的医疗服务提供者数量。本文强调了农村医学教育在增加当地初级保健医疗服务提供者数量以及解决现有医疗获取不平等问题方面的重要性。

abstract.text: Ownership of English general practices by physicians has been declining for many years and concentrated among fewer physicians. Non-clinical ownership may provide a sustainable alternative structure for general practice. In this study, we provide the first formal evaluation of non-clinical ownership in an English general practice setting. We compile a comprehensive dataset of general practices across eight years between 2015/16 and 2022/23 from a range of sources to investigate the impact of non-clinical ownership stakes on key primary care outcomes, including staffing levels and turnover, patient satisfaction, access, quality of care, reimbursement for non-core services and total patient list size. Employing a dynamic event study design combined with propensity-score weighting, we find practice manager partners increase direct patient care (excluding physicians and nurses), administrative staff numbers, reimbursement for non-core services and total patient list size. However, we find no statistically significant effect on any other outcome. Offering equity stakes to non-physician staff may support practice sustainability by allowing alternative ownership structures.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103122.abstractZh: 多年来，英国全科医生的股权状况一直在下降，且集中在较少的医生手中。非临床股权可能为全科医生提供一种可持续的替代结构。本研究首次对英国全科医生环境中的非临床股权进行了正式评估。我们收集了2015/16年至2022/23年间来自多个来源的八年数据，以研究非临床股权对关键初级保健结果的影响，包括人员配备和流动率、患者满意度、就医渠道、护理质量、非核心服务的报销情况以及患者总数。通过采用动态事件研究设计并结合倾向评分加权方法，我们发现诊所经理合作伙伴能够增加直接患者护理（不包括医生和护士）、行政人员数量、非核心服务的报销情况以及患者总数。然而，我们没有发现其他结果存在统计学上的显著影响。向非医生员工提供股权可能通过允许替代性股权结构来支持诊所的可持续性。

abstract.text: Most people consider parks important for their quality of life, yet systematic causal evidence is missing. We exploit exogenous variations in their use values to estimate causal effects. Using a representative household panel with precise geographical coordinates of households linked to satellite images of green spaces with a nationwide coverage, we employ a spatial difference-in-differences design, comparing within-individual changes between residents living close to a green space with those living further away. We exploit Covid-19 as an exogenous shock. We find that green spaces raised overall life satisfaction while reducing symptoms of anxiety (feelings of nervousness and worry) and depression. There is also suggestive evidence for reduced loneliness. Given the number of people in their surroundings, a compensating-surplus calculation suggests that parks added substantial benefits during the period studied.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103123.abstractZh: 大多数人认为公园对生活质量至关重要，但缺乏系统的因果证据。我们利用公园使用价值的外部变化来估计因果效应。我们采用了一个具有精确地理坐标的代表性家庭面板，并结合全国范围内的绿地卫星图像，采用空间差异-差异设计，比较居住在绿地附近和远离绿地居民的变化情况。我们将新冠疫情作为外部冲击因素纳入分析。研究发现，绿地提升了整体生活满意度，同时减少了焦虑症状（紧张和担忧的感觉）以及抑郁症状。还有迹象表明，绿地有助于减少孤独感。考虑到周围的人口数量，补偿性收益计算表明，在研究期间，公园带来了显著的好处。

abstract.text: This study examines the effect of financial distress within households on intimate partner violence in the United States. By leveraging the timing of bank closing days and fixed wage payment schedules, we identify months when households have to stretch their finances due to changes in their regular payment schedules. Using monthly records from the National Crime Victimization Survey, we find that these shocks significantly increase the likelihood of women experiencing IPV. We further corroborate the assumption of worsened household conditions during these periods by documenting changes in household behavior in terms of expenditures and time use.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103124.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了家庭财务困境对美国亲密伴侣暴力行为的影响。通过分析银行关闭日期和固定工资支付时间表，我们识别出家庭因常规支付计划的变化而不得不调整财务状况的月份。利用《全国犯罪受害者调查》的月度数据，我们发现这些冲击显著增加了女性遭受亲密伴侣暴力的可能性。我们通过记录家庭在支出和时间使用方面的变化，进一步证实了在这些时期家庭状况恶化的假设。

abstract.text: Identifying causal effects of prenatal psychological stress on birth outcomes is challenging because stressful events typically bundle psychological stress with material disruptions. The 2011 Fukushima nuclear accident provides a unique setting to overcome this challenge: while physical radiation exposure was geographically limited and well-documented, fear of radiation spread nationwide. We exploit this geographic separation to examine how maternal anxiety independently affects fetal development. Using universal Japanese birth records linked to census data, combined with a novel Google Trends-based measure of radiation-specific anxiety, we employ three complementary identification strategies: population-level comparisons of in-utero exposed versus unexposed cohorts, within-family sibling analysis controlling for time-invariant family characteristics, and dose-response estimation exploiting geographic variation in anxiety intensity. Experiencing the accident during pregnancy increased preterm births by 17% and reduced birth weights by 22-26 grams. Birth outcomes exhibit a clear dose-response relationship with anxiety intensity, with radiation-specific anxiety accounting for 72-79% of the overall preterm birth effects and 28-37% of the overall birth weight effects. Effects are concentrated among socioeconomically disadvantaged mothers and during first-trimester exposure, with the most severe impacts on already-vulnerable infants in the very low and extremely low birth weight categories. Our findings indicate that invisible threats generate measurable intergenerational health impacts through psychological stress pathways, with implications for disaster preparedness and risk communication during contemporary crises from pandemics to climate change.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103125.abstractZh: 识别产前心理压力对出生结果的影响是一个挑战，因为压力事件通常将心理压力与物质中断结合在一起。2011年福岛核事故提供了一个独特的情境来克服这一挑战：虽然物理辐射暴露在地理上受到限制且记录详尽，但辐射恐惧却在全国范围内蔓延。我们利用这种地理上的分离来研究母体焦虑如何独立影响胎儿发育。通过结合与人口普查数据相关的日本出生记录，以及基于Google趋势的辐射特异性焦虑测量方法，我们采用了三种互补的识别策略：对子宫内暴露与未暴露群体的人口水平比较、控制时间不变的家庭特征进行家族内兄弟姐妹分析，以及利用地理差异对焦虑强度进行剂量-反应估计。在怀孕期间遭遇事故导致早产率增加了17%，出生体重减少了22-26克。出生结果显示出明显的剂量-反应关系，其中辐射特异性焦虑解释了整体早产效应的72-79%，以及整体出生体重效应的28-37%。这些影响主要集中在社会经济地位较低的母亲身上，以及在妊娠早期暴露时，对极低和极低出生体重类别的婴儿影响最为严重。我们的研究结果表明，无形的威胁通过心理压力途径产生可测量的代际健康影响，这对从大流行病到气候变化的当代危机中的灾难准备和风险沟通具有重要意义。

abstract.text: In 2015, Brazil experienced an epidemic caused by the Zika virus. We use hundreds of millions of administrative records to document household responses to the first public health alert linking the Zika virus to the risk of congenital disease for those in utero. We study two margins of behavior: risk avoidance (avoiding pregnancy), and risk mitigation during pregnancy (ultrasounds and abortions). On risk avoidance, we find a 7% reduction in pregnancies post-alert, a response triggered immediately after the alert. On risk mitigation, we find a 9% increase in the use of ultrasounds in the first trimester of pregnancy, and a 5% rise in abortions, concentrated among late term abortions. We document that post-alert all households - irrespective of race or education for example - were able to reduce risks during pregnancy, in line with preventative measures not being costly. In contrast, the avoidance response is driven by more educated mothers perhaps because such households face lower costs of altering their plans around the timing of fertility. We further discuss consequent impacts on birth outcomes, supply side responses, and how our findings extend to household responses to health alerts related to other viral threats.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103126.abstractZh: 2015年，巴西爆发了由寨卡病毒引发的疫情。我们利用数亿份行政记录来记录家庭对首次公共卫生警报的反应，该警报将寨卡病毒与胎儿先天性疾病的风险联系起来。我们研究了两种行为倾向：风险规避（避免怀孕）和孕期风险缓解措施（超声波检查和堕胎）。在风险规避方面，我们发现警报发布后怀孕率降低了7%，这种反应在警报发布后立即出现。在风险缓解方面，我们发现孕早期使用超声波检查的比例增加了9%，堕胎率增加了5%，其中晚期堕胎占比较高。我们发现，在警报发布后，所有家庭——无论种族或教育水平如何——都能降低孕期风险，这与预防措施不会造成高昂成本的观点一致。相比之下，规避行为更多由受教育程度较高的母亲主导，因为这些家庭在调整生育计划方面的成本较低。我们进一步讨论了这对出生结果、供应方面的反应的影响，以及我们的发现如何适用于其他病毒威胁相关的健康警报下的家庭反应。

abstract.text: Selective mortality and fertility issues are persistent challenges in estimating the fetal origin effect, with attempts to address these issues being notably scarce. Evidence further suggests that selective mortality is more pronounced in males than in females. This study investigates the causal effects of prenatal exposure to the Great Chinese Famine on educational attainment by addressing gender-specific selection bias. We compare exposed individuals with their unexposed, same-gender siblings, using a famine intensity measure based on county-year level excess death rates. Our findings reveal remarkably similar consequences for both genders: on average, famine exposure increased illiteracy rates by 4 percentage points and decreased years of schooling by 0.3 years for both males and females. These results contribute to our understanding of the long-term impacts of prenatal malnutrition, while accounting for gender-specific selection biases.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103133.abstractZh: 选择性死亡和生育问题在估算胎儿起源效应方面一直是一个持续的挑战，而针对这些问题的研究却相对较少。有证据表明，选择性死亡在男性中比女性更为明显。本研究通过探讨性别特定的选择偏差，来研究中国大饥荒期间产前暴露对教育成就的因果效应。我们对比了暴露者与未暴露的同性别兄弟姐妹的情况，使用基于县-年份超额死亡率的饥荒强度指标进行分析。研究发现，两种性别的后果非常相似：平均而言，饥荒暴露使男性和女性的文盲率分别增加了4个百分点，而受教育年限则分别减少了0.3年。这些结果有助于我们理解产前营养不良的长期影响，同时考虑了性别特定的选择偏差。

abstract.text: We examine the relationship between physician preferences and both the intensity and cost of care delivered to commercially insured heart attack patients. We find that the survey-based preference measures collected by Cutler et al. (2019) (CSSW) predict variations in utilization that are same-signed, though substantially muted, relative to the strong relationships CSSW uncovered for both treatment and expenditure for Medicare beneficiaries. Additionally, regions with aggressive practice styles receive sufficiently lower reimbursements from commercial insurers that variations in practice preferences have weak correlations with expenditures in the commercial market. We present a parsimonious model of commercial insurers' pricing that can rationalize this fact pattern.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103134.abstractZh: 我们研究了医生偏好与商业保险覆盖的心脏病患者所接受的治疗强度和成本之间的关系。研究发现，Cutler等人（2019年）基于调查得出的偏好指标能够预测治疗需求的变化，但这些变化与CSSW研究发现的Medicare受益人治疗和支出之间的强相关性相比，变化幅度较小且影响较弱。此外，采用激进医疗模式的地区从商业保险公司获得的报销金额较低，因此医疗偏好与商业市场中的支出之间的相关性较弱。我们提出了一个简洁的商业保险公司定价模型，以解释这一事实模式。

abstract.text: We study the relationship between air pollution and suicide using detailed daily cause of death data from all death certificates in the U.S. over eight years. Using a two-stage residual inclusion estimator with wind direction as an instrument for daily pollution exposure, we estimated that a 1 μg/m 3 increase in daily PM2.5 is associated with a 0.39% increase in daily suicides and a 50.5% increase in monthly suicide-related hospitalizations. We find relatively large effects for men, young persons, and in counties where the mean level of pollution is above the median. Our event study estimates show the relationship between pollution and suicide exposure is contemporaneous.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103135.abstractZh: 我们研究了空气污染与自杀之间的关系，使用了美国八年期间所有死亡证明中的详细每日死因数据。通过采用以风向为工具变量的两阶段残差包含估计方法，我们发现每日PM2.5浓度每增加1微克/立方米，每日自杀率会增加0.39%，而每月与自杀相关的住院率则会增加50.5%。我们发现，男性、年轻人以及污染水平高于中位数的地区，这种影响更为显著。我们的事件研究估计表明，污染与自杀暴露之间的关系是同时发生的。

abstract.text: Equitable healthcare access for mobile, informally employed populations remains elusive in many developing contexts. We examine the impact of the first phase of China's cross-regional instant reimbursement (CRIR) reform-a province-level reform-on enrollment in health insurance and healthcare utilization. Informed by a theoretical model, we implement a triple-differences design leveraging CRIR's staggered rollout to identify causal effects. Results show that CRIR substantially increased local UEBMI enrollment (by 8%) and healthcare visits (by 14%), while reducing out-of-pocket spending (by 22%). These gains stem from lower administrative frictions and strengthened financial protection. Low-income, less-educated, and more informally employed migrants benefit the most, underscoring the reform's role in promoting inclusive development. Our findings highlight the importance of portable social insurance in improving healthcare access for mobile populations and offer insights for similar reforms in other developing settings.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103136.abstractZh: 在许多发展中国家，流动性和非正式就业人群难以获得公平的医疗保健服务。本研究考察了中国跨区域即时报销改革的第一阶段——省级改革——对医疗保险参保率和医疗利用的影响。基于理论模型，我们采用三重差异设计，利用即时报销的分阶段实施来识别因果效应。结果显示，即时报销显著增加了当地居民医疗保险的参保人数（增加了8%）和医疗就诊次数（增加了14%），同时降低了自付费用（减少了22%）。这些收益源于较低的行政摩擦和更强的财务保障。低收入、受教育程度较低且非正式就业较多的移民受益最大，这凸显了该改革在促进包容性发展中的作用。我们的研究发现强调了便携式社会保险在改善流动人群医疗保健服务获取方面的重要性，并为其他发展中国家的类似改革提供了启示。

abstract.text: This study examines the long-run economic consequences of disability, distinguishing conditions by the activities they impair. Using linked Canadian survey and administrative tax data, I estimate the effects of disability onset on detailed income components over a ten-year horizon and assess gaps in partial income insurance across disability types. Mental-cognitive disabilities lead to larger and more persistent losses in market income than physical disabilities. Despite this, both groups experience similar levels of partial insurance and comparable declines in after-tax income. Importantly, substantial heterogeneity exists within these broad categories. Disaggregating physical and mental-cognitive disabilities into mutually exclusive activity-based subtypes reveals pronounced differences in income trajectories and access to insurance that are masked by aggregate classifications. While the tax-transfer system provides partial income protection overall, its effectiveness varies markedly across subtypes, offering especially limited support for mental health-related disabilities, particularly among younger and less-educated individuals.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103137.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了残疾的长期经济后果，根据残疾所影响的活动类型进行分类。通过结合加拿大调查和行政税收数据，我估算了残疾发生对详细收入构成的影响，并评估了不同残疾类型在部分收入保险方面的差异。与身体残疾相比，认知残疾会导致更大且更持久的市场收入损失。尽管如此，两组残疾患者在部分保险覆盖程度以及税后收入下降幅度上表现相似。重要的是，这些大类内部存在显著的异质性。将身体残疾和认知残疾分解为互斥的活动类型后，可以发现收入轨迹和保险获取方面的显著差异，这些差异被总体分类所掩盖。虽然税收转移体系总体上提供了部分收入保护，但其有效性在不同残疾类型之间存在显著差异，尤其是对与心理健康相关的残疾，尤其是年轻且受教育程度较低的个体而言，这种保护尤为有限。

abstract.text: Heavy workloads facing health care providers may lead to changes in care processes that, in turn, affect quality of care and patient outcomes. Using direct observations of vaginal deliveries in three high-volume Kenyan hospitals, we study how workload affects care in maternity wards - a high-stress environment where hard-to-schedule patient admissions and uncertainty around labor progression can result in unexpected fluctuations in workload throughout the day. We first document that these facilities are persistently understaffed relative to international staffing benchmarks, implying high baseline workloads. Exploiting short-run variations in provider workload in this environment, we find that workload has little to no effect on quality, as measured by provider adherence to clinical guidelines and disrespectful care. We show that coping strategies employed by providers, such as using clinical interventions to speed up labor and delegating tasks to less qualified team members, may have weakened the relationship between workload and the quality measures we examine. However, these coping mechanisms could have negative implications for other (unmeasured) aspects of quality. Drawing on anecdotal and other evidence, we propose additional hypotheses for why quality may not be sensitive to workload in this setting.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103138.abstractZh: 医疗提供者面临繁重的工作负担，这可能导致护理流程发生变化，进而影响护理质量和患者预后。通过对肯尼亚三家高流量医院的阴道分娩过程进行直接观察，我们研究了工作负担对产科病房的影响——这是一个高压力的环境，难以安排患者的入院时间，且分娩进程的不确定性可能导致一天中工作负担出现意外波动。我们首先发现，这些医疗机构相对于国际人员配置标准而言，人员不足，这意味着他们面临较高的基础工作负担。利用这一环境中提供者工作负担的短期变化，我们发现，工作负担对护理质量的影响很小，甚至没有影响，因为护理质量可以通过提供者是否遵守临床指南以及是否提供不尊重患者的护理来衡量。我们发现，提供者采用的应对策略，如使用临床干预措施加速分娩或将任务委托给资质较低的团队成员，可能会削弱工作负担与我们所考察的质量指标之间的关系。然而，这些应对机制可能对其他质量方面产生负面影响。基于轶事和其他证据，我们提出了一些额外的假设，以解释为什么在这种环境下，质量可能并不受工作负担的影响。

abstract.text: Billions of people worldwide still lack access to healthy diets, with a high concentration in rural areas of developing countries. This paper examines how major transportation investments can improve dietary quality among rural households, leveraging the staggered rollout of the "Five Vertical and Seven Horizontal" National Trunk Highway System (5V7H), the country's largest expressway network completed by 2007. Using a staggered difference-in-differences design, we find that the 5V7H access increases the Dietary Diversity Score (DDS) and Chinese Healthy Eating Index (CHEI) of rural residents by 0.326 and 2.197 points, respectively. These benefits are more prominent among households with more children, access to refrigerators, or meal preparers with better nutrition knowledge, and less so among households with more diversified agricultural production. We further show that the 5V7H connection improves rural residents' dietary quality primarily through demand-side channels, including promoting off-farm employment, raising household income, and enhancing dietary literacy. In contrast, the contributions of supply-side channels, such as improved market access or lower food prices, are modest. Overall, our findings highlight the benefits of large-scale transportation infrastructure in facilitating the transition to healthier diets in rural areas of developing countries.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103139.abstractZh: 全球仍有数十亿人无法获得健康的饮食，这种情况在发展中国家的农村地区尤为严重。本文探讨了如何通过大规模的交通基础设施建设来改善农村家庭的饮食质量，具体措施包括逐步实施“五纵七横”国家干线公路系统。截至2007年，该系统已成为该国最大的高速公路网络。通过差异分组设计，我们发现“五纵七横”公路系统的建设使农村居民的饮食多样性得分提高了0.326分，中国健康饮食指数提高了2.197分。这些好处在子女较多的家庭、拥有冰箱或具备更好营养知识的餐饮服务提供者家庭中更为明显，而在农业生产多样化程度较高的家庭中则较为不明显。此外，我们还发现，“五纵七横”公路系统的建设主要通过需求端渠道来提高农村居民的饮食质量，包括促进非农就业、增加家庭收入以及提高饮食知识水平。相比之下，市场接入改善或食品价格下降等供给端渠道的贡献则较为有限。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，大规模的交通基础设施建设对于促进发展中国家农村地区的健康饮食转型具有积极意义。

abstract.text: We estimate the long-run labor market and health effects of breast cancer among Austrian women. Compared to a random sample of same-aged non-affected women, those diagnosed with breast cancer face a 22.8 percent increase in health expenses, 9 percent lower unconditional earnings, 5.8 lower employment probability, and an earnings penalty conditional on employment of 6.4 percent five years after diagnosis. We discuss changes in job quality, hours, incapacitation, and employer discrimination as potential mechanisms behind these labor market adjustments.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103141.abstractZh: 我们估算了奥地利女性中乳腺癌对劳动力市场及健康影响的长期影响。与同龄未患病的女性相比，被诊断出乳腺癌的女性健康支出增加了22.8%，无条件收入减少了9%，就业概率降低了5.8%，并且在诊断后的五年内，即使继续就业，收入损失也达到了6.4%。我们探讨了工作质量、工作时间、残疾状况以及雇主歧视等因素作为这些劳动力市场调整背后的潜在机制。

abstract.text: Plan standardization policies aim to help consumers assess plan value by limiting variation in cost-sharing and directing attention towards premiums, networks, and formularies. They may also intensify issuer competition and lower premiums. We study one such policy-the introduction of standardized "Simple Choice" plans alongside non-standardized options in the 2017 ACA marketplaces-and estimate its effect on premiums. Across multiple identification strategies and robustness checks, we find that Simple Choice plans reduced premiums for bronze, silver, and gold tiers, including a 7.3% reduction in the benchmark premium.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103142.abstractZh: 计划标准化政策旨在帮助消费者通过限制费用分担的变动来评估计划价值，并将注意力集中在保费、网络和服务方案上。这些政策还可能加剧发行者的竞争并降低保费。我们研究了其中一种政策——在2017年《平价医疗法案》市场引入标准化“简单选择”计划与非标准化选项的情况，并估算了其对保费的影响。通过多种识别策略和稳健性检验，我们发现“简单选择”计划降低了青铜级、银级和金级的保费，基准保费降低了7.3%。

abstract.text: Patients experiencing acute health symptoms often face uncertainty about how and where to receive care. We study patients who call a nurse advice line and receive one of four recommendations: emergency department (ED), urgent care (UC), primary care (PC), or self-care (Home). Leveraging an extension of examiner designs that recovers margin-specific effects for each pair of adjacent recommendations (ED-UC, UC-PC, PC-Home), we estimate the impact of nurse recommendations on both patient decisions and their subsequent health outcomes. We find that recommendations have large impacts on patient decisions at each margin. We then show that UC recommendations reduce 28-day healthcare costs by $404 relative to ED recommendations and by $247 relative to PC recommendations, suggesting substantial potential for cost savings through improved triage.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103149.abstractZh: 出现急性健康症状的患者常常不确定如何以及在哪里获得治疗。我们研究了那些拨打护士咨询热线并接受四种建议的患者：急诊科、紧急护理、初级保健或自我护理。通过扩展检验设计，我们分别评估了每种相邻建议组合的影响（急诊-紧急护理、紧急护理-初级保健、初级保健-自我护理），以估算护士建议对患者决策及其后续健康结果的影响。我们发现，这些建议对患者的决策有显著影响。进一步研究表明，与急诊建议相比，紧急护理建议可减少28天的医疗费用404美元；与初级保健建议相比，则可减少247美元。这表明，通过改进分诊流程，有巨大的潜力实现成本节约。

abstract.text: Poor health and unstable housing are closely linked. Most research has focused on how housing shapes health, with little empirical study of whether and how health events can lead to future residential mobility or housing instability. This paper uses high-frequency administrative data on residential location and health among Medicaid enrollees in New York City to test whether adverse health events trigger housing mobility or insecurity, independent of the financial toll of medical bills. Using an event study design, I find that health shocks - or, sudden hospitalizations after two hospital-free years - immediately increase residential mobility (21-35 % relative increase) and the probability of living in shelters or on the street (6-10 % relative increase). These increased rates of mobility and instability persist above expected levels for at least two years. For unplanned or urgent hospital admissions, the impact of health events is even greater. These estimates imply that, in their immediate aftermath, adverse health events could be a tipping point for approximately 80,000 additional moves and 20,000 additional cases of homelessness among the U.S. Medicaid-insured population annually. The effects of health events on residential mobility are smaller for those with subsidized housing, a usual source of outpatient care, higher-quality inpatient care, and social support, suggesting potential areas for policy interventions to break the relationship between health problems and housing outcomes, from both inside and outside of health systems. This work also contributes to our understanding of the long tail of social consequences of adverse health events.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103150.abstractZh: 健康状况不佳与不稳定的住房状况密切相关。大多数研究都关注住房如何影响健康，而关于健康事件是否以及如何导致未来的居住流动或住房不稳定性的实证研究却很少。本文利用纽约市Medicaid参保者关于居住位置和健康状况的高频行政数据，来检验不良健康事件是否会在不考虑医疗费用影响的情况下引发居住流动或不稳定现象。通过事件研究设计，我们发现健康冲击——即在连续两年无住院经历后突然住院——会立即增加居住流动率（相对增加21-35%），并增加居住在临时住所或街上的概率（相对增加6-10%）。这些增加的流动率和不稳定性至少会持续两年以上。对于计划外或紧急住院的情况，健康事件的影响更为显著。这些估计表明，在不良健康事件发生后，每年大约有8万人的居住位置会发生变动，另有2万人会出现无家可归的情况。对于那些拥有补贴住房的人群来说，健康事件对居住流动的影响较小，因为这些人群通常能够获得门诊护理、高质量的住院护理以及社会支持。这表明，政策干预可以在医疗系统内外发挥作用，从而打破健康问题与住房状况之间的关联。这项工作也有助于我们理解不良健康事件带来的社会后果。

abstract.text: We introduce a novel approach to identify state-dependent reporting bias in subjective health measures. The central idea is that health operates as a stock, making abrupt shifts in self-reported health (SRH) following retirement more likely to reflect reporting bias than actual changes. To capture such shifts, our analysis integrates three key elements: (1) differentiating stock and flow outcomes based on classical health theory; (2) leveraging an identification strategy inspired by regression discontinuity design; and (3) exploiting a unique high-frequency dataset on monthly health and retirement. Traditional estimates find a decline in SRH after retirement over longer periods; however, this decline steadily diminishes as the observation window narrows, showing no evidence of state-dependent reporting bias. Our analysis of short-term health dynamics also emphasizes distinguishing stock and flow health outcomes in policy evaluations.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103151.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种新颖的方法，用于识别主观健康指标中依赖于状态的报告偏差。其核心思想是，健康被视为一种存量，因此退休后自我报告的健康状况发生突然变化，更可能反映了报告偏差，而非实际的变化。为了捕捉这种变化，我们的分析整合了三个关键要素：（1）根据经典健康理论区分存量与流量结果；（2）采用受回归不连续设计启发的识别策略；（3）利用关于月度健康和退休的独特高频数据集。传统的估计结果显示，退休后健康状况在较长时间内会下降；然而，随着观察窗口的缩小，这种下降逐渐减弱，表明不存在依赖于状态的报告偏差。我们对短期健康动态的分析还强调了在政策评估中区分存量与流量健康结果的重要性。

abstract.text: We study the long-run consequences of fertility policy for aging and survival, exploiting the staggered provincial rollout of China's 1970s Later, Longer, Fewer campaign. Linking variation in exposure to the Chinese Longitudinal Healthy Longevity Survey (1998-2021), we find that cohorts subject to fertility restrictions experienced significantly higher late-life mortality, over 10% on average, and worse cognitive and psychological outcomes. These effects arise because smaller sibships, delayed childbearing, and wider spacing reduced both the supply and timing of intergenerational care. While the subsequent introduction of LTCI mitigated some adverse impacts, the effects were driven by in-kind benefits, whereas cash-based LTCI provided little offset, underscoring the limits of formal substitution for kin-based support. Our findings reveal a fundamental intergenerational trade-off in fertility control and highlight the enduring demographic costs of policies that reshape family structure.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103152.abstractZh: 我们研究了生育政策对老龄化与生存的长期影响，重点关注中国1970年代“晚生、少生”计划的省级实施差异。通过结合中国纵向健康长寿调查（1998-2021年）的数据，我们发现受到生育限制影响的群体在晚年死亡率显著升高，平均超过10%，同时认知和心理状况也较差。这些影响源于较小的亲属关系、延迟生育以及更宽的生育间隔，这些因素减少了代际照顾的供给和时间。虽然随后实施的长期健康保险政策缓解了一些负面影响，但这些影响主要是由实物福利驱动的，而现金形式的长期健康保险政策几乎没有起到抵消作用，这凸显了正式替代亲属支持方式的局限性。我们的研究揭示了生育控制中存在的根本代际权衡，并强调了重塑家庭结构政策所带来的长期人口成本。

abstract.text: We analyse the impact of a change in the administration of social security payments, occurring in utero and early infancy, on health in early childhood. We identify this impact through the gradual rollout of the so-called 'income management' policy in Aboriginal communities in Australia's Northern Territory in 2007. This policy changed the delivery method of social security payments but not their value - however, implementation challenges meant that many families did not receive their payments on time. Using linked administrative data, we find that children who were exposed to the policy rollout in utero or in their first three months of life (the 'fourth trimester') were at higher risk of severe infection requiring hospitalisation. These children spent, on average, 4.7 more days in hospital between birth and their 8th birthday. Most of this impact is concentrated in hospitalisations for infection, which increased by 23 percent. These admissions are driven by a range of infection types: bacterial, viral and respiratory. We link our findings to the 'immune programming hypothesis', i.e. maternal stress and poor nutrition during key stages in immune system development can permanently weaken the child's immune system. Our findings highlight the importance of attention to key phases in child development when designing policies that affect households' financial resources, even temporarily.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103153.abstractZh: 我们分析了社会保障支付管理方式在胎儿期和婴儿期发生的变化对幼儿健康的影响。我们通过2007年澳大利亚北领地原住民社区逐步实施所谓的“收入管理”政策来识别这一影响。该政策改变了社会保障支付的支付方式，但并未改变其价值——然而，实施过程中的挑战导致许多家庭未能按时收到支付。利用关联行政数据，我们发现，在胎儿期或出生后的前三个月（即“第四孕期”）接触该政策的儿童，出现需要住院治疗的严重感染的风险更高。这些儿童在出生到8岁生日之间的住院天数平均多出4.7天。这种影响主要集中在因感染而住院的情况，住院率上升了23%。这些住院病例涉及多种类型的感染：细菌性、病毒性和呼吸道性感染。我们将研究结果与“免疫编程假说”联系起来，即母亲在免疫系统发育的关键阶段承受的压力和营养不良会永久性地削弱儿童的免疫系统。我们的研究结果强调了在设计影响家庭财务资源政策时，关注儿童发育的关键阶段的重要性，即使这些政策只是暂时的。

abstract.text: This paper examines how expanding the legal definition of sexual assault affects fertility and sexual behavior, using a panel of European countries. I find that switching to tacit consent-based legislation reduces fertility by about 4% relative to the mean. This effect is driven by a decrease in couple formation and an increase in abortion rates. Supporting evidence is consistent with a behavioral channel in which more risk-averse individuals withdraw from dating and partner markets following the reform, altering the composition of those who remain active toward a pool that is less precautionary. Consistent with this compositional shift, contraceptive use rises among younger women but declines among older age groups, while condom use falls among young men. Finally, an analysis of appeals court verdicts in Sweden following the adoption of consent-based legislation shows a decline in unanimous guilty verdicts, indicating challenges in assessing tacit consent. These results are consistent with a simple framework in which heterogeneity in risk perceptions and precautionary behavior in dating and partner markets, including reduced participation by some individuals, helps explain the observed decline in fertility following the reform.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103154.abstractZh: 本文通过选取欧洲多个国家作为样本，探讨了扩大性侵犯法律定义对生育能力和性行为的影响。研究发现，采用基于默认同意的立法后，生育率相对下降了约4%。这一效应主要源于夫妻组建数量的减少以及堕胎率的上升。支持这一观点的证据表明，在改革后，更多规避风险的人选择退出约会市场和伴侣市场，导致活跃人群的组成发生变化，变得更加缺乏预防措施。与此组成变化一致的是，年轻女性的避孕使用率上升，而老年群体的使用率下降；同时，年轻男性的避孕套使用率下降。最后，对瑞典在采用基于同意的立法后上诉法院的判决进行分析后发现，一致认定有罪的情况有所减少，这表明在评估默认同意方面存在挑战。这些结果与一个简单的框架相一致：即不同个体在风险认知和约会及伴侣市场中的预防措施上的差异，包括部分个体参与度的降低，有助于解释改革后生育率的下降现象。

abstract.text: Many volunteer markets, and most prominently markets for substances of human origin, feature dynamic coordination problems where volunteering today can temporarily restrict volunteering later. We show that, unsurprisingly, these restrictions reduce market surplus compared to no restrictions. We examine whether providing volunteers with demand or supply information improves market surplus without and with intertemporal restrictions. We show theoretically that, without restrictions, providing demand or supply information increases market surplus, while with restrictions, providing supply rather than demand information causes higher market surplus. Experimental results support most predictions and further show that supply information especially improves market surplus when intertemporal restrictions exist. Overall, comparative static inferences in an environment without intertemporal restrictions do not carry over to an environment with restrictions. Thus, policies based on analyses of static conditions will not necessarily be effective in situations featuring dynamic spillovers.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103155.abstractZh: 许多志愿者市场，尤其是涉及人类源性物质的市场，存在动态协调问题，即今天的志愿者参与可能会暂时限制后续的志愿者参与。我们发现，这些限制措施与没有限制措施相比，确实会减少市场剩余。我们研究了向志愿者提供需求或供应信息是否能在存在和不存在时间限制的情况下改善市场剩余。理论研究表明，在没有限制的情况下，提供需求或供应信息会增加市场剩余；而在存在限制的情况下，提供供应信息而非需求信息则会导致更高的市场剩余。实验结果支持大部分预测，并进一步表明，在存在时间限制的情况下，供应信息对改善市场剩余尤为有效。总体而言，在没有时间限制的环境中的比较静态推断并不适用于存在时间限制的环境。因此，基于静态条件分析的政策在具有动态溢出效应的情境下可能不会有效。

abstract.text: This paper develops a unified framework for evaluating health outcomes that jointly incorporates equity and productivity. Extending beyond traditional QALYs, PALYs, and the more recent PQALYs, we introduce a broader class of evaluation functions that integrate equity- and productivity-sensitive conditions. By imposing several normative criteria, including independence from measurement scales and Pigou-Dalton transfer principles, we obtain tractable power-form representations. In balancing equity and efficiency, the framework provides a coherent foundation for assessing interventions in contexts where both health and productive capacity are at stake.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103156.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个统一的框架，用于评估健康结果，该框架同时考虑了公平性和生产力因素。该框架超越了传统的质量生命年（QALYs）、生产力生命年（PALYs）以及较新的质量-生产力生命年（PQALYs）等评估方法，引入了一类更广泛的评估函数，这些函数同时考虑了公平性和生产力方面的因素。通过施加若干规范标准，包括与测量尺度的独立性以及皮古-达顿转移原则，我们能够得到易于处理的功率形式表示。在平衡公平性和效率的同时，该框架为评估涉及健康和生产能力方面的干预措施提供了连贯的基础。

abstract.text: Pharmaceutical expenditures are rising rapidly, driven in part by the innovation of highly effective but very expensive drug therapies that treat multiple diseases, implying that payers face a critical trade-off between cost containment and access to new medicines. A key policy question is whether producers should be restricted to uniform pricing or allowed to use indication-based pricing, where prices vary across patient groups. We use a two-market model to analyse how this choice affects drug producers' incentives to invest in new indications, their pricing strategies, and the resulting surplus for health plans. In a monopoly setting, indication-based pricing yields higher profits and thus strengthens incentives to invest in new indications, while the payer prefers uniform pricing unless the fixed investment costs cannot be recouped. However, monopoly-based insights may not hold if the multi-indication producer faces therapeutic competition in one of the markets. Specifically, we identify a softening-of-competition effect, where a uniform pricing restriction serves as a credible commitment to raise prices in the competitive market. In this case, the health plan might favour indication-based pricing to reduce costs. Overall, our findings suggest that neither pricing scheme is universally optimal, underscoring the need for case-by-case assessments across drug classes.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103157.abstractZh: 药品支出正在迅速增加，部分原因是出现了高效但价格昂贵的药物疗法，这些疗法可以治疗多种疾病。这意味着支付方在控制成本和获得新药物之间面临着一个关键的权衡。一个重要的政策问题是，是否应该限制生产商采用统一定价，还是允许他们采用基于适应症定价的策略，即不同患者群体的价格有所不同。我们使用双市场模型来分析这种选择如何影响药物生产商在新适应症上的投资动机、定价策略以及由此产生的健康计划收益。在垄断环境下，基于适应症定价能够带来更高的利润，从而增强生产商在新适应症上的投资动机，而支付方则更倾向于统一定价，除非固定投资成本无法得到回收。然而，如果多适应症生产商在其中一个市场上面临治疗性竞争，那么基于垄断的见解可能并不适用。具体来说，我们发现存在一种竞争软化效应，即统一定价限制实际上是一种可信的承诺，可以在竞争市场中提高价格。在这种情况下，健康计划可能会倾向于采用基于适应症定价来降低成本。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，这两种定价方案都不是普遍最优的，这强调了需要根据不同药物类别进行个案评估。

abstract.text: This paper estimates the causal effect of online food delivery platforms on body weight in China. Exploiting the staggered rollout of Eleme across Chinese cities between 2010 and 2020, we find that platform entry shifts the BMI distribution rightward among urban young adults: it increases body mass index, lowers underweight prevalence, and raises the likelihood of being overweight. Effects are negligible among urban older adults, consistent with lower platform adoption in this group. Mechanism analysis points to shifts in dietary preferences toward energy-dense foods, reduced meal preparation time, and increased restaurant entry. Our findings highlight the health trade-offs associated with digital food platforms in rapidly urbanizing developing countries, where improved caloric access may coexist with greater exposure to lower-quality, energy-dense foods.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103158.abstractZh: 本文估算了在线食品配送平台对中国体重的因果效应。通过分析Eleme在中国城市间在2010至2020年间的分阶段推广情况，我们发现该平台的进入使城市年轻成年人的BMI分布向右偏移：它增加了体重指数，降低了体重过轻的患病率，并提高了超重的可能性。而在城市老年人群中，这种效应可以忽略不计，这与该群体对平台的采用率较低一致。机制分析指出，这种变化源于饮食偏好的转变，即更倾向于选择能量密度高的食物，餐食准备时间减少，以及餐厅的进入频率增加。我们的研究结果凸显了在快速城市化的发展中国家，数字食品平台带来的健康权衡，即改善的热量获取可能与接触更劣质、能量密度高的食物并存。

abstract.text: Schools support families not only through education but also by facilitating daily routines, childcare, and social supports. Disruptions to schooling may therefore have broader effects on family well-being, including parental mental health. We study how school closures affected parental initiation of antidepressant use, as a proxy for mental healthcare needs, using national commercial claims data and a difference-in-differences design that exploits geographic variation in physical school access during the COVID-19 pandemic. Even though antidepressant use declined during the pandemic overall, we find that in zip codes with a high level of school closures, the decline in antidepressant use was approximately 3.8% smaller for both mothers and fathers relative to zip codes that remained largely open during the early months of the pandemic. These effects persisted through 2021, even after in-person instruction resumed. Mothers across most racial groups are affected by specific school-level closures (elementary, middle, and high), while for fathers, there are only small detectable increases with respect to elementary schools. These findings highlight the role of schools in buffering household stress and supporting mental health, and contribute to a broader economics literature that leverages the pandemic as a natural experiment to better understand how institutional disruptions impact health outcomes.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103159.abstractZh: 学校通过教育以及协助日常事务、儿童照料和社会支持等方式为家庭提供支持。因此，学校停课可能会对家庭福祉产生更广泛的影响，包括父母的心理健康。本研究利用全国商业理赔数据，并通过差异-差异设计，探讨了学校停课对父母使用抗抑郁药物行为的影响，以此作为心理健康需求的代理指标。研究发现，尽管在整个疫情期间抗抑郁药物的使用量有所下降，但在学校停课严重的地区，母亲和父亲使用抗抑郁药物的减少幅度分别比疫情期间学校基本开放的地区小约3.8%。这些影响一直持续到2021年，即使线下教学恢复后也是如此。大多数种族群体的母亲受到特定学校级别停课的影响（小学、初中和高中），而父亲的减少幅度则相对较小，主要集中在小学阶段。这些发现强调了学校在缓解家庭压力和支持心理健康方面的作用，并为利用疫情作为自然实验来更好地理解制度性中断如何影响健康结果的经济学研究提供了支持。

abstract.text: Child maltreatment is a pressing concern in the United States, with more than four million children referred to child protective services in 2022. Parental mental health and substance use disorders are strongly associated with child maltreatment. We use administrative data from 2004-2022 to study the relationship between the number of mental health and substance use treatment centers and child maltreatment reports in U.S. counties. Findings show that a 9.6% increase in the supply of treatment centers per county reduces child maltreatment reports by 0.7% and child injury deaths by 0.4%. These findings suggest that improved access to mental health and substance use treatment may help reduce child maltreatment.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103160.abstractZh: 儿童虐待是美国一个紧迫的问题，2022年有超过四百万儿童被转介给儿童保护服务机构。父母的精神健康和物质使用障碍与儿童虐待之间存在密切关联。我们利用2004年至2022年的行政数据，研究美国各县的心理健康和物质使用治疗中心数量与儿童虐待报告之间的关系。研究结果表明，每个县的治疗中心数量增加9.6%，儿童虐待报告减少0.7%，儿童伤害死亡人数减少0.4%。这些发现表明，改善对心理健康和物质使用治疗的获取可能有助于减少儿童虐待。

abstract.text: We study the effects of retirement on cognitive functioning among women aged 63 to 67 by exploiting a German retirement reform that raised the early retirement age for women born after 1951 by three years, from 60 to 63. Our indicators of cognitive functioning are objective cognitive test scores (word recall, semantic fluency, and the Stroop test) from a large biomedical dataset, as well as the diagnosis of cognitive disorders from administrative health insurance claims. We find reductions of around 13% of a standard deviation per year in retirement for measures of fluid intelligence, whereas crystallized intelligence remains unaffected. These estimates reflect the reform-induced shift in retirement duration for compliers around the eligibility cutoff. In contrast, additional years in retirement do not affect diagnosis of cognitive disorder and decrease diagnoses of dementia-related risk factors such as hypertension, depression, and sleep problems. The improvement in health outcomes suggests that cognitive decline is not driven by health deterioration but might possibly be due to reduced cognitive engagement after leaving work.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103161.abstractZh: 我们研究了退休年龄对63至67岁女性认知功能的影响，通过一项德国退休改革来研究这一效应。该改革将1951年后出生的女性的提前退休年龄提高了三年，从60岁提高到63岁。我们的认知功能指标来自一个大型生物医学数据集中的客观认知测试成绩（如单词回忆、语义流畅性和斯特鲁普测试），以及来自行政健康保险索赔中的认知障碍诊断数据。研究发现，退休后，流体智力的标准偏差每年减少约13%，而晶体智力则保持不变。这些估计反映了改革导致的退休时间变化对符合改革条件的人的影响。相比之下，额外的退休年限并不会影响认知障碍的诊断，反而会降低与痴呆症相关的风险因素如高血压、抑郁和睡眠问题的诊断。健康结果的改善表明，认知能力下降并非由健康状况恶化引起，而可能是由于退休后认知活动的减少所致。

abstract.text: This research studies the impact of improving access to treatment for substance use disorders by reducing wait times. Linked individual-level administrative data are used to estimate the impacts of wait times on patients' treatment service utilization and employment. Potential confounding is addressed using an instrumental variables strategy that exploits exogenous variation in wait times generated by local congestion in the healthcare system. We find that longer wait times lead to increased use of treatment services in the focal treatment episode, raised re-entry into subsequent treatment episodes, and lowered employment, consistent with patients' health deteriorating while waiting for treatment. Our calculations suggest that each dollar spent on reducing wait times yields a return of between six and seven dollars. These findings demonstrate that shortening wait times for treatment can significantly reduce the economic and social burdens of addiction.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103162.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了通过缩短治疗等待时间来改善物质使用障碍患者治疗机会的影响。利用相关的个体级行政数据，我们估算了等待时间对患者治疗服务利用和就业的影响。通过使用工具变量策略来应对潜在的混杂因素，该策略利用了医疗系统局部拥堵导致的等待时间的外生变化。我们发现，较长的等待时间会导致治疗服务的使用增加，后续治疗阶段的再入院率上升，同时就业率下降，这与患者在等待治疗期间健康状况恶化的情况一致。我们的计算表明，每花费一美元用于缩短等待时间，可以获得六到七美元的回报。这些发现表明，缩短治疗等待时间可以显著减轻成瘾带来的经济和社会负担。

abstract.text: Despite substantial disability-related costs, participation in public disability benefit programs remains incomplete in many countries. This is particularly the case in low- and middle-income countries where disability programs are relatively new and awareness of eligibility rules may be limited. This paper evaluates whether reducing information frictions can increase enrolment in Vietnam's national disability benefits program. In a randomised controlled trial across 70 rural communes, standardised information about disability benefits was embedded within routine government loudspeaker broadcasts over a five-week period. Using commune-level administrative data observed approximately two years after the intervention, the results show that program enrolment was 9 percent higher in treated communes. The effects are larger among individuals classified with severe disabilities, for whom enrolment increased by 12 percent. Smaller effects are observed among persons with the most severe disabilities, who were likely already well covered by the program. Larger effects are also observed among children who are eligible for higher monthly disability pension amounts. These findings demonstrate that a low-cost and scalable information campaign delivered through existing government communication infrastructure can substantially increase participation in disability benefit programs.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103163.abstractZh: 尽管与残疾相关的成本相当高，但在许多国家，公众参与残疾福利计划的情况仍然不完整。这种情况在低收入和中等收入国家尤为明显，因为这些国家的残疾福利计划相对较新，人们对资格规则的认识可能有限。本文评估了减少信息摩擦是否可以提高越南国家残疾福利计划的参与率。在70个农村社区进行的随机对照试验中，标准化的残疾福利信息被嵌入到政府常规广播中，持续了五周时间。根据干预后约两年的社区级行政数据，结果显示，接受干预的社区的参与率提高了9%。对于被归类为严重残疾的个体来说，参与率提高了12%。而对于那些已经得到较好保障的严重残疾人士来说，效果则较小。对于符合更高月额残疾养老金条件的儿童来说，效果则更为显著。这些发现表明，通过现有的政府传播基础设施开展低成本且可扩展的信息宣传活动，可以显著提高残疾福利计划的参与率。

abstract.text: Social health insurance expansions can affect not only new beneficiaries but also those who remain outside the program. This paper studies these spillovers in the context of Medicare Part D. Increases in insured demand can raise or lower price depending on market conditions: they may increase price when pharmaceutical firms face less elastic demand, but reduce price when demand concentration strengthens bargaining and pass-through in competitive markets. I find that Part D lowered the out-of-pocket unit price paid by Americans under age 65 without prescription drug insurance. Price declines are larger in therapeutic classes more exposed to Part D and in classes with stronger within-class competition, consistent with a demand-concentration channel. Demand increases mainly for generic drugs and among existing users. The implied consumer-surplus gain is roughly $76 per person per year, comprising about $65 from lower price on inframarginal consumption and $11 from additional consumption. Demand responses appear strongest among lower-income, younger, and healthier uninsured individuals, consistent with greater pre-existing non-adherence. Although price fall across several drug classes, demand does not increase significantly for medications associated with greater overuse in the United States, suggesting potentially positive net health spillovers.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103164.abstractZh: 社会健康保险扩围不仅会影响新的受益人，也会影响那些仍不在保险计划范围内的人员。本文研究了在Medicare Part D背景下这些溢出效应。保险需求的增加可能会根据市场状况导致价格上升或下降：当制药公司面临的需求弹性较低时，价格可能会上升；而在竞争市场中，需求集中使得议价能力和价格传递性增强时，价格可能会下降。我发现，Part D降低了65岁以下没有处方药保险的人需支付的自付单位价格。在更容易受到Part D影响的治疗类别中，以及竞争较为激烈的类别中，价格下降幅度更大，这与需求集中的机制相符。需求增加主要出现在仿制药和现有用户中。由此带来的消费者 surplus 收益约为每人每年76美元，其中约65美元来自次边际消费价格的降低，11美元来自额外消费。需求反应在低收入、年轻且健康状况较好的无保险人群中最为明显，这与之前存在的非依从性问题相符。尽管多个药物类别的价格有所下降，但与美国过度使用相关的药物需求并没有显著增加，这表明可能存在积极的净健康溢出效应。

abstract.text: I document that households in the United States are more likely to choose health plans offered by the husband's employer than the wife's. This gap may reflect gender disparities in employment status, plan quality, or an inherent gender effect. Using a novel identification strategy that holds employment status and plan quality fixed, I find that the gender effect increases the probability of selecting the husband's plan by 6.3 percentage points.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103165.abstractZh: 我的研究指出，美国的家庭更倾向于选择丈夫所在雇主提供的健康计划，而不是妻子所在雇主提供的计划。这种差异可能反映了就业状况、计划质量方面的性别差异，或者是一种固有的性别效应。通过一种创新的识别策略，在假设就业状况和计划质量不变的情况下，我发现性别效应使得选择丈夫所在雇主计划的几率增加了6.3个百分点。

abstract.text: We estimate the short-term cognitive effects of fine particulate matter (PM 2.5 ) exposure using novel exposure data collected during cognitive testing in Kenya. Unlike most existing studies that rely on satellite-based or fixed monitoring station data, we measure highly localized ambient pollution using portable monitors deployed at cognitive testing sites and link these readings directly to Harmonized Cognitive Assessment Protocol (HCAP) scores. Higher PM 2.5 exposure during testing is associated with lower cognitive performance, particularly in executive function, memory, and visuospatial tasks. Binned exposure models suggest a monotonic pattern, with more negative estimates at higher exposure levels. Notably, effects are significantly larger among more educated individuals, possibly due to greater task demands or lower chronic exposure that limits physiological adaptation. Given that cognitive impairment is evident even at PM 2.5 levels below Kenya's mean annual regulatory threshold of 35μg/m 3 , the findings suggest that short-term exposure may impose underappreciated human capital costs that current regulatory standards fail to mitigate. The results highlight the potential cognitive and economic returns to interventions that reduce air pollution exposures in low-resource settings.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103166.abstractZh: 我们利用在肯尼亚进行认知测试期间收集的新颖暴露数据，估算了细颗粒物（PM 2.5）暴露对短期认知影响的效应。与大多数依赖卫星监测或固定监测站数据的现有研究不同，我们通过在认知测试现场部署便携式监测设备来测量高度局部化的环境污染，并将这些监测数据直接与《协调认知评估协议》（HCAP）得分相关联。测试期间较高的PM 2.5暴露水平与较低的认知表现相关，尤其是在执行功能、记忆和视觉空间任务方面。分箱暴露模型显示出一个单调的趋势，即暴露水平越高，影响越显著。值得注意的是，受教育程度较高的个体所受影响更为严重，这可能是由于任务要求更高或长期暴露限制生理适应的缘故。鉴于即使在肯尼亚年均监管阈值35μg/m³以下的PM 2.5水平下，认知障碍也依然存在，这些发现表明短期暴露可能会带来被低估的人力资本成本，而当前的监管标准未能有效缓解这一问题。研究结果强调了在资源匮乏的环境中，减少空气污染暴露的干预措施可能带来的潜在认知和经济效益。

abstract.text: We examine the financial consequences of the 2007 California Fair Pricing Law, which places a price ceiling on hospital bills for financially vulnerable individuals. Using cross-sectional variation in exposure to the law, proxied by county-level uninsured rates, we estimate its impact on individual financial outcomes. We find that the law reduces the likelihood of incurring non-medical debt in collections and the number of non-medical accounts in collections. In addition, we find evidence that credit scores increased and suggestive evidence that the number of delinquent accounts decreased for individuals in more exposed counties. Our results suggest hospital billing regulations can improve targeted individuals' financial outcomes.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103173.abstractZh: 我们研究了2007年加州公平定价法案的财务后果，该法案为经济困难的人群设定了医院账单的价格上限。通过以县级无保险率为指标来衡量法律实施后的差异，我们评估了该法律对个体财务结果的影响。研究发现，该法律降低了个人因债务催收而承担非医疗债务的可能性，以及处于催收中的非医疗账户数量。此外，我们还发现，在更易受到法律影响的县中，个人的信用评分有所提高，且逾期账户数量也有所减少。我们的结果表明，医院计费规定能够改善特定群体的财务状况。

abstract.text: This paper studies the health consequences of administrative centralization in healthcare, focusing on the consolidation of Local Health Authorities (LHAs) within the Italian National Health Service. This type of reform fits within a broader set of cost-containment efforts aimed at reducing administrative expenditures and exploiting economies of scale. In the Italian case, the reform centralized governance and expanded the scale of health administration, creating authorities with substantially larger catchment areas and shifting decision-making to more heterogeneous jurisdictions. Such changes may affect the responsiveness of healthcare provision to local needs, the coordination of service delivery, and access to care. Using an event-study Difference-in-Differences design, we estimate the policy's impact on municipal mortality rates, accounting for heterogeneous treatment effects and co-occurring fiscal adjustment policies. We find a significant increase in mortality starting four years after implementation, with an average treatment effect on the treated of 2.1%. The effects are concentrated in municipalities belonging to absorbed LHAs and in those exposed to mergers involving relatively large pre-reform LHAs and substantial post-merger expansions in catchment areas; they are also unevenly distributed, creating new vulnerable areas. Welfare estimates based on life-years lost indicate that the monetary costs of increased mortality exceed plausible administrative savings by roughly an order of magnitude.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103174.abstractZh: 本文研究了行政集权在医疗保健领域的健康影响，重点关注意大利国家卫生服务体系中地方卫生当局的整合。这种改革属于旨在减少行政开支和发挥规模经济效应的更广泛成本控制措施的一部分。在意大利案例中，该改革实现了治理的集中化，并扩大了卫生管理的规模，形成了管辖范围大幅扩大的当局，同时决策权转移到了更多不同的管辖区域。这些变化可能会影响医疗保健服务的响应能力、服务提供的协调以及就医的获取。通过事件研究法中的差异分解设计，我们评估了该政策对市政死亡率的影响，同时考虑了异质性处理效应和同时实施的财政调整政策。研究发现，实施后的四年里，死亡率显著上升，对受影响的地区而言，平均处理效应为2.1%。这些影响主要集中在那些被整合进地方卫生当局的市镇，以及那些经历了较大规模合并的市镇，这些市镇在合并后管辖范围显著扩大；此外，这些影响分布不均，导致新的脆弱区域出现。基于生命年损失的福利评估表明，因死亡率增加而产生的货币成本大约比预期的行政节省高出一个数量级。

abstract.text: We study how individuals' migration decisions during a pandemic interact with the spatial allocation of hospital resources, characterizing both the laissez-faire equilibrium and the planner's allocation in closed form. Susceptible individuals leave high-infection cities while infected individuals move toward better-resourced ones, but these private decisions diverge from the planner's along two dimensions. First, the migration of infected agents toward susceptible-rich destinations raises transmission risk, a contagion externality the planner internalizes by restricting such flows. Second, the migration of infected agents toward better-resourced cities relieves hospital congestion at the epicenter, a congestion externality the planner internalizes by encouraging such flows. The two externalities work in opposite directions, and our comparative statics show when each dominates. The framework explains a cross-country pattern that standard misallocation theory cannot: during COVID-19, countries with greater regional dispersion in mortality tended to have lower aggregate mortality. This pattern arises naturally once contagion and endogenous mobility are added to a standard misallocation framework. More broadly, the analysis identifies a setting in which spatial dispersion can raise rather than reduce welfare, reversing the sign of the standard misallocation prescription.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103175.abstractZh: 我们研究了在疫情期间个人迁移决策如何与医院资源的空间分配相互作用，以封闭形式描述了自由放任均衡和规划者的分配方案。易感个体会离开高感染率的城市，而感染个体则倾向于前往资源更丰富的地区，但这些私人决策在两个方面与规划者的决策存在差异。首先，感染个体向易感人群聚集较多的地区迁移会增加传播风险，这种传染外部性需要规划者通过限制此类流动来内部化。其次，感染个体向资源更丰富的城市迁移可以缓解疫情中心的医院拥堵问题，这种拥堵外部性也需要规划者通过鼓励此类流动来内部化。这两种外部性作用方向相反，我们的比较静态分析揭示了每种外部性何时占主导地位。该框架解释了一种标准错误分配理论无法解释的现象：在COVID-19疫情期间，地区间死亡率分布更分散的国家往往具有更低的整体死亡率。一旦将传染效应和内生性迁移因素纳入标准错误分配框架，这种现象就自然出现了。更广泛地说，该分析揭示了一种情境，在这种情境下，空间分散可能会提高而不是降低福利水平，从而逆转了标准错误分配理论的建议。

abstract.text: This paper examines the relationship between union membership and deaths of despair. Using state-level variation in the timing of the adoption of right-to-work laws as a natural experiment, I show that right-to-work laws are associated with a decline in union membership and an increase in deaths of despair. Two-way fixed-effects (TWFE) difference-in-differences (DiD) estimates suggest that the adoption of a right-to-work law is associated with a 2.6 percentage point reduction in union membership and an increase in deaths of despair mortality of 13 additional persons per 100,000, implying there are approximately 7.5 additional deaths of despair for every 1,000 workers who lose union membership. An analysis of mechanisms suggests the increase in mortality is largely driven by increased opioid usage and a concomitant increase in overdose deaths. I support the TWFE results with estimates from two alternative estimators robust to concerns about treatment effect heterogeneity and variation in treatment timing. Estimates from the Callaway and Sant'Anna (2021) estimator and the Borusyak et al. (2024) estimator support the TWFE findings: right-to-work laws reduce union membership and increase deaths of despair.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103176.abstractZh: 本文探讨了工会会员数与绝望死亡之间的关系。通过以各州在采用自由工作法的时间上的差异作为自然实验，我发现自由工作法与工会会员数的减少以及绝望死亡人数的增加有关。双向固定效应（TWFE）差异估计表明，采用自由工作法会导致工会会员数减少2.6个百分点，同时每10万人中绝望死亡人数增加13人，这意味着每1000名失去工会会员的工人，大约有7.5人因此死亡。机制分析表明，死亡率的增加主要源于阿片类药物使用的增加以及过量死亡人数的相应增加。我通过两种替代估计方法支持了TWFE的结果，这两种方法能够克服治疗效果异质性和治疗时间变化带来的问题。Callaway和Sant'Anna（2021年）以及Borusyak等人（2024年）的估计方法也支持了TWFE的发现：自由工作法减少了工会会员数，并增加了绝望死亡人数。

abstract.text: Determining the value of different post-acute care settings for clinically similar patients is important for providers and payers. This study examines the causal effect of post-acute care (PAC) setting on Medicare spending and short-term patient outcomes among beneficiaries discharged from hospitals following treatment for stroke or congestive heart failure (CHF). Using 2013-2017 Medicare claims data, we implement an instrumental variable strategy that exploits daily variation in skilled nursing facility (SNF) bed occupancy at the hospital service area level to estimate the local average treatment effect of SNF versus home health agency (HHA) care. Our findings reveal no significant differences, on average, in 30-day mortality or rehospitalization rates between SNF and HHA care among stroke and CHF patients. However, the 95% confidence intervals do not exclude clinically meaningful reductions in 30-day mortality. Meanwhile, SNF care is associated with approximately $4700 more in Medicare spending per PAC episode. The spending gap is larger in markets with more constrained SNF capacity, particularly in states with Certificate of Need regulations, rural areas, and low-income neighborhoods. However, we do not detect statistically significant differences in short-term health outcomes across these markets on average, suggesting that supply constraints may amplify the spending implications of SNF use while the relationship between PAC setting and short-term clinical outcomes remains uncertain. These findings highlight the importance of aligning PAC discharge decisions with both clinical needs and local capacity considerations, particularly under value-based payment models.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103177.abstractZh: 确定不同康复护理环境对临床相似患者的价值对于医疗服务提供者和支付方来说非常重要。本研究探讨了康复护理环境对Medicare支出以及中风或充血性心力衰竭患者出院后短期疗效的因果效应。利用2013-2017年的Medicare索赔数据，我们采用了一种工具变量策略，利用医院服务区域熟练护理设施床位占用率的日变化来估计熟练护理设施与家庭健康机构护理之间的局部平均治疗效果。研究发现，中风和充血性心力衰竭患者在熟练护理设施和家庭健康机构护理之间的30天死亡率或再次住院率方面没有显著差异。然而，95%的置信区间并未排除30天死亡率有临床意义的降低。同时，熟练护理设施护理每一次康复护理事件会导致Medicare支出增加约4700美元。在熟练护理设施能力受限的市场中，这种支出差距更大，尤其是在有需求认证规定的州、农村地区以及低收入社区。然而，我们并未发现这些市场之间短期健康结果存在统计学上的显著差异，这表明供应限制可能会加剧熟练护理设施使用的支出影响，而康复护理环境与短期临床结果之间的关系仍不确定。这些发现强调了在价值基础支付模式下，将康复护理出院决策与临床需求和当地能力因素相结合的重要性。
