abstract.text: After a pause in statutory minimum wage increases during the Great Recession, several states increased their minimum wages, including increases as large as 60% over just a few years. Using a triple difference-in-differences framework and data on the universe of births from 2010 to 2019, this study investigates how recent minimum wage hikes affected birth outcomes. We first document sizeable negative impacts of minimum wage policy on the labor supply and economic well-being of females aged 16-44. We then document small adverse effects on birth outcomes, estimating that minimum wage increases led to lower birthweight, fewer normal birthweight births, and more small for gestational age births. These findings generally contrast with an earlier literature relying primarily on much smaller minimum wage increases which showed more evidence of positive impacts on birth outcomes.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103184.abstractZh: 在大衰退期间，法定最低工资增长出现了一段时间的中断，但随后多个州提高了最低工资标准，有些州的增幅甚至达到了60%。本研究采用三重差异框架，并基于2010至2019年的出生数据，探讨了近期最低工资上调对出生结果的影响。我们首先发现，最低工资政策对16-44岁女性的劳动力供应和经济福祉产生了显著的负面影响。随后，我们发现最低工资上调对出生结果的影响较小，估计最低工资的提高导致了较低的出生体重、较少的正常出生体重婴儿以及更多小于胎龄的婴儿。这些发现与早期文献中的研究结果不同，后者主要基于较低幅度的最低工资上调，这些文献显示最低工资上调对出生结果有更多的积极影响。

abstract.text: This paper explores the relationships between overall diet quality and attitudes toward risk and time using a general population survey. We combine a food frequency questionnaire and a choice-based preference module to elicit individual risk and time preferences. The online questionnaire was administered to a socioeconomic panel representative of the French population. We show that risk and time preferences are associated with individual heterogeneity in key aspects of diet quality, a result that holds across a wide range of robustness checks. Using a hierarchical Bayes framework, we jointly estimate individual risk aversion and impatience parameters and show that associations hold for both model-free and structural estimates of risk and time preferences. We further show that these associations account for a substantial share of the heterogeneity in dietary outcomes beyond sociodemographic controls. Risk and time preferences contribute to both the income-diet-quality and education-diet-quality gradients, but in opposite directions, resulting in a limited net contribution to explaining socioeconomic inequalities in diet quality.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103185.abstractZh: 本文通过一项针对普通人群的调查，探讨了整体饮食质量与对风险和时间的态度之间的关系。我们结合食物频率问卷和基于选择的偏好模块来收集个体对风险和时间的偏好信息。在线问卷的受访者来自一个代表法国人口的社会经济样本群体。研究发现，风险和时间的偏好与个体在饮食质量关键方面的差异相关，这一结果在广泛的稳健性检验中均得到验证。利用分层贝叶斯框架，我们联合估计了个体对风险的厌恶程度和时间紧迫性参数，并发现这些关联在模型自由估计和结构估计中均成立。进一步研究表明，这些关联在排除社会人口学因素后，仍能解释饮食结果中的大部分个体差异。风险和时间的偏好对收入-饮食质量和教育-饮食质量的梯度都有贡献，但方向相反，因此它们在解释社会经济不平等中的饮食质量方面的作用有限。

abstract.text: Using rich survey data for England, we investigate whether providing parents with information about the weight status of their children reduces children's weight and improves health behaviors, or whether it has adverse effects. We exploit the timing of survey interview compared to the timing of sending out weight reports to parents in a difference-in-differences framework. Our analysis does not reveal the intended effects on body weight or health behaviors. Instead, we find adverse effects for children with overweight that are concentrated in disadvantaged families and driven by increases in breakfast skipping and feeling tired and unhappy at school.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103186.abstractZh: 我们利用英格兰的丰富调查数据，研究向父母提供孩子体重信息是否有助于减少孩子的体重并改善健康行为，或者是否会产生负面影响。我们通过比较调查访谈的时间与向父母发送体重报告的时间，采用差异-差异框架进行分析。我们的分析并未显示出对体重或健康行为的预期影响。相反，我们发现，对于超重儿童来说，这种信息传递反而产生了负面影响，这些影响主要集中在弱势家庭中，表现为早餐减少以及在学校感到疲倦和不快乐。

abstract.text: Choosing a physician who can deliver high-quality care at a reasonable cost can improve health outcomes and reduce spending on healthcare. I study a disclosure program that classifies physicians based on quality and cost. I use a regression discontinuity design and find that physicians who score higher on both quality and cost effectiveness see 38% more new patients, and that younger patients are more responsive than older patients. Evaluating claims of patients who switch physicians following physician exit, I find that middle-aged patients experience larger reductions in spending than younger patients when switching to higher-quality, lower-cost physicians.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103187.abstractZh: 选择能够以合理价格提供高质量医疗服务的医生，可以改善健康结果并减少医疗支出。我研究了一个基于质量和成本对医生进行分类的披露计划。通过回归连续设计分析发现，在质量和成本效益方面得分较高的医生，能够吸引多38%的新患者，而且年轻患者比年长患者更愿意接受医疗服务。在评估患者更换医生后的费用变化时，我发现中年患者在转向更高质量、更低成本的医生后，支出减少幅度比年轻患者更大。

abstract.text: The Affordable Care Act (ACA) significantly expanded health insurance in the United States, but its impact has varied across time and states. We assess the law's heterogeneous impacts over the three presidential administrations since its enactment (between 2013 and 2023), as well as across states with different levels of implementation of the law. We focus on the law's Medicaid expansion and Marketplace subsidies, including the enhanced subsidies under the American Rescue Plan of 2021 (ARP). We use national household survey data and a triple-difference design-leveraging variation by time, place, and income-to identify the coverage impacts of the key components of the law. We find that about 50% of ACA-related coverage gains between 2013 and 2023 came from Marketplace subsidies-about 40% from the original ACA subsidies and 10% from the ARP enhancements-while the remaining half were due to Medicaid, including from the "welcome mat" effect. Coverage gains differed substantially across presidential administrations, with Marketplace subsidies in particular proving more effective under Presidents Obama and Biden than under President Trump. The same subsidy amount was >1.5 times as effective in states running their own state-based Marketplaces than in states relying on the federal Marketplace, and this result persists even after accounting for states' political ideology. Our findings highlight that while the ACA's explicit economic features drive coverage gains, their effectiveness can be substantially enhanced or hindered through federal and state implementation.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103188.abstractZh: 《平价医疗法案》显著扩大了美国的健康保险覆盖范围，但其影响在不同时间和州之间存在差异。我们评估了该法案在三个总统任期内（2013年至2023年）以及实施程度不同的州之间的异质影响。我们重点关注该法案的医疗补助扩展和市场补贴措施，包括2021年《美国救援计划》中的增强补贴。我们利用全国家庭调查数据和三重差异设计，通过时间、地点和收入差异来识别该法案关键组成部分对覆盖范围的影響。研究发现，2013年至2023年间，约50%的《平价医疗法案》相关覆盖增益来自市场补贴——其中约40%来自最初的《平价医疗法案》补贴，10%来自《美国救援计划》的增强补贴——而剩余的一半则来自医疗补助，包括“欢迎垫效应”。各总统任期的覆盖增益存在显著差异，特别是在奥巴马和拜登总统任期内，市场补贴的效果优于特朗普总统任期。同样的补贴金额，在拥有自己州级市场的州中，其效果比依赖联邦市场的州高出1.5倍以上，即使考虑到各州的政治意识形态，这一结果仍然成立。我们的研究指出，虽然《平价医疗法案》的明确经济特征推动了覆盖增益，但其效果可以通过联邦和州的实施措施得到显著增强或阻碍。

abstract.text: Many transfer programs target women based on evidence that mothers are more likely than fathers to allocate resources toward child welfare. However, findings on gendered impacts remain mixed-likely because parental knowledge, preferences, and household decision-making roles differ across contexts. In this study, we experimentally vary the intrahousehold informational context itself through a randomized controlled trial in rural Ethiopia. Specifically, employing a factorial design, we cross-randomize two key dimensions: (1) which parent receives nutrition behavior change communication (BCC) - neither, mother only, or both; and (2) which parent receives a household food voucher - mother or father. We find that, pooled across settings in which fathers do not receive BCC, vouchers assigned to mothers generate larger improvements in child-feeding practices than vouchers assigned to fathers. The largest effects occur when mothers receive both BCC and the voucher. This maternal advantage attenuates and is no longer detectable when fathers also receive BCC. We provide suggestive evidence that when mothers have both a knowledge advantage and control over resources, they are better able to mobilize greater intrahousehold support. These findings highlight the importance of accounting for intrahousehold contexts, not just recipient gender, when designing nutrition interventions.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103189.abstractZh: 许多转移项目以女性为对象，这一做法基于这样的证据：母亲比父亲更有可能将资源用于儿童福利。然而，关于性别影响的发现仍然参差不齐——这可能是因为不同情境下父母的知识、偏好以及家庭决策角色存在差异。在这项研究中，我们通过一项在埃塞俄比亚农村进行的随机对照试验，实验性地改变了家庭内部的信息环境。具体来说，我们采用了因子设计，随机化了两个关键维度：（1）哪个父母会收到营养行为改变宣传——不接收、仅母亲接收或两者都接收；（2）哪个父母会收到家庭食品券——母亲还是父亲。我们发现，在父亲不接收营养行为改变宣传的情况下，分配给母亲的食品券能带来更大的儿童喂养行为改善效果，而分配给父亲的食品券则效果较弱。当母亲同时收到营养行为改变宣传和食品券时，这种优势最为明显。当父亲也收到营养行为改变宣传时，这种优势会减弱，甚至不再明显。我们的研究提供了一些启示：当母亲既拥有知识优势又能够控制资源时，她们更能动员更多的家庭内部支持。这些发现强调了在设计营养干预措施时，不仅要考虑接受者的性别，还要考虑家庭内部的环境因素。

abstract.text: Policymakers at both the state and federal levels have promoted restrictions on online sales of electronic nicotine delivery systems (ENDS) as an important tool for reducing youth vaping. This study provides the first comprehensive evaluation of statewide online ENDS sales restrictions and their effects on youth and young adult tobacco-related behaviors. Using data from four nationally representative datasets-the Monitoring the Future survey, the State and Combined Youth Risk Behavior Surveillance System surveys, the Population Assessment of Tobacco and Health study, and the Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System survey-and a generalized difference-in-differences framework, we examine the effects of these policies on product acquisition, ENDS use, and related tobacco outcomes. We find that online sales restrictions substantially reduce online purchases of ENDS products, indicating that the policies affect the targeted channel of access. Some evidence suggests substitution to social sources but also a decrease in obtaining ENDS products from "other" sources such as the black market. We find no evidence that these laws reduce overall youth ENDS use, frequent use, initiation, or cigarette smoking. These null results are consistent with online purchasing accounting for a small share of youth ENDS acquisition even prior to policy adoption. Taken together, the results suggest that restricting online sales can successfully limit a specific access channel without producing large changes in overall patterns of ENDS use.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103190.abstractZh: 国家和联邦层面的政策制定者一直提倡对电子尼古丁输送系统的在线销售进行限制，认为这是减少青少年使用电子烟的有效手段。本研究首次对全州范围内的在线电子尼古丁输送系统销售限制及其对青少年和年轻成人烟草相关行为的影响进行了全面评估。通过利用四个具有全国代表性的数据集——《未来监测调查》、《州级及综合青少年风险行为监测系统调查》、《烟草与健康人口评估研究》以及《行为风险因素监测系统调查》的数据，并采用广义差异-差异框架，我们研究了这些政策对产品获取、电子尼古丁输送系统使用及相关烟草行为的影响。研究发现，在线销售限制显著减少了电子尼古丁输送系统产品的在线购买行为，表明这些政策影响了特定的获取渠道。部分证据表明，青少年更倾向于从社交渠道获取产品，但从“其他”渠道如黑市获取电子尼古丁输送系统产品的行为有所减少。我们没有发现这些法律能够减少青少年的整体电子尼古丁输送系统使用量、频繁使用频率、初次使用次数或吸烟行为。这些无显著性结果表明，即使在实施政策之前，在线购买在青少年电子尼古丁输送系统获取中所占的比例也很小。综合来看，这些结果表明，限制在线销售可以成功限制某一特定获取渠道，而不会对电子尼古丁输送系统使用的整体模式产生重大影响。

abstract.text: Direct-to-consumer advertising is pervasive in US healthcare markets, but little evidence exists on the effects of advertising by hospitals, second only to drug manufacturers in medical marketing. Advertising may help facilities increase market share by stealing existing patients, expanding the market for hospital care, or both. Regardless, it has important public finance implications due to the large sums of taxpayer funds spent by federal and state governments to subsidize hospital operations and finance care through public insurance programs. This paper provides the first causal evidence on the market expansion effects of hospital advertising. To obtain causal estimates, we leverage the fact that spikes in political advertising significantly crowd out hospital advertising in the same market, motivating an instrumental variables design. Using claims data on the universe of Traditional Medicare beneficiaries, we find that advertising expands aggregate patient volume and spending on inpatient care - though to a modest degree (implied elasticities are 0.06 and 0.05, respectively). Although the overall effect of advertising on hospital outpatient care is small and imprecise, for-profit hospitals obtain higher outpatient Medicare volume and revenue.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103191.abstractZh: 直接面向消费者的广告在美国医疗市场中非常普遍，但关于医院广告效果的研究却很少，其影响力仅次于药品制造商在医疗营销领域的表现。广告可能有助于医疗机构通过吸引现有患者来增加市场份额，或者同时实现市场扩展。不过，由于联邦和州政府花费大量资金补贴医院运营并通过公共保险计划为医疗提供资金，因此这一行为对公共财政有着重要的影响。本文首次提供了关于医院广告对市场扩展效果的因果证据。为了获得这些因果估计，我们利用了政治广告的激增会显著挤占同一市场中的医院广告这一事实，从而设计了工具变量模型。通过对传统医疗保险受益人相关的数据进行分析，我们发现广告确实增加了患者数量和住院治疗的支出——尽管这种影响较为有限（相应的弹性系数分别为0.06和0.05）。虽然广告对医院门诊服务的总体影响较小且不够精确，但营利性医院能够获得更多的门诊医疗保险业务量和收入。

abstract.text: There is increasing evidence on regional variations in US Medicare health care utilization based on older patients who move. Yet moving for the elderly population is typically endogenous, and evidence is limited for younger populations. In this paper, we harness the mandatory migration of military personnel to estimate supply and demand factors in a system of care for younger enrollees in which military physicians are salaried and copayments and deductibles are negligible. Our preferred estimates imply that supply effects explain between one-half and two-thirds of overall regional variation. These variations cannot be explained by differences in quality of care, but appear consistent with location-specific differences in physician beliefs. We are grateful for financial support from the Department of Defense (DoD) (Award HT94022210005) and for very helpful comments from Amy Finkelstein, Robert Kaestner, Edward Norton, two anonymous reviewers, and the editor. The contents, views or opinions expressed in this publication or presentation are those of the author(s) and do not necessarily reflect official policy or position of Uniformed Services University of the Health Sciences, the DoD, or Departments of the Army, Navy, or Air Force. Mention of trade names, commercial products, or organizations does not imply endorsement by the U.S. Government.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103192.abstractZh: 越来越多的证据表明，基于老年患者的迁移，美国医疗保险医疗服务的利用在地区之间存在差异。然而，老年人的迁移通常是内生的现象，而对于年轻人群的证据则较为有限。在本文中，我们利用军事人员的强制性迁移来估算年轻参保者的医疗体系中供需因素，其中军事医生获得固定薪酬，且共付额和免赔额可以忽略不计。我们的估算结果显示，供应因素可以解释整体地区差异的半数到三分之二。这些差异无法用医疗质量的差异来解释，但似乎与医生对地理位置的特定看法一致。我们感谢国防部提供的资金支持（项目编号HT94022210005），并感谢Amy Finkelstein、Robert Kaestner、Edward Norton以及两位匿名审稿人的宝贵意见，同时也感谢编辑的协助。本出版物或演讲中表达的内容、观点或意见均为作者个人观点，并不一定反映健康科学大学、国防部或陆军、海军及空军部门的官方政策或立场。提及商标、商业产品或组织并不意味着美国政府对其的认可。

abstract.text: We evaluated both the demand for and impact of a prevention tool against malaria that requires repeated purchase and overcomes the limits of mosquito bed nets. We used a randomized experiment to examine the effects of subsidies for a mosquito repellent ointment that protects against mosquito bites and malaria on product use and malaria cases in Burkina Faso. Around 3100 households were randomly allocated to one of the three experimental groups defined by level of subsidy: 0, 50 or 100%. Subsidies strongly and significantly increase the probability of acquiring a jar of mosquito repellent ointment and using it regularly during the rainy season. We find no substitution with bed nets, but a strong effect on the use of mosquito coils. The treatment effects on usage are heterogeneous, including more positive outcomes for young children as reported by their caregiver. The impact on use continues even after the end of the subsidy, with effects on demand and willingness to pay elicited through a Becker-DeGroot-Marschak approach eight months after the end of the intervention. Our intervention induces a significant reduction in declared malaria occurrence during the rainy season, but no effect at the very end of the rainy season when blood tests were taken. The seemingly discrepancy will be partly explained by timing and sample size.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103193.abstractZh: 我们评估了针对疟疾的预防性工具的需求及其影响，这种工具需要反复购买，并且可以克服蚊帐的局限性。我们通过随机实验来研究对蚊咬和疟疾有防护作用的驱蚊膏的补贴对布基纳法索地区产品使用率和疟疾病例的影响。大约3100户家庭被随机分配到三个实验组之一，补贴水平分别为0、50或100%。补贴显著增加了购买驱蚊膏并在雨季定期使用的可能性。我们没有发现驱蚊膏与蚊帐之间存在替代关系，但对其使用效果有显著影响，尤其是对幼儿的使用效果。补贴结束后，这种使用效果仍然持续，通过Becker-DeGroot-Marschak方法在干预结束八个月后仍能观察到需求变化和支付意愿的变化。我们的干预措施显著减少了雨季期间疟疾病例的申报数量，但在雨季末期进行血液检测时则没有效果。这种看似矛盾的现象部分可以通过时间和样本量来解释。

abstract.text: Motivated by the high prices of branded/patented pharmaceuticals in many parts of the world, this paper analyzes price regulations in a two-country (home and foreign) model where a single home firm serves both markets and its R&D investment determines product quality. We study two types of price regulations: direct price controls (PCs) and external reference pricing (ERP) under which the price that the firm is permitted to charge locally depends upon its price abroad. We show that although ERP undermines R&D incentives, its implementation can raise home welfare. However, home's optimal ERP policy is too restrictive from a joint welfare perspective. Furthermore, if the foreign market is subject to a PC, home prefers ERP to a PC due to strategic considerations that come into play due to the international price linkage created by ERP.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103195.abstractZh: 本文基于全球许多地区品牌/专利药品价格高昂的问题，分析了一个双国模型中的价格管制机制。在该模型中，一家本土企业同时服务于两个市场，其研发投资决定了产品的质量。我们研究了两种类型的价格管制措施：直接价格管制和外部参考定价。在外部参考定价下，企业在本土可以收取的价格取决于其在国外的价格。研究表明，尽管外部参考定价会削弱研发激励，但其实施仍可以提高本土的福利水平。然而，从整体福利的角度来看，本土企业的最优外部参考定价政策过于严格。此外，如果国外市场受到直接价格管制的约束，由于外部参考定价带来的国际价格联动效应，本土企业更倾向于采用外部参考定价而非直接价格管制。

abstract.text: High temperatures have been found to worsen mental health, but evidence from low- and middle-income countries remains scarce, where adaptive capacity is limited. Using nationwide weekly administrative data covering the entire population and a survey series representative of urban Mexico, we estimate the effects of heat on self-reported well-being, emergency department visits for mental illness, and suicide within a unified empirical design. Comparing hotter and cooler weeks across years within the same locations and calendar week, we find that one extra day above 30 °C (86 °F) increases suicides by 5% and emergency department visits for mental illness by 2.4%. Self-reported mental well-being also deteriorates at high temperatures, although responses vary across measures. We find that the response to temperature is concentrated in particular diagnosis and demographic groups and is attenuated in municipalities with greater mental health service availability. Our results indicate that heat imposes mental health burdens from reduced well-being to clinical demand and mortality, highlighting mental health as a key component of climate damages and a priority for climate-health policy.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2026.103196.abstractZh: 既有研究发现高温损害心理健康，但适应能力较弱的中低收入国家仍缺乏证据。我们结合覆盖墨西哥全国人口的周度行政数据和具有城市人口代表性的一系列调查，在同一实证框架下估计高温对自报福祉、精神疾病急诊就诊和自杀的影响。我们在同一地点、同一日历周内比较不同年份气温较高和较低的周次。气温超过 30°C 的天数每增加一天，自杀人数增加 5%，精神疾病急诊就诊量增加 2.4%。自报心理福祉也随高温恶化，不过不同指标反映的变化有所不同。影响集中在部分诊断类别和人口群体，心理健康服务更容易获得的市镇所受影响较小。高温造成的心理健康负担涉及主观福祉、临床服务需求和死亡。衡量气候损失及制定气候与健康政策时，应当将心理健康纳入考虑。

abstract.text: Background: Hospital consolidation has intensified globally, but evidence regarding its association with clinical quality remains mixed, particularly in universal healthcare systems with regulated prices. We assessed whether hospital acquisitions were associated with changes in 30-day excess mortality for acute myocardial infarction (AMI) and stroke. Methods: This quasi-experimental cohort study used a staggered difference-in-differences design analyzing German hospitals providing AMI or stroke care (2009-2019). We compared performance changes three years pre- and post-acquisition between acquired hospitals (n = 125 for AMI; n = 121 for stroke) and control hospitals with stable ownership (n = 821 for AMI; n = 830 for stroke). Primary outcomes were 30-day excess mortality rates. Secondary outcomes included medical staffing intensity and the provision of cardiac catheterization laboratories and stroke units. Findings: Acquisition was associated with a 1.24 percentage-point (pp) decline in excess 30-day AMI mortality within three years (95% CI -2.04 to -0.44; p = 0.002). This improvement coincided with a 6.63 pp increase in the probability of providing cardiac catheterization laboratories (0.75 to 12.52; p = 0.03). For stroke, the association with excess 30-day mortality indicated a clinically relevant but statistically insignificant 0.43 pp decline (-1.38 to 0.53; p = 0.44). Nurse staffing intensity transiently increased during the acquisition year for both AMI and stroke. Interpretation: In a regulated, fixed-price system, acquisitions were significantly associated with reduced AMI mortality and expanded interventional infrastructure. Findings suggest consolidation can improve clinical quality by unlocking capital for life-saving investments. While capital-intensive conditions like AMI benefit rapidly, complex care pathways like stroke likely require additional clinical integration strategies. Funding: German Research Foundation.

10.1016/j.lanepe.2026.101788.abstractZh:
背景：全球范围内医院合并现象日益加剧，但关于其与临床质量关联性的证据仍不一致，尤其是在价格受监管的全民医疗体系中。我们研究了医院合并是否会导致急性心肌梗塞（AMI）和中风患者30天超额死亡率的变化。  
方法：这项准实验性队列研究采用了分阶段差异设计，分析了2009至2019年间提供AMI或中风治疗的德国医院。我们比较了合并前后三年内被合并医院（AMI组125家，中风组121家）与所有权稳定的对照医院（AMI组821家，中风组830家）的表现变化。主要研究结果是30天超额死亡率。次要结果包括医疗人员配置强度以及心脏导管实验室和中风病房的设置情况。  
研究结果：合并后三年内，AMI患者30天超额死亡率下降了1.24个百分点（95%置信区间：-2.04至-0.44；p=0.002）。这一改善同时伴随着提供心脏导管实验室的可能性增加了6.63个百分点（0.75至12.52；p=0.03）。对于中风而言，30天超额死亡率的下降幅度为0.43个百分点（-1.38至0.53；p=0.44），但这一差异在统计学上并不显著。在合并当年，AMI和中风病房的护士配置强度均有所上升。  
结论：在价格受监管且固定价格的体系中，医院合并显著降低了AMI死亡率，并扩大了介入治疗基础设施。研究结果表明，合并可以通过释放资本来实现对救命投资的改善，从而提高临床质量。虽然像AMI这样的资本密集型措施能够迅速带来效益，但像中风这样的复杂护理需求可能需要额外的临床整合策略。资金来源：德国研究基金会。

abstract.text: Despite targeted policy interventions, patients within China's hierarchical healthcare system persistently opt for tertiary hospitals over secondary hospitals for inpatient care. Utilizing discrete choice modeling of hospitalization data from a major Chinese city participating in the China PEACE Million Persons Project, we examine inpatient hospital choice trade-offs based on records collected between 2016 and 2023 with a final sample of 1,894 cases. Our analysis explicitly distinguishes institutional prestige from disease-specific expertise and investigates how these trade-offs differ between emergency and non-emergency admissions. Results demonstrate that patients unequivocally prioritize specialty matching over institutional reputation, especially during emergency admissions and among patients with severe cardio-cerebrovascular conditions. Willingness-to-travel (WTT) calculations indicate patients are willing to accept, on average, 14.8 extra minutes of travel time for superior specialty alignment. Furthermore, our analysis identifies significant preference heterogeneity, revealing systematic disparities emerging from interactions between individual socioeconomic characteristics and hospital attributes. Decomposition analysis elucidates critical structural disadvantages of secondary hospitals, primarily stemming from inadequate specialty alignment and prolonged inpatient stays. These findings underscore the need for reforms that address both supply-side constraints and demand-side sorting, by strengthening secondary hospitals' disease-specific roles, integrating them into medical alliances, and linking reimbursement rules to clinical appropriateness and referral pathways.

10.1016/j.socscimed.2026.119051.abstractZh: 尽管有针对性的政策干预，中国分级医疗体系中的患者仍然更倾向于选择三级医院而非二级医院进行住院治疗。本研究利用中国PEACE百万人口项目参与的主要中国城市的住院数据，通过离散选择模型进行分析，样本时间为2016年至2023年，最终获得1,894个案例。分析明确区分了机构声誉与疾病特异性专业能力的差异，并探讨了急诊与非急诊住院之间的选择权衡。结果显示，患者在急诊住院以及患有严重心血管脑血管疾病的情况下，明显更重视专业匹配而非机构声誉。意愿出行计算表明，患者平均愿意接受额外14.8分钟的出行时间，以获得更专业的医疗服务。此外，分析还发现显著的偏好差异，这些差异源于个体社会经济特征与医院属性之间的相互作用。分解分析揭示了二级医院的关键结构性劣势，主要源于专业匹配不足和住院时间延长。这些发现强调了进行改革的重要性，这些改革需要解决供给端和需求端的问题，通过加强二级医院在疾病特异性方面的作用、将其整合到医疗联盟中，并将报销规则与临床适宜性和转诊路径联系起来。

abstract.text: Policymakers across countries are struggling to retain and attract physicians. The design of policies to retain and attract physicians requires knowledge about their motivations to ensure that physicians are satisfied with their work. Based on the agency literature, we set up a theoretical framework outlining physicians' satisfaction (a proxy of utility) as a function of different sources of motivation (profits, patient benefits, societal benefits, and reputation). We then provide novel empirical evidence of how these motivations link to physicians' work satisfaction. This evidence is based on unique survey data on Danish general practitioners (GPs) which measures different dimensions of motivations and work satisfaction in 2019, combined with detailed register data on their working conditions. Using ordinary least square regressions, we estimate the association between GPs' work satisfaction and different sources of motivations, while controlling for a rich set of demand and supply factors. We find that one standard deviation (SD) increase in altruism towards society and in reputational motivation is associated with an increase of 8.4% and 8.7% of one SD in GP satisfaction, respectively. In contrast, one SD increase in profit orientation is associated with a 8.0% reduction of one SD in GP satisfaction. These results are robust to accounting for demand and supply factors. Overall, we predict theoretically and demonstrate empirically that different sources of motivation relate differently to physicians' work satisfaction. This knowledge may be useful for policymakers to design policies that can attract and retain more individuals to the profession.

10.1016/j.socscimed.2026.119263.abstractZh: 各国政策制定者都在努力留住并吸引医生。制定留住和吸引医生的政策时，需要了解医生的动机，以确保医生对其工作感到满意。基于代理理论，我们建立了一个理论框架，将医生的满意度（作为效用的代理指标）作为不同动机来源（利润、患者利益、社会利益和声誉）的函数。然后，我们提供了新的实证证据，说明这些动机如何与医生的工作满意度相关联。这些证据基于2019年对丹麦全科医生进行的独特调查数据，该数据测量了不同动机和工作满意度的维度，并结合了关于他们工作条件的详细登记数据。通过普通最小二乘回归，我们估计了全科医生的工作满意度与不同动机来源之间的关联，同时控制了丰富的供需因素。我们发现，对社会 altruism 动机的增加一个标准差，以及声誉动机的增加一个标准差，分别会导致全科医生满意度增加8.4%和8.7%。相反，利润导向的增加一个标准差，会导致全科医生满意度减少8.0%。这些结果在考虑供需因素后仍然保持稳定。总体而言，我们从理论上预测并实证证明了不同动机来源与医生工作满意度之间的关系是不同的。这些知识可能对政策制定者设计能够吸引和留住更多人的政策有所帮助。

abstract.text: Operations management has an important role in improving healthcare. Some of its core concepts and tools, such as Lean and statistical process control, have their own Elements in this series. In this Element, the authors offer an overview of three major topics in healthcare operations management: capacity and demand, focus, and people and process. They demonstrate how queuing theory reveals counterintuitive insights about capacity utilisation and waiting times, examine how strategic focus can achieve significant productivity gains while creating potential inequities, and explore why process improvements must account for human behaviours like multitasking and workarounds. Using practical examples, the authors illustrate both the critical role and the limitations of operations management against a backdrop of high demand and resource constraints. This title is also available as open access on Cambridge Core.

10.1017/9781009325868.abstractZh: 运营管理在改善医疗保健方面发挥着重要作用。其中的一些核心概念和工具，如精益管理和统计过程控制，在本系列中都有相应的内容。在本篇中，作者概述了医疗保健运营管理中的三个主要主题：产能与需求、重点分配以及人员与流程。他们展示了排队理论如何揭示关于产能利用率和等待时间的反直觉见解，探讨了战略性重点分配如何在创造潜在不平等的同时实现显著的生产力提升，并探讨了为什么流程改进必须考虑诸如多任务处理和工作变通等人类行为。通过实际案例，作者说明了在高需求和资源限制的情况下，运营管理的关键作用及其局限性。该文章也可在剑桥核心平台上以开放获取的形式获取。

abstract.text: Paying for primary care anne sophie oxholm, anthony scott Key messagesChapter 3.1 draws out insights into the way primary care is paid.Primary care delivers first-contact access to health services and seeks to coordinate care.It is paid for in different ways in different settings: through salary, capitation (a fixed payment per enlisted patient), feefor-service (FFS), pay for performance (P4P) or through blended payments that combine two or more of these methods.Key learning includes that:• The way health systems pay for primary care can incentivize treatment that supports wider health systems' goals, such as: ○ reducing avoidable referrals to secondary care, improving efficiency and reducing waste; and ○ encouraging adherence to evidence-based clinical guidelines, enhancing quality.• P4P is often used to improve quality but the evidence on how effective it is, is mixed.If performance measures are not carefully designed to be context specific and adjusted for risk appropriately, they can create unintended barriers to and inequalities in access.• The design of primary care payment models needs to be "holistic", to consider the goals of the health system and to underpin quality, access and efficiency.

10.1017/9781009746274.012.abstractZh:
支付初级保健费用——安妮·索菲·奥克斯霍尔姆、安东尼·斯科特

关键要点

第3.1章深入探讨了初级保健的支付方式。初级保健提供首诊服务，并致力于协调医疗护理。不同环境下的支付方式各不相同：通过工资、按人次付费、服务费用支付、绩效付费，或结合两种或多种支付方式。主要结论包括：

• 卫生系统对初级保健的支付方式可以激励支持更广泛卫生系统目标的医疗行为，例如：减少不必要的转诊到二级医疗机构，提高效率并减少浪费；鼓励遵循基于证据的临床指南，提升医疗质量。
• 绩效付费通常用于提升医疗质量，但关于其有效性的证据并不一致。如果绩效指标没有根据具体情况进行精心设计，并且没有适当调整以考虑风险因素，则可能会造成不必要的障碍和获取上的不平等。
• 初级保健支付模式的设计需要“全面考虑”，既要符合卫生系统的目标，又要保障医疗质量、可及性和效率。

abstract.text: BACKGROUND: Geographic segmentation of health insurance creates administrative barriers that limit patients' access to out-of-network healthcare, particularly in underserved regions. We assess the impact of a reimbursement reform removing interregional administrative barriers on patient healthcare utilization. METHODS: We conduct a quantitative quasi-experimental study using longitudinal administrative data from a representative city with limited high-tier medical resources. The causal effects of the reform are estimated based on patient visit records from January 2021 to November 2022 using a regression discontinuity of time (RDiT) design. RESULTS: The reform significantly increases intercity healthcare visits by up to 11.2%, especially among low-income patients and women. While patients with severe conditions benefit, increased utilization for minor ailments also occurs. This surge in demand strains medical resources, leading to increased readmission rates without reducing hospital stays. CONCLUSIONS: Removing administrative barriers enhances equity but may reduce healthcare efficiency if demand management is neglected. Policymakers should combine expanded access with investments in local healthcare capacity and demand-side controls to ensure sustainable and equitable service delivery.

10.1038/s43856-026-01624-4.abstractZh:
背景：健康保险的地理分割造成了行政障碍，限制了患者在非网络医疗机构获得医疗服务的情况，尤其是在服务不足的地区。我们评估了取消区域间行政障碍的报销改革对患者医疗服务利用的影响。  
方法：我们使用来自一个医疗资源有限但具有代表性的城市的纵向行政数据，进行了一项定量准实验研究。基于2021年1月至2022年11月的患者就诊记录，采用时间回归不连续设计（RDiT）方法估算改革的因果效应。  
结果：改革显著增加了跨城市医疗就诊的比例，最高可达11.2%，尤其是在低收入患者和女性患者中。虽然重症患者受益，但轻微疾病患者的就诊率也有所增加。这种需求激增给医疗资源带来了压力，导致再入院率上升，但住院时间并未减少。  
结论：消除行政障碍有助于提升公平性，但如果忽视需求管理，可能会降低医疗服务的效率。政策制定者应将扩大医疗服务获取与对当地医疗能力的投资以及需求侧控制相结合，以确保服务的可持续性和公平性。

abstract.text: This paper examines whether adverse selection exists in decisions by policyholders who allow their policies to lapse and then reinstate them, respectively. We find that lapse policies have lower pre-lapse claim experience than those that are continuouslyin-force, indicating that policies with lower risk are more likely to lapse. This result implies that lapse decisions are subject to adverse selection/retention. Because policies reinstated after six months are subject to limited underwriting, we separated reinstated policies into two groups: those reinstated within six months group and those reinstated after six months group. The evidence shows that reinstated policies both have higher subsequent claim probability than those that are continuously-in-force. These results imply that reinstatement decisions are subject to adverse selection. Finally, we also find that the longer the policy lapse prior to reinstatement, the higher the claim probability. This observation is consistent with continued negative health shock/changes being experienced by some individuals following the six-month period after lapsation.

10.1057/s10713-026-00116-8.abstractZh: 本文探讨了保单持有人在保单失效后重新续保的决策中是否存在逆向选择现象。研究发现，失效保单的索赔经历低于持续有效的保单，这表明风险较低的保单更容易失效。这一结果意味着重新续保的决策可能受到逆向选择的影响。由于六个月后重新续保的保单面临有限的承保风险，我们将重新续保的保单分为两组：六个月内重新续保的保单和六个月后重新续保的保单。研究结果表明，重新续保的保单后续索赔概率高于持续有效的保单。这些结果表明，重新续保的决策也可能受到逆向选择的影响。最后，我们还发现，保单失效时间越长，后续索赔概率越高。这一观察结果与某些人在失效六个月后仍然面临持续的健康冲击或变化相一致。

abstract.text: This paper examines efficiency losses in China’s special-purpose bond (SPB) issuance by tracing bond proceeds to underlying public projects and comparing project quality across different applicant types. Using a hand-collected project-level dataset from SPB disclosure documents, we show that enterprise-applied projects have significantly stronger repayment fundamentals and higher expected returns than projects applied by government departments or public institutions, and they feature more informative disclosures. Additional evidence indicates that the enterprise advantage operates through three channels: enterprises propose projects with more diversified revenue sources, exhibit tighter operational alignment between firm capabilities and project requirements, and demonstrate stronger organizational capacity. The results provide micro-level evidence on how institutional design shapes the quality of public debt-financed investment and offer implications for improving SPB allocation and managing local government debt risks.

10.1080/00036846.2026.2742445.abstractZh: 本文通过追踪专项债券的资金去向，并比较不同申请者类型下的项目质量，来研究中国专项债券发行中的效率损失。基于从专项债券披露文件中手工收集的项目级数据集，我们发现企业申请的项目的还款基础更为稳健，预期回报也更高，且项目信息披露更为详尽。进一步的研究表明，企业的优势主要体现在三个方面：企业提出的项目具有更多元化的收入来源；企业能力与项目需求之间的运作更加紧密；企业具备更强的组织能力。这些研究结果为制度设计如何影响公共债务融资投资的质量提供了微观层面的证据，并为改善专项债券的分配以及管理地方政府债务风险提供了启示。

abstract.text: Many mental health disorders start in adolescence, and appropriate initial treatment may improve trajectories. But what is appropriate treatment? We use a large national database of insurance claims to examine the impact of initial mental health treatment on the outcomes of adolescent children over the next 2 years, where treatment is either consistent with US Food and Drug Administration guidelines, consistent with looser guidelines published by professional societies (gray area prescribing), or inconsistent with any guidelines (red-flag prescribing). We find that red-flag prescribing increases self-harm, use of emergency rooms, and health care costs, suggesting that treatment guidelines effectively scale up good treatment in practice.

10.1086/738249.abstractZh: 许多精神健康障碍始于青春期，适当的初始治疗可能改善其发展轨迹。但什么才是适当的治疗？我们使用一个大型全国保险理赔数据库，考察初始精神健康治疗对青少年子女随后两年结果的影响，其中治疗要么符合美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）指南，要么符合专业学会发布的更宽松指南（灰色地带处方，gray area prescribing），要么不符合任何指南（危险信号处方，red-flag prescribing）。我们发现，危险信号处方会增加自伤、急诊室使用和医疗费用，这表明治疗指南能在实践中有效扩大良好治疗的实施规模。

abstract.text: In a randomized controlled trial, we test whether removal of a barrier to exercise can improve academic performance. We find strong support for this hypothesis: university students who were provided with a free gym card exercised more and had a significant improvement in academic performance. The treated students were both less likely to drop out of classes and to fail at the exam. We provide evidence showing that exercise caused a healthier lifestyle and increased perceived self-control, which ultimately improved academic performance. The study demonstrates that removing barriers to physical activity can be an important tool for improving educational achievements.

10.1086/738251.abstractZh: 在一项随机对照试验中，我们检验去除锻炼障碍是否能改善学业成绩。我们为这一假设找到了有力支持：获得免费健身卡的大学生锻炼更多，学业成绩也显著提高。受干预学生退课和考试不及格的可能性都更低。我们提供的证据表明，锻炼带来了更健康的生活方式，并提高了自我控制感，最终改善了学业成绩。该研究表明，消除身体活动的障碍可以成为提高教育成就的重要工具。

abstract.text: This paper provides theory and evidence that distorted long-term interest rate expectations limit the effectiveness of monetary policy. Beliefs that depart from rational expectations break the tight link between policy rates and long-term interest rates, even when determined by the expectations hypothesis of the yield curve. Because long-term expectations are excessively sensitive to short-term interest rates, optimal policy is less aggressive relative to rational expectations. More aggressive policy leads to suboptimal volatility in long-term interest rates and aggregate demand through standard intertemporal substitution effects. These effects are quantitatively important in the United States over the postwar period.

10.1086/738335.abstractZh: 本文提供理论与证据表明，扭曲的长期利率预期会限制货币政策的有效性。偏离理性预期的信念会打破政策利率与长期利率之间的紧密联系，即使长期利率由收益率曲线的预期假说决定也是如此。由于长期预期对短期利率过度敏感，相对于理性预期情形，最优政策更不激进。更激进的政策会通过标准的跨期替代效应，导致长期利率和总需求出现次优波动。这些效应在战后美国具有重要的数量意义。

abstract.text: We provide evidence that the quantitative importance of the Haar prior for posterior impulse response inference has been overstated. How sensitive posterior inference is to the Haar prior depends on the width of the identified set. This width depends not only on how much the identified set is narrowed by the identifying restrictions but also on the data through the reduced-form model parameters. Hence, the role of the Haar prior can be assessed only on a case-by-case basis. We show by example that when the identification is sufficiently tight, posterior inference based on a Gaussian-inverse Wishart-Haar prior is justified.

10.1086/738339.abstractZh: 我们提供证据表明，Haar 先验对后验脉冲响应推断的定量重要性被高估了。后验推断对 Haar 先验的敏感程度取决于识别集的宽度。该宽度不仅取决于识别约束将识别集收窄了多少，还通过简化式模型参数取决于数据。因此，Haar 先验的作用只能逐案评估。我们通过示例表明，当识别足够紧时，基于高斯-逆 Wishart-Haar 先验的后验推断是合理的。

abstract.text: Pay-as-bid (or discriminatory or multiple-price) auctions are used to sell homogenous goods such as treasury securities and commodities. We prove the uniqueness of their pure-strategy Bayesian Nash equilibrium and establish a tractable representation of equilibrium bids for symmetrically-informed bidders. Analyzing design, we show that supply transparency and full disclosure are revenue-maximizing in pay as bid, though not necessarily in uniform-price (or single-price) auctions, the main alternative auction format. Pay as bid raises weakly more revenue than uniform price and may lead to higher welfare. Our results provide an explanation for the revenue equivalence observed in empirical studies of treasury auctions.

10.1086/738341.abstractZh: 按报价支付拍卖（或称差别价格拍卖或多价拍卖）用于出售国债证券和大宗商品等同质商品。我们证明其纯策略贝叶斯纳什均衡的唯一性，并为具有对称信息的投标人建立了均衡报价的易处理表示。在分析拍卖设计时，我们表明，在按报价支付拍卖中，供给透明度与完全披露能够实现收入最大化，但在统一价格（或单一价格）拍卖——主要的替代拍卖形式——中未必如此。按报价支付拍卖带来的收入弱高于统一价格拍卖，并可能带来更高福利。我们的结果为国债拍卖实证研究中观察到的收入等价现象提供了解释。

abstract.text: We analyze a nonlinear pricing model where the seller controls both product pricing (screening) and buyer information about their own values (persuasion). We prove that the optimal mechanism always consists of finitely many signals and items, even with a continuum of buyer values. The seller optimally pools buyer values and reduces product variety to minimize informational rents. We show that value pooling is optimal even for finite value distributions if their entropy exceeds a critical threshold. We also provide sufficient conditions under which the optimal menu restricts offering to a single item.

10.1086/738342.abstractZh: 我们分析一个非线性定价模型，其中卖方同时控制产品定价（筛选）和买方关于自身估值的信息（说服）。我们证明，即使买方估值是连续统，最优机制也始终由有限多个信号和物品构成。卖方最优地混同买方估值并减少产品种类，以最小化信息租金。我们表明，即使对于有限估值分布，只要其熵超过临界阈值，估值混同也是最优的。我们还给出了最优菜单将提供范围限制为单一物品的充分条件。

abstract.text: We analyze how private decisions and optimal public policies are shaped by personal and societal preferences, material incentives, and social norms. We show how incentives interact with honor and stigma, deriving optimal taxation. We then analyze the expressive role of law as embodying society’s values and when it calls for a weakening or a strengthening of incentives. The law should be softened when it signals agents’ willingness to contribute to the public good and toughened when it signals social externalities. We also shed light on norms-based interventions, societies’ resistance to economists’ messages, and the avoidance of cruel and unusual punishments.

10.1086/738343.abstractZh: 我们分析私人决策与最优公共政策如何受到个人偏好和社会偏好、物质激励以及社会规范的影响。我们展示激励如何与荣誉和污名相互作用，并据此推导最优税收。随后，我们分析法律作为社会价值之体现所具有的表达性作用，以及法律何时要求弱化或强化激励。当法律传递出经济主体愿意为公共物品作出贡献的信号时，法律应趋于宽松；当法律传递出社会外部性的信号时，法律应趋于严厉。我们还阐释基于规范的干预、社会对经济学家信息的抵制，以及对残酷和非常刑罚的避免。

abstract.text: We present a dynamic quantitative trade and migration model that incorporates downward nominal wage rigidities and show how this framework can generate changes in unemployment and labor participation that match those uncovered by the empirical literature studying the China shock. We find that the China shock leads to average welfare increases in most US states, including many that experience unemployment during the transition. However, nominal rigidities reduce the overall US gains by around two-thirds. In addition, there are 18 states that experience welfare losses in the presence of downward nominal wage rigidity that would have experienced gains without it.

10.1086/738344.abstractZh: 我们提出一个纳入名义工资向下刚性的动态量化贸易与迁移模型，并说明该框架如何能够产生与考察中国冲击的实证文献所揭示的失业和劳动参与变化相一致的结果。我们发现，中国冲击使美国大多数州的平均福利上升，其中包括许多在转型期间经历失业的州。然而，名义刚性使美国总体收益减少约三分之二。此外，有18个州在存在名义工资向下刚性的情况下出现福利损失，而若没有这种刚性，它们本会获得福利改善。

abstract.text: The measurement of intelligence should identify and measure an individual’s subjective confidence that a response to a test question is correct. Existing measures do not do that, nor do they use extrinsic financial incentive for truthful responses. We rectify both issues and show that each matters for the measurement of intelligence, particularly for women. Our results on gender and confidence in the face of risk have wider applications in terms of the measurement of “competitiveness” and financial literacy. Contrary to received literature, women are more intelligent than men, compete when they should in risky settings, and are more literate.

10.1086/738345.abstractZh: 智力测量应当识别并测量个体对测试题回答正确性的主观信心。现有测量既未做到这一点，也未采用外在金钱激励来促使如实回答。我们同时纠正了这两个问题，并表明二者各自都对智力测量有影响，尤其对女性而言。我们关于性别与面对风险时的信心的结果，在“竞争性”和金融素养的测量方面具有更广泛的应用。与既有文献相反，女性比男性智力更高，在风险情境中该竞争时会竞争，并且金融素养更高。

abstract.text: Using field experimental data (study time tracking and randomized incentives), we identify a structural model of learning. Student effort is influenced by external costs/benefits and unobserved heterogeneity: motivation (willingness to study) and productivity (conversion rate of time into skill). We estimate academic labor supply elasticities and skill technology. Productivity and motivation are uncorrelated. Low productivity, not low motivation, is the stronger predictor of academic struggles. School quality augments productivity and accelerates skill production. We find that dynamic skill complementarities arise mainly from children’s aging and from a feedback loop between investment activity and productivity rather than from carrying forward past skill stocks.

10.1086/738479.abstractZh: 我们利用田野实验数据（学习时间追踪和随机激励），识别出一个学习结构模型。学生努力受外部成本/收益和不可观测异质性影响：动机（学习意愿）和生产率（将时间转化为技能的转化率）。我们估计了学业劳动供给弹性和技能生产技术。生产率与动机不相关。低生产率而非低动机是学业困难更强的预测因素。学校质量会提高生产率并加速技能生产。我们发现，动态技能互补性主要源于儿童年龄增长，以及投资活动与生产率之间的反馈回路，而非源于既往技能存量的结转。

abstract.text: Families invest time, home goods/services, and market-based childcare in their children. We study these investments, focusing on the role of parental human capital and the substitutability of inputs in skill production. We develop a relative demand estimation strategy that uses intratemporal optimality to estimate the substitutability and relative productivity of inputs. We show how relative demand restrictions simplify and improve estimation of the dynamics of skill production. We estimate the skill production technology for American children aged 5–12, finding moderately strong complementarity between inputs and little difference in the technology by parental education. Counterfactual simulations show that estimated input complementarity has important implications for policies that subsidize inputs or provide free childcare.

10.1086/738480.abstractZh: 家庭在子女身上投入时间、家庭用品和服务以及市场化儿童照护。我们研究这些投入，重点关注父母人力资本的作用以及技能生产中投入品的可替代性。我们提出一种相对需求估计策略，利用期内最优性来估计投入品的可替代性和相对生产率。我们展示相对需求约束如何简化和改进对技能生产动态的估计。我们估计了5–12岁美国儿童的技能生产技术，发现投入品之间具有中等强度的互补性，且技能生产技术因父母教育程度不同而差异很小。反事实模拟表明，估计出的投入品互补性对补贴投入品或提供免费儿童照护的政策具有重要含义。

abstract.text: We construct a dynamic model of child development where forward-looking parents and children jointly take actions to increase the child’s cognitive and noncognitive skills within a Markov perfect equilibrium framework. In addition to time and money investments in their child, parents also choose whether to use explicit incentives to increase the child’s self-investment, which may reduce the child’s future intrinsic motivation to invest by reducing the child’s discount factor. We use the estimated model parameters to show that the use of extrinsic motivation has large costs in terms of the child’s future incentives to invest in themselves.

10.1086/738481.abstractZh: 我们构建了一个儿童发展的动态模型。在该模型中，具有前瞻性的父母与儿童在马尔可夫完美均衡框架内共同采取行动，以提高儿童的认知与非认知技能。除了对儿童进行时间与金钱投资外，父母还会选择是否使用显性激励来增加儿童的自我投资；这种显性激励可能通过降低儿童的贴现因子，削弱儿童未来进行投资的内在动机。我们利用估计得到的模型参数表明，使用外部激励会在儿童未来自我投资的激励方面带来很大的成本。

abstract.text: Using a model of maternal labor supply and investment in children, this paper synthesizes the findings from three separate welfare reform experiments across six sites. The proposed model maps variation in experimental design to parameters that define labor supply behavior, childcare use, and the importance of money and childcare arrangements in the development of child skills. The estimation procedure—which aggregates available evidence to identify the model’s key causal parameters—amounts to a structural meta-analysis. A number of counterfactuals underscore the utility of this model-based approach for understanding the mechanisms behind treatment effects and the roles played by heterogeneity and selection in shaping impacts.

10.1086/738482.abstractZh: 本文利用一个关于母亲劳动力供给与子女投资的模型，综合了在六个地点开展的三个独立福利改革实验的研究结果。所提出的模型将实验设计中的变异映射为若干参数，这些参数界定劳动力供给行为、儿童保育使用，以及金钱和儿童保育安排对儿童技能发展的重要性。该估计程序汇总现有证据以识别模型的关键因果参数，相当于一项结构元分析。若干反事实分析凸显了这种基于模型的方法的实用性，有助于理解处理效应背后的机制，以及异质性和选择在塑造影响中所起的作用。

abstract.text: This paper uses three decades of data on rhesus monkeys to investigate the multigenerational effects of early-life advantage. Monkeys and their offspring are both randomly assigned to be reared together or apart from their mothers. For the first time, we document the intergenerational complementarity of early-life advantage, where the benefits of maternal rearing are present only for offspring of mothers who were themselves mother reared. This illustrates the intergenerational dynamics of social advantage and how the value of an intervention can depend on the experiences of the previous generation. Our paper demonstrates how studies of primates can inform human development.

10.1086/738483.abstractZh: 本文利用三十年的恒河猴数据，考察早期生活优势的多代效应。猴子及其后代均被随机分配为与母亲共同抚养或与母亲分离抚养。我们首次记录了早期生活优势的代际互补性：母亲抚养的收益仅存在于那些其母亲本身由母亲抚养的后代中。这揭示了社会优势的代际动态，以及一项干预措施的价值如何可能取决于上一代的经历。本文表明，灵长类动物研究如何为人类发展研究提供启示。

abstract.text: Inequality of opportunity occurs when children of equal academic performance are sent to different-quality schools because their parents differ in socioeconomic status. We demonstrate that children from low–socioeconomic status (SES) families are significantly less likely to enter the academic track, even after conditioning on prior school performance. We then provide causal evidence that a low-intensity mentoring program can improve the education outcomes of low-SES children and reduce inequality of opportunity. Low-SES children randomly assigned to mentors for 1 year are 20% more likely to enter a high-track program. Mentorship affects both parents and children and has positive long-term implications for children’s educational trajectories. The effects are enduring and scalable.

10.1086/738484.abstractZh: 机会不平等是指学业表现相同的儿童因父母社会经济地位不同而被送往质量不同的学校。我们表明，来自低社会经济地位（SES）家庭的儿童进入学术轨的概率显著更低，即使在控制此前的学校表现之后也是如此。随后我们提供因果证据，表明低强度导师制项目能够改善低 SES 儿童的教育结果并减少机会不平等。被随机分配接受为期一年导师指导的低 SES 儿童进入高轨项目的概率高出 20%。导师指导同时影响父母和儿童，并对儿童的教育轨迹具有积极的长期含义。这些效应具有持久性且可扩展。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the weekly evolution of skills as measured by unique data from a widely-emulated early childhood home-visiting program in rural China. The design of the study avoids input endogeneity issues and lack of comparable measures of skills that plague previous studies. Skills, nominally classified as the same, in fact, do not appear to share a common unit scale across levels. They are produced by skill-lifecycle-stage-specific learning processes. A novel dynamic stochastic skill production model for multiple skills is developed, aligning with empirical evidence. The model explains the "fadeout" of measures of learning through forgetting or depreciation of skills.

10.1086/739256.abstractZh: 本文利用来自中国农村一项被广泛效仿的幼儿家访项目的独特数据，考察技能的周度演变。该研究设计避免了困扰以往研究的投入内生性问题以及缺乏可比技能测度的问题。名义上归为同一类的技能，在不同水平上事实上似乎并不共享同一单位尺度。它们由技能生命周期阶段特定的学习过程所生产。本文构建了一个与经验证据相一致的多技能动态随机技能生产模型。该模型通过技能的遗忘或折旧解释了学习测度的消退。

abstract.text: This paper examines the impact of cultural diversity on innovation. Focusing on the United States from 1850 to 1940, we develop a novel surname-based measure of cultural diversity and combine this with patent data. Leveraging quasi-random variation in counties’ surname compositions driven by historical immigration, we find that rising diversity increased both the quantity and the quality of innovation within counties and for individual inventors. Examining mechanisms, we provide evidence suggesting that greater surname diversity accelerated innovation both by expanding the range of ideas, skills, and perspectives available for recombination and by fostering the diverse social interactions that facilitate idea sharing.

10.1086/739323.abstractZh: 本文考察文化多样性对创新的影响。我们聚焦1850—1940年的美国，构建了一种新的基于姓氏的文化多样性测度，并将其与专利数据相结合。利用由历史移民驱动的各县姓氏构成中的准随机变异，我们发现，多样性上升同时提高了县层面和个体发明者层面的创新数量与质量。在考察机制时，我们提供的证据表明，更大的姓氏多样性加速创新，既通过扩大可用于重组的想法、技能和视角的范围，也通过促进有助于想法分享的多样化社会互动。

abstract.text: I build an empirical model of the South American agricultural sector to show how environmental policy is transmitted along a supply chain when regulation at the externality’s source is infeasible. Given obstacles to a first-best carbon tax on farmers, I show how second-best alternatives—downstream agribusiness taxes—reduce upstream emissions, but their effectiveness is limited by poor targeting while also being regressive. Agribusiness monopsony power worsens targeting by lowering pass-through to upstream farmers in uncompetitive and emissions-intense regions, thus eroding the Pigouvian signal where social cost is highest. By contrast, small-scale but well-targeted upstream interventions perform robustly when markets face preexisting distortions.

10.1086/739325.abstractZh: 我构建了一个南美洲农业部门的实证模型，以说明当在外部性的源头进行监管不可行时，环境政策如何沿供应链传导。鉴于对农民征收第一最优碳税存在障碍，我表明次优替代方案——下游农业企业税——能够减少上游排放，但其有效性受制于目标定位不佳，同时也具有累退性。农业企业的买方垄断力量会恶化目标定位：在缺乏竞争且排放密集的地区，它降低了对上游农民的传导，从而在社会成本最高之处削弱庇古信号。相比之下，当市场面临既有扭曲时，小规模但目标定位良好的上游干预表现稳健。

abstract.text: We study what changes to an agent's decision problem increase her value for information. We prove that information becomes more valuable if and only if the agent's reduced-form payoff in her belief becomes more convex. When the transformation corresponds to the addition of an action, the requisite increase in convexity occurs if and only if a simple geometric condition holds, which extends in a natural way to the addition of multiple actions. We apply these findings to two scenarios: a monopolistic screening problem in which the good is information and delegation with information acquisition.

10.1086/739326.abstractZh: 我们研究经济主体决策问题的何种变化会提高其对信息的估值。我们证明，当且仅当经济主体以信念为自变量的简约式收益变得更凸时，信息才会变得更有价值。当该变换对应于新增一个行动时，所需的凸性提高当且仅当一个简单的几何条件成立时才会出现，而该条件可以自然推广到新增多个行动的情形。我们将这些发现应用于两类情形：商品为信息的垄断筛选问题，以及含信息获取的授权问题。

abstract.text: Since the 1980s, the United States has experienced both an increase in income inequality and a rise in residential segregation by income. We develop a general equilibrium model with residential choice, where segregation and inequality amplify each other because of a local spillover affecting educational returns. We calibrate the model to a representative US metro in 1980 and use the micro estimates of neighborhood exposure effects in Chetty and Hendren (2018b) to discipline the spillover. We then explore the economy’s response to an unexpected skill premium shock and show that segregation played a significant role in amplifying the increase in inequality.

10.1086/739328.abstractZh: 自20世纪80年代以来，美国既经历了收入不平等加剧，也经历了按收入划分的居住隔离上升。我们构建了一个包含居住选择的一般均衡模型；在该模型中，由于存在影响教育回报的本地溢出效应，隔离与不平等会相互放大。我们将模型校准到1980年美国一个代表性都市区，并利用 Chetty and Hendren（2018b）对邻里暴露效应的微观估计来约束该溢出效应。随后，我们考察经济对未预期技能溢价冲击的反应，并表明隔离在放大不平等上升方面发挥了重要作用。

abstract.text: We address the estimation of endogenous treatment models with social interactions in both the treatment and outcome equations. We model the interactions between individuals via a game theoretic approach based on discrete Bayesian games. We employ a nested pseudo joint likelihood algorithm when obtaining the model’s parameters and provide relevant treatment effects and procedures for their estimation. Our empirical application examines the impact of an individual’s exercise frequency on their level of self-esteem. We find that an individual’s exercise frequency is influenced by their expectation of their friends’ exercise frequency. Moreover, an individual’s level of self-esteem is affected by their level of exercise and, at relatively lower levels of self-esteem, by the expectation of their friends’ self-esteem.

10.1086/739329.abstractZh: 我们研究处理方程和结果方程均存在社会互动的内生处理模型的估计问题。我们通过基于离散贝叶斯博弈的博弈论方法对个体之间的互动进行建模。在获取模型参数时，我们采用嵌套伪联合似然算法，并给出相关的处理效应及其估计程序。我们的实证应用考察个体锻炼频率对其自尊水平的影响。我们发现，个体的锻炼频率受到其对朋友锻炼频率预期的影响。此外，个体的自尊水平受到其锻炼水平的影响，并且在自尊水平相对较低时，还受到对朋友自尊水平预期的影响。

abstract.text: We develop an assignment model of automation. Each of a continuum of tasks of variable complexity is assigned to either capital or one of a continuum of labor skills. We characterize conditions for interior automation, whereby tasks of intermediate complexity are performed by capital. Interior automation arises when low-skill wages are low and effective cost of capital in low-complexity tasks is high. Minimum wages make interior automation less likely. Higher capital productivity causes employment and wage polarization, changes the skill premium nonmonotonically, and reduces the real wage of workers with comparative advantage profiles close to that of capital.

10.1086/739330.abstractZh: 我们构建了一个自动化的任务分配模型。复杂程度可变的任务构成一个连续统，其中每项任务被分配给资本或劳动技能连续统中的某一技能水平。我们刻画了内部自动化（interior automation）的条件，即中等复杂度的任务由资本完成。当低技能工资较低，且资本在低复杂度任务中的有效成本较高时，内部自动化会出现。最低工资会降低内部自动化出现的可能性。资本生产率提高会导致就业和工资极化，非单调地改变技能溢价，并降低比较优势特征与资本相近的工人的实际工资。

abstract.text: Despite escalating losses in climate-related disasters, adoption of protective technologies and behaviors is limited by risk misperception, externalities, and insurance market frictions. One response to these market failures is to mandate these investments. We measure the effect of California’s wildfire building codes on own and neighboring structure survival using comprehensive data on US homes exposed to wildfires since 2000. Differences across jurisdictions and vintages reveal remarkable resilience effects of building codes. Codes also increase survival of neighboring homes by reducing structure-to-structure spread. We then develop and estimate a model of social benefits of mandatory building standards versus other adaptation policies.

10.1086/739331.abstractZh: 尽管气候相关灾害造成的损失不断上升，防护性技术和行为的采用仍受风险误判、外部性和保险市场摩擦的限制。应对这些市场失灵的一种方式是强制要求进行这些投资。我们利用2000年以来受野火影响的美国住宅的综合数据，衡量加州野火建筑规范对自身及邻近建筑结构存续的影响。不同辖区和建筑年代的差异显示，建筑规范具有显著的韧性效应。规范还通过减少建筑结构间的火势蔓延，提高邻近住宅的存续概率。随后，我们构建并估计一个模型，比较强制性建筑标准与其他适应政策的社会收益。

abstract.text: We provide an organizational economics foundation for commitment to information structures in persuasion. An uninformed principal faces a joint screening-and-persuasion problem: she wants to influence a receiver’s belief about a payoff-relevant state using information elicited from a privately informed agent. The agent’s messages are publicly observed, so the principal cannot commit to a garbling of private communications. We show that commitment only to an employment contract with the agent permits the principal to implement the optimal unconstrained intermediation scheme. We apply our result to a brokerage contracting with sell-side analysts, where private communication is constrained by conflict-of-interest regulations, showing that public investment rating schemes can sidestep these regulations.

10.1086/739332.abstractZh: 我们为说服情境下对信息结构的承诺提供了组织经济学基础。一个不知情的委托人面临筛选与说服的联合问题：她希望利用从拥有私人信息的代理人那里获取的信息，影响接收者关于某一与支付相关状态的信念。代理人的消息会被公开观察到，因此委托人无法承诺对私下沟通的信息进行模糊化处理。我们证明，只有对与代理人签订的雇佣合同作出承诺，委托人才能够实施最优的无约束中介方案。我们将这一结果应用于与卖方分析师有关的经纪合同安排；在该情形中，私下沟通受到利益冲突监管的约束，而公开投资评级方案能够绕过这些监管。

abstract.text: We study the first-ever ratings for corporate securities. In 1909, John Moody published a book that partitioned the majority of listed railroad bonds into letter-graded ratings. These ratings had no regulatory implications and were largely explainable using publicly available information. We find that lower-than-market-implied ratings caused a rise in secondary market bond yields and that bonds that were rated experienced a substantial decline in their bid-ask spreads, consistent with reduced information asymmetries and improved liquidity. Our findings suggest that ratings can improve information transmission and highlight their potential value for the functioning of financial markets.

10.1086/739333.abstractZh: 我们研究公司证券史上首个评级。1909年，约翰·穆迪（John Moody）出版了一本书，将大多数上市铁路债券划分为字母评级。这些评级没有监管含义，且在很大程度上可由公开可得信息解释。我们发现，低于市场隐含水平的评级导致二级市场债券收益率上升；而被评级的债券买卖价差大幅下降，这与信息不对称减少和流动性改善相一致。我们的发现表明，评级可以改善信息传递，并凸显其对金融市场运行的潜在价值。

abstract.text: During adolescence, peer interactions become increasingly central to children’s development, whereas the direct influence of parents wanes. Nevertheless, parents can continue to exert leverage by shaping their children’s peer groups. We construct and estimate a model of parenting with peer and neighborhood effects where parents intervene in peer formation and show that the model captures empirical patterns of skill accumulation, parenting style, and peer characteristics among US high school students. We find that interventions that move children to better neighborhoods lose impact when they are scaled up, because parents’ equilibrium responses push against successful integration with the new peer group.

10.1086/739334.abstractZh: 在青春期，同伴互动对儿童发展日益居于核心位置，而父母的直接影响则逐渐减弱。尽管如此，父母仍可通过塑造子女的同伴群体来继续施加影响。我们构建并估计了一个包含同伴效应与邻里效应的父母养育模型，其中父母会干预同伴形成；并表明该模型能够刻画美国高中生在技能积累、养育风格和同伴特征方面的经验模式。我们发现，将儿童迁移到更好社区的干预在扩大规模时效果会减弱，因为父母的均衡反应会阻碍儿童与新同伴群体的成功融合。

abstract.text: We use Facebook data to study Syrian migrants’ social integration in Germany, establishing five findings: (1) Migrants’ social integration varies across regions, driven by causal, place-based effects. (2) This spatial variation reflects how frequently Germans befriend neighbors and how likely they are to befriend migrants versus other Germans. Using a mover’s design, we show that both factors are shaped more by local institutions and policies than by persistent native characteristics. (3) Integration courses boost intergroup friending rates. (4) Migrants receive help from Germans, such as finding jobs or housing. (5) Germans quasi-randomly exposed to migrants in high school are likelier to befriend migrants later.

10.1086/739335.abstractZh: 我们利用 Facebook 数据研究叙利亚移民在德国的社会融入，得到五项发现：(1) 移民的社会融入因地区而异，且由基于地点的因果效应驱动。(2) 这种空间差异反映了德国人与邻居结交的频率，以及他们与其他德国人相比与移民结交的可能性。采用搬迁者设计（mover’s design），我们表明这两个因素更多由本地制度和政策塑造，而非由持久的本地居民特征塑造。(3) 融入课程提高了群体间交友率。(4) 移民从德国人那里获得帮助，例如找工作或住房。(5) 在高中阶段准随机接触到移民的德国人，日后更有可能与移民成为朋友。

abstract.text: Many ideas succeed in small trials but weaken considerably at scale. Using early childhood investment as a case study, this paper develops a dynamic microfounded human capital model stylized in the Chicago tradition. The framework features optimizing agents, complementary skill formation, and a policymaker choosing scaling strategies. The model shows that naive extrapolation from pilots systematically overestimates societal impact by overlooking voltage drops: declining benefit-cost profiles due to unrepresentative samples and contexts. Optimal scaling requires option C thinking, a mechanism-based design approach that anticipates these failures through backward induction from real-world implementation constraints. Studies in this special issue enrich the model’s insights.

10.1086/739436.abstractZh: 许多想法在小规模试验中取得成功，但在规模化时明显减弱。本文以幼儿教育投资为案例，构建一个按芝加哥传统进行风格化设定的动态微观基础人力资本模型。该框架包含最优化经济主体、互补性技能形成，以及选择规模化策略的政策制定者。模型表明，从试点进行的朴素外推会因忽视电压降（voltage drops）而系统性地高估社会影响：由于样本和情境不具代表性，收益-成本曲线下降。最优规模化需要选项 C 思维，这是一种基于机制的设计方法，通过从现实实施约束出发进行逆向归纳来预见这些失败。本期特刊中的研究丰富了该模型的洞见。

abstract.text: We test Le Play’s 1875 hypothesis that the French Revolution contributed to France’s early fertility decline by imposing equal partition of inheritance among all children, including women. We combine new data on local inheritance rules before the Revolution and individual-level demographic data from historical sources and crowdsourced genealogies. Difference-in-differences and regression discontinuity estimates show that the inheritance reforms enacted during the Revolution reduced completed fertility by 0.5 children. A key mechanism was the desire to avoid land fragmentation across generations. These reforms closed the fertility gap between regions with different historical inheritance rules and crucially contributed to France’s demographic transition.

10.1086/739821.abstractZh: 我们检验了Le Play在1875年提出的假设，即法国大革命通过实施所有子女，包括女性，平等分配遗产的规定，导致了法国早期生育率的下降。我们结合了大革命前当地遗产规则的新数据，以及历史资料中的个人层面人口统计数据，还有众包整理的家谱数据。差异分解法和回归不连续法估计表明，大革命期间实施的遗产改革使完成生育的子女数量减少了0.5个。其中一个关键机制是避免土地在代际间的分散。这些改革缩小了具有不同历史遗产规则地区之间的生育差距，并显著促进了法国的人口转型。

abstract.text: This paper examines the nature of entrepreneurship using a novel panel dataset based on US Internal Revenue Service data. We analyze income growth trajectories and the determinants of entrepreneurial choice for business owners. Compared with prior household survey–based studies, we find that self-employed individuals have significantly higher average incomes and steeper income growth than their wage-earning matched peers. Contrary to survey evidence, we find a limited role for nonpecuniary motives, uninsurable risk, and liquidity constraints driving entrepreneurial choice. Prior work experience predicts entrepreneurial entry. Entry and exit rates into self-employment remain stable over time, including during the Great Recession.

10.1086/739823.abstractZh: 本文利用一个基于美国国税局（IRS）数据的新面板数据集考察创业的性质。我们分析了企业主的收入增长轨迹以及创业选择的决定因素。与以往基于家庭住户调查的研究相比，我们发现自雇者的平均收入显著更高，且其收入增长比匹配的可比工薪劳动者更陡峭。与调查证据相反，我们发现非货币动机、不可保险风险和流动性约束在驱动创业选择方面的作用有限。先前的工作经历可以预测创业进入。自雇的进入率和退出率随时间保持稳定，包括在大衰退期间。

abstract.text: The US government is the dominant supplier of global safe assets and faces a downward-sloping demand for its debt. We develop a model of the global economy in which US public debt generates special value for holders, endowing the US government with market power. We use variations in demand elasticities during high- and low-volatility regimes to distinguish this model from a price-taking benchmark and find that the data reject price-taking behavior in favor of the US government exploiting market power. We quantify the distortions, finding significant underprovision of safe assets, convenience yield markups, and welfare benefits for the United States.

10.1086/739824.abstractZh: 美国政府是全球安全资产的主导供应者，并面对向下倾斜的债务需求。我们构建了一个全球经济模型，其中美国公共债务为持有者带来特殊价值，使美国政府拥有市场势力。我们利用高波动与低波动状态下需求弹性的变化，将该模型与价格接受者基准区分开来，发现数据拒绝价格接受行为，而支持美国政府运用市场势力。我们量化了这些扭曲，发现安全资产供给显著不足、存在便利收益率加成，以及美国获得福利收益。

abstract.text: Algorithm designers increasingly care not only about accuracy but also about fairness across predefined groups. We study the trade-off between these objectives and characterize it by a fairness-accuracy frontier: the set of outcomes that cannot be simultaneously improved in both dimensions. The shape of this frontier is governed by a simple property of the inputs, which we call group skew. In particular, reducing accuracy for both groups to increase fairness is justified if and only if inputs are group skewed. We also study an information design problem in which a designer regulates inputs but another agent chooses the algorithm. We show that, when inputs are not group skewed, banning group identity or other informative inputs is strictly suboptimal.

10.1086/739826.abstractZh: 算法设计者日益不仅关注准确率，也关注预先定义群体间的公平性。我们研究这两类目标之间的权衡，并用公平—准确率前沿来刻画这一权衡：该前沿由无法在两个维度上同时改进的结果集合构成。其形状由输入的一项简单性质决定，我们称之为群体偏斜。特别地，为提升公平性而降低两个群体的准确率，当且仅当输入具有群体偏斜时才是合理的。我们还研究一个信息设计问题：设计者监管输入，而另一个主体选择算法。我们表明，当输入不具有群体偏斜时，禁止使用群体身份或其他信息性输入是严格次优的。

abstract.text: How efficiently do markets reallocate capital in booms and busts? Using a novel dataset of offshore drilling contracts, I examine the role of matching in shaping industry reallocation. Oil companies search and match with capital (rigs) in a decentralized market. I find that oil and gas booms increase the option value of searching, which leads agents to avoid bad matches, reducing mismatch through a sorting effect. I provide an identification strategy to disentangle unobserved demand changes from the sorting effect. Estimating a model, I find substantial benefits to the sorting effect and an intermediary, but I find that demand-smoothing policies are ineffective.

10.1086/739827.abstractZh: 市场在繁荣与萧条时期重新配置资本的效率如何？本文利用一套新的海上钻井合同数据集，考察匹配在塑造行业再配置中的作用。石油公司在分散市场中搜寻资本（钻井平台）并与之匹配。我发现，油气繁荣提高了搜寻的期权价值，这使经济主体避免不良匹配，从而通过排序效应减少错配。我提供了一种识别策略，用以将不可观测的需求变化与排序效应区分开来。通过对模型进行估计，我发现排序效应和中介具有可观收益，但需求平滑政策无效。

abstract.text: We develop and estimate a life-cycle model of addiction in which forward-looking youth choose to smoke, attend school, work part-time, and consume while facing borrowing constraints. The model features multiple channels for studying the reciprocal causal effects of addiction and education. Variations in endowments and cigarette prices are sources of identification. We show that education causally reduces smoking. A counterfactual experiment finds that in the absence of cigarette smoking, college attendance increases by 2 percentage points in the population. An alternative 25% additional excise tax achieves similar results. Impacts vary substantially across persons of different cognitive and noncognitive abilities.

10.1086/739828.abstractZh: 我们构建并估计了一个成瘾的生命周期模型：具有前瞻性的年轻人选择是否吸烟、上学、从事兼职工作以及消费，同时面临借贷约束。该模型包含多条渠道，用于研究成瘾与教育之间的相互因果效应。禀赋和香烟价格的变化是识别来源。我们表明，教育会因果性地减少吸烟。一项反事实实验发现，若不存在吸烟，总人口中的大学入学率将提高2个百分点。另一种方案是额外征收25%的消费税，也能取得类似结果。这些影响在不同认知能力和非认知能力的人群之间差异显著。

abstract.text: The Allais critique of expected utility theory (EUT) has led to the development of theories of choice under risk that relax the independence axiom but adhere to the fundamental/conventional axioms of ordering (completeness and transitivity) and monotonicity (with respect to first-order stochastic dominance). Unlike experimental work designed to test independence, our experiment is comprehensive, testing the entire set of axioms on which EUT is based. Our econometric analysis is also nonparametric and performed at the level of each individual subject. For the vast majority of subjects, departures from independence are small relative to departures from ordering and/or monotonicity.

10.1086/739829.abstractZh: 阿莱对期望效用理论（EUT）的批评推动了风险下的选择理论的发展，这些理论放松了独立性公理，但遵循排序（完备性与传递性）和单调性（相对于一阶随机占优）的基本/传统公理。与旨在检验独立性的实验研究不同，我们的实验是全面的，检验了 EUT 所依据的整套公理。我们的计量分析也是非参数的，并在每个个体受试者层面进行。对绝大多数受试者而言，对独立性的偏离相对于对排序和/或单调性的偏离较小。

abstract.text: Experimental evidence from Pakistan shows that distance poses a large and discontinuous access constraint: women with village-based training centers are four times more likely to access valued training opportunities. More than half of the travel penalty is incurred when crossing the village boundary. Exogenous stipend variation reveals that this boundary effect is costly to offset and is not explained by travel costs. Security considerations are an important factor: providing secure group transport raises take-up, while women with greater safety concerns and those traversing underpopulated areas, a proxy for insecurity, have lower take-up. The training has similar positive benefits for women attending inside- and outside-village centers.

10.1086/739830.abstractZh: 来自巴基斯坦的实验证据表明，距离构成了显著且不连续的获取约束：村庄内设有培训中心的女性获得有价值培训机会的可能性是其他女性的四倍。超过一半的出行惩罚发生在跨越村庄边界时。外生津贴变动显示，这一边界效应的抵消成本很高，且不能由出行成本解释。安全考量是重要因素：提供安全的集体接送服务会提高参与率，而安全担忧更强的女性以及穿行于人口稀少地区（不安全程度的代理变量）的女性参与率更低。培训对在村内和村外中心参加的女性具有相似的正向收益。

abstract.text: We develop a life-cycle model of labor supply and human capital formation that incorporates health shocks, health insurance, and medical treatment decisions. We use the model to study effects of health shocks on health, labor supply, earnings, and earnings inequality. We also simulate provision of public insurance to agents who lack employer-sponsored insurance. While this increases medical spending substantially, it creates positive labor supply incentives for low-skill workers while reducing costs of social insurance, Medicaid, and free care. The net program cost is modest, and all model agents are ex ante better off in a balanced budget simulation.

10.1086/739831.abstractZh: 我们构建了一个纳入健康冲击、健康保险和医疗治疗决策的劳动力供给与人力资本形成生命周期模型。我们利用该模型研究健康冲击对健康、劳动力供给、收入和收入不平等的影响。我们还模拟了向未获得雇主提供保险的经济主体提供公共保险的情形。尽管这会大幅增加医疗支出，但它会为低技能劳动者形成正向的劳动力供给激励，同时降低社会保险、Medicaid 和免费医疗的成本。该项目的净成本适中，并且在平衡预算模拟中，所有模型经济主体的事前境况都得到改善。

abstract.text: We provide necessary and sufficient conditions for linking preferences for personal and social consumption and attitudes toward risk. We also offer an experimental test of the theory in which subjects were confronted with risky personal choices, riskless social choices, and risky social choices. Revealed preference tests show that subject choices are generally consistent within each choice domain but frequently involve at least some errors. We test for consistency across choice domains using a revealed preference test that accounts for these errors. The choices of a large majority of subjects are consistent with the predictions of our theory.

10.1086/739832.abstractZh: 我们给出了将个人消费偏好与社会消费偏好以及风险态度联系起来的充分必要条件。我们还对该理论进行了实验检验，实验中受试者面对有风险的个人选择、无风险的社会选择和有风险的社会选择。显示性偏好检验表明，受试者的选择在各个选择域内大体一致，但常常至少包含一些错误。我们使用一种考虑这些错误的显示性偏好检验来考察不同选择域之间的一致性。绝大多数受试者的选择与我们的理论预测相一致。

abstract.text: Private signals model noisy information about an unknown state. Although these signals are called private, they may still carry information about each other. Our paper introduces the concept of private private signals, which contain information about the state but not about other signals. To achieve privacy, signal quality may need to be sacrificed. We study the informativeness of private private signals and characterize those that are optimal in the sense that they cannot be made more informative without violating privacy. We discuss implications for privacy in recommendation systems, information design, causal inference, and mechanism design.

10.1086/739833.abstractZh: 私人信号刻画关于未知状态的噪声信息。尽管这些信号被称为私人信号，它们仍可能携带关于彼此的信息。本文引入私人—私人信号（private private signals）的概念：这类信号包含关于状态的信息，但不包含关于其他信号的信息。为实现隐私，可能不得不牺牲信号质量。我们研究私人—私人信号的信息量，并刻画如下意义上最优的信号：在不违反隐私的前提下，其信息量无法再提高。我们讨论这对推荐系统、信息设计、因果推断和机制设计中隐私问题的启示。

abstract.text: We develop and test a model of social duties. The model distinguishes unconditional duties to take or avoid certain actions from conditional duties that depend on the actions’ payoffs. It also distinguishes strict duties (must do) from liberal duties (ought to do). The disutility associated with duty violation depends on the duty’s strictness and is proportional to the externality the violation causes. The model rationalizes behavioral patterns that are incompatible with consequentialist preferences. Our tests comprise parameter estimation based on subjects’ behavior across different situations as well as measurement of duties through spectators’ appropriateness ratings.

10.1086/739834.abstractZh: 我们构建并检验了一个社会义务模型。该模型区分了采取或避免某些行动的无条件义务与取决于行动收益的有条件义务，也区分了严格义务（必须做）与宽松义务（应当做）。违反义务所带来的负效用取决于义务的严格程度，并与违反义务所造成的外部性成比例。该模型能够合理解释与后果主义偏好不相容的行为模式。我们的检验包括基于受试者在不同情境中的行为进行参数估计，以及通过旁观者的适当性评分来测量义务。

abstract.text: We analyze a fundamental dilemma and time-inconsistency problem facing climate-concerned producers of natural gas. In the short term, it is tempting to produce more to outcompete coal. When this policy is anticipated, however, investments in renewables fall and emissions may ultimately increase. When the gas producers cannot precommit, their policies can be counterproductive. A simulated version applied to Europe verifies that the gas trap is quantitatively important. We discuss the robustness of this result and possible solutions, ranging from direct investments in renewables to taxes on the search and exploration of gas.

10.1086/740172.abstractZh: 我们分析关注气候的天然气生产商面临的一个根本性两难与时间不一致问题。短期内，多生产以在竞争中压过煤炭颇具吸引力。然而，当这一政策被预期到时，对可再生能源的投资会下降，排放最终可能反而增加。当天然气生产商无法预先承诺时，其政策可能适得其反。一个应用于欧洲的模拟版本验证了天然气陷阱在数量上具有重要意义。我们讨论这一结果的稳健性以及可能的解决方案，从直接投资于可再生能源到对天然气的勘探与寻找征税。

abstract.text: This paper examines how training a ects productivity across hierarchical layers within organizations. After a randomized training program for frontline employees at a government agency, trained workers' output increased while their requests for managerial assistance fell. This freed managers to focus on strategic tasks { particularly managers with the strongest connections to trained employees. A structural model of organizational hierarchies shows that spillovers to managers account for approximately 45% of the program's total benefi ts, indicating that evaluations focused solely on individual trainees may substantially understate the full value of training investments.

10.1086/740219.abstractZh: 本文考察培训如何影响组织内部各层级的生产率。在一家政府机构对一线员工实施随机培训项目后，受训员工的产出增加，而其向管理层寻求协助的请求减少。这使管理者得以专注于战略性任务，尤其是与受训员工联系最紧密的管理者。一个组织层级结构模型表明，对管理者的溢出效应约占该项目总收益的45%，这说明仅聚焦于个体受训者的评估可能大幅低估培训投资的全部价值。

abstract.text: We use equity returns to construct a time-varying measure of the zero-beta interest rate: the expected return of a stock portfolio orthogonal to the stochastic discount factor. In contrast to safe rates, the zero-beta rate fits the aggregate consumption Euler equation remarkably well both unconditionally and conditional on monetary policy shocks and is high, volatile, and persistent enough to explain the average return and most of the volatility of the market portfolio. The puzzle is why safe rates are so low, stable, and disconnected from both consumption and the zero-beta rate.

10.1086/740220.abstractZh: 我们利用股票收益率构造零贝塔利率的时变度量：即与随机贴现因子正交的股票组合的预期收益率。与安全利率不同，零贝塔利率无论无条件还是在以货币政策冲击为条件时，都能很好地拟合总量消费欧拉方程，并且其水平足够高、波动足够大、持续性足够强，从而能够解释市场组合的平均收益率及其大部分波动率。真正的谜题在于，安全利率为何如此之低、如此稳定，并且与消费和零贝塔利率都脱节。

abstract.text: In a field experiment among US university students, incentives for sleep increase both sleep and academic performance. Our primary intervention pairs bedtime reminders with morning feedback and immediate rewards for sleeping at least 7 hours on weeknights. The intervention raises the share of weeknights with 7+ hours of sleep by 26% and average sleep by 19 minutes during a 4-week treatment period, with posttreatment effects of 8 minutes. Immediate incentives outperform both delayed incentives and reminders/feedback alone during treatment but have no distinguishable impacts posttreatment. The primary intervention improves average semester course performance by 0.075–0.089 grade points, a 0.10–0.11 standard deviation increase. Our results demonstrate that incentives targeting sleep can be a cost-effective approach to improve educational outcomes.

10.1086/740221.abstractZh: 在一项针对美国大学生的实地实验中，睡眠激励同时提高了睡眠和学业表现。我们的主要干预措施将就寝提醒与晨间反馈以及对工作日夜间至少睡满7小时的即时奖励相结合。在为期4周的处理期内，该干预使睡眠达到7小时以上的工作日夜间占比提高26%，平均睡眠时间增加19分钟，处理后的效应为8分钟。即时激励在处理期内优于延迟激励以及仅提供提醒/反馈，但在处理后没有可区分的影響。主要干预使学期课程平均成绩提高0.075–0.089个绩点，相当于提高0.10–0.11个标准差。我们的结果表明，针对睡眠的激励可以成为改善教育结果的一种成本有效方法。

abstract.text: We analyze acquisitions in US power plants by using rich data on hourly productivity and thousands of ownership changes. We find a 2% average increase in efficiency for acquired plants, beginning 5 months after acquisition. Efficiency gains rise to 5% under direct ownership changes, with no significant change when only parent ownership changes. Investigating the mechanisms, three-quarters of the efficiency gain is attributed to increased productive efficiency, while the rest comes from dynamic efficiency through changes in production allocation. Our evidence suggests that high-productivity firms buy underperforming assets from low-productivity firms and make them as productive as their existing assets through operational improvements.

10.1086/740222.abstractZh: 我们利用关于小时生产率以及数千次所有权变更的丰富数据，分析美国发电厂的收购。我们发现，被收购电厂的平均效率提高 2%，这一提升在收购后 5 个月开始显现。在直接所有权变更下，效率提升达到 5%；而当仅母公司所有权发生变更时，效率没有显著变化。在机制方面，效率提升的四分之三归因于生产效率提高，其余部分来自通过改变生产配置实现的动态效率。我们的证据表明，高生产率企业从低生产率企业手中购买表现不佳的资产，并通过运营改善使其达到与自身现有资产相同的生产率水平。

abstract.text: We state conditions under which choice data suffice to identify preferences when consumers may not be fully informed about attributes of goods. Our approach can be used to test for full information, forecast how consumers will respond to information, and conduct welfare analysis when consumers are imperfectly informed. In a lab experiment, we successfully forecast the average response to new information when consumers engage in costly search. In data from Expedia, our method identifies which attribute was not immediately visible to consumers in search results and allows us to compute the value of additional information.

10.1086/740223.abstractZh: 我们给出条件，在这些条件下，当消费者可能并未充分了解商品属性时，选择数据足以识别偏好。我们的方法可用于检验完全信息、预测消费者对信息的反应，以及在消费者信息不完全时进行福利分析。在一项实验室实验中，当消费者进行有成本的搜索时，我们成功预测了消费者对新信息的平均反应。在来自 Expedia 的数据中，我们的方法识别出消费者在搜索结果中未能立即看到的属性，并使我们能够计算额外信息的价值。

abstract.text: To study long-run large-scale early childhood policies, this paper incorporates early childhood investments into a general equilibrium heterogeneous agent overlapping generations model calibrated using US data. A randomized controlled trial evaluation of a short-run small-scale early childhood program in the model predicts effects on children’s education and income that are similar to the empirical evidence. A long-run large-scale program, however, yields over twice as large welfare gains as those of a short-run small-scale program even after considering general equilibrium and taxation effects. Key to this difference is that investing in a child not only improves her skills but also creates better ancestors for future generations.

10.1086/740224.abstractZh: 为研究长期大规模幼儿教育政策，本文将对幼儿教育的投资纳入一个使用美国数据校准的一般均衡异质性经济主体世代交叠模型。模型中对一项短期小规模幼儿教育项目的随机对照试验评估所预测的儿童教育与收入效应，与经验证据相近。然而，长期大规模项目所带来的福利收益，即使考虑一般均衡与税收效应之后，仍超过短期小规模项目的两倍。造成这一差异的关键在于，对儿童的投资不仅提升其自身技能，还为其后代创造了更好的祖先。

abstract.text: Mayshar, Moav, and Pascali apply an instrumental variables identification strategy to data from nearly 1,000 societies included in the Ethnographic Atlas to claim that cultivation of cereals (appropriable by elites), rather than increased land productivity following the adoption of agriculture, led to the development of the state. We show two things. (1) Evidence for the appropriability theory holds when moving from a tribe-chiefdom to a state and not more broadly. (2) Conclusions are driven by a handful of outliers with statistical significance at the 10% level lost with winsorization at 2.1% (or trimming at 1.2%) of locations by cereal advantage.

10.1086/740225.abstractZh: Mayshar、Moav和Pascali采用工具变量识别策略，对《民族志地图集》中近1000个社会的数据进行分析，认为是谷物的种植（被精英阶层占有）而非农业采用后土地生产力的提高，促成了国家的形成。我们的研究揭示了两点：(1) 当从部落首领制转向国家制时，支持占有理论的证据更为明显，而不仅仅是在更广泛的范围内；(2) 结论的成立依赖于少数具有统计显著性的异常案例，但当谷物占有优势导致10%的地点在2.1%的水平上失去统计显著性，或者在1.2%的水平上减少时，结论的有效性就会受到影响。

abstract.text: We study the impact of financial aid on upward mobility. We estimate the causal impacts of a Colombian policy targeting high-achieving, low-socioeconomic-status students on later-life educational and labor market outcomes. Using regression discontinuity design, difference-in-differences, and population-wide administrative microdata, we find that the policy boosted attendance and completion at high-value-added colleges, particularly in STEM fields. Improved college quality led to greater skill development. Nine years later, recipients earn 18 log points more and are more likely to reach the top 1%.
