The policy narrowed socioeconomic gaps in college quality, attainment, skill development, earnings, and returns to ability, improving equity and efficiency.

10.1086/740226.abstractZh: 我们研究财政援助对向上流动的影响。我们估计了哥伦比亚一项针对成绩优异、社会经济地位较低学生的政策对日后教育和劳动力市场结果的因果影响。利用断点回归设计、双重差分以及覆盖全体人口的行政微观数据，我们发现该政策提高了高附加值大学的入学率和完成率，尤其是在 STEM 领域。大学质量的改善带来了更大的技能发展。九年后，受益者的收入高出 18 个对数点，且更有可能进入收入前 1%。该政策缩小了在大学质量、学业完成、技能发展、收入和能力回报方面的社会经济差距，改善了公平与效率。

abstract.text: Health insurance is increasingly provided through managed competition, in which subsidies for consumers and risk adjustment for insurers are key market design instruments. We illustrate theoretically that, in markets with adverse selection, subsidies provide greater flexibility in tailoring premiums to heterogeneous buyers, and produce equilibria with lower markups and greater enrollment. We assess these effects quantitatively using estimates from the California ACA marketplace.

10.1086/740234.abstractZh: 健康保险越来越多地通过管理式竞争来提供，其中对消费者的补贴和对保险公司的风险调整是市场设计的关键手段。我们从理论上说明，在存在逆向选择的市场中，补贴能够更灵活地调整保费，以适应不同消费者的需求，并促成具有较低加价率和更高参保率的均衡状态。我们通过加州ACA市场的数据定量评估这些效应。

abstract.text: An updating rule specifies how an agent reacts to information. It is Blackwell monotone if more information is always better for an agent in any decision problem and strictly Blackwell monotone if, in addition, every strict information improvement is strictly better in some decision problem. Bayes’s law is strictly Blackwell monotone. Within a broad class of updating rules—those that distort Bayesian posteriors in a signal-independent manner—it is the only strictly Blackwell-monotone updating rule. If decisions are evaluated nonpaternalistically (according to an agent’s beliefs), the Blackwell-monotone updating rules are affine distortions of Bayesian posteriors.

10.1086/741272.abstractZh: 更新规则规定经济主体如何对信息作出反应。若在任何决策问题中更多信息对经济主体总是更好，则该更新规则是布莱克韦尔单调的；若此外每一严格的信息改进都在某个决策问题中严格更好，则它是严格布莱克韦尔单调的。贝叶斯法则严格布莱克韦尔单调。在一大类更新规则——即以与信号无关的方式扭曲贝叶斯后验的更新规则——中，它是唯一严格布莱克韦尔单调的更新规则。若非家长主义地评价决策（依据经济主体的信念），则布莱克韦尔单调的更新规则是贝叶斯后验的仿射扭曲。

abstract.text: I propose a general theory of strategic network formation based on increasing marginal linking costs and vertical heterogeneity among the players. In the spirit of revealed preference, I describe the entire set of graphs that can be stable, without making any parametric assumptions about players’ preferences. Stable graphs feature assortativity and clustering, and I highlight conditions that lead to hierarchies and cliquish behavior. Extensions shed light on which findings are robust and which are more fragile. Collectively, these results map interpretable properties of preferences to particular network structures and furnish new tools to study strategic network formation.

10.1086/741274.abstractZh: 我提出一个关于策略性网络形成的一般理论，该理论基于递增的边际连接成本以及经济主体之间的纵向异质性。遵循显示性偏好的思路，我描述了所有可能稳定的图集合，而不对经济主体的偏好作任何参数化假设。稳定图具有同配性和聚类特征，我强调了导致层级结构和派系行为的条件。扩展分析揭示了哪些发现是稳健的、哪些则较为脆弱。总体而言，这些结果将可解释的偏好属性映射到特定的网络结构，并为研究策略性网络形成提供了新的工具。

abstract.text: We study optimal service allocation through queues when agents have homogeneous preferences and must be incentivized to enter and remain in the queue. The designer controls entry, exit, service priority, and information about queue priorities. Under a mild regularity condition, the optimal mechanism admits agents only up to a cutoff queue length, never removes admitted agents, serves them according to a first-come, first-served (FCFS) rule, and provides no information beyond recommendations. FCFS is also necessary for optimality in a rich domain. The result identifies a new role for queue disciplines in regulating agents’ beliefs and dynamic incentives, and uncovers a hitherto unrecognized virtue of FCFS in this regard.

10.1086/741622.abstractZh: 我们研究当经济主体具有同质偏好且必须被激励进入并留在队列中时，通过排队进行的最优服务配置。设计者控制进入、退出、服务优先级以及关于队列优先级的信息。在一个温和的正则条件下，最优机制仅允许队列长度不超过某一临界值的进入者，从不移除已进入者，按照先到先服务（FCFS）规则为其提供服务，并且除建议之外不提供任何信息。在一个丰富的定义域中，FCFS 也是最优性的必要条件。该结果识别出队列规则在调节经济主体信念与动态激励方面的新作用，并揭示了 FCFS 在这方面此前未被认识到的优点。

abstract.text: We consider estimation and inference for a regression coefficient in panels with interactive fixed effects (i.e., a factor structure). We show that previously developed estimators and confidence intervals (CIs) are heavily biased and size distorted when some of the factors are weak. Combining the theory of minimax linear estimation with a nuclear norm bound on the error of an initial estimate of the interactive effects, we propose estimators with improved rates of convergence and uniformly valid CIs allowing for weak factors. Our method substantially outperforms conventional approaches when factors are weak, with little cost to estimation error when factors are strong.

10.1086/741623.abstractZh: 我们考虑在具有交互固定效应（即因子结构）的面板中对回归系数进行估计和推断。我们表明，当部分因子较弱时，已有估计量和置信区间（CI）存在严重偏差且规模失真。我们将极小极大线性估计理论与对交互效应初始估计误差的核范数界相结合，提出具有改进收敛速率且允许弱因子的均匀有效置信区间的估计量。当因子较弱时，我们的方法大幅优于常规方法；当因子较强时，估计误差的代价很小。

abstract.text: We develop an asset demand system to analyze the equilibrium relation between international portfolio holdings and flows, exchange rates, and asset prices across all countries. We introduce a nested logit model of asset demand, for which we develop a new identification strategy by instrumental variables. Averaged across years and issuer countries, the demand elasticities are 27.9 for short-term debt, 3.2 for long-term debt, and 1.2 for equity. These demand elasticities are empirical targets for international macro models that feature inelastic demand to resolve long-standing puzzles in international finance. We use the estimated demand system to decompose the variation in exchange rates and asset prices into portfolio flows and shifts in asset demand to interpret economic events such as the European sovereign debt crisis and to estimate the convenience yields on US assets. In units of annual expected returns, the convenience yield is 1.41% on the US dollar, 2.71% on US long-term debt, and 0.50% on US equity.

10.1086/741624.abstractZh: 我们构建了一个资产需求系统，用以分析所有国家之间的国际组合持有与流动、汇率和资产价格之间的均衡关系。我们引入了一个嵌套 logit 资产需求模型，并为此开发了一种基于工具变量的新识别策略。按年份和发行国平均，短期债务的需求弹性为 27.9，长期债务为 3.2，股票为 1.2。这些需求弹性为国际宏观模型提供了经验目标，这些模型以需求缺乏弹性为特征，用以解释国际金融中长期存在的谜题。我们使用估计出的需求系统将汇率和资产价格的变化分解为组合流动和资产需求变动，以解读欧洲主权债务危机等经济事件，并估计美国资产的便利收益率。以年化预期收益率计，美元的便利收益率为 1.41%，美国长期债务为 2.71%，美国股票为 0.50%。

abstract.text: We study changes in markups across 70 product markets from 2006 to 2018. A growing literature has documented rising markups using a production function approach. We instead estimate demand and invert firms’ first-order pricing conditions to infer markups. To make the method scalable, we propose estimating nested logit demand models using household panel data to automate the assignment of products to nests. We find an overall upward trend in markups, with considerable heterogeneity across and within product markets. These increases are primarily driven by changes in firms’ marginal costs and households’ price sensitivity instead of changes in firm ownership.

10.1086/741641.abstractZh: 我们研究了2006年至2018年间70个产品市场的加成率变化。越来越多的文献使用生产函数方法记录了加成率的上升。我们转而估计需求并反演企业的一阶定价条件以推断加成率。为使该方法具有可扩展性，我们提出使用家庭面板数据估计嵌套logit需求模型，以自动完成产品到嵌套的分配。我们发现加成率总体呈上升趋势，且在产品市场之间和内部存在相当大的异质性。这些上升主要由企业边际成本和家庭价格敏感度的变化驱动，而非企业所有权的变化。

abstract.text: Despite serving as one of the more celebrated relationships in health economics, evidence on the relationship between education and health remains quite mixed–with limited research devoted to how these effects evolve later in life. Leveraging a 1972 compulsory schooling reform within the United Kingdom, this paper examines the effects of education on health and health care utilization over the life cycle. Our regression discontinuity estimates suggest that the reform led to substantial reductions in hospitalization among men for lifestyle-related conditions–with these effects varying heterogeneously over the life cycle.

10.1086/741687.abstractZh: 尽管教育与健康之间的关系在健康经济学中备受关注，但关于这一关系的证据仍然相当零散——针对这些影响在人生后期如何演变的研究非常有限。本文利用1972年英国实施的义务教育改革，探讨了教育对生命周期中健康与医疗利用的影响。我们的回归不连续估计表明，该改革显著减少了男性因生活方式相关疾病而住院的情况，而这些影响在生命周期中表现出不同的变化特征。

abstract.text: Recent years have seen tremendous advances in the theory and application of sequential experiments. While these experiments are not always designed with hypothesis testing in mind, researchers may still be interested in performing tests after the experiment is completed. The purpose of this paper is to aid in the development of optimal tests for sequential experiments by analyzing their asymptotic properties. Our key finding is that the asymptotic power function of any test can be matched by a test in a limit experiment where a Gaussian process is observed for each treatment, and inference is made for the drifts of these processes. This result has important implications, including a powerful sufficiency result: any candidate test only needs to rely on a fixed set of statistics, regardless of the type of sequential experiment. These statistics are the number of times each treatment has been sampled by the end of the experiment, along with final value of the score (for parametric models) or efficient influence function (for non-parametric models) process for each treatment. We then characterize asymptotically optimal tests under various restrictions such as unbiasedness, α-spending constraints etc. Finally, we apply our our results to three key classes of sequential experiments: costly sampling, group sequential trials, and bandit experiments, and show how optimal inference can be conducted in these scenarios.

10.1086/742418.abstractZh: 近年来，序贯实验的理论与应用取得了巨大进展。尽管这些实验在设计时并不总是以假设检验为目的，研究者仍可能希望在实验完成后进行检验。本文旨在通过分析序贯实验的渐近性质，为构建最优检验提供帮助。我们的核心发现是：任何检验的渐近功效函数，都可以由一个极限实验中的检验来匹配；在该极限实验中，对每种处理分别观测一个高斯过程，并针对这些过程的漂移项进行推断。这一结果具有重要含义，其中包括一个强有力的充分性结果：无论序贯实验属于何种类型，任何候选检验都只需依赖一组固定的统计量。这些统计量是实验结束时每种处理被抽样的次数，以及每种处理对应的得分过程（参数模型）或有效影响函数过程（非参数模型）的最终值。随后，我们刻画了在无偏性、α 消耗约束等各种限制条件下的渐近最优检验。最后，我们将结果应用于三类关键的序贯实验：有成本抽样、分组序贯试验和 bandit 实验，并展示在这些情形下如何进行最优推断。

abstract.text: I derive a formula for the equilibrium distribution of markups in the search-theoretic model of imperfect competition of Butters (1977), Varian (1980), and Burdett andJudd (1983).The level of markups and the sign of the relationship between a seller's markup and its size depends on the extent of search frictions, as well as on other deep parameters. Markups are efficient. Markups are positive even though the varieties produced by sellers are perfect substitutes. Markups are heterogeneous even when all sellers operate the same production technology. Markups depend on size, even though the substitutability between a variety and the others does not depend on how much of that variety is consumed. Interpreting these markups through the lens of the monopolistic competition model of Dixit and Stiglitz (1977) would lead one to recover incorrect and unstable buyers' preferences. Interpreting these markups through the lens of the Dixit-Stiglitz model would also leads to incorrect policy recommendations. These results are a cautionary note on recent work in macroeconomics.

10.1086/742420.abstractZh: 我推导出Butters（1977）、Varian（1980）和Burdett and Judd（1983）不完全竞争搜索理论模型中加成均衡分布的公式。加成水平以及卖方加成与其规模之间关系的符号，取决于搜索摩擦的程度以及其他深层参数。加成是有效率的。即使卖方生产的品种是完全替代品，加成仍为正。即使所有卖方采用相同的生产技术，加成仍具有异质性。加成取决于规模，即使某一品种与其他品种之间的可替代性并不取决于该品种的消费量。通过Dixit and Stiglitz（1977）垄断竞争模型的视角来解释这些加成，会导致恢复出错误且不稳定的买方偏好。通过Dixit-Stiglitz模型的视角来解释这些加成，还会导致错误的政策建议。这些结果对宏观经济学近期研究构成了警示。

abstract.text: The mechanisms driving disparities in mental health care are not well understood. This paper develops a structural model of diagnosis for attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), highlighting how patient and physician factors can result in disparities. Using electronic health record data, I estimate model parameters and decompose the observed male∶female ADHD diagnostic difference of 2.3∶1. Simulations show that only 20%–25% of this diagnostic difference can be explained by underlying symptom prevalence, with the majority driven by differences in diagnostic thresholds. I find that physicians view missed diagnosis to be costlier for their male patients, which I argue may have economic justifications.

10.1086/742421.abstractZh: 心理健康保健差异的驱动机制尚不明确。本文构建了一个注意力缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）诊断的结构模型，强调患者和医生因素如何导致差异。利用电子健康记录数据，我估计了模型参数，并分解了观察到的男性∶女性ADHD诊断差异2.3∶1。模拟显示，该诊断差异中仅有20%–25%可由潜在症状患病率解释，大部分由诊断阈值差异驱动。我发现医生认为漏诊对其男性患者的成本更高，我认为这可能有经济上的合理性。

abstract.text: A rent guarantee insurance (RGI) policy makes a limited number of rent payments to the landlord on behalf of an insured tenant unable to pay rent due to a negative income or health expenditure shock. We introduce RGI in a rich quantitative equilibrium model of housing insecurity and show it increases welfare by improving risk sharing across idiosyncratic and aggregate states of the world, reducing the need for a large security deposits, and reducing homelessness which imposes large costs on society. While unrestricted access to RGI is not financially viable due to moral hazard and adverse selection, restricting access can restore viability. Private insurers target better off renters to break even, while public insurers focus on households most at-risk of homelessness. Stronger tenant protections increase the effectiveness of RGI.

10.1086/742422.abstractZh: 租金保证保险（RGI）政策代表参保租户向房东支付有限次数的租金，适用于租户因负向收入冲击或医疗支出冲击而无力支付租金的情形。我们将RGI引入一个关于住房不安全的丰富定量均衡模型，结果表明，RGI通过改善对个体特异性冲击和总体冲击的风险分担、减少对大额押金的需求，以及减少无家可归现象（无家可归会给社会带来巨大成本），提高了福利。由于道德风险和逆向选择，无限制地获得RGI在财务上不可行，但限制获得条件可以恢复可行性。私人保险公司以较富裕的租户为目标以实现收支平衡，而公共保险公司则聚焦于最有可能无家可归的家庭。更强的租户保护提高了RGI的有效性。

abstract.text: We examine the intergenerational effect of education policy on crime. Using administrative data that link outcomes across generations with crime records, we show that the Swedish comprehensive school reform, gradually implemented between 1949 and 1962, reduced conviction rates both for the generation directly affected and for their sons. The reduction occurred across several types of crime. Mediation analysis suggests that the key channels include increased parental educational attainment and household income, as well as reduced criminal behavior among fathers.

10.1086/742423.abstractZh: 我们考察教育政策对犯罪的代际影响。利用将各代结果与犯罪记录相连接的行政数据，我们表明，1949 年至 1962 年间逐步实施的瑞典综合学校改革，既降低了直接受影响那一代的定罪率，也降低了其儿子的定罪率。这一下降出现在多种犯罪类型上。中介分析表明，关键渠道包括父母受教育程度提高、家庭收入增加，以及父亲犯罪行为的减少。

abstract.text: We propose a practical and robust method for making inference on average treatment effects estimated by synthetic controls. We develop a K-fold cross-fitting procedure for bias correction. To avoid the difficult estimation of the long-run variance, inference is based on a self-normalized t-statistic, which has an asymptotically pivotal t-distribution. Our t-test is easy to implement, provably robust against misspecification, and valid with stationary and nonstationary data. It demonstrates an excellent small-sample performance in application-based simulations and performs well relative to other methods. We illustrate the usefulness of the t-test by revisiting the effect of carbon taxes on emissions.

10.1086/742424.abstractZh: 我们提出一种实用且稳健的方法，用于对合成控制法估计的平均处理效应进行推断。我们构建了一个K折交叉拟合程序以进行偏差校正。为避免长期方差估计的困难，推断基于自归一化t统计量，该统计量具有渐近枢轴t分布。我们的t检验易于实施，可证明对模型错误设定具有稳健性，且适用于平稳和非平稳数据。在基于应用的模拟中，它展现出优异的小样本表现，并相对于其他方法表现良好。我们通过重新审视碳税对排放的影响来说明该t检验的实用性。

abstract.text: An informed seller designs a dynamic mechanism to sell an experience good. The seller has partial information about the product match, which affects the buyer's private consumption experience. We characterize equilibrium mechanisms of this dynamic informed principal problem. The belief gap between the informed seller and the uninformed buyer, coupled with the buyer's learning, gives rise to mechanisms that provide the skeptical buyer with limited access to the product and an option to upgrade if the buyer is swayed by a good experience. Depending on the seller's screening technology, this takes the form of free/discounted trials or tiered pricing, which are prevalent in digital markets. In contrast to static environments, having consumer data can reduce sellers' revenue in equilibrium, as they fine-tune the dynamic design with their data forecasting the buyer's learning process.

10.1086/742434.abstractZh: 拥有信息的卖方设计一种动态机制来销售体验品。卖方掌握关于产品匹配程度的部分信息，该信息会影响买方的私人消费体验。我们刻画了这一动态知情委托人问题的均衡机制。知情卖方与不知情买方之间的信念差距，加之买方的学习过程，共同催生出这样的机制：向持怀疑态度的买方提供有限的产品获取机会，并赋予其在被良好体验说服时进行升级的选项。取决于卖方的筛选技术，这表现为免费/折扣试用或分层定价，这些做法在数字市场中十分普遍。与静态环境相比，拥有消费者数据在均衡中反而可能降低卖方收入，因为卖方会利用其预测买方学习过程的数据对动态设计进行微调。

abstract.text: We study the macroeconomic implications of asymmetric information in capital markets. We build a quantitative capital-accumulation model in which capital is traded in illiquid markets, with sellers having more information about capital quality than buyers. Asymmetric information distorts the terms of trade for sellers of high-quality capital, who list higher prices and are willing to accept lower trading probabilities to signal their type. Led by the model's predictions, we measure the distortions from asymmetric information by studying the relationship between listed prices and trading probabilities in a unique dataset of individual capital units listed for trade. By combining the empirical measurement with the model, we show that information asymmetries can play a quantitatively large role during economic crises when the degree of asymmetric information deteriorates.

10.1086/742435.abstractZh: 我们研究资本市场中信息不对称的宏观经济含义。我们构建一个数量资本积累模型，其中资本在流动性不足的市场上交易，卖方对资本质量的信息多于买方。信息不对称扭曲了高质量资本卖方的交易条件，这些卖方会挂出更高的价格，并愿意接受更低的成交概率以传递其类型信号。在模型预测的引导下，我们通过研究一个独特的单件资本挂牌交易数据集中的挂牌价格与成交概率之间的关系，来度量信息不对称造成的扭曲。通过将实证度量与模型相结合，我们表明，当信息不对称程度恶化时，信息不对称在经济危机期间可能发挥数量上很大的作用。NBER 工作论文系列的机构订阅者以及发展中国家居民可在 www.nber.org 免费下载本文。

abstract.text: We study the frictions in dealer-intermediation in residential real estate through the lens of "iBuyers," technology entrants, who purchase and sell residential real estate through online platforms.iBuyers supply liquidity to households by allowing them to avoid a lengthy sale process. They sell houses quickly and earn a 5% spread. Their prices are well explained by a simple hedonic model, consistent with their use of algorithmic pricing.iBuyers choose to intermediate in markets that are liquid, and in which automated valuation models have low pricing error. These facts suggest that iBuyers' speedy offers may come at the cost of information loss concerning house attributes that are difficult to capture in an algorithm, resulting in adverse selection. We calibrate a dynamic structural search model with adverse selection to understand and quantify the economic forces underlying the tradeoffs of dealer intermediation in this market. The model reveals the central tradeoff to intermediating in residential real estate. To provide valuable liquidity service, transactions must be closed quickly. Yet, the intermediary must also be able to price houses accurately to avoid adverse selection, which is difficult to accomplish quickly. We find that low underlying liquidity exacerbates adverse selection. Our analysis suggests that iBuyers' technology provides a middle ground: they can transact quickly limiting information loss. Even with this technology, intermediation is only profitable in the most liquid and easy to value houses. Therefore, iBuyers' technology allows them to supply liquidity, but only in pockets where it is relatively least valuable. We also find limited scope for dealer intermediation even with improved pricing technology, suggesting that underlying liquidity will be an impediment for intermediation in the future.

10.1086/742710.abstractZh: 我们通过“iBuyers”这一技术进入者的视角，研究住宅房地产中交易商中介的摩擦。iBuyers通过在线平台购买和出售住宅房地产。iBuyers为家庭提供流动性，使家庭得以避免漫长的出售过程。它们快速出售房屋并赚取5%的价差。其价格可由一个简单的特征价格模型很好地解释，这与它们使用算法定价相一致。iBuyers选择在流动性较高、且自动估值模型定价误差较低的市场中进行中介。这些事实表明，iBuyers的快速报价可能以损失关于难以在算法中捕捉的房屋属性的信息为代价，从而导致逆向选择。我们校准了一个带有逆向选择的动态结构搜索模型，以理解和量化该市场中交易商中介权衡背后的经济力量。模型揭示了住宅房地产中介的核心权衡。为提供有价值的流动性服务，交易必须快速完成。然而，中介还必须能够准确定价房屋以避免逆向选择，而这很难快速做到。我们发现，较低的底层流动性会加剧逆向选择。我们的分析表明，iBuyers的技术提供了一种中间路径：它们可以快速交易，从而限制信息损失。即便拥有这种技术，中介也只有在流动性最高且最容易估值的房屋上才有利可图。因此，iBuyers的技术使它们能够提供流动性，但仅限于流动性相对最没有价值的局部市场。我们还发现，即便定价技术得到改进，交易商中介的空间也有限，这表明底层流动性在未来仍将是中介的障碍。

abstract.text: In this paper we provide new estimates of the impact of unions on nonunion wage setting. We allow the presence of unions to affect nonunion wages both through the typically discussed channel of nonunion firms emulating union wages in order to fend off the threat of unionisation and through a bargaining channel in which nonunion workers use the presence of union jobs as part of their outside option. We specify these channels in a search and bargaining model that includes union formation and, in our most complete model, the possibility of nonunion firm responses to the threat of unionisation. Our results indicate an important role played by union wage spillovers in lowering wages over the 1980-2010 period. We find de-unionisation can account for 38% of the decline in the mean hourly wage between 1980 and 2010, with two-thirds of that effect being due to spillovers. Both the traditional threat and bargaining channels are operational, with the bargaining channel being more important.

10.1086/742712.abstractZh: 本文对工会对非工会工资设定的影响提供了新的估计。我们允许工会的存在通过两个渠道影响非工会工资：一是通常讨论的非工会企业为抵御工会化威胁而模仿工会工资的渠道，二是议价渠道，即非工会劳动者将工会岗位的存在作为其外部选项的一部分。我们在一个包含工会形成的搜寻与议价模型中设定这些渠道，并在最完整的模型中纳入非工会企业对工会化威胁作出反应的可能性。结果表明，工会工资溢出在1980—2010年期间降低工资方面发挥了重要作用。我们发现，去工会化可以解释1980年至2010年间平均小时工资下降的38%，其中三分之二的效果来自溢出效应。传统的威胁渠道和议价渠道都在发挥作用，而议价渠道更为重要。

abstract.text: The U.S. shale boom has profoundly increased crude oil movements by both pipelines-the traditional mode of transportation-and railroads. This paper develops a model of how pipeline investment and railroad use are determined in equilibrium, emphasizing how railroads' flexibility allows them to compete with pipelines. We show that policies that address crude-by-rail's environmental externalities by increasing its costs should lead to large increases in pipeline investment and substitution of oil flows from rail to pipe. Similarly, we find that policies enjoining pipeline construction would cause 80-90% of the displaced oil to flow by rail instead.

10.1086/742713.abstractZh: 美国页岩油繁荣极大地增加了原油通过管道——传统运输方式——和铁路的运输量。本文构建了一个模型，刻画管道投资与铁路使用如何在均衡中被决定，并强调铁路的灵活性如何使其能够与管道竞争。我们表明，通过提高铁路原油运输成本来应对其环境外部性的政策，应当会导致管道投资大幅增加以及石油流从铁路向管道的替代。类似地，我们发现，禁止管道建设的政策会导致80%—90%被转移的石油转而通过铁路运输。

abstract.text: I examine how disruptions to students' environments propagate to their classmates to understand the mechanisms behind peer interactions in the classroom.I combine administrative and survey data from Chile with detailed measures of housing damages from the 2010 earthquake, one of the most violent ever recorded. Damages to a student's own home reduced achievement and raised self-reported cost of study effort. Average damages among classmates induced schools to reallocate resources towards student support and increased achievement. In contrast, dispersion in classmates' damages had heterogeneous achievement effects across the prior performance distribution, which schools did not appear to mitigate, pointing to peer interactions. Motivated by evidence suggesting students value classroom rank, I show that a game-of-status model of competition for grades rationalizes the findings. The results suggest that, beyond production complementarities and a desire to conform, a desire to compete could shape peer effects on learning.2 Examples of studies using naturally occurring exogenous variation in peer characteristics to account for confounding effects are Hoxby (2000); Angrist and Lang (2004); Hoxby and Weingarth (2005); Lavy, Paserman, and Schlosser (2012); Imberman, Kugler, and Sacerdote (2012).3 I gratefully acknowledge Prof. Sergio Ruiz of the Geology Department at the University of Chile, a leading expert on the seismic vulnerability of Chilean buildings, for feedback on the damage measure. The measure falls within Deterministic Earthquake Loss Estimation, which aims to estimate losses from a specific seismic event. It stands in contrast to Probabilistic Earthquake Loss Estimation, which aims to predict potential losses from many possible seismic events (McGuire (2004)).

10.1086/742714.abstractZh: 我考察学生所处环境的扰动如何传导至其同班同学，以理解课堂中同伴互动的机制。我将智利行政数据与调查数据，与2010年地震（有记录以来最强烈的地震之一）住房损失的详细度量相结合。学生自家住房受损降低了学业成绩，并提高了自我报告的学习努力成本。同班同学的平均受损程度促使学校将资源重新配置到学生支持上，并提高了学业成绩。相比之下，同班同学受损程度的离散度对学业成绩的影响在先前成绩分布上具有异质性，而学校似乎并未缓解这一影响，这指向同伴互动。受学生重视课堂排名的证据启发，我表明一个关于成绩竞争的“地位博弈”模型能够合理化这些发现。结果表明，除了生产互补性和从众意愿之外，竞争意愿也可能塑造同伴对学习的影响。2 使用同伴特征中自然发生的外生变异来控制混杂效应的研究示例包括 Hoxby（2000）；Angrist 和 Lang（2004）；Hoxby 和 Weingarth（2005）；Lavy、Paserman 和 Schlosser（2012）；Imberman、Kugler 和 Sacerdote（2012）。3 我衷心感谢智利大学地质系的 Sergio Ruiz 教授，他是智利建筑地震脆弱性领域的顶尖专家，感谢他对损失度量的反馈。该度量属于确定性地震损失估计，旨在估计特定地震事件造成的损失。它与概率性地震损失估计形成对比，后者旨在预测许多可能地震事件的潜在损失（McGuire（2004））。

abstract.text: We present a model where social media platforms offer plans that intermix entertaining content with digital advertising (“ads”). Users derive utility from entertainment and learn about their valuation for a product from ads. While some users are fully rational, others naïvely perceive digital ads as more informative than they actually are. We characterize the profit-maximizing business model of the platform and show that welfare is lower when the platform monetizes through advertising instead of subscription both for naïfs (because they are targeted by intense digital advertising, which makes them over-optimistic about product quality and over-purchase the product) and for sophisticates (because the inflated demand from naïfs increases the firm’s price). This negative welfare effect is intensified when the platform can offer mixed business models that separate the naïve and sophisticated users into different plans. Our results are robust to firm-level and platform-level competition, because digital ads soften competition between both firms and platforms. We also show how digital ad taxes can improve welfare.

10.1086/742715.abstractZh: 我们构建一个模型，其中社交媒体平台提供将娱乐内容与数字广告（“广告”）混合在一起的方案。用户从娱乐中获得效用，并从广告中了解自己对某一产品的估值。部分用户完全理性，另一些用户则天真地认为数字广告比其实际更具信息性。我们刻画了平台利润最大化的商业模式，并表明，当平台通过广告而非订阅实现变现时，福利对天真的用户和成熟的用户都更低：对天真的用户而言，他们成为密集数字广告的目标，这使他们过度乐观地判断产品质量并过度购买该产品；对成熟的用户而言，来自天真用户的需求膨胀抬高了企业设定的价格。当平台能够提供混合商业模式、将天真用户与成熟用户分隔到不同方案中时，这一负面的福利效应会加剧。由于数字广告会削弱企业之间以及平台之间的竞争，我们的结果对企业层面和平台层面的竞争均稳健。我们还说明了数字广告税如何能够改善福利。NBER 工作论文系列的机构订阅者以及发展中国家居民可在 www.nber.org 免费下载本文。

abstract.text: A quota mechanism, such as a mandatory grading curve, links together multiple decisions. We analyze the performance of quota mechanisms when the number of linked decisions is finite and the designer has imperfect knowledge of the type distribution. Using a new optimal transport approach, we derive an ex post decision error guarantee for quota mechanisms. This guarantee cannot be improved by any mechanisms without transfers. We quantify the sensitivity of quota mechanisms to errors in the designer’s estimate of the type distribution. Finally, we show that quotas are robust to a range of agents’ beliefs about each other.

10.1086/742716.abstractZh: 配额机制（例如强制性评分曲线）将多项决策联系在一起。我们分析了当关联决策数量有限且设计者对类型分布了解不完全时配额机制的表现。运用一种新的最优传输方法，我们推导出配额机制的事后决策误差保证。该保证无法被任何无转移支付机制改进。我们量化了配额机制对设计者类型分布估计误差的敏感性。最后，我们表明配额对经济主体关于彼此的一系列信念具有稳健性。

abstract.text: People predominantly talk within their identity groups. Conversations between majority-group members may, therefore, be crucial in shaping discrimination against minorities. In an experiment in India (N=3,397), nontransgender participants strongly discriminate against transgender workers when hiring for a grocery delivery, but a discussion with two nontransgender neighbors eliminates this discrimination in private postdiscussion choices. The discussion is 1.7 times more effective at reducing discrimination than information about transgender people’s legal rights, and effects partially persist after 1 month. The evidence is consistent with norm-based persuasion, in which pro-transgender participants are more vocal and create a perceived antidiscriminatory norm that reduces subsequent discrimination.

10.1086/742724.abstractZh: 人们主要在其身份群体内部进行交流。因此，多数群体成员之间的对话在形成对少数群体的歧视方面可能起着关键作用。在印度的一项实验中（样本量3,397人），非跨性别参与者在招聘杂货配送员时强烈歧视跨性别者，但通过与两位非跨性别邻居的对话，这种歧视在私人选择中得到了消除。这种对话在减少歧视方面比提供有关跨性别者法律权利的信息有效1.7倍，并且其效果在1个月后仍部分持续存在。这些证据与基于规范的说服理论一致，即支持跨性别者的参与者更积极发声，从而形成了一种被认为能够减少后续歧视的反歧视规范。

abstract.text: I study competition between state regulators in the US life insurance industry. States compete for insurers by setting lower capital requirements, but the costs of such actions are partially borne by other states. I document states’ behaviors and insurers’ responses to this competition and its effects on life insurance supply. I develop a quantitative model of the insurance market that captures states’ competition and insurers’ responses. I find that competition leads regulators to set lower capital requirements, which increases default risks but increases consumer surplus by lowering prices. On net, competition between regulators decreases total surplus and redistributes across states.

10.1086/742725.abstractZh: 我研究美国寿险业州监管者之间的竞争。各州通过设定较低的资本要求来争夺保险公司，但这种行为的成本部分由其他州承担。我记录了各州的行为、保险公司对这种竞争的反应，以及竞争对人寿保险供给的影响。我构建了一个保险市场的定量模型，刻画各州的竞争和保险公司的反应。我发现，竞争导致监管者设定较低的资本要求，这增加了违约风险，但通过降低价格提高了消费者剩余。净效应而言，监管者之间的竞争降低了总剩余，并在各州之间进行了再分配。

abstract.text: We measure the role of firm heterogeneity in counterfactual predictions of monopolistic competition trade models without parametric restrictions on the distribution of firm fundamentals. We show that two bilateral elasticity functions are sufficient to nonparametrically compute the counterfactual aggregate impact of trade shocks, and recover changes in economic fundamentals from observed data. These functions are identified from two semiparametric gravity equations governing the impact of bilateral trade costs on the extensive and intensive margins of firm-level exports. Applying our methodology, we estimate elasticity functions that imply an impact of trade costs on trade flows that falls when more firms serve a market because of smaller extensive margin responses. Compared to a baseline where elasticities are constant, firm heterogeneity amplifies both the gains from trade in countries with more exporter firms and the welfare gains of European market integration in 2003-2012.

10.1086/743331.abstractZh: 我们衡量企业异质性在垄断竞争贸易模型反事实预测中的作用，且不对企业基本面的分布施加参数限制。我们证明，两个双边弹性函数足以非参数地计算贸易冲击的反事实总量影响，并从观测数据中恢复经济基本面的变化。这两个函数由两个半参数引力方程识别，这些方程刻画双边贸易成本对企业层面出口的扩展边际和集约边际的影响。应用我们的方法，我们估计的弹性函数表明，当更多企业服务于某一市场时，贸易成本对贸易流量的影响会下降，因为扩展边际反应更小。与弹性为常数的基准情形相比，企业异质性既放大了出口企业更多的国家的贸易收益，也放大了2003—2012年欧洲市场一体化的福利收益。

abstract.text: Two office-motivated politicians compete for power by making promises to citizens. Unlike in voting models, a citizens' political activity is observable and subject to retaliation if the citizen happens to back the wrong politician. In equilibrium, a citizen supports the politician that is expected to win the political contest, not the one who promises her the most. Consequently, the incentives for politicians to redistribute resources and provide public goods are different from those in voting models. Citizens who are better able to coordinate with others receive more resources in equilibrium. Transition to democracy is not voluntary in this model.

10.1086/743332.abstractZh: 两位以职位为动机的政治家通过向公民作出承诺来争夺权力。与投票模型不同，公民的政治活动是可观测的，并且如果该公民恰好支持了错误的政治家，就会遭到报复。在均衡中，公民支持的是预期将赢得政治角逐的政治家，而不是向她承诺最多利益的那一位。因此，政治家重新分配资源和提供公共品的激励与投票模型中的情形不同。更有能力与他人协调的公民在均衡中获得更多资源。在该模型中，向民主的转型并非自愿的。

abstract.text: The current polarization of elites in the U.S., particularly in Congress, is frequently ascribed to the emergence of cohorts of ideologically extreme legislators replacing moderate ones. Politicians, however, do not operate as isolated agents, driven solely by their preferences. They act within organized parties, whose leaders exert control over the rank-and-file, directing support for and against policies. This paper shows that the omission of party discipline as a driver of political polarization is consequential for our understanding of this phenomenon. We present a multi-dimensional voting model and identification strategy designed to decouple the ideological preferences of lawmakers from the control exerted by their party leadership. Applying this structural framework to the U.S. Congress between 1927-2018, we find that the influence of leaders over their rank-and-file has been a growing driver of polarization in voting, particularly since the 1970s. In 2018, party discipline accounts for around 65% of the polarization in roll call voting. Our findings qualify the interpretation of -and in two important cases subvert -a number of empirical claims in the literature that measures polarization with models that lack a formal role for parties.

10.1086/743333.abstractZh: 当前美国精英群体、尤其是国会中的极化，常被归因于意识形态极端的新一批议员取代了温和派议员。然而，政治家并非作为孤立的、仅受自身偏好驱动的经济主体行事。他们在有组织的政党中行动，政党领袖对普通议员施加控制，引导其支持或反对各项政策。本文表明，将政党纪律作为政治极化的驱动因素加以忽略，会影响我们对这一现象的理解。我们提出一个多维投票模型和识别策略，旨在将立法者的意识形态偏好与其政党领袖所施加的控制区分开来。将这一结构框架应用于1927—2018年的美国国会，我们发现领袖对普通议员的影响力日益成为投票极化的驱动因素，尤其是自20世纪70年代以来。2018年，政党纪律约占唱名投票极化的大约65%。我们的发现限定了——并在两个重要情形下颠覆了——文献中若干实证主张的解释，这些主张使用未赋予政党正式角色的模型来度量极化。

abstract.text: We provide new theory and evidence on the resilience of internal city structure after a large shock, analyzing the atomic bombing of Hiroshima. Exploiting newly digitized data, we document that the city structure recovered within five years after the bombing. Our new dynamic quantitative model of internal city structure incorporates commuting, forward-looking location choices, migration frictions, agglomeration forces, and heterogeneous location fundamentals. Strong agglomeration forces in our estimated model explain Hiroshima's recovery, and we find an alternative equilibrium where the city center did not recover. These results highlight the role of agglomeration forces, multiple equilibria, and expectations in urban dynamics.

10.1086/743334.abstractZh: 我们提供了关于大震后城市内部结构恢复力的最新理论和证据，以广岛原子弹爆炸事件为研究对象。通过利用新数字化数据，我们发现城市结构在爆炸后五年内便开始恢复。我们新的动态量化模型考虑了通勤、前瞻性位置选择、迁移摩擦、聚集效应以及异质性的位置基础等因素。我们估计的模型中，强烈的聚集效应解释了广岛城市的恢复过程，同时我们还发现了一个城市中心未能恢复的另一个均衡状态。这些结果凸显了聚集效应、多重均衡以及预期在城市动态中的作用。

abstract.text: Optimal transportation policies depend on demand elasticities that interact across modes and vary across the population, but understanding how and why these elasticities vary has been an empirical challenge. Using an experiment with Uber in Egypt, we randomly assign large price discounts for transport services over a 3 month period to examine: (1) the demand for ride-hailing services, (2) the demand for total mobility (km/week), and (3) its contributions to external costs (e.g.congestion).A 50% discount more than quadruples Uber usage and induces an increase of nearly 49% in total mobility. These effects are stronger for women, who are less mobile at baseline and perceive public transit as unsafe. Technology-induced reductions in the price of ridehailing services could generate substantial benefits to users (4.3% of GDP) that would be accompanied by considerable increases in external costs (1% of GDP), with benefits accruing to the most affluent and costs being borne by the entire population.

10.1086/743387.abstractZh: 最优交通政策取决于在不同交通方式之间相互作用、并随人群而变化的需​​求弹性，但理解这些弹性如何以及为何变化一直是一个实证难题。我们利用在埃及与 Uber 开展的一项实验，在 3 个月期间随机分配大幅的交通服务价格折扣，以考察：(1) 网约车服务的需求，(2) 总出行需求（公里/周），以及 (3) 其对外部成本（如拥堵）的贡献。50% 的折扣使 Uber 使用量增加逾四倍，并使总出行量增加近 49%。这些效应在女性中更强，因为女性在基线时的出行更少，并认为公共交通不安全。技术带来的网约车服务价格下降可为用户带来可观收益（占 GDP 的 4.3%），同时伴随外部成本的大幅增加（占 GDP 的 1%），收益归于最富裕人群，而成本由全体人口承担。

abstract.text: Boys are less likely than girls to enter college, a gap often attributed to differences in noncognitive skills. We study how being classified as gifted – determined by having an IQ score of ≥116 – affects college entry for disadvantaged children in a large urban school district. We find increases of around 50 percent for marginally eligible boys, but only small effects for girls. There are also large effects for boys (but not girls) on course-taking and grades in middle and high school with no effects on standardized tests scores. These patterns suggest that gifted services raise the non-cognitive skills of underachieving boys, leading to gains in educational attainment.

10.1086/743389.abstractZh: 男孩进入大学的可能性低于女孩，这一差距常被归因于非认知技能的差异。我们研究在一个大型城市学区中，被认定为资优——认定标准为智商分数≥116——如何影响弱势儿童的大学入学。我们发现，对于处于资格边缘的男孩，大学入学率提高约50%，但对女孩的影响很小。在初中和高中的选课与成绩方面，男孩（而非女孩）也受到较大影响，但对标准化考试成绩没有影响。这些模式表明，资优服务提升了表现不佳男孩的非认知技能，从而带来教育获得的提升。

abstract.text: We leverage the introduction of the first antibiotic therapies in 1937 to examine the long-run effects of early childhood pneumonia on adult educational attainment, employment, income, and work-related disability. Using census data, we document large average gains on all outcomes, alongside substantial heterogeneity by race and gender. On average, Black men exhibit smaller schooling gains than white men but larger employment and earnings gains. Among Black men (and women), we identify a pronounced gradient in gains linked to systemic racial discrimination in the pre–Civil Rights era: individuals born in more discriminatory Jim Crow states realized much smaller gains than those born in less discriminatory states. There is no similar gradient among white Americans. Women of both races exhibit smaller education and earnings gains than men on average, consistent with cultural and institutional barriers to women's work. Our findings highlight the role of opportunities in shaping the extent to which investments in early-life health translate into longer run economic gains.

10.1086/743898.abstractZh: 我们利用1937年首批抗生素疗法的引入，考察幼儿期肺炎对成年后教育程度、就业、收入及工作相关残疾的长期影响。使用人口普查数据，我们记录了所有结果上的大幅平均改善，同时也发现按种族和性别存在显著异质性。平均而言，黑人男性的受教育程度改善小于白人男性，但就业和收入改善更大。在黑人男性（以及女性）中，我们发现改善幅度存在明显的梯度，这与民权运动前时代系统性的种族歧视相关：出生于歧视更严重的吉姆·克劳州的个体所实现的改善远小于出生于歧视较轻州的个体。美国白人中没有类似的梯度。两种种族的女性平均而言在教育程度和收入上的改善均小于男性，这与女性工作面临的文化和制度障碍相一致。我们的发现凸显了机会在决定早期健康投资能在多大程度上转化为更长期经济收益方面的作用。

abstract.text: This paper studies whether common leadership, defined as two firms sharing executives or board directors, contributes to collusion. Using an explicit measure of labor market collusion from unsealed court evidence, we find that the probability of collusion between two firms increases by 11 percentage points after the onset of common leadership, a ninefold increase over the baseline rate. These results are not driven by closeness of product or labor market competition. Our findings are consistent with the increasing attention toward common leadership under Clayton Act Section 8.

10.1086/743900.abstractZh: 本文研究共同领导——即两家企业共享高管或董事会成员——是否助长合谋。利用来自未封存法庭证据的劳动力市场合谋的明确度量，我们发现，在共同领导出现之后，两家企业之间发生合谋的概率上升11个百分点，为基准率的九倍。这些结果并非由产品市场或劳动力市场竞争的接近程度所驱动。我们的发现与《克莱顿法》第8条下对共同领导日益增加的关注相一致。NBER工作论文系列的机构订阅者以及发展中国家居民可在www.nber.org免费下载本文。

abstract.text: We study social learning using experiments where two people independently learn relevant information and can share it to make accurate private decisions. Across three experiments, people are substantially less sensitive to information others discover than to equally-relevant information they discovered themselves. This holds when they must learn information from others through discussion; when the experimenter perfectly communicates the information; and even when participants observe others’ information with their own eyes. Our results therefore stem not from a failure to elicit information from others but a systematic tendency to underweight it relative to one’s own information. Our findings illustrate a powerful barrier to social learning that might underlie many documented cases of failure to learn from others.

10.1086/743914.abstractZh: 我们通过实验研究社会学习：在实验中，两个人各自独立地获取相关信息，并且可以共享这些信息以做出准确的私人决策。在三项实验中，人们对于他人发现的信息的敏感程度，显著低于对自身发现的同等相关信息。这一结果在以下情形下均成立：他们必须通过讨论从他人那里获取信息时；实验者完美地传达信息时；甚至当参与者亲眼观察他人的信息时。因此，我们的结果并非源于未能从他人那里获取信息，而是源于一种系统性的倾向，即相对于自身信息而言低估他人信息。我们的发现揭示了一种社会学习的强大障碍，它可能解释了许多已记录的未能从他人处学习的案例。

abstract.text: We develop a dynamic macroeconomic framework with worker heterogeneity, putty-clay adjustment frictions, and firm monopsony power to study the distributional impact of labor market policies over time. Our framework reconciles the well-known tension between low short-run and high long-run elasticities of substitution across inputs of production, especially among workers with different skills within a same education group. We use this framework to evaluate the effects of redistributive policies such as the minimum wage and the Earned Income Tax Credit. We argue that since these policies generate slow transition dynamics that can differ greatly in the short and long run, a serious assessment of their overall impact must take account of the entire time path of the responses they induce.

10.1086/743915.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个动态宏观经济框架，该框架考虑了工人异质性、劳动力市场的调整摩擦以及企业的垄断买方力量，以研究劳动力市场政策随时间变化的分配影响。我们的框架解决了生产投入之间在短期和长期替代弹性之间的明显矛盾，尤其是在同一教育群体内具有不同技能的工人之间。我们利用这一框架来评估诸如最低工资和劳动收入税收抵免等再分配政策的效果。我们认为，由于这些政策导致的过渡过程在短期和长期可能存在很大差异，因此对其整体影响的严肃评估必须考虑它们引发的响应在整个时间过程中的变化。

abstract.text: Workers with variable earnings and flexible hours offer unique opportunities to evaluate intertemporal labor supply elasticities. Existing static analyses, however, have generated well-known puzzles, suggesting evidence of downward sloping labor supply curves. Using a large sample of shifts of New York City taxicab drivers, we estimate a dynamic optimal stopping model of drivers’ work times and quitting decisions. Our model exploits a set of sufficient statistics for equilibrium interactions between supply and demand, allowing us to estimate driver opportunity costs via a single agent problem. Our results demonstrate that several apparent behavioral biases documented in the literature can be reproduced using entirely standard preferences. We use our model to provide new estimates of individual earnings elasticities and show that taxi drivers have similar elasticities to workers in markets where experimental evidence has been obtained. Finally, we use data spanning a 2012 fare change to estimate labor supply elasticities with respect to market prices, accounting for the equilibrium impact of prices on supply and demand. We find market elasticities to be approximately a tenth of the size of individual elasticities, suggesting that existing estimates of the benefits to recent earnings legislation in the taxi and ride-hail industries

10.1086/744012.abstractZh: 具有可变收入且工作时间灵活的员工为评估跨时期的劳动力供给弹性提供了独特的机会。然而，现有的静态分析产生了一些众所周知的难题，表明劳动力供给曲线呈下降趋势。通过大量纽约市出租车司机的样本数据，我们建立了一个动态最优停止模型，用于分析司机的工作时间与辞职决策。我们的模型利用了一组充分统计量来反映供给与需求之间的均衡互动，从而通过单一代理问题来估算司机的机会成本。我们的研究结果表明，文献中记录的几种明显的行为偏差可以通过完全标准的偏好设定来再现。我们利用该模型对个体收入弹性进行了新的估算，并发现出租车司机的弹性与那些有实验证据支持的市场中的工人具有相似的弹性。最后，我们利用2012年票价调整的数据来估算劳动力供给对市场价格弹性的影响，同时考虑了价格对供给与需求均衡的影响。我们发现市场弹性大约是个体弹性的十分之一，这表明现有对出租车和网约车行业近期收入立法所带来的好处的估算可能存在偏差。

abstract.text: We report a large-scale examination of behavioral attenuation: due to information-processing constraints, the elasticity of people’s decisions to fundamentals is generally too small. We implement 30 experiments on a broad range of economic decisions, including choice, valuation, belief formation, strategic games and generic optimization. In 93% of our experiments, the elasticity of decisions to fundamentals decreases in participants’ cognitive uncertainty. Moreover, in decision problems with objective solutions, elasticities are universally smaller than is optimal. We show that the magnitude of attenuation is partly driven by the complexity of the decision problem. Many widely-studied anomalies represent special cases of behavioral attenuation.

10.1086/744015.abstractZh: 我们报告了一项关于行为衰减的大规模检验：由于信息处理约束，人们对基本面的决策弹性通常过小。我们针对广泛的经济决策实施了30项实验，包括选择、估值、信念形成、策略博弈和一般性优化。在我们的实验中，93%的实验显示，决策对基本面的弹性随参与者认知不确定性的上升而下降。此外，在具有客观解的决策问题中，弹性普遍小于最优水平。我们表明，衰减的幅度部分由决策问题的复杂性驱动。许多被广泛研究的异象是行为衰减的特例。

abstract.text: We study the equity-efficiency implication of giving school districts control over teacher pay using an equilibrium model of the market for public-school teachers. Teachers differ in their comparative advantages in teaching low-or high-achieving students. School districts, which serve different student bodies, use both wage and hiring strategies to compete for their preferred teachers. We estimate the model using data from Wisconsin, where districts gained control over teacher pay in 2011. We find that, all else equal, giving districts control over teacher pay would lead to more efficient teacher-district sorting but larger educational inequality. Teacher bonus programs that incentivize comparative advantage-based sorting, combined with bonus rates favoring districts with more low-achieving students, could improve both efficiency and equity.

10.1086/744049.abstractZh: 我们利用一个公立学校教师市场均衡模型，研究赋予学区教师薪酬控制权所带来的公平与效率含义。教师在教学低成就学生或高成就学生上具有不同的比较优势。服务于不同学生群体的学区同时运用工资策略和招聘策略来竞争其偏好的教师。我们使用威斯康星州的数据估计该模型，该州学区在2011年获得了教师薪酬控制权。我们发现，在其他条件相同的情况下，赋予学区教师薪酬控制权会带来更有效的教师—学区匹配，但也会扩大教育不平等。激励基于比较优势进行匹配的教师奖金计划，若结合向低成就学生较多的学区倾斜的奖金比例，则可能同时改善效率与公平。

abstract.text: Deforestation for cattle ranching in the Brazilian Amazon emits carbon, and reforestation absorbs carbon. The social productivities for these alternative activities vary across locations. We analyze a spatial/dynamic model of efficient land allocation to establish a benchmark for policies. We treat cattle prices as stochastic and location-specific productivities as uncertain when assessing the consequences of imposing alternative prices of carbon emissions. Modest carbon price increases would incentivize Brazil to choose policies that capture a significant amount of greenhouse gases in the next 30 years. Our analysis pinpoints tropical forest management as an important contributor to climate change mitigation.

10.1086/744117.abstractZh: 巴西亚马逊地区为养牛而进行的森林砍伐会排放碳，而重新造林则会吸收碳。这些替代性活动的社会生产率因地点而异。我们分析一个空间/动态的有效土地配置模型，以建立政策基准。在评估施加替代性碳排放价格的后果时，我们将牛价视为随机，将地点特定生产率视为不确定。适度的碳价上升将激励巴西选择能在未来30年捕获大量温室气体的政策。我们的分析指出，热带森林管理是减缓气候变化的重要贡献因素。

abstract.text: By regulating how firms collect, store, and use data, privacy laws may change the role of data in production and alter firm demand for information technology inputs. We study how firms respond to privacy laws in the context of the EU's General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) by using seven years of data from a large global cloudcomputing provider. Our difference-in-difference estimates indicate that, in response to the GDPR, EU firms decreased data storage by 26% and data processing by 15% relative to comparable US firms, becoming less "data-intensive."To estimate the costs of the GDPR for firms, we propose and estimate a production function where data and computation serve as inputs to the production of "information."We find that data and computation are strong complements in production and that firm responses are consistent with the GDPR representing a 20% increase in the cost of data on average. Variation in the firm-level effects of the GDPR and industry-level exposure to data, however, drives significant heterogeneity in our estimates of the impact of the GDPR on production costs.

10.1086/744118.abstractZh: 通过规范企业如何收集、存储和使用数据，隐私法可能改变数据在生产中的作用，并改变企业对信息技术投入品的需求。我们利用一家大型全球云计算提供商七年的数据，在欧盟《通用数据保护条例》（GDPR）的背景下研究企业如何回应隐私法。我们的双重差分估计表明，相对于可比美国企业，欧盟企业在回应 GDPR 时数据存储减少 26%、数据处理减少 15%，从而变得“数据密集度”更低。为估计 GDPR 给企业带来的成本，我们提出并估计了一个生产函数，其中数据和计算作为“信息”生产的投入品。我们发现，数据与计算在生产中是强互补品，且企业反应与 GDPR 平均使数据成本上升 20% 相一致。然而，GDPR 在企业层面效应的差异以及行业层面对数据暴露程度的差异，导致我们对 GDPR 影响生产成本估计存在显著异质性。

abstract.text: I study the role of firms' balance sheet liquidity in the transmission of monetary policy to investment. I develop a heterogeneous firm macroeconomic model with financial constraints, debt issuance costs, and differential returns on firms' cash and borrowing. The model matches key novel moments from U.S. firm-level data on liquid asset holdings, debt issuance activity, and investment responses to identified monetary shocks. Counterfactual analysis shows that the rise in U.S. firms' liquid asset holdings over recent decades has significantly increased the relevance of balance sheet liquidity and the behavior of liquid asset returns in monetary transmission.

10.1086/744130.abstractZh: 我研究企业资产负债表流动性在货币政策向投资传导中的作用。我构建了一个异质性企业宏观经济模型，其中包含金融约束、债务发行成本，以及企业现金与借款之间的收益率差异。该模型匹配了美国企业层面数据中关于流动资产持有、债务发行活动以及对已识别货币冲击的投资反应的关键新矩。反事实分析表明，近几十年来美国企业流动资产持有的上升显著提高了资产负债表流动性以及流动资产收益率行为在货币政策传导中的相关性。

abstract.text: New technologies have enabled firms to elicit granular behavioral data from consumers in exchange for lower prices and better experiences. This data can mitigate asymmetric information and moral hazard, but it may also increase firms' market power if kept proprietary. We study a voluntary monitoring program by a major U.S. auto insurer, in which drivers accept short-term tracking in exchange for potential discounts on future premiums. Using a proprietary dataset matched with competitor price menus, we document that safer drivers self-select into monitoring, and those who opt in become yet 30% safer while monitored. Using an equilibrium model of consumer choice and firm pricing for insurance and monitoring, we find that the monitoring program generates large profit and welfare gains. However, large demand frictions hurt monitoring adoption, forcing the firm to offer large discounts to induce opt-in while preventing the unmonitored pool from unraveling given the competitive environment.A counterfactual policy requiring the firm to make monitoring data public would thus further reduce the firm's incentive to elicit monitoring data, leading to less monitoring and lower consumer welfare in equilibrium.

10.1086/744482.abstractZh: 新技术使企业能够以更低的价格和更好的体验为交换，获取消费者的细粒度行为数据。这些数据可以缓解信息不对称和道德风险，但如果企业将其专有化，也可能增强企业的市场势力。我们研究美国一家大型汽车保险公司实施的自愿监测计划，在该计划中，驾驶员接受短期跟踪，以换取未来保费的可能折扣。利用与竞争对手价格菜单相匹配的专有数据集，我们发现，更安全的驾驶员会自我选择进入监测，而选择加入者在被监测期间变得更加安全，幅度达30%。利用一个关于保险与监测的消费者选择和企业定价的均衡模型，我们发现该监测计划带来了可观的利润和福利收益。然而，较大的需求摩擦损害了监测的采用，迫使企业提供大幅折扣以诱导选择加入，同时在竞争环境下防止未被监测群体出现逆向选择式的瓦解。因此，一项要求企业公开监测数据的反事实政策将进一步降低企业获取监测数据的激励，导致均衡中监测减少、消费者福利下降。

abstract.text: We use a detailed establishment-level dataset from Germany to document a new dimension of firm heterogeneity: large firms spend a higher share of their wage bill on immigrants than small firms. We show analytically that ignoring this heterogeneity in the immigrant share leads to biased estimates of the welfare gains from immigration. To do so, we set up and estimate a model where heterogeneous firms choose their immigrant share and then use it to quantify the welfare effects of an increase in the number of immigrants in Germany. Two new adjustment mechanisms arise under firm heterogeneity. First, native workers reallocate across firms, which mitigates the competition effect between immigrants and natives in the labor market. Second, the gains are largely concentrated among the largest and most productive employers, which induces an additional aggregate productivity gain. If we ignore the heterogeneity in the immigrant share across firms, we would underestimate the welfare gains of native workers by 11%.

10.1086/744485.abstractZh: 我们使用德国详细的企业层面数据集，记录企业异质性的一个新维度：大企业工资总额中用于移民的份额高于小企业。我们通过解析证明，忽略移民份额上的这种异质性会导致对移民福利收益的估计出现偏差。为此，我们构建并估计了一个模型，其中异质性企业选择其移民份额，然后利用该模型量化德国移民数量增加所带来的福利效应。在企业异质性下出现了两个新的调整机制。第一，本地劳动者在企业之间重新配置，这缓解了移民与本地劳动者在劳动力市场上的竞争效应。第二，收益在很大程度上集中于规模最大、生产率最高的雇主，这带来了额外的总量生产率收益。如果我们忽略企业间移民份额的异质性，就会将本地劳动者的福利收益低估 11%。

abstract.text: This paper shows that immigration fostered the emergence of organized labor in the United States. I digitize archival records to assemble the first county-level dataset on historical U.S. union membership and use a shift-share instrument to isolate a plausibly exogenous labor supply shock induced by immigration, between 1900 and 1920. Counties with higher immigration experienced increases in union presence, the number of union branches, the share of unionized workers, and the number of union members per branch. These effects were more pronounced among skilled workers, particularly in counties more exposed to labor competition from immigrants, and in areas with more negative attitudes toward immigrants. The evidence is consistent with existing workers unionizing in response to immigration, driven by both economic and social motivations. These findings highlight a novel driver of unionization in the early 20th-century United States and reveal an unexplored consequence of immigration: the development of institutions aimed at protecting workers’ status in the labor market, with effects that persist to the present.

10.1086/744504.abstractZh: 本文表明，移民促进了美国有组织劳工的兴起。我通过数字化档案记录，构建了首个关于美国历史工会会员人数的县级数据集，并使用移动份额工具变量分离出1900年至1920年间由移民引发的、可视为外生的劳动力供给冲击。移民水平更高的县，工会存在感、工会分支数量、工会化工人占比以及每个分支的工会会员人数均有所增加。这些效应在技术工人中更为明显，在受移民劳动力竞争影响更大的县以及对移民态度更负面的地区尤为突出。证据与现有工人因移民而加入工会相一致，其动机既包括经济因素也包括社会因素。这些发现凸显了20世纪初美国工会化的一个新驱动因素，并揭示了移民的一个尚未被探讨的后果：旨在保护工人在劳动力市场中地位的制度得以发展，其影响延续至今。

abstract.text: Hegemonic powers, like the United States and China, exert influence on other countries by threatening the suspension or alteration of financial and trade relationships. Mechanisms that generate gains from integration, such as external economies of scale and specialization, also increase the hegemon's power because in equilibrium they make other relationships poor substitutes for those with a global hegemon. Other countries can implement economic security policies to shape their economies in order to insulate themselves from undue foreign pressure. Countries considering these policies face a tradeoff between gains from trade and economic security. While an individual country can make itself better off, uncoordinated attempts by multiple countries to limit their dependency on the hegemon via economic security policies lead to inefficient fragmentation of the global financial and trade system. We study financial services as a leading application both as tools of coercion and an industry with strong strategic complementarities. We estimate that U.S. geoeconomic power relies on financial services, while Chinese power relies on manufacturing. Since power is nonlinear and increases disproportionally as the hegemon approaches controlling the entire supply of a sectoral input, we estimate that much economic security could be achieved with little overall fragmentation by diversifying the input sources of key sectors controlled by the hegemons.

10.1086/744505.abstractZh: 霸权国家（如美国和中国）通过威胁暂停或改变金融与贸易关系来对其他国施加影响。那些从一体化中产生收益的机制，例如外部规模经济和专业化，也会增强霸权国的权力，因为在均衡中这些机制使其他国家与全球霸权国之外的关系成为较差的替代品。其他国家可以实施经济安全政策来塑造本国经济，从而与不当的外国压力隔绝。考虑这些政策的国家面临贸易收益与经济安全之间的权衡。尽管单个国家可以使自身状况改善，但多个国家通过经济安全政策限制对霸权国依赖的不协调尝试，会导致全球金融与贸易体系的低效碎片化。我们以金融服务作为主要应用场景进行研究，既将其视为强制工具，也将其视为具有强策略互补性的行业。我们估计，美国的地缘经济权力依赖金融服务，而中国的权力依赖制造业。由于权力是非线性的，并且当霸权国接近控制某一部门投入品的全部供给时权力会不成比例地上升，我们估计，通过分散由霸权国控制的关键部门的投入品来源，可以在整体碎片化程度很低的情况下实现很大的经济安全。

abstract.text: Debortoli, Nunes, and Yared (2021) showed that when initial government debt is too high, Lucas and Stokey's (1983) debt management policy fails to implement a Ramsey plan for flat-rate taxes on labor. We show that preventing continuation Ramsey planners from resetting current-period tax rates and using short-term debt to finance accumulated primary deficits implements all Ramsey plans, including those with the high debt levels that trouble Lucas and Stokey's implementation. Our implementation equalizes Lagrange multipliers on distinct implementability constraints that face the Ramsey planner and the continuation planners, an essential indication of a successful implementation. We provide examples of our implementation under different initial debt structures and government spending patterns.

10.1086/744576.abstractZh: Debortoli、Nunes和Yared在2021年的研究中指出，当政府初始债务过高时，Lucas和Stokey在1983年提出的债务管理政策无法实施 Ramsey计划，即采用固定税率对劳动力征税。我们的研究表明，通过阻止持续性的Ramsey规划者重新设定当期税率，并利用短期债务来融资累积的初级赤字，可以实现所有Ramsey计划，包括那些债务水平较高的计划，而这些债务水平正是Lucas和Stokey所担忧的问题。我们的实施方法使得Ramsey规划者与持续性规划者面临的不同可实施性约束条件下的拉格朗日乘数达到均衡，这标志着实施的成功。我们还提供了在不同初始债务结构和政府支出模式下实施该策略的示例。

abstract.text: The standard revealed-preference approach to welfare economics encounters fundamental difficulties when the act of choosing directly affects welfare through emotions such as guilt, pride, and anxiety. We address this problem by developing an approach that redefines consumption bundles in terms of the sensations they produce, and measures welfare by blending choice-based methods with self-reported well-being techniques. In applications to classic social preferences paradigms, our approach shows that standard revealed-preference methods, including those that exploit choices over menus, mismeasure welfare because preferences depend on choice sets, while self-reported happiness and satisfaction are not sufficient statistics for welfare.

10.1086/744577.abstractZh: 福利经济学的标准显示性偏好方法在以下情形中会遇到根本性困难：选择行为本身会通过内疚、自豪和焦虑等情绪直接影响福利。我们通过发展一种方法来解决这一问题：该方法以选择所产生的感受来重新定义消费束，并将基于选择的方法与自我报告的幸福感技术相结合来度量福利。在应用于经典社会偏好范式时，我们的方法表明，标准的显示性偏好方法——包括那些利用菜单选择的方法——会错误地度量福利，因为偏好依赖于选择集；而自我报告的幸福感和满意度并不是福利的充分统计量。

abstract.text: Aggregate price shocks generate unequal welfare losses both across and within income groups.Policymakers face a trade-off: price subsidies direct more support to households facing larger losses, but create inefficiencies, while transfers are less distortionary but harder to target.We develop and implement a framework to quantify this trade-off using rich panel data on households' energy spending and incomes, alongside price and policy variation from the 2022-23 European Energy Crisis.Absent policy intervention, average household welfare losses would have equalled 6% of income, with some households facing much larger losses.The combination of an energy-price subsidy and universal transfers reduced both the mean and dispersion of losses, but incurred efficiency costs equal to 12% of total relief-package revenue costs.Optimal policy entails a strictly positive price subsidy, though its level is lower when transfers can be targeted using income and prior energy usage.

10.1086/744933.abstractZh: 整体价格冲击会导致不同收入群体之间的福利损失不均。政策制定者面临一个权衡：价格补贴会向遭受更大损失的家庭提供更多支持，但也会产生效率低下的问题；而转移支付虽然造成的扭曲较小，但难以精准定位。我们开发并实施了一个框架，利用关于家庭能源支出和收入的丰富面板数据，以及2022-23年欧洲能源危机期间的价格和政策变化数据，来量化这一权衡。如果没有政策干预，平均家庭福利损失将相当于收入的6%，而某些家庭的损失会更大。能源价格补贴与普遍转移支付相结合，既降低了损失的平均水平，也减少了损失的不对称性，但效率成本相当于总救济方案收入成本的12%。最优政策应实行严格意义上的价格补贴，不过当转移支付能够根据收入和之前的能源使用情况进行精准定位时，补贴水平会更低。

abstract.text: Equilibrium labor market theory suggests that unemployment benefit extensions affect unemployment by impacting both job search decisions by the unemployed and job creation decisions by employers. The existing empirical literature focused on the former effect only. We develop a new methodology necessary to incorporate the measurement of the latter effect. Implementing this methodology in the data, we find that benefit extensions raise equilibrium wages and lead to a sharp contraction in vacancy creation and employment and a rise in unemployment.

10.1086/745090.abstractZh: 均衡劳动力市场理论表明，失业救济金的延长会通过影响失业者的求职决策和雇主的就业创造决策来影响失业情况。现有的实证文献仅关注前一种影响。我们开发了一种新的研究方法，以纳入后一种影响的测量。通过应用这一方法于数据，我们发现救济金的延长会提高均衡工资，导致职位空缺的急剧减少以及失业率的上升。

abstract.text: We argue that the relative price of materials is an important determinant of the labor share of income. When materials and primary inputs are complements and the profit share is positive, a higher price of materials lowers the labor share and raises the profit share of value added, without requiring markups or returns to scale to change. We show that materials-price fluctuations align with U.S. labor-share trends, provide causal evidence on this mechanism across industries and commuting zones, and quantify its importance in a dynamic quantitative model. Finally, we use our mechanism to rationalize differential labor-share trends across countries.

10.1086/745092.abstractZh: 我们认为，材料的相对价格是决定收入中劳动份额的重要因素。当材料和初级投入是互补品且利润份额为正时，材料价格的上涨会降低劳动份额，同时提高附加值中的利润份额，而无需通过加价或规模效应来实现。我们证明，材料价格的波动与美国的劳动份额趋势一致，为不同行业和通勤区域之间的这种机制提供了因果证据，并在一个动态量化模型中量化了其重要性。最后，我们利用这一机制来解释不同国家之间劳动份额差异的原因。

abstract.text: Do investors anticipate that demands for racial equity will impact companies? We explore this question in the context of the Black Lives Matter (BLM) movement—the largest racially motivated protest movement in U.S. history—and its effect on the U.S. policing industry using a novel dataset on publicly traded firms contracting with the police. It is unclear whether the BLM uprisings were likely to increase or decrease market valuations of firms contracting heavily with police because of the increased interest in reforming the police, fears over rising crime, and pushes to “defund the police”. We find, in contrast to the predictions of economics experts we surveyed, that in the three weeks following incidents triggering BLM uprisings, policing firms experienced a stock price increase of seven percentage points relative to the stock prices of nonpolicing firms in similar industries. In particular, firms producing surveillance technology and police accountability tools experienced higher returns following BLM activism–related events. Furthermore, policing firms’ fundamentals, such as sales, improved after the murder of George Floyd, suggesting that policing firms’ future performances bore out investors' positive expectations following incidents triggering BLM uprisings. Our research shows how—despite BLM’s calls to reduce investment in policing and explore alternative public safety approaches—the financial market has translated high-profile violence against Black civilians and calls for systemic change into shareholder gains and additional revenues for police suppliers.

10.1086/745094.abstractZh: 投资者是否预期对种族公平性的要求会影响公司？我们在“黑人的命也是命”运动的背景下探讨了这个问题——这是美国历史上规模最大的种族主义抗议运动——以及该运动对美国警察行业的影响。我们使用了关于与警察有合作关系的上市公司的新型数据集来进行研究。目前尚不清楚“黑人的命也是命”抗议活动是否会增加或降低与警察有密切合作的公司的市场估值，因为人们越来越关注改革警察制度、对犯罪上升的担忧，以及呼吁“削减警察经费”的呼声。与我们所调查的经济学专家的预测相反，我们发现，在引发“黑人的命也是命”抗议活动的事件发生的三周内，与警察有合作的公司的股价相对于类似行业的非警察公司的股价上涨了7个百分点。特别是，生产监控技术和警察问责工具的公司，在“黑人的命也是命”活动相关的事件后获得了更高的回报。此外，乔治·弗洛伊德遇害事件之后，警察公司的各项基本面指标有所改善，这表明在引发“黑人的命也是命”抗议活动的事件之后，警察公司的未来表现符合投资者的积极预期。我们的研究表明，尽管“黑人的命也是命”运动呼吁减少对警察的投资并探索替代的公共安全方法，但金融市场将针对黑人平民的暴力事件以及系统性变革的呼吁转化为股东收益和警察供应商的额外收入。

abstract.text: Background and Objectives: Medicaid is the largest payer for long-stay nursing home care, yet the relationship between payment and quality is understudied. Given the relationship of staffing to quality of care, this study aimed to investigate the association between Medicaid payment rates and nursing staff levels in nursing homes, both overall and by ownership type (for-profit, not-for-profit, government). Research Design and Methods: The study employed a retrospective, cross-sectional analysis using a nationwide, facility-level database, comprising facility-level Medicaid payment rates collected directly from the states, staffing levels derived from the Payroll-Based Journal (PBJ), and facility and resident characteristics from the Medicare Cost Reports and Certification and Survey Provider Enhanced Reporting (CASPER). Multivariate regression with state fixed effects was used to assess the relationship between Medicaid payment and staffing levels. The final sample accounted for 9,510 freestanding nursing homes across the United States. Results: Results demonstrate significant associations between Medicaid payment rates and total, nurse aide, and registered nurse staffing levels. Medicaid payment rates were not consistently associated with licensed practical nurse staffing levels. Findings did not vary across not-for-profit, for-profit, and government nursing homes. Discussion and Implications: Medicaid reimbursement levels affect nursing staff levels in nursing homes, regardless of ownership type. Policymakers should consider Medicaid payment rates when setting nursing home policy to support staffing and sustain quality of care.

10.1093/geroni/igag087.abstractZh:
背景与目的：医疗补助是长期护理院护理服务的最大支付方，然而支付与服务质量之间的关系尚未得到充分研究。鉴于人员配置与护理质量之间的关联，本研究旨在探讨医疗补助支付率与护理院护理人员数量之间的关系，包括整体情况以及不同所有制类型（营利性、非营利性、政府性质）的护理院。

研究设计与方法：本研究采用回顾性、横断面分析，利用全国性的机构级数据库，该数据库包含直接从各州获得的机构级医疗补助支付率、从基于工资记录的数据库中提取的人员配置数据，以及来自医疗保险成本报告、认证和调查提供者增强报告中的机构及居民特征数据。采用带有州固定效应的多变量回归分析，以评估医疗补助支付与人员配置之间的关系。最终样本包括美国境内的9,510家独立运营的护理院。

结果：研究结果表明，医疗补助支付率与护理人员总数、护理助理和注册护士的数量之间存在显著关联。然而，医疗补助支付率与执业护士的人员配置数量之间并未表现出一致的关联。研究结果在不同所有制类型的护理院中并未存在差异。

讨论与启示：无论护理院的所有权类型如何，医疗补助的报销水平都会影响其护理人员的数量。政策制定者在制定护理院政策时，应考虑医疗补助支付率，以支持人员配置并维持护理质量。

abstract.text: BACKGROUND: Emergency medical services (EMS) are vital for reducing death from time-sensitive conditions such as cardiac arrest and trauma. As health systems turn to private ambulance providers to meet rising demand and fiscal constraints, rigorous evaluation of their quality is essential. METHODS: We systematically searched PubMed, Embase, Medline, Web of Science, and Google Scholar for studies published from 2005 to 2025 that compared the quality of private and public ambulance services. Studies were included if they reported on service quality indicators, including response times, clinical outcomes, financial costs, and staffing. In addition, methodological quality was appraised using the Joanna Briggs Institute critical appraisal tools for peer-reviewed studies and the AACODS (Authority, Accuracy, Coverage, Objectivity, Date, Significance) checklist for grey literature, and study designs were further classified according to the Oxford Centre for Evidence-Based Medicine Levels of Evidence framework. RESULTS: Sixteen studies from 11 countries met the inclusion criteria. Fourteen studies assessed system-level indicators rather than clinical outcomes, including response time, prehospital interventions, transport characteristics, utilization, awareness, and satisfaction, costs and billing, and staff knowledge, and staff profiles. Only four studies examined differences in clinical outcomes. Private ambulance services are likely to incur higher patient charges, insurer payments, and out-of-pocket spending. Findings across other domains showed little consensus. CONCLUSION: The evidence comparing private and public ambulance quality is limited, inconsistent, and highly context-dependent. More rigorous, multi-country studies using standardized metrics and transparent public reporting of quality indicators regardless of ownership status are urgently needed. Policymakers should exercise caution when integrating private providers into public EMS systems, with careful attention to contract design, terms of collaboration, and the establishment of minimum clinical governance standards to safeguard and improve quality of care.

10.1093/intqhc/mzag048.abstractZh:
背景：紧急医疗服务对于减少心脏骤停和创伤等时间敏感疾病的死亡率至关重要。随着卫生系统转向私人救护车服务提供商以满足日益增长的需求和财政限制，对其服务质量进行严格评估是必不可少的。  
方法：我们在PubMed、Embase、Medline、Web of Science和Google Scholar中系统搜索了2005至2025年间发表的研究，这些研究比较了私人与公共救护车服务的质量。如果研究报告中包含服务质量指标，如响应时间、临床结果、财务成本和人员配置，则纳入研究范围。此外，还使用Joanna Briggs研究所的同行评审研究批判性评估工具以及AACODS（权威性、准确性、覆盖范围、客观性、日期、重要性）清单来评估灰色文献的方法学质量，并根据牛津循证医学证据等级框架对研究设计进行分类。  
结果：来自11个国家的16项研究符合纳入标准。其中14项研究评估了系统层面的指标，而非临床结果，包括响应时间、院前干预、运输特性、利用率、意识水平、满意度、成本和计费方式以及人员知识水平等。仅有4项研究探讨了临床结果的差异。私人救护车服务可能会导致更高的患者费用、保险公司支付费用以及个人自付支出。其他领域的发现则缺乏共识。  
结论：关于私人与公共救护车服务质量的比较证据有限、不一致且高度依赖于具体情境。迫切需要更严格的多国研究，采用标准化的指标，并公开透明地报告质量指标，无论这些机构的所有权状况如何。政策制定者在将私人提供者纳入公共紧急医疗服务体系时应当谨慎行事，需要仔细考虑合同设计、合作条款，以及建立最低限度的临床治理标准，以保护和提升护理质量。

abstract.text: This paper uses newly collected data on the allocation of dowry to examine its role in resolving intergenerational frictions around migration in India. Migration disrupts traditional elderly support structures, in which sons live near their parents and care for them in old age. We develop a model in which dowry can promote migration by allowing sons to make upfront transfers to their parents and ease constraints on income sharing. To test this hypothesis, we collect two new data sets that measure the distribution of dowry between family members. We document for the first time that net transfers of dowry to a man’s parents are common but far from universal. Consistent with using dowry for income sharing, such transfers occur more often when sons migrate, especially when they work in higher-earning occupations. In nationally representative data, migration rates are higher in areas with stronger historical dowry traditions. Finally, exploiting a large-scale highway construction program, we show that men from areas with stronger historical dowry traditions migrate more when migration costs fall. Our findings provide some clues as to why dowry persists despite its well-documented adverse consequences.

10.1093/qje/qjaf041.abstractZh: 本文利用新收集的嫁妆分配数据，考察嫁妆在解决印度围绕迁移的代际摩擦中的作用。迁移会冲击传统养老支持结构，即儿子住在父母附近并在父母年老时照料他们。我们构建了一个模型，其中嫁妆可以通过让儿子向父母进行预先转移，并缓解收入共享约束，来促进迁移。为检验这一假说，我们收集了两套新数据集，用以衡量嫁妆在家庭成员之间的分配。我们首次记录了向男方父母转移的嫁妆净额相当常见，但远非普遍现象。与将嫁妆用于收入共享相一致，当儿子迁移时，此类转移更常发生，尤其是当儿子从事收入更高的职业时。在全国代表性数据中，历史嫁妆传统更强的地区迁移率更高。最后，利用一项大规模高速公路建设项目，我们表明当迁移成本下降时，来自历史嫁妆传统更强地区的男性迁移得更多。我们的发现为嫁妆为何在有充分记录的不利后果下仍持续存在提供了一些线索。

abstract.text: This article empirically studies the effects of the early law and economics movement on the U.S. judiciary. We focus on the Manne Economics Institute for Federal Judges, an intensive economics course that trained almost half of federal judges between 1976 and 1999. Using the universe of published opinions in U.S. Circuit Courts and 1 million District Court criminal sentencing decisions, we estimate the within-judge effect of Manne program attendance. Selection into attendance was limited, as the program was popular among judges of all backgrounds, frequently oversubscribed, and admitted participants on a first-come, first-served basis. We find that after attending economics training, participating judges use more economics language in their opinions, rule against regulatory agencies more often, and impose more severe criminal sentences. We argue that economics, as a rigorous social science, was especially effective in persuading judges.

10.1093/qje/qjaf042.abstractZh: 本文实证研究早期法与经济学运动对美国司法系统的影响。我们聚焦于 Manne 联邦法官经济学研究所——一门强化经济学课程，在 1976 年至 1999 年间培训了近半数联邦法官。利用美国巡回法院已公布判决意见的全样本以及 100 万份地区法院刑事量刑裁决，我们估计参加 Manne 项目在同一法官内部产生的效应。参训的选择性有限，因为该项目受到各类背景法官的欢迎，经常报名超额，并按先到先得原则录取参与者。我们发现，参加经济学培训后，参训法官在判决意见中使用更多经济学语言，更经常地作出不利于监管机构的裁决，并判处更严厉的刑罚。我们认为，经济学作为一门严谨的社会科学，在说服法官方面尤为有效。

abstract.text: Has the dominance of the dollar in global trade rendered monetary policy ineffective? An emerging view contends that if a country invoices its exports in dollars, exchange rates cannot stabilize economic activity, as the classical expenditure-switching channel is muted. This view rests on the premise that export prices are sticky in dollars, breaking the link between export demand and depreciations. But this assumption is not borne out by the data: goods priced in dollars tend to have more flexible prices, along with higher elasticities of substitution. We propose a model with more realistic assumptions and show that even with dollar pricing, depreciating the currency by loosening monetary policy can still boost exports and activity materially. The limit to any expansion is not demand, but supply capacity. We also show that low exchange rate pass-through to dollar prices is not informative about price stickiness. The price response to exchange rates is small when demand elasticities are high, even with flexible prices: low pass-through is an equilibrium result, not evidence of a nominal friction.

10.1093/qje/qjaf043.abstractZh: 美元在全球贸易中的主导地位是否已使货币政策失效？一种新兴观点认为，如果一国以美元计价其出口，汇率就无法稳定经济活动，因为经典的支出转换渠道被削弱。该观点基于这样一个前提：出口价格以美元计价时具有粘性，从而切断了出口需求与货币贬值之间的联系。但数据并不支持这一假设：以美元计价的商品往往价格更灵活，替代弹性也更高。我们提出一个假设更符合现实的模型，并表明即使采用美元定价，通过放松货币政策使货币贬值仍能显著提振出口和经济活动。任何扩张的限制都不是需求，而是供给能力。我们还表明，汇率向美元价格的传导较低并不能说明价格粘性。当需求弹性较高时，即使价格灵活，价格对汇率的反应也很小：低传导是均衡结果，而不是名义摩擦的证据。

abstract.text: Why do banks fail? We create a panel covering most commercial banks from 1863 through 2024 to study the history of failing banks in the United States. Failing banks are characterized by rising asset losses, deteriorating solvency, and an increasing reliance on expensive noncore funding. These commonalities imply that bank failures are highly predictable using simple accounting metrics from publicly available financial statements. Failures with runs were common before deposit insurance, but these failures are strongly related to weak fundamentals, casting doubt on the importance of non-fundamental runs. Furthermore, low recovery rates on failed banks’ assets suggest that most failed banks subject to runs were fundamentally insolvent, barring large value destruction of receiverships. Altogether, our evidence suggests that the primary cause of bank failures and banking crises is almost always and everywhere a deterioration of bank fundamentals.

10.1093/qje/qjaf044.abstractZh: 银行为何倒闭？我们构建了一个覆盖1863年至2024年多数商业银行的面板数据，以研究美国倒闭银行的历史。倒闭银行的特征是资产损失上升、偿付能力恶化，以及日益依赖昂贵的非核心融资。这些共性意味着，利用公开财务报表中的简单会计指标可以高度预测银行倒闭。在存款保险制度建立之前，伴随挤兑的倒闭很常见，但这些倒闭与疲弱的基本面密切相关，这使非基本面挤兑的重要性受到质疑。此外，倒闭银行资产的低回收率表明，多数遭遇挤兑的倒闭银行从根本上已经资不抵债，除非接管处置过程造成大规模价值损毁。总体而言，我们的证据表明，银行倒闭和银行业危机的主要原因几乎总是、并且在任何地方都是银行基本面恶化。

abstract.text: Election results act as powerful signals, shaping social behavior in ways that can be dramatic and even violent. This article shows how racial violence in the post-Reconstruction U.S. South was tied to the local performance of the anti-Black Democratic Party in presidential elections. Using a regression discontinuity design based on close presidential vote shares, we find that Southern counties where Democrats lost the popular vote between 1880 and 1900 were nearly twice as likely to experience Black lynchings in the following four years. Despite no corresponding changes in local office holding, these defeats were salient among local elites. We show that Southern newspapers, closely aligned with the Democratic Party, amplified narratives of Black criminality in the aftermath of Democratic losses. Such accusations were, in turn, frequently invoked by lynch mobs. These findings point to the strategic use of racial violence by Democratic elites, foreshadowing the institutionalized vote suppression of Jim Crow.

10.1093/qje/qjaf045.abstractZh: 选举结果作为强有力的信号，会以显著甚至暴力的方式塑造社会行为。本文表明，重建后美国南方的种族暴力与反黑人民主党在总统选举中的地方得票表现相关。基于总统得票份额接近的断点回归设计，我们发现，在1880—1900年间民主党输掉普选票的南方各县，其随后四年发生黑人遭私刑事件的可能性接近翻倍。尽管地方公职任职情况没有相应变化，这些败选仍对地方精英十分显著。我们表明，与民主党紧密结盟的南方报纸在民主党败选后放大了黑人犯罪叙事。这些指控反过来常被私刑暴民援引。这些发现指向民主党精英对种族暴力的策略性使用，并预示了吉姆·克劳制度化的投票压制。

abstract.text: Nearly 400,000 Black men were drafted into the National Army during World War I, where they toiled primarily as menial laborers in segregated units. Leveraging novel variation from the World War I draft lottery and millions of digitized military and NAACP records, we document the pioneering role these men played in the early civil rights movement. Relative to observably similar individuals from the same draft board, Black men randomly inducted into the Army were significantly more likely to join the nascent NAACP and become prominent community leaders in the New Negro era. We find little evidence that these effects are explained by migration or improved socioeconomic status. Rather, corroborating historical accounts about the catalyzing influence of institutional racism in the military, we show that increased civic activism was driven by soldiers who experienced the most discriminatory treatment while serving their country.

10.1093/qje/qjaf046.abstractZh: 第一次世界大战期间，近40万名黑人男性被征召入国民军，他们主要在种族隔离部队中从事低微的体力劳动。我们利用第一次世界大战征兵抽签带来的新变异，以及数百万份数字化的军队和NAACP记录，记录了这些人在早期民权运动中发挥的开创性作用。相对于来自同一征兵委员会、可观测特征相似的个人，被随机征召入伍的黑人男性显著更有可能加入初生的NAACP，并在新黑人时代成为杰出的社区领袖。我们几乎没有发现证据表明这些效应可由迁移或社会经济地位改善来解释。相反，与关于军队中制度性种族主义具有催化影响的历史记述相印证，我们表明，公民行动主义的增加是由那些在为国服役期间遭受最歧视性待遇的士兵所驱动的。

abstract.text: We construct the first annual market rent and home sales price series for American cities over the twentieth century using 2.7 million newspaper real estate listings. Our findings revise several stylized facts about U.S. housing markets. Real market rents did not fall during the postwar period in most cities and rose nationally by 60% from 1890 to 2006. We also document higher sales price growth between 1953 and 1987 relative to previous series. Real prices reached almost four times their 1890 level by 2006. Prices grew most in metros with high demand and low levels of construction. We find that the rent-to-price ratio fell from about 8% in the early twentieth century to 3% by 2006, consistent with declines in the cost of owning housing relative to renting. For the typical year in our period, the annual return to owning housing was 9%, driven mostly by rental returns of 7.7%, with capital gains contributing only 1.3%. While capital gains were close to zero from 1890 to 1940, they grew to nearly a third of total returns from 1970 to 2006.

10.1093/qje/qjaf047.abstractZh: 我们利用270万条报纸房地产广告，构建了20世纪美国城市的首个年度市场租金与住房销售价格序列。我们的发现修正了关于美国住房市场的若干典型事实。在大多数城市，实际市场租金在战后时期并未下降，且全国范围内从1890年到2006年上涨了60%。我们还记录到，相对于此前的序列，1953—1987年间的销售价格增长更高。到2006年，实际价格几乎达到其1890年水平的四倍。需求高且建设水平低的大都市区价格增长最快。我们发现，租金与价格之比从20世纪初的约8%降至2006年的3%，这与自有住房相对于租房的成本下降相一致。在我们考察时期的典型年份，自有住房的年收益率为9%，主要来自7.7%的租金收益率，资本利得仅贡献1.3%。1890—1940年资本利得接近于零，而1970—2006年则增长至总收益率的近三分之一。

abstract.text: Concerns about excessive mobile phone use among youth are mounting. We present estimates of behavioral and contextual peer effects, along with comprehensive evidence on how students’ own and their peers’ app usage affect academic performance, physical health, and labor market outcomes. Our analysis draws on administrative data from a Chinese university covering three student cohorts over four years. We exploit random roommate assignments, differential exposure to a policy shock (gaming restrictions for minors), and differential exposure to a discrete event (the introduction of a blockbuster video game) for identification. App usage is contagious: a one s.d. increase in roommates’ in-college app usage raises own usage by 5.8%. High app usage is harmful across all measured outcomes. A one s.d. increase in app usage reduces GPAs by 36.2% of a within-cohort-major s.d. and lowers wages by 2.3%. Roommates’ app usage reduces a student’s GPA and wages through both disruptions and behavioral spillovers, generating a total negative effect that exceeds half the magnitude of the impact from the student’s own app usage. Extending China’s three-hour-per-week gaming restriction for minors to college students would boost their initial wages by 0.9%. High-frequency GPS and app usage data show that heavy app users spend less time in study halls, are more frequently late or absent from class, and get less sleep.

10.1093/qje/qjaf048.abstractZh: 对青少年过度使用手机的担忧日益加剧。我们给出了行为性同伴效应与情境性同伴效应的估计，并提供了关于学生自身及其同伴的 App 使用如何影响学业表现、身体健康和劳动力市场结果的全面证据。我们的分析使用中国某大学的行政数据，涵盖三个学生队列、时间跨度为四年。我们利用随机室友分配、对政策冲击（未成年人游戏限制）的不同暴露程度，以及对一个离散事件（一款爆款电子游戏上线）的不同暴露程度进行识别。App 使用具有传染性：室友在校期间 App 使用量增加一个标准差（s.d.），会使自身使用量提高 5.8%。高 App 使用量对所有测度结果均产生不利影响。App 使用量增加一个标准差，会使 GPA 下降相当于同队列同专业内标准差 36.2% 的幅度，并使工资降低 2.3%。室友的 App 使用既通过干扰、也通过行为溢出降低学生的 GPA 和工资，所产生的总负向效应超过学生自身 App 使用影响幅度的一半。将中国针对未成年人的每周三小时游戏限制扩展到大学生，会使其起薪提高 0.9%。高频 GPS 和 App 使用数据显示，重度 App 使用者花在自习室的时间更少、上课迟到或缺勤的频率更高，并且睡眠更少。

abstract.text: We use novel surveys of firms and workers, linked to administrative employer-employee data, to study the prevalence and importance of individual bargaining in wage determination. We show that simple survey questions accurately elicit firms’ bargaining strategies. Using the elicited strategies for 772 German firms, we document that the majority of firms are willing to engage in individual wage bargaining. Labor market factors predict firms’ strategies better than firm characteristics. Survey responses from nearly 10,000 full-time workers indicate that most workers provide their salary expectations before they receive a job offer. Most outside offers are rejected, with the worker remaining at the incumbent firm. There is substantial heterogeneity in workers’ bargaining behavior, which translates into within-firm wage inequality. Firms that set pay via individual bargaining have a 3 percentage point higher gender wage gap.

10.1093/qje/qjaf049.abstractZh: 我们利用与行政雇主—雇员数据相链接的新型企业和劳动者调查，研究个体谈判在工资决定中的普遍性和重要性。我们表明，简单的调查问题能够准确获取企业的谈判策略。利用从 772 家德国企业获取的谈判策略，我们发现大多数企业愿意进行个体工资谈判。劳动力市场因素对企业谈判策略的预测能力优于企业特征。近 10,000 名全职劳动者的调查回答表明，大多数劳动者在收到工作录用通知之前就给出自己的薪资预期。大多数外部录用邀约被拒绝，劳动者仍留在当前雇主处。劳动者的谈判行为存在显著异质性，并转化为企业内工资不平等。通过个体谈判设定工资的企业，其性别工资差距高 3 个百分点。
