abstract.text: We use anonymized admissions data from several colleges linked to income tax records and SAT and ACT test scores to study the determinants and causal effects of attending Ivy-Plus colleges (Ivy League, Stanford, MIT, Duke, and Chicago). Children from families in the top 1% are more than twice as likely to attend an Ivy-Plus college as those from middle-class families with comparable SAT/ACT scores. Two-thirds of this gap is due to higher admission rates for students with comparable test scores from high-income families; the remaining third is due to differences in rates of application and matriculation. In contrast, children from high-income families have no admissions advantage at flagship public colleges. The high-income admissions advantage at Ivy-Plus colleges is driven by three factors: (i) preferences for children of alumni, (ii) weight placed on nonacademic credentials, and (iii) athletic recruitment. Using a new research design that isolates idiosyncratic variation in admissions decisions for waitlisted applicants, we show that attending an Ivy-Plus college instead of the average flagship public college increases students’ chances of reaching the top 1% of the earnings distribution by 50%, nearly doubles their chances of attending an elite graduate school, and almost triples their chances of working at a prestigious firm. The three factors that give children from high-income families an admissions advantage are uncorrelated or negatively correlated with postcollege outcomes, whereas academic credentials such as SAT/ACT scores are highly predictive of postcollege success.

10.1093/qje/qjaf050.abstractZh: 我们使用若干所高校的匿名录取数据，并将其与所得税记录以及 SAT 和 ACT 考试成绩相匹配，以研究就读常春藤+院校（Ivy-Plus colleges；包括常春藤联盟、斯坦福大学、麻省理工学院、杜克大学和芝加哥大学）的决定因素和因果效应。来自收入前 1% 家庭的孩子，其就读常春藤+院校的可能性是 SAT/ACT 成绩相当的中产家庭孩子的两倍以上。这一差距的三分之二源于考试成绩相当但来自高收入家庭的学生录取率更高；其余三分之一源于申请率和最终入学率的差异。相比之下，来自高收入家庭的孩子在旗舰公立高校并不具有录取优势。常春藤+院校中高收入家庭的录取优势由三个因素驱动：(i) 对校友子女的偏好，(ii) 对非学术资质的重视，以及 (iii) 体育招生。我们采用一种新的研究设计，分离出候补名单申请者录取决定中的个体特异性变异，并据此表明：就读常春藤+院校而非平均水平的旗舰公立高校，使学生进入收入分布前 1% 的概率提高 50%，使其就读精英研究生院的机会几乎翻倍，并使其在知名企业工作的机会几乎增至三倍。赋予高收入家庭孩子录取优势的这三个因素，与大学毕业后的结果不相关或负相关；而 SAT/ACT 成绩等学术资质则对大学毕业后的成功具有很强的预测力。

abstract.text: In this article, we establish a causal connection between two of the most salient social developments in the United States over the past decades: the opioid epidemic and the political realignment between the Republican and Democratic parties. Drawing on unsealed records from litigation against Purdue Pharma, we uncover rich geographic variation in the marketing of prescription opioids that serves as a quasi-exogenous source of exposure to the epidemic. We use this variation to document significant increases in drug-related mortality and greater reliance on public transfer programs. This induced economic hardship led to substantial changes in the political landscape of the communities most affected by the opioid epidemic. We estimate that from the mid-2000s to 2022, exposure to the opioid epidemic continuously increased the Republican vote share in House, presidential, and gubernatorial elections. By the 2022 House elections, a one-standard-deviation increase in our measure of exposure led to a 4.5 percentage point increase in the Republican vote share. From 2012 until 2022, this increase in the House vote share translated into Republicans winning additional seats.

10.1093/qje/qjaf051.abstractZh: 本文建立过去几十年美国两项最突出的社会发展现象之间的因果联系：阿片类药物流行病与共和党和民主党之间的政治重组。利用针对普渡制药（Purdue Pharma）诉讼中解封的记录，我们发现了处方阿片类药物营销中丰富的地理差异，这种差异构成了对该流行病暴露的准外生来源。我们利用这一差异记录了药物相关死亡率的显著上升以及对公共转移支付项目的更大依赖。由此引发的经济困难导致受阿片类药物流行病影响最严重的社区政治格局发生重大变化。我们估计，从2000年代中期到2022年，对阿片类药物流行病的暴露持续提高了共和党在众议院选举、总统选举和州长选举中的得票率。到2022年众议院选举时，我们的暴露度量每提高一个标准差，导致共和党得票率提高4.5个百分点。从2012年到2022年，众议院得票率的这一提高转化为共和党赢得额外席位。

abstract.text: We study the mechanisms driving bank losses across historical banking crises in 46 economies and the effectiveness of policy interventions in restoring bank capitalization. We find that bank stocks experience large, permanent declines at the onset of crises. These losses predict commensurate long-term declines in banks’ earnings and dividends, rather than elevated future equity returns. Bank losses are primarily driven by write-downs of nonperforming assets, not asset sales during panics. Forceful liquidity-based interventions during crises predict only small, temporary increases in bank market value. Overall, these results suggest that bank losses during crises are not primarily due to temporary price dislocations. Early liquidity interventions can avert banking crises, but only under specific conditions. Once large bank equity declines have occurred, policy responses have historically failed to prevent persistent undercapitalization in the banking sector.

10.1093/qje/qjaf052.abstractZh: 我们研究了46个经济体历史上银行业危机期间银行损失的驱动机制，以及政策干预在恢复银行资本状况方面的有效性。我们发现，银行股在危机爆发时经历大幅且永久性的下跌。这些损失预示着银行盈利和股息将出现幅度相称的长期下降，而不是未来股票收益率上升。银行损失主要由不良资产减记驱动，而不是由恐慌期间的资产出售驱动。危机期间强有力的流动性干预仅预示银行市值小幅、暂时上升。总体而言，这些结果表明，危机期间的银行损失并非主要源于暂时性的价格错位。早期流动性干预可以避免银行业危机，但仅在特定条件下才有效。一旦银行权益出现大幅下跌，政策应对在历史上未能阻止银行业持续资本不足。

abstract.text: A common concern surrounding minimum wage policies is their impact on independent businesses, which are often feared to be less able to bear or pass on cost increases. We examine how these typically small and medium-size firms accommodate minimum wage increases along product and labor market margins using a matched owner-firm-worker panel data set drawn from the universe of U.S. tax records over a 10-year period, and using state minimum wage changes as identifying variation. We find that on average, firms in highly exposed industries do not substantially reduce employment—they do not lay off workers but moderately reduce part-time hiring. Instead, these firms are able to fully finance the new labor costs with new revenues, leaving average owner profits unchanged. Higher wage floors, however, forestall entry, particularly for less productive firms, reducing the number of independent firms operating in these industries by roughly 2%. Yet these industries do not shrink; instead, incumbent responses and strong positive selection among entrants reshape industries that rely heavily on low-wage workers, yielding fewer but more productive firms after the cost shock. We also take a worker-level perspective to examine how potentially vulnerable individuals are affected by minimum wage increases. Using panels of low-earning and young workers, we find that their average earnings rise substantially with the minimum wage, while they are no less likely to be employed. Worker transitions indicate that minimum wage increases boost retention and that worker reallocation from independent firms toward corporations buffers disemployment impacts from reduced hiring at independent firms.

10.1093/qje/qjaf053.abstractZh: 围绕最低工资政策的一个常见担忧是其对独立企业的影响，人们往往担心这些企业承受或转嫁成本上升的能力较弱。我们使用一个匹配的所有者—企业—劳动者面板数据集，考察这些通常为中小型的企业如何沿产品市场和劳动力市场边际适应最低工资上调；该数据集取自为期10年的美国税收记录全集，并以州最低工资变化作为识别变异。我们发现，平均而言，受最低工资影响较大的行业中的企业并未大幅减少就业——它们不裁员，但会适度减少兼职招聘。相反，这些企业能够以新增收入完全覆盖新增劳动力成本，使所有者平均利润保持不变。然而，更高的工资下限会阻碍进入，尤其是生产率较低的企业进入，使这些行业中经营的独立企业数量减少约2%。但这些行业并未萎缩；相反，现有企业的反应以及进入者中强烈的正向选择重塑了严重依赖低工资劳动者的行业，在成本冲击后形成数量更少但生产率更高的企业。我们还从劳动者层面考察可能处于弱势的个体如何受到最低工资上调的影响。使用低收入劳动者和年轻劳动者的面板数据，我们发现其平均收入随最低工资大幅上升，而其就业概率并未降低。劳动者流动情况表明，最低工资上调提高了留任率，并且劳动者从独立企业向公司制企业再配置，缓冲了独立企业招聘减少所带来的就业减少影响。

abstract.text: We trace the evolution of the language of science, religion, and political economy in the centuries leading to the British Industrial Revolution. Using textual analysis of 264,443 works printed in England between 1500 and 1900, we test whether British culture manifested a belief in progress associated with science and industry. Our analysis yields three main findings. First, there was a separation in the languages of science and religion beginning in the mid-eighteenth century. Second, volumes using language at the nexus of science and political economy became more progress-oriented during the Enlightenment. Third, volumes using industrial language—especially those at the science-political economy nexus—were more progress-oriented beginning in the eighteenth century.

10.1093/qje/qjaf054.abstractZh: 我们追溯了在通往英国工业革命的数百年间科学、宗教和政治经济学语言的演变。通过对 1500—1900 年间在英格兰印刷的 264,443 部作品进行文本分析，我们检验了英国文化是否表现出一种与科学和工业相关联的进步信念。我们的分析得出三个主要发现。第一，自 18 世纪中叶起，科学语言与宗教语言出现了分离。第二，在启蒙运动期间，使用处于科学与政治经济学交汇处语言的书籍变得更加以进步为导向。第三，使用工业语言的书籍——尤其是处于科学与政治经济学交汇处的书籍——自 18 世纪起更加以进步为导向。

abstract.text: This article studies the returns to enrolling in U.S. public universities by comparing the long-term outcomes of barely admitted versus barely rejected applicants. I use administrative admission records spanning all 35 public universities in Texas, which collectively enroll 10% of all American public university students, to systematically identify and employ decentralized cutoffs in SAT/ACT scores that generate discontinuities in admission and enrollment. The typical marginally admitted student gains an additional year of education in the four-year sector, becomes 12 percentage points more likely to ever earn a bachelor’s degree, and eventually earns 8% more than their marginally rejected but otherwise identical counterpart. Marginally admitted students pay no additional tuition costs thanks to offsetting grant aid; cost-benefit calculations show internal rates of return of 26% for the marginal students themselves, 16% for society (which must pay for the additional education), and 7% for the government budget. Earnings gains are similar across admitting institutions of varying selectivity, but smaller for students from low-income families, who spend more time enrolled but complete fewer degrees and major in less lucrative fields. Finally, I develop a method to separately identify effects for students on the extensive margin of attending any university versus those on the margin of attending a more selective one, revealing larger effects on the extensive margin.

10.1093/qje/qjaf055.abstractZh: 本文通过比较勉强被录取与勉强被拒绝申请者的长期结果，研究就读美国公立大学的回报。我使用覆盖得克萨斯州全部35所公立大学的行政录取记录——这些学校合计招收了全美公立大学学生的10%——来系统识别并利用SAT/ACT分数中分散的录取门槛，这些门槛在录取和入学上产生不连续。典型的边缘录取学生将在四年制高等教育部门多获得一年教育，最终获得学士学位的概率提高12个百分点，并最终比仅在录取上边缘被拒绝、其他方面相同的对应者多获得8%的收入。由于抵消性助学金资助，边缘录取学生不需支付额外学费；成本收益计算显示，边际学生自身的内部收益率为26%，社会为16%（社会必须为额外教育付费），政府预算为7%。不同选拔性的录取院校带来的收入增益相近，但来自低收入家庭的学生收入增益较小；这些学生入学时间更长，但完成的学位更少，且主修收入较低的专业。最后，我开发一种方法，分别识别处于是否就读任何大学的外延边际上的学生与处于就读更具选拔性大学这一边际上的学生的效应，发现外延边际上的效应更大。

abstract.text: This article explores the relationship between economic growth and trust in government using variation in GDP growth experienced over a lifetime since birth. We assemble a newly harmonized global data set across 11 major opinion surveys, comprising 3.3 million respondents in 166 countries since 1990. Exploiting cohort-level variation, we find that people who have experienced higher GDP growth are more prone to trust their governments, with larger effects found in democracies. Higher-growth experiences are also associated with improved perceptions of government performance and living standards. We find no similar channel between growth experience and interpersonal trust. Second, more recent growth experiences appear to matter most for trust in government, with no detectable effect of growth experienced during one’s formative years, closer to birth, or before birth. Third, we find evidence of a “trust paradox” whereby average trust in government is lower in democracies than in autocracies. Our results are robust to a range of falsification exercises, robustness checks, and single-country evidence using the American National Election Studies and the Swiss Household Panel.

10.1093/qje/qjaf056.abstractZh: 本文利用个体自出生以来一生中所经历的 GDP 增长差异，考察经济增长与政府信任之间的关系。我们整合了一个新近协调的全球数据集，涵盖 1990 年以来 11 项主要民意调查、166 个国家的 330 万名受访者。利用队列层面的变异，我们发现，经历过更高 GDP 增长的人更倾向于信任政府，且在民主国家中效应更大。更高的增长经历还与对政府绩效和生活水平改善的感知相关。我们未发现增长经历与人际信任之间存在类似渠道。其次，较近期的增长经历似乎对政府信任最为重要，而个体成长关键期、接近出生时或出生前的增长经历未检测到可识别的影响。第三，我们发现了“信任悖论”的证据，即民主国家的平均政府信任水平低于专制国家。我们的结果在一系列证伪检验、稳健性检验以及使用美国全国选举研究（American National Election Studies）和瑞士家庭面板（Swiss Household Panel）的单一国家证据下均保持稳健。

abstract.text: We show that intergenerational mobility changed rapidly by race and class in recent decades in the United States and study the causal mechanisms underlying those changes. Between the 1978 and 1992 birth cohorts, earnings increased for white children from high-income families relative to white children from low-income families, increasing earnings gaps by parental income (class) by 30%. Earnings increased for Black children at all parental income levels, reducing white-Black earnings gaps for children from low-income families by 30%. Class gaps grew and race gaps shrank similarly for nonmonetary outcomes such as educational attainment, standardized test scores, and mortality rates. Using a quasi-experimental design, we show that the divergent trends in economic mobility were caused by differential changes in childhood environments, as proxied by parental employment rates, in local communities defined by race, class, and childhood county. Outcomes improve across birth cohorts for children who grow up in communities with increasing parental employment rates, with larger effects for children who move to such communities at younger ages. Children’s outcomes are most strongly related to the parental employment rates of peers they are more likely to interact with, such as those in their own birth cohort, suggesting that the relationship between children’s outcomes and parental employment rates is mediated by social interaction.

10.1093/qje/qjaf057.abstractZh: 我们表明，近几十年来美国按种族和阶层划分的代际流动性发生了迅速变化，并研究了这些变化背后的因果机制。在1978年与1992年出生队列之间，高收入家庭白人子女的 earnings 相对于低收入家庭白人子女有所提高，使按父母收入（阶层）衡量的 earnings 差距扩大了30%。所有父母收入水平的黑人子女的 earnings 均有所提高，使低收入家庭子女的白人—黑人 earnings 差距缩小了30%。对于教育 attainment、标准化考试成绩和死亡率等非货币结果，阶层差距同样扩大、种族差距同样缩小。利用准实验设计，我们表明经济流动性的分化趋势是由童年环境的差异性变化所导致的，童年环境以父母就业率作为代理变量，并在按种族、阶层和童年所在县定义的本地社区中加以衡量。对于在父母就业率不断上升的社区中长大的子女，其结果在不同出生队列之间有所改善，且对在更年幼时迁入此类社区的子女效应更大。子女结果与其更可能互动的同伴（例如同一出生队列中的同伴）的父母就业率关系最强，这表明子女结果与父母就业率之间的关系由社会互动所中介。

abstract.text: This article investigates whether virtual contact, initiated through a documentary film, can promote interethnic harmony. We carried out a cluster-randomized field experiment involving over 3,300 households across 121 multiethnic villages in Bangladesh. We find that a documentary film, designed to humanize the ethnic-minority Santals and evoke empathy among the ethnic majority Bengalis, increased the ethnic majority’s prosociality toward minorities, though the strength of the evidence varies by treatment arm and outcome. Using emotion-detecting software to analyze facial expressions during the film viewing suggests that the documentary elicited emotional responses consistent with empathy. We do not find evidence that the intervention reduced the prevalence of negative stereotypes and discriminatory opinions toward minorities. In villages assigned to target network-central people, we find positive behavioral effects on untreated individuals, including Santals, and village-level administrative data suggest a reduction in police complaints in those villages. About five months after the intervention, we conducted a casual-work field experiment involving 720 participants from the main intervention. In this task, pairs of ethnic-majority and minority participants jointly produced paper bags for a local supplier under a piece-rate compensation scheme. We find positive treatment effects on productivity for both ethnic groups, with effects concentrated in villages where network-central people were treated. For the ethnic majority, increased prosociality, and for the ethnic minority, reciprocity or peer pressure may have contributed to increased productivity. Overall, our findings suggest that virtual contact and social networks may help promote harmony in multiethnic communities.

10.1093/qje/qjag001.abstractZh: 本文考察通过纪录片发起的虚拟接触能否促进族群间和谐。我们在孟加拉国121个多族群村庄开展了覆盖3300余户家庭的整群随机田野实验。我们发现，一部旨在将少数民族Santal人予以人性化呈现并唤起多数族群Bengali人共情的纪录片，提高了多数族群对少数群体的亲社会性，尽管证据强度因处理组和结果变量而异。使用情绪识别软件分析观影过程中的面部表情表明，该纪录片引发了与共情一致的情绪反应。我们未发现该干预降低了针对少数群体的负面刻板印象和歧视性观点的普遍程度。在被分配以网络中心人物为干预对象的村庄中，我们发现对未受干预个体（包括Santal人）产生了积极的行为效应，村庄层面的行政数据表明这些村庄的警方投诉有所减少。干预约五个月后，我们开展了一项涉及主干预中720名参与者的零工田野实验。在该任务中，多数族群与少数族群参与者配对，在计件报酬方案下为当地供应商共同制作纸袋。我们发现对两个族群的生产率均存在正向处理效应，且效应集中在网络中心人物受到干预的村庄。对多数族群而言，亲社会性上升可能促进了生产率提高；对少数族群而言，互惠或同伴压力可能发挥了作用。总体而言，我们的发现表明，虚拟接触和社会网络可能有助于促进多族群社区的和谐。

abstract.text: Aspirations may condition the future-oriented choices of individuals and thus may play a role in the persistence of poverty or the effort to break out of it. We run a randomized controlled trial in remote, rural Ethiopia to explore this and evaluate an intervention that aims to change how poor people perceive their future opportunities, alter their aspirations, and through that, modify their investment decisions. A treatment group was shown video documentaries featuring individuals from similar communities who escaped poverty through their own efforts and who serve as relatable role models. Five years after the screening took place, the treated households had increased future-oriented investments in agriculture, children’s education, and assets. The results can be explained by an increase in aspirations in terms of lifetime goals. Overall, this research uniquely provides evidence that a light-touch behavioural intervention can have persistent economic impacts on a poor population.

10.1093/qje/qjag002.abstractZh: 抱负可能影响个体面向未来的选择，进而可能在贫困的持续或脱贫努力中发挥作用。我们在埃塞俄比亚偏远的农村地区开展了一项随机对照试验来探讨这一问题，并评估一项旨在改变贫困人口对未来机会的认知、改变其抱负并借此调整其投资决策的干预措施。一个处理组观看了纪录片视频，片中人物来自相似社区，通过自身努力摆脱了贫困，并作为可产生共鸣的榜样。在放映五年后，受处理的家庭增加了对农业、子女教育和资产等面向未来的投资。这一结果可以用终身目标意义上的抱负提升来解释。总体而言，本研究独特地提供了证据，表明一项轻触式行为干预能够对贫困人口产生持续的经济影响。

abstract.text: Does information about the long-run financial costs of reduced labor supply increase mothers’ working hours? We document descriptively that long-term financial factors are not top of mind when mothers decide on their employment level. Moreover, a substantial share of women holds overly optimistic expectations about pension receipt and wage growth under part-time work. In a large-scale field experiment in Switzerland, we randomly assign mothers working part-time as teachers to receive objective information about the long-run costs of reduced labor supply. The treatment increases both demand for financial information and future labor supply plans, in particular among women who underestimate the costs of part-time work. Leveraging linked employer administrative data one year post-intervention, we find that this group of mothers increases working hours by 7%. These findings underscore that policies reducing information frictions in labor supply decisions may help address remaining gender gaps in the labor market.

10.1093/qje/qjag003.abstractZh: 关于劳动力供给减少的长期财务成本的信息，是否会提高母亲的工作时长？我们通过描述性分析记录到，当母亲决定其就业水平时，长期财务因素并非其首要考虑。此外，相当一部分女性对兼职工作下的养老金领取和工资增长持有过于乐观的预期。在瑞士开展的一项大规模田野实验中，我们将兼职工作的教师母亲随机分配至接收关于劳动力供给减少的长期成本的客观信息。该干预既提高了对财务信息的需求，也提高了未来劳动力供给计划，尤其是在低估兼职工作成本的女性中。利用干预一年后的关联雇主行政数据，我们发现这一组母亲的工作时长增加了7%。这些发现强调，减少劳动力供给决策中信息摩擦的政策，可能有助于弥合劳动力市场中尚存的性别差距。

abstract.text: We introduce and validate a novel approach to identifying good managers. In a preregistered lab experiment, we causally identify managerial contributions by randomly assigning managers to teams and controlling for individual skill. We find that manager contributions are crucial for team success, and that people who self-select into management roles perform worse than randomly assigned managers. Managerial performance is strongly predicted by economic decision-making skill but not by demographic characteristics. Two validation studies support our experimental results. Participants who succeed in the lab receive more real-world promotions and, in a separate study of retail store managers, skill measures strongly predict store sales. A one standard deviation increase in manager quality increases annual per store sales by US$4.1 million (25% increase). Selecting managers on skills rather than demographic characteristics or the desire to lead could substantially improve organizational performance.

10.1093/qje/qjag004.abstractZh: 我们提出并验证了一种识别优秀管理者的新方法。在一项预注册的实验室实验中，我们通过将管理者随机分配到团队并控制个体技能，因果性地识别管理者的贡献。我们发现，管理者贡献对团队成功至关重要，而自我选择进入管理岗位的人表现不如随机分配的管理者。管理绩效可由经济决策技能强烈预测，但不受人口统计学特征预测。两项验证研究支持我们的实验结果。在实验室中取得成功的参与者获得了更多现实世界中的晋升；在一项针对零售店管理者的独立研究中，技能指标强烈预测门店销售额。管理者质量提高一个标准差，每家门店的年销售额增加 410 万美元（增长 25%）。基于技能而非人口统计学特征或领导意愿来选拔管理者，可以显著改善组织绩效。

abstract.text: We provide quasi-experimental evidence of how an innovative market-based solution using remote-sensing technology can mitigate drought-induced conflict. Droughts are a major driver of conflict in Africa, particularly between transhumant pastoralists and sedentary farmers. Index-Based Livestock Insurance (IBLI), a program piloted in Kenya, provides automated, preemptive payouts to pastoralists affected by droughts. Combining variation in rainfall and the staggered rollout of IBLI in Kenya over 2000–2020, we find that IBLI strongly reduces drought-induced conflict. Key mechanisms include a reduction in herd sizes, as well as income smoothing and asset price stabilization, contributing to an overall reduced migratory pressure for pastoralists. Our study suggests that market-based solutions are a scalable, cost-effective pathway to mitigate conflict, complementing political solutions such as power-sharing agreements and institutional reforms.

10.1093/qje/qjag005.abstractZh: 我们提供了准实验证据，说明一项利用遥感技术的创新性市场化方案如何缓解干旱引发的冲突。干旱是非洲冲突的主要驱动因素，尤其是游牧牧民与定居农民之间的冲突。指数型牲畜保险（IBLI）是一项在肯尼亚试点实施的项目，向受干旱影响的牧民提供自动化、预防性的赔付。结合降雨变化与2000—2020年间IBLI在肯尼亚的交错推广，我们发现IBLI显著减少了干旱引发的冲突。关键机制包括牲畜规模缩小，以及收入平滑和资产价格稳定，从而总体上降低了牧民的迁移压力。我们的研究表明，市场化方案是缓解冲突的一条可扩展、成本有效的路径，可补充权力分享协议和制度改革等政治解决方案。

abstract.text: This article studies the effects of automation in a task-based economy in which some jobs pay workers rents—wages above workers' outside options. We show that automation targets high-rent tasks, dissipating rents, amplifying wage losses, and reducing within-group wage dispersion in exposed groups. This form of rent dissipation is inefficient and offsets the productivity gains from automation. Using U.S. data from 1980 to 2016, we find evidence of sizable rent dissipation and reduced within-group wage dispersion due to automation. Automation accounts for 52% of the increase in between-group inequality since 1980, with rent dissipation explaining one-fifth of this total. Our estimates imply that inefficient rent dissipation has offset 60%–90% of the productivity gains from automation over this period.

10.1093/qje/qjag006.abstractZh: 本文研究任务型经济中的自动化效应，其中部分岗位向劳动者支付租金，即高于劳动者外部选项的工资。我们表明，自动化瞄准高租金任务，消散租金，放大工资损失，并降低受影响群体内部的工资离散度。这种形式的租金消散是无效率的，并抵消了自动化带来的生产率收益。利用美国1980年至2016年的数据，我们发现了租金消散规模可观以及自动化导致群体内工资离散度下降的证据。自动化解释了1980年以来群体间不平等上升的52%，其中租金消散解释了这一总量的五分之一。我们的估计意味着，无效率的租金消散在此期间抵消了自动化带来的生产率收益的60%–90%。

abstract.text: We develop a model that integrates modern theories of labor market flows with nominal wage rigidities to study the consequences of inflation on the labor market. Nominal wage stickiness incentivizes workers to engage in job-to-job transitions after an unexpected increase in the price level. Such dynamics lead to a rise in aggregate vacancies associating a seemingly tight labor market with lower real wages—two facts observed during the recent inflation period. The calibrated model jointly matches aggregate and cross-sectional trends in worker flows and wages during the 2021–2024 period. Using historical data, we show that prior periods of high inflation were also associated with increasing vacancies and upward shifts in the Beveridge curve. Our results suggest that policy makers and academics should be cautious about viewing the rise in the vacancy-to-unemployment rate as a sign of a tight labor market during inflationary periods without holistically looking at other labor market indicators.

10.1093/qje/qjag007.abstractZh: 我们构建了一个模型，将现代劳动力市场流动理论与名义工资刚性相结合，以研究通胀对劳动力市场的影响。名义工资粘性会激励劳动者在价格水平意外上升后从事工作间转换。这种动态导致总职位空缺上升，使看似紧张的劳动力市场与更低的实际工资并存——这是近期通胀时期观察到的两个事实。校准后的模型能够同时匹配2021—2024年期间劳动者流动和工资的总量与横截面趋势。利用历史数据，我们表明此前的高通胀时期同样伴随着职位空缺增加和贝弗里奇曲线的上移。我们的结果表明，政策制定者和学者在通胀时期不应将职位空缺与失业率之比上升视为劳动力市场紧张的信号，而不综合考虑其他劳动力市场指标。

abstract.text: We study the effect of conflict-induced displacement on human capital and occupational shifts, focusing on the Mozambican civil war (1977–1992), during which millions of civilians were forced to flee to the countryside, cities, and neighboring countries. Reconstructing the wartime mobility histories of the surviving population, we examine the consequences of multiple displacement trajectories in a unified framework. First, we characterize the education and sectoral employment of the universe of (non-)displaced. Second, we exploit differences in relocation trajectories among extended kin members during their schooling years. Displacement is associated with significant gains in education. Third, using a movers design, we show that minors displaced earlier to better districts experienced an increase in educational attainment. Focusing on moves during the intensification of the war and when comparing members of the same household, regional childhood exposure effects remain strong, whereas spatial sorting becomes negligible. Fourth, we jointly estimate place-based, spatial sorting, and uprootedness effects, showing that all forces are at play. Fifth, a small survey in Mozambique’s largest northern city reveals long-term effects: internally displaced people report higher education than their siblings who stayed behind but lower social capital and worse mental health relative to locals. Our findings demonstrate that displacement shocks can foster human capital accumulation, even in very low-income settings, albeit at the cost of enduring social and psychological traumas.

10.1093/qje/qjag009.abstractZh: 我们研究冲突导致的流离失所对人力资本和职业转换的影响，聚焦于莫桑比克内战（1977—1992年），期间数百万平民被迫逃往农村、城市和邻国。通过重建幸存人口在战时的迁移史，我们在一个统一框架下考察多种流离失所轨迹的后果。第一，我们刻画了全体（非）流离失所者的教育和部门就业状况。第二，我们利用扩展家庭成员在求学期间迁移轨迹的差异。流离失所与教育方面的显著收益相关。第三，采用迁移者设计，我们表明较早迁往更好地区的未成年人受教育程度有所提高。聚焦于战争加剧期间的迁移，并在比较同一家庭成员时，地区性童年暴露效应依然很强，而空间排序变得可以忽略。第四，我们联合估计基于地点的效应、空间排序效应和连根拔起效应，表明所有这些力量都在起作用。第五，在莫桑比克北部最大城市进行的一项小型调查揭示了长期效应：境内流离失所者报告的教育程度高于留在原地的兄弟姐妹，但相对于当地人，其社会资本更低、心理健康更差。我们的发现表明，流离失所冲击能够促进人力资本积累，即使在收入极低的环境中也是如此，尽管代价是持久的社会和心理创伤。

abstract.text: We develop a system of disaggregated economic accounts. The system breaks down national accounting positions into bilateral flows between consistently defined groups of consumers (consumer cells), groups of producers (producer cells), the government, and the rest of the world. We disaggregate the full circular flow of money, including consumer spending, labor compensation, firm profits, intermediates trade, foreign trade, and government transactions, while satisfying all national accounting identities. We implement the disaggregated system for small region-by-industry cells in Denmark and present stylized facts, such as variation in domestic spending, local and urban bias in consumer spending, and a pattern of triangular flows across regions. Cell-level measures of spending intensity capture how much spending by a cell contributes to the income of cells experiencing unemployment after a shock. Using a general equilibrium model, we show that fiscal transfers raise aggregate GDP by more when they target cells with high spending intensity on unemployed cells. The disaggregated economic accounts help governments select more effective policies.

10.1093/qje/qjag010.abstractZh: 我们构建了一个分解式经济核算体系。该体系将国民核算头寸分解为定义一致的消费者组（消费者单元）、生产者组（生产者单元）、政府与世界其他地区之间的双边流动。我们分解了货币的完整循环流动，包括消费者支出、劳动报酬、企业利润、中间品贸易、对外贸易和政府交易，同时满足所有国民核算恒等式。我们在丹麦按小区域—行业单元实施了这一分解体系，并呈现了一些典型事实，例如国内支出的差异、消费者支出中的本地与城市偏向，以及跨区域的三角流动模式。单元层面的支出强度指标刻画了一个单元的支出在冲击后对经历失业的单元的收入贡献程度。利用一般均衡模型，我们表明，当财政转移支付瞄准对失业单元具有高支出强度的单元时，其提升总体 GDP 的幅度更大。分解式经济核算有助于政府选择更有效的政策。

abstract.text: This article estimates that the macroeconomic damages from climate change are an order of magnitude larger than previously thought. Exploiting natural global temperature variability, we find that 1ºC warming reduces world GDP by over 20% in the long run. Global temperature correlates strongly with extreme climatic events, unlike country-level temperature used in previous work, explaining our larger estimate. We use this evidence to estimate damage functions in a neoclassical growth model. Business-as-usual warming implies a present welfare loss of more than 30%, and a social cost of carbon in excess of $1,200 per ton. These impacts suggest that unilateral decarbonization policy is cost-effective for large countries such as the United States.

10.1093/qje/qjag011.abstractZh: 本文估计，气候变化造成的宏观经济损害比此前认为的高出一个数量级。利用全球气温的自然变率，我们发现升温1ºC会使世界GDP在长期内下降超过20%。与以往研究使用的国家层面气温不同，全球气温与极端气候事件强烈相关，这解释了本文估计结果更大的原因。我们利用这一证据在新古典增长模型中估计损害函数。照常情景下的升温意味着超过30%的现值福利损失，以及超过每吨1200美元的碳社会成本。这些影响表明，对于美国等大国而言，单边脱碳政策具有成本效益。

abstract.text: This article develops a New Keynesian model with sovereign default risk. Inflation is set by forward-looking firms, monetary policy is an interest rate rule, and the fiscal government borrows externally, long-term, with an option to default. In this framework, default risk creates inflation pressures through an expectations channel, and tight monetary policy disincentivizes fiscal overborrowing. The model sheds light on temporary inflation events in emerging-market data: short-lived spikes in inflation, spreads, and domestic policy rates. As spreads rise, firms increase their prices in expectation of higher future inflation and low consumption during default. Monetary policy tightens, which reduces inflation and helps bring spreads down by disciplining government borrowing. These monetary-fiscal interactions imply that delivering the flexible-prices allocation may not be optimal for monetary policy.

10.1093/qje/qjag012.abstractZh: 本文构建了一个包含主权违约风险的新凯恩斯主义模型。通胀由前瞻性企业设定，货币政策遵循利率规则，财政政府以长期外部借款方式融资，并拥有违约选项。在该框架下，违约风险通过预期渠道产生通胀压力，而紧缩性货币政策会抑制财政过度借贷。该模型为新兴市场数据中的暂时性通胀事件提供了解释：通胀、利差和国内政策利率的短期飙升。随着利差上升，企业预期未来通胀上升且违约期间消费低迷，因而提高价格。货币政策收紧，从而降低通胀，并通过约束政府借贷帮助压低利差。这些货币—财政互动意味着，实现灵活价格配置对货币政策而言可能并非最优。

abstract.text: This article shows that a CEO’s trust enhances innovation within a firm, providing a novel micro-foundation for the well-known trust-growth relationship. I build a new matched CEO-firm-patent data set covering 5,753 CEOs in 3,598 U.S. public firms and 700,000 patents during 2000–2011. I exploit variation in generalized trust across CEO ethnic origins, inferred from their last names using deanonymized historical censuses. Following CEO turnovers, a one standard deviation increase in a CEO’s generalized trust is associated with 6% more future patents and 4%–6% higher average patent quality, driven entirely by higher-quality patents. Text analysis of employee reviews shows that the CEO’s trust enhances a firm’s trust culture. These results are consistent with insights from qualitative interviews suggesting that the CEO's trust and the firm’s trust culture encourage researchers to undertake high-risk explorative research and development. In addition, changes in the CEO’s bilateral trust toward inventors in different countries have comparable effects on inventors’ patenting, controlling for CEO and other fixed effects.

10.1093/qje/qjag013.abstractZh: 本文表明，CEO 的信任会增强企业内部的创新，从而为广为人知的信任—增长关系提供了新的微观基础。我构建了一个新的 CEO—企业—专利匹配数据集，涵盖 2000—2011 年间 3,598 家美国上市公司的 5,753 位 CEO 和 70 万项专利。我利用 CEO 族裔来源所对应的广义信任差异进行识别，族裔来源借助去匿名化的历史人口普查数据由其姓氏推断。在 CEO 更替之后，CEO 广义信任每提高一个标准差，与未来专利数量增加 6%、平均专利质量提高 4%—6% 相关，且这一效应完全由更高质量的专利驱动。对员工评论的文本分析显示，CEO 的信任会增强企业的信任文化。这些结果与定性访谈的洞见一致：访谈表明，CEO 的信任和企业的信任文化会鼓励研究人员开展高风险的探索性研发。此外，在控制 CEO 固定效应和其他固定效应后，CEO 对不同国家发明者的双边信任变化对发明者的专利产出具有可比的影响。

abstract.text: Empirical studies find that the pass-through of input cost changes to prices is incomplete: a 10% increase in costs causes downstream prices to rise less than 10%, even at long horizons. Using microdata from gas stations, food products, and manufacturing industries, I find that incomplete pass-through in percentages often disguises complete pass-through in levels: a $1/unit increase in input costs leads to $1/unit higher downstream prices. Pass-through appears incomplete in percentages due to a gap between prices and costs. Complete pass-through in levels contrasts with workhorse macroeconomic models that feature homothetic industry demand systems. I identify an alternative class of demand systems that yields pass-through in levels and highlight four implications. First, measuring pass-through in percentages can lead to spurious evidence of asymmetry and size dependence. Second, pass-through in levels leads to systematic fluctuations in relative price and markup dispersion that are not associated with changes in allocative efficiency. Third, pass-through in levels can explain dynamics of industry gross margins, operating profits, and entry in the data that are at odds with workhorse models. Finally, incorporating pass-through in levels into an input-output model of the U.S. economy better matches the volatility of consumer price inflation and the response of inflation to identified shocks.

10.1093/qje/qjag014.abstractZh: 实证研究发现，投入成本变化向价格的传导是不完全的：成本上升10%会使下游价格上升不足10%，即使在较长的时间跨度上也是如此。利用来自加油站、食品产品以及制造业的微观数据，我发现以百分比衡量的不完全传导往往掩盖了以水平值衡量的完全传导：投入成本每单位上升1美元会使下游价格每单位上升1美元。由于价格与成本之间存在缺口，传导在百分比上显得不完全。水平值上的完全传导与具有同质性行业需求系统的标准宏观经济模型形成对比。我识别出一类能够产生水平值传导的替代需求系统，并强调四点含义。第一，以百分比衡量传导可能产生不对称性和规模依赖性的虚假证据。第二，水平值传导会导致相对价格和加成率离散度的系统性波动，而这些波动与配置效率的变化无关。第三，水平值传导能够解释数据中行业毛利率、营业利润和进入的动态，而这些动态与标准模型不一致。最后，将水平值传导纳入美国经济的投入产出模型，能够更好地匹配消费者价格通胀的波动性以及通胀对已识别冲击的响应。

abstract.text: Women continue to be underrepresented in corporate leadership positions. This article studies the role of social connections in women’s career advancement. We investigate whether access to a larger share of female peers in business school affects the gender gap in senior managerial positions. Merging administrative data from a top 10 U.S. business school with public LinkedIn profiles, we first document that female MBAs are 24% less likely than male MBAs to enter senior management within 15 years of graduation. Next we use the exogenous assignment of students into sections to show that a larger proportion of female MBA section peers increases the likelihood of entering senior management for women but not for men. This effect is driven by female-friendly firms, such as those with more generous maternity leave policies and greater work-schedule flexibility. A larger proportion of female MBA peers induces women to transition to these firms where they attain senior management roles. A survey of female MBA alumnae reveals three key mechanisms: (i) information sharing, especially related to gender-specific advice, (ii) higher ambitions and self-confidence, and (iii) increasing support from male MBA peers. These findings highlight the role of social connections in reducing the gender gap in senior management positions.

10.1093/qje/qjag015.abstractZh: 女性在企业领导职位中仍然代表性不足。本文研究社会联系在女性职业晋升中的作用。我们考察在商学院接触更高比例的女性同伴是否会影响高级管理职位上的性别差距。我们将美国排名前 10 的商学院的行政数据与公开的 LinkedIn 个人资料合并，首先记录到女性 MBA 在毕业后 15 年内进入高级管理层的可能性比男性 MBA 低 24%。接下来，我们利用学生被外生分配到各班这一设定，表明女性 MBA 同班同伴比例较高会提高女性进入高级管理层的可能性，但对男性没有影响。这一效应由对女性友好的企业驱动，例如那些产假政策更慷慨、工作安排灵活性更高的企业。女性 MBA 同伴比例较高会促使女性转向这些企业，并在那里获得高级管理职位。一项针对女性 MBA 校友的调查揭示了三个关键机制：(i) 信息分享，尤其是与性别特定建议相关的信息分享；(ii) 更高的抱负和自信；(iii) 来自男性 MBA 同伴的支持增加。这些发现凸显了社会联系在缩小高级管理职位性别差距中的作用。

abstract.text: Do men negatively respond when women first enter an occupation? We answer this question by studying the end of one of the final explicit occupational barriers to women in the United States: in 2016, the U.S. military opened all positions to women, including historically male-only combat occupations. We exploit the staggered integration of women into combat units to estimate the causal effects of the introduction of female colleagues on men’s job performance, behavior, and perceptions of workplace quality, using monthly administrative personnel records and rich survey responses. We find that integrating women into previously all-male units does not negatively affect men’s performance or behavioral outcomes, including retention, promotions, demotions, separations for misconduct, criminal investigations, and medical conditions. Most of our results are precise enough to rule out small detrimental effects. However, there is a wedge between men’s perceptions and performance. The integration of women causes a negative shift in male soldiers’ perceptions of workplace quality. The decline is driven by units integrated with female officers, likely arising from female officers increasing men’s awareness of workplace problems or from men’s dissatisfaction from working with women in positions of authority—even though men in such units show some performance gains. If male-dominated workplaces are reluctant to incorporate women due to expectations that men will become less productive, our paper provides evidence to weigh against that notion.

10.1093/qje/qjag016.abstractZh: 当女性首次进入某一职业时，男性是否会作出负面反应？我们通过研究美国女性面临的最后几项明确职业壁垒之一被消除的过程来回答这一问题：2016年，美国军队向女性开放了所有岗位，包括历史上仅限男性的战斗岗位。我们利用女性分批融入战斗部队的交错过程，使用月度行政人事记录和丰富的调查回答，估计女性同事的引入对男性工作绩效、行为及对工作场所质量感知的因果效应。我们发现，将女性融入此前全男性的部队不会对男性的绩效或行为结果产生负面影响，包括留任、晋升、降职、因不当行为离职、刑事调查和健康状况。我们的大多数结果足够精确，可以排除小的不利效应。然而，男性的感知与绩效之间存在楔子。女性的融入导致男性士兵对工作场所质量的感知发生负面转变。这一下降主要由与女性军官一起融入的部队驱动，可能源于女性军官提高了男性对工作场所问题的意识，或源于男性对在权威岗位上与女性共事的不满——尽管这些部队中的男性表现出一些绩效改善。如果男性主导的工作场所因预期男性生产率会下降而不愿接纳女性，我们的论文提供了反驳这一观念的证据。

abstract.text: Why do managers matter for firm performance? This article provides evidence of the critical role of managers in matching workers to jobs within the firm using the universe of personnel records from a large multinational firm. The data cover 200,000 white-collar workers and 30,000 managers over 11 years in 100 countries. I identify good managers by their speed of promotion and leverage exogenous variation induced by the rotation of managers across teams. I find that good managers cause workers to reallocate within the firm through lateral and vertical transfers and generate large and persistent gains in workers’ career progression and productivity. My results imply that the visible hands of managers match workers’ specific skills to specialized jobs, leading to an improvement in the productivity of existing workers that outlasts the managers’ time at the firm.

10.1093/qje/qjag017.abstractZh: 管理者为何对企业绩效至关重要？本文利用一家大型跨国公司的全部人事记录，提供了管理者在企业内部将劳动者与岗位匹配方面发挥关键作用的证据。数据涵盖100个国家、11年间20万名白领劳动者和3万名管理者。我以晋升速度识别优秀管理者，并利用管理者在团队间轮换所产生的外生变异。我发现，优秀管理者会通过横向和纵向调动促使劳动者在企业内部重新配置，并在劳动者的职业发展和生产率方面带来大幅且持续的收益。我的结果表明，管理者的“看得见的手”将劳动者的特定技能与专业化岗位相匹配，从而提升现有劳动者的生产率，且这一改善在管理者离开企业后仍持续存在。

abstract.text: We study technology sophistication using a novel approach that measures the sophistication of the most advanced (MAX) and the most widely used (MOST) technologies in key business functions within establishments. Using data from over 21,000 establishments across 15 countries, we find that establishments generally underutilize the most sophisticated technologies available in a business function. These MAX-MOST gaps are persistent and strongly associated with productivity both across establishments and countries. At the establishment level, there is substantial variation in both MAX and MOST, with MOST showing a more skewed distribution. MAX and MOST follow different life cycle patterns in low-income countries and among small establishments, and they exhibit different associations with several establishment characteristics and performance indicators. This evidence underscores the different nature of the technology upgrading processes that drive MAX and MOST.

10.1093/qje/qjag018.abstractZh: 我们采用一种新方法研究技术复杂度，该方法衡量机构内关键业务职能中最先进（MAX）与使用最广泛（MOST）技术的复杂度。利用来自15个国家逾21000家机构的数据，我们发现机构通常未充分利用某一业务职能中可用的最先进技术。这些MAX-MOST差距具有持续性，并与机构层面和国家层面的生产率均强烈相关。在机构层面，MAX和MOST均存在显著差异，其中MOST的分布更为偏斜。在低收入国家和小型机构中，MAX与MOST遵循不同的生命周期模式，并且它们与若干机构特征和绩效指标呈现出不同的关联。这些证据凸显了驱动MAX与MOST的技术升级过程具有不同性质。

abstract.text: We argue that the Democratic Party’s evolution on economic policy helps explain partisan realignment by education. First, we document that educated Americans differentially oppose “predistribution” (e.g., job guarantees, higher minimum wages, protectionism, and stronger unions), while the educational gradient for redistribution (taxes and transfers) is close to zero. These relationships have been largely unchanged since the 1940s. Second, focusing on politicians and donors as key party actors, we show that the Democratic Party has moved away from predistribution since the 1970s. The number of predistribution bills introduced by Democratic House Speakers has declined by half since the 1970s. Unions—the traditional lobbying force for predistribution—see their share of Democratic Party PAC donations decline from 90% to 40% from 1968 to 1980, following 1970s legislation that facilitated corporate PAC donations. From 1980 onward, the Democrats rely increasingly on individual contributions from educated donors relative to the Republicans. We show the increased reliance on corporate PACs and educated donors is driven by the rise of a self-described “New Democrat’’ faction particularly conservative on predistribution and social issues. Finally, we trace the reaction of voters to these changes in the Democratic Party. Less-educated Americans begin to leave the party in the 1970s, after decades of serving as its base. We also show that in the crucial transition period of the 1970s through 1990s, New Democrat candidates outperform other Democrats among more-educated voters in both survey questions and actual Congressional elections. As the New Democrats are more socially conservative than other Democrats, their success with educated voters suggests that social issues alone cannot explain educational realignment.

10.1093/qje/qjag019.abstractZh: 我们认为，民主党在经济政策上的演变有助于解释按教育程度划分的党派重组。首先，我们记录到，受过教育的美国人相对更反对“预分配”（predistribution，例如工作保障、提高最低工资、保护主义和更强的工会），而再分配（税收和转移支付）的教育梯度接近于零。自20世纪40年代以来，这些关系基本未变。其次，我们以政治家和捐助者作为关键政党行为主体，表明民主党自20世纪70年代以来已逐渐远离预分配。自20世纪70年代以来，民主党众议院议长提出的预分配法案数量减少了一半。工会——预分配的传统游说力量——在民主党PAC捐款中的份额从1968年的90%下降到1980年的40%，此前20世纪70年代的立法为企业PAC捐款提供了便利。从1980年起，民主党相对于共和党越来越依赖受过教育的捐助者的个人捐款。我们表明，对企业PAC和受过教育的捐助者依赖的增加，是由一个自称“新民主党人”的派系崛起所驱动的，该派系在预分配和社会议题上尤其保守。最后，我们追踪选民对民主党这些变化的反应。受教育程度较低的美国人在20世纪70年代开始离开该党，此前数十年他们一直是该党的基础。我们还表明，在20世纪70年代至90年代的关键过渡期，新民主党候选人在调查问题和实际国会选举中在受教育程度较高的选民中表现优于其他民主党人。由于新民主党人在社会议题上比其他民主党人更保守，他们在受过教育的选民中的成功表明，仅凭社会议题无法解释按教育程度划分的党派重组。

abstract.text: Motivated by recent concerns surrounding the use of third-party pricing algorithms by competing firms, we study repeated Bertrand competition where market demand or the cost of serving the market is observed by an intermediary (or “algorithm”) that selectively discloses demand or cost information to maximize firms’ collusive profit. We show that an upper censorship disclosure policy is optimal, which leads to price rigidity and supra-monopoly prices in some states. Improving the algorithm’s accuracy reduces expected consumer surplus whenever it does so under monopoly pricing. When the state is positively correlated over time, the algorithm discloses more information when recent demand was lower or costs were higher. The analysis extends to a generalized model that accommodates product differentiation and capacity constraints. We relate our findings to recent antitrust cases.

10.1093/qje/qjag020.abstractZh: 受近期围绕竞争企业使用第三方定价算法的担忧所启发，我们研究重复伯特兰竞争，其中市场需求或服务市场的成本由一个中介（或“算法”）观察到，该中介选择性地披露需求或成本信息以最大化企业的合谋利润。我们证明，上截断披露政策是最优的，这会在某些状态下导致价格刚性和超垄断价格。提高算法的准确性会在垄断定价下降低预期消费者剩余时同样降低预期消费者剩余。当状态在时间上正相关时，算法在近期需求较低或成本较高时披露更多信息。该分析扩展到一个可容纳产品差异化和产能约束的广义模型。我们将研究发现与近期反垄断案件相联系。

abstract.text: This article examines the global adoption of technology in the late nineteenth century. We construct several novel data sets to test the idea that the codification of technical knowledge in the vernacular was necessary for countries to absorb the technologies of the first Industrial Revolution. We find that comparative advantage shifted to industries that could benefit from these technologies in countries and colonies with access to codified technical knowledge, but not in other regions. Using the rapid and unprecedented codification of technical knowledge in Meiji Japan as a natural experiment, we show that this pattern emerged only after the Japanese government codified vast amounts of technical knowledge. Our findings shed new light on the frictions associated with technological diffusion and offer a novel explanation for why Meiji Japan was unique among non-Western countries in successfully industrializing during the first wave of globalization.

10.1093/qje/qjag021.abstractZh: 本文考察19世纪末技术的全球采用情况。我们构建了若干新数据集，以检验如下观点：技术知识以本地语言进行的编纂，是各国吸收第一次工业革命技术所必需的条件。我们发现，在能够获得编纂技术知识的国家和殖民地，比较优势转向了能够从这些技术中受益的产业，而在其他地区则并非如此。以明治日本迅速且前所未有地编纂技术知识作为自然实验，我们表明这一模式只有在日本政府编纂了大量技术知识之后才出现。我们的发现为与技术扩散相关的摩擦提供了新的认识，并为明治日本为何在非西方国家中独树一帜、在第一波全球化期间成功实现工业化提供了一种新的解释。

abstract.text: Since 1967, all French firms with more than 100 employees have been required to share a fraction of their excess profits with their employees. Through this scheme, firms with excess profits distribute, on average, 10.5% of their pretax income to workers. In 1990, the eligibility threshold was reduced to 50 employees. We exploit this regulatory change to identify the effects of mandated profit-sharing on firms and their employees. The cost of mandated profit-sharing for firms is evident in the significant bunching at the 100-employee threshold observed prior to the reform, which completely disappears post-reform. Using a difference-in-differences strategy, we find that at the firm level, mandated profit-sharing (i) increases the labor share by 1.8 percentage points, (ii) reduces the profit share by 1.4 percentage points, and (iii) has small to nonexistent effects on investment and productivity. At the employee level, mandated profit-sharing increases lower-skilled workers’ total compensation and leaves high-skilled workers’ total compensation unchanged. Overall, mandated profit-sharing redistributes excess profits to lower-skilled workers in the firm without generating significant distortions or productivity effects.

10.1093/qje/qjag022.abstractZh: 自1967年起，所有员工人数超过100人的法国企业都必须与员工分享一部分超额利润。通过该计划，拥有超额利润的企业平均将税前收入的10.5%分配给劳动者。1990年，适用门槛降至50名员工。我们利用这一监管变化来识别强制性利润分享对企业及其员工的影响。强制性利润分享对企业的成本体现在改革前在100名员工门槛处观察到的显著聚束现象上，而这一现象在改革后完全消失。采用双重差分策略，我们发现，在企业层面，强制性利润分享(i)使劳动份额提高1.8个百分点，(ii)使利润份额下降1.4个百分点，(iii)对投资和生产率的影响很小甚至不存在。在员工层面，强制性利润分享提高了低技能劳动者的总薪酬，而使高技能劳动者的总薪酬保持不变。总体而言，强制性利润分享将超额利润在企业内部再分配给低技能劳动者，而未产生显著的扭曲或生产率效应。

abstract.text: We present a theory of choice in which attention to the features of options is determined by the decision maker’s categorization of the current problem in a set of problems she solved in the past. Categorization depends on goal-relevant and contextual problem-level features. The model yields heterogeneity in attention and choice in a given problem based on different past experiences and instability when changes in irrelevant context cause recategorization. We show that heterogeneous and unstable representations of a choice problem unify major biases in judgment and decision making.

10.1093/qje/qjag023.abstractZh: 我们提出一种选择理论，其中对选项特征的关注由决策者将当前问题归入其过去所解决问题集合中的某一类别所决定。归类取决于与目标相关的问题层面特征和情境性特征。该模型表明，给定问题中的关注和选择会因过去经历不同而呈现异质性，并且当无关情境的变化引发重新归类时会出现不稳定性。我们表明，对选择问题的异质且不稳定的表征统一解释了判断与决策中的主要偏差。

abstract.text: This article examines how the American Medical Association (AMA) helped shape the development of the U.S. health insurance system in the critical period after World War II. Working with the political public relations firm Campaigns, Inc., the AMA launched a nationwide campaign to weaken support for national health insurance by framing it as “socialized medicine,” while simultaneously enrolling people in private health insurance plans to shift demand away from a public alternative. Drawing on newly assembled archival data, we find that greater exposure to the campaign explains about 20% of the rise in private health insurance enrollment and a comparable decline in public support for a national program. The campaign also appears to have influenced policy making through coordinated messaging, resolutions passed by civic organizations, congressional rhetoric, and political donations. These findings suggest that the rise of private health insurance in the United States was not solely due to macroeconomic forces or collective bargaining; rather, it was also enabled by a strategic, interest group–financed effort to shape citizen views and influence policy.

10.1093/qje/qjag024.abstractZh: 本文考察美国医学会（AMA）在二战后关键时期如何塑造美国医疗保险体系的发展。美国医学会与政治公共关系公司 Campaigns, Inc. 合作，发起了一场全国性运动，将国家医疗保险框定为“社会化医疗”，以削弱对其的支持，同时让人们加入私人医疗保险计划，从而将需求从公共替代方案转移开。基于新整理的档案数据，我们发现，对该运动的暴露程度较高可以解释私人医疗保险参保率上升的约 20%，以及公众对国家计划支持率的相应下降。该运动似乎还通过协调一致的信息传递、公民组织通过的决议、国会言论和政治献金影响了政策制定。这些发现表明，美国私人医疗保险的兴起并非仅由宏观经济力量或集体谈判所致；相反，它还得益于一场由利益集团资助、旨在塑造公民观点并影响政策的战略性努力。

abstract.text: This article investigates how a government should manage international reserves when it faces the risk of a rollover crisis. We ask: Should the government accumulate reserves or reduce debt to make itself less vulnerable? We show that the optimal policy entails initially reducing debt, followed by a subsequent increase in both debt and reserves as the government approaches a safe zone. Furthermore, we find that issuing additional debt to accumulate reserves can lead to a reduction in sovereign spreads. Evidence from a panel of emerging economies is consistent with these predictions: increases in reserves financed by public external borrowing are associated with lower spreads, and reserve holdings are not systematically drawn down during crisis episodes.

10.1093/qje/qjag025.abstractZh: 本文研究政府面临展期危机风险时应如何管理国际储备。我们提出：政府应当积累储备还是削减债务以降低自身脆弱性？我们表明，最优政策是起初削减债务，随后在政府接近安全区时同时增加债务与储备。此外，我们发现，发行额外债务以积累储备可以导致主权利差下降。来自一组新兴经济体的面板证据与这些预测一致：由公共对外借款融资的储备增加与更低的利差相关，且储备持有在危机期间并未被系统性地动用。

abstract.text: We study rainmaking as an instrumental religious belief. We present a model in which a religious leader tries to persuade people to believe. Praying for rain can persuade only where the hazard of rainfall during a dry spell is increasing over time, so that prayer is most likely to succeed when people most want rain. We present evidence from prayers for rain in Murcia, Spain, where the hazard rate is increasing, that the church’s prayers for rain predict rainfall over two centuries. To generalize this finding, we gather an original data set of whether ethnic groups around the world traditionally prayed for rain. We find that ethnic groups facing an increasing rainfall hazard are 47% more likely to pray for rain, consistent with our model’s prediction that societies are more likely to pray for rain where prayer is persuasive.

10.1093/qje/qjag026.abstractZh: 我们研究作为工具性宗教信仰的求雨行为。我们构建了一个模型，其中宗教领袖试图说服人们相信。求雨只有在干旱期内降雨风险随时间上升的情形下才具有说服力，因此当人们最渴望降雨时，祈祷最有可能成功。我们提供了来自西班牙穆尔西亚的求雨证据，该地降雨风险率呈上升趋势，教会的求雨祈祷在两个世纪的时间跨度内能够预测降雨。为推广这一发现，我们收集了一个原创数据集，记录世界各地族群传统上是否求雨。我们发现，面临降雨风险上升的族群求雨的可能性高出47%，这与模型的预测一致，即当祈祷具有说服力时，社会更有可能求雨。

abstract.text: How does proximity to coworkers affect training and productivity? We study software engineers at a Fortune 500 firm from 2019 to 2024, leveraging two shocks to proximity: the office closures in 2020 and the subsequent return-to-office mandates in 2022 and 2023. In both cases, co-located teams experienced bigger changes in proximity than distributed ones, facilitating difference-in-differences designs. We find that sitting near teammates increases coding feedback by 18.3% and improves code quality. Gains are concentrated among less-tenured and younger employees, who are building human capital. However, there is a trade-off: experienced engineers write less code when sitting near teammates. In national U.S. data, we find evidence that the rise of remote work has had scarring effects on young college graduates. In remotable jobs, young graduates’ unemployment rate increased relative to older graduates’ post-pandemic (2022–2024) compared to pre-pandemic (2017–2019), a pattern we do not observe in non-remotable jobs.

10.1093/qje/qjag027.abstractZh: 与同事的邻近程度如何影响培训和生产率？我们研究了某《财富》500强企业2019年至2024年的软件工程师，利用两次邻近程度冲击：2020年的办公室关闭以及随后2022年和2023年的重返办公室要求。在这两种情况下，同地办公团队经历的邻近程度变化都大于分布式团队，这便于采用双重差分设计。我们发现，坐在队友附近使编码反馈增加18.3%，并改善代码质量。收益集中在任职时间较短和较年轻的员工身上，他们正在积累人力资本。然而，存在权衡：经验丰富的工程师在坐在队友附近时编写的代码更少。在美国全国数据中，我们发现远程工作的兴起对年轻大学毕业生产生了创伤性影响。在可远程办公的工作中，与疫情前（2017—2019年）相比，年轻毕业生在疫情后（2022—2024年）的失业率相对于年长毕业生上升，而我们在不可远程办公的工作中未观察到这一模式。

abstract.text: Theory predicts that outsourcing public services to the private sector can reduce costs and improve efficiency but can also induce cost-cutting and compromise quality. We assess the Brazilian Organizações Sociais de Saude model (OSS), which outsources management of public hospital services to the private sector while the state remains the residual claimant. We show that this enhances hospital production and operational efficiency without adverse effects on hospital quality and equity. Increased inpatient production addresses previously unmet demand, expanding local access to hospital care and reducing population mortality. Performance gains arise from improved operational efficiency achieved through increased hospital management capacity. This facilitates staffing adjustments, favoring higher-skilled personnel, dismissing lower-productivity staff, and adopting flexible, performance-tied employment contracts. Effects are larger among private organizations with more management experience, underscoring returns to managerial capacity. Our findings show that incentive-ownership structures can address the quantity-quality trade-off in public service delivery, even when contracts are incomplete and quality is hard to measure.

10.1093/qje/qjag028.abstractZh: 理论预测，将公共服务外包给私营部门可以降低成本并提高效率，但也可能引发削减成本并损害质量。我们评估了巴西社会组织卫生模式（OSS），该模式将公立医院服务的管理外包给私营部门，而国家仍是剩余索取者。我们表明，这提高了医院生产和运营效率，且未对医院质量和公平性产生不利影响。住院服务产量的增加满足了此前未被满足的需求，扩大了当地获得医院护理的机会，并降低了人群死亡率。绩效改善源于通过提高医院管理能力实现的运营效率提升。这促进了人员配置调整，倾向于聘用技能更高的人员、解聘生产率较低的员工，并采用与绩效挂钩的灵活就业合同。在管理经验更丰富的私营组织中，效应更大，凸显了管理能力的回报。我们的研究结果表明，激励-所有权结构可以解决公共服务提供中的数量-质量权衡，即使在合同不完全且质量难以衡量的情况下也是如此。

abstract.text: Stock markets play a dual role: they provide information about firms’ fundamentals, which improves resource allocations, and they provide liquidity. We propose a setting in which these two roles interact: if stocks are used more intensively for liquidity, then prices reveal less information about fundamentals. We structurally estimate stock price informativeness for several countries and show that it declines when alternative liquidity sources, such as banks, are in distress. To study the real effects of this mechanism, we devise a strategy to integrate our stock-trading module into a dynamic general equilibrium model with heterogeneous firms. We calibrate the model to the United States and simulate recessions with and without banking distress. In a standalone recession, prices become more informative and allocation improves, mitigating output losses by 4.4%. If the recession coincides with banking distress, agents rely more on stock markets to obtain liquidity, prices become less informative, and allocation deteriorates, magnifying output losses by 22%.

10.1093/qje/qjag029.abstractZh: 股票市场发挥双重作用：它们提供关于企业基本面的信息，从而改善资源配置；同时它们提供流动性。我们提出一个这两种作用相互影响的设定：如果股票被更密集地用于获取流动性，那么价格所揭示的基本面信息就会减少。我们对若干国家的股价信息含量进行结构估计，并表明当银行等替代性流动性来源陷入困境时，股价信息含量会下降。为研究这一机制的实体效应，我们设计了一种策略，将我们的股票交易模块整合进一个包含异质性企业的动态一般均衡模型。我们将模型校准至美国，并模拟有银行困境和无银行困境的衰退。在单独的衰退中，价格变得更具信息含量，配置得到改善，使产出损失减轻 4.4%。如果衰退与银行困境同时发生，经济主体更多地依赖股票市场获取流动性，价格的信息含量下降，配置恶化，使产出损失放大 22%。

abstract.text: This article uses labor force surveys from 160 countries to build a new microdatabase on hours worked covering 97% of the world population in cross section. We also construct time series spanning over 20 years in 86 countries. Hours worked per adult slightly decline with GDP per capita but are weakly correlated with development overall. Hours worked by the young (aged 15–19) and elderly (aged 60+) fall with development, driven entirely by growing school attendance and public pension coverage. Hours worked among prime-age adults (aged 20–59) are stable with development but undergo a great gender reshuffling: falling hours per male worker have been exactly offset by increases in female labor force participation in many countries. Labor income taxes are strongly negatively related to hours worked across countries. This correlation is attenuated when controlling for social spending and disappears when further controlling for working hours regulations. Both social spending and working hours regulations are associated with lower hours worked.

10.1093/qje/qjag030.abstractZh: 本文利用160个国家的劳动力调查数据，构建了一个新的工作时长微观数据库，横截面覆盖全球97%的人口。我们还构建了86个国家跨度超过20年的时间序列。成年人人均工作时长随人均GDP略有下降，但总体上与发展水平的相关性较弱。年轻群体（15—19岁）和老年群体（60岁及以上）的工作时长随发展水平下降，这完全由入学率上升和公共养老金覆盖扩大所驱动。壮年成年人（20—59岁）的工作时长随发展水平保持稳定，但经历了显著的性别重组：在许多国家，男性劳动者人均工作时长的下降恰好被女性劳动力参与率的上升所抵消。各国劳动所得税与工作时长呈强烈负相关。在控制社会支出后，这一相关性减弱；在进一步控制工作时长规制后，该相关性消失。社会支出和工作时长规制均与更低的工作时长相关。

abstract.text: We test for stereotyping—the exaggeration of representative traits—in a high-stakes economic environment. Using surveys administered among undergraduates at the Ohio State University as well as large-scale nationally representative data, we measure how U.S. first-year students perceive the relationship between college majors and occupations. We show that students greatly overestimate the likelihood that majors lead to their representative jobs (e.g., counselor for psychology, journalist for journalism). Using an implicit association test, we show that students associate majors with their representative careers and that these associations strongly predict belief biases, in line with a stereotyping mechanism. A simple equilibrium model of the labor market predicts that stereotyping reduces welfare by increasing misallocation, which we corroborate with correlational evidence on job/major mismatch. In a field experiment, we test a light-touch policy to reduce stereotyping and find significant effects on students’ intentions about what to study as well as the classes and majors they enroll in.

10.1093/qje/qjag031.abstractZh: 我们检验了在高利害经济环境中的刻板印象现象，即对代表性特征的夸大。利用在俄亥俄州立大学本科生中实施的调查以及大规模全国代表性数据，我们测量了美国一年级学生如何认知大学专业与职业之间的关系。我们发现，学生大幅高估了各专业通向其代表性职业的可能性（例如，心理学专业通向心理咨询师，新闻学专业通向记者）。通过内隐联想测验，我们发现学生将专业与其代表性职业相关联，且这些关联能够强烈预测信念偏差，这与刻板印象机制相一致。一个简单的劳动力市场均衡模型预测，刻板印象会通过加剧错配而降低福利，我们利用关于工作/专业错配的相关性证据对此加以印证。在一项实地实验中，我们检验了一项旨在减少刻板印象的轻触式政策，发现该政策对学生关于学习什么的意向以及他们所选修的课程和专业产生了显著影响。

abstract.text: We study how people’s beliefs about the economy covary with household-level events, using a unique link between Danish administrative data and a large-scale survey of consumer expectations. We find that compared to actual inflation, people’s inflation forecasts covary much more strongly (and negatively) with both recently realized household income changes and measures of expected future household income changes. We formally establish that these findings are stark deviations from the Bayesian rational expectations benchmark. Similar results hold for perceptions of past inflation (backcasts), suggesting that imperfect recall is a key mechanism for biased forecasts. Building on this, a series of additional tests, some of which use data on adverse health events, suggests that the forecast biases are at least partly due to affect-cued recall. That is, negative (positive) household-level events cue negative (positive) recollections, which lead to pessimistic (optimistic) forecasts.

10.1093/qje/qjag032.abstractZh: 我们研究人们对经济的信念如何与家庭层面事件共同变化，利用丹麦行政数据与一项大规模消费者预期调查之间的独特链接。我们发现，与实际通胀相比，人们的通胀预测与近期实现的家庭收入变化以及预期未来家庭收入变化的度量之间，呈现出强得多（且为负向）的共同变化。我们正式确立，这些发现明显偏离贝叶斯理性预期基准。类似结果也适用于对过去通胀的感知（回溯预测），这表明不完美记忆是有偏预测的一个关键机制。在此基础上，一系列额外检验——其中一些使用了不良健康事件数据——表明预测偏差至少部分源于情感线索触发的记忆。也就是说，负向（正向）的家庭层面事件会引出负向（正向）的回忆，进而导致悲观（乐观）的预测。

abstract.text: We explore the mechanics of empathy. We show that information about an outgroup can activate and magnify empathy when presented in conjunction with an experience simulating their struggles. This response increases the willingness to help the struggling group. We provide evidence for this effect in an immersive virtual reality experiment where participants (witnesses) experience a simulation of the struggle of unauthorized migrants (protagonists), then replicate these results in a series of controlled lab experiments. We show that information enhances the witnesses’ empathetic response and drives them to engage in more prosocial behavior when it increases their perceived interpersonal similarity, or relatability to the protagonist—an effect we trace to attention: eye-tracking data reveal that information provision concentrates witnesses’ gaze on the struggles of the protagonist instead of searching through peripheral elements of the scene. Conversely, only information packages that strengthen perceived relatability—an effect that can vary across subgroups with heterogeneous attributes—magnify empathy. Together, our evidence suggests that the ability to put oneself in the shoes of another person or group can be enhanced by activating empathy through simple, targeted, information provision.

10.1093/qje/qjag033.abstractZh: 我们探讨共情的机制。我们表明，当关于外群体（outgroup）的信息与模拟其困境的体验同时呈现时，这些信息能够激活并放大共情。这一反应会提高帮助该困境群体的意愿。我们在一项沉浸式虚拟现实实验中为该效应提供了证据：参与者（见证者）体验对无证移民（主角）困境的模拟，随后我们在一系列受控实验室实验中复制了这些结果。我们表明，当信息提高见证者感知到的人际相似性，即与主角的可关联性时，信息会增强见证者的共情反应，并促使他们采取更多亲社会行为——我们将这一效应追溯到注意力：眼动追踪数据显示，信息提供使见证者的注视集中于主角的困境，而非在场景的边缘元素中搜寻。相反，只有强化感知可关联性的信息组合——这一效应可能因属性异质的子群体而不同——才会放大共情。综合来看，我们的证据表明，通过简单、有针对性的信息提供来激活共情，可以增强设身处地理解他人或其他群体的能力。

abstract.text: If unions raise worker wages, who pays? We provide a comprehensive assessment of firm responses to increased unionization, using changes in the tax deductibility of union dues in Norway as a quasi-exogenous source of variation in firm-level union density. In the average private sector firm, higher union density raises labor costs and leads firms to contract employment and production, lowering profits without increasing the labor share. The incidence is shared: consumers bear part of the cost through higher prices, shareholders through lower profits, and the remainder is offset by productivity improvements. The total wage bill falls, with losses concentrated among less attached “outsider” workers. Firm responses vary systematically by the degree of market competition. In manufacturing, where firms operate in less competitive product and labor markets, the response is reversed: the average firm expands employment and production, reduces labor markdowns, and does not experience profit declines. Instead, higher labor costs are largely passed on to consumers through higher prices, with the remainder offset by productivity gains. Workers benefit as both wages and employment rise. These patterns suggest that unions can offset employer monopsony power and that firm responses—and therefore who ultimately bears the cost—depend importantly on market structure. Overall, unionization in this setting primarily redistributes from consumers rather than shareholders and has effects that differ sharply across firms, including a reallocation toward larger and more productive firms. We rationalize these patterns using a partial-equilibrium model of union bargaining with product- and labor-market power.

10.1093/qje/qjag034.abstractZh: 如果工会提高工人工资，谁来承担成本？我们利用挪威工会会费税收可扣除性的变化，作为企业层面工会密度变化的准外生来源，全面评估了企业对工会化程度上升的反应。在平均私营部门企业中，工会密度上升会提高劳动力成本，并促使企业收缩就业和生产，降低利润，但并未提高劳动收入份额。成本归宿是分担的：消费者通过更高的价格承担一部分成本，股东通过更低的利润承担一部分成本，其余部分则由生产率改善所抵消。总工资支出下降，损失集中在依附程度较低的“局外人”劳动者身上。企业反应因市场竞争程度而存在系统性差异。在制造业中，企业所处的产品市场和劳动力市场竞争程度较低，反应方向相反：平均企业会扩大就业和生产，降低工资向下压低的幅度，并且不会经历利润下降。相反，更高的劳动力成本在很大程度上通过更高的价格转嫁给消费者，其余部分由生产率收益抵消。工人同时因工资和就业上升而受益。这些模式表明，工会可以抵消雇主的买方垄断力量，而企业反应——从而最终由谁承担成本——在很大程度上取决于市场结构。总体而言，在这一情境下，工会化主要从消费者而非股东向劳动者再分配，并且其影响在不同企业之间差异显著，包括向更大、生产率更高的企业再配置。我们用一个包含产品市场和劳动力市场势力的局部均衡工会谈判模型来解释这些模式。

abstract.text: People may fail to recall and use information they already know when making decisions. We empirically investigate whether such “retrieval failures” distort consumption-smoothing behavior among Zambian farmers, who derive their income from one annual harvest and spend it over the course of the year. We document that individuals underestimate upcoming spending by 50%, creating scope for undersaving. To improve recall, we randomize an intervention that prompts people to think through their future expenses associatively in categories—without providing any external information or guidance. Treated individuals increase “remembered” expenses by 36%–60%; as predicted by the memory literature, effects are concentrated among small, irregular, and stochastic items. Immediate spending drops and, six weeks after the intervention, treated households hold 15% higher savings. They subsequently enter the hungry season—the final months of the year when consumption typically declines sharply—with one additional month of savings, leading to a flatter spending profile over the year. Households use the increased savings to self-finance additional farm investment, resulting in a 9% increase in the next year’s crop revenue. We replicate the intervention’s effect on beliefs among low-income Americans, suggesting that retrieval failures generalize across settings and populations.

10.1093/qje/qjag035.abstractZh: 人们在决策时可能无法回忆并使用自己已经知道的信息。我们实证研究这种“记忆提取失败”是否会扭曲赞比亚农民的消费平滑行为；这些农民的收入来自每年一次的收成，并在一年中逐步支出。我们发现，个体低估了即将发生的支出，幅度达50%，这为储蓄不足创造了空间。为改善记忆提取，我们随机实施了一项干预，促使人们按类别联想式地思考未来支出，而不提供任何外部信息或指导。接受干预者“记得”的支出增加了36%–60%；正如记忆文献所预测的，效应集中在金额小、不规律且随机的项目上。即时支出下降，且在干预六周后，接受干预的家庭持有的储蓄高出15%。随后，他们带着多出一个月的储蓄进入饥饿季节——即一年中消费通常大幅下降的最后几个月——从而使全年支出曲线更为平滑。家庭将增加的储蓄用于自筹额外的农业投资，使次年作物收入增加9%。我们在低收入美国人中复现了该干预对信念的影响，表明记忆提取失败在不同环境和人群中具有普遍性。

abstract.text: Information often spreads and influences beliefs regardless of its reliability. We show that this occurs in part because indicators of reliability tend to be lost in the process of word-of-mouth transmission. We conduct controlled experiments where participants listen to economic forecasts and pass them on through voice messages. Other participants listen either to original or transmitted audio recordings and report incentivized beliefs. Across various transmitter incentive schemes, a claim’s reliability is lost in transmission much more than the claim itself. Reliable and unreliable information, once filtered through transmission, affect listeners’ beliefs similarly. Mechanism experiments show that reliability is lost not because it is perceived as less relevant or harder to transmit but because it is less likely to come to mind during transmission. Evidence from our experiments, a large corpus of everyday conversations, and economic TV news shows that contextual cues can bring reliability to mind and induce its transmission, but situations in which people share information seldom contain such cues.

10.1093/qje/qjag037.abstractZh: 信息往往不论其可靠性如何都会传播并影响信念。我们表明，这部分是因为可靠性的指示信号在口口相传的过程中容易丢失。我们开展了控制实验，参与者收听经济预测并通过语音信息将其转发。其他参与者收听原始或转发后的音频录音，并报告有激励的信念。在各种传递者激励方案下，一项说法的可靠性在传递中丢失的程度远大于该说法本身。可靠和不可靠的信息一旦经过传递过滤，对听者信念的影响相似。机制实验表明，可靠性之所以丢失，并非因为它被视为较不相关或较难传递，而是因为它在传递过程中较不容易被想到。来自我们的实验、一个大型日常对话语料库以及经济电视新闻的证据表明，情境线索可以使可靠性被想到并促使其被传递，但人们分享信息的情境很少包含此类线索。

abstract.text: We study the history and geography of wealth accumulation in the United States using newly collected historical property tax records from the early 1800s onward. These records come from the administration of the General Property Tax—a tax that aspired to cover all types of property. We construct wealth series at the state, county, and national levels. At the state level, we use annual assessed values of wealth from state-level reports drawn from multiple sources. Because assessed values may differ from market values, we also require assessment ratios, defined as the ratio of assessed to market wealth. We obtain state-level assessment ratios from decadal U.S. Census wealth data (drawn from various census reports, including those on “Wealth, Debt, and Taxation”), in which the census carried out detailed valuation work, complemented with information on changes in assessment practices from the state reports, to build higher-frequency series of assessment ratios. The result is long-run annual wealth series for states from 1850 (or earlier, depending on the state) to 1935. We obtain national wealth series by aggregating these state series. At the county level, we use assessed values (or market values where available) from the U.S. Census wealth data for each decade and apply either state-level or county-level assessment ratios, where available, to obtain market values of wealth for each decade from 1850 to 1930. We use these data to show, first, that the United States experienced extraordinary wealth accumulation after the Civil War and until the Great Depression. Second, spatial inequality in the United States has been large and highly persistent since the mid-1800s. We also examine the determinants of long-term wealth growth and find, among other results, that counties with a higher share of enslaved property before the Civil War or with higher wealth inequality experienced lower subsequent long-run wealth growth.

10.1093/qje/qjag038.abstractZh: 我们利用新收集的19世纪初以来历史财产税记录，研究美国财富积累的历史与地理分布。这些记录来自一般财产税的征管——该税种力图覆盖所有类型的财产。我们构建了州、县和国家层面的财富序列。在州层面，我们使用来自多类来源的州级报告中年度财富评估值。由于评估值可能不同于市场价值，我们还需要评估比率，即评估财富与市场财富之比。我们从十年一次的美国人口普查财富数据（取自包括“财富、债务与税收”在内的各类普查报告）中获得州级评估比率，普查在这些数据中开展了详细估值工作，并结合州报告中关于评估实践变化的信息，构建更高频率的评估比率序列。由此得到各州自1850年（或更早，视州而定）至1935年的长期年度财富序列。我们通过加总这些州序列得到国家财富序列。在县层面，我们使用美国人口普查财富数据中每个十年的评估值（或在可得时使用市场价值），并在可得时应用州级或县级评估比率，以获得1850年至1930年每个十年的市场财富价值。我们利用这些数据表明：第一，美国在南北战争后至大萧条期间经历了非凡的财富积累。第二，自19世纪中叶以来，美国空间不平等程度一直很高且高度持续。我们还考察了长期财富增长的决定因素，并发现，除其他结果外，南北战争前奴隶财产份额更高或财富不平等更高的县，其随后的长期财富增长更低。

abstract.text: Investors’ return expectations are pivotal in stock markets, but the reasoning behind these expectations is not well understood. This article explores economic agents’ mental models of what drives returns. We survey the general population, retail investors, financial professionals, and academic experts to investigate how they forecast and explain future returns in scenarios with stale news about future company earnings. We find that investors strongly disagree in their forecasts and reasoning. Most academic experts view markets as efficient. By contrast, most households express a perspective we call “expected earnings reasoning”: they directly equate higher expected earnings with higher expected returns. Professionals are split between market efficiency, mispricing, and expected earnings reasoning. In detailed experiments, we dissect why households adopt expected earnings reasoning. We show that it arises from inattention to how stock price changes affect investor costs—that is, how much investors must pay to acquire a claim to future cash flows—because the typical format and context of investment problems obscure these cost implications. Our results help connect a series of previously documented anomalies in expectation and trading data and highlight the importance of selective attention and context in shaping reasoning and belief formation.

10.1093/qje/qjag039.abstractZh: 投资者的收益率预期在股票市场中至关重要，但这些预期背后的推理机制尚未得到充分理解。本文探讨经济主体关于收益率驱动因素的思维模型。我们调查了普通公众、散户投资者、金融专业人士和学术专家，考察他们在存在关于公司未来盈利的过时信息的情景下如何预测和解释未来收益率。我们发现，投资者在预测和推理上存在严重分歧。大多数学术专家将市场视为有效的。相比之下，大多数家庭表达了一种我们称之为“预期盈利推理”的视角：他们直接将更高的预期盈利等同于更高的预期收益率。专业人士则在市场有效性、错误定价和预期盈利推理之间分化。在详细的实验中，我们剖析了家庭为何采用预期盈利推理。我们表明，这一推理源于对股价变化如何影响投资者成本的忽视——即投资者为获得对未来现金流的索取权必须支付多少——因为投资问题的典型格式和语境掩盖了这些成本含义。我们的结果有助于将一系列先前记录的预期和交易数据中的异象联系起来，并凸显了选择性注意和语境在塑造推理与信念形成中的重要性。

abstract.text: We study worker noncompete clauses in a large field experiment with two finance firms. Across ~14,000 job offers to freelance recruiters on short-term contracts, we randomize wages and the presence, salience, and duration of noncompetes (all contracts also included a nondisclosure agreement). Removing a noncompete increases mobility between competing employers by 36%–52% and raises workers’ total earnings from the two firms by 12%–17%. We find no evidence—rejecting even small effects—that removing noncompetes generates secret leakage. We also find no evidence that workers choose noncompete jobs for higher pay. Many workers appear unaware of noncompetes before firms’ post-employment communication. The results align with a model of inattention and uncertainty about enforcement.

10.1093/qje/qjag040.abstractZh: 我们在一项与两家金融企业合作的大型田野实验中研究劳动者的竞业限制条款。针对约14,000份向短期合同自由招聘人员发出的工作邀约，我们随机化工资以及竞业限制条款的存在、显著性和期限（所有合同均同时包含保密协议）。取消竞业限制使竞争性雇主之间的流动性提高36%–52%，并使劳动者从两家企业获得的总收入提高12%–17%。我们没有发现任何证据——甚至能够排除很小的效应——表明取消竞业限制会导致秘密泄露。我们也没有发现劳动者为获得更高薪酬而选择含竞业限制岗位的证据。许多劳动者在企业于雇佣关系结束后进行沟通之前似乎并未意识到竞业限制的存在。这些结果与一个关于注意力不足和对可执行性不确定的模型相一致。

abstract.text: This article constructs the first global data set on intersectoral capital service expenditures. I use these data to disaggregate capital services and intermediate inputs in a dynamic multisector trade model. Steady-state allocations and responses to shocks are determined by a capital-augmented global input-output matrix. Two properties of the measured network deliver larger long-run consumption gains from globalization than existing estimates, as well as larger gains in more capital-intensive countries. First, more trade-exposed sectors supply capital to more consumption-influential producers. Second, heterogeneity in the network reallocates sectoral expenditures toward producers with larger declines in capital rental prices. These reallocations raise capital incomes and lower consumption price indices.

10.1093/qje/qjag041.abstractZh: 本文构建了首个关于跨部门资本服务支出的全球数据集。我利用这些数据在一个动态多部门贸易模型中对资本服务和中间投入进行分解。稳态配置和对冲击的响应由资本扩展型全球投入产出矩阵决定。所测度网络的两种性质带来了比现有估计更大的全球化长期消费收益，并且在资本更密集的国家带来更大的收益。第一，更多暴露于贸易的部门向对消费影响更大的生产者供给资本。第二，网络中的异质性将部门支出重新配置到资本租赁价格下降幅度更大的生产者。这些重新配置提高了资本收入并降低了消费价格指数。

abstract.text: We study the causal effects of income on a rich array of employment outcomes, leveraging an experiment in which 1,000 low-income individuals were randomized into receiving $1,000 per month unconditionally for three years, with a control group of 2,000 participants receiving $50/month. We gather detailed survey data, administrative records, and data from a mobile phone app. The transfer caused total individual income excluding the transfers to fall by about $1,900/year relative to the control group and a 4.2 percentage point decrease in labor market participation. Participants reduced their work hours as a result of the transfers by 1–2 hours/week and participants’ partners reduced their work hours by a comparable amount. Among other categories of time use, the greatest increase generated by the transfer was in time spent on leisure. Despite asking detailed questions about amenities, we find no effect on quality of employment, and our confidence intervals can rule out even small improvements. Treated participants broadly increase expenditures, led by spending on nondurable goods and services, with smaller increases in spending on durable goods and human capital. We observe no significant effects on degree attainment, though the magnitudes of the estimated effects generally appear larger among younger participants. Measures of subjective well-being are higher among treated participants in the first year of the transfers but then revert to control-group levels. Overall, our results suggest a moderate labor supply effect that does not appear offset by other productive activities.

10.1093/qje/qjag042.abstractZh: 我们研究收入对一系列丰富就业结果的因果效应，利用一项实验：1,000 名低收入个体被随机分配为无条件每月领取 1,000 美元、持续三年，对照组 2,000 名参与者每月领取 50 美元。我们收集了详细的调查数据、行政记录以及来自一款手机应用的数据。该转移支付导致剔除转移支付后的个人总收入相对于对照组下降约 1,900 美元/年，并使劳动力市场参与率下降 4.2 个百分点。参与者因该转移支付而减少了工作时间，每周减少 1—2 小时，参与者的伴侣也减少了大致相当的工作时间。在其他时间使用类别中，该转移支付带来的最大增幅是休闲时间。尽管我们询问了关于工作福利的详细问题，但未发现对就业质量的影响，且我们的置信区间可以排除即使很小的改善。处理组参与者总体上增加了支出，其中以非耐用品和服务支出为主，耐用品和人力资本支出的增幅较小。我们未观察到对学位获得有显著影响，尽管估计效应的大小在较年轻参与者中通常显得更大。在转移支付的第一年，处理组参与者的主观幸福感指标更高，但随后回落至对照组水平。总体而言，我们的结果表明存在适度的劳动力供给效应，且该效应似乎并未被其他生产性活动所抵消。

abstract.text: School assignment policies are a key lever for expanding access to high-performing schools and promoting racial and socioeconomic integration. For over 50 years, the Metropolitan Council for Educational Opportunity (METCO) has bussed students of color from Boston, Massachusetts, to relatively wealthier and predominantly white suburbs. I estimate the effects of attending a high-performing suburban school by comparing applicants who receive enrollment offers with applicants who do not. A two-stage least squares approach exploits waitlist assignment priorities and controls for a rich set of characteristics from birth records and application data. Attending a suburban school boosts math and English test scores, reduces dropout, and increases on-time high school graduation. Four-year college aspirations, enrollment, and graduation increase along with earnings in adulthood. Students whose parents did not attend college and boys experience the largest effects. The evidence points to several mechanisms, including access to higher value-added schools, higher-achieving peers, and schools with stronger college-going norms. Participants are more likely to be tracked into lower-performing classes, implying that effects could be larger with access to more advanced coursework. District value-added estimates suggest that students’ educational trajectories shift at least as much as they would from growing up in the suburban districts.

10.1093/qje/qjag043.abstractZh: 学校分配政策是扩大优质学校入学机会、促进种族和社会经济融合的关键杠杆。五十多年来，大都会教育机会委员会（METCO）一直用校车将马萨诸塞州波士顿的有色人种学生送往相对更富裕且以白人为主的郊区。我通过比较收到入学录取通知的申请者与未收到录取通知的申请者，估计就读高绩效郊区学校的影响。两阶段最小二乘法利用了候补名单分配优先级，并控制了出生记录和申请数据中丰富的一组特征。就读郊区学校提高了数学和英语考试成绩，降低了辍学率，并提高了按时高中毕业率。四年制大学志向、入学率和毕业率上升，成年后的收入也随之增加。父母未上过大学的学生和男孩受到的影响最大。证据指向若干机制，包括获得更高增值学校的机会、更高成就的同龄人以及具有更强大学升学规范的学校。参与者更有可能被分轨到表现较低的班级，这意味着如果能够获得更高级的课程，影响可能会更大。学区增值估计表明，学生的教育轨迹至少会像在郊区学区成长那样发生同等程度的变化。

abstract.text: This article provides the first comprehensive global evidence on people’s fairness and efficiency preferences, beliefs about the sources of inequality and the efficiency cost of redistribution, and policy attitudes toward redistribution. Using a globally harmonized consequential experiment with more than 65,000 individuals across 60 countries, we show that the source of inequality plays a substantially larger role for inequality acceptance than the efficiency cost of redistribution. At the global level, implemented inequality increases by 85% when inequality is caused by merit rather than luck, compared with a 14% increase when redistribution entails a 50% efficiency cost. We document substantial heterogeneity in fairness views and beliefs within and across societies. The meritocratic fairness view is most prominent in many richer Western societies, while libertarian and egalitarian fairness views are widespread in many other parts of the world. Globally, people are more likely to believe that inequality reflects luck rather than merit, while beliefs in large efficiency costs of redistribution are relatively weak. Fairness preferences and beliefs are strongly associated with redistribution attitudes and actual redistribution through taxes and transfers across countries. Our findings illustrate how the interaction between fairness views and beliefs may shape redistribution across societies, highlighting the importance of jointly understanding preferences and beliefs in the political economy of redistribution.

10.1093/qje/qjag044.abstractZh: 本文提供了关于人们的公平与效率偏好、对不平等来源及再分配效率成本的信念，以及对再分配的政策态度的首个全球性系统证据。基于一项在60个国家、超过65000名个体中开展的全球统一化有后果实验，我们表明，不平等来源对不平等接受度的影响远大于再分配的效率成本。在全球层面，当不平等由功绩而非运气造成时，实际实施的不平等程度上升85%；相比之下，当再分配带来50%的效率成本时，不平等程度仅上升14%。我们记录了各社会内部及社会之间在公平观和信念上的显著异质性。精英 meritocratic 公平观在许多较富裕的西方社会最为突出，而自由至上主义和平均主义公平观在世界许多其他地区广泛存在。在全球范围内，人们更倾向于认为不平等反映的是运气而非功绩，而认为再分配具有较大效率成本的信念相对较弱。公平偏好与信念同再分配态度以及各国通过税收和转移支付实现的实际再分配密切相关。我们的发现表明，公平观与信念之间的相互作用如何塑造各社会的再分配，凸显了在再分配的政治经济学中联合理解偏好与信念的重要性。

abstract.text: There is a large latent workforce in developing countries that consists of hundreds of millions of women who prefer to have paid work and yet are out of the labor force. Often, available job opportunities are incompatible with traditional gender roles that encourage women to stay at home.
