In a randomized experiment with 1,670 households, we partner with a jobs platform to offer short-term data work to women who are out of the labor force. We find three main results. First, flexible work-from-home jobs are highly effective at bringing women into paid work. Job flexibility more than triples take-up from 15% for an office job to 48% for a job that women can do from home while multitasking with childcare. Second, these jobs can act as a stepping stone to less flexible work. Trying paid work from home increases take-up of less flexible jobs two to three months later among women without previous work experience. “Gateway jobs” are especially important for women from more traditional households: their labor supply is more likely to be marginal to flexibility, and in turn, work experience shifts their attitudes to become less traditional. Third, from the labor demand side, remote work comes with trade-offs in worker performance. Working from the office increases accuracy by 3% and speed by 18%. However, these performance drawbacks of work-from-home arrangements may be outweighed by the increase in available workers.

10.1093/qje/qjag045.abstractZh: 发展中国家存在一支庞大的潜在劳动力队伍，由数亿名希望从事有酬工作却处于劳动力队伍之外的女性构成。现有工作机会往往与鼓励女性留在家中的传统性别角色不相容。在一项涉及 1,670 户家庭的随机实验中，我们与一个就业平台合作，向处于劳动力队伍之外的女性提供短期数据工作。我们得到三个主要结果。第一，灵活的家办公工作对于将女性带入有酬工作极为有效。工作灵活性使申领率提高两倍以上，从办公室工作的 15% 提高到女性可以在家一边照看孩子一边多任务处理的工作的 48%。第二，这些工作可以作为通向灵活性较低工作的踏脚石。尝试在家从事有酬工作，会使此前没有工作经验的女性在两到三个月后对灵活性较低工作的申领率上升。“门户工作”对来自更传统家庭的女性尤为重要：她们的劳动力供给更可能处于灵活性的边际上，进而，工作经验会改变她们的态度，使其变得不那么传统。第三，从劳动力需求侧看，远程工作伴随着劳动者绩效方面的权衡。在办公室工作使准确率提高 3%、速度提高 18%。然而，在家办公安排在绩效上的这些劣势，可能被可获得劳动者数量的增加所抵消。

abstract.text: This article provides evidence on how wage inequality among workers affects the labor movement, drawing on three complementary research designs: a vignette experiment with union organizers, a natural policy experiment that increased wage inequality among Wisconsin school teachers, and an information intervention during the 2023 Writers Guild of America strike. Across all studies, we find that inequality undermines union strength through multiple channels. First, among workers, those with high individual bargaining power are more likely to withdraw support in unequal environments, preferring individual over collective bargaining. Second, among union organizers, those facing hypothetical choices strategically respond to inequality in ways that may preserve membership but limit redistribution, such as shifting their campaign away from wages and choosing smaller, more homogeneous bargaining units.

10.1093/qje/qjag046.abstractZh: 本文基于三项互补的研究设计，提供证据说明工人之间的工资不平等如何影响劳工运动：一项以工会组织者为对象的情景实验、一项提高威斯康星州教师之间工资不平等的自然政策实验，以及 2023 年美国编剧协会罢工期间的一项信息干预。所有研究均发现，不平等通过多种渠道削弱工会力量。第一，在工人中，个人议价能力较高者在不平等环境中更可能撤回支持，偏好个人谈判而非集体谈判。第二，在工会组织者中，面对假设性选择者会以可能维持会员规模但限制再分配的方式对不平等作出策略性回应，例如将运动重心从工资转移，并选择更小、更同质的谈判单位。

abstract.text: We measure which economic topics are top of mind using quarterly German household and firm panels from 2020 to 2024, a period that spans the post-pandemic inflation surge and the subsequent disinflation. With these data, we study potential determinants and consequences of having inflation top of mind. In line with goal-directed attention, the likelihood that inflation is top of mind rises with proxies for its true payoff relevance. At the same time, prior experiences predict whether respondents have inflation and energy prices top of mind conditional on a large set of controls for payoff relevance, and this relationship strengthens when the environment becomes more inflationary. Having inflation top of mind predicts stronger increases in information acquisition and inflation expectations over the shock period. At odds with goal-optimality, having inflation top of mind is associated with expectations further away from multiple ex-ante benchmarks. Finally, both key determinants of having inflation top of mind—payoff relevance and prior experiences—are associated with stronger shifts of expectations away from these benchmarks over the shock period.

10.1093/qje/qjag047.abstractZh: 我们使用2020年至2024年的季度德国家庭和企业面板数据，衡量哪些经济话题最受关注，这一时期跨越了疫情后的通胀飙升及随后的去通胀过程。基于这些数据，我们研究通胀成为最受关注话题的潜在决定因素与后果。与目标导向型注意力一致，通胀成为最受关注话题的可能性随其真实收益相关性的代理变量上升而上升。与此同时，在大量控制收益相关性的条件下，先前经历能够预测受访者是否将通胀和能源价格视为最受关注的话题，且当环境变得更具通胀性时，这一关系增强。通胀成为最受关注话题预示着在冲击期间信息获取和通胀预期的更大幅度上升。与目标最优性相悖的是，通胀成为最受关注话题与预期偏离多个事前基准更远相关联。最后，通胀成为最受关注话题的两个关键决定因素——收益相关性和先前经历——都与冲击期间预期更大幅度地偏离这些基准相关联。

abstract.text: We propose a tractable model in which risk, at both the micro and macro levels, is endogenous and driven by incentives. In the model, each firm chooses the mean and the variance of its productivity process, as well as how it covaries with the productivity of other firms. Aggregate risk arises when firms select productivity processes that are correlated with one another. The theory predicts that larger firms and those with lower markups are less volatile and less correlated with aggregate productivity. We find support for these predictions in the data. Through their impact on risk-taking decisions, distortions such as taxes and markups can make GDP more volatile in equilibrium. In a calibrated version of the model, removing distortions significantly reduces GDP volatility.

10.1093/qje/qjag048.abstractZh: 我们提出一个易处理模型，其中微观和宏观层面的风险都是内生的，并由激励驱动。在该模型中，每家企业选择其生产率过程的均值和方差，以及该过程如何与其他企业的生产率共同变动。当企业选择彼此相关的生产率过程时，总量风险便会产生。该理论预测，规模较大的企业以及加成率较低的企业波动性较小，且与总量生产率的关联性较弱。我们在数据中找到了支持这些预测的证据。通过影响风险承担决策，税收和加成等扭曲可以使均衡状态下的GDP更加波动。在模型的校准版本中，消除扭曲会显著降低GDP波动。

abstract.text: Schools across the U.S. have sharply restricted student use of phones during the school day. We evaluate one type of restriction—lockable phone pouches—using nationwide data combining a large-scale teacher survey, GPS pings, standardized test scores, and school administrative records, along with sales records from the largest pouch provider. Using a staggered difference-in-differences design, we find that pouch adoption substantially reduces phone use as measured by GPS pings and teacher reports. In the first year after adoption, disciplinary incidents increase, and we find suggestive evidence that student subjective well-being falls, consistent with short-term disruption. However, disciplinary effects fade, while the estimated effects on well-being appear to recover and become positive in later years. For academic achievement, average effects on test scores are consistently close to zero. High schools see modest positive effects, particularly in math, while middle schools see small negative effects. We find little evidence of effects on school attendance and no clear evidence of improvements in self-reported classroom attention or perceived online bullying.

10.1093/qje/qjag050.abstractZh: 美国各地学校已大幅限制学生在校期间使用手机。我们评估其中一类限制——可上锁的手机袋——使用的是全国性数据，这些数据结合了大规模教师调查、GPS 定位信号、标准化考试成绩和学校行政记录，以及最大手机袋供应商的销售记录。采用交错双重差分设计，我们发现，手机袋的采用大幅减少了以 GPS 定位信号和教师报告衡量的手机使用。在采用后的第一年，纪律事件增加，并且我们发现有提示性证据表明学生主观幸福感下降，这与短期扰动相一致。然而，纪律效应随后消退，而对幸福感的估计效应似乎会恢复并在随后几年转为正效应。在学业成绩方面，对考试成绩的平均效应始终接近于零。高中呈现适度的正效应，尤其是在数学方面，而初中则呈现小的负效应。我们几乎没有发现证据表明其对学校出勤率有影响，也没有明确证据表明自报课堂注意力或感知到的网络欺凌状况有所改善。

abstract.text: Intensifying climate change makes protection against natural disaster risk – either through ex ante insurance or ex post aid – a first-order public policy issue. Flood risk protection in the U.S. traditionally featured ex post aid through FEMA and heavily subsidized insurance through the National Flood Insurance Program (NFIP). In an effort to correct subsidy-induced overbuilding and under-mitigation in flood-prone areas, the NFIP recently moved to actuarially fair insurance premiums. But this change has two unintended consequences: a fiscal spillover onto FEMA disaster aid as insurance coverage declines in flood-prone areas, and household exposure to uninsurable reclassification risk from uncertain climate projections. We develop a model of optimal flood insurance that incorporates the static and dynamic tradeoffs of subsidizing premiums. We then use a variety of identification strategies and data to estimate the five key parameters needed to implement this model. We find that the fiscal spillover and reclassification risk protection benefits significantly outweigh the moral hazard costs, and that the optimal subsidy to flood insurance is 51%, comparable to the level of subsidization before the recent reform.

10.1093/qje/qjag051.abstractZh: 气候变化加剧使自然灾害风险防护——无论是通过事前保险还是事后援助——成为首要的公共政策问题。美国的洪水风险防护传统上以事后援助（通过FEMA）和高度补贴的保险（通过国家洪水保险计划，NFIP）为特征。为纠正补贴引致的洪泛区过度建设与减灾投入不足，NFIP近期转向精算公平的保险费率。但这一变化带来两个非意图后果：随着洪泛区保险覆盖率下降，财政外溢至FEMA灾害援助；以及家庭面临来自不确定气候预测的不可保险的重新分类风险。我们构建了一个最优洪水保险模型，纳入补贴保费所涉及的静态与动态权衡。随后，我们运用多种识别策略和数据，估计了实施该模型所需的五个关键参数。我们发现，财政外溢与重新分类风险防护收益显著超过道德风险成本，且洪水保险的最优补贴为51%，与近期改革前的补贴水平相当。

abstract.text: This paper studies how new varieties enter markets and become locally available. We provide causal evidence of demand externalities that operate in two steps. First, information about new varieties diffuses directly through real-world social ties among consumers. Second, early purchases generate an indirect spillover to firms: local retailers learn from “pioneer” consumers which new varieties are most likely to succeed and adjust their product offerings accordingly. We study this process in the context of direct-to-consumer imports. Using customs records on individuals’ purchases matched to population-wide social networks, international migrant links, and retailer catchment areas, we document economically meaningful demand externalities. Product-specific expenditure shocks abroad transmit through migrant networks and shift which varieties consumers purchase. Leveraging these shocks as a plausibly exogenous source of local demand variation, we show strong peer effects: prior purchases by close neighbors, coworkers, or friends increase an individual’s likelihood of purchasing the same variety, especially for premium and visible goods. We leverage this result to identify an indirect spillover from consumers to firms: retailers are more likely to add a variety to their assortment when it becomes popular among consumers in their catchment area. Combining the instrument with linked consumer–retailer data and a self-conducted retailer survey, we show that this response reflects learning about latent demand for varieties not yet stocked locally. Together, social diffusion and retailer learning generate demand multipliers that reshape local product availability and expand access to global variety.

10.1093/qje/qjag052.abstractZh: 本文研究新品种如何进入市场并在当地变得可及。我们提供了需求外部性的因果证据，该外部性分两步发挥作用。第一，关于新品种的信息通过消费者之间现实世界的社会联系直接扩散。第二，早期购买会对企业产生间接溢出：本地零售商从“先驱”消费者那里了解到哪些新品种最有可能成功，并据此调整其产品供给。我们在直接面向消费者的进口背景下研究这一过程。利用与全人口社会网络、国际移民联系和零售商服务区域相匹配的个人购买海关记录，我们记录了具有经济意义的需求外部性。国外产品特定的支出冲击通过移民网络传导，并改变消费者购买哪些品种。将这些冲击作为本地需求变化的可信外生来源，我们展示了强烈的同伴效应：近邻、同事或朋友此前的购买会提高个人购买同一品种的可能性，尤其是对高端和可见商品而言。我们利用这一结果识别从消费者到企业的间接溢出：当某一品种在零售商服务区域的消费者中变得流行时，零售商更有可能将该品种加入其产品组合。将工具变量与消费者—零售商关联数据和自行开展的零售商调查相结合，我们表明这一反应反映了对当地尚未备货品种的潜在需求的学习。社会扩散与零售商学习共同产生需求乘数，重塑本地产品可及性并扩大对全球品种的获取。

abstract.text: This paper uses a range of natural experiments to show how mispricing of climate risk in mortgages and property insurance creates large taxpayer exposures and leads to excess credit flows to risky areas. Our central finding is that the government-sponsored enterprises’ (GSEs) policies for evaluating property insurers are a crucial source of this mispricing. We assemble a comprehensive new dataset on both mortgages and insurance to analyze these dynamics in Florida from 2009-2018. We begin by documenting a breakdown in the quality of insurance provision, with new under-capitalized and under-diversified insurers dominating insurance markets. These fragile insurers have high rates of insolvency, which we show causally increases mortgage defaults after natural disasters. We find that the GSEs’ reliance on third-party ratings of insurers leads them to accept insurance from companies at high risk of insolvency without pricing for it. This creates large taxpayer exposures, with an estimated 25% of the GSEs’ expected losses in Florida coming from insurance fragility. Most starkly, we show that private lenders strategically respond to the GSE mispricing. Mortgage denial rates are sensitive to insurance quality in the jumbo segment where loans are retained, but not in the conforming segment where loans are offloaded to the GSEs. This suggests that, all else equal, fewer conforming mortgages would have been originated if lenders screened insurance fragility as they do in jumbos.

10.1093/qje/qjag053.abstractZh: 本文通过一系列自然实验，揭示了抵押贷款和财产保险中气候风险定价错误如何导致大量纳税人承担风险，并引发过多信贷流向高风险地区。我们的核心发现是，政府资助的企业在评估财产保险公司的政策是这种定价错误的重要来源。我们整合了一个关于抵押贷款和保险的全面新数据集，以分析2009-2018年间佛罗里达州的动态变化。我们首先记录了保险提供质量下降的情况，新成立的、资本不足且风险分散度低的保险公司主导了保险市场。这些脆弱的保险公司存在高比例的破产风险，我们证明这种风险会加剧自然灾害后的抵押贷款违约情况。我们发现，政府资助的企业依赖第三方对保险公司的评级，导致它们接受高风险破产公司的保险而不进行相应定价。这造成了巨大的纳税人负担，估计佛罗里达州25%的政府资助企业损失来自保险公司的脆弱性。最引人注目的是，我们发现私人贷款机构会策略性地应对政府资助企业的定价错误。在大额贷款领域，抵押贷款拒绝率对保险质量非常敏感，而在常规贷款领域，贷款会被转交给政府资助企业。这表明，在其他条件相同的情况下，如果贷款机构像在大额贷款领域那样筛查保险公司的脆弱性，那么常规贷款的发放数量将会减少。

abstract.text: We use Canadian matched employer-employee data to assess the sources of the union pay premium. After controlling for worker heterogeneity using the two-way fixed effects approach of Abowd, Kramarz, and Margolis (AKM), we find that unionized firms pay about 15 log points more than non-unionized firms. Forty percent of this gap is linked to productivity differences between unionized and non-unionized firms as measured by value added per worker. The remaining gap reflects unions’ ability to extract more rents for workers. Our estimates imply that unions raise pay among unionized workers by around 9 log points, with considerable heterogeneity by industry and firm birth cohorts. The union effect grows to about 11 log points in an extension of the AKM approach where unions also affect the returns to unobservable worker characteristics.

10.1093/qje/qjag054.abstractZh: 我们使用加拿大匹配的雇主-雇员数据来评估工会薪酬溢价的来源。在采用Abowd、Kramarz和Margolis提出的双向固定效应方法控制工人异质性后，我们发现工会企业比非工会企业多支付约15个对数点的薪酬。其中40%的差距与工会和非工会企业之间的生产率差异有关，这一差异通过每工人的增加值来衡量。剩余的差距则反映了工会能够为工人获取更多利益的能力。我们的估计表明，工会使工会成员的薪酬提高了约9个对数点，且不同行业和公司成立时间对这一现象的影响存在显著差异。在扩展AKM方法的情况下，工会的影响进一步增加到约11个对数点，因为工会还会影响不可观测工人特征所带来的收益。

abstract.text: People persist in mistaken beliefs even in settings with high stakes, abundant data, and repeated opportunities to learn—settings where standard arguments imply they should correct their errors. We develop an attention-based framework for understanding why errors persist. When a person channels his attention through the lens of his potentially misspecified model, exposure to data is not the same as tracking the statistics necessary to tell him his model is wrong. A model is attentionally stable when the data the person deems relevant will, in the long run, fail to make the model look implausible. Models that erroneously rule things out—e.g., beliefs that a variable doesn’t matter or that a distinction doesn’t exist—tend to be attentionally stable because they divert attention away from data that would refute the models. Conversely, models that erroneously rule things in are less likely to be stable. Whether an error is discovered depends on the structure of the decision problem but is not tightly linked to its level of harm; arbitrarily costly errors can persist while trivially inexpensive ones may be detected. Nevertheless, no error is robust both to changes in the decision environment and to shocks that expand attention: every channeled-attention error is vulnerable to some perturbation that would reveal it. We use the framework to analyze the stability of psychological biases and empirical misconceptions, as well as to explain why fresh eyes catch mistakes, why people use overly coarse rather than overly fine categorizations, and why people recognize errors in others that they miss in themselves.

10.1093/qje/qjag055.abstractZh: 即使在高风险、数据丰富且有机会反复学习的情况下，人们仍会坚持错误的信念——在这些情况下，标准的论证本应促使他们纠正错误。我们提出了一个基于注意力的框架，以理解为何错误会持续存在。当一个人通过可能误设模型的视角来分配注意力时，接触数据的过程与追踪表明模型错误的统计数据并不相同。当一个人所认为相关的数据从长远来看无法使模型显得不可信时，该模型在注意力层面是稳定的。那些错误地排除某些因素的错误模型——例如，认为某个变量无关紧要或不存在某种差异的错误观念——往往具有稳定性，因为它们将注意力从可能反驳这些模型的数据中转移开。相反，那些错误地纳入某些因素的错误模型则不太可能保持稳定。错误是否被发现取决于决策问题的结构，但与其危害程度并无紧密关联；代价高昂的错误可能会持续存在，而微不足道的错误则可能被及时发现。然而，没有任何错误能够同时抵御决策环境的变化和扩展注意力的冲击：每一个被注意力引导的错误都容易受到某种扰动而暴露出来。我们利用这一框架来分析心理偏见和经验性误解的稳定性，并解释为何新的视角能够发现错误、为何人们倾向于使用过于粗略而非过于精细的分类方式，以及为何人们能够识别他人身上的错误而自己却未能察觉。

abstract.text: Germany experienced a sharp rise in wage inequality over the two decades leading up to the Great Recession. However, a remarkable trend reversal occurred in 2010—well before the introduction of the minimum wage in 2015—when wages at the bottom of the distribution began to grow more rapidly than those higher up. This paper attributes the reversal to an increasingly tight labor market after the Great Recession, supported by strong domestic demand, and operating through several interrelated and mutually reinforcing channels. Consistent with this hypothesis, job-to-job transition rates and between-job wage growth rose markedly after the recession, especially for workers at the lower rungs of the job ladder. Concurrently, workers increasingly moved from low-paying to higher-paying firms, compressing the worker-weighted distribution of firm wage premia. Tighter labor markets also reduced assortative matching between workers and firms, lowered the skill premium, and weakened firms’ monopsony power.

10.1093/qje/qjag057.abstractZh: 在经历大衰退之前的二十年里，德国的工资不平等程度急剧上升。然而，在2010年出现了显著的趋势逆转——这远早于2015年最低工资制度的实施——当时收入分配底层的工资增长速度开始快于较高层级的工资。本文认为，这种逆转是由于大衰退后劳动力市场变得愈发紧张，同时国内需求强劲，这些因素通过多个相互关联且相互加强的渠道发挥作用。与这一假设一致的是，经济衰退后，不同岗位之间的转换率以及岗位间的工资增长显著上升，尤其是处于较低层级的工作岗位。与此同时，工人越来越多地从低薪企业转向高薪企业，这导致企业工资溢价在工人加权基础上的分布更加集中。更为紧张的劳动力市场还降低了工人与企业之间的匹配程度，削弱了企业的垄断力量。

abstract.text: This paper uses high-frequency administrative data to show that most U.S. workers experience substantial month-to-month fluctuations in pay, even within ongoing employment relationships. Monthly earnings instability is pervasive but is masked in annual data. Moreover, this instability is unequally distributed: lower-income, hourly workers face more instability than higher-income, salaried workers. Firm-driven fluctuations in hours account for a large share of this instability. Monthly earnings instability, in turn, increases spending volatility and job separations. Short-term earnings risk is therefore a significant feature of the labor market and falls disproportionately on the most financially fragile workers.

10.1093/qje/qjag059.abstractZh: 本文利用高频行政数据表明，即使是在持续雇佣关系下，大多数美国工人的工资也存在着显著的月度波动。月度收入的不稳定性普遍存在，但在年度数据中被掩盖了。此外，这种不稳定性分布不均：低收入、按小时计酬的工人面临的不稳定性比高收入、固定工资的工人更为严重。企业驱动的工时波动占这种不稳定性的很大比例。月度收入的不稳定性反过来增加了支出的波动性和员工离职的风险。因此，短期收入风险是劳动力市场的一个重要特征，且主要由经济最脆弱的工人承担。

abstract.text: We study identification and inference in first-price auctions with risk-averse bidders and selective entry, building on a flexible framework we call the Affiliated Signal with Risk Aversion (AS-RA) model. Assuming exogenous variation in either the number of potential bidders (N) or a continuous instrument (z) shifting opportunity costs of entry, we provide a sharp characterization of the nonparametric restrictions implied by equilibrium bidding. This characterization implies that risk neutrality is nonparametrically testable. In addition, with sufficient variation in both N and z, the AS-RA model primitives are nonparametrically identified (up to a bounded constant) on their equilibrium domains. Finally, we explore new methods for inference in set-identified auction models based on Chen et al. (2018, Econometrica, vol. 86, 1965–2018), as well as novel and fast computational strategies using Mathematical Programming with Equilibrium Constraints. Simulation studies reveal the good finite-sample performance of our inference methods, which can readily be adapted to other set-identified flexible equilibrium models with parameter-dependent support.

10.1093/restud/rdaf016.abstractZh: 我们基于一个称为关联信号与风险厌恶（Affiliated Signal with Risk Aversion，AS-RA）模型的灵活框架，研究风险厌恶投标者与选择性进入下的一价拍卖中的识别与推断。假定潜在投标者数量（N）或移动进入机会成本的连续工具变量（z）中存在外生变化，我们给出了均衡投标所隐含的非参数限制的精确刻画。该刻画意味着风险中性是非参数可检验的。此外，当 N 和 z 都具有充分变化时，AS-RA 模型的基本参数在其均衡域上可被非参数识别（至多相差一个有界常数）。最后，我们基于 Chen 等（2018, Econometrica, 第86卷, 1965–2018）探索集合识别拍卖模型推断的新方法，以及使用带均衡约束的数学规划的新颖快速计算策略。模拟研究表明，我们的推断方法具有良好的有限样本表现，并且可以方便地适用于其他具有参数依赖支撑集的集合识别灵活均衡模型。

abstract.text: How do global value chain (GVC) linkages modify countries’ incentives to impose import protection? Are these linkages important determinants of trade policy in practice? We develop a new approach to modelling tariff setting with GVCs, in which optimal policy depends on the nationality of value-added content embedded in home and foreign final goods. Theory predicts that discretionary tariffs will be decreasing in the domestic content of foreign-produced final goods and the foreign content of domestically produced final goods. Using data for 14 countries between 1995 and 2015, we show that governments set lower tariffs and curb their use of temporary trade barriers where GVC linkages are strongest, consistent with theory. Turning to quantitative model counterfactuals, we find that severing GVC linkages would lead to the disappearance of tariff preferences. Further, targeted policies to decouple China from GVCs would increase the optimal tariff set by G7 countries on Chinese exports.

10.1093/restud/rdaf017.abstractZh: 全球价值链（GVC）联系如何改变各国实施进口保护的激励？这些联系在实践中是否是贸易政策的重要决定因素？我们提出一种在 GVC 背景下为关税设定建模的新方法，其中最优政策取决于本国与外国最终品中所含增加值的国籍。理论预测，可自由裁量的关税将随外国生产的最终品中本国含量上升、以及本国生产的最终品中外国含量上升而下降。使用 1995—2015 年 14 个国家的数据，我们发现，在 GVC 联系最强的领域，政府设定更低的关税并抑制对临时贸易壁垒的使用，这与理论一致。转向量化模型反事实分析，我们发现，切断 GVC 联系将导致关税优惠消失。此外，使中国与 GVC 脱钩的针对性政策将提高 G7 国家对中国出口商品设定的最优关税。

abstract.text: Not all barrels of oil are created equal: their extraction varies in both private cost and carbon intensity. Leveraging a comprehensive micro-dataset on world oil fields, alongside detailed estimates of carbon intensities and private extraction costs, this study quantifies the additional emissions and costs from having extracted the “wrong” deposits. We do so by comparing historical deposit-level supplies to counterfactuals that factor in pollution costs, while keeping annual global consumption unchanged. Between 1992 and 2018, carbon misallocation amounted to at least 11.00 gigatons of CO2-equivalent (GtCO2eq), incurring an environmental cost evaluated at $2.2 trillion (US$ 2018). This translates into a significant supply-side ecological debt for major producers of high-carbon oil. Looking forward, we estimate the gains from making deposit-level extraction socially optimal at about 9.30 GtCO2eq, valued at $1.9 trillion, along a future aggregate demand pathway coherent with the objective of net-zero emissions in 2050, and document unequal reserve stranding across oil nations.

10.1093/restud/rdaf018.abstractZh: 并非所有石油桶生而平等：其开采在私人成本和碳强度两方面均存在差异。本研究利用覆盖全球油田的综合性微观数据集，并结合对碳强度和私人开采成本的详细估计，量化了开采“错误”油藏所带来的额外排放和成本。我们通过将历史油藏层面的供给与纳入污染成本的反事实情形进行比较来实现这一点，同时保持全球年度消费量不变。1992年至2018年间，碳错配至少达到11.00吉吨二氧化碳当量（GtCO2eq），产生的环境成本按2018年美元计为2.2万亿美元。这意味着高碳石油主要生产国背负了显著的供给侧生态债务。展望未来，在与2050年净零排放目标相一致的未来总需求路径下，我们估计使油藏层面开采达到社会最优的收益约为9.30 GtCO2eq，价值1.9万亿美元，并记录了各产油国之间储量搁浅的不均衡。

abstract.text: A key question in labour market research is how the unemployment insurance system affects unemployment rates and labour market dynamics. We provide new answers to this old question by studying one of the largest unemployment insurance reforms in recent decades, the German Hartz reforms. On average, lower separation rates into unemployment account for 76% of declining unemployment after the reform, a fact unexplained by existing research focussing on job-finding rates. Exploiting institutional changes by age, employment duration, and wages, we establish a causal link between the reform and changes in labour market dynamics. Relying on the labour market theory, we generalize our empirical findings beyond the German case and establish separation rate changes as an important macroeconomic adjustment channel after unemployment insurance reforms. We derive analytically that the change of separation rates increases in proportion to average unemployment duration suggesting an equally important role for most other European labour markets.

10.1093/restud/rdaf019.abstractZh: 劳动力市场研究中的一个关键问题是，失业保险制度如何影响失业率和劳动力市场动态。我们通过研究近几十年来规模最大的失业保险改革之一——德国哈茨改革，为这一老问题提供了新的答案。平均而言，改革后失业下降的 76% 可由进入失业的分离率下降解释，而现有聚焦于求职率的研究未能解释这一事实。我们利用按年龄、就业持续时间和工资发生的制度变化，确立改革与劳动力市场动态变化之间的因果联系。基于劳动力市场理论，我们将实证发现推广到德国情形之外，并确立分离率变化是失业保险改革后重要的宏观经济调整渠道。我们通过解析推导表明，分离率的变化与平均失业持续时间成比例增加，这表明确实?

abstract.text: We provide evidence for a causal link between the U.S. economy and the global financial cycle. Using intraday data, we show that U.S. macroeconomic news releases have large and significant effects on global risky asset prices. Stock price indexes of 27 countries, the VIX, and commodity prices all jump instantaneously upon news releases. The responses of stock indexes co-move across countries and are large—often comparable in size to the response of the S&P 500. Further, U.S. macroeconomic news explains on average 23% of the quarterly variation in foreign stock markets. The joint behaviour of stock prices, bond yields, and risk premia suggests that systematic U.S. monetary policy reactions to news do not drive the estimated effects. Instead, the evidence points to a direct effect on investors’ risk-taking capacity. Our findings show that a byproduct of the U.S.’s central position in the global financial system is that news about its business cycle has large effects on global financial conditions.

10.1093/restud/rdaf020.abstractZh: 我们为美国经济与全球金融周期之间的因果关系提供了证据。利用日内数据，我们表明美国宏观经济数据发布对全球风险资产价格具有重大且显著的影响。27个国家的股票价格指数、VIX 以及大宗商品价格在数据发布时均瞬时跳升。各国股票指数的反应共同变动且幅度很大——往往与标普500指数的反应幅度相当。此外，美国宏观经济新闻平均解释了外国股票市场季度变动的23%。股票价格、债券收益率与风险溢价的联合行为表明，美国货币政策对新闻的系统性反应并不能驱动所估计的效应。相反，证据指向对投资者风险承担能力的直接影响。我们的发现表明，美国在全球金融体系中的核心地位的一个副产品是，关于其经济周期的新闻会对全球金融状况产生重大影响。

abstract.text: We study sequential experiments where sampling is costly and a decision-maker aims to determine the best treatment for full-scale implementation by (1) adaptively allocating units between two possible treatments, and (2) stopping the experiment when the expected welfare (inclusive of sampling costs) from implementing the chosen treatment is maximised. Working under a continuous time limit, we characterise the optimal policies under the minimax regret criterion. We show that the same policies also remain optimal under both parametric and non-parametric outcome distributions in an asymptotic regime where sampling costs approach zero. The minimax optimal sampling rule is just the Neyman allocation: it is independent of sampling costs and does not adapt to observed outcomes. The decision-maker halts sampling when the product of the average treatment difference and the number of observations surpasses a specific threshold. The results derived also apply to the so-called best-arm identification problem, where the number of observations is exogenously specified.

10.1093/restud/rdaf021.abstractZh: 我们研究抽样成本高昂的序贯实验：决策者旨在通过以下方式确定用于全面实施的最佳处理：（1）在两个可能的处理之间自适应地分配实验单元；（2）当实施所选处理所带来的预期福利（包含抽样成本）达到最大化时停止实验。在连续时间极限下，我们刻画了最小最大后悔准则下的最优策略。我们表明，在抽样成本趋于零的渐近情形下，无论结果分布为参数形式还是非参数形式，同一组策略也仍然最优。最小最大最优抽样规则就是 Neyman 分配：它独立于抽样成本，且不根据已观测结果进行调整。当平均处理差异与观测次数的乘积超过特定阈值时，决策者停止抽样。所得结果也适用于所谓的最佳臂识别问题；在该问题中，观测次数是外生给定的。

abstract.text: For standard statistical problems, we provide new evidence documenting (1) multimodality and (2) instability in probability estimates, including from irrelevant changes in problem description. The evidence motivates a model in which, when solving a problem, people represent each hypothesis by attending to its salient features while neglecting other, potentially more relevant, ones. Only the statistics associated with salient features are used. The model unifies biases in judgments about i.i.d. draws, such as the Gambler's Fallacy and insensitivity to sample size, with biases in inference such as under- and overreaction and insensitivity to the weight of evidence. The model makes predictions for how changes in the salience of specific features jointly shapes known biases and measured attention to features, but also create entirely new biases. We test and confirm these predictions experimentally. Salience-driven attention to features emerges as a unifying framework for biases conventionally explained using a variety of stable heuristics or distortions of Bayes' rule.

10.1093/restud/rdaf022.abstractZh: 针对标准统计问题，我们提供了新的证据，记录了概率估计中的（1）多峰性和（2）不稳定性，包括由问题描述中无关变化所导致的不稳定性。这些证据引出一个模型：在解决问题时，人们通过关注每个假设的显著特征、忽视其他可能更相关的特征来表征该假设，并且只使用与显著特征相关的统计量。该模型将关于独立同分布抽样的判断偏差（如赌徒谬误和对样本量不敏感）与推断偏差（如反应不足和反应过度以及对证据权重不敏感）统一起来。该模型预测，特定特征显著性的变化如何共同塑造已知偏差和对特征的测度关注，同时也会产生全新的偏差。我们通过实验检验并证实了这些预测。由显著性驱动的对特征的关注，成为一个统一框架，用于解释那些通常用各种稳定启发式或对贝叶斯规则的扭曲来解释的偏差。

abstract.text: We study how incentive constraints can be relaxed by randomization in a repeated-game setting. Our study is motivated by the workings of a detected bidding cartel that adopted a protocol of keeping the winning bid secret from the designated losers when defection was a concern. Keeping the winning bid secret makes accurately undercutting the winning bid more difficult and makes defection less attractive as potential defectors risk not winning the auction even if they deviate. We formalize these ideas in the context of a repeated-game setting and show that a cartel can attain higher payoffs by having the pre-selected winner randomize its bid and keep it secret from other members. Calibration of the model to the bid data of the cartel suggests that randomization may increase firms’ profits by about 56%.

10.1093/restud/rdaf023.abstractZh: 我们研究在重复博弈环境中，随机化如何放松激励约束。我们的研究受到一个已被查获的投标卡特尔的运作方式启发：当担心出现背叛时，该卡特尔采用了一项协议，对指定落败者保密中标报价。对中标报价保密会使准确报出低于中标报价的价格变得更加困难，也会降低背叛的吸引力，因为潜在背叛者即使偏离，也面临无法赢得拍卖的风险。我们在重复博弈环境中将这些想法形式化，并表明卡特尔可以通过让预先选定的中标者随机化其出价并向其他成员保密，获得更高的收益。用该卡特尔的投标数据对模型进行校准的结果表明，随机化可能使企业利润增加约 56%。

abstract.text: We study collusion among firms against imperfectly monitored environmental regulation. Firms increase variable profits by violating regulation and reduce expected noncompliance penalties by violating jointly. We consider a case of three German automakers colluding to reduce the effectiveness of emissions control technology. By estimating a structural model of the European automobile industry from 2007 to 2018, we find that collusion lowers expected noncompliance penalties substantially and increases buyer and producer surplus. Due to increased pollution, welfare decreases by € 1.57–5.57 billion. We show how environmental policy design and antitrust play complementary roles in preventing noncompliance.

10.1093/restud/rdaf024.abstractZh: 我们研究企业针对监测不完善的环境规制所进行的合谋。企业通过违反规制提高可变利润，并通过联合违规降低预期不合规处罚。我们考察三家德国汽车制造商合谋降低排放控制技术有效性的案例。通过估计2007年至2018年欧洲汽车行业的结构模型，我们发现，合谋大幅降低预期不合规处罚，并提高买方剩余和生产者剩余。由于污染增加，福利下降15.7亿至55.7亿欧元。我们说明环境政策设计与反垄断如何在防范不合规行为方面发挥互补作用。

abstract.text: It is well-known that individual beliefs cannot be identified using traditional choice data, unless we exogenously assume state-independent utilities. In this paper, I propose a novel methodology that solves this long-standing identification problem in a simple way. This method relies on extending the state space by introducing a proxy, for which the agent has no stakes conditional on the original state space. The latter allows us to identify the agent’s conditional beliefs about the proxy given each state realization, which in turn suffices for indirectly identifying her beliefs about the original state space. This approach is analogous to the one of instrumental variables in econometrics. Similarly to instrumental variables, the appeal of this method comes from the flexibility in selecting a proxy.

10.1093/restud/rdaf025.abstractZh: 众所周知，除非外生假定状态无关效用，否则个体信念无法利用传统选择数据加以识别。本文提出一种新方法，以简单方式解决这一长期存在的识别问题。该方法依赖通过引入一个代理变量来扩展状态空间；在原始状态空间给定的条件下，经济主体对该代理变量没有利害关系。后者使我们能够识别经济主体在每种状态实现下对代理变量的条件信念，进而足以间接识别其对原始状态空间的信念。这一方法类似于计量经济学中的工具变量方法。与工具变量类似，该方法的吸引力来自选择代理变量时的灵活性。

abstract.text: Non-family-based institutions for socializing young people may play a vital role in creating close-knit, inclusive communities. We study the potential for youth camps—integrating rituals, sports, and civics training—to strengthen intergroup cohesion. We randomly assigned Hindu and Muslim adolescent boys, from West Bengal, India, to 2-week camps or to a pure control arm. To isolate mechanisms, we cross-randomized collective rituals (such as singing the national anthem, wearing uniforms, chanting support during matches, and synchronous dancing) and the intensity of intergroup contact. We find that camps reduce ingroup bias, increase willingness to interact with outgroup members, and enhance psychological well-being. Campers continue to have twice as many outgroup friends than control participants 1 year after the camps ended. Meanwhile, additional camp elements have heterogeneous effects: rituals have more positive impacts for the Hindu majority than the Muslim minority, while higher intergroup contact backfires among Hindus but not Muslims. Our findings demonstrate that inclusive youth camps may be a powerful tool for bridging deep social divides. Yet, we also highlight the conceptual challenges in crafting optimal integrative camps that help all groups.

10.1093/restud/rdaf026.abstractZh: 非家庭性的青少年社会化机构可能在建设关系紧密、包容的社区中发挥关键作用。我们研究青少年营地——融合仪式、体育和公民培训——强化群际凝聚力的潜力。我们将印度西孟加拉邦的印度教和穆斯林青少年男孩随机分配到为期两周的营地或纯控制组。为识别机制，我们对集体仪式（如唱国歌、穿制服、比赛时齐声助威和同步舞蹈）与群际接触强度进行交叉随机化。我们发现，营地降低了内群体偏差，提高了与外部群体成员互动的意愿，并改善了心理福祉。营地结束一年后，营地参与者拥有的外群体朋友数量仍是控制组参与者的两倍。同时，额外的营地要素具有异质性效应：仪式对印度教多数群体的积极影响大于对穆斯林少数群体；更高强度的群际接触在印度教徒中适得其反，但在穆斯林中并非如此。我们的发现表明，包容性青少年营地可能是弥合深刻社会分歧的有力工具。然而，我们也强调了在设计能够惠及所有群体的最优融合型营地方面所面临的概念性挑战。

abstract.text: We examine how shootings at schools—an increasingly common form of gun violence in the States—impact the educational and economic trajectories of students. Using linked schooling and labor market data in Texas from 1992 to 2018, we compare within-student and across-cohort changes in outcomes following a shooting to those experienced by students at matched control schools. We find that school shootings increase absenteeism and grade repetition, reduce high school graduation, college enrollment, and college completion; and reduce employment and earnings at ages 24–26 years. We further find school-level increases in the number of leadership staff and reductions in retention among teachers and teaching support staff in the years following a shooting. The adverse impacts of shootings span student characteristics, suggesting that the economic costs of school shootings are universal.

10.1093/restud/rdaf027.abstractZh: 我们考察校园枪击——美国日益常见的一种枪支暴力形式——如何影响学生的教育和经济轨迹。利用得克萨斯州1992—2018年关联的学校教育与劳动力市场数据，我们将枪击发生后结果在同一学生内部及跨队列的变化，与匹配对照学校学生所经历的变化进行比较。我们发现，校园枪击提高缺勤率和留级率，降低高中毕业率、大学入学率和大学毕业率；并降低24—26岁时的就业和收入。我们还发现，枪击发生后数年，学校层面领导人员数量增加，教师和教学支持人员的留任率下降。枪击的不利影响遍及不同学生特征，表明校园枪击的经济成本具有普遍性。

abstract.text: We study attention utility, the hedonic pleasure or pain derived purely from paying attention to information, which differs from the news utility that arises from gaining new information. The main, field, study examines brokerage account login data to show that investors pay disproportionate attention to already-known positive information on their stocks. Through its effect on logins, this selective attention affects their trading activity. Three experimental studies then show that (1) investors are more likely to engage in a paid task that will involve attention to a prior investment if that investment has gained value; (2) paying attention to a winning stock is more motivating than a doubling of monetary incentives; and that (3) attention has value independent of information acquisition.

10.1093/restud/rdaf028.abstractZh: 我们研究注意力效用，即纯粹源于对信息投入注意力而产生的享乐性愉悦或痛苦，它不同于因获取新信息而产生的消息效用。主要的实地研究考察券商账户登录数据，表明投资者对其股票上已知的正面信息投入了不成比例的注意力。通过影响登录行为，这种选择性注意力影响其交易活动。随后三项实验研究表明：(1) 若某项先前投资已经增值，投资者更可能参与一项需要关注该先前投资的有偿任务；(2) 关注一只上涨股票比将货币激励翻倍更具激励作用；(3) 注意力具有独立于信息获取的价值。

abstract.text: Labour productivity in manufacturing differs starkly across regions in China. We document that productivity, wages, and start-up rates of non-state firms have nevertheless experienced rapid unconditional regional convergence after 1995. To analyse these patterns, we construct a Hopenhayn model that incorporates location-specific capital wedges, output wedges, and entry barriers. Using Chinese Industry Census data, we estimate these wedges and examine their role in explaining differences in performance and growth across prefectures. Entry barriers explain most of the differences. We investigate the empirical covariates of these entry barriers and find that changes in barriers are causally related to changes in the size of the state sector: a smaller state sector leads to lower entry barriers.

10.1093/restud/rdaf029.abstractZh: 中国各地区制造业劳动生产率存在显著差异。尽管如此，我们记录到，非国有企业的生产率、工资和新企业创办率在 1995 年后经历了快速的区域无条件收敛。为分析这些模式，我们构建了一个纳入地区特定资本楔子、产出楔子和进入壁垒的 Hopenhayn 模型。利用中国工业普查数据，我们估计了这些楔子，并考察它们在解释各地级市绩效与增长差异中的作用。进入壁垒解释了其中的大部分差异。我们考察了这些进入壁垒的实证协变量，发现进入壁垒的变化与国有部门规模的变化存在因果联系：国有部门规模越小，进入壁垒越低。

abstract.text: Using a dynamic panel approach, we provide empirical evidence that negative health shocks significantly reduce earnings. The effect is primarily driven by the participation margin and is concentrated among the less educated and those in poor health. Next, we develop a life-cycle model of labour supply featuring risky and heterogeneous frailty profiles that affect individuals’ productivity, likelihood of access to social insurance, disutility from work, mortality, and medical expenses. Individuals can either work or not work and apply for social security disability insurance (SSDI/SSI). Eliminating health inequality in our model reduces the variance of log lifetime (accumulated) earnings by 28% at age 55. About 60% of this effect is due to the impact of poor health on the probability of obtaining SSDI/SSI benefits. Despite this, we show that eliminating the SSDI/SSI program reduces ex ante welfare.

10.1093/restud/rdaf030.abstractZh: 我们使用动态面板方法提供了经验证据，表明负向健康冲击会显著降低收入。该效应主要由参与边际驱动，并集中在受教育程度较低者和健康状况较差者中。接下来，我们构建了一个劳动力供给的生命周期模型，其中具有风险和异质性的衰弱状况会影响个人的生产率、获得社会保险的可能性、工作负效用、死亡率和医疗支出。个人可以选择工作或不工作，并申请社会保障残疾保险（SSDI/SSI）。在我们的模型中，消除健康不平等会使55岁时对数终身（累计）收入的方差降低28%。这一效应的约60%来自健康状况较差对获得 SSDI/SSI 待遇概率的影响。尽管如此，我们表明取消 SSDI/SSI 计划会降低事前福利。

abstract.text: This paper estimates the Brazilian Amazon’s carbon-efficient forest cover—i.e. when farmers internalize the social cost of carbon. We propose a dynamic discrete choice land-use model and estimate it using a panel of land use and carbon stock of 5.7 billion pixels between 2008 and 2017. The business-as-usual scenario implies an inefficient release of 42 billion tons of CO2 in the long run, resulting from the deforestation of an area twice the size of France. A carbon tax that makes farmers internalize the social cost of carbon would implement the efficient allocation and generate welfare gains exceeding 1.6 trillion dollars. Responses from a carbon tax are highly convex: a carbon tax of only $10/ton would preserve 95% of the efficient carbon stock. An excise tax on cattle ranching, a second-best policy, achieves at most 87% of the first-best welfare gains.

10.1093/restud/rdaf031.abstractZh: 本文估计巴西亚马孙地区在碳效率意义上的森林覆盖，即农民将碳的社会成本内部化时的森林覆盖。我们提出一个动态离散选择土地利用模型，并使用2008—2017年57亿像素的土地利用与碳储量面板数据进行估计。照常情景意味着，长期将因相当于法国面积两倍的森林砍伐而造成420亿吨CO2的低效率排放。使农民将碳的社会成本内部化的碳税将实现有效配置，并带来超过1.6万亿美元的福利收益。对碳税的反应高度凸性：仅为每吨10美元的碳税即可保留95%的有效碳储量。对养牛业征收消费税作为次优政策，至多能实现最优福利收益的87%。

abstract.text: We modify a canonical experimental design to identify the effectiveness of retractions. Comparing beliefs after retractions to beliefs (1) without the retracted information and (2) after equivalent new information, we find that retractions result in diminished belief updating in both cases. We propose this reflects updating from retractions being more complex, and our analysis supports this: we find longer response times, lower accuracy, and higher variability. The results—robust across diverse participant groups and design variations—enhance our understanding of belief updating and offer insights into addressing misinformation.

10.1093/restud/rdaf032.abstractZh: 我们修改了一个经典实验设计，以识别撤回的有效性。将撤回后的信念与以下两种情形下的信念进行比较：（1）未接触被撤回信息；（2）接触等价的新信息。我们发现，在两种情形下，撤回都会导致信念更新幅度降低。我们提出，这反映的是由撤回引发的更新更为复杂，而我们的分析支持这一点：我们发现反应时间更长、准确性更低、变异性更高。这些结果——在不同参与者群体和设计变体中均稳健——加深了我们对信念更新的理解，并为应对错误信息提供了启示。

abstract.text: Many countries base college admissions on a centrally administered test. Students invest a great deal of resources to improve their performance on the test, and there is growing concern about the high costs associated with these activities. We consider modifying the test by introducing performance-disclosure policies that pool intervals of performance rankings. Pooling affects the equilibrium allocation of students to colleges, which hurts some students and benefits others, but also affects students’ effort. We investigate how such policies can improve students’ welfare in a Pareto sense, study the Pareto frontier of pooling policies, and identify improvements that are robust to the distribution of college seats. We illustrate the potential applicability of our results with an empirical estimation that uses data on college admissions in Turkey. We find that a policy that pools a large fraction of the lowest-performing students leads to a Pareto improvement in a contest based on the estimated parameters. A laboratory experiment based on the estimated parameters generally supports our theoretical predictions.

10.1093/restud/rdaf033.abstractZh: 许多国家依据统一组织的考试进行大学招生。学生投入大量资源以提高考试成绩，人们日益担心这些活动带来的高成本。我们考虑通过引入成绩披露政策来修改考试，这些政策将表现排名区间归并。归并会影响学生在大学之间的均衡配置，使一些学生受损、另一些学生受益，但也会影响学生的努力。我们考察此类政策如何在帕累托意义上改善学生福利，研究归并政策的帕累托前沿，并识别对大学招生名额分布稳健的改进。我们利用土耳其大学招生数据进行的实证估计说明结果的可能适用性。我们发现，在基于估计参数的竞赛中，将很大比例表现最低的学生归并的政策会带来帕累托改进。基于估计参数的实验室实验总体上支持我们的理论预测。

abstract.text: We discuss how to estimate the interplay between genes (nature) and environments (nurture), with an empirical illustration of the moderating effect of school starting age on one’s genetic predisposition towards educational attainment. We argue that gene–environment (G×E) studies can be instrumental for (i) assessing treatment effect heterogeneity, (ii) testing theoretical predictions, and (iii) uncovering mechanisms, thereby improving understanding of how (policy) interventions affect population subgroups. Empirically, we find that being old-for-grade and having a higher genetic propensity for education benefits children on assessment tests as they progress through school. In this setting, families appear to increase genetic inequalities while schools seem to reduce them.

10.1093/restud/rdaf034.abstractZh: 我们讨论如何估计基因（先天）与环境（后天）之间的交互作用，并以入学年龄对个体教育获得遗传倾向的调节效应作为经验示例。我们认为，基因—环境（G×E）研究有助于：(i) 评估处理效应异质性；(ii) 检验理论预测；(iii) 揭示机制，从而增进对（政策）干预如何影响不同人口子群体的理解。在经验分析中，我们发现，在同年级中年龄偏大且具有更高教育遗传倾向的儿童，随着在校年级提高，在评估测试中表现更好。在这一情境下，家庭似乎会扩大遗传不平等，而学校似乎会缩小遗传不平等。

abstract.text: Bank capital requirements are based on book values, which are slow to reflect losses. In this article, we develop a dynamic model of banks to study the interaction of regulation and delayed accounting. Our model explains four stylized facts: book and market values diverge during crises, the market-to-book ratio predicts future profitability, book leverage constraints rarely bind strictly even as market leverage fans out during crises, and banks delever gradually after net-worth shocks. We show how delayed accounting can allow the regulator to achieve better outcomes than immediate (mark-to-market) accounting. In an estimated version of the model, the optimal regulation couples faster loan-loss recognition with a modest relaxation of the book leverage constraint.

10.1093/restud/rdaf035.abstractZh: 银行资本要求基于账面价值，而账面价值对损失的反映较为迟缓。本文构建一个银行动态模型，研究监管与延迟会计之间的相互作用。我们的模型解释了四个典型事实：危机期间账面价值与市场价值出现分化；市净率能够预测未来盈利能力；即便危机期间市场杠杆趋于分散，账面杠杆约束也很少严格构成约束；银行在净值冲击后逐步去杠杆。我们表明，相较于即时（按市值计价）会计，延迟会计可使监管者取得更好的结果。在模型的估计版本中，最优监管将更快确认贷款损失与适度放松账面杠杆约束结合起来。

abstract.text: This article studies the efficient allocation in an economy in which firms are connected through input–output linkages and must pay a fixed cost to produce. When economic conditions are poor, some firms might decide not to operate, thereby severing the links with their neighbours and changing the structure of the production network. Since producers benefit from having access to additional suppliers, nearby firms tend to operate, or not, together. As a result, the production network features clusters of operating firms, and the exit of a producer can create a cascade of firm shutdowns. While well-connected firms are better able to withstand shocks, they trigger larger cascades upon exit. The theory also predicts how the structure of the production network changes over the business cycle. As in the data, recessions are associated with more dispersed networks that feature fewer highly connected firms. In the calibrated economy, the endogenous reorganization of the network substantially dampens the impact of idiosyncratic shocks on aggregate fluctuations.

10.1093/restud/rdaf036.abstractZh: 本文研究一个经济体中的有效配置：在该经济体中，企业通过投入产出联系相互连接，并且必须支付固定成本才能生产。当经济状况不佳时，一些企业可能决定不经营，从而切断与邻近企业的联系，并改变生产网络的结构。由于生产者从能够获得额外供应商中获益，邻近企业往往共同经营或共同停止经营。因此，生产网络表现为经营企业集群，而一个生产者的退出可能引发企业倒闭的连锁反应。连通性好的企业更能抵御冲击，但它们退出时会引发更大的连锁倒闭。该理论还预测生产网络结构如何随经济周期变化。与数据中的情形一样，衰退伴随着更为分散、高连通性企业更少的网络。在校准经济中，网络的内生重组大幅抑制了个体特异性冲击对总量波动的影响。

abstract.text: What characteristics of news generate over-or-underreaction? We study the asset-pricing consequences of diagnostic expectations, a model of belief formation based on the representativeness heuristic, in a setting where news events are drawn from categories with extreme distributions of fundamentals. Our model predicts greater overreaction to news belonging to categories with more extreme outliers, or tail events. We test our theory on a comprehensive database of corporate news that includes news from twenty-four different categories, including earnings announcements, product launches, mergers and acquisition, business expansions, and client-related news. We find theory-consistent heterogeneity in investor reaction to news, with more overreaction in the form of greater post-announcement return reversals and trading volume for news categories with more extreme distributions of fundamentals.

10.1093/restud/rdaf037.abstractZh: 新闻的哪些特征会导致过度反应或反应不足？我们研究诊断性预期的资产定价后果。诊断性预期是一种基于代表性启发式的信念形成模型，我们所处的设定中，新闻事件来自基本面分布极端的类别。我们的模型预测，对于属于具有更极端离群值（即尾部事件）类别的新闻，投资者会出现更强的过度反应。我们用一个涵盖公司新闻的综合数据库检验该理论，该数据库包含来自24个不同类别的新闻，包括盈余公告、产品发布、并购、业务扩张以及与客户相关的新闻。我们发现，投资者对新闻的反应存在与理论一致的异质性：对于基本面分布更极端的新闻类别，过度反应更强，表现为更大的公告后收益率反转和更高的交易量。

abstract.text: This paper documents that the Pearl Harbor attack triggered a sharp increase in volunteer enlistment rates of American men, the magnitude of the increase was smaller for Black men than for White men and the Black–White gap was larger in counties with higher levels of racial discrimination. The results suggest that political exclusion and discrimination can undermine support for the government during critical times such as war.

10.1093/restud/rdaf038.abstractZh: 本文记录，珍珠港事件引发美国男性志愿入伍率急剧上升；黑人男性的上升幅度小于白人男性，且在种族歧视程度更高的县，黑人与白人之间的差距更大。结果表明，政治排斥和歧视可能在战争等关键时刻削弱对政府的支持。

abstract.text: How much does firm intangibility amplify CEOs’ persistent private information and reduce firms’ public listing propensity? We develop a model of competing public and private investors financing firms heterogeneously exposed to persistent private cash flows. Equilibrium financing is driven by information rent differentials in CEO compensation. We validate and structurally estimate the model using firm listing and CEO compensation data. We find private (intangible) cash flows exhibit 63% higher persistence than their tangible counterparts. Further, if firm intangibility levels returned to those of 1980, mean listing propensities would increase 5 percentage points while mean CEO variable pay growth would decrease by 61%.

10.1093/restud/rdaf039.abstractZh: 企业无形性会在多大程度上放大 CEO 的持续性私有信息，并降低企业的上市倾向？我们构建了一个模型，其中相互竞争的公开市场投资者与私人投资者为异质地暴露于持续性私有现金流的企业提供融资。均衡融资由 CEO 薪酬中的信息租金差异驱动。我们利用企业上市和 CEO 薪酬数据对模型进行验证并进行结构估计。我们发现，私有（无形）现金流的持续性比有形现金流高 63%。此外，如果企业无形性水平回到 1980 年的水平，平均上市倾向将上升 5 个百分点，而 CEO 平均可变薪酬增长将下降 61%。

abstract.text: This article views hiring as a contextual bandit problem: to find the best workers over time, firms must balance “exploitation” (selecting from groups with proven track records) with “exploration” (selecting from under-represented groups to learn about quality). Yet modern hiring algorithms, based on supervised learning approaches, are designed solely for exploitation. Instead, we build a resume screening algorithm that values exploration by evaluating candidates according to their statistical upside potential. Using data from professional services recruiting within a Fortune 500 firm, we show that this approach improves the quality (as measured by eventual hiring rates) of candidates selected for an interview, while also increasing demographic diversity, relative to the firm’s existing practices. The same is not true for traditional supervised learning-based algorithms, which improve hiring rates but select far fewer Black and Hispanic applicants. Together, our results highlight the importance of incorporating exploration in developing decision-making algorithms that are potentially both more efficient and equitable.

10.1093/restud/rdaf040.abstractZh: 本文将招聘视为一个上下文老虎机问题：为了随时间找到最佳员工，企业必须在“利用”（从有可靠过往记录的群体中挑选）与“探索”（从代表性不足的群体中挑选以了解其质量）之间取得平衡。然而，基于监督学习的现代招聘算法仅用于利用。相反，我们构建了一种重视探索的简历筛选算法，依据候选人的统计上行潜力对其进行评估。利用一家财富500强公司内部专业服务招聘的数据，我们表明，相对于公司现有做法，该方法提高了入选面试候选人的质量（以最终录用率衡量），同时也提高了人口统计多样性。传统基于监督学习的算法则并非如此：它们提高了录用率，但选出的黑人和西班牙裔申请者少得多。总之，我们的结果凸显了在开发可能既更高效又更公平的决策算法时纳入探索的重要性。

abstract.text: We develop a satisficing model of choice in which the available alternatives differ in their inherent complexity. We assume—and experimentally validate—that complexity leads to errors in the perception of alternatives’ values. The model yields sharp predictions about the effect of complexity on choice probabilities, some of which qualitatively contrast with those of maximization-based choice models. We confirm the predictions of the satisficing model—and thus reject maximization—in a novel data set with information on hundreds of millions of real-world chess moves by highly experienced players. Looking beyond chess, our work offers a blueprint for incorporating complexity at the level of individual objects into models of choice and for detecting satisficing outside of the laboratory.

10.1093/restud/rdaf041.abstractZh: 我们构建了一个满意化选择模型，其中可选项的内在复杂性各不相同。我们假设——并通过实验验证——复杂性会导致对选项价值的感知出现误差。该模型就复杂性对选择概率的影响给出明确预测，其中一些预测在定性上与基于最大化的选择模型相异。我们利用一个包含数亿步经验丰富棋手真实国际象棋走子信息的新数据集，证实了满意化模型的预测——从而拒绝最大化。除国际象棋之外，我们的研究为将个体对象层面的复杂性纳入选择模型，以及在实验室之外识别满意化行为提供了蓝图。

abstract.text: We document that most dispersion in marginal revenue products of inputs occurs across plants within firms rather than between firms. This is commonly thought to reflect misallocation: dispersion is “bad”. However, we show that eliminating frictions hampering internal capital markets in a multi-plant firm model may in fact increase productivity dispersion and raise output: dispersion can be “good”. This arises as firms optimally stagger investment activity across their plants over time to avoid raising costly external finance, instead relying on reallocating internal funds. The staggering in turn generates dispersion in marginal revenue products. We use U.S. Census data on multi-plant manufacturing firms to provide empirical evidence for the model mechanism and show a quantitatively important role for good dispersion. Since there is less scope for good dispersion in emerging economies, the difference in the degree of misallocation between emerging and developed economies looks more pronounced than previously thought.

10.1093/restud/rdaf042.abstractZh: 我们发现，投入品边际收益产品的大部分离散度来自企业内部各工厂之间，而非企业之间。通常认为这反映了错配：离散是坏的。然而，我们表明，在多工厂企业模型中消除阻碍内部资本市场的摩擦，实际上可能提高生产率离散度并增加产出：离散也可以是好的。其原因在于，企业会最优地在时间上错开各工厂的投资活动，以避免筹集成本高昂的外部融资，转而依赖重新配置内部资金。这种错开进而导致边际收益产品出现离散。我们使用美国人口普查局关于多工厂制造业企业的数据，为模型机制提供经验证据，并表明好的离散具有数量上重要的作用。由于新兴经济体中好的离散余地较小，新兴经济体与发达经济体之间错配程度的差异看起来比此前认为的更为明显。

abstract.text: A collective choice problem specifies a finite set of alternatives from which a group of expected utility maximizers must choose. We associate a collective pseudo market with every collective choice problem and establish the existence and efficiency of pseudo Lindahl equilibrium (PLE) allocations. We also associate a cooperative bargaining problem with every collective choice problem and define a set-valued solution concept, the ω-weighted Nash bargaining set where ω is a vector of welfare weights. We provide axioms that characterize the ω-weighted Nash bargaining set. Our main result shows that ω-weighted Nash bargaining set payoffs are also the PLE payoffs of the corresponding collective pseudo market with the same utility functions and incomes ω. We define a pseudo core for collective pseudo markets and show that pseudo Lindahl equilibria are in the pseudo core. We characterize the set of PLE outcomes of discrete allocation problems and show that they contain the set of pseudo Walrasian equilibrium outcomes.

10.1093/restud/rdaf043.abstractZh: 一个集体选择问题给定一个有限备选方案集合，一组期望效用最大化者必须从中作出选择。我们将每个集体选择问题与一个集体伪市场相联系，并确立伪林达尔均衡（PLE）配置的存在性与效率。我们还将每个集体选择问题与一个合作谈判问题相联系，并定义一个集值解概念，即ω加权纳什谈判集，其中ω为福利权重向量。我们给出刻画ω加权纳什谈判集的公理。我们的主要结果表明，ω加权纳什谈判集收益同时也是对应集体伪市场在相同效用函数和收入ω下的PLE收益。我们为集体伪市场定义伪核心，并证明伪林达尔均衡位于伪核心中。我们刻画离散配置问题的PLE结果集合，并证明其包含伪瓦尔拉斯均衡结果集合。

abstract.text: This paper studies the effects of the court-ordered removal of children from home on health, crime, and education. To isolate causal effects, I exploit quasi-random variation in judge assignment together with across-judge variation in the tendency to favour removal in an instrumental variable design. Using a novel data set (N=26,579) based on Swedish court documents that I transcribe and link with detailed register data, I find that court-ordered out-of-home placement has large adverse effects on the mortality of the marginal child. These effects are primarily driven by suicides that occur while the removed child is still placed in out-of-home care. Removal also causes an increase in hospitalizations for mental illness and non-narcotic crimes. There is little evidence of adverse health effects for birth parents. I explore potential explanations for the detrimental effects on child health. Adverse care conditions and peer exposure appear to be important channels.

10.1093/restud/rdaf044.abstractZh: 本文研究法院命令将儿童带离家庭对健康、犯罪和教育的影响。为识别因果效应，我利用法官分配的准随机变异，以及不同法官在倾向于裁定带离家庭方面的差异，构建工具变量设计。基于我转录并与详细登记数据链接的瑞典法院文件所构建的新数据集（N=26,579），我发现法院命令的家庭外安置对边际儿童死亡率具有很大的不利影响。这些效应主要由被带离儿童仍处于家庭外照料期间发生的自杀所驱动。带离还会导致精神疾病住院增加和非麻醉品犯罪增加。几乎没有证据表明亲生父母受到不利健康影响。我探讨了儿童健康受损的潜在解释。不利的照料条件和同伴接触似乎是重要渠道。

abstract.text: We provide a macroeconomic theory where demand for goods has a productive role. A search friction prevents perfect matching between producers and potential customers. Larger demand induces more search, which, in turn, increases GDP and measured total factor productivity (TFP). We embed the product-market friction in a standard neoclassical model and estimate it using Bayesian techniques. Business cycles are driven by preference shocks, true technology shocks, and investment-specific shocks. Preference shocks have qualitatively similar effects as true productivity shocks. These shocks account for a large share of the fluctuations in consumption, GDP, and measured TFP and can be identified using shopping time data.

10.1093/restud/rdaf045.abstractZh: 我们构建了一个宏观经济理论，其中商品需求具有生产性作用。搜寻摩擦使生产者与潜在客户之间无法完全匹配。更大的需求会引致更多搜寻，进而提高 GDP 和测得的全要素生产率（TFP）。我们将产品市场摩擦嵌入标准新古典模型，并使用贝叶斯方法对其进行估计。经济周期由偏好冲击、真实技术冲击和投资特定冲击驱动。偏好冲击在定性上与真实生产率冲击具有相似效应。这些冲击解释了消费、GDP 和测得 TFP 波动的很大一部分，并可利用购物时间数据加以识别。

abstract.text: We use decision theory to confront uncertainty that is sufficiently broad to incorporate “models as approximations.” We presume the existence of a featured collection of what we call “structured models” that have explicit substantive motivations. The decision-maker confronts uncertainty through the lens of these models, but also views these models as simplifications, and hence, as misspecified. We extend the max–min analysis under model ambiguity to incorporate the uncertainty induced by acknowledging that the models used in decision making are simplified approximations. Formally, we provide an axiomatic rationale for a decision criterion that incorporates model misspecification concerns. We then extend our analysis beyond the max-min case allowing for a more general criterion that encompasses a Bayesian formulation.

10.1093/restud/rdaf046.abstractZh: 我们运用决策理论来应对足够宽泛、足以纳入“模型作为近似”的不确定性。我们假定存在一组我们称之为“结构化模型”的特定模型集合，这些模型具有明确的实质性动机。决策者通过这些模型的视角面对不确定性，但也将这些模型视为简化，并因此视为错误设定。我们将模型模糊性下的最大最小分析扩展到纳入如下不确定性：承认决策中所用模型是简化近似所引致的不确定性。形式上，我们为一种纳入模型错误设定关注的决策准则提供公理化依据。随后，我们将分析扩展到最大最小情形之外，允许采用一种包含贝叶斯表述的更一般准则。

abstract.text: We revisit the recent revealed preference analysis of sophisticated quasi-hyperbolic consumers by Blow et al. [(2021), “Non-parametric Analysis of Time-Inconsistent Preferences”, The Review of Economic Studies, 88, 2687–2734] (BBC). We show that BBC’s revealed preference test is too lax. There are non-rationalizable data that would pass their test. A basic problem with their test is that it requires finding a certain endogenous elasticity, without regard to the rationalizing utility. Their approach motivates a more stringent test, also based on first-order conditions, that would connect the endogenous elasticity and utility: We show that this test is also too lax. Aside from testing, we also discuss the possibility of recovering model parameters. We show that, even when discount factors are exactly identified, the approach followed in BBC allows for incorrect parameter values to lie in their identified set.

10.1093/restud/rdaf047.abstractZh: 我们重新审视了 Blow 等（2021，《时间不一致偏好的非参数分析》，The Review of Economic Studies，88，2687–2734，以下简称 BBC）近期对老练型准双曲消费者的显示性偏好分析。我们表明，BBC 的显示性偏好检验过于宽松：存在无法理性化的数据却能通过其检验。其检验的一个基本问题在于，它要求找到一个特定的内生弹性，却不考虑使数据理性化的效用。他们的方法引出了一个更严格的检验，该检验同样基于一阶条件，并将内生弹性与效用联系起来：我们表明这一检验也过于宽松。除检验之外，我们还讨论了还原模型参数的可能性。我们表明，即使贴现因子被精确识别，BBC 所采用的方法仍允许不正确的参数值落在其识别集内。

abstract.text: We develop a model of multi-dimensional misspecified learning in which an overconfident agent learns about groups in society from observations of his and others’ successes. We show that the average person sees his group relative to other groups too positively, and this in-group bias exhibits systematic comparative-statics patterns. First, a person is most likely to have negative opinions about other groups he competes with. Second, while information about another group’s achievements does not lower a person’s prejudice, information about economic or social forces affecting the group can, and personal contact with group members has a beneficial effect that is larger than in classical settings. Third, the agent’s beliefs are subject to “bias substitution”, whereby forces that decrease his bias regarding one group tend to increase his biases regarding unrelated other groups.

10.1093/restud/rdaf048.abstractZh: 我们构建了一个多维错误设定学习模型，其中过度自信的经济主体从自身及他人的成功观测中学习社会中的群体。我们表明，平均个体会相对于其他群体过度正面地看待自己所属群体，且这种内群体偏差呈现出系统性的比较静态模式。第一，个体最可能对其与之竞争的群体持负面看法。第二，关于另一群体成就的信息不会降低个体的偏见，但关于影响该群体的经济或社会力量的信息可以降低偏见；与群体成员的亲身接触具有有益效应，且该效应大于经典设定中的情形。第三，经济主体的信念会受到“偏差替代”的影响：降低其对某一群体偏差的力量，往往会增加其对无关其他群体的偏差。

abstract.text: I study repeated games with anonymous random matching where players can add or remove signals from their records. The ability to manipulate records introduces monotonicity constraints on players’ continuation values, under which sufficiently long-lived players will almost never cooperate. When players’ expected lifespans are intermediate, their ability to sustain cooperation depends on (i) whether their actions are complements or substitutes and (ii) whether manipulation takes the form of adding or removing signals.

10.1093/restud/rdaf049.abstractZh: 本文研究参与人能够添加或删除其记录中信号的匿名随机匹配重复博弈。操纵记录的能力会对参与人的延续价值施加单调性约束；在这些约束下，足够长寿的参与人几乎不会合作。当参与人的预期寿命处于中间水平时，其维持合作的能力取决于：(i) 他们的行动是互补还是替代；(ii) 操纵采取添加信号还是删除信号的形式。

abstract.text: When inferring causal effects from correlational data, a common practice by professional researchers but also lay people is to control for potential confounders. Inappropriate controls produce erroneous causal inferences. I model decision-makers (DMs) who use endogenous observational data to learn actions’ causal effect on payoff-relevant outcomes. Different DM types use different controls. Their resulting choices affect the very correlations they learn from, thus calling for an equilibrium analysis of the steady-state welfare cost of bad controls. I obtain tight upper bounds on this cost. Equilibrium forces drastically reduce it when types’ sets of controls contain one another.

10.1093/restud/rdaf050.abstractZh: 在从相关性数据推断因果效应时，专业研究者乃至普通人常用的一种做法是控制潜在混杂因素。不恰当的控制变量会产生错误的因果推断。我构建了一个模型，其中决策者（DMs）利用内生观测数据来学习行动对与收益相关结果的因果效应。不同类型的 DM 使用不同的控制变量。他们由此做出的选择会影响其据以学习的相关性本身，因而需要对坏控制变量的稳态福利成本进行均衡分析。我得到了该成本的紧上界。当各类型的控制变量集合相互包含时，均衡力量会大幅降低这一成本。

abstract.text: We formulate a tractable model of pricing under directed search with heterogeneous firm demands. Demand characteristics drive bids in a position auction and enable us to bridge insights from the ordered search literature to those in the position auction literature. Equilibrium pricing implies that the marginal consumer’s surplus decreases down the search order, so consumers optimally follow the firms’ position ordering. A firm suffers from “business stealing” by firms that precede it and “search appeal” from subsequent firms. We find rankings that achieve the maximal joint profit or consumer surplus by constructing firm-specific scores. A generalized second price auction for positions endogenizes equilibrium orders and bids are driven by position externalities that impact incremental profit from switching positions. The joint profit maximization order is upheld when firm heterogeneity concerns mostly their mark-up potentials. But the consumer welfare order is robust when firms differ mostly over their potential market sizes.

10.1093/restud/rdaf051.abstractZh: 我们构建了一个易处理模型，刻画企业需求异质时定向搜索下的定价。需求特征驱动位置拍卖中的出价，并使我们能够将有序搜索文献中的洞见与位置拍卖文献中的洞见相衔接。均衡定价意味着，边际消费者的剩余沿搜索顺序递减，因此消费者最优地遵循企业的位置排序。一家企业会因排在其前面的企业进行商业窃取而受损，也会因后续企业的搜索吸引力而受损。我们通过构建企业特定得分，找到实现联合利润最大化或消费者剩余最大化的排序。针对位置的广义第二价格拍卖将均衡排序内生化，出价由位置外部性驱动，这些外部性影响转换位置所带来的增量利润。当企业异质性主要涉及其加成潜力时，联合利润最大化排序得以维持。但当企业差异主要在于其潜在市场规模时，消费者福利排序具有稳健性。

abstract.text: Auction models are convenient abstractions of informal price-formation processes that arise in markets for assets or services. These processes involve frictions like bidder recruitment costs for sellers, participation costs for bidders, and limitations on sellers’ commitment abilities. This paper develops an auction model that captures such frictions. We derive novel insights, notably that outcomes are often inefficient, that markets sometimes unravel, and that the observability of competition may have a large effect.

10.1093/restud/rdaf052.abstractZh: 拍卖模型是对资产或服务市场中出现的非正式价格形成过程的一种便捷抽象。这些过程涉及摩擦，例如卖方招募竞标者的成本、竞标者的参与成本，以及卖方承诺能力的限制。本文构建了一个刻画此类摩擦的拍卖模型。我们得出了一些新的洞见，尤其是：结果常常是无效率的，市场有时会瓦解，而竞争的可观测性可能产生很大影响。

abstract.text: We study a bargaining game in which a seller can trade with one of two buyers, who have values h and l (h>l). The outside option principle (OOP) predicts that, as players become patient, the seller trades with the high-value buyer with probability converging to 1 at a price converging to max(h/2,l). While this prediction is supported by the Markov perfect equilibrium (MPE), a wide range of trading outcomes may emerge in subgame perfect equilibria (SPEs): in the patient limit, the seller can obtain any price in the interval [h/2,h] (and no other); moreover, allocative inefficiency and costly delay are possible. We propose equilibrium refinements less restrictive than Markov behavior that guarantee trading outcomes consistent with the OOP. One refinement requires that a buyer’s relative probability of trade does not increase dramatically following a failed negotiation with that buyer. Another refinement posits that the seller does not approach a buyer hoping that negotiations fail. SPEs satisfying both refinements conform with the OOP (but need not be MPEs). Our benchmark model features strategic matching by the seller. We provide a parallel analysis for the random matching protocol. Under random matching, prices in SPEs may also rise above and fall below l, but have a narrower range. A refinement particular to this protocol that restores the OOP requires that a random mismatch should not impact the seller excessively.

10.1093/restud/rdaf053.abstractZh: 我们研究一个讨价还价博弈，其中卖方可以与两个买方之一交易，两个买方的价值分别为 h 和 l（h>l）。外部选项原则（OOP）预测，随着参与者越来越有耐心，卖方与高价值买方交易的概率收敛于 1，交易价格收敛于 max(h/2,l)。尽管马尔可夫完美均衡（MPE）支持这一预测，但子博弈完美均衡（SPEs）中可能出现大范围的交易结果：在耐心极限下，卖方可以获得区间 [h/2,h] 内的任意价格（且不能获得其他价格）；此外，配置无效率和代价高昂的延迟均可能出现。我们提出了一些限制性弱于马尔可夫行为的均衡精炼，这些精炼保证交易结果与 OOP 一致。一种精炼要求，在与某一买方谈判失败后，该买方的相对交易概率不会大幅上升。另一种精炼设定，卖方不会抱着谈判会失败的期望去接触某一买方。同时满足这两种精炼的 SPEs 与 OOP 相符（但不必是 MPEs）。我们的基准模型以卖方的策略性匹配为特征。我们还对随机匹配机制进行了平行分析。在随机匹配下，SPEs 中的价格也可能高于和低于 l，但范围更窄。针对该机制的一种恢复 OOP 的特殊精炼要求，随机错配不应过度影响卖方。

abstract.text: Normal-form two-player games are categorized by players into K analogy classes so as to minimize the prediction error about the behaviour of the opponent. This results in Clustered Analogy-Based Expectation Equilibria in which strategies are analogy-based expectation equilibria given the analogy partitions and analogy partitions minimize the prediction errors given the strategies. We distinguish between environments with self-repelling analogy partitions in which some mixing over partitions is required and environments with self-attractive partitions in which several analogy partitions can arise, thereby suggesting new channels of belief heterogeneity and equilibrium multiplicity. Various economic applications are discussed.

10.1093/restud/rdaf054.abstractZh: 标准式两人博弈被参与人划分为 K 个类比类别，以最小化对对手行为的预测误差。由此得到聚类式基于类比的预期均衡（Clustered Analogy-Based Expectation Equilibria）：给定类比划分，策略是基于类比的预期均衡；给定策略，类比划分最小化预测误差。我们区分具有自我排斥型类比划分的环境——其中需要对划分进行一定混合——与具有自我吸引型类比划分的环境——其中可能出现若干种类比划分，从而提示了信念异质性和均衡多重性的新渠道。文中讨论了多种经济应用。

abstract.text: Unemployment differentials are greater between countries in the euro area than between U.S. states. In both regions, net migration responds to unemployment differentials, though the response is smaller in the euro area compared to the U.S. We use a multi-country DSGE model with cross-border migration to quantify Mundell’s hypothesis that labour mobility could substitute for independent monetary policy in a currency union. While not as effective as independent monetary policy, increased labour mobility reduces business cycle fluctuations for most countries in the euro area. However, Mundell’s conjecture does not hold uniformly. For countries that primarily face demand shocks, labour mobility stabilizes inflation and unemployment and improves welfare. If supply shocks are dominant however, labour mobility increases the cost of being in a currency union by magnifying inflation volatility.

10.1093/restud/rdaf055.abstractZh: 欧元区国家之间的失业率差异大于美国各州之间的失业率差异。在这两个区域，净移民都对失业率差异作出反应，但欧元区的反应小于美国。我们使用一个带有跨境移民的多国 DSGE 模型，量化蒙代尔关于劳动力流动可在货币联盟中替代独立货币政策的假说。尽管不如独立货币政策有效，劳动力流动增加仍会降低欧元区大多数国家的经济周期波动。然而，蒙代尔的猜想并不普遍成立。对于主要面临需求冲击的国家，劳动力流动可稳定通胀和失业并提高福利。然而，如果供给冲击占主导，劳动力流动会通过放大通胀波动而提高留在货币联盟的成本。

abstract.text: We quantify micro and macro effects of changes in the potential benefit duration (PBD) in unemployment insurance. In Poland, the PBD is 12 months for the newly unemployed if the previous year’s county unemployment rate is more than 150% of the national average, and 6 months otherwise. We exploit this cut-off using regression discontinuity estimates on registry data containing the universe of unemployed from 2005 to 2019. For those whose PBD is directly affected by the policy rule, benefit recipients younger than 50, a PBD increase from 6 to 12 months leads to 13% higher unemployment. A decomposition analysis reveals that 12 months after an increase in the PBD, only half of the increase in unemployment is due to the effect on search effort (the micro effect) while the other half is due to increased inflows into unemployment. The total effect on unemployment, which includes equilibrium effects, is entirely explained by the increase in unemployment of workers directly affected by the policy change. We find no evidence of spill-overs on two distinct groups of unemployed whose PBD is unchanged and no effect on measures of labour market tightness.

10.1093/restud/rdaf056.abstractZh: 我们量化失业保险中潜在待遇期限（PBD）变化的微观与宏观效应。在波兰，如果上一年县失业率高于全国平均水平的150%，新失业者的PBD为12个月；否则为6个月。我们利用这一断点，对包含2005年至2019年全部失业者的登记数据进行断点回归估计。对于PBD直接受政策规则影响者，即50岁以下的待遇领取者，PBD从6个月延长至12个月会使失业高出13%。分解分析显示，在PBD延长后的12个月，失业增加中仅有一半源于对搜寻努力的影响（微观效应），另一半源于流入失业的增加。对失业的总效应（包含均衡效应）完全由直接受政策变化影响的劳动者的失业增加所解释。我们没有发现对PBD未变的两类不同失业者存在溢出效应的证据，也没有发现对劳动力市场紧张程度指标的影响。

abstract.text: We study the welfare implications of the rise of common ownership in the U.S. from 1995 to 2021. We build a general equilibrium model with a hedonic demand system in which firms compete in a network game of oligopoly. Firms are connected through two large networks: the first reflects ownership overlap, the second product market rivalry. In our model, common ownership of competing firms induces unilateral incentives to soften competition and the magnitude of the common ownership effect depends on how much the two networks overlap. We estimate our model for the universe of U.S. public corporations using a combination of firm financials, investor holdings, and text-based product similarity data. We perform counterfactual calculations to evaluate how the efficiency and the distributional impact of common ownership have evolved over time. Under the assumption that firms maximise a share-weighted average of their shareholders’ income, we find that the welfare cost of common ownership, measured as the ratio of deadweight loss to total surplus, has increased about ninefold between 1995 and 2021. Under alternative assumptions about corporate governance, the deadweight loss of common ownership ranges between 3.5 and 13.2% of total surplus in 2021. The rise of common ownership has also led to a significant reallocation of surplus from consumers to producers.

10.1093/restud/rdaf057.abstractZh: 我们研究1995年至2021年美国共同持股兴起所带来的福利含义。我们构建一个包含享乐需求系统的一般均衡模型，其中企业在寡头网络博弈中竞争。企业通过两个大型网络相连：第一个反映持股重叠，第二个反映产品市场竞争关系。在我们的模型中，竞争性企业的共同持股会产生弱化竞争的单边激励，而共同持股效应的幅度取决于两个网络的重叠程度。我们结合企业财务数据、投资者持股数据和基于文本的产品相似度数据，对美国全部上市公司估计该模型。我们进行反事实计算，以评估共同持股的效率影响和分配影响如何随时间演变。在企业最大化其股东收入份额加权平均值的假设下，我们发现，以无谓损失与总剩余之比衡量的共同持股福利成本在1995年至2021年间上升了约九倍。在公司治理的不同假设下，2021年共同持股的无谓损失占总剩余的3.5%至13.2%。共同持股的兴起还导致剩余从消费者向生产者显著再分配。

abstract.text: This article provides a unified framework for studying the identification of counterfactual parameters in a general class of discrete outcome models, allowing for endogenous regressors and multidimensional latent variables, all without parametric distributional assumptions. Our main theoretical result is that, when the covariates are discrete, the infinite-dimensional latent variable distribution can be replaced with a finite-dimensional version that is equivalent from an identification perspective. The finite-dimensional latent variable distribution is constructed in practice by enumerating regions of the latent variable space with a new and efficient cell enumeration algorithm for hyperplane arrangements. We then show that bounds on a certain class of counterfactual parameters can be computed by solving a sequence of linear programming problems, and show how the researcher can introduce additional assumptions as constraints in the linear programmes. Finally, we apply the method to a mobile phone choice example with heterogeneous choice sets, and to an airline entry game example.

10.1093/restud/rdaf058.abstractZh: 本文提供了一个统一框架，用于研究一大类离散结果模型中反事实参数的识别问题。该框架允许存在内生回归元和 multidimensional 潜变量，并且完全不依赖参数分布假设。我们的主要理论结果是：当协变量为离散变量时，无限维潜变量分布可以被一个从识别角度看等价的有限维版本所替代。在实践中，有限维潜变量分布通过枚举潜变量空间的区域来构造，所用方法是针对超平面排列的一种新的高效单元枚举算法。随后我们证明，某一类反事实参数的界可以通过求解一系列线性规划问题来计算，并说明研究者如何将额外假设作为约束引入线性规划。最后，我们将该方法应用于一个具有异质选择集的手机选择例子和一个航空公司进入博弈例子。

abstract.text: We analyse earnings responses to six large payroll tax and income tax reforms in France. Our findings indicate full pass-through to workers when there is a strong and transparent link between contributions and expected benefits. In contrast, employer payroll taxes with no tax-benefit linkage exhibit limited pass-through to workers, while income tax nominally borne by employees show nearly full pass-through. Together with a meta-analysis of the literature, we interpret these results as empirical support for the long-standing hypothesis that tax-benefit linkage matters for the incidence of payroll taxes. In the absence of such linkage, our findings suggest that the individual-level incidence of payroll taxes aligns with their statutory incidence.

10.1093/restud/rdaf059.abstractZh: 我们分析法国六项大型工资税和所得税改革中的劳动收入反应。研究发现，当缴费与预期待遇之间存在强有力且透明的联系时，税收会完全转嫁给劳动者。相比之下，缺乏税收—待遇关联的雇主工资税对劳动者的转嫁有限，而名义上由雇员承担的所得税则表现出接近完全的转嫁。结合对相关文献的元分析，我们将这些结果解释为对一项长期假说的实证支持：税收—待遇关联对工资税归宿具有重要影响。在缺乏这种关联时，我们的发现表明，工资税的个体层面归宿与其法定归宿相一致。

abstract.text: I quantitatively analyse the macroeconomic impacts of raising capital requirements in a model in which heterogeneous firms may choose either intermediated or direct finance. Heterogeneous banks compete with other banks and the bond market, fund loans with insured deposits and costly equity (subject to a minimum capital-to-asset ratio), and monitor borrowers. I find that tighter capital requirements reduce costly bank failures while having only small effects on key macroeconomic aggregates, and that raising capital requirements above current levels can be welfare-improving. Three main forces give rise to these results. First, even though banks cut loan supply for a given level of net worth under a tighter capital requirement, in equilibrium banks’ net worth rises to dampen this effect. Second, intense competition from the non-bank sector disciplines banks’ lending responses to tighter regulation. Third, substitution by corporate firms offsets much of the decline in debt financing associated with tighter bank loan supply. As a corollary, almost all of the modest costs associated with tighter capital requirements are concentrated within the bank-dependent non-corporate sector.

10.1093/restud/rdaf061.abstractZh: 我构建了一个模型，其中异质性企业可以选择中介融资或直接融资，并在该模型中定量分析提高资本要求的宏观经济影响。异质性银行与其他银行和债券市场竞争，以受保存款和成本高昂的权益（受最低资本-资产比率约束）为贷款融资，并监督借款人。我发现，更严格的资本要求会减少代价高昂的银行倒闭，同时对关键宏观总量只有很小影响；并且，将资本要求提高到当前水平之上可以改善福利。三个主要力量产生了这些结果。第一，尽管在更严格资本要求下，给定净值水平，银行会削减贷款供给，但均衡中银行净值上升会抑制这一效应。第二，来自非银行部门的激烈竞争约束了银行对更严格监管的贷款反应。第三，公司企业的替代抵消了与银行信贷供给收紧相关的大部分债务融资下降。作为一个推论，与更严格资本要求相关的不大成本几乎全部集中在依赖银行的非公司部门。

abstract.text: How do movements in the distributions of bank size and income affect the macroeconomy? To answer this question, we develop a dynamic general equilibrium model with heterogeneous financial intermediaries, incomplete markets, and aggregate uncertainty. We find that market incompleteness and uninsured idiosyncratic bank rate of return risk generate minimal concentration in the bank net worth distribution, leading to an “as-if” result, whereby the economy behaves as if it had a representative bank. However, introducing ex ante heterogeneity in the banks’ rates of return significantly raises concentration and amplifies real and financial fluctuations relative to the representative-bank case, as this increases a key sufficient statistic, the average marginal propensity to lend. We then extend the model with two empirically validated features of the banking sector—countercyclical return risk and deposit market power—and show that these amplify and dampen aggregate fluctuations, respectively. Finally, because in the model with ex ante heterogeneity the distribution of bank size is highly concentrated, shocks to the largest banks can account for almost all of the aggregate variation that is due to idiosyncratic risk, leading to granular banking and economic cycles. The failure of granular banks (“too big to fail”) produces sizeable macroeconomic crises.

10.1093/restud/rdaf062.abstractZh: 银行规模分布和收入分布的变化如何影响宏观经济？为回答这一问题，我们构建了一个包含异质性金融中介、不完全市场和总量不确定性的动态一般均衡模型。我们发现，市场不完全性以及未保险的银行收益率个体特异性风险，会使银行净值分布的集中度极低，从而产生一个“仿佛”结果：经济表现得仿佛存在一家代表性银行。然而，引入银行收益率的事前异质性会显著提高集中度，并相对于代表性银行情形放大实际与金融波动，因为它提高了一个关键充分统计量——平均边际放贷倾向。随后，我们用银行业两个经经验验证的特征——逆周期收益率风险与存款市场势力——扩展模型，并表明二者分别放大和抑制总量波动。最后，由于在具有事前异质性的模型中银行规模分布高度集中，最大银行的冲击可以解释几乎全部由个体特异性风险引起的总量变异，从而导致颗粒性银行与经济周期。颗粒性银行的倒闭（“太大而不能倒”）会引发相当大的宏观经济危机。

abstract.text: This paper shows that the growing disparities between big and small cities in the U.S. since 1980 can be explained by firms endogenously responding to a skill-biased technology shock. With the introduction of a new skill-biased technology that is high fixed cost but low marginal cost, firms endogenously adopt more in big cities, cities that offer abundant amenities for high-skilled workers, and cities that are more productive in using high-skilled labour. In cities with more adoption, small and unproductive firms are more likely to exit the market, increasing the equilibrium rate of turnover or business dynamism—a selection effect similar to Melitz (2003). Differences in technology adoption and selection account for three key components of the growing regional disparities, known as the Great Divergence: (1) big cities saw a larger increase in the relative wages and supply of skilled workers, (2) big cities saw a smaller decline in business dynamism, and (3) firms in big cities invest more intensively in information and communication technology.

10.1093/restud/rdaf063.abstractZh: 本文表明，1980年以来美国大城市与小城市之间不断扩大的差距，可以由企业内生地对技能偏向型技术冲击作出反应来解释。随着一种固定成本高、边际成本低的新技能偏向型技术被引入，企业会内生地在大城市、为高技能劳动者提供丰富便利设施的城市，以及在使用高技能劳动力方面生产率更高的城市中采用更多该技术。在采用程度更高的城市，规模小且生产率低的企业更可能退出市场，从而提高均衡的企业更替率或商业活力——这是一种类似于 Melitz（2003）的选择效应。技术采用和选择上的差异解释了被称为“大分化”的不断扩大的地区差距的三个关键组成部分：（1）大城市中高技能劳动者的相对工资和供给增长更大；（2）大城市的商业活力下降幅度更小；（3）大城市企业对信息与通信技术（ICT）的投资强度更高。

abstract.text: We develop new robust discrete choice tools to learn about the average willingness to pay for a price subsidy and its effects on demand given exogenous, discrete variation in prices. Our starting point is a non-parametric, non-separable model of choice. We exploit the insight that our welfare parameters in this model can be expressed as functions of demand for the different alternatives. However, while the variation in the data reveals the value of demand at the observed prices, the parameters generally depend on its values beyond these prices. We show how to sharply characterize what we can learn when demand is specified to be entirely non-parametric or to be parametrized in a flexible manner, both of which imply that the parameters are not necessarily point identified. We use our tools to analyse the welfare effects of price subsidies provided by school vouchers in the DC Opportunity Scholarship Program. We find that the provision of the status quo voucher and a wide range of counterfactual vouchers of different amounts can have positive and potentially large benefits net of costs. The positive effect can be explained by the popularity of low-tuition schools in the programme; removing them from the programme can result in a negative net benefit. We also find that various standard logit specifications, in comparison, limit attention to demand functions with low demand for the voucher, which do not capture the large magnitudes of benefits credibly consistent with the data.
