We formulate a dynamic discrete choice model in an unobservedly heterogeneous population of possibly time-inconsistent agents. We provide conditions under which all population type probabilities and preferences for both time-consistent and sophisticated agents are point-identified and sharp set-identification results for naïve and partially sophisticated agents. Estimating the model using data from a health intervention providing insecticide-treated nets (ITNs) in rural Odisha, India, we find that about two-thirds of our sample comprises time-inconsistent agents and that both sophisticated and naïve agents are considerably present-biased. Counterfactuals show that the under-investment in ITNs attributable to present-bias leads to substantial costs that are about four times the price of an ITN.

10.1093/restud/rdag018.abstractZh: 时间不一致性可能在解释跨期行为方面发挥核心作用，尤其是在贫困家庭中。然而，关于时间不一致型经济主体的分布，目前所知甚少，且时间偏好参数在标准动态选择模型中通常无法被识别。我们在一个不可观测异质性、可能存在时间不一致型经济主体的人群中构建了动态离散选择模型。我们给出了使所有人群类型概率以及时间一致型与老练型经济主体的偏好均被点识别所需的条件，并给出了幼稚型与部分老练型经济主体的尖锐集合识别结果。利用印度奥迪沙农村地区一项提供驱虫蚊帐（ITNs）的健康干预数据对该模型进行估计，我们发现样本中约三分之二为时间不一致型经济主体，且老练型与幼稚型经济主体均存在相当大的现时偏误。反事实分析表明，由现时偏误导致的ITNs投资不足所带来的成本约为一顶ITNs价格的4倍。

abstract.text: We present a method to determine optimal monetary policy in heterogeneous-agent economies with nominal frictions and aggregate shocks, under various assumptions regarding fiscal policy. We analyze models with either sticky prices or sticky wages. In the sticky-price economy, when fiscal policy is optimally set, optimal monetary policy implements price stability. Inflation volatility remains low when fiscal policy follows empirically relevant rules. The inflation response is more pronounced when the Phillips curve is steep and profits are skewed toward highly productive agents. In the sticky-wage economy, optimal price inflation becomes significantly more volatile, while wage inflation remains small. Under both types of nominal rigidity, agents with lower productivity tend to benefit more from optimal monetary policy.

10.1093/restud/rdag019.abstractZh: 我们提出一种方法，用于在具有名义摩擦和总量冲击的异质性经济主体经济体中，在不同财政政策假设下确定最优货币政策。我们分析了价格粘性或工资粘性的模型。在价格粘性经济中，当财政政策被最优设定时，最优货币政策可实现价格稳定。当财政政策遵循经验相关的规则时，通胀波动仍然较低。当菲利普斯曲线较陡且利润向高生产率经济主体倾斜时，通胀反应更为显著。在工资粘性经济中，最优价格通胀变得显著更具波动性，而工资通胀仍然较小。在两种名义刚性下，生产率较低的经济主体往往从最优货币政策中获益更多。

abstract.text: While men and women make joint decisions about fertility, women give birth and are more likely to learn about a significant cost of childbearing—maternal health risk. Within couples in Zambia, men have systematically lower awareness of maternal risk factors and higher desire for children than their wives. We develop a model in which information asymmetries between partners over maternal health risk can persist in equilibrium due to strategic incentives and can generate disagreement over fertility that cannot be resolved with transfers. To study the effect of communication barriers on fertility, we design an experiment that varies whether the husband or the wife receives information about maternal health risk. One year after the intervention, men told about such risk exhibit significant gains in knowledge, report lower demand for children, and communicate this information to their wives, who also update their beliefs. Pregnancy falls significantly, while transfers remain unchanged relative to the control group. Meanwhile, when women are told about risk, they update their beliefs, but fail to transmit the information to their husbands, who do not change their demand for children. While pregnancy also falls among these couples, the decline is accompanied by a significant reduction in transfers and support to the wife. When childbearing costs, particularly those borne by one party, cannot be easily communicated within the household, targeting information can help overcome asymmetries and improve household decision-making.

10.1093/restud/rdag020.abstractZh: 尽管男性和女性共同做出生育决策，但女性承担生育过程，也更可能了解到生育的一项重大成本——孕产妇健康风险。在赞比亚的夫妻中，男性对孕产妇风险因素的认知系统性地低于妻子，且生育意愿高于妻子。我们构建了一个模型，其中伴侣之间关于孕产妇健康风险的信息不对称因策略性激励而在均衡中持续存在，并可能产生无法通过转移支付解决的生育分歧。为研究沟通障碍对生育的影响，我们设计了一项实验，随机决定由丈夫还是妻子接收孕产妇健康风险信息。干预一年后，被告知该风险的男性知识显著提升，报告更低的子女需求，并将该信息传递给妻子，妻子也随之更新信念。与对照组相比，怀孕率显著下降，而转移支付保持不变。与此同时，当女性被告知风险时，她们更新了信念，但未能将信息传递给丈夫，丈夫的子女需求未发生变化。尽管这些夫妻的怀孕率同样下降，但下降伴随着对妻子的转移支付和支持的显著减少。当生育成本——尤其是由一方承担的成本——难以在家庭内部沟通时，针对特定对象提供信息有助于克服不对称并改善家庭决策。

abstract.text: How do regional productivity shocks or transportation infrastructure improvements affect aggregate welfare? In a general class of spatial equilibrium models, we provide a formula for aggregate welfare changes, decomposed into terms associated with (i) technology [Fogel (1964), Railroads and American Economic Growth (Baltimore: Johns Hopkins Press), Hulten (1978) “Growth Accounting with Intermediate Inputs”, The Review of Economic Studies, 45, 511–518], (ii) spatial dispersion of marginal utility, (iii) fiscal externalities, (iv) technological externalities, and (v) redistribution. We further use this decomposition to derive a general formula for optimal spatial transfers and show that, whenever optimal transfers are in place, the technology term alone captures the aggregate welfare effects of technological shocks. We apply our framework to study welfare gains from improving the US highway network. We find that changes in the spatial dispersion of marginal utility are as important as technological externalities in accounting for the deviations from the Fogel-Hulten benchmark to assess welfare gains.

10.1093/restud/rdag021.abstractZh: 区域生产率冲击或交通基础设施改善如何影响总量福利？在一类一般的空间均衡模型中，我们给出了总量福利变化的公式，并将其分解为与以下因素相关的各项：(i) 技术 [Fogel (1964), Railroads and American Economic Growth (Baltimore: Johns Hopkins Press), Hulten (1978) “Growth Accounting with Intermediate Inputs”, The Review of Economic Studies, 45, 511–518]，(ii) 边际效用的空间分散，(iii) 财政外部性，(iv) 技术外部性，以及 (v) 再分配。我们进一步利用这一分解推导出最优空间转移支付的一般公式，并表明，只要最优转移支付到位，仅技术项即可捕捉技术冲击的总量福利效应。我们将该框架应用于研究改善美国公路网络所带来的福利收益。我们发现，在评估福利收益时，边际效用的空间分散变化与技术外部性同样重要，二者共同解释了相对于 Fogel-Hulten 基准的偏离。

abstract.text: We prove a central limit theorem for network formation models with strategic interactions and homophilous agents. Since data often consists of observations on a single large network, we consider an asymptotic framework in which the network size diverges. We argue that a modification of “stabilization” conditions from the literature on geometric graphs provides a useful high-level formulation of weak dependence which we utilize to establish an abstract central limit theorem. Using results in branching process theory, we derive interpretable primitive conditions for stabilization. The main conditions restrict the strength of strategic interactions and equilibrium selection mechanism. We discuss practical inference procedures justified by our results.

10.1093/restud/rdag022.abstractZh: 我们为具有策略互动和同质性经济主体的网络形成模型证明了一个中心极限定理。由于数据通常由对单个大网络的观测构成，我们考虑网络规模趋于无穷大的渐近框架。我们认为，对几何图文献中的“稳定化”条件加以修改，可为弱相依性提供一种有用的一般性表述，我们利用这一表述建立了一个抽象的中心极限定理。借助分支过程理论中的结果，我们推导出稳定化的可解释基本条件。主要条件限制了策略互动的强度与均衡选择机制。我们讨论了由本文结果所支持的实际推断程序。

abstract.text: Existing tests of reference-dependent preferences assume universal loss aversion. This paper examines the implications of heterogeneity in gain-loss attitudes for such tests. In experiments on labour supply and exchange behaviour, we first measure gain-loss attitudes and then study a canonical treatment effect that distinguishes different models of reference dependence. We document substantial heterogeneity in gain-loss attitudes and evidence against universal loss aversion. Moreover, we find heterogeneous treatment effects over gain-loss attitudes consistent with formulations of expectations-based reference points. Assuming homogeneous preferences would lead to different and potentially incorrect conclusions in these tests. Our findings provide foundational support for reference points derived from expectations and help reconcile inconsistencies in prior empirical exercises.

10.1093/restud/rdag023.abstractZh: 现有参照依赖偏好检验假定普遍存在损失厌恶。本文考察收益—损失态度异质性对此类检验的含义。在关于劳动力供给和交换行为的实验中，我们首先测度收益—损失态度，然后研究一个能够区分不同参照依赖模型的经典处理效应。我们记录了收益—损失态度的显著异质性，并发现反对普遍损失厌恶的证据。此外，我们发现，收益—损失态度上的异质性处理效应与基于预期的参照点表述相一致。假定偏好同质会导致这些检验得出不同且可能错误的结论。我们的发现为源自预期的参照点提供了基础性支持，并有助于调和先前实证研究中的不一致之处。

abstract.text: What are the effects of supply-side climate policies in the oil market? We use global company-level data to estimate the impact of 84 reforms of production taxes between 2000 and 2019 on oil production, exploration, and discoveries. We find that higher taxes primarily reduce companies’ exploration expenditures and oil discoveries, and also reduce short-term production of unconventional oil. We then quantify the implications for the oil market using a short- and medium-term dynamic model extending until the end of the century. Imposing a global climate royalty surcharge of 20 percentage points on oil producers reduces average annual emissions from oil by 5–7% in the first 5 years, and 9–20% in the medium term. If only OECD countries adopt this policy, 47–73% of the total emission reductions would be offset by increased production in non-OECD countries in the medium term.

10.1093/restud/rdag024.abstractZh: 石油市场中供给侧气候政策的效果如何？我们使用全球企业层面数据，估计2000年至2019年间84次生产税改革对石油生产、勘探和发现的影响。我们发现，提高税收主要减少企业的勘探支出和石油发现，同时也会减少非常规石油的短期产量。随后，我们使用一个延伸至本世纪末的短期和中期动态模型，量化其对石油市场的影响。对石油生产商在全球范围内征收20个百分点的气候特许权附加费，会使石油年均排放量在最初5年减少5%–7%，在中期减少9%–20%。如果只有OECD国家采用这一政策，中期内非OECD国家产量的增加将抵消总减排量的47%–73%。

abstract.text: We propose a simple and general model of experimentation in which reaching untried levels of a stock variable may, after a stochastic delay, lead to a catastrophe. Hence, at any point in time a catastrophe might well be under way, due to past experiments. We show how to measure this legacy of the past from prior beliefs and the chronicle of stock levels. We characterize the optimal policy as a function of the legacy and show that it leads to a new protocol for planning that applies to a general class of problems, encompassing the study of pandemics or climate change. Several original policy predictions follow, e.g. experimentation can stop but resume later.

10.1093/restud/rdag025.abstractZh: 我们提出一个简单且一般的试验模型：在该模型中，达到某一存量变量此前未曾尝试过的水平，可能在经历随机延迟后导致灾难。因此，在任何时点上，由于过去的试验，灾难很可能已经在进行之中。我们说明如何根据先验信念和存量水平的历史记录来度量这种过去的遗留影响。我们将最优政策刻画为这种遗留影响的函数，并表明它引出一个适用于一般类问题的新的规划协议，涵盖对流行病或气候变化的研究。由此得到若干具有原创性的政策预测，例如试验可以停止但随后恢复。

abstract.text: Multiple hypothesis testing (MHT) practices vary widely, without consensus on which are appropriate when. This article provides an economic foundation for these practices designed to capture leading examples, such as regulatory approval on the basis of clinical trials. MHT adjustments are appropriate in our framework to the extent that research costs are invariant to the number of hypotheses. Control of average size, as for example via a Bonferroni correction, emerges in the limit case where all costs are fixed; in the opposite limit, where costs vary in proportion to the hypothesis count, no correction is needed. We illustrate implications by calculating explicit critical values using data on actual costs in the drug approval process and in program evaluation research; these suggest that some MHT adjustment is warranted in these applications, but not as much as implied by standard practice.

10.1093/restud/rdag026.abstractZh: 多重假设检验（MHT）的做法差异很大，对于何种情形下适用何种做法尚无共识。本文为这些做法提供了一个经济学基础，旨在涵盖诸如基于临床试验的监管审批等主要例子。在我们的框架中，当研究成本不随假设数量变化时，MHT 调整是适当的。平均规模的控制，例如通过 Bonferroni 校正实现，出现在所有成本均固定的极限情形中；在相反的极限情形中，即成本与假设数量成比例变化时，则不需要任何校正。我们利用药品审批过程和项目评估研究中实际成本的数据计算显式临界值，以此说明其含义；这些结果表明，在这些应用中，某种程度的 MHT 调整是有必要的，但程度不及标准做法所隐含的水平。

abstract.text: This paper develops a new framework for understanding when and how migrants shape culture, applying it to the Confederate diaspora—a small migrant group that left a large cultural imprint. Southern Whites that migrated after the Civil War played a pivotal role in spreading Confederate symbols and racial norms across the U.S. by the early 20th century. Their far-reaching influence stemmed from two key conditions: (i) an ideological intensity rooted in their experiences of slavery, secession, and military defeat and (ii) access to malleable power structures during westward expansion and post-war reconciliation. These conditions enabled them to transmit Confederate culture to both kin and non-Southern neighbours and to expand their reach by mobilising civil society organisation and leveraging positions of authority. They shaped policies and institutions that helped entrench racial norms and inequalities in labour markets, housing, and the criminal justice system. Our findings provide empirical foundations for understanding how migrants can transform local culture, rather than merely assimilate.

10.1093/restud/rdag027.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个新的框架，用于理解移民何时以及如何塑造文化，并将其应用于邦联侨民——一个留下了巨大文化印记的小规模移民群体。内战后迁移的南方白人在截至20世纪初将邦联象征和种族规范传播至美国各地方面发挥了关键作用。其深远影响源于两个关键条件：（i）根植于其奴隶制、分离和军事失败经历的思想强度，以及（ii）在向西扩张和战后和解期间获得可塑的权力结构。这些条件使他们能够将邦联文化传递给亲属和非南方邻居，并通过动员公民社会组织、利用权威职位来扩大其影响范围。他们塑造了政策和制度，这些政策和制度有助于在劳动力市场、住房和刑事司法系统中固化种族规范和不平等。我们的发现为理解移民如何能够改造本地文化、而非仅仅被同化提供了实证基础。

abstract.text: Economists are often interested in the mechanisms by which a treatment affects an outcome. We develop tests for the “sharp null of full mediation” that a treatment D affects an outcome Y only through a particular mechanism (or set of mechanisms) M. Our approach exploits connections between mediation analysis and the econometric literature on testing instrument validity. We also provide tools for quantifying the magnitude of alternative mechanisms when the sharp null is rejected: we derive sharp lower bounds on the fraction of individuals whose outcome is affected by the treatment despite having the same value of M under both treatments (“always-takers”), as well as sharp bounds on the average effect of the treatment for such always-takers. An advantage of our approach relative to existing tools for mediation analysis is that it does not require stringent assumptions about how M is assigned. We illustrate our methodology in two empirical applications.

10.1093/restud/rdag028.abstractZh: 经济学家常常关注干预通过何种机制影响结果。我们构建了“完全中介的尖锐原假设”检验，即干预 D 仅通过某一特定机制（或一组机制）M 影响结果 Y。我们的方法利用了中介分析与检验工具变量有效性的计量经济学文献之间的联系。当尖锐原假设被拒绝时，我们还提供了量化替代机制大小的工具：我们推导出在两种干预下 M 取值相同但结果仍受干预影响的个体（“始终接受者”）所占比例的尖锐下界，以及此类始终接受者的平均干预效应的尖锐界。相对于现有的中介分析工具，我们方法的一个优势在于，它不要求对 M 的分配方式作出严格假设。我们用两个实证应用说明了我们的方法。

abstract.text: Linear instrumental variable estimators, such as two-stage least squares (TSLS), are commonly interpreted as estimating non-negatively weighted averages of causal effects, referred to as local average treatment effects (LATEs). We examine whether the LATE interpretation actually applies to the types of TSLS specifications that are used in practice. We show that if the specification includes covariates—which most empirical work does—then the LATE interpretation does not apply in general. Instead, the TSLS estimator will, in general, reflect treatment effects for both compliers and always/never-takers, and some treatment effects for the always/never-takers will necessarily be negatively weighted. We show that the only specifications that have a LATE interpretation are “saturated” specifications that control for covariates nonparametrically, implying that such specifications are both sufficient and necessary for TSLS to have a LATE interpretation, at least without additional parametric assumptions. This result is concerning because, as we document, empirical researchers almost never control for covariates nonparametrically, and rarely discuss or justify parametric specifications of covariates. We apply our results to thirteen empirical studies and find strong evidence that the LATE interpretation of TSLS is far from accurate for the types of specifications actually used in practice. We offer concrete recommendations for practice motivated by our theoretical and empirical results.

10.1093/restud/rdag029.abstractZh: 线性工具变量估计量，如两阶段最小二乘法（TSLS），通常被解释为估计因果效应的非负加权平均值，即所谓的局部平均处理效应（LATE）。我们考察LATE解释是否真正适用于实践中使用的各类TSLS设定。我们表明，如果设定中包含协变量——大多数实证研究确实如此——那么LATE解释一般并不适用。相反，TSLS估计量一般会同时反映依从者和始终接受者/从不接受者的处理效应，且始终接受者/从不接受者的某些处理效应必然被赋予负权重。我们表明，唯一具有LATE解释的设定是“饱和”设定，即非参数地控制协变量，这意味着此类设定是TSLS具有LATE解释的充分且必要条件，至少在没有额外参数假设的情况下如此。这一结果令人担忧，因为正如我们所记录的，实证研究者几乎从不非参数地控制协变量，也很少讨论或论证协变量的参数设定。我们将结果应用于十三项实证研究，发现强有力的证据表明，对于实践中实际使用的各类设定，TSLS的LATE解释远不准确。基于我们的理论和实证结果，我们提出了具体的实践建议。

abstract.text: This paper combines new data and a narrative approach to identify variation in political pressure on the Federal Reserve. From archival records, I build a data set of personal interactions between U.S. Presidents and Fed officials between 1933 and 2016. Since personal interactions do not necessarily reflect political pressure, I develop a narrative identification strategy based on President Nixon’s pressure on Fed Chair Burns. I exploit this narrative through restrictions on a structural vector autoregression that includes the President-Fed interaction data. I find that political pressure to ease monetary policy (i) increases the price level strongly and persistently, (ii) does not lead to positive effects on real economic activity, (iii) contributed to inflationary episodes outside of the Nixon era, and (iv) transmits differently from a typical monetary policy easing, by having a stronger effect on inflation expectations. Quantitatively, increasing political pressure by half as much as Nixon, for six months, raises the price level by about 7% over the following decade.

10.1093/restud/rdag030.abstractZh: 本文结合新数据与叙事方法，识别美联储所面临政治压力的变动。基于档案记录，我构建了1933年至2016年间美国总统与美联储官员私人互动的数据集。由于私人互动未必反映政治压力，我基于尼克松总统对美联储主席伯恩斯的施压，提出了一种叙事识别策略。我将该叙事通过一个包含总统—美联储互动数据的结构向量自回归中的约束加以利用。我发现，要求放松货币政策的政治压力（i）会强烈且持续地推高价格水平，（ii）不会对实际经济活动产生正向效应，（iii）促成了尼克松时代之外的通货膨胀事件，（iv）其传导方式不同于典型的货币政策宽松，对通胀预期的影响更强。在数量上，将政治压力提升至尼克松施压程度的一半并持续六个月，会使价格水平在随后十年中上升约7%。

abstract.text: We study the effect of risk on how firms organize their supply chains. We use transaction-level data on U.S. manufacturing imports to construct a novel measure of input sourcing risk based on the historical volatility of ocean shipping times. Our measure isolates the unexpected component of shipping times that is induced by weather conditions along more than 331,000 maritime routes. We first document that unexpected shipping delays significantly reduce importers’ sales, profits, and employment. We then show that firms actively diversify weather risk by using more routes and foreign suppliers, although their import values decline. To rationalize these findings, we introduce shipping time risk into a general equilibrium model of importing with firm heterogeneity. Our quantitative analysis predicts substantial costs for the U.S. economy associated with supply chain risk.

10.1093/restud/rdag031.abstractZh: 我们研究风险如何影响企业组织其供应链。我们使用美国制造业进口的交易层面数据，基于海运时间的历史波动率构建了一种新的投入品采购风险度量。该度量分离出由超过 331,000 条海上航线沿途天气条件所引致的航运时间中未预期到的成分。我们首先记录到，未预期的航运延迟显著降低了进口商的销售额、利润和就业。随后我们表明，企业通过使用更多航线和外国供应商来主动分散天气风险，尽管其进口值下降。为解释这些发现，我们将航运时间风险引入一个包含企业异质性的进口一般均衡模型。我们的定量分析预测，供应链风险给美国经济带来了可观的成本。

abstract.text: We show that the financial sector’s asset supply elasticities are sufficient statistics summarizing its macroeconomic effects for a large class of financial frictions. These elasticities are crucial for a wide range of policy questions, ranging from the size of fiscal multipliers to the relative effectiveness of asset purchases targeting the financial sector versus tax cuts targeting households. Workhorse macroeconomic models imply different values of these elasticities, generating output responses to policies that differ by orders of magnitude. We construct empirical measures of these elasticities and evaluate their policy implications in a quantitative model with household heterogeneity and illiquidity.

10.1093/restud/rdag032.abstractZh: 我们证明，对于一大类金融摩擦而言，金融部门资产供给弹性是足以概括其宏观经济效应的充分统计量。这些弹性对于一系列广泛的政策问题至关重要，从财政乘数的大小，到针对金融部门的资产购买与针对家庭的减税二者相对有效性的比较。主流宏观经济模型隐含的这些弹性取值不同，导致政策引起的产出反应相差数个数量级。我们构建了这些弹性的经验度量，并在一个包含家庭异质性与非流动性的定量模型中评估其政策含义。

abstract.text: When employers face a trade-off between being large and paying low wages—and in this sense have monopsony power—some productive employers decide against building large business networks, forgo sales, and remain small. These decisions have adverse consequences for aggregate labour productivity. Using high-quality administrative data from Germany, we document that East German plants (compared to West German ones) face steeper size-wage curves, invest less in their business networks, remain smaller, and are less productive. A model with labour market monopsony, product market power, and business network investments matching these features of the data predicts a 10% lower aggregate labour productivity in East Germany.

10.1093/restud/rdag033.abstractZh: 当雇主面临规模与低工资之间的权衡——并在此意义上拥有买方垄断力量——时，一些高生产率雇主会选择不建立大型商业网络、放弃销售机会并保持较小规模。这些决策对总量劳动生产率产生不利后果。利用德国高质量行政数据，我们发现，与西德工厂相比，东德工厂面临更陡峭的规模—工资曲线，对商业网络的投资更少，规模更小，生产率更低。一个包含劳动力市场买方垄断、产品市场势力和商业网络投资且与这些数据特征相匹配的模型预测，东德的总量劳动生产率低 10%。

abstract.text: This article develops the uniform asymptotic theory for local projection (LP) regression when the true lag order of the model is unknown and potentially infinite. The theory allows for varying degrees of persistence in the data, growing response horizons, and general conditionally heteroskedastic martingale-difference shocks. Based on the theory, we make two main contributions. First, we show that LPs can achieve semiparametric efficiency at a given horizon under classical assumptions on the data, provided that the controlled lag order diverges. Thus, the commonly perceived efficiency loss of LPs can become asymptotically negligible with many controls. Second, we propose LP-based inference procedures for (level and cumulated) impulse responses that possess robustness properties not shared by existing methods. Inference methods using two distinct standard errors are considered. The uniform validity for the first method depends on a zero fourth-order cumulant condition on shocks, while that of the second holds more generally for conditionally heteroskedastic martingale-difference shocks. We propose a bootstrap procedure that improves finite-sample performance and extend the standard error construction to structural responses.

10.1093/restud/rdag034.abstractZh: 本文在模型真实滞后阶数未知且可能为无穷的情形下，为局部投影（LP）回归建立了统一渐近理论。该理论允许数据具有不同程度的持续性、响应期限不断延长，以及一般的条件异方差鞅差冲击。基于该理论，我们作出两项主要贡献。第一，我们证明：在关于数据的经典假设下，只要所控制的滞后阶数发散，LP 在给定期限上即可达到半参数有效。因此，通常所认为的 LP 效率损失在控制变量很多时可渐近忽略。第二，我们提出基于 LP 的（水平与累积）脉冲响应推断程序，其稳健性是现有方法所不具备的。我们考察了使用两种不同标准误的推断方法。第一种方法的一致有效性依赖于冲击的四阶累积量为零这一条件，而第二种方法的一致有效性对条件异方差鞅差冲击更为一般地成立。我们提出一种自助法程序以改善有限样本表现，并将标准误的构造推广至结构响应。

abstract.text: Manager pay has increased considerably since 1980, and so has inequality in manager pay. Over the same period, there has been a sharp rise in market power. We start from the premise that the role of managers is to increase firm productivity. When markets are imperfectly competitive, productivity not only helps firm grow in size, productivity also affects market power. We model how imperfect competition in product markets affects manager pay, and break down the contributions of firm size and market power to compensation. We find that market power, on average, accounts for 45.2% of total manager pay. Notably, there is substantial variation across managers. Top managers are disproportionately employed by firms with market power, and they benefit from it: in 2019, 80.3% of top manager pay is attributable to market power. Our main conclusion is that rise of market power explains half of the increase in average manager pay, and nearly all of the increase in manager pay inequality.

10.1093/restud/rdag035.abstractZh: 自1980年以来，管理者薪酬大幅上升，管理者薪酬不平等也显著加剧。同一时期，市场势力急剧上升。我们从管理者作用是提高企业生产率这一前提出发。当市场为不完全竞争时，生产率不仅有助于企业规模扩张，生产率还影响市场势力。我们构建模型刻画产品市场不完全竞争如何影响管理者薪酬，并分解企业规模和市场势力对薪酬的贡献。我们发现，市场势力平均占管理者总薪酬的45.2%。值得注意的是，不同管理者之间存在很大差异。高层管理者不成比例地受雇于拥有市场势力的企业，并从中受益：2019年，高层管理者薪酬的80.3%可归因于市场势力。我们的主要结论是，市场势力上升解释了管理者平均薪酬增幅的一半，以及管理者薪酬不平等增幅的几乎全部。

abstract.text: I study linear panel data models with predetermined regressors (such as lagged dependent variables) where coefficients are individual-specific, allowing for heterogeneity in the effects of the regressors on the dependent variable. I show that the model is not point-identified in a short panel context but rather partially identified, and I characterize the identified sets for the mean, variance, and CDF of the coefficient distribution. This characterization is general, accommodating discrete, continuous, and unbounded data, and it leads to computationally tractable estimation and inference procedures. I apply the method to study lifecycle earnings dynamics among U.S. households using the Panel Study of Income Dynamics (PSID) dataset. The results suggest the presence of unobserved heterogeneity in earnings persistence, implying that households face varying levels of earnings risk which, in turn, contribute to heterogeneity in their consumption and savings behaviours.

10.1093/restud/rdag036.abstractZh: 我研究带有预定回归变量（如滞后因变量）的线性面板数据模型，其中系数为个体特定，从而允许回归变量对因变量的影响存在异质性。我证明，在短面板情形下该模型并非点识别，而是部分识别；我刻画了系数分布的均值、方差和CDF的识别集。这一刻画具有一般性，可容纳离散、连续和无界数据，并导向计算上易处理的估计与推断程序。我将该方法应用于利用收入动态面板研究（PSID）数据集研究美国家庭的生命周期收入动态。结果表明，收入持续性中存在未观测到的异质性，这意味着家庭面临不同程度的收入风险，进而导致其消费和储蓄行为存在异质性。

abstract.text: I study racial disparities in the criminal justice system by analysing abnormal bunching in the distribution of crack-cocaine amounts used in federal sentencing. I compare cases sentenced before and after the Fair Sentencing Act, a 2010 law that changed the 10-year mandatory minimum threshold for crack-cocaine from 50 g to 280 g. First, I find that after 2010, there is a sharp increase in the fraction of cases sentenced at 280 g (the point that now triggers a 10-year mandatory minimum), and that this increase is disproportionately large for black and Hispanic offenders. I then explore several possible explanations for the observed racial disparities, including racial discrimination that occurs after entry into the criminal justice system. I analyse data from multiple stages in the criminal justice system and find that the increased bunching for minority offenders is driven by prosecutorial discretion, specifically as used by about 20–30% of prosecutors. Moreover, the fraction of cases at 280 g falls in 2013 when evidentiary standards become stricter. Finally, the racial disparity in the increase cannot be explained by differences in education, sex, age, criminal history, seized drug amount, or other elements of the crime, but it can be largely explained by a measure of state-level racial animus. These results shed light on the role of prosecutorial discretion and racial discrimination as causes of racial disparities in sentencing.

10.1093/restud/rdag037.abstractZh: 我通过分析联邦量刑中可卡因碱（crack-cocaine）数量分布上的异常聚束现象，研究刑事司法系统中的种族差异。我比较了《公平量刑法》（Fair Sentencing Act）实施前后判决的案件，该2010年法律将可卡因碱的10年强制最低刑门槛从50克改为280克。首先，我发现2010年之后，判处280克（即现在触发10年强制最低刑的数量点）的案件比例急剧上升，且这一上升在黑人和西班牙裔罪犯中不成比例地更大。随后我探讨了观察到的种族差异的几种可能解释，包括进入刑事司法系统之后发生的种族歧视。我分析了刑事司法系统多个阶段的数据，发现少数族裔罪犯聚束现象的增加是由检察官自由裁量权驱动的，具体而言是由约20%–30%的检察官所行使的自由裁量权驱动的。此外，2013年证据标准变得更严格时，280克案件的比例下降。最后，这一上升中的种族差异无法由教育、性别、年龄、犯罪史、缴获毒品数量或犯罪的其他要素的差异来解释，但可以在很大程度上由州层面种族敌意（racial animus）的度量来解释。这些结果揭示了检察官自由裁量权和种族歧视作为量刑中种族差异成因的作用。

abstract.text: The seminal paper by Baron and Ferejohn (1989, “Bargaining in Legislatures”, American Political Science Review, 83, 1181–1206) leaves significant gaps in our understanding of open rule bargaining. We aim to fill these gaps by providing a fresh analysis of open rule bargaining. Our approach relies on an appealing class of stationary equilibria. In this class, we show that delays tend to be longer and allocations tend to be less egalitarian than originally predicted by Baron and Ferejohn. Our results shed new light on the efficiency and fairness implications of using an open vs. closed rule in legislatures and of bargaining processes in general.

10.1093/restud/rdag038.abstractZh: Baron 和 Ferejohn（1989，《立法机构中的讨价还价》，《美国政治学评论》，83，1181–1206）这篇开创性论文在开放规则讨价还价的理解上留下了显著空白。我们旨在通过对开放规则讨价还价的全新分析来填补这些空白。我们的方法依赖于一类具有吸引力的平稳均衡。在这一类均衡中，我们表明延迟往往比 Baron 和 Ferejohn 最初的预测更长，分配往往比其预测更不平等。我们的结果为立法机构中使用开放规则与封闭规则的效率与公平含义，以及一般意义上的讨价还价过程，提供了新的启示。

abstract.text: Discrete choice data allow researchers to recover differences in utilities, but these differences may not suffice to identify policy-relevant counterfactuals of interest. In fact, in the case of dynamic discrete choice models, only a narrow set of counterfactuals are point-identified. In this paper, we explore how much one can learn about counterfactual outcomes of interest within this framework. We focus on the partial identification of counterfactuals, while allowing for (mild) model restrictions that can gradually shrink the identified set. We derive bounds for low-dimensional objects (such as average welfare) as arguments of optimization programmes, along with a uniformly valid inference procedure. Furthermore, we develop new and tractable computational tools and algorithms suitable for dealing with high-dimensional problems like this. Finally, we illustrate in Monte Carlos, as well as an empirical exercise of firms’ export decisions, the informativeness of the identified sets, and we assess the impact of (common) model restrictions on results.

10.1093/restud/rdag039.abstractZh: 离散选择数据使研究者能够识别效用差异，但这些差异可能不足以识别政策相关的反事实。事实上，在动态离散选择模型中，只有一小类反事实是可点识别的。本文探讨在这一框架内能够对感兴趣的反事实结果了解到何种程度。我们聚焦于反事实的部分识别，同时允许（温和的）模型限制逐步收缩识别集。我们将低维对象（如平均福利）的边界推导为优化问题的参数，并给出统一有效的推断程序。此外，我们开发了适合处理此类高维问题的新的易处理计算工具和算法。最后，我们通过蒙特卡洛模拟以及企业出口决策的经验练习，说明识别集的信息含量，并评估（常见）模型限制对结果的影响。

abstract.text: An agent samples projects over time, observing quality for each, while a principal can select at most one. The principal values quality, whereas the agent only wants a project chosen. Transfers are unavailable, but the principal can verify quality by paying a cost. We fully characterize the dynamics of verification by determining optimal mechanisms for this problem. With a low verification cost and a long horizon, the optimal mechanism involves a deterministic selection rule that initially discriminates on quality but chooses a project irrespective of its quality at a deadline. Verification occurs with an intermediate probability before the deadline, declining over time. We show how these conclusions change if the verification cost is high or the horizon is short, and under certain forms of imperfect commitment. Our analysis provides guidelines on how dynamics interact with the benefits of verification.

10.1093/restud/rdag040.abstractZh: 一个经济主体随时间推移对项目进行抽样，并观测每个项目的质量，而委托人至多只能选择一个项目。委托人看重质量，而经济主体只希望有项目被选中。转移支付不可用，但委托人可以通过支付成本来核实质量。我们通过确定该问题的最优机制，完整刻画了核实的动态过程。在核实成本较低且期限较长时，最优机制包含一个确定性选择规则：该规则最初依据质量进行甄别，但在截止期限时不论质量如何都会选择一个项目。核实以中间概率在截止期限之前发生，并随时间推移而下降。我们展示了当核实成本较高或期限较短时，以及在若干形式的不完全承诺下，这些结论会如何变化。我们的分析为动态过程如何与核实的收益相互作用提供了指引。

abstract.text: We document dramatic changes in euro area interbank money markets during the financial and sovereign debt crises: unsecured borrowing declined across the euro area, while secured market haircuts on sovereign bonds increased, and bank borrowing from the European Central Bank rose in southern countries. We construct a quantitative general equilibrium model to assess the macroeconomic impact of these developments and the associated policy response. Our model features heterogeneous banks and sovereign bonds, secured and unsecured money markets, and a central bank. We compare a benchmark policy—the central bank providing collateralized lending to banks at haircuts lower than the market—with an alternative policy that maintains a constant central bank balance sheet. We show that the fall in output, investment, and capital would have been twice as high under the alternative policy.

10.1093/restud/rdag041.abstractZh: 我们记录了金融危机和主权债务危机期间欧元区银行间货币市场的剧烈变化：整个欧元区的无担保借款下降，而主权债券的有担保市场折扣率上升，南欧国家从欧洲中央银行的借款增加。我们构建一个定量一般均衡模型，以评估这些变化及相关政策应对的宏观经济影响。我们的模型包含异质性银行和主权债券、有担保和无担保货币市场以及中央银行。我们将一项基准政策——中央银行以低于市场的折扣率向银行提供有担保贷款——与另一项维持中央银行资产负债表不变的政策进行比较。我们表明，在替代政策下，产出、投资和资本的下降幅度本会高出一倍。

abstract.text: What are the channels through which monetary policy affects financial stability? Can (and should) central banks prevent financial crises by deviating from price stability? To what extent may monetary policy itself unintentionally breed financial vulnerabilities? We answer these questions using a New Keynesian model with capital accumulation and endogenous financial crises due to adverse selection and moral hazard in credit markets. Our findings are threefold. First, monetary policy affects the probability of a crisis both in the short run (via aggregate demand) and in the medium run (via capital accumulation). Second, the central bank can reduce the incidence of crises in the medium run by tolerating higher inflation volatility in the short run. Third, prolonged periods of loose monetary policy followed by a sharp tightening can lead to financial crises.

10.1093/restud/rdag042.abstractZh: 货币政策通过哪些渠道影响金融稳定？中央银行能否（以及是否应当）通过偏离价格稳定来防止金融危机？货币政策本身在多大程度上可能无意中滋生金融脆弱性？我们使用一个包含资本积累以及由信贷市场逆向选择和道德风险导致的内生金融危机的新凯恩斯主义模型来回答这些问题。我们的发现有三点。第一，货币政策既在短期（通过总需求）也在中期（通过资本积累）影响危机发生的概率。第二，中央银行可以通过在短期内容忍更高的通胀波动，在中期内降低危机的发生率。第三，长时间的货币宽松之后紧接着急剧的货币紧缩，可能导致金融危机。

abstract.text: Despite the increasing importance of multiple priors in various domains of economics, choice-based incentive-compatible multiple-prior elicitation remains an open problem. This paper develops a solution, comprising a preference-based identification of a subject’s probability interval for an event, and a method for eliciting it. The method applies under weak decision-theoretic assumptions, with no need for probabilistic sophistication. To demonstrate its feasibility, we implement it in three incentivized experiments on artificial and natural sources of uncertainty. Intervals elicited by our method are sensitive to the direction and amount of information and are typically consistent with “objective” probabilities where available. We find a predominance of non-degenerate probability intervals, with intervals being wider when there is less information or predictability. The probability intervals elicited with our method are similar to those stated by subjects on aggregate, suggesting that the method can provide behavioural foundations for the use of stated probability-interval techniques in the field.

10.1093/restud/rdag043.abstractZh: 尽管多重先验在经济学各领域中的重要性日益上升，基于选择的激励相容多重先验引出仍是一个未解决的问题。本文提出一种解决方案，包括基于偏好识别受试者对某一事件概率区间的方法，以及引出该区间的方法。该方法适用于较弱的决策理论假设，无需概率精细化能力。为证明其可行性，我们在三项针对人为和自然不确定性来源的激励实验中实施了该方法。我们的方法所引出的区间对信息的方向和数量敏感，并且在存在“客观”概率时通常与之保持一致。我们发现非退化概率区间占主导，当信息或可预测性较少时区间更宽。我们的方法所引出的概率区间在总体上与受试者所陈述的区间相似，这表明该方法可为在实地研究中使用陈述概率区间技术提供行为基础。

abstract.text: Do periods of persistently loose monetary policy increase financial fragility and the likelihood of a financial crisis? This is a central question for policymakers, yet the literature does not provide systematic empirical evidence about this link at the aggregate level. In this article, we fill this gap by analysing long-run historical data. We find that when the stance of monetary policy is accommodative over an extended period, the likelihood of financial turmoil in the medium term increases considerably. We investigate the causal pathways that lead to this result and argue that credit creation and asset price overheating are important intermediating channels.

10.1093/restud/rdag044.abstractZh: 持续宽松的货币政策时期是否会加剧金融脆弱性并提高金融危机发生的可能性？这是政策制定者面临的一个核心问题，然而现有文献并未在总量层面就这一联系提供系统的经验证据。本文通过分析长期历史数据填补了这一空白。我们发现，当货币政策立场在较长时期内保持宽松时，中期内发生金融动荡的可能性会显著上升。我们考察了导致这一结果的因果路径，并认为信贷创造和资产价格过热是重要的中介渠道。

abstract.text: We analyse discontinuous Markovian strategies for differential games. The best response correspondence uniquely maps almost all profiles of opponents’ strategies back to the strategy space. We thus make Markov-perfect equilibria in a wide class of differential games well-behaved, resolving a long-standing open problem. We provide a readily applicable necessary and sufficient condition for best responses and Markov-perfect Nash equilibria. We demonstrate our methods in a canonical model of non-cooperative mitigation of climate change. Our approach provides novel, economically important results: we obtain the entire set of symmetric Markov-perfect equilibria and demonstrate that the best equilibria can yield a major welfare improvement over the equilibrium which previous literature has focused on. International climate negotiations can be seen as being about coordination on good equilibria, rather than about bargaining over the limited surplus available in a dynamic prisoner’s dilemma.

10.1093/restud/rdag045.abstractZh: 我们分析微分博弈中的不连续马尔可夫策略。最优反应对应将几乎所有对手策略组合唯一地映射回策略空间。由此，我们使一大类微分博弈中的马尔可夫完美均衡具有良好性质，解决了一个长期悬而未决的开放问题。我们给出了一个可直接应用的最优反应与马尔可夫完美纳什均衡的充要条件。我们在一个气候变化非合作减缓的经典模型中展示了我们的方法。我们的方法给出了新的、具有重要经济意义的结果：我们得到了全部对称马尔可夫完美均衡，并证明最优均衡相较于既有文献所关注的均衡能够带来显著的福利改善。国际气候谈判可以被视为围绕良好均衡进行协调，而非就动态囚徒困境中有限的可得剩余进行讨价还价。

abstract.text: This article reconsiders the question of optimal labour income taxes for the very rich in the context of a flexible moral hazard model. In this setting, risk is not exogenous. Rather, each agent can affect the probabilities of all possible income outcomes by allocating a fixed time endowment across a variety of distinct tasks. I prove that the optimal income tax rates on high-end earners and the optimal Pareto tail index of the pre-tax labour income distribution are both endogenously determined by agent preferences. In particular, a society with less risk-averse agents will find it optimal to impose a lower tax rate on the rich, even though its members’ choices give rise to a smaller Pareto right tail index. In contrast, this kind of negative co-movement between inequality and optimal tax rates is a suboptimal response in the classical Mirrlees (1971)–Diamond (1998)–Saez (2001) setup to changes in the exogenous distribution of skills.

10.1093/restud/rdag046.abstractZh: 本文在一个灵活的道德风险模型框架下重新审视对极高收入者的最优劳动所得税问题。在该设定中，风险并非外生。相反，每个经济主体可以通过将固定时间禀赋配置于多种不同任务来影响所有可能收入结果的概率。本文证明，高收入者的最优所得税率与税前劳动收入分布的最优帕累托尾部指数均由经济主体的偏好内生决定。特别地，一个风险厌恶程度较低的社会会认为对富人征收较低税率是最优的，尽管其成员的选择导致较小的帕累托右尾指数。相比之下，在经典的 Mirrlees（1971）—Diamond（1998）—Saez（2001）设定中，面对外生技能分布的变化，不平等与最优税率之间的这种负向联动是一种次优反应。

abstract.text: This paper studies the long-term effects of technology and know-how transfers on structural transformations. In the 1950s, the Soviet Union supported the construction of the 156 Projects, which were large-scale, capital-intensive industrial clusters in China. These projects included a technology transfer, consisting of state-of-the-art Soviet machinery and equipment, and a know-how transfer, via the training of Chinese engineers, production supervisors, and high-skilled technicians by Soviet experts. We use newly assembled data that follow steel plants for over four decades, and we exploit natural variation in the transfers they eventually received. We find that, while production advantages stemming from Soviet technology faded away if not complemented with training, the know-how transfer had a long-lasting impact on plant performance, stimulated technology upgrade when China was a closed economy, and increased exports to the Western world when China engaged in international trade. The know-how transfer also generated productivity and technology spillovers onto complementary establishments.

10.1093/restud/rdag047.abstractZh: 本文研究技术与知识转移对结构转型的长期影响。20世纪50年代，苏联援建了156项工程，这些工程是中国境内大规模、资本密集型的产业集群。这些项目既包括技术转移，即提供当时最先进的苏联机器设备，也包括知识转移，即由苏联专家培训中国工程师、生产主管和高技能技术人员。我们使用新整理的数据，追踪钢铁厂四十余年，并利用这些工厂最终所获转移中的自然变异。我们发现，源自苏联技术的生产优势若未辅以培训便会逐渐消失，而知识转移对工厂绩效产生了持久影响，在中国处于封闭经济时期推动了技术升级，并在中国参与国际贸易后增加了对西方世界的出口。知识转移还对互补性企业产生了生产率和技术溢出效应。

abstract.text: This article combines personnel records of the U.S. government with census data to study how exposure to greater female representation at work can persistently reduce intergenerational gender gaps in labour market outcomes. Exploiting city-by-department variation in the sudden expansion of female employment during World War I, we find that daughters of civil servants exposed to female co-workers are more likely to work later in life. This intergenerational effect operates through exposed fathers and extends beyond the public sector, reducing the earnings gap by 12%. Consistent with a broader shift in attitudes towards working women, exposure to female co-workers also made male civil servants more likely to marry working women. We show that cities exposed to larger increases in female federal workers saw persistently higher female labour force participation in both the public and the private sector. Increasing gender representation within the public sector can thus have broader labour market implications.

10.1093/restud/rdag048.abstractZh: 本文结合美国政府人事记录与人口普查数据，研究在工作中接触更多女性代表如何能够持续缩小劳动力市场结果中的代际性别差距。我们利用第一次世界大战期间女性就业突然扩张在城市—部门层面的差异，发现接触女性同事的公务员的女儿在日后更有可能参加工作。这一代际效应通过受影响的父亲发挥作用，并延伸至公共部门之外，使收入差距缩小12%。与对职业女性态度的更广泛转变相一致，接触女性同事还使男性公务员更有可能与职业女性结婚。我们表明，女性联邦雇员增幅更大的城市，其公共部门和私营部门的女性劳动力参与率都持续更高。因此，提高公共部门内部的女性代表比例可能产生更广泛的劳动力市场影响。

abstract.text: We propose a new model of internal migration, based on persistent and spatially correlated idiosyncratic utility. The model is motivated by a new fact in the data that simple moving cost models struggle to match: the t-year interstate migration rate is proportional to the square root of t. The new model maintains the tractability and flexibility of standard migration models, but better matches the dynamics of migration, including the new fact. It has substantially different welfare implications and makes different counterfactual predictions, especially in terms of dynamic adjustment and long-run responses.

10.1093/restud/rdag049.abstractZh: 我们提出一个基于持续性且空间相关的个体特异性效用的内部迁移新模型。该模型由数据中的一个新事实所驱动，而简单的迁移成本模型难以匹配这一事实：t 年跨州迁移率与 t 的平方根成正比。新模型保持了标准迁移模型的易处理性和灵活性，但更好地匹配了迁移的动态特征，包括这一新事实。该模型具有显著不同的福利含义，并给出不同的反事实预测，尤其是在动态调整和长期响应方面。

abstract.text: This article presents a theoretical case for replacement of conventional heteroskedasticity-consistent and cluster-robust variance estimators with jackknife variance estimators, in the context of linear regression with heteroskedastic and/or cluster-dependent observations. We examine the bias of variance estimation and the coverage probabilities of confidence intervals. Concerning bias, we show that conventional variance estimators have full downward worst-case bias, while our jackknife variance estimator is never downward biased. Concerning confidence intervals, we show that intervals based on conventional standard errors have worst-case coverage equalling zero, while the jackknife-based confidence interval has coverage probability bounded by the Cauchy distribution, under the auxiliary assumption of normal errors. We also extend the Bell and McCaffrey (2002) student t approximation to our jackknife t-ratio, resulting in confidence intervals with improved coverage probabilities. Our theory holds under broad assumptions, allowing arbitrary cluster sizes, regressor leverage, within-cluster correlation, heteroskedasticity, regression with a single treated cluster, fixed effects, and delete-cluster invertibility failures. Our theoretical findings are consistent with the extensive simulation literature investigating heteroskedasticity-consistent and cluster-robust variance estimation.

10.1093/restud/rdag050.abstractZh: 本文在线性回归且存在异方差和/或聚类相关观测的背景下，为用 jackknife 方差估计量替代传统异方差一致与聚类稳健方差估计量提供了理论依据。我们考察方差估计的偏差以及置信区间的覆盖概率。关于偏差，我们表明传统方差估计量在最坏情形下具有完全向下的偏差，而我们的 jackknife 方差估计量从不会向下偏误。关于置信区间，我们表明基于传统标准误的区间在最坏情形下的覆盖概率等于零，而基于 jackknife 的置信区间在正态误差的辅助假设下，其覆盖概率以 Cauchy 分布为界。我们还将 Bell 和 McCaffrey（2002）的学生 t 近似推广到我们的 jackknife t 比率，从而得到覆盖概率有所改善的置信区间。我们的理论在宽泛的假设下成立，允许任意聚类规模、回归变量杠杆、聚类内相关、异方差、仅含单一处理聚类的回归、固定效应以及删除聚类不可逆的失败情形。我们的理论发现与大量考察异方差一致和聚类稳健方差估计的模拟文献相一致。

abstract.text: We implement Pigovian transport pricing in a field experiment in urban agglomerations of Switzerland over the course of 8 weeks. Our pricing considers the external costs from climate damages, health outcomes from pollution, accidents and physical activity, and congestion. It varies across time, space, and mode of transport and is deducted from a budget provided to GPS-tracked participants. The treatment significantly reduces the external costs of transport during the course of the experiment. The main underlying mechanism is a shift away from driving towards other modes, such as public transport, walking, and cycling. Providing information about the external costs of transport alone is insufficient to change the transport behaviour for the sample majority. A time-invariant tax on CO2 and health-related externalities would capture most of the welfare gains associated with the first-best policy.

10.1093/restud/rdag051.abstractZh: 我们在瑞士城市群开展了一项为期8周的实地实验，实施庇古式交通定价。我们的定价考虑了气候损害、污染对健康结果的影响、事故与身体活动以及拥堵所产生的外部成本。该定价随时间、空间和交通方式而变化，并从提供给受GPS追踪参与者的预算中扣除。干预在实验期间显著降低了交通的外部成本。其主要内在机制是从驾车转向其他方式，如公共交通、步行和骑行。仅提供交通外部成本信息不足以改变样本中多数人的交通行为。对CO2和健康相关外部性征收不随时间变化的税，将能捕获与最优政策相关的大部分福利收益。

abstract.text: For many technologies and behaviours, an agent’s benefit from adopting depends on his contacts adopting, and the benefit to his contacts of adopting depends on their contacts adopting. This paper examines how the architecture of these connections shapes the success or failure of the diffusion of innovations. We start with a standard model of diffusion with the key addition that some agents can coordinate their decisions. This captures the idea that people often talk and make decisions together with friends or family to adopt technologies. We show that insularity of connections, that is, the extent to which agents tend to concentrate their connections to a narrow set of other agents, determines contagion. However, whether insularity helps or hinders depends on the technology being diffused. For technologies that are valuable even without many contacts adopting, we find insular connections hinder adoption, but for technologies that are valuable only when many contacts adopt, insular connections facilitate adoption.

10.1093/restud/rdag052.abstractZh: 对于许多技术和行为而言，一个经济主体从采纳中获得的收益取决于其联系人是否采纳，而其联系人从采纳中获得的收益又取决于联系人的联系人是否采纳。本文考察这些连接的结构如何塑造创新扩散的成功或失败。我们从标准的扩散模型出发，关键补充是某些经济主体能够协调其决策。这刻画了人们常常与朋友或家人共同讨论并决定采纳技术这一现象。我们表明，连接的孤立性，即经济主体倾向于将其连接集中于一小群其他经济主体的程度，决定了传染。然而，孤立性是有助于还是阻碍扩散，取决于所扩散的技术。对于即便没有多少联系人采纳也具有价值的技术，我们发现孤立的连接会阻碍采纳；而对于只有许多联系人采纳时才有价值的技术，孤立的连接则会促进采纳。

abstract.text: We propose a novel channel through which rising income inequality affects job creation and macroeconomic outcomes. High-income households save relatively more in stocks and bonds but less in bank deposits. A rising top income share thereby increases the relative financing cost for bank-dependent firms, which in turn create fewer jobs compared to other firms. Exploiting variation in top income shares across US states and an instrumental variable strategy, we provide evidence for this channel. We then build a general equilibrium macroeconomic model with heterogeneous households and heterogeneous firms and calibrate it to our empirical estimates. The model shows that the secular rise in top incomes accounts for 13% of the decline in the employment share of small firms since 1980. Through the new channel, rising inequality also reduces the labour share and aggregate output. Model experiments show that ignoring the link between inequality and job creation understates welfare effects of income redistribution.

10.1093/restud/rdag053.abstractZh: 我们提出一个新颖的渠道，说明收入不平等上升如何影响就业创造与宏观经济结果。高收入家庭相对更多地将储蓄配置于股票和债券，而较少配置于银行存款。因此，最高收入份额上升会提高依赖银行融资的企业的相对融资成本，进而使这些企业相对于其他企业创造更少的就业。我们利用美国各州最高收入份额的差异以及工具变量策略，为该渠道提供了证据。随后，我们构建一个包含异质性家庭与异质性企业的一般均衡宏观经济模型，并根据我们的实证估计进行校准。模型显示，最高收入份额的长期上升解释了1980年以来小企业就业份额下降的13%。通过这一新渠道，不平等上升还降低了劳动份额与总产出。模型实验表明，忽视不平等与就业创造之间的联系会低估收入再分配的福利效应。

abstract.text: We investigate optimal monetary and macroprudential policies in an open economy with aggregate demand externalities and an occasionally binding zero lower bound constraint. Our analysis highlights that the optimal policy balances output stabilization and capital flow management. When macroprudential policy is available, monetary policy stabilizes the output gap. By contrast, when macroprudential policy is not available, monetary policy is used prudentially. However, contrary to a widespread view, raising the interest rate is not necessarily the optimal prudential policy. Finally, we show that international spillovers operate through the world real rate, but macroprudential policies provide insulation from the adverse effects of foreign policies.

10.1093/restud/rdag054.abstractZh: 我们研究一个存在总需求外部性和偶尔绑定的零利率下限约束的开放经济体中的最优货币政策与宏观审慎政策。我们的分析强调，最优政策在产出稳定与资本流动管理之间进行权衡。当宏观审慎政策可用时，货币政策稳定产出缺口。相反，当宏观审慎政策不可用时，货币政策被用于审慎目的。然而，与一种普遍观点相反，提高利率未必是最优的审慎政策。最后，我们表明，国际溢出效应通过世界实际利率发挥作用，但宏观审慎政策能够使经济免受外国政策不利影响的作用。

abstract.text: We exploit Germany’s temporary three-percentage-point value-added tax (VAT) cut in the second half of 2020 to study the spending response to unconventional fiscal policy. We use survey and scanner data on household consumption expenditures and their perceived pass-through of the tax change into prices, and a HANK model to quantify the effects of this VAT policy. The survey and scanner data show that the temporary VAT reduction led to a relative increase in durable and, to a lesser extent, semi-durable spending for individuals with high perceived pass-through. According to the HANK model, the VAT policy increased total aggregate consumption spending by 4.4% on impact.

10.1093/restud/rdag055.abstractZh: 我们利用德国在2020年下半年临时将增值税（VAT）下调三个百分点的政策，研究支出对非常规财政政策的反应。我们使用关于家庭消费支出及其对税收变化向价格传导的主观感知的调查数据和扫描数据，并构建HANK模型来量化该增值税政策的效果。调查数据和扫描数据显示，临时性增值税下调导致感知传导程度较高的个体在耐用品支出上相对增加，并在较小程度上导致其在半耐用品支出上相对增加。根据HANK模型，该增值税政策在冲击当期使总消费支出增加4.4%。

abstract.text: We study the labour market effects of permanent 30%–64% reductions on unemployment insurance benefits available in seven states. Leveraging linked firm-establishment data, we find that establishments based on reform states experience employment increases that are 0.8%–1.3% larger than those of the same firm’s establishments in other states. Using a similar multi-state firm design, starting salaries are 1.2%–5.5% lower in reform states and posted salaries for the same job fall by 3.2%–3.5%. The negative co-movement of employment and wages after the reform suggests a labour supply shock and mitigates against confounding changes in labour demand driving the results. Our findings are consistent with workers lowering their reservation wages as outside options fall, and employers take advantage of this by offering lower wages and increasing employment.

10.1093/restud/rdag056.abstractZh: 我们研究了七个州永久性削减30%–64%失业保险待遇对劳动力市场的影响。利用关联的企业—营业场所数据，我们发现，改革州的营业场所就业增幅比同一企业位于其他州的营业场所高出0.8%–1.3%。采用类似的多州企业设计，改革州的起薪低1.2%–5.5%，同一岗位的发布工资下降3.2%–3.5%。改革后就业与工资的反向变动表明存在劳动力供给冲击，这削弱了劳动力需求变化混淆结果的可能性。我们的发现与以下机制一致：随着外部选择变差，劳动者降低保留工资，而雇主利用这一点提供更低工资并增加就业。

abstract.text: We build a quantitative spatial model in which some workers can substitute on-site effort with work done from home. Ability and propensity to telecommute vary by education and industry. We quantify our framework to match the distribution of jobs and residents across 4,502 U.S. locations. Then, we simulate permanent increases in the attractiveness and productivity of telework that lead to greater adoption of hybrid and fully remote work. To validate our model, we show that our results are positively correlated with local changes in residents, jobs, and housing costs since 2019. The rise of telework results in a rich non-monotonic pattern of reallocations of residents and jobs within and across cities. Workers who can telecommute experience welfare gains, and those who cannot suffer losses. Broader access to jobs reduces wage inequality across residential locations, and heralds a partial reversal in the spatial concentration of talent and spending power known as the “Great Divergence”.

10.1093/restud/rdag057.abstractZh: 我们构建了一个定量空间模型，其中部分劳动者可以用居家工作替代现场工作。远程办公的能力和倾向因教育程度和行业而异。我们将框架量化，以匹配美国 4,502 个地点的工作岗位和居民分布。然后，我们模拟远程办公吸引力和生产率的永久性提高，这导致混合办公和完全远程办公的更广泛采用。为验证模型，我们表明结果与 2019 年以来居民、工作岗位和住房成本的本地变化正相关。远程办公的兴起导致居民和工作岗位在城市内部和城市之间出现丰富的非单调再分配模式。能够远程办公的劳动者获得福利收益，而无法远程办公的劳动者则遭受损失。更广泛的工作机会获取降低了居住地点之间的工资不平等，并预示着人才和消费能力空间集中度——即所谓的“大分化”——的部分逆转。

abstract.text: This article studies competition under information heterogeneity in selection markets and examines the impact of public information regulations aimed at reducing information asymmetries between competing firms. We develop a novel model and introduce new empirical strategies to analyse imperfect competition in markets where firms have heterogeneous information about consumers, vary in cost structures, and offer differentiated products. Using data from the Italian auto insurance market, we find substantial differences in the precision of risk ratings across insurers, and those with less accurate risk-rating algorithms tend to have more efficient cost structures. We assess the equilibrium effects of giving firms equal access to aggregated risk information from a centralized bureau. This policy significantly reduces prices by increasing competition, leading to a 15.7% boost in consumer surplus, almost reaching the efficiency benchmark where firms have full knowledge of consumers’ true risk. Aggregating information through the bureau favours low-risk consumers and reduces average costs by 12 euros per contract through more efficient insurer–insuree matching.

10.1093/restud/rdag058.abstractZh: 本文研究选择市场中的信息异质性下的竞争，并考察旨在减少竞争企业之间信息不对称的公共信息规制的影响。我们构建了一个新模型，并引入新的实证策略，以分析企业拥有关于消费者的异质性信息、成本结构各异且提供差异化产品的市场中的不完全竞争。利用意大利汽车保险市场的数据，我们发现各保险公司在风险评级的精确度上存在显著差异，而风险评级算法较不准确的公司往往具有更高效的成本结构。我们评估了让企业平等获取来自集中化征信机构的加总风险信息的均衡效应。该政策通过加剧竞争显著降低价格，使消费者剩余提高 15.7%，几乎达到企业完全掌握消费者真实风险的效率基准。通过征信机构加总信息有利于低风险消费者，并通过更高效的保险公司—投保人匹配使每份合同的平均成本降低 12 欧元。

abstract.text: We develop a general model of discrete choice that incorporates peer effects in preferences and consideration sets. We characterize the equilibrium behaviour and establish conditions under which all parts of the model can be recovered from a sequence of choices. We allow peers to affect preferences, consideration, or both. We show that these peer-effect mechanisms have different behavioural implications in the data. This allows us to recover the set and the type of connections between the agents in the network. We then use this information to recover each agent’s preferences and consideration mechanisms. These nonparametric identification results allow for general forms of heterogeneity across agents and do not rely on the variation of either exogenous covariates or the set of available options (menus). We apply our results to model expansion decisions by tea chains and find evidence of limited consideration. We simulate counterfactual predictions and show how limited consideration slows market penetration and competition.

10.1093/restud/rdag059.abstractZh: 我们构建了一个离散选择的一般模型，在偏好和考虑集（consideration sets）中纳入同伴效应。我们刻画了均衡行为，并确立了能够从一系列选择中识别模型各部分的条件。我们允许同伴影响偏好、考虑，或二者兼有。我们表明，这些同伴效应机制在数据中具有不同的行为含义。这使我们能够识别网络中经济主体之间连接的类型与集合。随后，我们利用这一信息识别每个经济主体的偏好与考虑机制。这些非参数识别结果允许经济主体之间存在一般形式的异质性，且不依赖于外生协变量或可选选项集合（菜单）的变动。我们将结果应用于茶饮连锁企业的扩张决策建模，并发现了有限考虑的证据。我们模拟反事实预测，并展示有限考虑如何减缓市场渗透与竞争。

abstract.text: Business dynamism—the process of firm entry, growth and exit—lies at the heart of modern endogenous growth models. While productivity differences have traditionally been seen as the main driving forces of business dynamism, a growing body of evidence suggests that customer acquisition is at least as important. In light of this evidence, we propose a novel endogenous growth model in which innovating firms must first acquire customers to sell their products. Estimating our model with aggregate and firm-level data, we find that expansions of firms’ customer bases (market sizes) boost their incentives to innovate and shift resources towards high-growth businesses (“gazelles”). Combined, these effects explain over 40% of aggregate growth and substantially change predictions about the efficacy of growth policies. Finally, we document support for key model predictions using firm-level micro-data.

10.1093/restud/rdag060.abstractZh: 企业动态——企业进入、成长与退出的过程——是现代内生增长模型的核心。尽管生产率差异传统上被视为企业动态的主要驱动力，但越来越多的证据表明，客户获取至少同样重要。鉴于这些证据，我们提出了一个新颖的内生增长模型，其中创新企业必须首先获取客户才能销售其产品。利用总量数据和企业层面数据对我们的模型进行估计，我们发现企业客户基础（市场规模）的扩张会增强其创新激励，并将资源重新配置到高增长企业（“瞪羚企业”）。综合来看，这些效应解释了超过40%的总量增长，并大幅改变了对增长政策有效性的预测。最后，我们利用企业层面微观数据为模型的关键预测提供了支持性证据。

abstract.text: We investigate how technologies that reduce the costs of monitoring by central authorities have shaped the historical transition from small patrimonial states to large bureaucratic organizations. Our analysis is based on a novel dataset that traces changes in the organizational structure and geographic presence of the U.S. federal government over the 19th century. To identify causal effects, we develop a new identification strategy that exploits the expansion of the railroad network as a source of variation in the travel time—and thus monitoring costs—between Washington D.C. and other locations. We present three main findings. First, reductions in travel time to Washington D.C. significantly increased the likelihood of federal government presence in a location. Second, this effect is stronger for occupations and tasks characterized by more severe agency problems. Third, decreases in travel time to Washington D.C. are associated with a decline in patrimonial features of the federal government in the location, in line with enhanced monitoring capacity reducing dependence on personal trust and connections.

10.1093/restud/rdag061.abstractZh: 我们考察降低中央权威监督成本的技术如何塑造了从小型世袭制国家向大型官僚组织的历史转型。我们的分析基于一个新数据集，该数据集追踪了19世纪美国联邦政府在组织结构和地理分布上的变化。为识别因果效应，我们提出了一种新的识别策略，利用铁路网络的扩张作为华盛顿特区与其他地点之间出行时间——从而监督成本——变化的来源。我们给出三个主要发现。第一，到华盛顿特区出行时间的缩短显著提高了联邦政府在某一地点存在的可能性。第二，对于代理问题更为严重的职业和任务，这一效应更强。第三，到华盛顿特区出行时间的减少与联邦政府在该地点世袭制特征的下降相关，这与监督能力增强降低了对个人信任和关系的依赖相一致。

abstract.text: We consider an oligopoly model in which each firm chooses not only its price but also its advertising strategy regarding how much, and what, product information to provide. To highlight firms’ strategic incentives, we impose no structural restrictions on feasible advertising content, so that each firm can disclose or conceal any information. We obtain a comprehensive characterization of the equilibrium advertising strategy and provide some sufficient conditions for the existence of symmetric pure-price equilibria. We show that intense competition induces firms to provide accurate product information; firms usually obfuscate consumers’ relatively low or high values; and requiring firms to provide more product information can reduce social surplus and also be harmful to consumers.

10.1093/restud/rdag062.abstractZh: 我们考虑一个寡头垄断模型，其中每家企业不仅选择其价格，还选择其广告策略，即提供多少以及何种产品信息。为突出企业的策略性激励，我们不对可行的广告内容施加任何结构性限制，因此每家企业都可以披露或隐瞒任何信息。我们得到了均衡广告策略的完整刻画，并给出了对称纯价格均衡存在性的一些充分条件。我们表明，激烈的竞争会促使企业提供准确的产品信息；企业通常会模糊消费者相对较低或较高的价值；而要求企业提供更多产品信息可能降低社会剩余，并且也可能对消费者有害。

abstract.text: We study the role of public risk-sharing in markets where firms face substantial cost uncertainty, focusing on public reinsurance in health insurance. We develop a model where insurers internalize cost uncertainty through risk charges that raise effective marginal costs and create a role for reinsurance. Public reinsurance lowers both expected costs and cost volatility, particularly for smaller insurers, reducing prices and enhancing competition. Using an event study of staggered state-level reinsurance programs, we show that public reinsurance leads insurers to lower prices and private reinsurance purchases, benefiting financially constrained insurers the most. Structural estimates indicate that risk charges account for a substantial share of the premium-cost wedge and highlight public reinsurance’s comparative advantage over premium subsidies by providing risk protection and enhancing competition. Our results underscore the importance of accounting for firms’ risk exposure in policy design and provide a general framework for understanding public risk-sharing policies.

10.1093/restud/rdag063.abstractZh: 我们研究公共风险分担在企业面临显著成本不确定性的市场中的作用，重点关注医疗保险中的公共再保险。我们构建了一个模型，其中保险公司通过风险收费将成本不确定性内部化，风险收费提高了有效边际成本，并为再保险创造了作用空间。公共再保险降低了预期成本和成本波动性，尤其是对规模较小的保险公司而言，从而降低价格并增强竞争。利用对各州交错实施的再保险计划进行的事件研究，我们发现公共再保险促使保险公司降低价格并减少私人再保险购买，其中融资约束最紧的保险公司受益最大。结构估计表明，风险收费在保费—成本楔子中占相当大的份额，并凸显出公共再保险相对于保费补贴的比较优势，即通过提供风险保护和增强竞争发挥作用。我们的结果强调了在政策设计中考虑企业风险暴露的重要性，并为理解公共风险分担政策提供了一个一般性框架。

abstract.text: In many markets, buyers make discrete choices between differentiated products and negotiate prices that are specific to the choice. We develop for estimation a model for this class of markets which is consistent with non-cooperative models of bargaining between a buyer and competing sellers. We show that when the buyer’s utility has GEV disturbances, the model has a tractable likelihood function which can be used with transaction-level data giving the selected product and its price. We estimate the model using data from the UK brick industry and use it to measure market power and analyse mergers. We analyse how spatial differentiation and ownership concentration affect the distribution of market power across transactions. In counterfactuals we find that switching from individually negotiated to uniform pricing causes markups, and merger price effects, to increase on average but to decrease for a minority of transactions.

10.1093/restud/rdag064.abstractZh: 在许多市场中，买方在差异化产品之间做出离散选择，并就特定于该选择的价格进行谈判。我们为这一类市场构建了一个可用于估计的模型，该模型与买方和相互竞争的卖方之间非合作讨价还价的模型相一致。我们证明，当买方效用具有GEV扰动时，该模型具有易处理似然函数，可与给出所选产品及其价格的交易层面数据一起使用。我们使用英国砖块行业的数据估计该模型，并用其衡量市场势力和分析合并。我们分析空间差异化和所有权集中度如何影响市场势力在不同交易间的分布。在反事实分析中，我们发现，从单独谈判定价转向统一定价会使加成平均上升，并使合并的价格效应平均上升，但对少数交易而言则会下降。

abstract.text: I develop a unified theoretical framework with schools and residential choices to study the welfare consequences of public schools’ switching from the traditional neighbourhood assignment to the deferred acceptance mechanism. I find that when families receive higher priorities at neighbourhood schools, the deferred acceptance mechanism creates higher aggregate or utilitarian welfare than neighbourhood assignment. Under a common school ranking assumption, I also show that the deferred acceptance creates higher aggregate welfare with neighbourhood priorities than without them.

10.1093/restud/rdag065.abstractZh: 我构建了一个包含学校选择和居住选择的统一理论框架，用以研究公立学校从传统就近入学分配转向延迟接受机制所带来的福利后果。我发现，当家庭在就近学校获得更高优先级时，延迟接受机制相比就近入学分配会产生更高的总量福利或功利主义福利。在共同学校排名假设下，我还表明，延迟接受机制在设有就近优先级时比没有就近优先级时产生更高的总量福利。

abstract.text: We study empirically and theoretically the effects of international financial flows on resource allocation. Using the universe of firms in Hungary, we show that removing capital controls lowers firms’ cost of capital and increases household consumption, with the latter playing a dominant role. The consumption channel leads to reallocation of resources toward high expenditure elasticity activities—such as services—promoting both the expansion of incumbents and firm entry. A multi-sector heterogeneous firm model replicates these dynamics. Our model shows that nonhomotheticity in consumption can quantitatively account for the reallocation of resources towards services and successfully replicates the dynamics of aggregate productivity following episodes of financial openness.

10.1093/restud/rdag066.abstractZh: 我们从实证和理论两方面研究国际金融流动对资源配置的影响。利用匈牙利全部企业的数据，我们表明取消资本管制会降低企业资本成本并增加家庭消费，其中后者发挥主导作用。消费渠道导致资源向高支出弹性活动（如服务业）重新配置，既促进现有企业扩张，也促进企业进入。一个多部门异质性企业模型复现了这些动态。我们的模型表明，消费的非位似性可以在数量上解释资源向服务业的重新配置，并成功复现金融开放之后总量生产率的动态。

abstract.text: We explore the power that precise information about consumers’ preferences grants an intermediary in shaping competition. We think of an intermediary as an information designer who chooses what information to reveal to firms, which then compete à la Bertrand in a differentiated product market. We analyse the information designs that maximize consumer and producer surplus and uncover systematic differences in how information can be used to intensify or soften competition. Our analysis demonstrates the power that users’ data can endow intermediaries with and speaks directly to current regulatory debates regarding digital marketplaces.

10.1093/restud/rdag067.abstractZh: 我们考察关于消费者偏好的精确信息赋予中间商塑造竞争的力量。我们将中间商视为信息设计者，由其选择向企业披露何种信息，企业随后在差异化产品市场中按 Bertrand 方式竞争。我们分析了使消费者剩余和生产者剩余最大化的信息设计，并揭示了信息在用于加剧或缓和竞争方面所存在的系统性差异。我们的分析展示了用户数据能够赋予中间商的力量，并直接回应了当前关于数字市场的监管争论。

abstract.text: I propose a model of skill-replacing routine-biased technological change (SR-RBTC). In this model, technology substitutes for the use of skill in routine tasks, in contrast to standard RBTC models, which assume that technology replaces the workers themselves. The SR-RBTC model explains three key trends that are inconsistent with standard RBTC models: (1) why specifically middle wages declined even though workers in routine occupations are dispersed across the entire bottom half of the wage distribution, (2) why middle wages stopped declining while technological change continued, and (3) why there is no substantial decline in the average wage of workers in routine occupations. I derive two new testable predictions from the model: a decrease in the return to skill and a decrease in skill level in routine occupations. I use an interactive fixed-effects model to confirm both predictions. Since SR-RBTC violates the ignorability assumption required by standard decomposition methods, I introduce a “skewness decomposition” to show that SR-RBTC is the main driver of bottom-half inequality trends.

10.1093/restud/rdag068.abstractZh: 我提出一个技能替代型常规偏向技术变革（SR-RBTC）模型。在该模型中，技术替代的是常规任务中技能的使用，而标准RBTC模型则假定技术替代的是劳动者本身。SR-RBTC模型解释了三个与标准RBTC模型不一致的关键趋势：（1）为何恰恰是中等工资下降，尽管常规职业中的劳动者分散在整个工资分布下半部分；（2）为何中等工资在技术变革持续进行的情况下停止下降；（3）为何常规职业劳动者的平均工资没有大幅下降。我从模型中推导出两个新的可检验预测：技能回报下降，以及常规职业中技能水平下降。我使用交互固定效应模型证实了这两个预测。由于SR-RBTC违背了标准分解方法所需的可忽略性假设，我引入“偏度分解”来表明SR-RBTC是下半部分不平等趋势的主要驱动因素。

abstract.text: We characterize optimal policy rules in a business-cycle model with nominal rigidities and heterogeneous households. The policymaker has access to two instruments: the short-term nominal rate, and lump-sum transfer payments. A policymaker with a traditional dual mandate that targets aggregates uses the same policy rule as is optimal in the textbook New Keynesian model. We then consider a policymaker with a distributional objective. The optimal policy rule now contains an additional term, reflecting the effects of the policymaker’s instruments on consumption inequality. Since, in our model, monetary policy only has very limited distributional effects, this additional term does not materially change optimal monetary policy. Fiscal stimulus payments, on the other hand, have strongly progressive effects and are thus well-suited to cushion the distributional effects of cyclical fluctuations.

10.1093/restud/rdag069.abstractZh: 我们在一个具有名义刚性且家庭异质性的商业周期模型中，描述了最优政策规则。政策制定者可以使用的两种工具是：短期名义利率和一次性转移支付。具有传统双重目标的政策制定者，如果以总量为目标，其使用的政策规则与教科书中的新凯恩斯模型中的最优政策规则相同。然后，我们考虑一个具有分配目标的政策制定者。最优政策规则现在包含了一个额外的项，反映了政策制定者工具对消费不平等的影响。由于在我们的模型中，货币政策对分配效应的影响非常有限，这个额外的项并不会实质性地改变最优货币政策。而财政刺激措施则具有强烈的累进效应，因此非常适合缓冲周期性波动对分配的影响。

abstract.text: We introduce a survey instrument to measure earnings risk allowing for the possibility of quitting or being fired from the current job. We find these transitions to be the key drivers of subjective risk. A link with administrative data provides multiple credibility checks and reveals that subjective earnings risk varies systematically across the population. It is also many times smaller than traditional estimates even when conditioning richly on demographics and job history. We show that subjective earnings risk can help explain why many hold limited liquid assets.

10.1093/restud/rdag070.abstractZh: 我们引入一种调查工具来测度收入风险，并允许从当前工作辞职或被解雇的可能性。我们发现这些转换是主观风险的关键驱动因素。与行政数据的链接提供了多重可信性检验，并揭示主观收入风险在人群中存在系统性差异。即使对人口特征和工作经历进行充分条件控制，它也比传统估计小许多倍。我们表明，主观收入风险有助于解释为何许多人持有的流动性资产有限。

abstract.text: This article studies the impact of income-based criminal punishments on crime. In Finland, speeding tickets become income-dependent if the driver’s speed exceeds the speeding limit by more than 20 km/h, leading to a substantial jump in the size of the speeding ticket. Contrary to predictions of a traditional Becker model, individuals do not bunch below the fine hike. Instead, the speeding distributions are smooth at the cutoff. However, I demonstrate that the size of the realized speeding ticket has sizable, but short-lived, impacts on reoffending. I use a regression discontinuity design to show that fines that are, on average, 200 euros larger decrease reoffending by 15% in the following 6 months. The drop in reoffending is driven by high-income individuals facing the highest fine at the cutoff. I estimate that a fixed fine hike that matches the current deterrence effect would raise the fine increase faced by the bottom income quartile by about 300% at the cutoff, relative to the increase they face under the current income-based schedule. My empirical results are consistent with an explanation that people operate under information frictions. To illustrate this, I construct a Becker model with misperception and learning that can explain all the empirical findings.

10.1093/restud/rdag071.abstractZh: 本文研究基于收入的刑事处罚对犯罪的影响。在芬兰，当驾驶员的超速幅度超过限速 20 公里/小时以上时，超速罚单金额转为取决于收入，导致超速罚单金额大幅跃升。与传统贝克尔模型的预测相反，个人并不会在罚款跃升点以下扎堆。相反，超速分布在临界点处是平滑的。然而，我证明实际开出的超速罚单金额对再犯具有可观但短暂的影响。我使用回归断点设计表明，平均高出 200 欧元的罚款使随后 6 个月内的再犯率下降 15%。再犯率的下降由在临界点面临最高罚款的高收入个人所驱动。我估计，若采用固定罚款上调幅度以匹配当前的威慑效应，则最低收入四分位群体在临界点面临的罚款增幅将比现行基于收入的罚款标准下其所面临的增幅高出约 300%。我的实证结果与人们处于信息摩擦之下的解释相一致。为说明这一点，我构建了一个包含错误感知与学习的贝克尔模型，该模型能够解释所有实证发现。

abstract.text: University access has significantly expanded in OECD countries, and further growth figures prominently in political agendas. We study possible consequences of historical and future expansions in a stochastic, general equilibrium Roy model where tertiary educational attainment is determined by cognitive ability and socioeconomic disadvantage. In our analysis, individual productivity depends not only on education but also directly on cognitive ability. The expansion of university access in the U.K. that started in the 1960s provides an ideal case study to draw lessons for the future. We find that this expansion led to the selection into college of progressively less talented students from advantaged backgrounds. Appropriate counterfactual policies existed that would have achieved the dual goal of increasing college graduates’ cognitive ability while improving tertiary education opportunities for the disadvantaged.

10.1093/restud/rdag072.abstractZh: 经合组织国家的大学入学机会显著扩大，进一步扩张在政治议程中占据重要位置。我们在一个随机一般均衡 Roy 模型中研究历史扩张与未来扩张的可能后果，其中高等教育 attainment 由认知能力和社会经济劣势决定。在我们的分析中，个体生产率不仅取决于教育，还直接取决于认知能力。英国自 1960 年代开始的大学入学机会扩张为汲取未来经验提供了理想的案例研究。我们发现，这一扩张导致来自优势背景、天赋 progressively 较低的学生被选入大学。存在适当的反事实政策，本可实现既提高大学毕业生认知能力、又改善弱势群体高等教育机会的双重目标。

abstract.text: This paper studies a multi-product monopolist facing a privately informed consumer with additive and type-increasing valuations. Separate monopoly pricing is robustly optimal with respect to the type distribution if and only if the marginal rate of substitution between each pair of goods is monotone. This result is obtained by extending the conventional Myersonian approach.

10.1093/restud/rdag073.abstractZh: 本文研究一个面临私人信息消费者且消费者具有可加且随类型递增估值的多产品垄断者。当且仅当任意两种商品之间的边际替代率单调时，分开的垄断定价相对于类型分布是稳健最优的。该结果通过扩展传统的 Myerson 方法得到。

abstract.text: In a data economy, transactions of goods and services generate data, which is stored, traded and depreciates. How are the economics of this economy different from traditional production economies? How do these differences matter for measurement of GDP, firm values, depreciation rates, welfare and externalities? We incorporate active experimentation and data as an intangible asset to devise a tractable recursive representation of the data economy. The model rationalizes why apps are often “free” and why even non-digital economic activity might be greater than GDP suggests. Calibrating the model using a combination of macroeconomic and financial moments suggests that the mis-measurement in U.S. GDP due to missing value of data has been as high as 6% in 2018.

10.1093/restud/rdag074.abstractZh: 在数据经济中，商品和服务交易会产生数据，数据被存储、交易并折旧。这一经济体的经济学与传统生产经济体有何不同？这些差异对GDP、企业价值、折旧率、福利和外部性的测度有何影响？我们将主动实验和数据作为一种无形资产纳入模型，构建了数据经济的易处理递归表示。该模型解释了为何应用程序往往“免费”，以及为何即使非数字经济活动也可能大于GDP所显示的水平。结合宏观经济与金融矩条件对模型进行校准后表明，由于数据价值缺失，2018年美国GDP的测度误差高达6%。

abstract.text: We study structural change in production networks for intermediate inputs (input–output network) and new capital (investment network). For each network, we document that the share of output produced by services (relative to goods) is rising over time. While the relative prices of services that produce intermediates and consumption are rising, we find that the relative price of services that produce investment is falling over time. We then develop a multi-sector growth model to study these trends and their implications for economic growth. To match the relative price trends, inputs to intermediates production are complements and inputs to investment production are substitutes. Hence, structural change endogenously reallocates resources to the slowest growing intermediates producers and the fastest growing investment producers. Growth accounting exercises reveal that investment-specific technical change accounts for an increasing share of U.S. aggregate growth, with 20% of aggregate growth since 2000 due to investment structural change. Growth projections from our model show that structural change within investment networks alone can offset stagnating or declining growth in other sectors due to Baumol’s cost disease.

10.1093/restud/rdag075.abstractZh: 我们研究中间投入品（投入—产出网络）和新资本（投资网络）生产网络中的结构变化。对每个网络，我们记录到服务业（相对于商品）生产的产出份额随时间上升。尽管生产中间投入品和消费品的服务相对价格在上升，我们发现生产投资品的服务相对价格随时间下降。随后我们构建一个多部门增长模型来研究这些趋势及其对经济增长的含义。为匹配相对价格趋势，中间投入品生产的投入品为互补品，投资品生产的投入品为替代品。因此，结构变化内生地将资源重新配置到增长最慢的中间投入品生产者和增长最快的投资品生产者。增长核算 exercise 显示，投资特定技术变化占美国总量增长的份额不断上升，2000 年以来总量增长的 20% 归因于投资结构变化。我们模型的增长预测显示，仅投资网络内部的结构变化就可以抵消其他部门因 Baumol 成本病而出现的增长停滞或下降。

abstract.text: We conduct an experimental analysis of selective disclosure in communication. In the model, an informed sender aims to influence a receiver by disclosing verifiable evidence that is selected from a larger pool of available evidence. Our experimental design leverages this model’s rich comparative statics, allowing us to systematically quantify the effects of selection relative to concealment. Our findings confirm the key qualitative predictions of the theory, suggesting that selection, rather than concealment, is often the dominant distortion in communication. We also identify deviations from the theory: Some senders are “deception averse” and overcommunicate relative to predictions; receivers respond too optimistically to both concealed and selected evidence, with errors of similar magnitude. Yet selection generates greater overall distortion in receiver behaviour because it is far more prevalent than concealment.

10.1093/restud/rdag076.abstractZh: 我们对沟通中的选择性披露进行了实验分析。在该模型中，掌握信息的发送者通过从更大的可用证据池中选取可验证证据进行披露，以影响接收者。我们的实验设计利用该模型丰富的比较静态结果，从而能够系统量化选择相对于隐瞒的影响。我们的发现证实了该理论的关键定性预测，表明在沟通中，选择而非隐瞒往往是主要的扭曲来源。我们还识别出与理论的偏离：部分发送者具有“欺骗厌恶”，相对于预测而言过度沟通；接收者对隐瞒证据和选择证据的反应都过于乐观，且误差幅度相近。然而，选择在接收者行为中产生的总体扭曲更大，因为其远比隐瞒更为普遍。

abstract.text: We show that the formalization of representativeness (Kahneman and Tversky, 1972, Cognitive Psychology, 3, 430–454) developed by Gennaioli and Shleifer (2010, The Quarterly Journal of Economics, 125, 1399–1433) features an intrinsic connection between uncertainty and overreaction. In the time series domain, we develop this connection in a smooth version of diagnostic expectations (DE), where overreaction varies smoothly with uncertainty. Intuitively, under smoothness, lower uncertainty leaves less room for representativeness to distort beliefs. Smooth DE provides a joint, parsimonious micro-foundation for key features of survey data: overreaction to news, stronger overreaction at longer horizons, overconfidence in subjective uncertainty, and a new stylized fact documented here—overreaction intensifies with higher uncertainty. An analytical Real Business Cycle model with Smooth DE accounts for survey overreaction and overconfidence, as well as three salient business cycle properties: asymmetry, countercyclical macro volatility, and countercyclical micro volatility.

10.1093/restud/rdag077.abstractZh: 我们表明，Gennaioli 和 Shleifer（2010，The Quarterly Journal of Economics，125，1399–1433）所发展的代表性（Kahneman 和 Tversky，1972，Cognitive Psychology，3，430–454）形式化，具有不确定性与过度反应之间的内在联系。在时间序列领域，我们在诊断性预期（DE）的平滑版本中发展了这一联系，其中过度反应随不确定性平滑变化。直观上，在平滑性下，较低的不确定性留给代表性扭曲信念的空间更小。平滑 DE 为调查数据的关键特征提供了一个联合、简约的微观基础：对新闻的过度反应、较长预测期上更强的过度反应、对主观不确定性的过度自信，以及本文记录的一个新典型事实——过度反应随不确定性升高而加剧。一个带有平滑 DE 的解析实际经济周期模型能够解释调查中的过度反应与过度自信，以及三个显著的商业周期特征：不对称性、逆周期的宏观波动性和逆周期的微观波动性。

abstract.text: We study the impact of large, successful manufacturing plants on other local producers in China, focusing on “Million-Rouble Plants” built in the 1950s during a brief alliance with the U.S.S.R. The ephemeral geopolitical situation and the locations of allied and enemy airbases provide exogenous variation in plant siting. We find a boom-and-bust pattern: Counties hosting these plants were 80% more productive than control counties in 1982 but 20% less productive by 2010. This decline reflects the performance of local establishments, which exhibit low productivity, limited innovation, and high markup. Specialization hindered spillovers, preventing the emergence of new clusters and local entrepreneurship.

10.1093/restud/rdag078.abstractZh: 我们研究大型、成功的制造业工厂对中国其他本地生产者的影响，聚焦于20世纪50年代在与苏联短暂结盟期间建设的“百万卢布工厂”。短暂的地缘政治形势以及盟国和敌国空军基地的位置为工厂选址提供了外生变异。我们发现了一种繁荣—萧条模式：1982年，拥有这些工厂的县的生产率比控制县高80%，但到2010年则低20%。这一下降反映了本地企业的表现，这些企业表现出低生产率、有限的创新和高加成率。专业化阻碍了溢出效应，阻止了新集群和本地创业的出现。

abstract.text: Racial covenants in housing deeds were widely used in the United States during the early 20th century to segregate neighbourhoods. In 1948, the Supreme Court decision in Shelley v. Kraemer made racial covenants unenforceable in court, stopping short of prohibiting them entirely. We surmise that even after losing their judicial enforceability, such covenants could have shaped segregation if they served as a focal point for coordination on an initial equilibrium in neighbourhood formation, a context characterised by investment durability and path dependency. To test this hypothesis, we assemble novel parcel-level data on racial covenants and develop a quasi-experimental design that exploits delays between covenant execution and housing construction to isolate exposure to enforceable covenants at the time neighbourhoods were built. Covenant enforceability indeed affected early-stage neighbourhood formation in terms of housing characteristics, public infrastructure placement, and the composition of initial residents. These early differences proved durable: A one standard deviation increase in neighborhood exposure to enforceable covenants accounts for 6%–24% of the observed neighbourhood racial segregation from 1980 to 2020 and 3.1%–4.4% of housing price differentials in the 21st century. We conclude that by coordinating beliefs and decisions during neighbourhood formation, the law generated spatial inequality that has long outlived racial covenants themselves.

10.1093/restud/rdag079.abstractZh: 20世纪初，美国住房契约中的种族限制条款被广泛用于实施社区隔离。1948年，最高法院在Shelley诉Kraemer案中裁定种族限制条款在法庭上不可执行，但并未完全禁止此类条款。我们推测，即使失去司法可执行性，如果这些条款在社区形成过程中充当了围绕初始均衡进行协调的焦点，那么在投资持久性和路径依赖特征显著的背景下，它们仍可能塑造隔离格局。为检验这一假说，我们汇编了关于种族限制条款的新型地块层面数据，并设计了一种准实验方法，利用条款签署与住房建设之间的时间差，分离出社区建成时暴露于可执行条款的影响。条款的可执行性确实在住房特征、公共基础设施布局以及初始居民构成方面影响了早期社区形成。这些早期差异被证明具有持久性：社区暴露于可执行条款的程度每增加一个标准差，可解释1980年至2020年间观测到的社区种族隔离的6%–24%，以及21世纪住房价格差异的3.1%–4.4%。我们得出结论：通过在社区形成过程中协调信念和决策，法律产生了空间不平等，其影响远远超出了种族限制条款本身。

abstract.text: The European Union (EU) designates 26% of its landmass as protected areas, limiting economic development for biodiversity. We use the staggered introduction of protected areas between 1985 and 2019 to study the selection of protected land and the causal effect of protection on vegetation cover and nightlights.
