We find no meaningful impacts on either outcome across four decades, countries, protection cohorts, or land characteristics. These null effects are consistent with the political economy of EU land protection: weak incentives to internalize biodiversity gains, green-glow motives, and area-based targets shape local siting and stringency choices. In practice, strict protection is applied where development pressure is low–so that protection has little bite—while in high-pressure regions, protection is typically weak, imposing only limited constraints on economic activity.

10.1093/restud/rdag080.abstractZh: 欧盟将其26%的陆地面积划定为保护区，以生物多样性为由限制经济开发。我们利用1985年至2019年间保护区的交错设立，研究保护用地的选择以及保护对植被覆盖和夜间灯光的因果效应。我们发现，在四十年间、跨国家、跨保护批次或跨土地特征，对这两种结果均无实质性影响。这些零效应与欧盟土地保护的政治经济学相一致：内化生物多样性收益的激励薄弱、绿色光环动机以及基于面积的目标共同塑造了地方选址和严格程度的选择。在实践中，严格保护被施加于开发压力较低的地区——因此保护几乎没有实际约束力——而在高压力地区，保护通常较弱，仅对经济活动施加有限约束。

abstract.text: Motivated by a secular increase in the concentration of the U.S. banking industry, I develop a new macroeconomic model with oligopolistic financial intermediaries and heterogeneous firms. Market power allows banks to price discriminate and charge firm-specific markups, exerting greater market power over productive and more financially constrained firms. This dampens capital accumulation and amplifies the effects of macroeconomic shocks. During a crisis, banks exploit the higher share of financially constrained firms to extract higher markups, inducing a larger decline in real activity. When a large bank fails, the remaining banks use their increased market power to restrict credit supply, worsening and prolonging the downturn.

10.1093/restud/rdag081.abstractZh: 受美国银行业集中度长期上升的启发，我构建了一个包含寡头金融中介和异质性企业的新宏观经济模型。市场势力使银行能够进行价格歧视并收取企业特定加成，对生产率更高和融资约束更强的企业施加更大的市场势力。这抑制了资本积累并放大了宏观经济冲击的影响。在危机期间，银行利用融资约束企业占比上升来提取更高的加成，导致实际经济活动出现更大幅度下降。当一家大型银行倒闭时，其余银行利用其增强的市场势力限制信贷供给，使衰退恶化并延长。

abstract.text: We estimate the impact of public pension incentives on labour supply far from the normal retirement age by exploiting Poland’s switch from a defined benefit to a notional defined contribution (NDC) scheme. This reform created a sharp cohort-based discontinuity in the link between current pension contributions and future benefits. Using this discontinuity and the universe of taxpayers, we estimate an employment elasticity with respect to the net return to work of 0.51 for men at ages 51–54. We estimate a lifecycle model to match these responses and discuss the broader implications of the reform. The shift to NDC reallocates work incentives over the lifecycle, strengthening incentives at younger ages, when labour supply is relatively inelastic, and weakening them at older ages, when labour supply is more elastic. This reallocation of work incentives tends to reduce aggregate lifecycle labour supply, which highlights the advantage of targeting pension incentives towards ages at which labour supply is most responsive.

10.1093/restud/rdag082.abstractZh: 我们通过利用波兰从待遇确定型向名义确定缴费型（NDC）制度的转变，估计公共养老金激励对远离正常退休年龄的劳动供给的影响。这项改革在当期养老金缴费与未来待遇之间的联系上，制造了一个以出生队列为基础的明显断点。利用这一断点以及全体纳税人数据，我们估计出51—54岁男性相对于工作净回报的就业弹性为0.51。我们估计了一个生命周期模型以匹配这些反应，并讨论了这项改革更广泛的含义。向NDC的转变在生命周期内重新配置了工作激励，在劳动供给相对缺乏弹性的较年轻年龄增强了激励，而在劳动供给更有弹性的较年长年龄削弱了激励。这种工作激励的重新配置倾向于降低总量生命周期劳动供给，这凸显了将养老金激励瞄准劳动供给反应最大的年龄段的优势。

abstract.text: We study monopolistic certification in markets where sellers possess partial private information about product quality. A certifier can provide information through two channels: screening sellers’ private information (soft information) and acquiring new quality data (hard information). We prove that any certification menu achieving less than maximal screening is Pareto dominated by one with full screening. Among Pareto-efficient menus, the certifier’s profit-maximizing menu provides maximal soft information while restricting hard information provision. The two channels diverge because screening creates value the certifier can fully capture, whereas hard information amplifies costly information rents. Using power value functions, we derive comparative statics showing that information restrictions target low-quality sellers when information value is moderate, but high-quality sellers receive perfect quality revelation when information value is high.

10.1093/restud/rdag083.abstractZh: 我们研究卖方对产品质量拥有部分私人信息时的垄断性认证。认证机构可以通过两种渠道提供信息：筛选卖方的私人信息（软信息）以及获取新的质量数据（硬信息）。我们证明，任何未达到最大筛选程度的认证菜单都被完全筛选的菜单帕累托占优。在帕累托有效的菜单中，利润最大化的菜单提供最大程度的软信息，同时限制硬信息的提供。两种渠道之所以出现分化，是因为筛选所创造的价值可被认证机构完全攫取，而硬信息则会放大代价高昂的信息租金。利用幂值函数，我们推导出比较静态结果，表明当信息价值处于中等水平时，信息限制针对的是低质量卖方，而当信息价值较高时，高质量卖方则获得完全的质量揭示。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the importance of the age composition for pandemic policy design. To do so, it introduces an economic framework with age heterogeneity, individual choice, and incomplete information, emphasising the value of testing. Calibrating the model to the U.S. COVID-19 pandemic reveals an 80% reduction in the death toll due to voluntary actions and the lockdown implemented in the US. The optimal lockdown, however, is more stringent than what was implemented. Moreover, the social planner follows an asymmetric approach by locking down the young relatively more than the old. We highlight the role of testing in reducing deaths, lowering economic costs, and allowing for a less restrictive lockdown. A social planner would choose a faster ramp-up in testing capacity relative to what occurred in the US. We use the framework to provide insights into pandemics caused by different viruses (including the Spanish flu) and underline the influence of economic conditions on optimal policies.

10.1093/restud/rdag084.abstractZh: 本文研究了年龄构成对于大流行病政策设计的重要性。为此，本文引入一个包含年龄异质性、个体选择和不完全信息的经济框架，并强调检测的价值。将模型校准至美国 COVID-19 大流行后发现，自愿行为和美国实施的封锁使死亡人数减少了 80%。然而，最优封锁比实际实施的封锁更为严格。此外，社会计划者采取非对称策略，对年轻人的封锁相对多于老年人。我们强调检测在降低死亡、减少经济成本和允许实施限制较少的封锁方面的作用。相对于美国实际发生的情况，社会计划者会选择更快地提升检测能力。我们运用该框架为不同病毒（包括西班牙流感）引起的大流行病提供洞见，并强调经济状况对最优政策的影响。

abstract.text: We examine the welfare-based opportunity cost of foreign exchange (FX) intervention when both covered interest rate parity (CIP) and uncovered interest rate parity (UIP) deviations are present. We consider a small open economy that receives international capital flows through constrained international financial intermediaries. Deviations from CIP come from limited arbitrage or through a convenience yield, while UIP deviations are also affected by global risk. We show that the sign of CIP and UIP deviations may differ for safe haven countries. We find that FX reserves may provide a net benefit, rather than a cost, when international intermediaries value the safe-haven properties of a currency more than domestic households. We show that this has been the case for the Swiss franc and the Japanese Yen. We examine the optimal policy of a constrained central bank planner in this context.

10.1093/restud/rdag085.abstractZh: 我们考察在抵补利率平价（CIP）与未抵补利率平价（UIP）偏离同时存在时，外汇（FX）干预基于福利的机会成本。我们考虑一个通过受约束的国际金融中介获得国际资本流动的小型开放经济体。CIP 偏离来自有限套利或便利收益率，而 UIP 偏离还受到全球风险的影响。我们表明，对于避风港国家，CIP 与 UIP 偏离的符号可能不同。我们发现，当国际中介比国内家庭更看重某种货币的避风港属性时，外汇储备可能带来净收益而非成本。我们表明，瑞士法郎和日元的情况正是如此。我们考察了这一背景下受约束的中央银行计划者的最优政策。

abstract.text: We document that the source of funds for paying health insurance premiums has a dramatic impact on plan choices. We focus on the MediSave programme in Singapore, a medical savings account that is used to pay out-of-pocket medical spending. Residents can also pay their health insurance premiums with cash or MediSave funds, but are subject to limits that vary by age and over time. By exploiting variations in those limits, we consistently find that when individuals are able to pay their health insurance premiums with MediSave funds, they are less price sensitive and more willing to enrol in more generous plans. We develop and estimate a mental accounting model which explains these patterns. We embed and reject alternative explanations such as hassle costs and liquidity constraints. We then extend this model and show that mental accounting can explain much, but not all, of the misweighting of premiums relative to out-of-pocket expenses in health insurance choice. We also find that allowing MediSave payment for both premiums and out-of-pocket expenses (e.g. putting them in the same mental account) enhances individual welfare and reduces adverse selection.

10.1093/restud/rdag086.abstractZh: 我们记录了支付医疗保险保费的资金来源对计划选择产生的显著影响。我们聚焦于新加坡的MediSave计划，这是一个用于支付自付医疗支出的医疗储蓄账户。居民也可以用现金或MediSave资金支付医疗保险保费，但受到随年龄和时间变化的限额约束。通过利用这些限额的变动，我们一致地发现，当个人能够用MediSave资金支付医疗保险保费时，他们对价格不那么敏感，更愿意加入保障更慷慨的计划。我们构建并估计了一个心理账户模型来解释这些模式。我们嵌入并拒绝了诸如麻烦成本和流动性约束等替代解释。随后我们扩展该模型并表明，心理账户可以解释医疗保险选择中保费相对于自付费用被错误加权的大部分但并非全部现象。我们还发现，允许MediSave同时支付保费和自付费用（例如将它们放入同一心理账户）会提高个人福利并减少逆向选择。

abstract.text: We use population data on capital income and wealth holdings for Norway to measure asset positions and wealth returns before individuals marry and after the household is formed. These data allow us to establish a number of novel facts. First, individuals sort on personal wealth rather than parental wealth. Second, people match also on their personal returns to wealth, and assortative mating on returns is as strong as that on wealth. Third, post-marriage returns on family wealth reflect in equal part the pre-marriage returns of the two spouses. However, for households at the top of the wealth distribution at marriage, family wealth is largely managed by the spouse with the highest potential to grow it, providing a microfoundation for the scale dependence in wealth returns documented in several empirical papers. Fourth, marriage lowers the degree of wealth inequality as well as the heterogeneity in returns relative to the counterfactual case of no marriages. We use a simple framework to illustrate how the inequality-attenuating role of marriage is affected by assortative mating on wealth and returns and by wealth management task allocation between spouses.

10.1093/restud/rdag087.abstractZh: 我们使用挪威的资本收入和财富持有总体数据，衡量个人在结婚前以及家庭形成后的资产头寸和财富收益率。这些数据使我们能够确立若干新的事实。第一，个体按个人财富而非父母财富进行匹配。第二，人们也按个人财富收益率进行匹配，且按收益率进行的选型婚配强度与按财富进行的选型婚配强度相当。第三，婚后家庭财富的收益率同等程度地反映了夫妻双方婚前的收益率。然而，对于结婚时处于财富分布顶端的家庭，家庭财富主要由最有潜力使其增值的一方管理，这为若干实证论文所记录的财富收益率规模依赖性提供了微观基础。第四，与无婚姻的反事实情形相比，婚姻降低了财富不平等程度以及收益率的异质性。我们用一个简单框架来说明，婚姻的不平等削弱作用如何受到按财富和收益率的选型婚配以及夫妻间财富管理任务分配的影响。

abstract.text: This paper studies the unemployment of physical capital—defined as idle units searching to be traded—and its macroeconomic implications. I provide evidence documenting that capital unemployment is large, volatile, and increases during economic downturns. I construct a capital-accumulation model that explains these patterns, with trading frictions in capital markets, which give rise to equilibrium capital unemployment, and financial shocks, which lead to large fluctuations in trading probabilities and capital unemployment. Using the model, I show that trading frictions and capital unemployment matter for aggregate dynamics. First, unemployed capital affects aggregate investment dynamics: Downturns characterized by large increases in unemployed capital are followed by investment slumps, because the economy tends to recover by absorbing existing unemployed capital rather than by producing new capital goods. Second, capital unemployment constitutes a propagation mechanism from financial shocks to economic activity, which shows up at the aggregate level as measured total factor productivity.

10.1093/restud/rdag088.abstractZh: 本文研究物质资本的失业——定义为闲置单位寻找交易机会——及其宏观经济含义。我提供的证据表明，资本失业规模大、波动性强，并在经济下行期间上升。我构建了一个资本积累模型来解释这些模式，该模型包含资本市场中的交易摩擦——其导致均衡资本失业——以及金融冲击——其导致交易概率和资本失业的大幅波动。利用该模型，我表明交易摩擦和资本失业对总量动态具有重要影响。第一，失业资本影响总量投资动态：以失业资本大幅增加为特征的下行期之后会出现投资低迷，因为经济往往通过吸收现有失业资本而非生产新资本品来实现复苏。第二，资本失业构成了从金融冲击到经济活动的传导机制，这在总量层面上表现为测得的全要素生产率。

abstract.text: Consider a setting where N players, partitioned into K observable types, form a directed network. Agents’ preferences over the form of the network consist of an arbitrary network benefit function (e.g. agents may have preferences over their network centrality) and a private, or dyadic, component which is additively separable in own links. This latter component allows for unobserved heterogeneity in the costs of sending and receiving links across agents (respectively out- and in- degree heterogeneity) as well as homophily/heterophily across the K types of agents. In contrast, the network benefit function allows agents’ preferences over links to vary with the presence or absence of links elsewhere in the network (and hence with the link formation behavior of their peers). In the null model, which excludes the network benefit function, links form independently across dyads in the manner described by Charbonneau, 2017, Econometrics Journal, 20, S1–S13 among others. Under the alternative, there is interdependence across linking decisions (i.e. strategic interaction). We show how to test the null with power optimized in specific directions. These alternative directions include many common models of strategic network formation (e.g. “connections” models, “structural hole” models etc.). Our random utility specification induces an exponential family structure under the null which we exploit to construct a similar test which exactly controls size (despite the the null being a composite one with many nuisance parameters). We further show how to construct locally best tests for specific alternatives without making any assumptions about equilibrium selection. To make our tests feasible, we introduce a new MCMC algorithm for simulating the null distributions of our test statistics.

10.1093/restud/rdag089.abstractZh: 考虑一个由N个参与者组成的设定，这些参与者被划分为K个可观测类型，并形成一个有向网络。经济主体对网络形式的偏好由两部分构成：一是任意的网络收益函数（例如，经济主体可能对其网络中心性有偏好），二是私人成分或二元成分，后者在自身连接上具有可加可分性。后一成分允许发送和接收连接成本在主体之间存在不可观测的异质性（分别为出度和入度异质性），以及K个类型主体之间的同质性/异质性。相比之下，网络收益函数允许经济主体对连接的偏好随网络中其他位置连接的存在或缺失而变化（因而随其同伴的连接形成行为而变化）。在零模型中——该模型排除了网络收益函数——连接按照Charbonneau（2017, Econometrics Journal, 20, S1–S13）等人所描述的方式在各二元组之间独立形成。在备择模型下，连接决策之间存在相互依赖（即策略互动）。我们展示了如何在特定方向上以最优功效检验零模型。这些备择方向包括许多常见的策略网络形成模型（例如“连接”模型、“结构洞”模型等）。我们的随机效用设定在零模型下诱导出指数族结构，我们利用该结构构造一个相似检验，该检验能够精确控制检验水平（尽管零模型是一个包含许多冗余参数的复合零模型）。我们进一步展示了如何在不 equilibrium 选择做任何假设的情况下，为特定备择模型构造局部最优检验。为使检验可行，我们引入一种新的MCMC算法来模拟检验统计量的零分布。

abstract.text: A principal (such as a centrist political party) can partially influence the allocation of power between two competing parties. The principal is closer to one party, the “Friend”, than to the other, the “Enemy”. The principal’s optimal contract initially seeks to exclude the Enemy. However, once the Enemy gains power, the principal embraces him in exchange for policy moderation. Moderation also disciplines the Friend, inducing him to move closer to the principal’s preferred policy. Principals close to the Friend fully embrace the Enemy; more centrist principals divide their support. Commitment benefits the principal only if she is close to the Friend and parties value power little.

10.1093/restud/rdag090.abstractZh: 一个委托人（例如一个中间派政党）可以在两个相互竞争的政党之间部分影响权力的配置。该委托人与其中一个政党——“友方”——的关系比与另一个政党——“敌方”——更近。委托人的最优合约最初试图排除敌方。然而，一旦敌方获得权力，委托人便会接纳敌方，以换取政策温和化。温和化也会约束友方，促使其向委托人偏好的政策靠拢。与友方关系密切的委托人会完全接纳敌方；更偏中间派的委托人则会分散其支持。只有当委托人接近友方且政党对权力的重视程度较低时，承诺才会使委托人受益。

abstract.text: We study a parsimonious model of a competitive labour market in which firms privately screen workers to identify talent. The equilibrium exhibits dispersion in wages and productivity; when talent is scarce, firms with superior screening skills post higher wages, attract better applicants, and recruit more talented workers. High-wage firms impose a compositional externality on low-wage firms, leading to equilibrium inefficiency: Welfare would be higher if low-skilled firms posted high wages and selected first. We also provide a micro-foundation for firms' heterogeneous screening skills. When talented workers are better at screening (e.g. via superior referrals), a dynamic version of the economy converges to a unique steady state in which differences in talent, profits and screening skills persist forever.

10.1093/restud/rdag091.abstractZh: 我们研究一个竞争性劳动力市场的简约模型，其中企业私下筛选工人以识别人才。均衡表现出工资和生产率上的分散；当人才稀缺时，筛选能力更强的企业发布更高工资，吸引更好的申请者，并招募到更有才华的工人。高工资企业对低工资企业施加了构成性外部性，导致均衡无效率：如果低技能企业发布高工资并优先筛选，福利会更高。我们还为企业异质的筛选能力提供了微观基础。当有才华的工人更擅长筛选（例如通过更优质的推荐）时，该经济的动态版本会收敛到一个唯一稳态，其中人才、利润和筛选能力的差异永远持续。

abstract.text: Do workers from social groups with comparable productivity distributions obtain comparable lifetime earnings? We study how a small amount of early-career discrimination propagates over time when workers’ productivity is revealed through employment. In breakdown learning environments that primarily track on-the-job failures, such discrimination spirals into a substantial lifetime earnings gap for groups of comparable productivity, whereas in breakthrough learning environments that track successes, early-career discrimination can be self-corrected, so comparable groups obtain comparable lifetime earnings. This contrast persists in large labour markets and with flexible wages, inconclusive learning, and misspecified employer beliefs.

10.1093/restud/rdag092.abstractZh: 来自生产率分布可比的社会群体的劳动者，是否能够获得可比的终身收入？我们研究了当劳动者的生产率通过就业经历逐步显现时，职业生涯早期少量的歧视如何随时间推移而扩散。在主要追踪在职失败经历的“中断式”学习环境中，这种歧视会不断放大，使生产率可比的群体之间形成显著的终身收入差距；而在追踪成功经历的“突破式”学习环境中，职业生涯早期的歧视能够自我纠正，因而可比的群体能够获得可比的终身收入。这一对比在大型劳动力市场中依然成立，并且在工资灵活、学习结果不确定以及雇主信念错误设定的情形下也持续存在。

abstract.text: We show that the emergence of new economic opportunities that draw women away from their traditional domestic roles has significantly influenced the adoption of religious veiling. We measure the prevalence of veiling among young women across Indonesia’s districts for more than two decades by hand-coding around a quarter million photographs attached to Indonesia’s public high school registers. To establish causality, we exploit exogenous variation generated by international demand for Indonesia’s products, interacted with the gender and sectoral composition of local industries. Districts exposed to stronger positive economic shocks—and thus greater economic opportunities for women—exhibit higher rates of veiling adoption. Our findings suggest that veiling facilitates young women’s participation in formal labour markets while safeguarding their personal and social image in society.

10.1093/restud/rdag093.abstractZh: 我们表明，将女性从传统家庭角色中吸引出来的新经济机会的出现，显著影响了宗教面纱的采用。我们通过手工编码印度尼西亚公立高中登记册上附带的约25万张照片，衡量了印度尼西亚各地区年轻女性在二十多年间佩戴面纱的普遍程度。为确立因果关系，我们利用印度尼西亚产品国际需求所产生的外生变异，并将其与当地产业的性别和部门构成进行交互。受到更强正向经济冲击——因而女性拥有更大经济机会——的地区，面纱采用率更高。我们的发现表明，面纱有助于年轻女性参与正规劳动力市场，同时维护其在社会中的个人形象和社会形象。

abstract.text: We experimentally study decentralized one-to-one matching markets with transfers. We vary the information available to participants, complete or incomplete, and the surplus structure, supermodular or submodular. Several insights emerge. First, while markets often culminate in efficient matchings, stability is more elusive, reflecting the difficulty of arranging attendant transfers. Second, incomplete information and submodularity present hurdles to efficiency and especially stability; their combination drastically diminishes stability’s likelihood. Third, matchings form “from the top down” in complete-information supermodular markets, but exhibit many more and less-obviously ordered offers otherwise. Last, participants’ market positions matter far more than their dynamic bargaining styles for outcomes.

10.1093/restud/rdag094.abstractZh: 我们通过实验研究带有转移支付的分散式一对一匹配市场。我们改变参与者可获得的信息（完全信息或不完全信息）以及剩余结构（超模或次模）。由此得到若干发现。第一，尽管市场往往最终实现有效匹配，但稳定性更难实现，这反映出安排相应转移支付的困难。第二，不完全信息和次模性对效率、尤其是稳定性构成障碍；二者结合会大幅降低稳定性出现的可能性。第三，在完全信息超模市场中，匹配“自上而下”形成；而在其他情形下，报价数量更多，且顺序不那么明显。最后，参与者的市场位置对结果的影响远大于其动态议价风格。

abstract.text: We study opinion dynamics in a social network consisting of two groups. Agents update their opinions by conforming to members of their own group while rejecting the views of the opposing group (affective polarization), and by listening to a media outlet that may provide biased information. We characterize the long-run opinions and identify when affective polarization and media bias lead to ideological polarization, persistent disagreement, or failures of learning. We also derive when information interventions or censorship improve the accuracy of average opinions and reduce disagreement, and when they backfire: better information helps only under specific media bias configurations and when directed to the agents we identify as most effective at propagating it through the network.

10.1093/restud/rdag095.abstractZh: 我们研究一个由两个群体构成的社交网络中的意见动态。经济主体通过顺从本群体成员、同时排斥对立群体的观点（情感极化）来更新自己的意见，并倾听可能提供有偏信息的媒体渠道。我们刻画长期意见，并识别情感极化与媒体偏差在何种条件下导致意识形态极化、持续分歧或学习失败。我们还推导出信息干预或审查在何种条件下提高平均意见的准确性并减少分歧，以及在何种条件下产生反效果：更好的信息仅在特定的媒体偏差配置下、且在被我们识别为最能在网络中传播该信息的那些经济主体中才有所帮助。

abstract.text: Using Danish registry data, we study how managers’ gender attitudes shape gender inequality in the workplace by exploiting the birth of a daughter—as opposed to a son—as a plausibly exogenous shock to male managers’ gender attitudes. Comparing within-firm changes in women’s labour outcomes depending on the gender of the manager’s newborn child, we find that women’s relative earnings and employment increase by 4.4% and 2.9%, respectively, following the birth of the manager’s first daughter. These effects are driven by an increase in managers’ propensity to substitute male hires with female hires that have comparable education, hours worked, and earnings. Consistent with this substitution channel, we do not detect any significant effect on firm performance. Because these effects emerge rapidly and persist over time, we can rule out the need for prolonged exposure to gender issues or for personal incentives tied to improving conditions for their own daughters as prerequisites for managers to promote gender equality within their firms.

10.1093/restud/rdag096.abstractZh: 利用丹麦的注册数据，我们研究了管理者的性别态度如何影响职场中的性别不平等问题。我们通过将女儿的出生视为一个可能的外生冲击因素，来探讨这一现象。通过比较不同公司中女性劳动成果的变化情况，我们发现，在管理者生下第一个女儿之后，女性的相对收入和就业率分别增加了4.4%和2.9%。这些效应主要是由于管理者更倾向于用具有相似教育背景、工作时间和收入水平的女性来替代男性员工所导致的。与这一替代机制一致的是，我们没有发现对公司绩效有任何显著影响。由于这些效应出现得很快并且持续存在，我们可以排除需要长时间关注性别问题或需要个人激励来促使管理者改善自己女儿的处境作为前提条件，才能推动公司内部的性别平等。

abstract.text: This paper studies how municipal governments jointly manage spending, credit market borrowing, and a public employee pension system. I model governments as levered investors who must meet non-defaultable pension obligations and may value government spending more than citizens. I quantify the model using data on California cities, including a new record of fiscal emergencies, tax increases required to maintain essential city services. After the financial crisis depleted pension funds, cities engaged in excessive risk-taking: the fiscal emergency option encouraged gambling for resurrection that kept cities vulnerable to shocks well into the recovery. To correct this problem, a savings requirement works better than a restriction on risk-taking or a pension funding requirement. The policy experiments emphasize that effective policies need to target the combined pension and bond finances, as policies that only target one, such as a pension funding requirement, are undermined by endogenous changes to the other.

10.1093/restud/rdag097.abstractZh: 本文研究市政府如何统筹管理支出、信贷市场借款和公共雇员养老金体系。我将政府建模为杠杆投资者，其必须履行不可违约的养老金义务，并且可能比公民更看重政府支出。我利用加利福尼亚州城市的数据对模型进行量化，其中包括一份关于财政紧急状态的新记录，即为维持城市基本服务所需的增税。金融危机耗尽养老基金后，城市进行了过度风险承担：财政紧急状态选项鼓励了“赌一把以求翻身”的行为，使城市在复苏很久之后仍易受冲击。为纠正这一问题，储蓄要求比限制风险承担或养老金注资要求更有效。政策实验强调，有效的政策需要同时针对养老金和债券融资的组合，因为只针对其中一项的政策（如养老金注资要求）会被另一项的内生变化所削弱。

abstract.text: In this paper, I document systematic heterogeneity in ownership and financing of firms across Eurozone countries. To rationalize these differences, I build a quantitative general equilibrium model of workers and entrepreneurs who choose debt and equity financing of their firms, subject to rich country-specific financial frictions. The novel data on firm ownership and financing, combined with the structure of the model, allows me to quantify the level of debt and equity frictions in each country. Quantitatively, I find much larger output effects from equity frictions: harmonizing them across countries would lead to nearly four times larger output effects compared to debt frictions, and removing them would increase aggregate output by 73% more. The larger impact on output is due not only to the estimated levels and dispersion of equity frictions but also to the greater risk sharing provided by equity, which further incentivizes entrepreneurs to expand their firms. Through their effect on risk sharing, equity frictions also rationalize the observed negative relationship between equity financing and wealth inequality. Quantitatively, they are responsible for over 70% of the explained variation in top wealth shares across countries.

10.1093/restud/rdag098.abstractZh: 本文记录了欧元区各国在企业所有权和融资方面存在的系统性异质性。为解释这些差异，我构建了一个包含劳动者和企业家的量化一般均衡模型，经济主体在丰富的国别金融摩擦约束下为企业选择债务融资和股权融资。关于企业所有权和融资的新颖数据，结合模型结构，使我能够量化每个国家的债务摩擦和股权摩擦水平。在量化层面，我发现股权摩擦带来的产出效应要大得多：在各国之间统一股权摩擦所带来的产出效应，几乎是统一债务摩擦的近四倍；而消除股权摩擦使总产出增加的幅度，比消除债务摩擦高出 73%。股权摩擦对产出更大的影响，不仅源于估计出的股权摩擦水平和离散程度，还源于股权所提供的更大风险分担，这进一步激励企业家扩张企业。通过其对风险分担的影响，股权摩擦也解释了所观察到的股权融资与财富不平等之间的负向关系。在量化层面，在各国顶层财富份额的可解释变异中，股权摩擦贡献了超过 70%。

abstract.text: Market definition is challenging in settings with network effects, where substitution patterns depend on changes in network size. We study these effects in the context of social media. We conduct an incentivized experiment comparing substitution in response to a proposed U.S. TikTok ban, in which all users simultaneously leave the app, with substitution when only a single user deactivates. We find substantially higher valuations of alternative social apps under a collective TikTok ban than under an individual TikTok deactivation. Mechanism evidence shows that both anticipated content-supply shifts and social coordination partly explain the wedge, with the relative importance of each channel varying across platforms. We then show that a collective time limit challenge, where peers jointly reduce TikTok and Instagram use, leads to more time spent on alternative social apps than has been observed in prior individual deactivation experiments. Together, our results suggest that individual-level substitution estimates can be an unreliable guide to market definition for network goods.

10.1093/restud/rdag099.abstractZh: 在网络效应存在的环境中，市场界定颇具挑战性，因为替代模式取决于网络规模的变化。我们在社交媒体情境下研究这些效应。我们开展了一项激励实验，比较在拟议的美国 TikTok 禁令下所有用户同时退出该应用时的替代行为，与仅有单个用户停用时的替代行为。我们发现，在集体 TikTok 禁令下，用户对替代社交应用的估值显著高于单个用户停用 TikTok 时的估值。机制证据表明，预期内容供给变化与社会协调部分解释了这一差异，且各渠道的相对重要性因平台而异。随后我们表明，在同伴共同减少 TikTok 和 Instagram 使用的集体时间限制挑战下，用户在替代社交应用上花费的时间多于此前单个停用实验中所观察到的情况。综合来看，我们的结果表明，个体层面的替代估计可能无法可靠地指导网络产品的市场界定。

abstract.text: Do higher aspirations for the future motivate people living in poverty to make long-term investments? Do their aspirations increase when economic conditions improve? To answer these questions, we run a 415-village field experiment with 8,300 women living in poverty in rural Kenya. We design an 80-minute workshop to help people set higher aspirations and plan to achieve them. We cross-randomise this with large unconditional cash transfers. The workshop substantially raises aspirations, labour supply, investment, revenue, and living standards 17 months later, relative to a placebo workshop. Increases in aspirations are the most likely mechanism to explain the economic effects. Cash transfers also raise aspirations, which might help to explain why transfers increase labour supply and investment. We conclude that aspirations respond to both economic and psychological interventions, contribute to investment decisions and living standards, and are important considerations for development policy.

10.1093/restud/rdag100.abstractZh: 对于未来的更高期望是否能够激励生活在贫困中的人们进行长期投资？当经济状况改善时，他们的期望是否会增加？为了回答这些问题，我们在肯尼亚农村开展了一项涉及415个村庄、8,300名贫困女性的实地实验。我们设计了一个80分钟的工作坊，帮助人们设定更高的期望并规划实现这些期望的路径。我们将这一工作坊与大规模的无条件现金转移措施进行交叉随机化实验。17个月后，与安慰剂工作坊相比，该工作坊显著提升了人们的期望、劳动力供应、投资、收入和生活水平。期望的上升很可能是解释这些经济效应的主要机制。现金转移同样能够提升人们的期望，这可能有助于解释为什么现金转移能够增加劳动力供应和投资。我们得出结论，期望对经济和心理干预都有响应，有助于投资决策和生活水平的提高，是发展政策中的重要考量因素。

abstract.text: We study how supply disruptions interact with monopoly pricing, inventory management, and consumer stockpiling in a continuous-time model. Pre-emption incentives—consumers prefer to stock up before a price hike while the firm prefers to hike before consumers stock up—lead to an equilibrium with gradual stockpiling and endogenous uncertainty over the timing of a price hike, which can trigger a run at the disruption onset. Consumer storage introduces welfare losses from randomized pricing, but can also strengthen the firm’s incentive to hold buffer stock. Rationing, price controls, and reserve mandates can each improve welfare, but only strategic government reserves can implement the social optimum.

10.1093/restud/rdag101.abstractZh: 我们研究在连续时间模型中，供给中断如何与垄断定价、库存管理和消费者囤积相互作用。先占激励——消费者倾向于在涨价前囤货，而企业倾向于在消费者囤货前涨价——导致均衡中出现逐步囤积以及对涨价时点的内生不确定性，这种不确定性可能在供给中断开始时引发抢购。消费者储存会因随机定价带来福利损失，但也能增强企业持有缓冲库存的激励。配给、价格管制和储备要求各自都能改善福利，但只有战略性政府储备才能实现社会最优。

abstract.text: We study how firms set wages for their employees when they can legally age-discriminate across workers. We exploit an age-specific minimum wage change in the UK, which raised the minimum applying to workers aged 25 and over, leaving unchanged the minima for younger workers. Using matched employer-employee data on a low-paying sector, we show large, positive wage spillovers on workers aged under 25, which arise within firms from company wage policy. Pay equity norms offer the most parsimonious explanation for the emergence of spillovers. The effects that we document also operate in other low-paying sectors of the UK labour market.

10.1093/restud/rdag102.abstractZh: 我们研究在企业可以合法地对不同年龄劳动者实施年龄歧视的情况下，企业如何为其员工设定工资。我们利用英国一项针对特定年龄的最低工资变动：该变动提高了适用于25岁及以上劳动者的最低工资，而未改变较年轻劳动者的最低工资。使用一个低工资部门的雇主—雇员匹配数据，我们表明，25岁以下劳动者获得了大幅且正向的工资溢出，这些溢出在企业内部源于公司工资政策。薪酬公平规范为溢出的出现提供了最简约的解释。我们所记录的效果同样存在于英国劳动力市场的其他低工资部门。

abstract.text: We use a sufficient statistic approach to quantify the general equilibrium effects of population ageing on the returns to wealth, wealth accumulation, and global imbalances. Combining population forecasts with household survey data from twenty-five countries, we measure the compositional effect of ageing: how a changing age distribution affects wealth-to-GDP, holding the age profiles of wealth and labour income fixed. In a baseline overlapping generations model this statistic, in conjunction with cross-sectional information and two standard macro parameters, pins down general equilibrium outcomes. Since the compositional effect is positive, large, and heterogeneous across countries, our model predicts that population ageing will lower returns to wealth, increase wealth-to-GDP ratios, and widen global imbalances through the twenty-first century. These conclusions extend to a richer model in which bequests, individual savings, and the tax-and-transfer system all respond to demographic change.

10.1093/restud/rdag103.abstractZh: 我们使用充分统计量方法量化人口老龄化对财富收益率、财富积累和全球失衡的一般均衡效应。我们将人口预测与来自25个国家的家庭调查数据相结合，测度老龄化的构成效应：在财富和劳动收入的年龄剖面保持固定的情况下，年龄分布的变化如何影响财富与GDP之比。在基准世代交叠模型中，该统计量结合横截面信息和两个标准宏观参数，即可确定一般均衡结果。由于构成效应为正、规模较大且在不同国家之间存在异质性，我们的模型预测，在整个21世纪，人口老龄化将降低财富收益率、提高财富与GDP之比，并扩大全球失衡。这些结论可扩展至一个更丰富的模型，其中遗产、个人储蓄以及税收和转移支付体系均对人口结构变化作出反应。

abstract.text: Standard New Keynesian (NK) models feature an optimal inflation target well below 2%, limited welfare losses from business cycle fluctuations and long-term monetary neutrality. We develop an NK framework with endogenous productivity and downward nominal wage rigidity (DNWR) which challenges these results. The interaction between endogenous growth and DNWR generates asymmetric hysteresis effects on unemployment and R&D. As a consequence, the model features a nonvertical long-run Phillips curve and a trade-off between price distortions and output hysteresis that changes the welfare-maximizing inflation rate to above 2%. Deviations from the optimal target carry welfare costs multiple times those in traditional NK models. Taylor rules that respond to the unemployment rate address more effectively the asymmetric hysteresis in our model. Results are robust to the inclusion of the effective lower bound on interest rates.

10.1093/restud/rdag104.abstractZh: 标准新凯恩斯主义（NK）模型的特征是，最优通胀目标远低于2%，经济周期波动带来的福利损失有限，且长期货币中性。我们构建了一个包含内生生产率和向下名义工资刚性（DNWR）的NK框架，该框架对这些结果提出了挑战。内生增长与DNWR之间的相互作用对失业和R&D产生非对称的滞后效应。因此，该模型具有非垂直的长期菲利普斯曲线，以及价格扭曲与产出滞后之间的权衡，这将福利最大化通胀率改变为高于2%。偏离最优目标所带来的福利成本是传统NK模型中的数倍。对失业率作出反应的泰勒规则能更有效地应对我们模型中的非对称滞后。结果在纳入利率有效下限时仍然稳健。

abstract.text: We present a flexible and scalable computational framework integrating machine learning and optimization theory to solve dynamic adverse selection models with persistent private information and many types. Our approach reformulates the model into a numerically tractable structure that bypasses set-valued dynamic programming; we formally prove that, under verifiable conditions, this relaxation yields the solution to the original problem. The recast problem is solved via a parallelized value function iteration algorithm, where high-dimensional, nonlinear functions are approximated using Gaussian process regression combined with Bayesian active learning. We apply our framework to two previously intractable models: one with persistent hidden information involving up to ten types and another incorporating multiple persistent types and overreporting. Validation against known solutions and rigorous credibility measures confirms accuracy. Allowing overreporting significantly alters long-run contract outcomes, concentrating consumption away from extremes and smoothing utility promises over time.

10.1093/restud/rdag105.abstractZh: 我们提出一个灵活且可扩展的计算框架，将机器学习与优化理论相结合，用于求解具有持续性私人信息和多种类型的动态逆向选择模型。我们的方法将模型重新表述为一个数值上易处理的结构，从而绕开集值动态规划；我们正式证明，在可验证的条件下，这一松弛可得到原问题的解。重新表述后的问题通过并行化值函数迭代算法求解，其中高维非线性函数采用高斯过程回归结合贝叶斯主动学习进行近似。我们将该框架应用于两个此前难以处理的模型：一个涉及最多十种类型的持续性隐藏信息模型，另一个则包含多种持续性类型和过度报告。与已知解的对比验证以及严格的可信度度量均确认了准确性。允许过度报告会显著改变长期合同结果，使消费从极端值向中间集中，并在时间上平滑效用承诺。

abstract.text: Even as global oil demand has increased in recent years, it is plausible to envision scenarios in which clean energy technologies or climate policies drive demand to essentially zero by the century’s end. This article asks what such a demand decline, when anticipated, might mean for global oil supply. One possibility is a “green paradox”: producers accelerate extraction. However, because extraction requires durable capital investments, the opposite may occur: producers reduce their investment rate, decreasing extraction. To evaluate the relative strengths of these opposing mechanisms, I develop a model of global oil supply that incorporates both, among other industry features. For model inputs with the strongest empirical support, both effects are modest, with disinvestment typically outweighing the green paradox. In order for the green paradox to substantially increase cumulative global oil extraction, investments must have short time horizons, and producers’ discount rates must be less than 4% real.

10.1093/restud/rdag106.abstractZh: 尽管近年来全球石油需求有所上升，但可以设想这样的情景：到本世纪末，清洁能源技术或气候政策将使需求基本降至零。本文探讨这种可被预期的需求下降对全球石油供给可能意味着什么。一种可能是“绿色悖论”：生产商加速开采。然而，由于开采需要耐久的资本投资，也可能出现相反情形：生产商降低投资率，从而减少开采。为评估这两种相反机制的相对强度，我构建了一个纳入二者及其他行业特征的全球石油供给模型。对于实证支持最强的模型输入，两种效应均较为温和，撤资通常超过绿色悖论。要使绿色悖论显著提高全球石油累计开采量，投资期限必须较短，且生产商的实际贴现率必须低于4%。

abstract.text: The structure of the Social Security program presents a trade-off between benefit duration and size; individuals who claim early receive lower monthly payments. Surprisingly, even wealthy Americans with high life expectancies frequently claim benefits at the earliest eligibility age, a behavior inconsistent with conventional life-cycle theory predictions. In fact, there is a striking similarity in claiming ages across groups with vastly different life expectancies, wealth levels, and incentives to delay. This paper resolves this puzzle by introducing policy details and subjective beliefs about longevity and program rules into a rich, forward-looking life-cycle model. When included in the model, subjective beliefs substantially narrow the claiming-age gaps across education (college vs. non-college) and marital-status (married vs. single) groups. Specifically, differences in program beliefs alone account for 48.6% of the education claiming age gap and 75.1% of the marital status gap. Counterfactual policy simulations demonstrate that failing to account for these claiming mechanisms dramatically overstates individual responses to an increase in the normal retirement age and understates the resulting fiscal savings.

10.1093/restud/rdag107.abstractZh: 社会保障项目的结构呈现出待遇持续时间与待遇规模之间的权衡；提前申领者每月领取的金额更低。令人意外的是，即便是预期寿命较长的富裕美国人，也常常在最早具备资格的年龄申领待遇，这一行为与传统生命周期理论的预测不一致。事实上，在预期寿命、财富水平和延迟申领激励差异巨大的各群体之间，申领年龄却呈现出惊人的相似性。本文通过将政策细节以及对寿命和项目规则的主观信念引入一个丰富的、前瞻性的生命周期模型，解开了这一谜题。将这些主观信念纳入模型后，不同教育群体（大学与非大学）以及不同婚姻状况群体（已婚与单身）之间的申领年龄差距大幅收窄。具体而言，仅项目信念差异一项就解释了教育群体申领年龄差距的 48.6% 和婚姻状况差距的 75.1%。反事实政策模拟表明，若不考虑这些申领机制，会大幅高估个人对正常退休年龄提高的反应，并低估由此带来的财政节省。

abstract.text: Over the past four decades, the U.S. economy has seen a decline in the share of young firms alongside a rise in the profit share of GDP. This paper explores how population aging contributes to these twin trends through a demand-side channel. The core hypothesis is that younger households exhibit lower consumer inertia—a tendency to stick with previously chosen products—than older households. As demand shifts toward more inertial consumers, entry becomes harder, incumbents raise markups, and market share tilts toward larger firms. To quantify this mechanism, I develop and calibrate a firm dynamics model with overlapping generations of consumers who differ in their degree of inertia. Using detailed micro data, I show that younger households are significantly less inertial. The model implies that population aging accounts for 20%–30% of the observed decline in young firms and rise in profits. Reduced-form evidence across U.S. states and product categories supports the model’s predictions.

10.1093/restud/rdag108.abstractZh: 过去四十年间，美国经济中年轻企业所占份额下降，同时利润占GDP的比重上升。本文探讨人口老龄化如何通过需求侧渠道促成这两大趋势。核心假设是，年轻家庭比年长家庭表现出更低的消费者惯性——即坚持此前所选产品的倾向。随着需求转向惯性更强的消费者，进入变得更加困难，现有企业提高加成，市场份额向更大企业倾斜。为量化这一机制，我构建并校准了一个企业动态模型，其中包含惯性程度不同的消费者世代交叠结构。利用详细的微观数据，我表明年轻家庭的惯性显著更低。模型意味着，人口老龄化可解释所观察到的年轻企业份额下降和利润上升的20%–30%。来自美国各州和产品类别的简约式证据支持模型的预测。

abstract.text: We compare and combine two distinct approaches to estimating market power in the U.S. brewing industry—one based on production data, the other on demand. Both methods produce similar estimates of average markups and reveal a recent upward trend. We then combine the two approaches in two ways. First, we replace conventional instruments in demand estimation with a moment involving a production-based markup estimate, yielding similar results. We then evaluate the common (but controversial) assumption that retail markets operate competitively, finding that demand-based markups recovered with the assumption of competitive retail markets align with production-based estimates, as long as downstream costs are accounted for.

10.1093/restud/rdag109.abstractZh: 我们比较并结合了两种估计美国酿酒业市场势力的不同方法——一种基于生产数据，另一种基于需求。两种方法给出的平均加成率估计相近，并都显示近期呈上升趋势。随后我们以两种方式结合这两种方法。首先，我们在需求估计中用涉及基于生产的加成率估计的矩条件替代传统工具变量，得到了相似的结果。接着，我们评估了零售市场以竞争性方式运行这一常见（但有争议的）假设，发现只要将下游成本纳入考虑，在竞争性零售市场假设下得到的需求侧加成率估计与基于生产的估计相一致。

abstract.text: To study competition, innovation, and industry dynamics that arise as a result of their interaction, we develop a new oligopolistic general-equilibrium Schumpeterian growth model. This model ties together the endogenous growth, oligopolistic competition, and dynamic industrial organization literatures in a single unified framework. Within each industry, there are an endogenously determined number of large firms (“superstars”) that compete à la Cournot and a continuum of small firms which collectively constitute a competitive fringe. Firms dynamically choose their innovation strategies, cognizant of other firms’ choices, and their entry and exit are endogenous. The model is consistent with the macroeconomic trends observed in the US since the 1970s, such as the domination of industries by a small number of superstar firms, the rise of markups, market concentration, profits, and R&D spending, and the decline in business dynamism, productivity growth, and the labour share. It replicates the empirical relationship between innovation and competition within and across industries. As an application, we estimate the model to disentangle the effects of separate mechanisms on the structural transition observed in the US, which yields striking results: (1) While the increase in the average markup causes a significant static welfare loss, this loss is overshadowed by the dynamic welfare gains from increased innovation in response to higher profit opportunities. (2) The increasing costs of innovation are found to be the primary determinant of lacklustre productivity growth, i.e. ideas are getting harder to find.

10.1093/restud/rdag110.abstractZh: 为研究竞争、创新及其相互作用所引致的产业动态，我们构建了一个新的寡头垄断一般均衡熊彼特增长模型。该模型将内生增长、寡头竞争与动态产业组织文献整合于单一统一框架之中。在每个产业内，存在内生决定数量的大型企业（“超级明星企业”）按古诺方式竞争，以及由小企业连续统构成的竞争性边缘。企业在考虑其他企业选择的基础上动态选择创新策略，其进入与退出均为内生。该模型与美国自20世纪70年代以来观察到的宏观趋势相一致，包括少数超级明星企业对产业的支配、加成率、市场集中度、利润与R&D支出的上升，以及企业动态、生产率增长与劳动份额的下降。它复现了产业内与产业间创新与竞争之间的经验关系。作为应用，我们估计该模型以分解不同机制对美国所观察到的结构转型的影响，得到了引人注目的结果：（1）尽管平均加成率的上升造成了显著的静态福利损失，但这一损失被因利润机会增加而引致的创新增加所带来的动态福利收益所掩盖。（2）创新成本的上升被发现是生产率增长乏力的主要决定因素，即思想正变得越来越难以发现。

abstract.text: When financial constraints bind, firms adjust employment in response to cash flow shocks. A 2010 revaluation of business rates, a U.K. tax levied on business-occupied properties, implied that similar firms, occupying similar properties in narrow geographical locations, experienced different tax changes. I find that, on average, for every £1 of additional cash flow triggered by the tax change, thirty-nine pence were spent on employment, with small and leveraged firms responding the most. I use these findings to discipline a general-equilibrium model with firm heterogeneity and financial frictions and quantitatively determine the aggregate effects of a fiscal transfer to firms.

10.1093/restud/rdag111.abstractZh: 当金融约束具有约束力时，企业会针对现金流冲击调整就业。2010年英国对营业房产税（对营业占用房产征收的一种税）的重新估值意味着，在狭窄地理区域内占用相似房产的相似企业经历了不同的税收变化。我发现，平均而言，税收变化所引发的每1英镑额外现金流中，有39便士用于就业支出，其中小型企业和杠杆化程度较高的企业反应最大。我利用这些发现来校准一个包含企业异质性和金融摩擦的一般均衡模型，并定量确定向企业进行财政转移支付的总量效应。

abstract.text: We study how online job search advice affects job search behavior and labor market outcomes of unemployed workers. In a large-scale field experiment embedded in the online platform of the Danish public employment service, we provide job seekers with vacancy information and occupational recommendations. Using a two-stage randomized design with regionally varying treatment intensities, we examine both direct effects of advice and treatment spillovers. We find that advice significantly increases employment and earnings when provided to a limited share of job seekers. As treatment intensity rises, these effects diminish and eventually disappear. The decline is driven by negative spillovers among treated job seekers, consistent with increased congestion in the occupations toward which job seekers redirect their search. Spillover effects on untreated job seekers are heterogeneous and depend on how advice alters occupation-specific competition in local labor markets.

10.1093/restud/rdag112.abstractZh: 我们研究在线求职建议如何影响失业劳动者的求职行为和劳动力市场结果。在一项嵌入丹麦公共就业服务在线平台的大规模田野实验中，我们向求职者提供空缺职位信息和职业建议。采用处理强度随地区变化的两阶段随机设计，我们考察建议的直接效应和处理溢出效应。我们发现，当建议仅提供给有限比例的求职者时，建议显著提高了就业和收入。随着处理强度上升，这些效应减弱并最终消失。这一下降由受处理求职者之间的负向溢出效应驱动，这与求职者将搜索转向的职业中拥挤程度上升相一致。对未受处理求职者的溢出效应具有异质性，取决于建议如何改变当地劳动力市场中特定职业的竞争状况。

abstract.text: Quality regulation seeks to ensure quality and foster competition by reducing vertical differentiation, but it may also have adverse effects on market structure. We study this trade-off in the context of pharmaceutical bioequivalence, which is the primary quality standard for generic drugs. By exploiting the introduction of bioequivalence in Chile, we find that stronger regulation reduced the number of drugs in the market by 18% and increased average paid prices by 13%. We estimate a model of drug entry, certification, and demand to study how drug quality, aversion to generics, and certification costs shape the equilibrium effects of quality regulation. We find that quality regulation increased demand for generic drugs by resolving asymmetric information and reducing aversion to unbranded generics, which induced the entry of high-quality drugs in place of low-quality drugs. Consumer welfare increased despite higher prices and a lower number of firms. We compare minimum quality standards with alternative designs of quality regulation, including quality disclosure.

10.1093/restud/rdag113.abstractZh: 质量监管旨在通过减少纵向差异化来确保质量并促进竞争，但也可能对市场结构产生不利影响。我们以药品生物等效性为背景研究这一权衡，生物等效性是仿制药的主要质量标准。利用智利引入生物等效性规定的契机，我们发现更严格的监管使市场中的药品数量减少了18%，并使平均实付价格上升了13%。我们估计了一个包含药品进入、认证和需求的模型，以研究药品质量、对仿制药的厌恶以及认证成本如何塑造质量监管的均衡效应。我们发现，质量监管通过缓解信息不对称和降低对无品牌仿制药的厌恶增加了对仿制药的需求，进而引致高质量药品进入并替代低质量药品。尽管价格上升且企业数量减少，消费者福利仍有所提高。我们将最低质量标准与质量监管的其他设计（包括质量披露）进行了比较。

abstract.text: The advent of large language models (LLMs) creates new opportunities to conduct qualitative interviews at scale, with thousands of respondents, thereby bridging qualitative and quantitative methods. We develop a simple, versatile approach for researchers to run AI-led qualitative interviews, including voice interviews. We assess its robustness by drawing comparisons to human experts and with several respondents-based quality metrics. The versatility of the approach is illustrated through four broad classes of applications: eliciting key factors in decision making, political views, subjective mental states, and mental models of the effects of public policies. High performance ratings are obtained in all of these domains. Our applications highlight the potential of AI-led interviews as a tool for measurement, hypothesis generation, and discovering mechanisms.

10.1093/restud/rdag114.abstractZh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）的出现为大规模开展定性访谈创造了新机会，可覆盖数以千计的受访者，从而弥合定性方法与定量方法。我们为研究者开发了一种简洁且通用的方法，用于开展由人工智能主导的定性访谈，包括语音访谈。我们通过与人类专家进行比较，并采用若干基于受访者的质量指标，评估该方法的稳健性。该方法的多用途性通过四大类应用得到展示：引出决策中的关键因素、政治观点、主观心理状态，以及关于公共政策效果的心智模型。在所有这些领域均获得了较高的性能评分。我们的应用凸显了人工智能主导的访谈作为测量、假设生成和发现机制工具的潜力。

abstract.text: In this paper I revisit the interpretation of the linear instrumental variables (IV) estimand as a weighted average of conditional local average treatment effects (LATEs). I focus on a situation in which additional covariates are required for identification while the reduced-form and first-stage regressions may be misspecified due to an implicit homogeneity restriction on the effects of the instrument. I show that the weights on some conditional LATEs are negative and the IV estimand is no longer interpretable as a causal effect under a weaker version of monotonicity, i.e. when there are compliers but no defiers at some covariate values and defiers but no compliers elsewhere. The problem of negative weights disappears in the interacted specification of Angrist and Imbens (I1995), which avoids misspecification and seems to be underused in applied work. I illustrate my findings in an application to the causal effects of pretrial detention on case outcomes. In this setting, I reject the stronger version of monotonicity, demonstrate that the interacted instruments are sufficiently strong for consistent estimation using the jackknife methodology, and present several estimates that are economically and statistically different, depending on whether the interacted instruments are used.

10.1093/restud/rdag116.abstractZh: 本文重新审视将线性工具变量（IV）估计量解释为条件局部平均处理效应（LATE）加权平均的做法。我关注的情形是：识别需要额外的协变量，而简化式与第一阶段回归可能因对工具变量效应施加了隐含的同质性限制而出现错误设定。我表明，在此情形下部分条件 LATE 的权重为负，且在较弱版本的单调性下——即某些协变量取值处存在依从者但无违抗者、而另一些取值处存在违抗者但无依从者——IV 估计量不再可解释为因果效应。负权重问题在 Angrist 和 Imbens（1995）的交互设定中消失，该设定避免了错误设定，但在应用研究中似乎使用不足。我以审前羁押对案件结果的因果效应为应用场景来说明上述发现。在该设定中，我拒绝了较强版本的单调性，证明交互工具变量在使用 jackknife 方法进行一致估计时足够强，并给出了若干在经济和统计上存在差异的估计结果，其差异取决于是否使用交互工具变量。

abstract.text: Decisions are typically made by drawing on multiple sources of information, yet the correlation among these sources is often hard to assess. We study robustly optimal strategies—those that maximize the worst-case payoff guarantee across all correlation structures. With two states and two actions, the robustly optimal strategy is strikingly simple: use only the best information source and ignore the rest. With more actions, a robustly optimal strategy decomposes the problem into local comparisons and assigns each comparison to the source that is best at that comparison. With more states, the same specialization logic survives through a concavification characterization: the decision problem is decomposed into payoff-relevant components, and each component is assigned to its best source. These results offer a new rationale for why ignoring information can be optimal and highlight the benefit of using specialized information sources when correlations are ambiguous.

10.1093/restud/rdag117.abstractZh: 决策通常依赖多个信息来源，但这些来源之间的相关性往往难以评估。我们研究稳健最优策略，即在所有相关结构下最大化最坏情形收益保证的策略。在两状态、两行动的情形下，稳健最优策略极为简单：只使用最佳信息来源，忽略其余来源。在行动更多时，稳健最优策略将问题分解为局部比较，并将每一项比较分配给在该比较上表现最佳的信息来源。在状态更多时，同样的专业化逻辑通过凹化刻画得以保留：决策问题被分解为与收益相关的组成部分，每个组成部分被分配给其最佳信息来源。这些结果为为何忽略信息可能是最优的提供了新的解释，并凸显了在相关性模糊时使用专业化信息来源的益处。

abstract.text: Economists and historians have long debated how open-access areas, frontier regions, and customary landholding regimes transformed into private property. This paper analyzes decentralized enclosure processes using the theory of aggregative games, examining how population density, enclosure costs, potential productivity gains, and local governance capacity, including the power to demand compensation, jointly determine the mix of property regimes. Depending on these fundamentals, private decisions to enclose may be strategic complements or substitutes. Strategic complements generate tipping points and socially destructive property races, whereas strategic substitutes produce smoother transitions and may leave enclosure below the social optimum. While policies to strengthen customary governance or compensate displaced stakeholders can realign incentives, addressing one distortion while neglecting others can worsen welfare.

10.1093/restud/rdag118.abstractZh: 经济学家和历史学家长期争论开放进入区域、边疆地区和习惯土地持有制度如何转变为私有产权。本文运用聚合博弈理论分析分散化圈地过程，考察人口密度、圈地成本、潜在生产率收益以及地方治理能力（包括要求补偿的权力）如何共同决定产权制度的组合。取决于这些基本因素，私人圈地决策可能是策略互补或策略替代。策略互补会产生临界点和社会破坏性的产权竞赛，而策略替代会产生更平滑的过渡，并可能使圈地低于社会最优水平。尽管加强习惯治理或补偿受影响利益相关者的政策能够使激励重新对齐，但只处理一种扭曲而忽视其他扭曲可能会恶化福利。

abstract.text: We investigate a dynamic oligopoly model with two phases: a normal phase where an essential input is available, and a disruption phase where firms must rely on inventories. Disruptions create an overcutting pricing incentive arising from the option to forgo sales and monopolize the market once rivals stock out. This monopoly option causes the price to jump to a supracompetitive level at the advent of the disruption and to remain above the competitive price path throughout. Price caps raise welfare, but reduce inventory investment. Government reserves reduce prices and raise buffer stocks, as do reserve mandates when financially feasible.

10.1093/restud/rdag119.abstractZh: 我们研究一个包含两个阶段的动态寡头垄断模型：在正常阶段，关键投入品可得；在中断阶段，企业必须依赖库存。中断会产生一种过度提价的定价激励，它源于企业可以选择放弃销售，并在竞争对手库存耗尽后垄断市场。这一垄断选择权使价格在中断出现时跃升至超竞争水平，并在整个过程中始终高于竞争性价格路径。价格上限会提高福利，但会减少库存投资。政府储备会降低价格并提高缓冲库存；当在财务上可行时，储备要求也会产生同样效果。

abstract.text: Commercial real estate accounts for about 20% of the U.S. capital stock and is highly regulated. Yet relatively little is known about how these regulations affect economic activity or consumer welfare. This paper develops a spatial general equilibrium model of the U.S. economy with commercial real estate regulations and congestion effects, the latter providing a rationale for such regulations. The model constructs a panel of commercial real estate regulation indices for major U.S. metropolitan areas by exploiting variation in the share of parcel value attributable to land versus structures in tax assessor records compiled by Cotality. We find that a moderate relaxation of commercial real estate building regulations across U.S. cities generates large allocative efficiency gains, increasing output by 2.7% to 5.3% and welfare by 2.8% to 8.0% of lifetime consumption. We then extract the component of our regulatory indices that covaries with specific zoning attributes in LightBox data, including zoning height limits, and use it to simulate local deregulation policies. Relaxing height limits in New York City raises its output by 2.9%.

10.1093/restud/rdag121.abstractZh: 商业房地产占美国资本总量的约20%，并且受到严格的监管。然而，关于这些监管如何影响经济活动或消费者福利，我们知之甚少。本文构建了一个包含商业房地产监管和拥堵效应的美国经济空间一般均衡模型，后者为这些监管提供了理论依据。该模型利用Cotality公司编制的税务评估记录中土地与建筑物价值占比的变化，为美国主要都市区构建了一组商业房地产监管指数。研究发现，适度放宽美国各城市的商业房地产建筑规定，能够带来巨大的资源配置效率提升，使产出增加2.7%至5.3%，福利水平提高2.8%至8.0%。随后，我们提取了LightBox数据中与特定分区属性相关的监管指数成分，包括分区高度限制，并利用这些指数模拟地方放松监管的政策效果。例如，纽约市放宽高度限制后，其产出增加了2.9%。

abstract.text: In collegial organizations, homophily jeopardizes the recruitment of the most talented (“meritocracy”). We analyze the dynamics and welfare properties of an organization whose incumbent members coopt new ones in a forward-looking manner. We identify organizations in which meritocracy is likely to give way to favoritism and entrenchment, and investigate policy interventions (such as affirmative action, quality-based or diversity-based funding, discretionary overruling of majority decisions, blind hiring processes) and their unintended consequences.

10.1093/restud/rdag122.abstractZh: 在集体组织中，同质性可能会危及最优秀人才的招募（“精英统治”）。我们分析了一个组织的动态与福利特性，该组织的现任成员以前瞻性方式选拔新成员。我们发现，在某些组织中，精英统治可能会让位于偏袒和固化，并研究了政策干预措施（如平权行动、基于质量或多样性的资助、对多数决定的自由裁量权、盲选流程）及其未预见的后果。

abstract.text: What determines demand elasticities and markups in production networks, where firms' demand and pricing are interdependent? I propose competition in markups, an equilibrium concept in which firms choose markups, taking other firms' markups as given. In partial equilibrium with vertical structures, it links upstream demand elasticities to downstream characteristics without backward induction and ties pass-through to the curvature of final demand. In general equilibrium with arbitrary industry networks, it microfounds firms' demand elasticities and markups through their within-industry market shares and four industry-level network statistics---cycle, substitution in production, substitution in consumption, and consumer-price impact. Empirical analysis of Compustat firms from 1997 to 2019 confirms the predicted variation of industry demand elasticities and firm markups. Relative to an exogenous-markup benchmark, endogenous markups dampen the aggregate TFP impact of a productivity shock to an industry's largest firm by 6% for the median industry, and by up to 48% across industries.

10.1093/restud/rdag123.abstractZh: 什么决定了生产网络中的需求弹性和价格加成？在这样一个网络中，企业的需求和定价是相互依存的。我提出了“价格加成的竞争”这一均衡概念，即企业根据其他企业的价格加成来选择自己的价格加成。在具有垂直结构的局部均衡中，这一概念将上游需求弹性与下游特征联系起来，而无需进行逆向归纳，并将传递效应与最终需求的曲率联系起来。在具有任意行业网络的全局均衡中，这一概念通过企业在本行业内的市场份额以及四个行业级网络统计数据——生产中的替代性、消费中的替代性以及消费者价格影响，来微观分析企业的需求弹性和价格加成。对1997年至2019年间Compustat企业的实证分析证实了行业需求弹性和企业价格加成的变化规律。相对于外生设定的价格加成基准，内生性价格加成会使一个行业最大企业的总技术效率对生产率冲击的影响减弱6%，在中等规模的行业中尤为明显，而在整个行业范围内则可能高达48%。

abstract.text: I develop and estimate a life-cycle discrete-choice model of fertility and female labour supply to study the optimal design of a range of child-related policies. First, I examine two German reforms that introduced wage-contingent parental leave payments and expanded access to low-cost public childcare. I find that both reforms raised completed fertility, with the parental leave reform having a particularly strong impact on highly educated women. Second, I solve for a budget-neutral optimal policy portfolio that maximizes either aggregate welfare or fertility, while ensuring that welfare and fertility do not decline for any education group. I consider four prominent child subsidies as well as the degree of tax jointness. My results show that optimal policy has the potential to increase welfare by 0.5% or fertility by 5.7%. While the solutions are qualitatively similar, they prioritize different policy instruments depending on the specific objective being targeted.

10.1093/restud/rdag124.abstractZh: 我开发并估计了一个关于生育率和女性劳动力供应的生命周期离散选择模型，以研究一系列与儿童相关的政策的最佳设计。首先，我研究了两项德国改革，这两项改革引入了基于工资的父母休假福利，并扩大了低成本公共儿童保育服务的获取范围。我发现这两项改革都提高了生育率，其中父母休假改革对受过高等教育的女性产生了特别强烈的影响。其次，我找到了一个预算中性的最优政策组合，该组合能够最大化总体福利或生育率，同时确保任何教育群体的福利和生育率都不会下降。我考虑了四种主要的儿童补贴以及税收联合程度。我的结果显示，最优政策有可能使福利增加0.5%，或生育率增加5.7%。虽然这些解决方案在质量上是相似的，但它们根据具体的目标而优先考虑不同的政策工具。

abstract.text: We study the role of hard information in contractual and market settings in which the receiver can flexibly adjust allocations and transfers in response to the sender's disclosure. These settings include monopoly pricing, insurance contracting, and policy negotiations. Across these settings, the sender is worst off if she reveals her type completely because the receiver would then adjust the terms of trade to extract her surplus. Taking this feature as our central departure from the literature, we characterize the entire set of equilibrium payoffs in these disclosure games. We prove an equivalence result: a payoff profile can be approximated by an equilibrium of the disclosure game if and only if it can be achieved through information design. Thus, there exist equilibria in which the sender obtains approximately her commitment payoff.

10.1093/restud/rdag125.abstractZh: 我们研究了在契约和市场环境中，接收方能够根据发送方的披露信息灵活地调整分配和转移的情况中，硬信息的角色。这些环境包括垄断定价、保险契约和政策谈判。在这些环境中，如果发送方完全披露自己的类型，那么她的处境将变得最为不利，因为接收方会调整交易条款以获取她的剩余收益。我们将这一特征作为与现有文献的核心区别，对这类披露博弈中的全部均衡收益进行了描述。我们证明了一种等价性结果：一个收益配置可以通过信息设计来近似实现，当且仅当该配置可以通过信息设计来实现时，它才能被视为披露博弈的均衡解。因此，存在一些均衡情况，在这种情况下，发送方获得的收益大致相当于她的承诺收益。

abstract.text: Using high-frequency administrative data covering millions of US homeowners, I document three novel facts about homeowner responses to property tax increases driven by rising home values. First, non-migrating homeowners cut consumption, exhibit financial distress, and do not borrow against their higher home values. Second, heterogeneity analysis shows that consumption responses do not vary by liquidity, consistent with savings target behavior. In contrast, distress responses are concentrated among liquidity-constrained homeowners. Many homeowners report being debt averse and therefore unwilling to borrow in order to avoid illiquidity and distress. Third, tax hikes induce migration—partly by displacing illiquid homeowners—but do not accelerate neighborhood change. A simple welfare framework reveals that the largest costs of property taxes arise from financial distress, suggesting welfare gains from policies that limit taxes for liquidity-constrained households.

10.1093/restud/rdag127.abstractZh: 利用覆盖数百万美国房主的高频行政数据，我发现了关于房主对财产税增加的三种新现象。首先，不迁移的房主会减少消费，表现出财务困境，并且不会利用更高的房产价值进行借贷。其次，异质性分析表明，消费反应并不受流动性影响，这与储蓄目标行为一致。相反，财务困境反应则集中在流动性受限的房主中。许多房主表示厌恶债务，因此不愿借贷以避免流动性不足和财务困境。第三，税收增加会导致迁移——部分原因是取代了流动性不足的房主——但并不会加速社区变化。一个简单的福利框架显示，财产税的最大成本来自财务困境，这表明对于流动性受限的家庭来说，限制税收的政策会带来福利收益。

abstract.text: This paper examines competitive information disclosure in search markets with a mix of selective consumers, who search costlessly, and casual consumers, who incur positive search costs. Selective consumers incentivize truthful disclosure; casual consumers, concealment. With both types, the equilibrium features partial disclosure, which persists despite intense competition. Casual consumers may search actively, but only in small markets. While selective consumers benefit from increased competition, casual consumers may be harmed. Changes in search costs have non-monotone effects: the equilibrium approaches full disclosure as the cost approaches zero or the mean valuation. When costs are high, further increases raise equilibrium informativeness and the welfare of selective consumers, while reducing the welfare of casual consumers.

10.1093/restud/rdag129.abstractZh: 本文研究了具有选择性消费者和随意性消费者的搜索市场中的竞争信息披露现象。选择性消费者无需支付搜索成本，而随意性消费者则需要承担一定的搜索成本。选择性消费者倾向于选择真实披露信息，而随意性消费者则倾向于隐瞒信息。在两种情况下，均衡都表现为部分披露，即使存在激烈的竞争，这种状态也会持续存在。随意性消费者可能会积极进行搜索，但仅限于小型市场。虽然选择性消费者能从激烈的竞争中获得利益，但随意性消费者可能会因此受损。搜索成本的变化具有非单调效应：当成本趋近于零或平均估值时，均衡会趋向于完全披露。当成本较高时，进一步的成本增加会提高选择性消费者的信息优势，同时降低随意性消费者的福利。

abstract.text: This paper revisits the widely held idea of a “human resources crisis” in primary health care (PHC) across low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). First, we review micro- and macro-level evidence, finding little empirical support for generalized workforce shortages. Providers in LMICs appear to operate with substantial excess capacity, characterized by low caseloads, short consultation lengths, and modest wait times. Second, using nationally representative data from 7,915 facilities across 10 African countries, we estimate that the median provider sees 10.9 patients per day. We suggest that the perceived experience of overcrowding arises from a highly unequal distribution of caseloads, with most visits concentrated among a minority of providers. In other words, the average provider is not busy, but the average patient visits a busy provider. Third, we assess allocative inefficiencies using matched data on provider caseload and competence, documenting that caseloads are not concentrated among more competent providers. Using simulations, we show that this misallocation reduces potential aggregate service quality by 4–33 percent, depending on the country. These findings suggest that failures in PHC service delivery cannot be addressed by simply expanding human resources under existing systems arrangements—the competence, allocation, and utilization of both new and existing providers must be improved to meaningfully impact care quality.

10.1093/wbro/lkag002.abstractZh: 本文重新审视了在低收入和中等收入国家中，初级卫生保健领域普遍存在的“人力资源危机”现象。首先，我们回顾了微观和宏观层面的证据，发现几乎没有实证支持普遍存在的劳动力短缺现象。这些国家的医疗服务提供者似乎拥有相当多的过剩能力，表现为较低的就诊人数、较短的咨询时间以及适中的等待时间。其次，利用来自10个非洲国家的7,915家医疗机构的全国代表性数据，我们估计平均每位医疗服务提供者每天接待10.9名患者。我们认为，所感知到的过度拥挤现象源于就诊人数的高度不平等分布，大多数就诊集中在少数医疗服务提供者手中。换句话说，平均而言，医疗服务提供者并不忙碌，但平均而言，患者会去拜访那些忙碌的医疗服务提供者。第三，我们通过匹配数据评估了资源配置效率低下的问题，发现就诊人数并未集中在更有能力的医疗服务提供者手中。通过模拟分析，我们发现这种资源配置的不合理会导致整体服务质量的下降，降幅取决于具体国家。这些发现表明，单纯通过扩大现有系统中的人力资源并不能解决初级卫生保健服务提供的不足问题——必须改善新医生和现有医生的能力、资源配置和利用方式，才能真正提升护理质量。

abstract.text: BACKGROUND: US maternal mortality and severe maternal morbidity (SMM) are marked by substantial disparities by race, payer, and geography. To the extent that such disparities are driven by differences across hospitals rather than within hospitals, understanding what shapes delivery hospital choice can inform policy responses. OBJECTIVES: To examine how distance, hospital attributes, and maternal characteristics jointly shape delivery hospital choice, and whether patterns differ between urban Atlanta and smaller Georgia markets. RESEARCH DESIGN: Retrospective observational study using a conditional logit model to estimate delivery hospital choice. Hospital markets were defined through community detection on patient-flow data. We report marginal effects on selection probability. SUBJECTS: Seven hundred ten thousand eight hundred seventy deliveries across 84 Georgia hospitals, 2016-2021. MEASURES: Deterministically linked hospital discharge, birth, and fetal death records, supplemented with American Hospital Association, CMS, and Area Resource Files data. RESULTS: Distance (in miles) strongly deterred hospital selection in both markets, with greater sensitivity in Atlanta (-2.7 percentage points [pp] per additional mile) than outside Atlanta (-1.9 pp/mile). Individuals preferred hospitals with higher perinatal levels of care and teaching status. A hospital's elective C-section rate was negatively associated with its selection outside Atlanta (-1.3 pp) but positively in Atlanta (+2.5 pp). Higher comorbidity was associated with higher-quality hospital selection, though the highest-risk Atlanta individuals showed lower preference for high-elective-C-section hospitals. CONCLUSIONS: Delivery hospital choice in Georgia reflects distance, practice environment, insurance, and clinical complexity, with urban/nonurban differences. Medicaid-insured individuals show delivery patterns consistent with provider supply-side constraints, which may raise concerns to the extent that they face an elevated risk of adverse maternal outcomes. Findings inform payment and referral policies improving access to risk-appropriate delivery settings and reducing maternal health disparities.

10.1097/mlr.0000000000002383.abstractZh:
背景：美国的孕产妇死亡率和严重孕产妇发病率在不同种族、支付方和地理区域之间存在显著差异。如果这些差异是由医院之间的差异而非医院内部的差异所导致，那么了解影响医院选择的因素将有助于制定政策。  
目标：研究距离、医院属性和孕产妇特征如何共同影响医院选择，并探讨这些模式在亚特兰大市区和佐治亚州较小市场之间的差异。  
研究设计：采用条件逻辑模型进行回顾性观察研究，以估计医院选择情况。通过患者流量数据进行社区检测来定义医院市场。我们报告了选择概率的边际效应。  
对象：2016年至2021年间，佐治亚州84家医院中的710,870例分娩案例。  
测量方法：利用美国医院协会、CMS和地区资源文件的数据，结合医院出院、分娩和胎儿死亡记录进行确定性的关联分析。  
结果：距离（以英里为单位）在两个市场中都强烈抑制了医院选择，亚特兰大的敏感度更高（每增加一英里，选择概率降低2.7个百分点），而外部亚特兰大的敏感度则较低（每英里降低1.9个百分点）。个体更倾向于选择具有较高围产期护理水平和教学水平的医院。医院的择期剖宫产率与在亚特兰大以外的选择呈负相关（降低1.3个百分点），而在亚特兰大则呈正相关（增加2.5个百分点）。较高的合并症与更高质量的医院选择相关，不过亚特兰大高风险群体对高择期剖宫产率医院的偏好较低。  
结论：佐治亚州的医院选择受到距离、医疗环境、保险和临床复杂性的影响，城市与非城市地区之间存在差异。获得医疗补助保险的个人在分娩模式上表现出与医疗服务提供者供给限制相一致的情况，这可能会引发担忧，因为他们面临较高的不良妊娠结局风险。这些发现为支付和转诊政策提供了依据，有助于改善适合风险状况的分娩环境，并减少孕产妇健康方面的差异。

abstract.text: Purpose This study investigates the efficiency of hospital services production in Afghanistan, a conflict-affected and resource-constrained setting, to identify key drivers of hospital productivity and provide actionable insights for healthcare policy and management. Design/methodology/approach We use 2010–2020 panel data from 29 national public hospitals in Afghanistan. To account for endogeneity and unobserved heterogeneity, we estimate hospital production functions using Olley–Pakes (OP) and OP-generalized method of moments (OP-GMM) control function estimators. We also implement an instrumental variables strategy (geographic distance) to address the endogeneity of bed occupancy. Findings This study demonstrates increasing returns to labor and material inputs, suggesting gains through improved staffing, while capital inputs show diminishing marginal productivity. Productivity-enhancing bed occupancy reflects the importance of capacity utilization. Conversely, higher mortality rates highlight quality inefficiencies in care delivery. This study advances the performance management literature by applying control function estimators in a fragile context. It integrates methodological rigor with practical relevance, providing new insights into how hospitals convert limited resources into effective service and identifying resource combinations that maximize efficiency and accountability. Originality/value To our knowledge, this is the first study to apply OP and OP-GMM methods to healthcare in Afghanistan. By addressing endogeneity in input selection, we provide more accurate productivity estimates, offering critical insights for hospital administrators and policymakers. Findings guide investments in labor and materials, improving service utilization and linking productivity to quality metrics. These results have wider implications for fragile health systems in other low-income countries.

10.1108/ijppm-11-2024-0779.abstractZh:
研究目的  本研究旨在调查阿富汗这一受冲突影响且资源有限的地区医院服务的生产效率，以识别医院生产力的关键驱动因素，并为医疗政策和管理提供实用的见解。  
研究方法/途径  我们采用了2010至2020年间阿富汗29家国有公立医院的数据。为了处理内生性和未观测异质性问题，我们采用了Olley–Pakes（OP）方法和OP-广义矩估计（OP-GMM）控制函数估计方法。我们还采用了工具变量策略（地理距离）来处理床位占用率的内生性问题。  
研究结果  研究表明，劳动力和物质投入具有递增收益，表明通过改善人员配置可以提升生产力；而资本投入则表现出递减的边际生产力。提高生产力的床位占用率反映了容量利用的重要性。相反，较高的死亡率凸显了护理服务中的质量不足。本研究通过在脆弱的情境下应用控制函数估计方法，为绩效管理领域提供了新的见解。它结合了方法论的严谨性与实际相关性，为医院如何将有限资源转化为有效服务提供了新的思路，并确定了能够最大化效率和责任制的资源组合。  
创新性/价值  据我们所知，这是首次将OP和OP-GMM方法应用于阿富汗的医疗保健领域。通过解决输入选择的内生性问题，我们获得了更准确的生产力估计结果，为医院管理者和政策制定者提供了重要的参考。研究结果指导了对劳动力和材料的投资，提高了服务利用率，并将生产力与质量指标联系起来。这些结果对其他低收入国家的脆弱医疗系统具有更广泛的意义。

abstract.text: OBJECTIVE: To examine, for the United States: (1) national trends in market competition using three approaches to operationalizing markets and (2) how competitive markets differ from concentrated ones for general newborn nurseries [GNNs], general pediatric inpatient units [GPIUs], neonatal intensive care units [NICUs], pediatric intensive care units [PICUs], and pediatric emergency departments [PEDs]. STUDY SETTING AND DESIGN: This study describes hospital markets for the above most common hospital-based pediatric service lines. Antitrust enforcement guidelines characterize market structures as: "Competitive," "Concentrated," or "Unavailable" if ≥ 5, 1-4, or zero hospitals within a market provide each service, respectively. Trends were determined by the share pediatric population residing in each market structure in 2018 compared with 2011 using three different approaches to operationalizing markets: Healthcare Referral Regions [HRR], Neonatal Intensive Care Regions [NICR], and Pediatric Emergency Referral Regions [PERR]. Competitive markets were compared with concentrated ones in 2018 using demographic data and hospital characteristics. DATA SOURCES AND ANALYTIC SAMPLE: Data come from the Health Systems and Providers Database (HSPD) developed by the National Bureau of Economic Research and the American Community Survey. Since the HSPD provides a near census of US hospitals, only point estimates are presented. PRINCIPAL FINDINGS: Irrespective of how markets were operationalized, the share of the national pediatric population living in competitive markets increased for NICU (3%-8% increase), PICU (21%-35%), and PED (30%-76%) services and remained stable for GNN services over the study period. Directionality of the change in share living in competitive GPIU markets depended on how markets were operationalized. Using HRRs, competitive (relative to concentrated) markets exhibited smaller declines in pediatric population size, larger non-white populations, and higher prevalence of children's hospitals. CONCLUSION: Market competitiveness for hospital-based pediatric services varies by service line, demographic and socioeconomic factors, and specific market definition used. Future studies should examine whether competitive markets offer better outcomes at lower prices and whether pediatric patients in concentrated markets require more protections.

10.1111/1475-6773.70102.abstractZh:
目的：针对美国，研究：(1)通过三种市场定义方法分析市场竞争的国家趋势；(2)一般新生儿护理机构、一般儿科住院病房、新生儿重症监护病房、儿科重症监护病房和儿科急诊部门中竞争市场与集中市场的差异。  
研究背景与设计：本研究描述了上述最常见的儿科服务领域的医院市场。反垄断执法指南将市场结构分为“竞争型”、“集中型”或“不可用型”，即市场中提供每项服务的医院数量分别大于或等于5家、1-4家或零家。通过三种不同的市场定义方法，即医疗转诊区域、新生儿重症监护区域和儿科急诊转诊区域，确定2018年与2011年相比，每种市场结构中儿科人口的占比。使用人口统计数据和医院特征，比较2018年竞争市场与集中市场的差异。  
数据来源与分析样本：数据来自由国家经济研究局和美国社区调查开发的卫生系统和提供者数据库。由于HSPD提供了美国医院的近似人口普查数据，因此仅呈现点估计值。  
主要发现：无论市场如何定义，全国儿科人口在竞争市场中的占比均有所上升，其中新生儿重症监护病房服务增加了3%-8%，儿科重症监护病房服务增加了21%-35%，儿科急诊部门服务增加了30%-76%。在研究期间，一般新生儿护理服务中的这一占比保持稳定。竞争型儿科住院病房市场中的占比变化方向取决于市场的定义方式。使用人力资源模型分析后发现，与集中式市场相比，竞争性市场在儿科人口规模下降幅度较小，非白人人口比例较高，儿童医院的普及率也较高。结论：医院儿科服务的市场竞争性因服务类型、人口统计和社会经济因素以及所采用的市场定义不同而有所差异。未来的研究应探讨竞争性市场是否能在较低价格下提供更好的服务效果，以及集中式市场中的儿科患者是否需要更多的保护措施。

abstract.text: OBJECTIVE: The Veterans Health Administration's (VHA) Community Care Network generally includes physicians with higher Medicare Merit-Based Incentive Payment System (MIPS) quality scores than nonparticipants, yet veterans disproportionately receive care from participating physicians with lower scores. Whether physician quality or availability influences veterans' use of community care has not been comprehensively evaluated. Our objective was to assess whether VHA community care specialists with higher MIPS quality scores receive greater referral volume or have longer wait times. STUDY SETTING AND DESIGN: We used multivariate regression models to assess the associations between physicians' MIPS quality scores, ranging from 0 to 100, and wait times or referral volumes. We also tested whether wait time moderated the association between physician quality and referral volume. DATA SOURCES AND ANALYTIC SAMPLE: We used administrative data to identify referrals to community-based specialists during 2021-2022. Referrals were then merged with MIPS quality scores from the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services using national provider identifiers. PRINCIPAL FINDINGS: Our sample included 83,911 specialty care referrals involving 43,736 specialists. The mean MIPS quality score was 81.9 (SD = 20.9), including 77.9% of physicians who scored ≥ 75, the threshold for a positive payment adjustment. The overall mean wait time was 21.8 days (SD = 22.0), and the mean referral volume was 6.6 per year (SD = 10.5). In covariate-adjusted regression models, MIPS scores were not associated with wait times (+0.12 days per 10-point increase, 95% CI: -0.02, 0.25) or referral volumes (-0.15 referrals per 10-point increase, 95% CI: -0.37, 0.06). Wait time did not significantly moderate the relationship between MIPS score and referral volume. CONCLUSION: Physician quality appears to play a limited role in shaping referral decisions or access patterns in VHA community care. Although higher-scoring physicians sometimes have slightly longer wait times, these differences are small and do not translate into higher referral volumes.

10.1111/1475-6773.70148.abstractZh:
研究目的：退伍军人健康管理局的社区护理网络通常包含那些在Medicare基于绩效的激励支付系统（MIPS）中得分较高的医生，然而退伍军人却更多地从得分较低的参与医生那里获得护理。目前尚未全面评估医生的质量或可用性是否会影响退伍军人对社区护理的使用。我们的研究目的是评估MIPS得分较高的VHA社区护理专家是否接收更多的转诊量或等待时间更长。

研究环境与设计：我们使用多元回归模型来评估医生在MIPS中的得分（范围从0到100）与等待时间或转诊量之间的关联。我们还测试了等待时间是否调节了医生质量与转诊量之间的关系。

数据来源与分析样本：我们使用行政数据来识别2021-2022年期间转诊给社区专科医生的案例。然后，通过国家提供者标识符将转诊信息与Medicare & Medicaid Services的MIPS得分进行合并。

主要发现：我们的样本包括83,911例专科护理转诊，涉及43,736名专科医生。平均MIPS得分为81.9（标准差为20.9），其中77.9%的医生得分≥75，达到获得正向支付调整的门槛。总体平均等待时间为21.8天（标准差为22.0），平均每年转诊量为6.6次（标准差为10.5）。在协变量调整后的回归模型中，MIPS得分与等待时间（-0.12天/每增加10分，95%置信区间：-0.02，0.25）或转诊量（-0.15次/每增加10分，95%置信区间：-0.37，0.06）之间没有关联。等待时间并未显著调节MIPS得分与转诊量之间的关系。结论：在VHA社区护理中，医生质量对转诊决策或就医模式的影响似乎有限。尽管评分较高的医生有时需要稍长的等待时间，但这些差异很小，并不会导致转诊量的增加。

abstract.text: This article proposes an empirical framework and a novel equilibrium concept to analyze network competition in the airline industry. A two‐stage entry model links direct and indirect flights, using a technological relationship estimated from data to mimic the hub‐and‐spoke network. It employs revealed‐preference arguments to bound fixed cost parameters, estimated using state‐of‐the‐art econometric methods. Ignoring network externality undervalues the benefits of additional flights by 13.2% and leads to 21.5% fewer one‐stop flights. A hypothetical merger between Alaska and Virgin in 2014 could increase consumer surplus as the merged airline would offer more flights with muted post‐merger prices.

10.1111/1756-2171.70031.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个实证框架和一种新的均衡概念，用于分析航空业中的网络竞争。该模型采用两阶段进入模式，将直飞和间接航班联系起来，并利用从数据中估计出的技术关系来模拟枢纽辐射型网络。文中运用揭示偏好理论来约束固定成本参数，这些参数是通过最先进的经济计量方法估算得出的。忽略网络外部性会导致额外航班带来的收益减少13.2%，并导致一站式航班数量减少21.5%。假设2014年阿拉斯加航空与维珍航空合并，可能会增加消费者剩余，因为合并后的航空公司将提供更多的航班，且合并后的价格变化较小。

abstract.text: In the presence of adverse selection, mergers can increase welfare through a reduction in inefficient sorting. I characterize the sorting externality internalized between merging firms in a tractable discrete choice model. Mergers benefit consumers when the firms are small, willingness to pay is moderately increasing in cost, and consumer costs are skewed. Applying the model to the non‐group health insurance market, 13% of potential mergers would improve consumer surplus. In markets where the sorting distortion exceeds $5 per person, nearly one‐third of mergers improve consumer surplus, highlighting the importance of considering adverse selection in merger evaluation.

10.1111/1756-2171.70070.abstractZh: 在逆向选择存在的情况下，合并可以通过减少低效的筛选行为来提高福利。我在一个可行的离散选择模型中描述了合并企业之间内部化的筛选外部性。当企业规模较小、支付意愿随成本适度增加且消费者成本呈偏态分布时，合并对消费者是有益的。将该模型应用于非团体健康保险市场，有13%的潜在合并能够提升消费者剩余。在筛选扭曲超过每人5美元的市场中，近三分之一的合并能够提升消费者剩余，这凸显了在合并评估中考虑逆向选择的重要性。

abstract.text: Hospital payment schemes designed to control expenditure could also influence the medical resource allocation. We study hospital responses to the introduction of a blended payment scheme—a diagnosis‐based payment scheme with a predetermined global budget—and their distributional consequences. Exploiting a quasi‐experimental reform in China, we find hospitals respond by upcoding, shifting admissions toward categories with higher upcoding potential, and increasing total admissions. Hospitals’ heterogeneous responses widen the disparity in their payments, primarily through heterogeneous upcoding. Hospitals with more coding knowledge, greater reform exposure, higher tier, and larger size secure a larger share of the social health insurance fund.

10.1111/iere.70106.abstractZh: 旨在控制支出的医院支付方案也可能影响医疗资源的分配。我们研究了医院对引入混合支付方案的反应——一种基于诊断的支付方案，并设定了预先确定的总体预算——以及这些方案带来的分配后果。通过利用中国的一项准实验性改革，我们发现医院通过过度编码来应对，将住院病例转向那些有更大过度编码潜力的类别，并增加总住院人数。医院的不同反应加剧了支付差异，主要是通过不同的过度编码行为造成的。拥有更多编码知识、更频繁接触改革、处于更高层级以及规模更大的医院，能够获得更多的社会医疗保险资金。

abstract.text: In this paper, we investigate the contracts offered by a large healthcare purchaser to health service providers. Contracts are based on the DRG principle that all hospitalizations in a diagnosis group are reimbursed at the same rate. This principle is relaxed in practice, as in several cases, the amount reimbursed within each DRG exhibits considerable variability. We build a theoretical model which explains this variability as the attempt of the health authority to ensure appropriate matching between hospitals and patients. We test the model using a very large and detailed administrative data set for the largest region in Italy. In line with our theoretical results, we show that the state funded purchaser offers providers a system of incentives such that, as required by optimality, that providers which treat more patients receive a higher average reimbursement per treatment, suggesting therefore that they treat on average more difficult patients and are compensated for doing so.

10.1111/jems.70035.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们研究了大型医疗采购方向医疗服务提供者提供的合同。这些合同基于DRG原则，即同一诊断组中的所有住院治疗都按照相同的标准进行报销。然而，在实践中这一原则被放宽了，因为在某些情况下，每个DRG内的报销金额存在相当大的差异。我们构建了一个理论模型，用以解释这种差异性，认为这是卫生当局试图确保医院与患者之间实现合理匹配的一种尝试。我们使用意大利最大地区的庞大且详细的行政数据集来测试该模型。与我们的理论结果一致的是，我们发现国家资助的采购方为提供者提供了一套激励机制，使得按照最优性要求，治疗更多患者的提供者能够获得更高的平均报销金额。这表明，他们平均治疗的是更为复杂的病例，并因此获得了相应的补偿。

abstract.text: We focus on the determinants of pharmaceutical drug prices. Using data from the Brazilian pharmaceutical market, we find large variations in drug prices across buyers, drug classes, and time periods. Our estimation results provide evidence that transaction‐specific determinants between buyers and sellers (e.g., transaction volume, buyer's loyalty, multiple drug purchases from the same seller) exert strong effects on drug prices. Our counterfactuals show that group purchasing organizations achieve price reductions that vary across drug classes and that these price reductions primarily depend on buyer price sensitivity.

10.1111/joie.70020.abstractZh: 我们重点关注药品价格的决定因素。通过巴西药品市场的数据分析，我们发现不同购买者、不同药品类别以及不同时间段之间的药品价格存在较大差异。我们的估计结果表明，买卖双方在交易过程中的特定因素（如交易数量、购买者的忠诚度、从同一卖家处多次购买药品等）对药品价格有显著影响。我们的反事实分析显示，团购组织能够降低药品价格，但这种降价效果因药品类别而异，且这种降价效果主要取决于购买者对价格的敏感度。

abstract.text: We identify and quantify a new form of welfare loss in insurance markets. We first show theoretically that moral hazard from subsidies for cost‐sharing combined with community rating mimics adverse selection and can unravel insurance markets. To quantify the potential welfare loss, we use exogenous variation in the number of subsidized enrollees on the ACA exchanges. We find that subsidy‐induced moral hazard led to higher premiums, which has lowered enrollment among the unsubsidized by 6.2 percentage points. We estimate the welfare costs of this “moral hazard induced unraveling” to be around 25% of the total welfare loss.

10.1111/jori.70075.abstractZh: 我们识别并量化了保险市场中一种新的福利损失形式。我们首先从理论上证明，由成本分担补贴引起的道德风险，结合社区评级机制，会模仿逆向选择现象，从而导致保险市场的崩溃。为了量化潜在的福利损失，我们使用了美国《平价医疗法案》交易所中补贴参保人数变化的外部变量。研究发现，补贴引起的道德风险导致保费上升，这使得未享受补贴的参保人数减少了6.2个百分点。我们估计，这种“道德风险导致的市场崩溃”所带来的福利损失约占总福利损失的25%。

abstract.text: Indian Health Service provides healthcare for 2.5 million Alaskan Natives and Native Americans.
