However, health disparities between Native Americans and other groups have been widening. One important factor for this trend is funding. In this paper, I document the effect of funding constraints on mortality outcomes using fixed effects models. I find that, at the end of the fiscal year, deaths disproportionately increased for Native Americans by approximately 3.2 per 100,000. Specifically, I find evidence of increased heart attack, drug, diabetes, and flu mortality and that the effect is concentrated among older adults. These results show that it is crucial for there to be adequate resources in the healthcare system so that policies aimed at addressing health disparities can indeed improve health outcomes.

10.1111/pbaf.70042.abstractZh: 印度卫生服务为250万阿拉斯加原住民和美洲原住民提供医疗服务。然而，美洲原住民与其他群体之间的健康差异正在扩大。这一趋势的一个重要因素是资金问题。在本文中，我使用固定效应模型来研究资金限制对死亡率的影响。我发现，在财政年度结束时，美洲原住民的死亡率增加了约每10万人3.2例。具体来说，我发现心脏病发作、药物相关疾病、糖尿病和流感的死亡率有所增加，且这种影响主要集中在老年人中。这些结果表明，确保医疗系统中有足够的资源至关重要，这样才能使旨在解决健康差异的政策真正改善健康结果。

abstract.text: OBJECTIVES: In the USA, an estimated 40-50 million operations are performed annually, with high rates of adverse events. Since the 1980s, report cards have been used for outcome measures and to improve safety of surgical care. As part of Making Healthcare Safer IV-an initiative aimed at publishing evidence-based reviews as they are completed to help healthcare leaders, researchers and policymakers act more quickly on evidence-supported practices-we performed an updated review on the certainty of evidence on patient safety practices related to the use of surgical report cards and outcome measurements. DESIGN: Systematic review using the Grade of Recommendations Assessment, Development and Evaluation (GRADE) approach. DATA SOURCES: PubMed, Web of Science, Scopus and the Cochrane Library were searched from November 2011 to May 2023. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA FOR SELECTING STUDIES: We included primary research studies (randomised control trials or observational studies with a comparison group, including pre-post studies) or observational studies that investigated a surgical report card in adult or paediatric surgical patients at the hospital or surgeon level in inpatient or outpatient settings. Excluded studies included: narrative reviews, scoping reviews, editorials, commentaries, abstracts, studies that measured only patient knowledge or levels of engagement or studies using local surgical dashboard data. DATA EXTRACTION AND SYNTHESIS: Screening and eligibility were done in duplicate, while data extraction was done by one reviewer and checked by a second reviewer. Specific items in the Risk Of Bias In Non-randomised Studies - of Interventions tool and a modification of the National Institutes of Health Tool were used to assess for bias in studies. Two reviewers assessed each study for risk of bias. A modified version of the GRADE framework was used to assess the certainty of evidence. RESULTS: We identified 19 studies that met the inclusion criteria: 13 primary research studies and 6 descriptive studies of surgical collaboratives. Of the primary studies, nine used a pre-post or longitudinal study design and four used a regression discontinuity or concurrent controlled design. Seven of the studies were about the American College of Surgeons National Surgical Quality Improvement Project. Five studies were from single institutions and the remainder included nine to greater than 700 hospitals. Pre-post studies of report cards that prompted quality improvement (QI) programmes all reported improvements in outcomes, longitudinal studies reported benefits in some but not all outcomes and one in four controlled before-and-after studies reported a statistically significant mortality benefit. All studies, except for one, were at moderate or high risk of bias. Six collaboratives were identified with preliminary data. CONCLUSIONS: Based on the above evidence, the theoretical rationale and parallel evidence in other settings, we judged that it was moderate certainty that report cards and outcomes measurements can improve surgical outcomes. However, given the evidence from studies where report cards were actively linked to institutional QI initiatives, we recommend that outcome data must be paired with actionable QI efforts to meaningfully improve patient outcomes.

10.1136/bmjopen-2025-101718.abstractZh:
研究目的：在美国，每年大约进行4000万到5000万例手术，其中不良事件的发生率很高。自20世纪80年代以来，报告卡被用于评估手术效果并提高手术安全性。作为“提升医疗安全计划IV”的一部分——该计划旨在在相关证据基础上发布综述，以帮助医疗领导者、研究人员和政策制定者更快地采取基于证据的做法——我们对该领域关于使用手术报告卡和结果测量对患者安全实践的证据确定性进行了更新综述。  
研究设计：采用推荐等级评估、发展和评估方法进行的系统综述。  
数据来源：从2011年11月至2023年5月，在PubMed、Web of Science、Scopus和Cochrane图书馆中进行了数据搜索。  
研究选择标准：我们纳入了主要研究（随机对照试验或具有对照组的可观察性研究，包括前后对比研究），以及调查医院或外科医生层面成人或儿科手术患者手术报告卡的可观察性研究，这些研究可以在住院或门诊环境中进行。排除的研究包括：叙述性综述、范围综述、社论、评论、摘要，以及仅测量患者知识或参与程度的研究，或使用当地手术数据表的研究。  
数据提取与综合：筛选和资格确认由两名研究人员分别完成，数据提取由一名研究人员执行，并由另一名研究人员进行核查。使用“非随机研究中的偏倚风险评估工具”和修改后的美国国立卫生研究院工具来评估研究的偏倚。两名研究人员分别评估了每项研究的偏倚风险。采用改良版的GRADE框架来评估证据的确定性。研究结果表明：我们发现了19项符合纳入标准的研究，其中包括13项基础研究项目和6项关于外科协作项目的描述性研究。在基础研究项目中，有9项采用前后对照或纵向研究设计，4项采用回归不连续或同期对照设计。其中7项研究涉及美国外科医生学院的国家外科质量改进项目。5项研究来自单一机构，其余研究涵盖了9到700多家医院。所有关于报告卡促进质量改进项目的前后对照研究均显示结果有所改善；纵向研究则表明某些结果有所改善，但并非所有结果都如此；四分之一的对照前后研究结果显示死亡率有显著下降。除了一项研究外，所有研究都存在中等或较高的偏倚风险。另有6项协作项目提供了初步数据。综上所述，基于上述证据、理论依据以及其他领域的类似研究，我们认为报告卡和结果测量能够改善外科手术结果，但这种改善具有中等确定性。然而，鉴于那些将报告卡与机构质量改进计划紧密关联的研究结果，我们建议将结果数据与可操作的改进措施相结合，以真正改善患者的治疗效果。

abstract.text: Background Physicians’ preferences for financial and non-financial incentives significantly influence their job satisfaction and career choices. A comprehensive understanding of these preferences can aid in the optimisation of incentive policies. While prior studies have examined these preferences using discrete choice experiments (DCEs), the effects of intrinsic motivations, such as altruism and job satisfaction, on incentive responsiveness remain poorly understood. Understanding this heterogeneity is essential for designing incentive policies that are effective and tailored to the healthcare context in China. This study aimed to assess how physicians’ altruism and job satisfaction shape their preferences for financial and non-financial incentives. Methods This study employed a DCE methodology and surveyed 886 physicians from urban tertiary hospitals. The DCE design was based on a comprehensive literature review and focus group interviews, assessing physicians’ preferences regarding attributes such as work environment, workload, career development opportunities and career identity. Mixed logit models were used to estimate the willingness to pay for each attribute and analyse heterogeneity across subgroups based on levels of altruism and job satisfaction. Results Financial incentives were the most important factor for physicians, followed by attributes such as work atmosphere and workload. On average, physicians expressed a willingness to sacrifice 4859.035 ¥ for an improved work atmosphere and 4335.008 ¥ in exchange for reduced workload. Subgroup analysis showed that physicians with low- and medium-altruism prioritised improvements related to working conditions, while those with high-altruism placed greater emphasis on intrinsic career development and career identity. Furthermore, physicians reporting low-job satisfaction demonstrated heightened sensitivity to both financial and non-financial incentives, whereas those with high-job satisfaction showed weaker preference for financial incentives and greater preference for improvements in work atmosphere ( β =1.002) and work environment ( β =0.876). Conclusion The findings highlight the need to align incentive policies with physicians’ intrinsic motivations and current job satisfaction. Financial incentives remain a key driver of job preferences. Non-financial factors, including improvements in the work atmosphere, work environment, workload, career development and professional identity, also play an important role in supporting physicians’ job satisfaction and retention. Considering differences in altruism and job satisfaction can help healthcare institutions and policymakers develop more targeted and context-specific incentive strategies.

10.1136/bmjopen-2025-102765.abstractZh: 背景：医生对财务和非财务激励的偏好显著影响着他们的工作满意度和职业选择。全面了解这些偏好有助于优化激励政策。虽然先前的研究通过离散选择实验来研究这些偏好，但诸如利他主义和工作满意度等内在动机对激励反应的影响仍不甚明了。理解这种异质性对于设计有效且适合中国医疗环境的激励政策至关重要。本研究旨在评估医生的利他主义和工作满意度如何影响其对财务和非财务激励的偏好。方法：本研究采用离散选择实验方法，对来自城市三级医院的886名医生进行了调查。实验设计基于全面的文献回顾和焦点小组访谈，评估了医生对工作环境、工作量、职业发展机会和职业认同等属性的偏好。使用混合逻辑模型来估计医生对各个属性的支付意愿，并基于利他主义水平和工作满意度分析不同子群体的异质性。结果：财务激励是医生最重视的因素，其次是工作环境和工作量等属性。平均而言，医生愿意为改善工作环境支付4859.035元，为减少工作量支付4335.008元。子群体分析显示，低度和中度利他主义的医生更重视工作条件的改善，而高度利他主义的医生则更重视内在的职业发展与职业认同。此外，工作满意度较低的医生对财务和非财务激励的敏感度更高，而工作满意度较高的医生则对财务激励的偏好较低，更看重工作氛围和工作环境的改善（β=1.002，β=0.876）。研究结果表明，需要使激励政策与医生的内在动机和当前的工作满意度相一致。财务激励仍然是影响工作选择的关键因素。非财务因素，如工作氛围、工作环境、工作量、职业发展以及职业身份的提升，也在提升医生的工作满意度和保持职位方面发挥着重要作用。考虑到利他主义和工作满意度的差异，有助于医疗机构和政策制定者制定更具针对性和特定情境的激励策略。

abstract.text: Health system fragmentation is the division and lack of coordination among major health system functions such as financing, service delivery or governance. It is often claimed that fragmentation significantly affects the efficiency, equity and quality, often leading to inefficiencies and poor performance. However, the fragmentation of health systems, particularly from the structural and financing perspective, is conceptually underexplored. This article focuses on fragmentation of health system financing, a critical driver of health system performance and presents a framework and narrative literature review of the impacts of health system financing fragmentation on health system performance. Health system financing fragmentation is explored across six domains (purchasers, risk pools, eligibility categories, benefit packages, providers and payments) and the impacts of such fragmentation are analysed. Existing evidence, mostly from high-income settings and a few low- and middle-income country (LMIC) case studies, indicates that highly fragmented health system financing can lead to duplication of services, high administrative costs and inequitable access to care. However, empirical evidence is limited, context-specific and rarely from LMICs. Where comparative empirical studies are available, they generally find that health systems with fewer, more coordinated purchasers and risk pools tend to perform better in terms of equity and efficiency. Conversely, case-study evidence and descriptive analyses suggest that systems with multiple, uncoordinated eligibility categories and benefits packages often face challenges in achieving universal health coverage and equitable access to high-quality care. Competition, lack of regulation, complex payment systems and decentralisation have been found to further contribute to health system fragmentation. While economic theory highlights that some level of fragmentation and competition may enhance responsiveness and innovation, the empirical support for these potential benefits is weak and highly context-dependent. Overall, the balance of available evidence suggests that, in most settings, excessive financing fragmentation tends to undermine the health system goals of efficiency and equity.

10.1136/bmjph-2025-004716.abstractZh: 医疗体系的分化是指医疗体系中的主要功能，如融资、服务提供或治理之间的分离与缺乏协调。人们通常认为，这种分化会显著影响效率、公平性和质量，常常导致效率低下和表现不佳。然而，从结构和融资的角度来看，医疗体系的分化在概念上尚未得到充分探讨。本文重点关注医疗体系融资的分化问题，这是影响医疗体系绩效的关键因素之一。文章提出了一种框架，并回顾了关于医疗体系融资分化对医疗体系绩效影响的文献。医疗体系融资的分化在六个领域进行了探讨：购买者、风险池、资格类别、福利套餐、医疗服务提供者以及支付方式。研究发现，高度分化的医疗体系融资可能导致服务重复、行政成本过高以及就医机会的不平等。然而，现有证据主要来自高收入国家以及少数低收入和中等收入国家的案例研究，这些证据表明，较少且更协调的购买者和风险池往往能在公平性和效率方面取得更好的表现。相反，案例研究和描述性分析表明，拥有多个不协调的资格类别和福利套餐的体系在实现全民健康覆盖和公平获得高质量医疗服务方面面临挑战。竞争、缺乏监管、复杂的支付系统以及权力分散等因素，都被认为会进一步加剧卫生系统的碎片化。虽然经济理论指出一定程度的碎片化和竞争可能会提升响应能力和创新能力，但关于这些潜在好处的实证支持却非常薄弱，并且高度依赖于具体情境。总体而言，现有证据表明，在大多数情况下，过度的融资碎片化往往会破坏卫生系统追求效率和公平的目标。

abstract.text: AI consumer markets are characterized by severe buyer-supplier market asymmetries. Complex AI systems can appear highly accurate while making costly errors or embedding hidden defects. While there have been regulatory efforts surrounding different forms of disclosure, large information gaps remain. This paper provides the first experimental evidence on the important role of information asymmetries and disclosure designs in shaping user adoption of AI systems. We systematically vary the density of low-quality AI systems and the depth of disclosure requirements in a simulated AI product market to gauge how people react to the risk of accidentally relying on a low-quality AI system. Then, we compare participants’ choices to a rational Bayesian model, analyzing the degree to which partial information disclosure can improve AI adoption. Our results underscore the deleterious effects of information asymmetries on AI adoption, but also highlight the potential of partial disclosure designs to improve the overall efficiency of human decision-making.

10.1145/3772318.3791420.abstractZh: AI消费市场的特点在于买卖双方市场存在严重的不对称性。复杂的AI系统可能看起来非常准确，但实际上却会犯昂贵的错误或隐藏缺陷。尽管已有各种监管措施要求对相关信息进行披露，但信息差距仍然很大。本文首次提供了实验性证据，证明信息不对称和披露设计在影响用户采用AI系统方面起着重要作用。我们在模拟的AI产品市场中系统地改变了低质量AI系统的密度和披露要求的深度，以评估人们对误用低质量AI系统风险的反应。然后，我们将参与者的选择与理性贝叶斯模型进行比较，分析部分信息披露在提高AI采用率方面的效果。我们的研究结果强调了信息不对称性对AI采用率的不利影响，同时也指出了部分披露设计在提高人类决策效率方面的潜力。

abstract.text: In 2001, Germany abolished public occupational disability insurance (ODI)—the second tier of its public DI system—for cohorts born after 1960. Using administrative data, we first document that, in the long run, overall DI inflows declined by roughly one-third. Second, using representative survey data, we document at best modest ODI insurance take-up responses in the private individual, risk-rated market, which lacks guaranteed issue. Third, an equilibrium model incorporating interactions between the public safety net, the first-tier public DI, and the private market reveals that coverage denials and weak insurance demand, driven by complementary social insurance, can explain the modest private ODI take-up response. Coverage gradients by income and health are thus substantial. Finally, counterfactual simulations highlight the limited scope of incremental reforms.

10.1162/rest.a.1789.abstractZh: 2001年，德国取消了针对1960年后出生的群体的公共职业残疾保险（ODI）——这是其公共残疾保险体系的第二层级。通过行政数据，我们首先发现，从长期来看，公共残疾保险的投入总量减少了大约三分之一。其次，通过代表性调查数据，我们发现，在缺乏保障性的私人个体风险评级市场中，公共职业残疾保险的覆盖率表现平平。第三，一个结合公共安全网络、第一层级公共残疾保险和私人市场相互作用的均衡模型表明，由于补充性社会保险的驱动，覆盖范围的拒绝和薄弱的保险需求可以解释私人职业残疾保险覆盖率较低的现状。因此，不同收入水平和健康状况的覆盖程度存在显著差异。最后，反事实模拟分析表明，渐进式改革的效果有限。

abstract.text: Despite the continuing U.S. hospital merger wave, it remains unclear how mergers change, or fail to change, hospital behavior and performance. We open the black box of hospital practices through a megamerger between two for-profit chains. Benchmarking the merger's effects against the acquirer's stated aims, we show they achieved some of their goals, harmonizing electronic medical records and sending managers to target hospitals. Postacquisition managerial processes were similar across the merged chain. However, these interventions failed to drive detectable gains in performance. Our findings demonstrate the importance of organizations for merger research in health care and the economy more generally.

10.1162/rest_a_01384.abstractZh: 尽管美国医院合并的浪潮持续不断，但合并如何改变或未能改变医院的行为和绩效仍不清楚。我们通过两家营利性连锁医院之间的大规模合并来探究医院行为的奥秘。通过将合并效果与收购方提出的目标进行对比，我们发现收购方确实实现了一些目标，例如统一电子病历，并派遣管理人员前往目标医院。合并后，各连锁医院的管理流程大致相同。然而，这些干预措施并未带来可检测到的绩效提升。我们的研究结果表明，在医疗保健领域以及更广泛的经济领域，组织因素对于合并研究的重要性。

abstract.text: Platform endorsement is becoming increasingly popular and plays a critical role in online health care platforms by aiding patient choices and shaping doctors’ decisions. Using a unique dataset from a major Chinese online doctor consultation platform, this study applies a generalized synthetic control method to examine the impact of endorsement on patient demand, doctor service pricing, quantity, and quality. The findings show that endorsement significantly increases the price and quantity of paid services, while reducing free services among endorsed doctors. Despite handling higher service volumes, endorsed doctors maintain or improve quality. The endorsement program generates greater revenue for endorsed doctors and the platform, but it raises concerns about equity in health care access due to reduced free service provision for underprivileged patients. The analysis further reveals that the impact of endorsement varies between initial endorsement and reendorsement as well as between high-prosocial and low-prosocial doctors. These findings underscore the nuanced role of information disclosure in shaping doctor behavior and patient access, offering important implications for platform design.

10.1177/00222437251408776.abstractZh: 平台推荐正变得越来越流行，并在在线医疗平台上发挥着关键作用，它通过帮助患者做出选择并影响医生的决策来发挥作用。本研究利用来自一家中国主要在线医生咨询平台的独特数据集，采用一种通用的合成控制方法，来考察推荐对患者的需求、医生服务的价格、数量和质量的影响。研究结果表明，推荐显著增加了付费服务的价格和数量，同时减少了被推荐医生提供的免费服务。尽管处理更高的服务量，被推荐的医生仍然能够保持或提高服务质量。推荐计划为被推荐的医生和平台带来了更多的收入，但这也引发了关于医疗资源分配公平性的担忧，因为贫困患者获得的免费服务减少了。分析还发现，推荐的影响在初次推荐和再次推荐之间有所不同，同时在高社会贡献度与低社会贡献度的医生之间也存在差异。这些发现强调了信息披露在塑造医生行为和患者获取方面所扮演的微妙角色，为平台设计提供了重要的启示。

abstract.text: Follow-up appointments are crucial for maintaining continuity of care, yet patients often encounter various barriers to accessing these services. In this study, we examine the potential of telemedicine applications for follow-up care (tele-follow-up), focusing on its impact on care access, service efficiency, and care quality. By collaborating with a large hospital that implemented tele-follow-up services across departments over time, we employ a staggered difference-in-differences design to identify the causal effects of tele-follow-up services. Our findings indicate that the adoption of tele-follow-up services increases total follow-up volume by 48.14%. Notably, we identify positive spillover effects on traditional onsite care, with onsite follow-up visits and initial visits increasing by 14.11% and 7.90%, respectively. We further investigate the mechanism underlying these results. On the demand side, patients with higher costs of accessing onsite follow-up care, such as those living in rural areas or with comorbidities, exhibit greater demand elasticity following the availability of the tele-follow-up channel. On the supply side, dedicating the telemedicine channel exclusively to follow-up care enhances physicians’ efficiency by enabling more focused practice across online and in-person work shifts. The increased access to follow-up services enabled by telemedicine further translates into better patient outcomes, as evidenced by a significant reduction in readmission rates. Our study demonstrates the value of tele-follow-up services and offers practical insights for healthcare decision-makers seeking to leverage digital health to enhance continuity of care.

10.1177/10591478261449973.abstractZh: 随访预约对于保持护理的连续性至关重要，但患者往往面临各种障碍，难以获得这些服务。本研究探讨了远程医疗应用在随访护理中的潜力，重点关注其对护理可及性、服务效率以及护理质量的影响。通过与一家在多个科室逐步实施远程随访服务的医院合作，我们采用了分阶段差异设计方法来识别远程随访服务的因果效应。研究发现，采用远程随访服务使总随访次数增加了48.14%。值得注意的是，我们发现远程随访服务对传统现场护理产生了积极的溢出效应，现场随访和初次就诊次数分别增加了14.11%和7.90%。我们进一步研究了这些结果的机制。在需求方面，那些难以获得现场随访服务的患者，如居住在农村地区或患有合并症的患者，在远程随访渠道可用后表现出更大的需求弹性。在供应方面，将远程医疗渠道专门用于随访护理可以提高医生的效率，使他们能够在线上和线下工作时间更集中地工作。远程医疗带来的随访服务可及性提高，进一步转化为更好的患者结果，表现为再入院率的显著下降。我们的研究展示了远程随访服务的价值，并为寻求利用数字健康技术来提升护理连续性的医疗保健决策者提供了实用见解。

abstract.text: Hospitals spend billions of dollars annually on major construction projects and facility upgrades, but limited research to date has examined whether this expenditure benefits patients. Using a novel dataset of California hospital construction projects opening between 2010 and 2019, we estimate the effect of project opening on patient experience and clinical measures using a difference-in-differences framework. We find sizable, statistically significant improvements in patient experience-cleanliness, quietness at night, and likelihood to recommend-with effects persisting for at least 2 years after opening. We find no measurable impact on clinical outcomes, 30-day mortality, and readmission for heart attacks and heart failure. These results suggest infrastructure investments meaningfully affect perceived care environments but may not translate into near-term changes in clinical performance. Policymakers and hospital leaders should weigh these returns when evaluating capital expenditures and potential support for hospital construction.

10.1177/10775587261471942.abstractZh: 医院每年在重大建设项目和设施升级上花费数十亿美元，但迄今为止的研究很少探讨这些支出是否真正惠及患者。我们利用2010年至2019年间加州医院建设项目的新数据集，通过差异-差异框架估算项目落成对患者体验和临床指标的影响。研究发现，患者的体验在清洁度、夜间安静程度以及推荐意愿等方面有显著且统计学上显著的改善，这些影响在项目落成后至少持续了两年。然而，我们并未发现对临床结果、30天死亡率以及心脏病和心力衰竭的再入院率有显著影响。这些结果表明，基础设施投资确实对感知的护理环境有积极影响，但可能不会立即转化为临床性能的改善。政策制定者和医院领导者在评估资本支出和对医院建设的潜在支持时，应充分考虑这些回报。

abstract.text: Occupation-based practice (OBP) is an integral part of stroke rehabilitation, focusing on engaging individuals in daily activities. However, the mechanisms that underpin its positive outcomes remain insufficiently explored. This scoping review explores reported OBPs, including interventions across hospitals, communities, or both settings for stroke rehabilitation, and identifies the emerging powers of occupation within these practices. Employing the PRISMA extension for scoping reviews was applied with a deductive research approach. A total of 45 articles were selected. Findings revealed that OBPs can evoke all nine powers of occupation proposed by Bontje, which include therapeutic change, self-expression, participation, and habit formation. Hospital-based practices primarily focused on enhancing physical and cognitive functions, whereas community-based approaches concentrated on fostering independence and social integration. In summary, OBPs are essential tools in stroke rehabilitation, offering a comprehensive approach to address the physical, emotional, and social needs of individuals with stroke during their recovery journey.

10.1177/15394492251397829.abstractZh: 基于职业的练习是中风康复的重要组成部分，重点在于让患者参与日常活动。然而，其积极效果背后的机制尚未得到充分研究。本综述探讨了各种基于职业的练习方法，包括在医院、社区或两者结合的环境中进行的中风康复干预，并强调了这些实践中职业元素所发挥的积极作用。采用PRISMA扩展框架对综述进行了分析，采用演绎研究方法。共筛选出45篇相关文章。研究发现，基于职业的练习能够激发Bontje提出的九种职业功能，包括治疗性改变、自我表达、参与以及习惯形成。医院环境下的练习主要侧重于提升身体和认知功能，而社区环境下的练习则更注重培养独立性和社交能力。总之，基于职业的练习是中风康复中的重要工具，为中风患者在康复过程中提供全面的支持，满足其身体、情感和社会需求。

abstract.text: Objective: Understanding multiple determinants of health and their contributions to premature mortality is essential for policymaking in population health. As an exploratory forecasting exercise, we aimed to analyze the associations between multiple determinants of health and improvement in premature mortality in U.S. counties. Methods: Using County Health Rankings data on health determinants from 2010-2014, we predicted changes in premature mortality from 2015 to 2019. We used Extreme Gradient Boosting, which allows for flexible functional estimates of a multi-dimensional health production function, to assess the association between improvement in premature mortality and pre-period health determinants. We made Accumulated Local Effects plots to illustrate these associations and conducted a conventional spatial regression as a robustness check. Results: We find a negative association between the baseline some-college rate (percentage of adults aged 25-44 with some post-secondary education) and change in premature mortality. A one-percentage-point increase in the baseline some-college rate in 2010-2014 is associated with a reduction of premature mortality by 9.57 years of potential life lost per 100,000 population from 2015 to 2019. The magnitude of the association for each county varied based on each county's baseline some-college rate. Conclusions: Our findings reveal that improvements in post-secondary education are associated with relatively large, yet variable, gains in population health across U.S. counties. Applying machine learning methods to estimate a county-level health production function can inform tailored policies to improve local population health.

10.1177/22799036261480261.abstractZh: 目的：了解健康的多重决定因素及其对过早死亡的影响，对于人口健康政策的制定至关重要。作为一项探索性预测研究，我们旨在分析美国各县的多种健康决定因素与过早死亡减少之间的关联。方法：利用2010-2014年的县级健康排名数据，我们预测了2015至2019年间过早死亡的变化情况。我们采用了极端梯度提升算法，该算法能够灵活地估计多维健康生产函数，以评估过早死亡减少与前期健康决定因素之间的关联。我们通过累积局部效应图来展示这些关联，并进行了传统的空间回归分析以验证结果的稳健性。结果：我们发现，基础水平上的某种教育程度（25-44岁成年人中接受过某种高等教育的比例）与过早死亡的变化之间存在负相关关系。在2010-2014年间，基础水平上的某种教育程度每提高一个百分点，从2015到2019年，每10万人潜在的寿命损失就会减少9.57年。各县的关联程度因各自的基础水平而有所差异。结论：我们的研究发现表明，提高高等教育的水平能够带来相对较大但具有差异性的人口健康改善效果。应用机器学习方法估算县级健康生产函数，可以为制定有针对性的政策以改善当地人口健康提供指导。

abstract.text: Experimental and quasi-experimental studies show that childhood neighborhoods have substantial causal impacts on children's adult earnings and other long-term socioeconomic outcomes. Several market failures are likely to lead to excessive residential segregation by parental income and to an undersupply of mixed-income neighborhoods. Missing markets for opportunity originate in capital market imperfections for borrowing on children's future earnings, neighbor spillovers, behavioral biases, and housing search frictions. Customized housing mobility services combined with subsidized housing vouchers can help low-income families move to higher-opportunity areas. Place-based policies that create mixed-income neighborhoods appear to increase long-term outcomes for less-advantaged children. (JEL I12, I32, I38, J13, J15, R23, R38)

10.1257/aer.116.9.3197.abstractZh: 实验研究和准实验研究表明，童年居住的社区对儿童成年后的收入及其他长期社会经济结果具有显著的因果影响。若干市场失灵很可能导致按父母收入形成的过度居住隔离，以及混合收入社区供给不足。机会市场缺失源于以下方面：以子女未来收入为抵押进行借贷的资本市场不完全性、邻里溢出效应、行为偏差以及住房搜寻摩擦。定制化住房流动服务与补贴性住房券相结合，可以帮助低收入家庭迁往机会更多的地区。旨在创建混合收入社区的基于地点的政策似乎能够改善弱势儿童的长期结果。（JEL I12, I32, I38, J13, J15, R23, R38）

abstract.text: This paper estimates the effects of improving public transit infrastructure on city structure and welfare. It develops a quantitative urban model with multiple worker groups and transit modes, and derives a special case yielding sufficient statistics for aggregate welfare in a broad class of models. The paper estimates reduced-form elasticities to implement the approach using data spanning construction of the world’s largest Bus Rapid Transit system in Bogotá, Colombia. This class of models explains observed adjustments in economic activity. Standard value-of-time calculations capture only 52 percent of welfare gains. Accounting for reallocation and general equilibrium effects, distributional impacts are modest. (JEL H76, L92, L98, O18, R42, R53)

10.1257/aer.20190874.abstractZh: 本文估计了改善公共交通基础设施对城市结构与福利的影响。本文构建了一个包含多个劳动者群体和多种交通方式的量化城市模型，并推导出一个特殊情形，该情形可为一大类模型中的总量福利提供充分统计量。本文利用哥伦比亚波哥大建设全球最大快速公交系统期间的数据，估计简约式弹性以实施该方法。这一类模型能够解释所观测到的经济活动调整。标准的统计生命价值计算仅捕捉到福利收益的52%。在考虑重新配置和一般均衡效应后，分配影响较为有限。(JEL H76, L92, L98, O18, R42, R53)

abstract.text: Many employers link wages at establishments outside of the home region to the level at headquarters. We show this using new data on 1,200 multinationals’ establishments across the world and linked employee-level data on their establishments in Brazil. Headquarters wage changes arising from minimum wage and exchange rate shocks are partially transmitted to workers employed in the same position abroad. Wage change transmission appears to be direct and results from firm-wide wage-setting procedures rather than associated technology or employment changes. “Anchored” wage setting is somewhat associated with particular characteristics of the job × employer × headquarters-establishment country-pair. (JEL F23, F31, J24, J31, J38, M16, O15)

10.1257/aer.20200042.abstractZh: 许多雇主将总部所在地区以外分支机构的工资与总部工资水平挂钩。我们利用关于全球 1200 家跨国公司分支机构的新数据，以及这些公司在巴西分支机构的关联员工层面数据，证明了这一点。由最低工资和汇率冲击引起的总部工资变化，会部分传导至海外同一岗位的员工。工资变化传导似乎是直接的，并且源于全企业范围的工资设定程序，而非相关的技术或就业变化。“锚定”工资设定在一定程度上与岗位×雇主×总部—分支机构所在国配对的特定特征相关。（JEL F23, F31, J24, J31, J38, M16, O15）

abstract.text: We construct a public atlas of mean outcomes in adulthood by childhood census tract. Outcomes vary sharply across neighborhoods: For children whose parents earn $27,000, the standard deviation of mean household income in adulthood is $10,420 across tracts within counties. Only half the variation in outcomes is explained by traditional measures of neighborhood opportunity like poverty rates. Experimental and quasi-experimental estimates indicate 60 percent of the variation in outcomes across neighborhoods is driven by causal effects. We demonstrate how our statistics can be applied to better target policies to improve low-opportunity areas and help families move to affordable high-opportunity areas. (JEL G51, I32, I38, J12, R23)

10.1257/aer.20200108.abstractZh: 我们构建了一个公共图谱，按儿童时期的人口普查区展示成年期的平均结果。结果在社区之间差异显著：对于父母收入为 27,000 美元的儿童，在县内各普查区之间，其成年期平均家庭收入的标准差为 10,420 美元。结果差异中只有一半能由贫困率等传统社区机会指标解释。实验和准实验估计表明，社区间结果差异的 60% 由因果效应驱动。我们展示了如何应用我们的统计结果，更好地瞄准旨在改善低机会地区的政策，并帮助家庭搬迁至可负担的高机会地区。（JEL G51, I32, I38, J12, R23）

abstract.text: We show that bank shocks to firms propagate along the production network with stronger upstream than downstream effects. Our identification relies on (i) administrative datasets from Spain covering supplier-customer transactions and bank loans, (ii) bank credit supply shocks from the global financial crisis, and (iii) a general equilibrium model of a production network with financial frictions, estimated structurally. We find network propagation amplifies the impact of bank shocks on GDP growth by nearly 50 percent. Moreover, bank shocks to firms’ distant suppliers and customers contribute similarly to this aggregate effect as bank shocks to firms’ direct customers and suppliers. (JEL D22, D85, E23, G01, G21, G32, L14)

10.1257/aer.20201088.abstractZh: 我们表明，银行对企业冲击会沿生产网络传导，且上游效应强于下游效应。我们的识别依赖于：(i) 覆盖供应商—客户交易与银行贷款的西班牙行政数据集，(ii) 全球金融危机期间的银行信贷供给冲击，以及 (iii) 一个包含金融摩擦的生产网络一般均衡模型，并进行结构估计。我们发现，网络传导使银行冲击对 GDP 增长率的影响放大约 50%。此外，对企业远距离供应商和客户的银行冲击，与对企业直接客户和供应商的银行冲击，对这一总量效应的贡献相近。（JEL D22, D85, E23, G01, G21, G32, L14）

abstract.text: Using new methods, we measure the intensities of higher-order risk preferences (prudence and temperance) in an incentivized experiment with 658 adolescents. Aligned with theory, we find that higher-order risk preferences are strongly related to field behavior, including prevention, health, addictive behavior, and financial decision-making. Most importantly, we show that ignoring prudence and temperance can yield misleading conclusions about the relation of risk preferences to field behavior, and that survey measures of risk tolerance often relate to field behavior because they capture higher-order risk preferences. (JEL C83, D81, D91, J13)

10.1257/aer.20211217.abstractZh: 我们使用新方法，在一个包含 658 名青少年的有激励实验中测量高阶风险偏好（审慎与节制）的强度。与理论一致，我们发现高阶风险偏好与实地行为密切相关，包括预防行为、健康、成瘾行为和金融决策。最重要的是，我们表明，忽略审慎与节制可能会对风险偏好与实地行为之间的关系得出误导性结论，并且风险容忍度的调查测量往往与实地行为相关，是因为它们捕捉到了高阶风险偏好。（JEL C83, D81, D91, J13）

abstract.text: We argue that consumer credit spreads matter for household choices and that time-varying spreads have important distributional consequences. Studying Danish household data, we show that consumer credit spreads have heterogeneous impact on asset dynamics and consumption choices across the wealth distribution and that time-varying spreads induce a countercyclical marginal propensity to consume. We study a HANK model where banks provide consumer credit and corporate loans. Through countercyclical credit spreads, frictional finance amplifies aggregate shocks and induces consumption inequality. Economies with less leveraged banks experience reduced aggregate volatility but may face higher volatility and lower welfare at the household level. (JEL D12, D31, E12, E21, E32, E52, G51)

10.1257/aer.20211219.abstractZh: 我们认为，消费信贷利差会影响家庭选择，而随时间变化的利差具有重要的分配后果。基于丹麦家庭数据，我们表明消费信贷利差对资产动态和消费选择的影响在财富分布上具有异质性，且随时间变化的利差会引致逆周期的边际消费倾向。我们研究了一个由银行提供消费信贷和企业贷款的HANK模型。通过逆周期信贷利差，摩擦性金融放大了总量冲击并引致消费不平等。银行杠杆较低的经济体总量波动性降低，但可能在家庭层面面临更高的波动性和更低的福利。（JEL D12, D31, E12, E21, E32, E52, G51）

abstract.text: Principal-agent problems often extend beyond what can be directly addressed through conventional incentive arrangements. We examine a context where physicians are likely under-incentivized to minimize total medical costs until their private financial interests align with those of patients. Leveraging novel data on physician ownership of ambulatory surgery centers——that is, same-day facilities——we show that these equity holdings cause a substitution away from higher cost, rival settings that lowers Medicare spending by 10–40 percent per physician. We find no clear evidence of perverse behavior following these investments. Instead, our findings demonstrate how entrepreneurial activity can indirectly limit principal-agent problems and improve efficiency. (JEL D82, D91, G51, I11, I18, L84)

10.1257/aer.20211324.abstractZh: 委托—代理问题往往超出传统激励机制安排所能直接解决的范围。我们考察了这样一个情境：在医生的私人财务利益与患者利益一致之前，医生可能缺乏足够激励去最小化医疗总成本。利用关于医生持有门诊手术中心——即当日手术设施——所有权的新颖数据，我们表明这些股权持有导致从成本更高的竞争性场所转向，从而使每位医生的 Medicare 支出降低 10%–40%。我们未发现这些投资之后出现不当行为的确凿证据。相反，我们的发现表明，创业活动可以间接限制委托—代理问题并提高效率。（JEL D82, D91, G51, I11, I18, L84）

abstract.text: Should optimal income taxation change when firms have market power? We analyze how the planner can optimally tax labor income of workers and profits of entrepreneurs. We derive optimal tax rates that depend on markups and identify four distinct components: the Mirrleesian incentive effect, the Pigouvian tax correction of the negative externality of market power, redistribution through altered factor prices, and reallocation of output toward the most productive firms. We quantify the optimal tax for the US economy and provide concrete proposals how to use income taxation to redistribute income while incentivizing production in the presence of market power. (JEL D24, D31, D43, H21, H23, H24, H25)

10.1257/aer.20211445.abstractZh: 当企业拥有市场势力时，最优所得税是否应改变？我们分析计划者如何最优地对劳动者的劳动收入和企业家的利润征税。我们推导出取决于加成率的最优税率，并识别出四个不同组成部分：Mirrleesian 激励效应、对市场势力负外部性的庇古税纠正、通过要素价格变化实现的再分配，以及将产出重新配置到生产率最高的企业。我们对美国经济的最优税收进行量化，并就如何在存在市场势力的情况下利用所得税进行收入再分配、同时激励生产提出具体建议。（JEL D24, D31, D43, H21, H23, H24, H25）

abstract.text: We study social preferences in settings where someone who chooses on behalf of others knows how those individuals rank the available options but may lack cardinal information concerning those comparisons. Contrary to majoritarian principles, most people place more weight on preventing least preferred outcomes for others than on enabling most preferred outcomes. Ranks matter both intrinsically and because they provide a basis for inferring cardinal utility. Ordinal aggregation principles are stable across domains and countries with divergent political traditions. Designing attractive social choice mechanisms is challenging in practice partly because aggregation principles that make manipulation difficult yield outcomes people consider normatively unappealing. (JEL C91, D71, D72)

10.1257/aer.20211491.abstractZh: 我们研究这样一种情境中的社会偏好：代他人进行选择的人知道这些个体如何排序可得选项，但可能缺乏关于这些比较的基数信息。与多数主义原则相反，大多数人对防止他人最不偏好的结果赋予的权重，高于对促成他人最偏好的结果赋予的权重。排序既具有内在重要性，也为推断基数效用提供了依据。序数聚合原则在不同领域以及政治传统各异的国家之间保持稳定。在实践中设计有吸引力的社会选择机制颇具挑战性，部分原因在于：使操纵变得困难的聚合原则，会产生人们认为在规范上缺乏吸引力的结果。（JEL C91、D71、D72）

abstract.text: We provide a model to explain how the interaction between the spot and lending markets for stocks can lead to abrupt changes in short selling activity. Furthermore, rational short sellers may choose to abandon the market even as mispricing widens. We document empirically that the dynamics of short selling are fat tailed and subject to abrupt changes, especially for the stocks that the model identifies as susceptible to such dynamics. (JEL G11, G12, G14, G41)

10.1257/aer.20211548.abstractZh: 我们构建了一个模型，用以解释股票的现货市场与借贷市场之间的相互作用如何导致卖空活动出现突变。此外，即使错误定价扩大，理性的卖空者也可能选择退出市场。我们通过经验证据表明，卖空动态具有厚尾特征并会发生突变，对于模型识别为易受此类动态影响的股票尤其如此。（JEL G11、G12、G14、G41）

abstract.text: We propose a novel identification strategy to isolate exogenous immigration shocks across US counties, by interacting quasi-random variations in the composition of ancestry across counties with the contemporaneous inflow of migrants from different countries. We show a positive causal impact of immigration on local innovation and wages at the five-year horizon. The positive dynamic impact of immigration on innovation and wages dominates the short-run negative impact of increased labor supply. A structural estimation of a model of endogenous growth and migrations suggests the increased immigration to the United States since 1965 may have increased innovation and wages by 5 percent. (JEL J15, J22, J31, J61, O31, R11, R23)

10.1257/aer.20211601.abstractZh: 我们提出一种新的识别策略，通过将各县祖先构成中的准随机变化与同期来自不同国家的移民流入相互作用，分离出美国各县面临的外生移民冲击。我们表明，在五年期上，移民对本地创新和工资具有正向因果影响。移民对创新和工资的正向动态影响，超过了劳动力供给增加带来的短期负向影响。对内生增长与移民模型的结构估计表明，自1965年以来流入美国的移民增加，可能使创新和工资提高了5%。（JEL J15, J22, J31, J61, O31, R11, R23）

abstract.text: We embed diagnostic expectations in a workhorse neoclassical model with heterogeneous firms and risky debt. A realistic degree of overreaction estimated from US firms’ earnings forecasts generates realistic credit cycles. Good times produce economic and financial fragility, predicting future disappointment of expectations, low bond returns, and investment declines. To generate the size of spread increases observed during 2007–2009, the model requires only moderate negative shocks. Diagnostic expectations offer a realistic, parsimonious way to produce financial reversals in business cycle models. (JEL D84, E13, E22, E32, E44, G12, G32)

10.1257/aer.20211820.abstractZh: 我们将诊断性预期嵌入一个包含异质性企业和风险债务的标准新古典模型。基于美国企业盈利预测估计得到的现实程度过度反应，会生成现实的信贷周期。景气时期会造成经济与金融脆弱性，预示未来预期落空、债券收益率偏低以及投资下降。为生成 2007—2009 年期间观察到的利差上升幅度，模型只需要温和的负向冲击。诊断性预期提供了一种现实且简约的方式，在企业周期模型中生成金融逆转。（JEL D84, E13, E22, E32, E44, G12, G32）

abstract.text: Most organizations rely on managers to identify talented workers. However, managers who are evaluated on team performance have an incentive to hoard workers. This study provides the first empirical evidence of talent hoarding using personnel records and survey evidence from a large firm. Talent hoarding is self-reported by three-fourths of managers, is detectable in manager ratings of worker talent, and occurs more frequently under stronger hoarding incentives, proxied by performance-related pay, team size, and talent visibility. Using quasi-random exposure to talent hoarding, I show that hoarding deters internal job applications, inhibiting career progression and altering talent allocation in the firm. (JEL D22, J23, L60, M12, M51, M54)

10.1257/aer.20220264.abstractZh: 多数组织依赖管理者识别有才能的员工。然而，按团队绩效接受考核的管理者有动机囤积员工。本研究利用一家大型企业的人事记录和调查证据，首次提供了人才囤积的经验证据。四分之三的管理者自报存在人才囤积行为，该行为可在管理者对员工才能的评级中被识别，并且在更强的囤积动机下更频繁发生，这些动机以绩效相关薪酬、团队规模和人才可见性作为代理变量。利用准随机暴露于人才囤积的设定，我表明囤积会阻碍内部职位申请，抑制职业晋升并改变企业内的人才配置。（JEL D22, J23, L60, M12, M51, M54）

abstract.text: We revisit the role of temporary layoffs in the business cycle. While some have emphasized a stabilizing effect due to recall hiring, we quantify from the data an important countercyclical destabilizing effect due to “loss-of-recall,” whereby workers in temporary-layoff unemployment lose their job permanently. We develop a quantitative model allowing for endogenous flows of workers across employment and both temporary-layoff and jobless unemployment. The model captures both pre- and post-pandemic unemployment dynamics, including the contractionary role of loss-of-recall. We use our structural model to show that the Paycheck Protection Program generated sizable employment gains, in part by significantly reducing loss-of-recall. (JEL E24, E32, I12, J41, J63, J64)

10.1257/aer.20220749.abstractZh: 我们重新审视临时裁员在商业周期中的作用。尽管一些研究强调了召回雇佣所带来的稳定效应，我们从数据中量化出一个重要的由“召回丧失”所致的逆周期不稳定效应，即处于临时裁员型失业中的劳动者永久失去其工作岗位。我们构建一个允许劳动者在就业、临时裁员型失业与无业失业之间内生流动的定量模型。该模型同时刻画了大流行前和大流行后的失业动态，包括召回丧失的收缩性作用。我们运用结构模型表明，薪资保护计划带来了可观的就业增长，部分原因在于其显著减少了召回丧失。（JEL E24, E32, I12, J41, J63, J64）

abstract.text: We show that subjective assessments of employee “potential” contribute to gender gaps in promotion and pay. Using data on 29,809 management-track employees from a large retail chain, we find that women receive substantially lower potential ratings despite receiving higher performance ratings. Differences in potential ratings account for approximately half of the gender promotion gap. Women’s lower potential ratings do not reflect accurate forecasts of future performance: Women subsequently outperform male colleagues, both on average and on the margin of promotion. We highlight two mechanisms driving the gender potential gap: strategic retention and stereotyping. (JEL J16, J31, J71, L81, M12, M51)

10.1257/aer.20220831.abstractZh: 我们表明，对员工“潜力”的主观评估会加剧晋升和薪酬中的性别差距。利用一家大型零售连锁企业29,809名管理通道员工的数据，我们发现，尽管女性的绩效评分更高，但其潜力评分却显著更低。潜力评分的差异大约解释了性别晋升差距的一半。女性较低的潜力评分并不反映对未来绩效的准确预测：女性随后在平均意义上以及在晋升边际上都优于男性同事。我们强调驱动性别潜力差距的两个机制：策略性留任与刻板印象。(JEL J16, J31, J71, L81, M12, M51)

abstract.text: This paper shows that the wage assimilation of immigrants is the result of the intricate interplay between individual skill accumulation and dynamic labor market equilibrium effects. When immigrants and natives are imperfect substitutes, rising immigrant inflows widen the wage gap between them. Using a production function framework in which workers supply both general and host-country-specific skills, we show that this labor market competition channel explains about one-fifth of the large increase in the average immigrant–native wage gap across arrival cohorts in the United States since the 1960s. The results further reveal substantial heterogeneity across different groups of immigrants. (JEL J22, J23, J24, J31, J61, K37, O33)

10.1257/aer.20220865.abstractZh: 本文表明，移民的工资同化是个人技能积累与动态劳动力市场均衡效应之间复杂相互作用的结果。当移民与本地人是不完全替代品时，移民流入的增加会扩大二者之间的工资差距。本文采用一个生产函数框架，其中劳动者同时提供一般技能和东道国特定技能，并表明这一劳动力市场竞争渠道解释了自20世纪60年代以来美国不同到达队列之间移民—本地人平均工资差距大幅上升的大约五分之一。结果进一步揭示了不同移民群体之间存在显著异质性。（JEL J22, J23, J24, J31, J61, K37, O33）

abstract.text: We study the effects of intensifying competition for contracts in the context of US Defense procurement. Leveraging a discontinuous regulation that mandates agencies to publicize certain contract opportunities, we document that expanding the set of bidders reduces award prices but deteriorates post-award performance in terms of cost overruns and delays. We develop and estimate an auction model with endogenous entry and stochastic execution performance, in which the buyer endogenously chooses the intensity of competition. Model estimates indicate substantial heterogeneity in performance across contractors and show that simple adjustments to the current regulation could provide significant savings in procurement spending. (JEL D22, D24, D44, D82, D86, H56, H57)

10.1257/aer.20221345.abstractZh: 我们研究美国国防采购中合同竞争加剧的影响。利用一项要求机构公开某些合同机会的不连续监管规定，我们发现，扩大投标人集合会降低授标价格，但会恶化授标后的履约表现，具体体现为成本超支和延迟。我们构建并估计了一个包含内生进入和随机履约表现的拍卖模型，其中买方内生选择竞争强度。模型估计表明，承包商之间的履约表现存在显著异质性，并显示对现行监管规定作简单调整即可在采购支出上带来显著节约。（JEL D22, D24, D44, D82, D86, H56, H57）

abstract.text: This paper develops an asset market-based test for preference for the timing of resolution of uncertainty. Our main theorem provides a characterization of preference for early resolution of uncertainty in terms of the risk premium realized during the period when the informativeness of macroeconomic announcements is resolved. Empirically, we find support for preference for early resolution of uncertainty based on evidence on the dynamics of the implied volatility of S&P 500 index options before Federal Open Market Committee announcements. (JEL D81, D83, G13, G14, G41)

10.1257/aer.20221351.abstractZh: 本文基于资产市场构建了关于不确定性消解时机偏好的检验。我们的主要定理利用宏观经济公告信息含量消解期间所实现的 risk premium，刻画了对不确定性提前消解的偏好。在实证上，基于联邦公开市场委员会公告前 S&P 500 指数期权隐含波动率动态的证据，我们找到了对不确定性提前消解偏好的支持。（JEL D81, D83, G13, G14, G41）

abstract.text: Why is workplace sexual harassment chronically underreported? We hypothesize that employers coerce victims into silence through the threat of a retaliatory firing. To test this, we estimate how two external shocks that reduce workers’ outside options—unemployment rate increases and sharp cuts to unemployment insurance benefits—affect the selectivity of sexual harassment charges filed with the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission. We find that both shocks increase selectivity, which implies an increase in underreporting. Bolstering these findings, anonymous Google searches for “sexual harassment in the workplace” (total prevalence) spike relative to charges filed (reported prevalence) during the Great Recession. (JEL J71, J78)

10.1257/aer.20221703.abstractZh: 为什么职场性骚扰长期存在举报不足？我们提出假说：雇主通过解雇报复的威胁迫使受害者保持沉默。为检验这一假说，我们估计两类削弱劳动者外部选择的外部冲击——失业率上升和失业保险待遇大幅削减——如何影响向平等就业机会委员会（EEOC）提交的性骚扰指控的选择性。我们发现，两类冲击均提高了选择性，这意味着举报不足程度上升。为支持上述发现，在大衰退期间，针对“职场性骚扰”的匿名谷歌搜索量（总体发生率）相对于提交的指控（已举报发生率）出现激增。（JEL J71, J78）

abstract.text: Policy choices often create trade-offs between workers and consumers. I examine how foreign competition alters the consumer welfare and domestic employment effects of mergers. I construct a model incorporating consumer demand, endogenous product portfolios, and employment decisions. Applying the model to Whirlpool’s acquisition of Maytag in the appliance industry, I compare the observed merger to a counterfactual acquisition by a foreign buyer. Although Whirlpool’s acquisition decreased consumer welfare by $271 million annually, it preserved 797 domestic jobs. These jobs must therefore be valued at more than $344, 000 per year for the domestic employment benefits to offset the consumer harm. (JEL E24, F23, G34, J30, L13, L68, R23)

10.1257/aer.20230017.abstractZh: 政策选择往往会在劳动者与消费者之间造成权衡。我考察外国竞争如何改变合并的消费者福利效应与国内就业效应。我构建了一个纳入消费者需求、内生产品组合与就业决策的模型。将该模型应用于家电行业 Whirlpool 收购 Maytag 的案例，我将观察到的合并与由外国买方进行收购的反事实情形进行比较。尽管 Whirlpool 的收购使消费者福利每年减少 2.71 亿美元，但它保住了 797 个国内工作岗位。因此，要使国内就业收益抵消消费者损害，这些岗位的价值必须超过每年 344,000 美元。（JEL E24, F23, G34, J30, L13, L68, R23）

abstract.text: We show that, depending on how the impact of omitted variables is measured, it can be substantially easier for omitted variables to flip coefficient signs than to drive them to zero. This behavior occurs with “Oster's delta” (Oster 2019a), a widely reported robustness measure. Consequently, any time this measure is large—suggesting omitted variables may be unimportant—a much smaller value reverses the sign of the parameter of interest. We propose a modified measure of robustness to address this concern. We illustrate our results in four empirical applications and two meta-analyses. We implement our methods in the companion Stata module “regsensitivity.” (JEL C18, C21, C52)

10.1257/aer.20230242.abstractZh: 我们表明，取决于遗漏变量影响的衡量方式，遗漏变量使系数符号反转可能比使其趋于零容易得多。这一现象出现在“Oster's delta”（Oster 2019a）中，该指标是一种被广泛报告的稳健性度量。因此，只要该度量取值较大——表明遗漏变量可能并不重要——一个小得多的取值就会使目标参数的符号反转。我们提出一种修正的稳健性度量以应对这一问题。我们在四个实证应用和两项元分析中展示了我们的结果。我们将方法实现在配套的 Stata 模块“regsensitivity”中。（JEL C18、C21、C52）

abstract.text: This paper studies the efficiency of self-enforced relational agreements, a common solution to contracting frictions, when sellers have market power and contracts cannot be externally enforced. To this end, I develop a dynamic contracting model with limited enforcement in which buyers can default on their trade credit debt and estimate it using a novel dataset from the Ecuadorian manufacturing supply chain. The key empirical finding is that bilateral trade is inefficiently low in early periods of the relationship, but converges toward efficiency over time, despite sellers’ market power. Counterfactual simulations imply that both market power and enforcement contribute to inefficiencies in trade. (JEL D86, G32, K12, L14, L60, O14)

10.1257/aer.20230264.abstractZh: 本文研究自我实施的关系型协议的效率，此类协议是契约摩擦的一种常见解决方案，研究情形为卖方具有市场势力且契约无法由外部强制执行。为此，我构建了一个带有有限执行力的动态契约模型，其中买方可以对其贸易信贷债务违约，并使用来自厄瓜多尔制造业供应链的一个新数据集对该模型进行估计。关键的经验发现是，在关系的早期阶段，双边贸易低效地偏低，但尽管卖方具有市场势力，贸易随时间推移会趋近于效率水平。反事实模拟表明，市场势力和执行力都会导致贸易中的低效率。（JEL D86、G32、K12、L14、L60、O14）

abstract.text: We propose an extensive-form solution concept, with players who neglect information from hypothetical events but make inferences from observed events. Our concept modifies cursed equilibrium (Eyster and Rabin 2005) and allows that players can be cursed about endogenous information. (JEL C73, D44, D71, D81, D83, D91)

10.1257/aer.20230309.abstractZh: 我们提出一个扩展式解概念，其中参与人忽视来自假设事件的信息，但从已观测事件中进行推断。我们的概念对诅咒均衡（Eyster and Rabin 2005）进行了修正，并允许参与人对内生信息存在诅咒。（JEL C73、D44、D71、D81、D83、D91）

abstract.text: I study how firm market power and worker bargaining power shape wages and welfare. Using French micro-data, I document patterns linking wages and firm market power that existing models cannot explain. A model in which firms produce vertically differentiated goods and share profits with workers explains those patterns. The model (i) reveals new challenges in estimating monopsony and bargaining power, proposing an alternative approach; (ii) shows that the passthrough of firm-specific shocks to wages depends on the type of shock; (iii) explains how markups shape firm wage premia; and (iv) formalizes how strengthening worker bargaining power affects wages and welfare. (JEL D22, J31, J42, J52, L12, L22)

10.1257/aer.20230344.abstractZh: 我研究企业市场势力和劳动者议价能力如何塑造工资与福利。利用法国微观数据，我记录了工资与企业市场势力之间的关联模式，而现有模型无法解释这些模式。一个企业生产纵向差异化产品并与劳动者分享利润的模型能够解释这些模式。该模型（i）揭示了估计买方垄断和议价能力时面临的新挑战，并提出了一种替代方法；（ii）表明企业特定冲击向工资的传导取决于冲击类型；（iii）解释了加成如何塑造企业工资溢价；（iv）形式化了加强劳动者议价能力如何影响工资与福利。（JEL D22, J31, J42, J52, L12, L22）

abstract.text: We evaluate equity-efficiency trade-offs from admissions quotas by examining effects on output once beneficiaries start producing in the relevant industry. We estimate the impact of abolishing a 40 percent quota for male primary school teachers on their pupils’ long-run outcomes. We combine this reform with the timing of union-bargained teacher retirements to isolate quasi-random variation in male quota teachers. Pupils exposed to male quota teachers transition more smoothly to postcompulsory education and have higher educational attainment and labor force attachment at age 25. Evidence suggests the quota improved the allocation of talent by mending imperfections in the unconstrained selection process. (JEL I21, I23, I28, J16, J24, J45)

10.1257/aer.20230376.abstractZh: 我们通过考察受益者在相关行业开始产出后的产出效应，评估招生配额带来的公平—效率权衡。我们估计废除男性小学教师40%配额对其学生长期结果的影响。我们将这一改革与工会谈判确定的教师退休时点相结合，以分离出男性配额教师的准随机变异。接触过男性配额教师的学生向义务教育后阶段过渡更顺畅，并在25岁时具有更高的教育成就和劳动力市场附着度。证据表明，该配额通过修补无约束选拔过程中的不完全性，改善了人才配置。（JEL I21, I23, I28, J16, J24, J45）

abstract.text: Captive finance subsidiaries create a channel for trade policy to affect consumer credit. Examining the impact of the Trump administration’s metal tariffs on captive automobile lenders, we find that consumers received higher interest rates from captive lenders after the tariffs relative to unaffected noncaptive lenders. Further, we document a disparate impact on low-income borrowers and in areas with less lending competition. Our results suggest that tariffs may impact not only the price of goods but also the financing terms of purchases. Thus, focusing solely on directly affected product prices may underestimate tariff pass-through significantly. (JEL F13, F14, G21, L22, L61, L62)

10.1257/aer.20230432.abstractZh: 专属金融子公司为贸易政策影响消费者信贷创造了一个渠道。通过考察特朗普政府金属关税对汽车专属贷款机构的影响，我们发现，相对于未受影响的非专属贷款机构，消费者在关税实施后从专属贷款机构获得了更高的利率。此外，我们记录了其对低收入借款人和贷款竞争较弱地区的不成比例影响。我们的结果表明，关税可能不仅影响商品价格，还影响购买的融资条件。因此，仅关注直接受影响的产品价格可能显著低估关税传导。（JEL F13, F14, G21, L22, L61, L62）

abstract.text: This paper studies the economic impacts of carbon pricing. Exploiting institutional features of the European carbon market and high-frequency data, I identify carbon policy shocks and trace their dynamic effects. A restrictive carbon policy shock raises energy prices, reduces emissions, spurs green innovation, but decreases economic activity—disproportionately burdening poorer households. Not only are the poor more affected because of their higher energy spending, but they also experience larger income losses. These indirect, general equilibrium effects via income and employment play an important role in the transmission of carbon pricing policies, accounting for about two-thirds of the aggregate consumption response. (JEL E23, E24, O44, Q41, Q54, Q55, Q58)

10.1257/aer.20230448.abstractZh: 本文研究碳定价的经济影响。利用欧洲碳市场的制度特征和高频数据，我识别碳政策冲击并追踪其动态效应。限制性碳政策冲击会提高能源价格、减少排放、促进绿色创新，但会降低经济活动——并给较贫困家庭带来不成比例的负担。贫困家庭不仅因其能源支出更高而受到更大影响，还遭受更大的收入损失。这些经由收入和就业产生的间接一般均衡效应在碳定价政策的传导中发挥重要作用，约占总量消费反应的三分之二。（JEL E23, E24, O44, Q41, Q54, Q55, Q58）

abstract.text: This paper examines the effects of privatizing social health insurance. We exploit a natural experiment in Medicaid, wherein nearly 100,000 enrollees were randomly assigned between a publicly operated fee-for-service system and private managed care. Managed care reduced costs by 5.6 percent via cost-effective substitutions among prescription drugs and via lower prices for outpatient services. We present evidence that pharmacy utilization management was the key mechanism reducing overuse and encouraging substitution to lower-cost drugs without decreasing observed quality. In contrast, privatizing medical benefits led to only modest savings and was associated with decreased health care quality and consumer satisfaction. (JEL G22, H41, I13, I18, I38)

10.1257/aer.20230541.abstractZh: 本文考察社会医疗保险私有化的影响。我们利用 Medicaid 中的一项自然实验，其中近 10 万名参保者被随机分配到公共运营的按服务付费制与私人管理的管理式照护之间。管理式照护通过处方药之间具有成本效益的替代以及门诊服务价格的下降，使成本降低 5.6%。我们提供的证据表明，药房利用管理是减少过度使用并鼓励替代为低成本药物而不降低可观测质量的关键机制。相比之下，医疗待遇的私有化仅带来有限的节省，并且与医疗质量和消费者满意度的下降相关。（JEL G22、H41、I13、I18、I38）

abstract.text: Exposure to better peers in the workplace can influence career trajectories through two opposing channels: positively, via knowledge spillovers, and negatively, through competition for advancement. We disentangle these effects by studying untrained labor market entrants and distinguishing between coworkers in the same occupation with whom they are likely to compete versus those with whom they are unlikely to compete. We find robust evidence of persistent knowledge spillovers but also identify countervailing competition effects of comparable magnitude. Both effects are more pronounced for men than for women. (JEL D83, J16, J24, M53, M54, O33)

10.1257/aer.20230714.abstractZh: 工作场所中接触更优秀的同伴会通过两个方向相反的渠道影响职业轨迹：正向渠道是知识溢出，负向渠道是对晋升的竞争。我们通过研究未经培训的劳动力市场新进入者，并区分同一职业中他们可能与之竞争的同事和不太可能与之竞争的同事，来分离这两种效应。我们发现持续性知识溢出的稳健证据，但也识别出量级相当的反向竞争效应。两种效应对男性都比对女性更明显。（JEL D83, J16, J24, M53, M54, O33）

abstract.text: Item-level transactions data yield cost-of-living indices that can account for quality change and consumer substitution. Transactions data require confronting the rapid turnover of items because prices of new and existing products are interrelated in equilibrium. This paper evaluates multiple approaches to measuring quality change at scale. It shows that a hedonic superlative approach—using econometrics or machine learning for hedonic estimation combined with index formulas that require simultaneous observation of item-level price and expenditure—yields improved measures of the cost of living. Accounting for ubiquitous quality change and for consumer substitution yields lower measures of inflation than traditional, official methods. (JEL C43, C45, E31, L15, L81)

10.1257/aer.20230766.abstractZh: 项目层面交易数据可得到能够考虑质量变化与消费者替代的生活成本指数。交易数据要求应对项目的快速更替，因为新产品与现有产品的价格在均衡中相互关联。本文评估多种大规模衡量质量变化的方法。研究表明，享乐型超越指数方法——使用计量经济学或机器学习进行享乐估计，并结合需要同时观察项目层面价格与支出的指数公式——能够给出改进的生活成本衡量。考虑普遍存在的质量变化与消费者替代，会得到低于传统官方方法的通胀衡量。（JEL C43, C45, E31, L15, L81）

abstract.text: Designing public transport networks involves trade-offs between coverage, service frequency, and direct service. We use the expansion of the bus system in Jakarta, Indonesia, to study these trade-offs. We analyze how new direct connections, changes in bus travel time, and wait-time reductions affect bus ridership and aggregate flows and estimate a transit network demand model by matching the route launch events. Commuters in Jakarta are 2–3 times more sensitive to wait time than bus time and inattentive to long routes. We develop a flexible framework to characterize optimal networks. A less concentrated network would increase ridership and commuter welfare. (JEL L92, L98, O18, R41, R42, R48)

10.1257/aer.20230768.abstractZh: 设计公共交通网络需要在覆盖范围、服务频率和直达服务之间进行权衡。我们利用印度尼西亚雅加达公交系统的扩张来研究这些权衡。我们分析新的直达连接、公交出行时间变化以及等待时间缩短如何影响公交客流量和总量流动，并通过匹配线路开通事件来估计一个公交网络需求模型。雅加达的通勤者对等待时间的敏感程度是公交出行时间的2—3倍，并且对长线路不敏感。我们构建了一个灵活的框架来刻画最优网络。一个集中度更低的网络将提高客流量和通勤者福利。（JEL L92, L98, O18, R41, R42, R48）

abstract.text: Do elite colleges help talented students join the social elite or help incumbent elites retain their positions? We combine intergenerationally linked data from Chile with a regression discontinuity design to show that, looking across generations, elite colleges do both. Lower-status individuals who gain admission to elite college programs transform their children’s social environment. Children become more likely to attend high-status private schools and colleges and to live near and befriend high-status peers. In contrast, academic achievement is unaffected. Simulations combining descriptive and quasi-experimental findings show that elite colleges tighten the link between social and human capital while decreasing intergenerational social mobility. (JEL I23, I26, J24, J62, O15, Z13)

10.1257/aer.20230802.abstractZh: 精英大学究竟是在帮助有才能的学生进入社会精英阶层，还是在帮助现有精英维持其地位？我们将智利的代际关联数据与回归断点设计相结合，表明从跨代视角看，精英大学两者兼有。获得精英大学项目录取的低地位个体改变了其子女的社会环境。子女更有可能就读高地位的私立学校和大学，并更可能居住在高地位同伴附近并与他们结交。相比之下，学业成绩不受影响。将描述性发现与准实验发现相结合的模拟表明，精英大学强化了社会资本与人力资本之间的联系，同时降低了代际社会流动性。（JEL I23, I26, J24, J62, O15, Z13）

abstract.text: Equal pay laws increasingly require that workers with different group identities doing “similar” work are paid equal wages within firm. We study such “equal pay for similar work” (EPSW) policies theoretically and test our models’ predictions empirically using evidence from a 2009 gender-based Chilean EPSW. Under EPSW, firms segregate their workforce by gender. When there are more men than women in a labor market, EPSW increases the gender wage gap. (JEL J16, J31, J38, K31, O15)

10.1257/aer.20230832.abstractZh: 同工同酬法日益要求，在同一企业内从事“相似”工作的不同群体身份劳动者获得同等工资。我们从理论上研究了此类“相似工作同工同酬”（EPSW）政策，并利用2009年智利一项基于性别的EPSW政策的证据，对模型预测进行了实证检验。在EPSW下，企业按性别隔离其劳动力。当劳动力市场中男性多于女性时，EPSW会扩大性别工资差距。（JEL J16, J31, J38, K31, O15）

abstract.text: We use firm-level data to document that private businesses experience large fluctuations in their profit shares. These are due to large, fat-tailed, and transitory changes in output that are not fully accompanied by changes in their inputs. We interpret this evidence using a model of entrepreneurial dynamics. Because firms can limit their exposure to risk by operating at a smaller scale, our model predicts large macroeconomic losses from uninsurable business risk, much larger than those stemming from credit constraints. While self-financing allows entrepreneurs to quickly overcome credit constraints, even wealthy entrepreneurs remain considerably exposed to risk. (JEL D33, E02, E44, G32, L25, L26)

10.1257/aer.20230849.abstractZh: 我们使用企业层面数据记录到，私营企业的利润份额经历大幅波动。这些波动源于产出的大幅、厚尾且暂时性的变化，而投入并未随之充分调整。我们用一个企业家动态模型来解释这一证据。由于企业可以通过以较小规模经营来限制其风险暴露，我们的模型预测，不可保险的经营风险会造成巨大的宏观经济损失，远大于信贷约束所造成的损失。尽管自融资使企业家能够迅速克服信贷约束，但即便是富有的企业家仍相当程度地暴露于风险之中。（JEL D33, E02, E44, G32, L25, L26）

abstract.text: We introduce an empirical framework for valuing markets in environmental offsets. Using newly collected data on wetland conservation and offsets, we apply this framework to evaluate a set of decentralized markets in Florida, where land developers purchase offsets from long-lived producers who restore wetlands over time. We find offsets led to substantial private gains from trade, creating $2.4 billion of net surplus from 1995 to 2020 relative to direct conservation. Offset trading also generated new hydrological externalities. A locally differentiated Pigouvian tax would have prevented $1.6 billion of new flood damage while preserving more than two-thirds of the private gains from trade. (JEL D47, D62, H23, Q24, Q54, Q57, R14)

10.1257/aer.20231016.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个用于评估环境抵消市场的实证框架。利用新收集的湿地保护与抵消数据，我们将该框架应用于评估佛罗里达州的一组分散化市场，在这些市场中，土地开发商从长期存在的生产者处购买抵消，后者随时间推移恢复湿地。我们发现，抵消带来了可观的私人贸易收益，与直接保护相比，1995年至2020年间创造了24亿美元的净剩余。抵消交易还产生了新的水文外部性。一项本地差异化的庇古税本可避免16亿美元的新增洪水损失，同时保留超过三分之二的私人贸易收益。（JEL D47, D62, H23, Q24, Q54, Q57, R14）

abstract.text: We study optimal monetary policy during times of global scarcity of tradable goods. The optimal monetary response entails a surge in inflation, which helps rebalance production toward the tradable sector. While the inflation costs are fully borne domestically, however, the gains in terms of higher supply of tradable goods partly spill over to the rest of the world. National central banks may thus fall into a coordination trap and implement an excessively tight monetary policy causing an unnecessarily sharp global contraction. (JEL E24, E31, E32, E52, F11, F31, F42)

10.1257/aer.20231018.abstractZh: 我们研究可贸易品全球稀缺时期的最优货币政策。最优货币反应会带来通胀上升，这有助于将生产重新平衡至可贸易部门。然而，通胀成本完全由本国承担，而可贸易品供给增加所带来的收益却部分外溢至世界其他地区。因此，各国央行可能落入协调陷阱，实施过度紧缩的货币政策，造成不必要的全球急剧收缩。（JEL E24, E31, E32, E52, F11, F31, F42）

abstract.text: Judge IV designs rely on monotonicity—each judge being weakly stricter than more lenient judges in all cases. I measure monotonicity in judicial panels in five different settings and find that it is violated in up to 50 percent of nonunanimous cases. The monotonicity violations are not detected by conventional tests, but they would typically induce little bias in judge IV estimates. (JEL C26, K41, K42, O17)

10.1257/aer.20231104.abstractZh: 法官工具变量设计依赖单调性——每位法官在所有案件中都弱严格于更宽松的法官。我在五种不同情境下的司法合议庭中测量单调性，发现非一致裁决案件中违反单调性的比例最高可达 50%。传统检验未能检测出这些单调性违背，但它们通常只会给法官工具变量估计带来很小的偏差。（JEL C26, K41, K42, O17）

abstract.text: Using linked employer-employee data from Brazil, we document a significant gender pay gap, which is largely attributed to women working at lower-paying employers. To interpret this fact, we develop an equilibrium search model with endogenous firm pay, amenities, and hiring. We provide a constructive proof of identification of all model parameters. The estimated model suggests that amenities are important for both men and women, and that compensating differentials account for half of the gender pay gap. Equal treatment policies partly close gender gaps but are not output- or welfare-improving. (JEL E24, J16, J23, J31, J32, M51, O15)

10.1257/aer.20231107.abstractZh: 利用巴西的雇主—雇员匹配数据，我们记录到显著的性别工资差距，这在很大程度上归因于女性在工资较低的雇主处工作。为解释这一事实，我们构建了一个包含内生企业工资、工作福利和招聘的均衡搜寻模型。我们给出了所有模型参数可识别性的构造性证明。估计出的模型表明，工作福利对男性和女性都很重要，补偿性工资差异解释了性别工资差距的一半。平等对待政策部分缩小了性别差距，但并未改善产出或福利。（JEL E24, J16, J23, J31, J32, M51, O15）

abstract.text: We explore how traders’ equity capitalization influences asset prices in a framework that accounts for market power. In our model, traders with capital constraints engage in transactions in an imperfectly competitive market. We demonstrate that looser capital constraints elevate both asset prices and price impact, the latter diminishing market liquidity. Using Canadian Treasury auction data, we illustrate how to apply our model to quantify these effects. We estimate the shadow costs of capital constraints by leveraging a temporary policy exemption during 2020–2021. We show that while these constraints are only infrequently binding, their relative impact when activated can be sizable. (JEL E63, G12, G14, G23, G41, L13)

10.1257/aer.20231202.abstractZh: 我们考察交易者的权益资本化如何在一个考虑市场势力的框架中影响资产价格。在我们的模型中，面临资本约束的交易者在不完全竞争市场中进行交易。我们证明，较宽松的资本约束会同时抬高资产价格和价格影响，而后者会削弱市场流动性。利用加拿大国债拍卖数据，我们说明如何应用我们的模型来量化这些效应。我们借助 2020—2021 年一项临时政策豁免来估计资本约束的影子成本。我们表明，尽管这些约束只是偶尔具有约束力，但其被激活时的相对影响可能相当大。（JEL E63、G12、G14、G23、G41、L13）

abstract.text: We examine how social interactions and friendships shape students’ political opinions in a natural experiment at Sciences Po, a leading French university specializing in social and political sciences. The quasi-random assignment of students into short-term integration groups before their academic curriculum reduces political opinion gaps and fosters friendship formation. Using same-group membership as an instrumental variable for friendship, we find that friendship reduces opinion differences by 44 percent of the mean opinion gap. Our evidence supports a homophily-enforced mechanism: Friendships form among initially politically similar students, leading them to join political associations together, reinforcing their similarity. (JEL C93, D72, Z13)

10.1257/aer.20231344.abstractZh: 我们考察在法国一所专注于社会与政治科学的顶尖大学巴黎政治学院（Sciences Po）开展的一项自然实验，研究社会互动与友谊如何塑造学生的政治观点。学生在正式课程开始前被准随机分配到短期融入小组，这一安排缩小了政治观点差距并促进了友谊形成。以同组归属作为友谊的工具变量，我们发现友谊使观点差异缩小了平均观点差距的44%。我们的证据支持一种由同质性强化的机制：友谊在初始政治立场相似的学生之间形成，促使他们共同加入政治社团，从而进一步强化其相似性。（JEL C93、D72、Z13）

abstract.text: We study racial disparities in promotions in a setting in which promotions are formulaic: the US patent office. Using detailed administrative data that allow us to observe who is eligible for promotion when, we document that Black patent examiners experience delays in promotions they are entitled to, slowing their climb to the top of the career ladder by a year and reducing career earnings by 2.5 percent. Institutional features rule out statistical discrimination with accurate priors. Slow promotions even under Black supervisors argue against taste-based animus. Instead, the patterns fit models of belief-based discrimination. (JEL J15, J41, J71, M12, M51, O34)

10.1257/aer.20231368.abstractZh: 我们研究晋升中的种族差异，研究场景中的晋升遵循固定规则：美国专利局。利用详细行政数据，我们得以观察谁在何时具备晋升资格，并记录到黑人专利审查员在其本应获得的晋升上遭遇延迟，这使其攀升至职业阶梯顶端的时间延长一年，并使职业收入减少2.5%。制度特征排除了先验准确的统计性歧视。即使在黑人主管手下晋升也较慢，这反对基于偏好的敌意。相反，这些模式符合基于信念的歧视模型。（JEL J15, J41, J71, M12, M51, O34）

abstract.text: This paper investigates a sequential social learning problem in which individuals face ambiguity about others’ signal structures and have max-min expected utility preferences, thereby exhibiting ambiguity aversion. Unlike previous findings, which suggest that learning outcomes depend on the specifics of the learning environment, this study establishes information cascades as a robust outcome under ambiguity. With sufficient ambiguity, cascades arise almost surely, regardless of the statistical properties of signal structures. Moreover, standard results predicting the absence of cascades can easily break down: Even minimal ambiguity can trigger cascades when signals are bounded and lead to incorrect herding when signals are unbounded. (JEL D81, D82, D83)

10.1257/aer.20231394.abstractZh: 本文研究一个序贯社会学习问题：个体对他人信号结构存在模糊性，并具有最大最小期望效用偏好，从而表现出模糊厌恶。与以往认为学习结果取决于学习环境具体特征的研究发现不同，本文确立信息瀑布是在模糊性下的一种稳健结果。当模糊性足够大时，无论信号结构具有何种统计性质，信息瀑布几乎必然出现。此外，预测信息瀑布不会出现的标准结果很容易失效：即使极小的模糊性，在信号有界时也能触发信息瀑布，而在信号无界时则会导致错误的羊群行为。（JEL D81, D82, D83）

abstract.text: Relative to remote work, working downtown facilitates valuable interactions with other in-office workers but entails commuting costs. The resulting coordination mechanism can lead to multiple stationary equilibria with varying levels of remote work. Temporary reductions in commuters, as in the COVID-19 pandemic, can lead to persistently large fractions of remote workers. Cell phone-based mobility data for the United States shows commuting trips in the largest cities, which are more likely to exhibit multiplicity, have stabilized at only 60 percent of prepandemic levels, while they are fully back in smaller cities. Cities with permanently low commuting experience average welfare losses of 2.3 percent. (JEL I12, J22, M54, R23, R31)

10.1257/aer.20231414.abstractZh: 相对于远程办公，在市中心办公有利于与其他到岗办公的劳动者进行有价值的互动，但会带来通勤成本。由此形成的协调机制可能导致存在多个远程办公比例不同的稳态均衡。通勤者人数的暂时减少（如新冠疫情期间）可能导致远程办公者比例持续处于较高水平。美国基于手机的出行数据表明，在更可能出现多重均衡的大城市，通勤出行仅稳定在疫情前水平的60%，而在较小城市则已完全恢复。通勤长期处于低水平的城市平均承受2.3%的福利损失。（JEL I12, J22, M54, R23, R31）

abstract.text: Moretti (2021) reports a positive elasticity between technology cluster size and patenting, and uses an event study and instrumental variables regressions to justify a causal interpretation. The event study does not use the variation generated by inventors moving across cities, and the instrument is constructed incorrectly due to a coding error. I run a corrected event study and fix the coding error, and find null effects. The reported elasticity may not be causal. (JEL J24, L60, O31, O34, R32)

10.1257/aer.20231415.abstractZh: Moretti（2021）报告了技术集群规模与专利申请数量之间存在正相关性，并采用事件研究和工具变量回归方法来支持其因果解释。事件研究并未考虑发明者在不同城市间流动所带来的变化，而工具变量的构建因编码错误而出现问题。我进行了修正后的事件研究，并修正了编码错误，结果发现效应为零。因此，所报告的关联性可能并非具有因果意义。（JEL J24, L60, O31, O34, R32）

abstract.text: What are the implications of unequal access to innovation careers for the direction of innovation and inequality? Leveraging novel linked datasets in the United States and Finland, we document that innovators create products more likely to be purchased by consumers like them in terms of gender, socioeconomic status, and age. Homophily exists both within narrow product categories and across industries and has been stable in recent decades. Incorporating this “social push” channel into a growth model, we estimate that unequal access to innovation careers has a large effect on cost of living inequality and long-run growth. (JEL D63, J16, L26, M13, O31, O33, O47)

10.1257/aer.20231417.abstractZh: 创新职业机会的不平等获取对创新方向和不平等有何影响？利用美国和芬兰的新型关联数据集，我们记录到，创新者所创造的产品更可能被与其在性别、社会经济地位和年龄上相似的消费者购买。同质性既存在于狭窄的产品类别内部，也跨越不同行业，且在近几十年保持稳定。将这一“社会推动”渠道纳入增长模型后，我们估计创新职业机会的不平等获取对生活成本不平等和长期增长具有显著影响。（JEL D63, J16, L26, M13, O31, O33, O47）

abstract.text: Preschool-aged children get sick frequently and spread disease to other family members. Despite the universality of this experience, there is limited causal evidence on the magnitudes and consequences of these externalities, especially for infant siblings with developing immune systems and brains. We show in Danish administrative data that during infancy, younger siblings have two to three times higher hospitalization rates for respiratory conditions than older siblings. We combine birth order and within-municipality variation in respiratory disease prevalence among young children, finding lasting differential impacts of early-life respiratory disease exposure on younger siblings' earnings, educational attainment, chronic respiratory health, and mental health-related outcomes. (JEL D13, D62, I12, J12, J13, J24, J31)

10.1257/aer.20231521.abstractZh: 学龄前儿童经常生病，并将疾病传播给其他家庭成员。尽管这种经历具有普遍性，但关于这些外部性的大小和后果的因果证据仍然有限，尤其是对于免疫系统和大脑尚在发育中的婴儿弟妹而言。我们利用丹麦行政数据表明，在婴儿期，弟弟妹妹因呼吸系统疾病住院的比率是哥哥姐姐的两到三倍。我们结合出生顺序与市镇内幼儿呼吸系统疾病患病率的变异，发现生命早期呼吸系统疾病暴露对弟弟妹妹的 earnings、教育获得、慢性呼吸系统健康以及心理健康相关结果具有持久的差异化影响。（JEL D13, D62, I12, J12, J13, J24, J31）

abstract.text: Lack of market transparency can impair the liquidity provision of nonstandard liquidity suppliers and make liquidity demand increasing in illiquidity. This can yield strategic complementarities and induce multiple equilibria. Then an initial dearth of liquidity may degenerate into a liquidity rout (as in a “flash crash”), and traders faced with the largest cost of trading are those trading more intensely at equilibrium. An increase in order flow transparency and/or in the mass of dealers who are in the market at all times has a positive impact on total welfare. (JEL G12, G14, G41)

10.1257/aer.20231613.abstractZh: 市场缺乏透明度会削弱非标准流动性供给者的流动性提供，并使流动性需求随非流动性上升而增加。这可能产生策略互补性并引致多重均衡。于是，初始的流动性匮乏可能恶化为流动性溃退（如“闪崩”中那样），而在均衡中交易最密集的交易者恰恰面临最高的交易成本。订单流透明度的提高和/或始终在场交易商数量的增加，会对总福利产生正向影响。（JEL G12、G14、G41）

abstract.text: We show remote work led to large drops in lease revenues, occupancy, and market rents in the commercial office sector. We revalue New York City office buildings, taking into account both the cash flow and discount rate implications of these shocks, and find a 46 percent decline in long-run value. For all US office markets combined, we find a $556.8 billion value destruction. Higher-quality buildings were buffered against these trends due to a flight to quality, while lower-quality offices are at risk of becoming a stranded asset. These valuation changes have repercussions for financial stability and local public finances. (JEL E31, E32, G12, J22, M51, R33)

10.1257/aer.20231619.abstractZh: 我们表明，远程办公导致商业办公部门的租赁收入、入住率和市场租金大幅下降。我们对纽约市办公楼进行重新估值，同时考虑这些冲击对现金流和折现率的影响，发现长期价值下降46%。对于美国所有办公市场合计，我们发现价值毁损达5568亿美元。由于“向优质资产转移”，较高质量的建筑受到缓冲，而较低质量的办公楼则面临成为搁浅资产的风险。这些估值变化对金融稳定和地方公共财政具有影响。(JEL E31, E32, G12, J22, M51, R33)

abstract.text: Statistical inference is often simplified by sample splitting. This simplification comes at the cost of the introduction of randomness not native to the data. We propose a simple procedure for sequentially aggregating statistics constructed with multiple splits of the same sample. The user specifies a bound and a nominal error rate. If the procedure is implemented twice on the same data, the nominal error rate approximates the chance that the results differ by more than the bound. We illustrate the application of the procedure to several widely applied econometric methods. (JEL C20, C30, C52)

10.1257/aer.20231651.abstractZh: 统计推断常通过样本拆分得到简化。这种简化以引入并非数据本身固有的随机性为代价。我们提出一种简单程序，用于序贯聚合基于同一样本多次拆分所构造的统计量。使用者指定一个界限和一个名义错误率。若该程序在同一数据上实施两次，名义错误率近似于结果差异超过该界限的概率。我们说明该程序在若干广泛应用的计量经济学方法中的应用。（JEL C20、C30、C52）

abstract.text: Based on a narrative classification of all significant postwar changes in R&D appropriations for five major federal agencies, we find that an increase in nondefense R&D appropriations leads to increases in various measures of innovative activity and higher business-sector productivity in the long run. We structurally estimate the production function elasticity of nondefense government R&D capital using the SP-IV methodology of Lewis and Mertens (2024) and obtain implied returns of 140 to 210 percent over the postwar period. The estimates indicate that government-funded R&D accounts for one-fifth of business-sector TFP growth since WWII and imply substantial underfunding of nondefense R&D. (JEL D24, E23, H50, O31, O33, O38)

10.1257/aer.20231684.abstractZh: 基于对五个主要联邦机构战后 R&D 拨款所有重大变化的叙事分类，我们发现，非国防 R&D 拨款的增加会带来多种创新活动指标上升，并在长期提高企业部门生产率。我们使用 Lewis 和 Mertens（2024）的 SP-IV 方法，对非国防政府 R&D 资本的生产函数弹性进行结构估计，得到战后时期 140% 至 210% 的隐含回报率。估计结果表明，政府资助的 R&D 占二战以来企业部门 TFP 增长的五分之一，并意味着非国防 R&D 的资金投入严重不足。（JEL D24, E23, H50, O31, O33, O38）

abstract.text: We study how public sector workers balance their professional motivations with private economic concerns, focusing on police arrests. Arrests made near the end of an officer's shift typically require overtime work, and officers respond by reducing arrest frequency but increasing arrest quality. Days in which an officer works a second job after their police shift have higher opportunity cost, also reducing late-shift arrests. Combining our estimates in a dynamic model identifies officer preferences over workplace activity and overtime work. Our results indicate that officers' private costs of arrests have a first-order impact on the quantity and quality of enforcement. (JEL K42, J33, J45)

10.1257/aer.20231696.abstractZh: 我们研究公共部门工作者如何在职业动机与私人经济考量之间进行权衡，并以警察逮捕行为为焦点。在警员班次临近结束时实施的逮捕通常需要加班，警员的反应是降低逮捕频率但提高逮捕质量。若警员在警察班次之后还要从事第二份工作，则当天的时间机会成本更高，这同样会减少晚班时段的逮捕。我们将各项估计结果纳入动态模型，识别出警员对工作场所活动和加班工作的偏好。结果表明，警员实施逮捕的私人成本对执法数量和质量具有一阶影响。（JEL K42、J33、J45）

abstract.text: Conflict along transportation routes during Somalia’s al-Shabaab insurgency significantly increases maize prices at distant locations, decreasing food security, health, and education. Estimated conflict risk has strong price effects independently of realized conflict, highlighting the importance of safety concerns. A model of least-cost route choice in the presence of conflict reveals that more and shorter alternative routes to circumvent conflict can lower prices but their effectiveness diminishes as violence becomes more correlated across routes. Alternatively, securing key transportation routes would alleviate price increases. A market access approach suggests spatial spillovers of conflict also matter for prices of more general baskets of food and nonfood items. (JEL D74, I15, I25, O15, O17, Q11, R41)

10.1257/aer.20231699.abstractZh: 索马里青年党叛乱期间，运输路线沿线的冲突显著推高了远距离地区的玉米价格，进而削弱粮食安全、健康和教育。估计的冲突风险独立于已实现的冲突而对价格产生强烈影响，凸显了安全关切的重要性。一个存在冲突情形下的最小成本路线选择模型表明，更多且更短的绕行冲突的替代路线可以降低价格，但随着暴力在不同路线之间的相关性增强，其有效性会下降。另一种做法是，保障关键运输路线将缓解价格上涨。市场准入方法表明，冲突的空间溢出效应对于更广泛的食品和非食品商品篮子价格同样重要。（JEL D74, I15, I25, O15, O17, Q11, R41）

abstract.text: This paper studies how managers plan under uncertainty. In a new panel survey of German manufacturing firms, we observe both forecasts of sales growth and a quantitative measure of subjective uncertainty. We show that subjective uncertainty reflects change experienced by firms: It is high when growth is either unusually low or unusually high. Subjective uncertainty is more than conditional volatility; while more volatile firms are typically more uncertain, experienced change alone increases uncertainty, consistent with a model of learning. Uncertainty over our sample is mostly idiosyncratic but varies substantially over time and leads managers to plan lower employment and prices. (JEL C83, D22, E20, E23)

10.1257/aer.20240056.abstractZh: 本文研究管理者如何在不确定性下进行规划。在一项针对德国制造业企业的新面板调查中，我们同时观测到销售增长预测和主观不确定性的定量测度。我们表明，主观不确定性反映了企业所经历的变化：当增长异常低或异常高时，主观不确定性较高。主观不确定性不仅仅是条件波动率；虽然波动率更高的企业通常更不确定，但仅经历变化本身就会提高不确定性，这与学习模型相一致。在我们的样本中，不确定性主要是个体特异性的，但随时间大幅变化，并促使管理者规划更低的就业和价格。（JEL C83, D22, E20, E23）

abstract.text: Natural gas has replaced coal as the dominant fuel for US electricity generation. However, utilities in regulated US states have retired coal more slowly than others. We build a structural model of rate-of-return regulation during an energy transition where utilities face trade-offs between lowering costs and maintaining and using legacy capacity. A regulated utility facing carbon taxes lowers short-run coal generation 48 percent as much as a cost minimizer would. Thirty years after a sudden energy transition, a cost minimizer has retired 71 percent more coal capacity than the regulated utility. Alternative regulations may jeopardize affordability and reliability goals during energy transitions. (JEL D24, L94, L98, Q35, Q48)

10.1257/aer.20240094.abstractZh: 天然气已取代煤炭成为美国发电的主要燃料。然而，美国受监管各州的公用事业公司退役煤炭的速度慢于其他州。我们构建了一个能源转型期间收益率监管的结构模型，其中公用事业公司在降低成本与维持和使用既有产能之间面临权衡。面临碳税时，受监管的公用事业公司减少短期燃煤发电的幅度仅为成本最小化者的48%。在能源转型突然发生三十年后，成本最小化者退役的煤炭产能比受监管的公用事业公司多71%。替代性监管可能在能源转型期间危及可负担性和可靠性目标。（JEL D24, L94, L98, Q35, Q48）

abstract.text: This paper studies how gender-biased technological change in agriculture affected women’s work in twentieth-century Norway. In the 1950s, dairy farms began widely adopting milking machines to replace milking cows by hand, a task typically performed by young women. We show that the machines pushed rural young women in dairy-intensive areas out of farming. The displaced women moved to cities where they acquired more education and found better-paying, skilled employment. Our results suggest that the adoption of milking machines broke up allocative inefficiencies associated with moving costs across sectors, which improved the economic status of women relative to men. (JEL J16, J24, J43, J61, N34, N54, O33)

10.1257/aer.20240167.abstractZh: 本文研究20世纪挪威农业中性别偏向型技术变革如何影响女性就业。20世纪50年代，奶牛场开始广泛采用挤奶机，以替代手工挤奶，而这一工作通常由年轻女性承担。我们发现，挤奶机将奶牛养殖密集地区的农村年轻女性挤出农业。被迫离开农业的女性迁往城市，在那里接受了更多教育，并找到了薪酬更高、技能型的工作。我们的结果表明，挤奶机的采用打破了与跨部门转移成本相关的配置无效率，从而提升了女性相对于男性的经济地位。（JEL J16, J24, J43, J61, N34, N54, O33）

abstract.text: We study residential segregation and access to public services across 1.5 million urban and rural neighborhoods in India. Muslim and Scheduled Caste segregation in India is high by global standards and only slightly lower than Black-White segregation in the United States. Within cities, public facilities and infrastructure are systematically less available in Muslim and Scheduled Caste neighborhoods. Nearly all regressive allocation is across neighborhoods within cities—at the most informal and least studied form of government. These inequalities are not visible in the aggregate data typically used for research and policy. (JEL H76, J15, O15, O17, O18, R23)

10.1257/aer.20240179.abstractZh: 本文研究印度150万个城市和农村社区的居住隔离与公共服务可及性。按全球标准衡量，印度穆斯林和表列种姓的隔离程度很高，仅略低于美国的黑人与白人隔离程度。在城市内部，穆斯林和表列种姓社区的公共设施和基础设施可及性系统性更低。几乎所有累退性分配都发生在城市内部不同社区之间——即最非正式、研究最少的政府形式。这些不平等在研究 and 政策通常使用的总量数据中并不可见。（JEL H76, J15, O15, O17, O18, R23）

abstract.text: This paper studies which misspecified models are likely to persist when decision-makers compare them with competing models.
