The main result characterizes such models based on two features that can be derived from primitives: The model’s asymptotic accuracy in predicting the equilibrium distribution of observed outcomes and the “tightness” of the prior around such equilibria. Misspecified models can be robust, persisting against any arbitrary competing model—including the true model—despite decision-makers observing an infinite amount of data. Moreover, simple misspecified models equipped with entrenched priors can be more robust than complex correctly specified models. (JEL C11, C52, D11, L82)

10.1257/aer.20240246.abstractZh: 本文研究当决策者将错误设定模型与竞争模型进行比较时，哪些错误设定模型可能持续存在。主要结果基于两个可由基本参数推导出的特征来刻画此类模型：模型在预测可观测结果均衡分布方面的渐近准确性，以及先验围绕此类均衡的“紧致程度”。错误设定模型可以是稳健的，即使决策者观察到无限量数据，也能抵御任何任意的竞争模型——包括真实模型——而持续存在。此外，配备根深蒂固先验的简单错误设定模型可能比复杂的正确设定模型更为稳健。（JEL C11, C52, D11, L82）

abstract.text: We show that higher rates of distressed home sales (i.e., foreclosures and short sales) among Black and Hispanic homeowners severely reduce realized housing returns for these groups—in particular, to a level below that realized by White homeowners. Yet absent financial distress, houses owned by minorities do not appreciate at substantially slower rates than houses owned by nonminorities. Racial differences in liquidity and income stability, which are imperfectly observed by lenders, are important determinants of differences in distress. Policies that prevent foreclosure among distressed minorities can mitigate the racial gap in returns. (JEL D31, G51, J15, R31)

10.1257/aer.20240327.abstractZh: 我们表明，黑人和西班牙裔房主中更高的困境住房出售率（即止赎和短售）严重降低了这些群体已实现的住房收益率，尤其是降至低于白人房主已实现收益率的水平。然而，在没有财务困境的情况下，少数族裔拥有的住房升值速度并不比非少数族裔拥有的住房显著更慢。流动性和收入稳定性的种族差异——贷款人无法完全观测到这些差异——是困境差异的重要决定因素。防止陷入困境的少数族裔被止赎的政策可以缓解收益率中的种族差距。（JEL D31, G51, J15, R31）

abstract.text: We establish a link between labor scarcity and the adoption of laborsaving technology in industrializing England. During the Napoleonic Wars, more than 10 percent of the male population served in the armed forces. Where recruitment was heavy, more machines economizing on labor were adopted. Naval recruitment, instrumented by warships' coastal access, provides exogenous variation in labor scarcity and suggests that the link between labor shortages and adoption is causal. Where mechanical skills were abundant, the impact of labor scarcity on adoption appears to be larger. (JEL J24, N13, N43, N63, N73, O14, O31)

10.1257/aer.20240393.abstractZh: 我们将劳动力稀缺与工业化英格兰劳动节约型技术的采用之间建立了联系。在拿破仑战争期间，超过10%的男性人口在军队服役。在征兵规模较大的地方，更多节约劳动的机器被采用。海军征兵以军舰的沿海通达性作为工具变量，提供了劳动力稀缺的外生变异，并表明劳动力短缺与采用之间的联系是因果性的。在机械技能较为充裕的地方，劳动力稀缺对采用的影响似乎更大。（JEL J24, N13, N43, N63, N73, O14, O31）

abstract.text: We study the effects of the largest corporate income tax cut in US history on firms and workers. To identify causal effects, we use employer-employee matched tax records and event studies comparing similarly sized firms in the same industry that faced divergent tax changes due to their preexisting legal status. Tax cuts cause increases in firms' investment, sales, profits, employment, and payrolls, with earnings gains concentrated among highly paid workers. In the short run, 87 percent of private income gains flow to the top 10 percent of the income distribution. (JEL D22, D31, G31, H25, H32, J23, L25)

10.1257/aer.20240404.abstractZh: 我们研究美国历史上最大规模的企业所得税减税对企业与劳动者的影响。为识别因果效应，我们使用雇主—雇员匹配税务记录，并采用事件研究，比较同一行业中因既有法律地位不同而面临不同税收变化的规模相近企业。减税导致企业投资、销售额、利润、就业和工资总额上升，且收入增长集中于高薪劳动者。短期内，私人收入增长的87%流向收入分布前10%的人群。（JEL D22, D31, G31, H25, H32, J23, L25）

abstract.text: We use Danish administrative data to examine the effects of parental death on labor market outcomes. Leveraging the timing of sudden, first parental deaths and a matched-control difference-in-differences strategy, we find that men’s earnings decline by 2 percent, while women’s earnings decline by 3 percent following a parental death. Both women and men experience mental health deterioration, leading to increased use of psychological assistance and prescriptions for mental health conditions and opioids. Women with young children experience a comparatively larger earnings decline (around 4 percent) likely due to the loss of informal childcare. (JEL D91, I12, J13, J16, J31)

10.1257/aer.20240432.abstractZh: 我们使用丹麦行政数据考察父母死亡对劳动力市场结果的影响。利用突发性首次父母死亡的时间安排以及匹配对照的双重差分策略，我们发现，在父母死亡后，男性的收入下降2%，而女性的收入下降3%。女性和男性均出现心理健康恶化，导致心理援助使用增加，以及针对心理健康状况和阿片类药物的处方增加。有年幼子女的女性收入下降幅度相对更大（约4%），这可能是因为失去了非正式儿童照料。(JEL D91, I12, J13, J16, J31)

abstract.text: Modern theories of aggregate supply are built on the foundation that firms set prices and commit to producing whatever the market demands. We remove this strategic restriction and allow firms to choose supply functions, mappings that describe the prices charged at each quantity of production. Theoretically, we characterize firms’ optimal supply function choices in general equilibrium and study the resulting implications for aggregate supply. Aggregate supply flattens under lower inflation uncertainty, higher idiosyncratic demand uncertainty, and less elastic demand. Quantitatively, our theory can rationalize the flattening of aggregate supply during the Great Moderation and steepening during the 1970s and 2020s. (JEL D21, D43, E13, E23, E31, E32)

10.1257/aer.20240443.abstractZh: 现代总供给理论建立在一个基础之上：企业设定价格并承诺按市场需求生产任意数量。我们取消这一策略性限制，允许企业选择供给函数，即描述每一产量水平上所收取价格的映射。在理论上，我们在一般均衡中刻画了企业最优供给函数的选择，并研究了其对总供给的含义。在通胀不确定性较低、个体特异性需求不确定性较高以及需求弹性较低时，总供给曲线趋于平坦。在定量上，我们的理论能够解释大稳健时期总供给的平坦化以及20世纪70年代和2020年代的陡峭化。（JEL D21, D43, E13, E23, E31, E32）

abstract.text: We develop a leverage theory of tying in markets with network effects. When a monopolist in one market cannot perfectly extract surplus from consumers, tying can be a mechanism through which unexploited consumer surplus is used as a demand-side leverage to create a “quasi-installed base” advantage in another market characterized by network effects. Our mechanism does not require any precommitment to tying; rather, tying emerges as a best response that lowers the quality of tied-market rivals. While tying can lead to exclusion of tied-market rivals, it can also expand use of the tying product, leading to ambiguous welfare effects. (JEL D41, D85, K21, L15, L40)

10.1257/aer.20240461.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个具有网络效应的市场中搭售的杠杆理论。当某一市场的垄断者无法完全攫取消费者剩余时，搭售可以成为一种机制：未被攫取的消费者剩余被用作需求侧杠杆，在另一个具有网络效应的市场中创造“准安装基础”优势。我们的机制并不要求对搭售作出任何事前承诺；相反，搭售是作为一种降低被搭售市场竞争对手质量的最优反应而出现。尽管搭售可能导致被搭售市场的竞争对手被排斥，但它也可能扩大搭售产品的使用，从而产生不确定的福利效应。（JEL D41, D85, K21, L15, L40）

abstract.text: We document the effects of a comprehensive set of mergers of consumer packaged goods manufacturers on prices, quantities, and product assortment. Across specifications, we find a small average price effect of mergers (−0.5−1.1 percent) but substantial heterogeneity, with a standard deviation between 3.9 and 7.6 percentage points. Through a model of enforcement, we find that agencies act as if they challenge mergers they expect would increase prices more than 4.8 to 6.3 percent. Increases in stringency would reduce prices and the prevalence of completed price-increasing mergers, with minimal impacts on blocked price-decreasing mergers, at significantly greater agency burden. (JEL D43, G34, K21, L13, L41, L66)

10.1257/aer.20240497.abstractZh: 我们记录了包装消费品制造商一系列全面合并对价格、数量和产品组合的影响。在不同设定下，我们发现合并的平均价格效应较小（−0.5% 至 −1.1%），但异质性显著，标准差在 3.9 至 7.6 个百分点之间。通过一个执法模型，我们发现，机构的行为方式似乎是：对于预期会使价格上涨超过 4.8% 至 6.3% 的合并，它们会提出质疑。提高执法严格程度会降低价格和已完成的价格上涨型合并的发生率，对被阻止的价格下降型合并影响极小，但会给机构带来显著更大的负担。（JEL D43, G34, K21, L13, L41, L66）

abstract.text: Each month, a fraction of UK property leases are extended by 90 years or more. We construct a new dataset using thousands of these natural experiments since 2000 and estimate the expected long-term housing yield, y * . After remaining steady at around 5 percent, y * starts to decline when the Great Recession hits and reaches a low of 2.7 percent in 2024. The decline is steeper in inelastic markets, while y * remains higher in regions more exposed to long-run climate risk. Our estimate of y * is updated in real time using public data. (JEL E32, G12, Q54, R31, R38)

10.1257/aer.20240513.abstractZh: 每月都有一部分英国房产租约被延长90年或更长时间。我们利用2000年以来数千个此类自然实验构建了一个新数据集，并估计了预期长期住房收益率 y*。y*在围绕5%保持稳定之后，于大衰退来袭时开始下降，并在2024年降至2.7%的低点。这一下降在缺乏弹性的市场中更为陡峭，而在长期气候风险暴露更高的地区，y*仍然较高。我们对y*的估计利用公开数据实时更新。（JEL E32, G12, Q54, R31, R38）

abstract.text: A designer employs a dynamic protocol to elicit private information. Protocols produce a set of contextual privacy violations—information learned that may be superfluous given the context. A protocol is maximally contextually private if there is no protocol that produces a proper subset of the violations it produces, while implementing the choice rule. Contextual privacy violations arise when a choice rule makes some agents collectively, but not individually, pivotal. In auctions, designing for contextual privacy requires choosing an initial question posed to each agent and the order for querying agents. Ascending-join protocols are maximally contextually private for k-item Vickrey auctions. (JEL D44, D82)

10.1257/aer.20240579.abstractZh: 设计者采用动态协议来揭示私人信息。协议会产生一组情境隐私侵犯——即所获知的、在给定情境下可能多余的信息。若不存在另一个协议，在实施该选择规则的同时所产生的隐私侵犯是其产生侵犯的真子集，则该协议是最大情境隐私的。当选择规则使某些经济主体集体而非个体成为关键者时，就会出现情境隐私侵犯。在拍卖中，为情境隐私而设计需要选择向每个经济主体提出的初始问题以及询问经济主体的顺序。升序加入协议对于 k 件物品的 Vickrey 拍卖是最大情境隐私的。（JEL D44, D82）

abstract.text: We study the problem of designing a dynamic reassignment mechanism when agents' preferences over objects change over time. In the context of Norway's system for (re)assigning patients to general practitioners (GPs), we provide direct evidence of misallocation under the current mechanism—patients waiting for each others' GPs, but who cannot trade—and estimate a structural model of GP-switching behavior to evaluate alternatives. Introducing top trading cycles (TTC) would, on average, reduce waiting times and increase patient welfare. However, patients endowed with less desirable GPs would be harmed. Prioritizing these patients can avoid these harms while preserving most of the gains from TTC. (JEL D82, H51, I11, I13, I18)

10.1257/aer.20240617.abstractZh: 我们研究当经济主体对对象的偏好随时间变化时，动态重新分配机制的设计问题。在挪威将患者（重新）分配至全科医生（GP）的体系背景下，我们提供了当前机制下错配的直接证据——患者彼此等待对方的全科医生，却无法进行交换——并估计了一个全科医生转换行为的结构模型以评估替代方案。引入最高交易循环（TTC）机制平均而言会缩短等待时间并提高患者福利。然而，初始被分配较不受欢迎的全科医生的患者会受到损害。优先考虑这些患者可以避免上述损害，同时保留 TTC 的大部分收益。（JEL D82, H51, I11, I13, I18）

abstract.text: The validity of instrumental variable (IV) designs is typically tested using two types of falsification tests. We characterize these tests as conditional independence tests between negative control variables—proxies for unobserved variables posing a threat to the identification—and the IV or the outcome. We describe the conditions variables must satisfy in order to serve as negative controls. We show these falsification tests examine not only independence and the exclusion restriction but also functional form assumptions. Our analysis reveals conventional applications of these tests may flag problems even in valid IV designs. We offer implementation guidance to address these issues. (JEL C12, C18, C26, C52)

10.1257/aer.20240636.abstractZh: 工具变量（IV）设计的有效性通常通过两类证伪检验来检验。我们将这些检验刻画为负控制变量——对识别构成威胁的未观测变量的代理变量——与工具变量或结果变量之间的条件独立性检验。我们描述了变量作为负控制变量所必须满足的条件。我们表明，这些证伪检验不仅考察独立性和排除限制，还考察函数形式假设。我们的分析揭示，这些检验的常规应用即使在有效的工具变量设计中也可能提示存在问题。我们提供了实施指导以应对这些问题。（JEL C12, C18, C26, C52）

abstract.text: We show that in heterogeneous agent New Keynesian (HANK) economies with countercyclical risk, the natural interest rate is endogenous and co-moves with output, leaving the economy susceptible to self-fulfilling fluctuations. Unlike in representative agent New Keynesian models, the Taylor principle is not sufficient to guarantee uniqueness of equilibrium in HANK if risk is even mildly countercyclical: Multiple bounded equilibria exist, no matter how strongly monetary policy responds to changes in inflation. For an active monetary policy to eliminate self-fulfilling fluctuations, it must stabilize the endogenous natural rate fluctuations. Alternatively, a passive monetary and active fiscal regime can also eliminate equilibrium multiplicity. (JEL E12, E23, E31, E32, E43, E52, E62)

10.1257/aer.20240642.abstractZh: 我们表明，在风险呈逆周期特征的异质性经济主体新凯恩斯（HANK）经济中，自然利率是内生的，并与产出同向变动，使经济容易受到自我实现波动的影响。与代表性经济主体新凯恩斯模型不同，在HANK中，只要风险哪怕只是轻微逆周期，泰勒原则就不足以保证均衡的唯一性：无论货币政策对通胀变化作出多强的反应，都存在多重有界均衡。要使主动货币政策消除自我实现的波动，它必须稳定内生的自然利率波动。或者，被动货币政策与主动财政政策组合也能消除均衡多重性。（JEL E12, E23, E31, E32, E43, E52, E62）

abstract.text: This paper develops a dynamic model of the attention economy featuring two interlinked markets: a product market, where consumers have limited awareness of firms, and an attention market, where platforms attract attention by investing in free services (e.g., social media, streaming, podcasts) and sell targeted ads using data on consumer preferences. The model provides a tractable framework in which platform investment, ad-driven discovery, product demand, and ad revenue are jointly determined. The effects of data and interoperability policies can reverse over time, platform quality may be inefficiently high or low, and the rise of data-rich digital advertising can coincide with a declining ad revenue-to-GDP ratio. (JEL D43, D44, D58, D83, L86, M37)

10.1257/aer.20240651.abstractZh: 本文构建了一个注意力经济的动态模型，包含两个相互关联的市场：产品市场，其中消费者对企业的认知有限；以及注意力市场，其中平台通过投资免费服务（如社交媒体、流媒体、播客）来吸引注意力，并利用消费者偏好数据出售定向广告。该模型提供了一个易处理框架，在其中平台投资、广告驱动的发现、产品需求和广告收入被联合决定。数据和互操作性政策的效果可能随时间而逆转，平台质量可能无效率地过高或过低，而数据丰富的数字广告的兴起可能与广告收入占GDP比率的下降同时发生。（JEL D43, D44, D58, D83, L86, M37）

abstract.text: Efficient risk sharing implies a simple factor structure for marginal utilities of expenditure (MUEs): Pareto weights divided by a common price. The standard approach infers MUEs from total expenditures, implicitly assuming homothetic preferences, unitary income elasticities, and identical price elasticities. Risk-sharing tests using total expenditures work for idiosyncratic shocks (budgets change, but not prices), but not “covariate” shocks (prices change). I describe all preferences that permit one to infer MUEs from expenditures and estimate nonhomothetic MUEs to test whether covariate shocks are shared efficiently in Uganda. This delivers sensible results; the standard approach suggests that droughts, floods, and pests are beneficial. (JEL D12, D81, O12, O13, Q12)

10.1257/aer.20240664.abstractZh: 有效的风险分担意味着支出边际效用（MUEs）具有简单的因子结构：帕累托权重除以一个共同价格。标准方法从总支出推断支出边际效用，隐含地假设偏好同质、收入弹性为单位值以及价格弹性相同。使用总支出的风险分担检验适用于个体特异性冲击（预算变化，但价格不变），但不适用于“共同”冲击（价格变化）。我描述了所有允许从支出推断支出边际效用的偏好，并估计非同位相似的支出边际效用，以检验乌干达的共同冲击是否得到有效分担。这得出了合理的结果；而标准方法却表明干旱、洪水和病虫害是有益的。（JEL D12, D81, O12, O13, Q12）

abstract.text: Durables represent a large share of households' marginal propensity to spend (MPX). We develop a quantitative model of spending that takes durables into account and matches a rich set of empirical regularities simultaneously. Scaling the response of nondurables provides a poor approximation of the MPX on durables when it comes to its distribution in the population, its persistence over time, and its cyclicality. As an application, we study how the MPX varies with the size of stimulus checks and find that it declines more slowly compared to a model of purely nondurable spending. (JEL D11, E21, E32, E62, G51)

10.1257/aer.20240666.abstractZh: 耐用品占家庭边际支出倾向（MPX）的很大一部分。我们构建了一个将耐用品考虑在内的支出定量模型，并同时匹配一系列丰富的经验规律。在耐用品 MPX 的人口分布、随时间持续性和周期性方面，将非耐用品的响应按比例缩放只能提供很差的近似。作为应用，我们研究 MPX 如何随刺激支票规模变化，并发现与纯非耐用品支出模型相比，其下降速度更慢。（JEL D11, E21, E32, E62, G51）

abstract.text: The implementation of evidence-based policies hinges on the dissemination of evidence to policymakers, a process influenced by the attributes of the sender. We conducted a nationwide RCT with ideologically opposite think tanks, major newspapers, and a research institution with nonsalient ideology to communicate a nonideological, cost-effective policy to local policymakers. Results show a 65 percent increase in policy adoption when informing institutions align ideologically with policymakers. We compare the impact of think tanks versus media outlets on implementation, finding both equally effective when ideologically aligned. We explore three actions where ideology may influence adoption: information exposure, belief updating and implementation. (JEL C93, D72, D78, D83, I23)

10.1257/aer.20240673.abstractZh: 基于证据的政策实施取决于证据向政策制定者的传播，而这一过程受到信息发送者特征的影响。我们开展了一项全国性随机对照试验（RCT），由意识形态对立的智库、主要报纸以及一家意识形态不显著的研究机构，向地方政策制定者传播一项非意识形态且成本有效的政策。结果显示，当信息提供机构在意识形态上与政策制定者一致时，政策采纳率提高65%。我们比较了智库与媒体机构对实施的影响，发现两者在意识形态一致时效果相同。我们考察了意识形态可能影响政策采纳的三个环节：信息暴露、信念更新与实施。（JEL C93, D72, D78, D83, I23）

abstract.text: We investigate the origins and implications of zero-sum thinking: the belief that gains for one individual or group tend to come at the cost of others. Using a new survey of 20,400 US residents, we measure zero-sum thinking, political preferences, policy views, and a rich array of ancestral information spanning four generations. We find that a more zero-sum mindset is strongly associated with more support for government redistribution, race- and gender-based affirmative action, and more restrictive immigration policies. Zero-sum thinking can be traced back to the experiences of both the individual and their ancestors, encompassing factors such as the degree of intergenerational upward mobility they experienced, whether they immigrated to the United States or lived in a location with more immigrants, and whether they were enslaved or lived in a location with more enslavement. (JEL C83, D72, D91, H23, J15, J16, Z13)

10.1257/aer.20240692.abstractZh: 我们考察零和思维的起源与影响：零和思维是指一种认为某个个体或群体的收益往往以他人为代价的信念。基于一项针对20,400名美国居民的新调查，我们测度了零和思维、政治偏好、政策观点，以及涵盖四代人的丰富祖先信息。我们发现，更强的零和心态与对政府再分配、基于种族和性别的平权行动以及更严格的移民政策的更强支持密切相关。零和思维可以追溯到个体及其祖先的经历，涵盖其所经历的代际向上流动程度、是否移民至美国或居住在移民更多的地区、是否曾被奴役或居住在奴役现象更普遍的地区等因素。（JEL C83, D72, D91, H23, J15, J16, Z13）

abstract.text: We document how deepening resource scarcity results in rationing on the basis of race in a high-stakes setting: health care. Using detailed, time stamped data on 107,000 inpatient admissions to a large health system, we find that in-hospital mortality increases for Black but not White patients as hospitals reach capacity. These findings are not explained by differential patient selection. We identify rationing by wait times as a mechanism, documenting that sicker Black patients wait longer for care than healthier White patients at almost all capacity levels. Text analysis of unstructured clinical notes reveals rationing of provider effort as another mechanism. (JEL I11, I12, I14, J15)

10.1257/aer.20240701.abstractZh: 我们记录了资源稀缺加剧如何在一种高风险情境——医疗保健——中导致基于种族的配给。利用某大型医疗系统107,000例住院入院的时间戳详细数据，我们发现，随着医院达到容量上限，黑人患者的院内死亡率上升，而白人患者则没有出现这一上升。这些发现无法由患者选择差异来解释。我们识别出等待时间配给作为一种机制，记录到在几乎所有容量水平下，病情更重的黑人患者比病情更轻的白人患者等待更长时间才能获得照护。对非结构化临床记录文本的分析揭示了医疗服务提供者努力程度的配给作为另一机制。(JEL I11, I12, I14, J15)

abstract.text: The random utility model (RUM), a cornerstone in economics, is typically studied under the assumption that choice frequencies of all alternatives are observable. In practice, however, some alternatives have unobservable choice frequencies and are commonly aggregated into a single category called an outside option. We study RUM in such environments and derive a finite, nonredundant system of inequality constraints on observed choice frequencies that characterizes RU-rationalizability. We show that the conventional practice of aggregating unobserved alternatives can miss key information leading to incorrect conclusions such as that observed choices are rationalizable, even when no RUM is consistent with them. (JEL D11, D44, D83)

10.1257/aer.20240712.abstractZh: 随机效用模型（RUM）是经济学的基石之一，通常在所有备选项的选择频率均可观测的假设下进行研究。然而在实践中，某些备选项的选择频率不可观测，通常被归并为一个称为外部选项的单一类别。我们研究此类环境下的RUM，并推导出关于可观测选择频率的有限、非冗余不等式约束体系，用以刻画RU-理性化。我们表明，将不可观测备选项归并的常规做法可能遗漏关键信息，从而导致错误结论，例如即使不存在与之相容的RUM，也会得出所观测选择是可理性化的结论。（JEL D11, D44, D83）

abstract.text: Digital platforms reduce geographic frictions, enabling better matching between service providers and users. I quantify reallocation gains in Swedish online health care, using nationwide time-conditional random assignment between patients and physicians. Matching high-risk patients with doctors effective at reducing Emergency Room visits lowers such visits by 4.4 percent (SE 1.3); reallocations also reduce Counter-Guideline antibiotics by 3.1 percent (1.4). I find limited trade-offs in matching; horizontal differentiation among doctors and varied patient needs allow improvement in multiple outcomes simultaneously. Efficiency-enhancing reallocations also affect equity. The findings highlight the potential for care reorganization aligning provider heterogeneity with patient needs when geographic constraints are lifted. (JEL C78, H51, I11, I13, I14, I18)

10.1257/aer.20240756.abstractZh: 数字平台降低了地理摩擦，使服务提供者与用户之间能够更好地匹配。我利用全国范围内患者与医生之间按时间条件进行的随机分配，量化了瑞典在线医疗中的再配置收益。将高风险患者与能有效减少急诊就诊的医生匹配，可使此类就诊减少4.4%（标准误1.3）；再配置还使违反指南的抗生素使用减少3.1%（1.4）。我发现匹配中的权衡有限；医生之间的横向差异以及患者需求的多样性，使得多个结果可以同时改善。提升效率的再配置也会影响公平。研究结果凸显了在地理约束被解除时，将提供者异质性与患者需求相匹配的医疗重组潜力。（JEL C78, H51, I11, I13, I14, I18）

abstract.text: We develop a simple multilayer network model in which agents allocate effort across layers with heterogeneous structures, subject to an aggregate effort constraint. Incentives are shaped by agents’ network positions within each layer, and equilibrium behavior reflects both within- and cross-layer interactions. We analyze how shocks propagate through the network and characterize optimal targeting interventions. Our results show that effective policy design must account for effort allocation across layers. We also demonstrate that predictions from monolayer models can diverge sharply from those of multilayer models, underscoring the importance of accounting for network complexity in both empirical and policy analyses. (JEL C70, D78, D82, D85, H41, Z13)

10.1257/aer.20240763.abstractZh: 我们构建一个简单的多层网络模型，其中经济主体在具有异质结构的不同层之间配置努力，并受到总努力约束。激励由经济主体在每一层内的网络位置所塑造，均衡行为同时反映层内和跨层互动。我们分析冲击如何通过网络传导，并刻画最优定向干预。结果表明，有效的政策设计必须考虑跨层的努力配置。我们还证明，单层模型的预测可能与多层模型的预测显著背离，这凸显了在实证分析和政策分析中考虑网络复杂性的重要性。（JEL C70、D78、D82、D85、H41、Z13）

abstract.text: This paper studies how collective bargaining affects wages and amenities. By merging collective bargaining agreements (CBAs) to linked employer-employee data in Brazil, I combine rich contracted amenities with wage information. I implement a difference-in-differences strategy that exploits a court ruling enforcing CBA continuation (i.e., ultra-activity) to estimate the effects of union bargaining power. Strengthening unions raises wages and amenities without reducing employment—increasing retention despite some labor-labor substitution. A revealed-preference approach shows that amenities account for 45 percent of total compensation gains. These findings suggest that collective bargaining can offset monopsony power, but employers retain the right-to-manage workforce composition. (JEL J31, J32, J42, J51, J52, O15)

10.1257/aer.20240766.abstractZh: 本文研究集体谈判如何影响工资与工作福利。通过将集体谈判协议（CBAs）与巴西的匹配雇主—雇员数据合并，我将丰富的合同约定工作福利与工资信息结合起来。我采用双重差分策略，利用一项强制 CBA 延续（即“超期效力”，ultra-activity）的法院裁决，估计工会议价能力的影响。增强工会力量会提高工资和工作福利，且不减少就业——尽管存在一定的劳动—劳动替代，仍提高留任率。显示性偏好方法表明，工作福利占总薪酬收益的 45%。这些发现表明，集体谈判可以抵消买方垄断力量，但雇主仍保留管理劳动力构成的权利。（JEL J31, J32, J42, J51, J52, O15）

abstract.text: The influence of on-the-job training and supervisors, especially in high-stakes settings like policing, is poorly understood. Examining a central behavior in the debate surrounding police reform, we investigate the impact of a field training officer (FTO) on a recruit’s use of force. Leveraging a setting with conditional as-good-as-random assignment, we demonstrate a causal link between FTO and recruit use of force. A 1 standard deviation increase in FTO force propensity leads to a 14 to 18 percent rise in recruit force, persisting for at least two years. This underscores field training’s impact and reveals a promising avenue for reform. (JEL D91, J24, J45, K42, M53)

10.1257/aer.20240785.abstractZh: 在职培训和主管人员的影响，尤其是在警务等高风险情境中的作用，仍缺乏充分理解。本文考察围绕警务改革的争论中的一个核心行为，研究现场培训教官（FTO）对新警员使用武力的影响。借助一个具备条件性近似随机分配特征的情境，我们证明 FTO 与新警员使用武力之间存在因果联系。FTO 的武力倾向每提高 1 个标准差，新警员的武力使用会上升 14% 至 18%，且这一效应至少持续两年。这凸显了现场培训的影响，并揭示了一条有前景的改革路径。（JEL D91、J24、J45、K42、M53）

abstract.text: How does information transmission change when it requires attracting the attention of receivers? This paper combines an experiment that varies freelance professionals’ incentives to attract attention about scientific findings, with several online experiments that exogenously expose receivers to the content created. Attention incentives lead to significantly less information being transmitted, but not more factually inaccurate content. These incentives increase information demand and the knowledge of interested receivers. However, among the majority of receivers who do not demand more information, attention incentives lower knowledge and increase biases in beliefs, revealing a channel through which misperceptions can arise: missing information. (JEL C91, D83, D91)

10.1257/aer.20240850.abstractZh: 当信息传递需要吸引接收者注意力时，信息传递会如何变化？本文结合了一项实验与若干在线实验：前者改变自由职业专业人士吸引人们关注科学发现的激励，后者外生地让接收者接触所创造的内容。注意力激励导致被传递的信息显著减少，但并未使内容在事实层面更加不准确。这些激励提高了信息需求以及有兴趣的接收者的知识水平。然而，在大多数并未需求更多信息的接收者中，注意力激励降低了知识水平并加剧了信念偏差，揭示了一条可能产生错误认知的渠道：信息缺失。（JEL C91、D83、D91）

abstract.text: Digitization reforms have been hailed as an effective way of strengthening state capacity. However, digitization can also fundamentally reshape the organization of bureaucracies. Using a unique administrative dataset on agricultural taxation and surveys of local bureaucrats from Punjab, Pakistan, we show that digitization reforms can have unintended consequences for state capacity. We exploit the staggered rollout of the digitization of land records in Punjab to show that digitization had a negative effect on tax collection. The fall in taxes was not due to a decrease in the tax base. Instead, digitization affected the bureaucrats’ capacity to collect taxes. (JEL D73, H11, H71, O12, O17)

10.1257/aer.20240880.abstractZh: 数字化改革被誉为增强国家能力的有效方式。然而，数字化也可能从根本上重塑官僚机构的组织方式。利用巴基斯坦旁遮普省农业税收的独特行政数据集以及对地方官僚的调查，我们表明数字化改革可能对国家能力产生非预期后果。我们利用旁遮普省土地记录数字化交错推行的特征，表明数字化对税收征收产生了负面影响。税收下降并非源于税基缩小，而是数字化影响了官僚征收税收的能力。（JEL D73, H11, H71, O12, O17）

abstract.text: A common interpretation of Pareto-efficient policies is that, for some cardinal utility representations of preferences, they maximize utilitarian welfare. We show in the context of income taxation that such cardinalizations are often extreme, requiring unbounded curvature of utility with respect to consumption. Taxes can be justified as utilitarian without these extreme cardinalizations if and only if revenues are decreasing and concave in a class of narrowly targeted tax cuts. We reformulate this condition as a sufficient-statistics test. The test fails whenever elasticities of taxable income are too heterogeneous within some income level, as we argue is empirically likely. (JEL D81, H21, H23, H24, J22, J31)

10.1257/aer.20240919.abstractZh: 帕累托有效政策的一种常见解释是：对于偏好的某些基数效用表示，这些政策使功利主义福利最大化。我们在所得税语境中表明，这类基数化往往是极端的，要求效用相对于消费具有无界曲率。当且仅当在一类窄口径定向减税中，税收收入是递减且凹的，税收才能在没有这些极端基数化的情况下被论证为功利主义的。我们将这一条件重新表述为一个充分统计量检验。只要某一收入水平内应税收入的弹性过于异质——我们认为这在经验上很可能——该检验就会失败。（JEL D81, H21, H23, H24, J22, J31）

abstract.text: We provide experimental evidence on the intergenerational impacts of secondary education subsidies in a low-income context, leveraging a randomized controlled trial and 15-year longitudinal follow-up. Secondary school scholarships delay fertility, reduce unwanted pregnancies, and change partner selection. Under-one mortality is reduced by half. We also document cognitive development gains of 0.24 standard deviations of test scores by age five among children of female scholarship recipients. Means-tested secondary school scholarships are a high-return investment, with a conservatively estimated US$4.1 in benefits for each US$1 the policy would cost the government in the long run. (JEL H52, I12, I21, I26, J13, J16, O15)

10.1257/aer.20241001.abstractZh: 我们提供了低收入背景下中等教育补贴代际影响的实验证据，利用一项随机对照试验和15年纵向追踪数据。中学奖学金推迟生育、减少意外怀孕，并改变伴侣选择。一岁以下婴儿死亡率降低一半。我们还记录了女性奖学金获得者的子女在五岁时认知发展方面的改善，标准化考试成绩提高0.24个标准差。以经济状况调查为基础的中等教育奖学金是一项高回报投资，从长期看，政府每花费1美元，保守估计可获得4.1美元的收益。（JEL H52, I12, I21, I26, J13, J16, O15）

abstract.text: This paper studies the productivity of nurse practitioners (NPs) and physicians, two professions performing overlapping tasks but with starkly different backgrounds, training, and pay. Using quasi-experimental variation in patient assignment to NPs versus physicians in Veterans Health Administration emergency departments, we find that, on average, NPs use more resources and exhibit a higher 30-day preventable hospitalization rate than physicians. However, the NP-physician performance difference varies by case complexity and severity. Importantly, even larger productivity variation exists within each profession, leading to substantial overlap between the productivity distributions of the two professions; NPs outperform physicians in 38 percent of random pairs. (JEL I11, I18, J24, J44, M53)

10.1257/aer.20241007.abstractZh: 本文研究执业护士（NP）与医生的生产率。这两类职业承担相互重叠的任务，但其背景、培训和薪酬存在显著差异。利用退伍军人健康管理局急诊科中患者被分配给NP还是医生的准实验变异，我们发现，平均而言，NP使用的资源更多，且30天可预防住院率高于医生。然而，NP与医生的绩效差异随病例复杂性和严重程度而变化。重要的是，每一职业内部的生产率差异甚至更大，导致两类职业的生产率分布存在大量重叠；在38%的随机配对中，NP的表现优于医生。（JEL I11, I18, J24, J44, M53）

abstract.text: This paper considers how far private adaptation may reduce future vulnerability to climate risks. Using data on monthly firm-to-firm transactions from Pakistan, we find that flood-affected firms are more likely to relocate to safer ground and shift purchases toward suppliers in less flood-prone regions and reached via less flood-prone roads. The results indicate that firms are imperfectly informed about flood risk and update their beliefs following floods. We quantify aggregate impacts using a spatial model of endogenous production network formation. The findings suggest that firms' learning will shape the economic impact of increasingly frequent climate-related disasters. (JEL D22, L14, O13, O14, Q54, R32)

10.1257/aer.20241027.abstractZh: 本文考察私人适应能在多大程度上降低未来对气候风险的脆弱性。利用巴基斯坦企业间月度交易数据，我们发现，受洪水影响的企业更可能迁往更安全的地点，并将采购转向位于洪水风险较低地区、且可通过洪水风险较低道路到达的供应商。结果表明，企业对洪水风险的信息并不完全，并会在洪水发生后更新信念。我们使用内生生产网络形成的空间模型量化总量影响。研究结果表明，企业的学习将塑造日益频繁的气候相关灾害的经济影响。（JEL D22, L14, O13, O14, Q54, R32）

abstract.text: We study a canonical collective action game with incomplete information. Individuals attempt to coordinate to achieve a shared goal, while also facing a temptation to free-ride. More similar information can help them coordinate, but it can also exacerbate free-riding. Our main result shows that more similar information facilitates (impedes) achieving the common goal when it is sufficiently challenging (easy). We apply this insight to show why less powerful authoritarian governments may face larger protests if they restrict press freedom, when committee diversity is beneficial in costly voting, and when a more diverse community contributes more to public good provision. (JEL C71, D71, D72, D81, D82, D83, H41)

10.1257/aer.20241056.abstractZh: 我们研究一个具有不完全信息的经典集体行动博弈。个体试图协调以实现共同目标，同时面临搭便车的诱惑。更相似的信息有助于他们协调，但也可能加剧搭便车。我们的主要结果表明，当共同目标足够困难（容易）时，更相似的信息会促进（阻碍）共同目标的实现。我们运用这一洞见说明：为何权力较弱的威权政府在限制新闻自由时可能面临更大规模的抗议；在 costly voting 中委员会多样性何时有益；以及更多样化的社区何时对公共品提供贡献更大。（JEL C71, D71, D72, D81, D82, D83, H41）

abstract.text: An increasing number of decisions are guided by machine learning algorithms. But when consequential decisions are encoded in algorithms, individuals may strategically alter their behavior to achieve desired outcomes. This paper develops an empirical approach that adjusts decision algorithms to anticipate manipulation. By explicitly modeling incentives to manipulate, our approach produces decision rules that are stable under manipulation, even when the rules are fully transparent. We stress-test this approach through a large field experiment in Kenya. When implemented, linear strategy-robust decision rules outperform standard linear models such as LASSO. (JEL C45, C93, D12, D91, G51, O12, O16)

10.1257/aer.20241087.abstractZh: 越来越多的决策由机器学习算法指导。但当具有重大后果的决策被编码进算法时，个体可能策略性地改变自身行为以达成期望结果。本文提出一种调整决策算法以预判操纵的实证方法。通过显式建模操纵激励，我们的方法产生在操纵下保持稳定的决策规则，即使这些规则完全透明。我们通过肯尼亚的一项大规模田野实验对该方法进行压力测试。实施后，线性策略稳健决策规则优于 LASSO 等标准线性模型。（JEL C45, C93, D12, D91, G51, O12, O16）

abstract.text: Weekly lotteries determine which politicians ask the UK prime minister a question in front of a male-dominated, noisy chamber. Lottery winners receive 4 percent higher vote margin in the next election, but women are 12 percent less likely to submit questions than same-cohort men. The gender gap does not close with lottery-induced experience asking a question, but it closes after a format change, with questions asked to a smaller, quieter audience. The switch differentially draws in women with quieter voices. Our findings support institutional change, rather than experience, as a response to gender gaps in adversarial settings like the UK Parliament. (JEL D44, D72, J16)

10.1257/aer.20241127.abstractZh: 每周抽签决定哪些政客在男性主导、嘈杂的议事厅中向英国首相提问。抽签获胜者在下次选举中的得票优势高出4%，但女性提交问题的可能性比同队列男性低12%。性别差距并未因抽签带来的提问经历而缩小，但在形式改变、向规模更小、更安静的听众提问之后缩小。这一转变以不同方式吸引了声音更轻的女性。我们的发现支持以制度变革而非经历来应对英国议会这类对抗性环境中的性别差距。（JEL D44, D72, J16）

abstract.text: We assemble a new dataset spanning 150 years and 60 countries to study the economic toll of war. A war of average intensity is associated with an output drop of close to 10 percent in the war-site economy, while consumer prices rise by approximately 20 percent. The capital stock, total factor productivity, and equity returns all decline sharply. The economic ramifications of war are not confined to the war site. The evidence points to adverse economic outcomes in other belligerent and third-party countries if they are exposed to the war site through trade linkages or share a common border. (JEL D74, E23, E32, F43, F51, N40)

10.1257/aer.20241355.abstractZh: 我们构建了一个涵盖150年、60个国家的新数据集，以研究战争的经济代价。一场平均强度的战争与战争发生地经济体接近10%的产出下降相关，同时消费者价格上升约20%。资本存量、全要素生产率和股票收益率均大幅下降。战争的经济影响并不局限于战争发生地。证据表明，如果其他交战国和第三方国家通过贸易联系与战争发生地相关联或与其共享边界，这些国家也会出现不利的经济结果。（JEL D74, E23, E32, F43, F51, N40）

abstract.text: We study cultural integration as an equilibrium outcome of marital matching along cultural and education lines and intrahousehold investment decisions regarding fertility and cultural socialization. Our model allows us to identify cultural-ethnic-group-specific investment parameters and spousal preferences for marital matching. Structural estimates reveal a strong demand to preserve cultural identity on the part of immigrants and limited acceptance of the immigrants' cultural diversity on the part of natives. Furthermore, these estimates reveal a substantial heterogeneity of the parental value of children's education across cultures. Nonetheless, our estimates simulate substantial—though heterogeneous—cultural integration rates across immigrant groups. (JEL D13, J12, J13, J15, Z13)

10.1257/aer.20241404.abstractZh: 我们将文化融合作为沿着文化与教育维度进行婚姻匹配以及家庭内部关于生育和文化社会化投资决策的均衡结果加以研究。我们的模型使我们能够识别特定文化—族裔群体的投资参数以及配偶对婚姻匹配的偏好。结构估计揭示出移民一方对保持文化身份有强烈需求，而本地人对移民文化多样性的接受程度有限。此外，这些估计还揭示出父母对子女教育的重视程度在不同文化之间存在显著异质性。尽管如此，我们的估计模拟出各移民群体之间存在显著——尽管异质——的文化融合率。（JEL D13, J12, J13, J15, Z13）

abstract.text: Why do health facilities in developing countries do so poorly? This paper examines the role of financial constraints. I describe an experiment in which we surprised health workers in randomly selected public health clinics in Nigeria with a ₦600,000 grant paid out in installments over one year. Its administration was left entirely to health workers. The award led to large productivity gains. Using expenditure data combined with novel textual data, I provide an explanation for these effects. I show the award increased investments in physical and human capital, led to lower prices for patients, and inspired health workers to do better. (JEL D24, G31, H75, I11, J24, J31, O15)

10.1257/aer.20241459.abstractZh: 为什么发展中国家的卫生机构表现如此糟糕？本文考察金融约束的作用。我描述了一项实验：我们向尼日利亚随机选取的公共卫生诊所的卫生工作者提供一笔60万奈拉的资助，令其意外，该资助在一年内分期支付。资金管理完全交由卫生工作者负责。该奖励带来了大幅生产率提升。利用支出数据并结合新的文本数据，我为这些效应提供了一种解释。我表明，该奖励增加了对物质资本和人力资本的投资，降低了患者支付的价格，并激励卫生工作者做得更好。（JEL D24, G31, H75, I11, J24, J31, O15）

abstract.text: We study how international migrant income prospects affect long-run development in origin areas. We leverage the 1997 Asian Financial Crisis exchange rate shocks in a shift-share identification strategy across Philippine provinces. Initial migrant income shocks are magnified six-fold over time, increasing domestic income, education levels, migrant skills, and high-skilled migration. Remarkably, 74.9 percent of long-run income gains come from domestic rather than migrant income. Trade driven impacts of exchange rate shocks are orthogonal to effects via migrant income. A structural model reveals that 19.7 percent of long-run income gains stem from educational investments. International migration fosters broad economic development in origin communities. (JEL F22, F31, G01, J24, J82, O15, O16)

10.1257/aer.20241465.abstractZh: 我们研究国际移民收入前景如何影响来源地区的长期发展。我们利用1997年亚洲金融危机汇率冲击，在菲律宾各省之间采用移动份额识别策略。初始移民收入冲击随时间被放大六倍，提高了国内收入、教育水平、移民技能和高技能移民。值得注意的是，长期收入增益中有74.9%来自国内收入而非移民收入。汇率冲击通过贸易产生的影响与通过移民收入产生的效应正交。一个结构模型揭示，长期收入增益中有19.7%源于教育投资。国际移民促进了来源社区的广泛经济发展。（JEL F22, F31, G01, J24, J82, O15, O16）

abstract.text: How do majority groups respond to narrowing inequality in racially polarized environments? We study this by examining the Freedmen's Bureau, an agency created after the US Civil War to aid former slaves and launch institutional reform in the South. Using new historical records and an event-study approach, we estimate the bureau's impact on political, social, and economic outcomes. Vote shares for Democrats, the party that previously championed slavery and opposed Black civil rights, initially eroded in bureau counties, but these impacts faded as federal oversight weakened. Racial backlash emerged rapidly and persisted, suggesting White majorities sought to offset Black progress. (JEL D63, D72, J15, N31, N41)

10.1257/aer.20241561.abstractZh: 在种族极化环境中，多数群体如何回应不平等的缩小？我们通过考察自由民局（Freedmen’s Bureau）来研究这一问题。该机构在美国内战后设立，旨在帮助前奴隶并在南方启动制度改革。利用新的历史记录和事件研究方法，我们估计了自由民局对政治、社会和经济结果的影响。在设有自由民局的县，民主党的得票份额最初下降；民主党此前拥护奴隶制并反对黑人公民权利。但随着联邦监督削弱，这些影响逐渐消退。种族反弹迅速出现并持续存在，表明白人多数群体试图抵消黑人的进步。（JEL D63, D72, J15, N31, N41）

abstract.text: Using administrative data from Scandinavian countries, we provide evidence on international migration responses to wealth taxes and evaluate their aggregate economic implications. We find significant migration responses among the wealthy: A 1 percentage point increase in the top wealth tax rate decreases the stock of wealthy taxpayers by about 2 percent. A large fraction of the wealthy are business owners, and their businesses are negatively affected by owner out-migration. The aggregate effects are nevertheless modest: The migration responses to a 1 percentage point increase in the top wealth tax rate reduce employment by 0.02 percent, investments by 0.07 percent, and value added by 0.10 percent. (JEL D31, E22, E24, F22, H24, L26, K34)

10.1257/aer.20241596.abstractZh: 我们利用斯堪的纳维亚国家的行政数据，提供关于对财富税的国际迁移反应的证据，并评估其总量经济影响。我们发现富裕人群存在显著的迁移反应：最高财富税率每提高1个百分点，富裕纳税人的存量约减少2%。富裕人群中有很大一部分是企业所有者，其企业受到所有者外迁的负面影响。尽管如此，总量效应仍然温和：对最高财富税率提高1个百分点的迁移反应使就业减少0.02%、投资减少0.07%、增加值减少0.10%。（JEL D31, E22, E24, F22, H24, L26, K34）

abstract.text: We assess whether men and women are treated differently when presenting their economics research. We collected data across thousands of seminars, job market talks, and conference presentations, leveraging human judgment and audio-processing algorithms to measure the number, tone, and type of interruptions. Within a seminar series, women are interrupted more than men. This holds when controlling for characteristics of the presenter, paper, and audience. Interruptions that are negative in tenor or tone or cut off the presenter mid-sentence increase for women presenters. We also find greater engagement of female audience members with female presenters, suggesting a potential role model effect. (JEL A11, C45, J16, J44)

10.1257/aer.20241718.abstractZh: 我们评估男性和女性在展示其经济学研究时是否受到不同对待。我们收集了数千场研讨会、求职报告和会议报告的数据，利用人工判断和音频处理算法测量打断的次数、语气和类型。在同一系列研讨会中，女性比男性被更频繁地打断。在控制报告人、论文和听众特征后，这一结果依然成立。对于女性报告人，语气或语调为负面、或在句子中途打断报告人的打断行为有所增加。我们还发现女性听众对女性报告人的参与度更高，提示可能存在榜样效应。（JEL A11, C45, J16, J44）

abstract.text: We study the relationship between corporate income taxation and carbon dioxide (CO 2 ) emissions in the United States. We show CO 2 -intensive firms benefit more from the tax advantage of debt and pay lower income taxes on their capital income. Building on these new facts, we provide evidence that a cut in the corporate income tax rate leads to a larger expansion of clean firms. We develop a multisector general equilibrium model that accounts for our evidence and quantify the impact of corporate tax reforms on aggregate emissions. A policy that eliminates the tax advantage of debt could reduce aggregate emissions without affecting GDP. (JEL D22, G32, H25, H32, Q52, Q54, Q58)

10.1257/aer.20241765.abstractZh: 我们研究美国企业所得税与二氧化碳（CO2）排放之间的关系。我们表明，CO2 密集型企业从债务的税收优势中获益更多，并对其资本收入缴纳更低的企业所得税。基于这些新事实，我们提供证据表明，企业所得税税率的削减会带来清洁企业更大幅度的扩张。我们构建一个多部门一般均衡模型，该模型能够解释我们的证据，并量化企业税制改革对总量排放的影响。一项消除债务税收优势的政策可以在不影响 GDP 的情况下降低总量排放。（JEL D22, G32, H25, H32, Q52, Q54, Q58）

abstract.text: This paper studies the implications of central bank credibility for long-run inflation and inflation dynamics. We introduce central bank lack of commitment into a standard nonlinear New Keynesian economy with sticky-price monopolistically competitive firms. Inflation is driven by the interaction of lack of commitment and the economic environment. We show that long-run inflation increases following an unanticipated permanent increase in the labor wedge or decrease in the elasticity of substitution across varieties. In the transition, inflation overshoots and then gradually declines. Quantitatively, inflation overshooting is persistent, and the welfare loss from lack of commitment relative to inflation targeting is large. (JEL D43, E12, E23, E24, E31, E52, E58)

10.1257/aer.20241925.abstractZh: 本文研究中央银行可信度对长期通胀和通胀动态的影响。我们将中央银行缺乏承诺引入一个标准的非线性新凯恩斯主义经济，其中企业为价格粘性的垄断竞争企业。通胀由缺乏承诺与经济环境之间的相互作用驱动。我们表明，在劳动楔子出现未预期的永久性上升或品种间替代弹性出现未预期的永久性下降之后，长期通胀会上升。在过渡过程中，通胀会超调，随后逐步下降。在数量上，通胀超调具有持续性，且相对于通胀目标制，缺乏承诺所带来的福利损失很大。（JEL D43, E12, E23, E24, E31, E52, E58）

abstract.text: The recent inflation surge brought inflation back on people's minds. I quantify when and how much attention to inflation changes and derive the macroeconomic implications of these attention changes. I estimate an attention threshold at an inflation rate of 4 percent, that attention doubles when inflation exceeds this threshold, and that supply shocks have stronger and more persistent effects on inflation in times of high attention. Developing a model featuring the attention threshold, I show that attention changes offer a joint explanation for inflation surges, inflation's co-movement with inflation expectations, and a long last mile of disinflation. (JEL D84, E12, E31, E43, E52)

10.1257/aer.20250051.abstractZh: 近期通胀飙升使通胀重新回到人们的关注视野。我量化了对通胀的关注在何时发生变化以及变化幅度，并推导这些关注变化带来的宏观经济含义。我估计关注阈值出现在4%的通胀率：当通胀超过该阈值时，对通胀的关注程度翻倍；在高关注时期，供给冲击对通胀的影响更强且更持久。通过构建一个包含关注阈值的模型，我表明关注变化能够联合解释通胀飙升、通胀与通胀预期的联动，以及去通胀过程中漫长的“最后一英里”。（JEL D84, E12, E31, E43, E52）

abstract.text: We consider an economy in which long-lived experts are matched with short-lived clients. Experts choose the type of client with whom they match, unobserved by the market. The interaction outcome depends on both the expert’s and the client’s type. We study the effects of supplying information about otherwise unobservable outcomes, such as “medical report cards,” to help clients identify better experts. Such information can lead to inefficient matches, as experts reject risky clients to build their reputation. Hence, information can reduce welfare. Withholding information can mitigate these perverse incentives at the cost of misallocating experts known to be inept. (JEL C78, D82, D83)

10.1257/aer.20250053.abstractZh: 我们考虑一个由长期存续的专家与短期存续的客户相匹配的经济。专家选择与其匹配的客户类型，而该类型无法被市场观测。互动结果同时取决于专家类型和客户类型。我们研究提供关于原本不可观测结果的信息（例如“医疗报告卡”）以帮助客户识别更优秀专家的效应。此类信息可能导致低效率匹配，因为专家会拒绝高风险客户以建立自身声誉。因此，信息可能降低福利。隐瞒信息可以缓解这些逆向激励，但代价是错误配置那些已知能力不足的专家。(JEL C78, D82, D83)

abstract.text: What is the optimal response of a resource exporter when a price cap is imposed on its main export? This paper develops a dynamic framework incorporating stochastic prices, financial frictions, and market power to study this novel tool of statecraft. With the right design, a price cap can incentivize increased extraction, stabilizing prices in the global market. But the stabilizing effects diminish when there is leakage outside the cap. Consequently, weak enforcement of the policy worsens the trade-off faced by the sanctioning policymaker. We provide a systematic approach to setting and enforcing an optimal cap level in these circumstances. (JEL F12, F14, F51, L71, P28, P33, Q35)

10.1257/aer.20250064.abstractZh: 当某资源出口国的主要出口品被施加价格上限时，其最优应对是什么？本文构建了一个纳入随机价格、金融摩擦与市场势力的动态框架，以研究这一新型治国工具。若设计得当，价格上限可以激励出口国增加开采，从而稳定全球市场价格。但当价格上限之外存在泄漏时，其稳定效应会减弱。因此，政策执行不力会加剧实施制裁的决策者所面临的权衡。我们提供了一套系统性方法，用于在这些情形下设定并执行最优的价格上限水平。（JEL F12、F14、F51、L71、P28、P33、Q35）

abstract.text: We study the causal effects of global supply chain disruptions by constructing a new index of real-time port congestion using Automatic Identification System data from container ships and a spatial clustering algorithm. We develop a model with search frictions between producers and retailers that links upstream production slack to downstream supply shortages and captures output and price responses to supply chain shocks. The co-movements of output, prices, spare capacity, and market tightness provide novel identification restrictions. We find that demand and supply shocks drove US disinflation in 2020, while the inflation surge in 2021 was driven mainly by supply chain shocks. (JEL C43, E31, F14, F23, L14, L92)

10.1257/aer.20250081.abstractZh: 我们通过使用集装箱船的自动识别系统数据和空间聚类算法构建新的实时港口拥堵指数，研究全球供应链中断的因果效应。我们构建了一个生产商与零售商之间存在搜寻摩擦的模型，将上游生产闲置与下游供给短缺联系起来，并刻画产出和价格对供应链冲击的反应。产出、价格、闲置产能和市场紧度的联动提供了新的识别约束。我们发现，需求冲击和供给冲击推动了2020年美国通胀放缓，而2021年通胀飙升主要由供应链冲击驱动。（JEL C43, E31, F14, F23, L14, L92）

abstract.text: Americans rarely marry outside their race or class group, a pattern with well-documented implications for inequality and intergenerational mobility. Limited exposure may partly explain these low intergroup marriage rates. We instrument for exposure using variation in childhood neighborhoods based on whether other race and class groups had more opposite-sex children of similar age. Exposure increases interclass (high- and low-parent income) marriage but has no detectable effect on interracial (White and Black) marriage. A spatial marriage model predicts that residential segregation—one of many forms of exposure—accounts for more than one-third of marital sorting by class but less than 5 percent by race. (JEL J12, J15, J62, R23)

10.1257/aer.20250115.abstractZh: 美国人很少与自身种族或阶层群体之外的人结婚，这一模式对不平等和代际流动的影响已有充分文献记载。接触机会有限可能部分解释了这些较低的群体间通婚率。我们利用童年邻里环境的变化作为接触的工具变量，其依据是其他种族和阶层群体是否有更多年龄相近的异性子女。接触机会增加了跨阶层（父母收入高低不同）婚姻，但对跨种族（白人与黑人）婚姻没有可检测到的影响。一个空间婚姻模型预测，居住隔离——众多接触形式之一——解释了按阶层婚配中超过三分之一的婚姻匹配，但按种族婚配中不足5%。（JEL J12, J15, J62, R23）

abstract.text: We study the welfare impacts of 96 climate-related tax and spending policies. We extend and apply the marginal value of public funds (MVPF) framework, most notably providing a new method for incorporating learning-by-doing spillovers. We find subsidies for the production of clean energy (such as wind production tax credits) have higher MVPFs than all other subsidies in our sample, including EV subsidies. Conservation nudges have large MVPFs when targeting regions with dirty grids. Fuel taxes and cap-and-trade policies are highly efficient means of raising revenue. We also construct traditional cost-per-ton estimates and compare and contrast the lessons they provide. (JEL D83, H23, H25, L62, Q42, Q54, Q58)

10.1257/aer.20250166.abstractZh: 我们研究了96项气候相关税收与支出政策的福利影响。我们扩展并应用了公共资金边际价值（MVPF）框架，尤其是提供了一种纳入“干中学”溢出效应的新方法。我们发现，清洁能源生产补贴（如风电生产税收抵免）的MVPF高于样本中所有其他补贴，包括电动汽车补贴。当以电网污染较重的地区为目标时，节能引导措施具有较高的MVPF。燃料税与总量管制和交易政策是筹集收入的高度有效手段。我们还构建了传统的每吨成本估计，并比较和对照了二者所提供的启示。（JEL D83, H23, H25, L62, Q42, Q54, Q58）

abstract.text: We analyze consumer surplus when a monopolist can adjust both prices and product qualities across segments, engaging in secondand third-degree price discrimination simultaneously. We characterize the consumer-optimal segmentation and show that it has a striking structure: Consumers with the same value receive the same quality in every segment, though prices differ. Under mild conditions, any segmentation harms consumers if and only if demand is sufficiently more elastic than supply. Hence, potential benefits for consumers depend critically on demand and supply elasticities. These findings have implications for regulatory policy regarding price discrimination and market segmentation. (JEL D42, D83, K21, L12, L15)

10.1257/aer.20250206.abstractZh: 我们分析了当垄断者能够同时调整不同细分市场的价格和产品质量、并同时实施二级和三级价格歧视时的消费者剩余。我们刻画了消费者最优的市场细分，并表明其具有一个显著结构：具有相同价值的消费者在每个细分市场中获得相同的质量，尽管价格不同。在温和条件下，任何市场细分都会损害消费者利益，当且仅当需求相对于供给足够富有弹性。因此，消费者可能获得的收益关键取决于需求和供给弹性。这些发现对有关价格歧视和市场细分的监管政策具有启示意义。（JEL D42, D83, K21, L12, L15）

abstract.text: Over 2 billion people lack clean drinking water. Existing solutions face high costs (piped water) or low demand (point-of-use chlorine). Using a 60,000 household cluster-randomized experiment, we test an alternative approach: decentralized treatment and home delivery of clean water to the rural poor. At low prices, take-up exceeds 90 percent, sustained throughout the experiment. High prices reduce take-up but are privately profitable. We experimentally recover revealed-preference measures of valuation. Willingness-to-pay is several times higher than prior indirect estimates; willingness-to-accept is larger and exceeds marginal cost. Self-reported health measures improve accordingly. On a cost-per-DALY basis, free water delivery regimes appear highly cost effective. (JEL I12, O12, O13, O18, Q25, Q51, Q53)

10.1257/aer.20250278.abstractZh: 超过20亿人缺乏清洁饮用水。现有解决方案要么成本高昂（管道供水），要么需求低迷（使用点氯化）。我们利用一项包含6万户家庭的整群随机实验，检验另一种替代方案：对农村贫困人口实行分散式处理并配送清洁饮用水。在低价下，申领率超过90%，且在整个实验期间持续如此。高价会降低申领率，但具有私人盈利性。我们通过实验恢复了显示性偏好意义上的估值指标。支付意愿比此前的间接估计高出数倍；接受意愿更高，且超过边际成本。自报健康指标也相应改善。按每DALY成本衡量，免费送水制度显得极具成本有效性。（JEL I12、O12、O13、O18、Q25、Q51、Q53）

abstract.text: Mechanisms that aim to reduce environmental degradation at low cost can be undermined when participants' conservation actions are not marginal to the incentive—or “additional”—as the lowest-cost participants may not be the highest social value. We investigate this challenge in the Conservation Reserve Program's auction mechanism for ecosystem services, linking bids to satellite-derived land use. Three-quarters of marginal auction winners are not additional. The heterogeneity in counterfactual land use introduces adverse selection. We develop a model of bidding and additionality to quantify welfare implications. Alternative auctions increase efficiency by using scoring rules that incorporate expected land use impacts. (JEL D44, D82, Q24, Q57, R14)

10.1257/aer.20250295.abstractZh: 旨在以低成本减少环境退化的机制，在参与者的保护行动对激励而言并非边际——或并非“额外”——时可能被削弱，因为成本最低的参与者未必具有最高的社会价值。我们在保护储备计划（Conservation Reserve Program）的生态系统服务拍卖机制中研究这一挑战，将投标与卫星衍生的土地利用数据相匹配。边际拍卖获胜者中有四分之三并非额外的。反事实土地利用的异质性引入了逆向选择。我们构建了一个投标与额外性模型，以量化福利含义。替代性拍卖通过采用纳入预期土地利用影响的评分规则来提高效率。（JEL D44, D82, Q24, Q57, R14）

abstract.text: We study the role of victim reporting in the production of public safety. We examine the Secure Communities program, a crime-reduction policy that involved police in detecting unauthorized immigrants and increased deportation fears in immigrant communities. We find that the policy reduced the likelihood that Hispanic victims report crimes to police and increased offending against Hispanics. The number of reported crimes is unchanged, masking these opposing effects. We show that reduced reporting drives the offending increase and provide the first elasticity of offending to victim reporting in the literature, calculating that a 10 percent decline in reporting increases offending by 7.9 percent. (JEL J15, K37, K42)

10.1257/aer.20250305.abstractZh: 我们研究受害者报案在公共安全供给中的作用。我们考察“安全社区”计划，这是一项减少犯罪的举措，该政策让警察参与识别无合法身份的移民，并加剧了移民社区对遣返的恐惧。我们发现，该政策降低了西班牙裔受害者向警方报案的可能性，并增加了针对西班牙裔的犯罪行为。报案犯罪数量保持不变，掩盖了这些方向相反的效果。我们表明，报案减少推动了犯罪行为增加，并给出了文献中首个犯罪行为对受害者报案的弹性，计算得出报案下降10%会使犯罪行为增加7.9%。（JEL J15、K37、K42）

abstract.text: A principal decides which party deserves a prize. Only the parties observe the state that determines who is deserving. The principal gives each party a text describing the conditions under which that party deserves the prize and asks each to report the state. The parties are nonstrategic. Each activates a known cheating procedure whose outcome depends on the state and on the text. Implementation is achieved if, whenever the parties disagree, the liar is identified by the “one-way cheating principle”: The truthful party is the unique party who could not have produced his story had the rival's story been true. (JEL D82, D91)

10.1257/aer.20251879.abstractZh: 一位委托人决定哪一方应获得奖励。只有各方观察到决定谁应获奖的状态。委托人给每一方一份文本，描述该方在何种条件下应获奖，并要求每一方报告状态。各方均非策略性行事。每一方启动一个已知的作弊程序，其结果取决于状态和文本。若每当各方意见不一致时，说谎者都能通过“单向作弊原则”被识别出来，则实施得以实现：诚实的一方是唯一一个在对手陈述为真的情况下不可能给出自己陈述的一方。（JEL D82、D91）

abstract.text: Doctors often treat similar patients differently, which affects health outcomes and medical spending. We assess the recent literature on doctor decision-making through the lens of a model that incorporates diagnostic and procedural skills, beliefs, incentives, and differences in patient pools. Decision-making is affected by beliefs, training, experience, peer effects, financial incentives, and time constraints. Interventions to improve decision-making include providing information, guidelines, and technologies like electronic medical records and algorithmic decision tools. Economists have made progress in understanding doctor decision-making, but applications of that knowledge to improving health care are still limited. (JEL D83, D91, G51, I11, I14, J24, J44)

10.1257/jel.20251762.abstractZh: 医生常常对相似的患者采取不同的治疗方法，这会影响健康结果和医疗支出。我们通过一个模型来评估关于医生决策的最新研究，该模型考虑了诊断与操作技能、信念、激励因素以及患者群体的差异。决策过程受到信念、培训、经验、同伴效应、财务激励和时间限制的影响。改善决策能力的干预措施包括提供信息、指导方针，以及使用电子病历和算法决策工具等技术。经济学家在理解医生决策方面取得了进展，但将这些知识应用于改善医疗保健方面仍然有限。（JEL D83, D91, G51, I11, I14, J24, J44）

abstract.text: Medicaid is one of the largest public programs in the United States—providing health insurance to over 75 million low-income Americans—and over three quarters of its enrollees receive care via private “managed care” insurers. In this article, we make three central points about the economics of contracting out Medicaid to private insurers. First, the empirical evidence on Medicaid privatization is mixed: contracting out has not meaningfully reduced public costs or improved quality of care. Second, we propose a framework, which we call “procured competition,” to describe the unique structure of Medicaid managed care as a hybrid of public procurement and regulated competition. Third, we discuss the key policy levers across procurement, competition, and consumer choice in this model. Throughout, we highlight open research questions, arguing that the enormous variation in how states design these programs—combined with limited evidence on what works—represents a promising area for high-impact scholarship.

10.1257/jep.20251475.abstractZh: 医疗补助是美国最大的公共项目之一，为超过7500万低收入美国人提供健康保险。超过四分之三的参保者通过私人“管理式护理”保险公司获得医疗服务。在本文中，我们提出了关于将医疗补助外包给私人保险公司的三个核心观点。首先，关于医疗补助私有化的实证证据并不一致：外包并未显著降低公共成本或提高护理质量。其次，我们提出了一种称为“采购竞争”的框架，来描述医疗补助管理式护理的独特结构，这是一种公共采购与监管竞争的结合体。第三，我们讨论了该模型中涉及采购、竞争和消费者选择的关键政策因素。在整个讨论中，我们强调了开放的研究问题，认为各州在规划这些项目时的巨大差异，加上关于有效方法的有限证据，为具有高度影响力的学术研究提供了广阔的空间。

abstract.text: This paper investigates how consumer impatience affects competition and how delivery technology may reshape market structure in online retail markets.

10.1287/mksc.2024.0885.abstractZh: 本文探讨了消费者不耐烦情绪如何影响竞争，以及配送技术如何可能重塑在线零售市场的结构。

abstract.text: This paper studies how product market competition shapes the impact of private equity (PE) acquisitions on consumers. We examine nursing home buyouts and observe that PE-owned facilities exhibit greater competitive sensitivity: competing more aggressively when competitive incentives are strong and exploiting market power more aggressively when competitive incentives are weak. We find that PE-owned facilities are more sensitive to local market competition—even when comparing effects only across facilities purchased as part of the same acquisition—and are more responsive to a pro-competitive policy helping consumers compare facilities. This suggests that regulators should attend to the competitive sensitivity of acquirers and the concentration of markets where acquisitions occur, as well as consider pro-competitive policies to mitigate or even reverse PE’s potentially adverse consequences. This paper was accepted by Carrie Chan, healthcare management. Funding: This work was supported by the UCLA Price Center for Entrepreneurship and Innovation and the UCLA Fink Center for Finance and Investment. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01486 .

10.1287/mnsc.2023.01486.abstractZh: 本文研究了产品市场竞争如何影响私募股权收购对消费者的影响。我们研究了养老院收购的情况，发现由私募股权公司拥有的机构表现出更强的竞争敏感性：在竞争激励较强的环境下，这些机构会采取更激进的竞争策略；而在竞争激励较弱的情况下，则会更积极地利用市场力量。我们发现，即使是同一收购中购买的机构之间，私募股权公司拥有的机构也更能应对当地市场竞争——并且对有助于消费者比较机构的亲竞争政策反应更为积极。这表明，监管机构应关注收购方的竞争敏感性以及收购发生市场的集中度，并考虑实施亲竞争政策来减轻甚至逆转私募股权公司可能带来的负面影响。本文由Carrie Chan负责医疗管理领域的评审。资金支持：本研究得到了UCLA创业与创新价格中心以及UCLA金融与投资芬克中心的支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可访问https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01486。

abstract.text: Electricity grids form the backbone of modern economies, but the utilities responsible for maintaining them face new energy management challenges associated with both aging infrastructure and climate change. Growing evidence suggests that digital technologies and data-driven decision-making may improve firm performance. However, existing work focuses on the private sector. Organizations providing public services have different incentives and constraints. In this paper, we narrow this gap through a study of the U.S. power sector. We construct a rich utility-level data set and estimate the effects of “smart” meters on electricity losses, a key indicator of system and utility performance. Implementing an augmented staggered difference-in-differences design, we find that electricity losses decrease by 4%–7% following smart meter deployment, on average. Utilities’ annual revenue increases by 1%–2%. We show that the underlying mechanisms relate to changes in energy management. Consumption measurement and billing accuracy improve, as indicated by an increase in sales, giving utilities a clearer understanding of the system to enhance decision-making. Utilities invest in complementary organizational capital that is important for fully realizing the benefits of digitalization, such as hiring “quants.” They also offer new products, like demand response programs, which attenuates the increase in sales but does not drive the reduction in losses. Power outage duration declines, suggesting that utilities use smart meters to improve reliability by restoring service faster after disruptions. Outage frequency remains unchanged. This paper was accepted by Caroline Flammer, sustainability. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06349 .

10.1287/mnsc.2024.06349.abstractZh: 电力网络是现代经济的基础，但负责维护这些网络的公用事业公司面临着与基础设施老化及气候变化相关的新能源管理挑战。越来越多的证据表明，数字技术和数据驱动的决策可能提升企业的绩效。然而，现有的研究主要集中在私营部门。提供公共服务的组织具有不同的激励和约束条件。在本文中，我们通过对美国电力行业的研究来缩小这一差距。我们构建了一个丰富的公用事业级数据集，并估算了“智能”电表对电力损耗的影响，电力损耗是系统和公用事业绩效的关键指标。通过实施增强型分阶段差异差异设计，我们发现，在智能电表部署后，电力损耗平均减少了4%至7%。公共事业的年度收入增加了1%至2%。我们表明，这些机制与能源管理方面的变化有关。消费测量和计费准确性得到了改善，这表现为销售额的增加，使公用事业公司能够更清晰地了解系统状况，从而更好地做出决策。公用事业公司投资于互补的组织资本，这对于充分实现数字化的好处非常重要，例如雇佣“量化分析师”。它们还推出了新的产品，如需求响应计划，这些产品虽然减少了销售额的增加，但并没有导致损耗的减少。停电持续时间缩短，这表明公用事业公司利用智能电表通过更快恢复服务来提高可靠性。停电频率保持不变。本文已被Caroline Flammer的可持续性领域接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06349获取。

abstract.text: This study considers a voluntary hospital certification program and how it shapes patient health outcomes. The Baby-Friendly Hospital Initiative designates participating hospitals as “Baby-Friendly” if they adhere to various practices thought to promote breastfeeding. We estimate the effect of being born in a Baby-Friendly hospital on breastfeeding initiation and infant health. Identification relies on a within-mother analysis that compares siblings who were born in the same hospital: one when the hospital was not certified and another when the hospital was certified. Data come from South Carolina birth certificates from 2010 to 2019 linked to subsequent emergency department records, hospital records, and death certificates. The results indicate that Baby-Friendly accreditation has no widespread effects on breastfeeding initiation. It does, however, increase breastfeeding rates among a subset of Black mothers with a history of bottle-feeding. Infants exposed to the designation are more likely to leave the hospital in under two days, and there is also some evidence of subsequent reductions in healthcare utilization in the next year. We do not find precise changes in all-cause one-year mortality, although we do observe a marginally significant reduction in deaths caused by “extreme immaturity.” This paper was accepted by Anita Carson, healthcare management. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06422 .

10.1287/mnsc.2024.06422.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了自愿性的医院认证计划如何影响患者的健康结果。Baby-Friendly Hospital Initiative将符合特定实践要求的医院认定为“Baby-Friendly”医院，这些实践被认为有助于促进母乳喂养。我们评估了在Baby-Friendly医院出生对母乳喂养开始率和婴儿健康的影响。研究通过母系分析来识别数据，比较了在同一家医院出生的兄弟姐妹：一家出生在尚未获得认证的医院，另一家则出生在已获得认证的医院。数据来源于2010年至2019年南卡罗来纳州的出生证明，并与后续的急诊记录、医院记录和死亡证明进行关联。研究结果表明，Baby-Friendly认证对母乳喂养开始的促进作用并不明显。然而，它确实提高了有奶瓶喂养历史的黑人母亲群体的母乳喂养率。被认定为Baby-Friendly医院的婴儿更有可能在两天内出院，并且有证据表明，在接下来的一年里，医疗使用率也有所下降。我们没有发现全因死亡率的精确变化，但观察到因“极度不成熟”导致的死亡人数有轻微下降。本文由Anita Carson负责医疗管理领域的审稿。补充材料可访问：https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06422。

abstract.text: We document that interactions with manipulated clinical decision support (CDS) systems can induce not only short-term, but also long-term changes in physicians’ opioid prescribing behavior. Physicians in our sample adopted electronic health record software from a list of federally certified vendors in 2011. Between 2016 and Spring 2019, one vendor secretly embedded a biased CDS function designed to promote extended-release opioid sales. Affected physicians not only increased opioid claims relative to the control group during the treatment window, but also maintained a higher propensity to prescribe opioids, even after the biased function was removed. This long-term behavioral change persisted even after affected physicians moved to new locations, changed their affiliations, or faced stricter state-level opioid regulations. Increasing physician awareness helped mitigate this impact. Using machine-learning algorithms, we estimate that decision-making distortion accounts for approximately 54% of the treatment effects in a physician decision model with dynamic learning. This paper was accepted by Hemant Bhargava, information systems. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07930 .

10.1287/mnsc.2024.07930.abstractZh: 我们记录了与经过操控的临床决策支持系统之间的互动不仅会在短期内，还会在长期内改变医生对阿片类药物的处方行为。我们的样本中的医生在2011年采用了来自联邦认证供应商列表中的电子健康记录软件。在2016年至2019年春季期间，某供应商秘密植入了一个旨在促进长效阿片类药物销售的偏见性决策支持功能。受影响的医生在治疗期间不仅增加了阿片类药物的索赔量，而且即使在偏见功能被移除后，他们继续表现出更高的阿片类药物处方倾向。这种长期的行为变化在受影响医生迁移到新的地点、改变隶属关系或面临更严格的州级阿片类药物监管规定后仍然持续存在。提高医生的意识有助于减轻这种影响。通过机器学习算法，我们估计决策偏差在具有动态学习能力的医生决策模型中占到了大约54%的治疗效果。这篇论文已被Hemant Bhargava的信息系统领域接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07930获取。

abstract.text: Hospital prices for Americans with commercial health insurance are determined through thousands of negotiations between hospitals and insurers. Threats of network departicipation (brinkmanship) in these negotiations may help parties secure more favorable terms. We studied 14,918 relationships between 3,772 unique hospitals and 92 unique in-market insurers to better understand the relationships among organizational characteristics (including market conditions), public brinkmanship, and departicipation. We documented 1,249 episodes of public brinkmanship, corresponding to about 8 percent of hospital-insurer relationships, for contracts ending between August 2021 and July 2025. About 28 percent of these public threats culminated in withdrawal. Profitable hospitals, for-profit hospitals, and hospitals commanding relatively high prices were most likely to engage in public brinkmanship; national insurers were more likely to engage in brinkmanship than single-state or regional insurers. We observed brinkmanship in about 16 percent of relationships where the hospital system and insurer each controlled roughly 25-45 percent and 30-45 percent of local beds and commercial lives, respectively. Our findings emphasize the importance of local contexts in shaping hospital-insurer relationships. Policy makers should assess the effectiveness of aggressive negotiations as a means to control costs and the impact of brinkmanship and departicipation on consumers' access and experiences.

10.1377/hlthaff.2025.01663.abstractZh: 美国商业健康保险患者的医院价格是通过医院与保险公司之间的数千次谈判确定的。在这些谈判中，威胁退出网络的行为可能有助于各方获得更有利的条款。我们研究了3,772家医院与92家市场内保险公司之间的14,918笔交易关系，以更好地了解组织特征（包括市场条件）、公开威胁行为以及退出行为之间的关系。我们记录了1,249起公开威胁行为，约占医院与保险公司交易关系的8%，这些合同在2021年8月至2025年7月期间终止。其中约28%的公开威胁最终导致了退出。盈利性医院、营利性医院以及定价较高的医院更有可能采取公开威胁行为；全国性保险公司比单一州或地区性保险公司更有可能采取这种威胁行为。我们观察到，在大约16%的关系中，医院系统和保险公司分别控制着约25-45%和30-45%的当地床位和商业业务。我们的研究结果强调了当地环境在塑造医院与保险公司关系中的重要性。政策制定者应评估积极谈判作为控制成本手段的有效性，以及威胁行为和退出行为对消费者获取和服务体验的影响。

abstract.text: Background: This dissertation investigates how operational pressures, workload dynamics, and technological interventions shape patient care quality and service efficiency in high-stakes healthcare settings. Methodology and Results: This dissertation applies operational management concepts, causal inference methods, and econometrics to improve healthcare operations management. The first study (Chapter 1) examines how different dimensions of workload influence voluntary attrition among ICU nurses. While greater patient responsibility within a shift is associated with higher engagement and a lower likelihood of quitting, sustained cumulative workload, overtime shifts, and exposure to patient mortality significantly increase voluntary turnover. The second study (Chapter 2) evaluates the adoption of a Virtual Nurse (VN) model on patient outcomes. The implementation reduces patient length of stay by 7.18% and decreases 30- and 60-day readmission rates by approximately 2%. The third study (Chapter 3) shifts focus to the Emergency Department and examines how operational pressures influence physicians’ discretionary clinical decisions, specifically the ordering of resource-intensive diagnostic tests such as CT scans. The results show that increased multitasking, proximity to shift end, and accumulated prior patient interactions reduce the likelihood of ordering a CT scan. Conclusion: This dissertation advances the understanding of how workload, technology, and clinical decision-making interact to shape operational and clinical outcomes in high-acuity healthcare environments. The findings offer actionable managerial insights on workload design, task delegation, and the strategic integration of virtual workforce solutions to sustain high-quality care under operational pressure.

10.17615/9jgp-qs83.abstractZh: 背景：本论文研究运营压力、工作量动态和技术干预如何影响高风险医疗环境中的患者护理质量和服务效率。方法论与结果：本论文运用运营管理概念、因果推断方法和计量经济学方法来改进医疗运营管理。第一项研究（第一章）探讨了工作量的不同维度如何影响重症监护室护士的自愿离职情况。研究发现，在轮班期间承担更多患者责任与更高的工作积极性以及较低的离职率相关，而持续累积的工作量、加班轮班以及面临患者死亡风险则显著增加了自愿离职的可能性。第二项研究（第二章）评估了虚拟护士模式对患者结果的影响。实施该模式后，患者住院时间减少了7.18%，30天和60天的再入院率也分别降低了约2%。第三项研究（第三章）重点关注急诊科，探讨运营压力如何影响医生的自由裁量临床决策，特别是资源密集型诊断测试如CT扫描的安排。研究结果表明，增加多任务处理、接近轮班结束时间以及之前的患者互动经历都会降低医生安排CT扫描的可能性。结论：本论文进一步揭示了工作量、技术和临床决策如何相互作用，从而影响高风险医疗环境中的运营和临床结果。研究结果为工作量设计、任务分配以及战略性整合虚拟劳动力解决方案以在运营压力下维持高质量护理提供了可行的管理建议。

abstract.text: This thesis examines the effects of GP competition and consolidation on the quality of health care presented in chapters 2 and 3. Quality is being measured using data from the General Practice Patients Survey (GPPS) and performance indicators from the Quality and Outcomes Framework (QOF). Competition in the market is being measured as the number of rival full time equivalent GPs, the number of GP practice competitors in the market and the Herfindel-Hirshman Index (HHI) to capture market concentration in which the GP practice operates. Market size is defined as a fixed or variable radius circle centred on the GP practice. Chapter 2 analyses competition in both the fixed and variable radius markets using the fixed effects estimator. The findings confirm that competition improves quality consistent with economic theory and prior empirical works on the effects of competition on quality in regulated healthcare markets. All the coefficients are under 1 percentage point for both the fixed and variables radius markets sections although most of them are statistically significant at 10% or lower. Chapter 3 uses GP mergers data constructed from the FOI and uses exact matching to create a control group from the practices that did not merge in the period. The difference-in-differences approach is used to estimate the effects of mergers on quality of care. The findings show that quality measured as patient satisfaction drops in merged GP practices after merger both in the short and long run. For instance, getting through to practice on phone declines to more than 5.4 percentage points in the first year following the merger and it increases to 8.7 percentage points in the 4th year after the merger. The pattern of the results is similar to other outcome variables and are robust to a number of different model specifications. The findings from both chapters have a number of policy implications which may need to be considered when adopting market mechanisms. For instance, mergers may need to be analysed on a case-by-case basis.

10.17635/lancaster/thesis/3318.abstractZh: 本论文探讨了全科医生竞争与整合对医疗服务质量的影响，相关分析分别在第2章和第3章中进行。服务质量通过全科医生患者调查的数据以及质量与成果框架中的绩效指标来衡量。市场竞争程度通过竞争对手的全日制等效全科医生数量、市场上的竞争医生数量以及赫芬德尔-赫希曼指数来衡量，后者用于反映全科医生执业所在市场的集中度。市场规模被定义为以全科医生执业点为中心的固定或可变半径范围。第2章使用固定效应估计方法，分析了固定半径和可变半径市场中的竞争情况。研究结果表明，竞争确实提升了服务质量，这与经济理论以及关于竞争对监管医疗市场服务质量影响的先前实证研究一致。所有系数在固定半径和可变半径市场部分均低于1个百分点，尽管其中大多数在10%或更低水平上具有统计学意义。第3章利用从信息公开法案中获取的全科医生合并数据，并通过精确匹配法从未合并的执业点中创建对照组。采用差异-差异方法来估计合并对服务质量的影响。研究发现，合并后的全科医生执业点中，以患者满意度衡量的服务质量在短期和长期内均有所下降。例如，合并后的第一年，通过电话联系执业点的成功率下降了5.4个百分点以上，而在合并后的第四年则上升到了8.7个百分点。这些结果与其他成果变量类似，并且在不同模型设定下依然具有稳健性。这两章的研究结果具有一些政策意义，在采用市场机制时需要考虑这些意义。例如，合并行为可能需要逐一进行分析。

abstract.text: Although the literature on assignment mechanisms emphasizes the importance of efficiency based on agents’ preferences, policymakers may want to achieve different goals. For instance, school districts may want to affect student learning outcomes but must take teacher welfare into account when assigning teachers to students in classrooms and schools. This paper studies both the potential efficiency and equity test-score gains from within-district reassignment of teachers to classrooms using novel data that allows us to observe decisions of both teachers and principals in the teacher internal transfer process, and test-scores of students from the observed assignments. We jointly model student achievement and teacher and school principal decisions to account for potential selection on test score gains and to predict teacher effectiveness in unobserved matches. Teachers, but not principals, are averse to assignment based on the teachers’ comparative advantage. Estimates from counterfactual assignments of teachers to classrooms imply that, under a constraint not to reduce any retained teacher’s welfare, average student test scores could rise by 7% of a standard deviation. Although both high and low achievers would experience average gains under this counterfactual, gains would be larger for high-achieving students.

10.17848/wp23-392.abstractZh: 尽管关于分配机制的文献强调基于代理人偏好的效率的重要性，但政策制定者可能希望实现不同的目标。例如，学区可能希望影响学生的学习成果，但在将教师分配到各个教室和学校时，必须考虑教师的福利。本文研究了通过重新分配教师到教室来提升效率和公平性的潜力，利用新颖的数据来观察教师及其校长在内部调动过程中的决策，以及由此产生的学生考试成绩的变化。我们联合建模学生成绩、教师及学校校长的决策，以考虑基于考试成绩的选择效应，并预测在未观察到的匹配情况下的教师效能。研究表明，教师而非校长对基于教师比较优势的分配持反感态度。根据反事实分配后的估计，在不降低任何保留教师的福利的前提下，平均学生考试成绩可以提高7%的标准差。尽管高成就者和低成就者都能从中受益，但高成就学生的收益更大。

abstract.text: Competition can control costs and incentivise efficiency in the healthcare sector. This paper examines how regulation interacts with competition in healthcare markets and identifies areas where competition authorities can advocate for pro-competitive regulation. It presents a framework for identifying and reviewing regulatory barriers to competition, and it discusses empirical evidence and relevant experience by competition authorities. It finds that rules such as needs based entry restrictions, or incumbents’ involvement in licensing decisions, can limit entry and reduce capacity. Similar concerns arise in professional regulation, where restrictive definitions of tasks and limited portability of licences can exacerbate workforce shortages and reduce access. The development of digital services can also be slowed down by regulatory barriers, such as the lack of interoperability between electronic records systems. Finally, pro-competitive regulation can support patients and payers by providing them with usable information.

10.1787/102fea92-en.abstractZh: 竞争可以在医疗保健领域控制成本并激励效率提升。本文探讨了监管与医疗保健市场中的竞争之间的相互作用，并指出了竞争部门可以倡导有利于竞争性的监管领域。文章提出了一个框架，用于识别和审查阻碍竞争的监管障碍，并讨论了竞争部门的相关经验和实证证据。研究发现，诸如基于需求的准入限制或现有企业参与许可决策等规则可能会限制新进入者的机会并降低产能。在专业监管领域，对任务的定义过于严格以及许可证的可转移性有限等问题同样会导致劳动力短缺和就医机会减少。数字服务的发展也可能因监管障碍而受阻，例如电子记录系统之间缺乏互操作性。最后，有利于竞争性的监管可以通过提供有用的信息来支持患者和支付方。

abstract.text: La concurrence peut contribuer à maîtriser les coûts et à améliorer l’efficience dans le secteur de la santé. Cette note examine les interactions entre réglementation et concurrence sur les marchés de la santé et identifie des domaines où les autorités de la concurrence peuvent plaider pour une réglementation proconcurrentielle. Elle présente un cadre permettant d’identifier et d’examiner les barrières réglementaires à la concurrence en s’appuyant sur des données empiriques et l’expérience acquise par les autorités de la concurrence à cet égard. L’analyse met en évidence que certaines règles peuvent restreindre l’entrée sur les marchés et limiter les capacités, notamment les restrictions à l’entrée fondées sur l’évaluation des besoins ou l’implication des acteurs en place aux décisions d’octroi d’agréments. La réglementation professionnelle suscite des préoccupations similaires, dans la mesure où des définitions restrictives des compétences et la faible portabilité des agréments peuvent exacerber des pénuries de personnel et réduire l’accès à la profession. Le développement des services numériques peut également être ralenti par des barrières réglementaires, notamment en raison du manque d’interopérabilité entre les systèmes de dossiers électroniques. Enfin, une réglementation proconcurrentielle peut être un appui pour les patients et les organismes payeurs en leur fournissant des informations exploitables.

10.1787/9fae27e7-fr.abstractZh: 竞争有助于控制成本并提高医疗保健领域的效率。本文探讨了监管与市场竞争之间的相互作用，并指出了竞争监管机构可以倡导有利于竞争性的监管领域的方向。文章提出了一个框架，通过实证数据和竞争监管机构在此方面的经验，来识别并评估对竞争的限制因素。分析表明，某些规则可能会限制市场进入，并限制市场容量，例如基于需求评估的进入限制，或限制现有参与者参与许可决策。专业监管也引发类似的担忧，因为对技能的限制性定义以及许可的不可转移性可能会加剧人员短缺问题，并降低进入该行业的机会。数字服务的发展也可能因监管障碍而受阻，尤其是由于电子病历系统之间的互操作性不足。最后，有利于竞争性的监管可以为患者和支付机构提供有用的信息支持。

abstract.text: This research analyzes the quality of management practices in Spanish companies, applying the methodology of the World Management Survey through interviews with company managers. The results show that the management quality of Spanish companies is lower than in more advanced countries. However, similar patterns of behavior to those found by the World Management Survey at the global level are identified, such as firm size, internationalization of the company, employee skills, intensity of competition, ownership by dispersed capital, professional management in family-owned companies, gross domestic product per capita, or flexible labor regulation are associated with better management quality. The paper concludes with a series of recommendations for companies or organizations that aim to improve their management.

10.18046/j.estger.2025.174.6822.abstractZh: 本研究通过采用世界管理调查的方法，对西班牙公司的管理实践质量进行了分析，并通过对公司管理层的访谈来获取数据。研究结果表明，西班牙公司的管理质量低于一些发达国家。然而，与全球范围内世界管理调查所发现的类似行为模式仍然存在，例如企业规模、公司的国际化程度、员工技能、竞争强度、分散资本的所有权、家族企业中的专业管理、人均国内生产总值以及灵活的劳动法规等因素，都与更好的管理质量相关。文章最后提出了一系列建议，旨在帮助那些希望提升自身管理能力的公司或组织。

abstract.text: Key insights1.The Ministry of Justice (MoJ)'s day-to-day budget -£11.8 billion in day-to-day spending in 2025-26 -is a key input into the financial resources of the justice system.It saw large reductions in the early 2010s, followed by a partial recovery in recent years.Between 2007-08 and 2016-17, this budget was reduced by 33% in real terms, compared with a 3% reduction in total day-to-day departmental spending.MoJ spending began to recover from 2016-17, and by 2025-26 the day-to-day budget stood 2.4% below its 2002-03 level in real terms.Current plans imply real-terms growth in day-to-day justice funding of around 1.8% per year between 2025-26 and 2028-29, faster than the 1.2% per year average for overall departmental spending.Recent increases are expected to undo, in aggregate, the spending reductions of the early 2010s, but spending per person in 2025-26 remains 17% lower than its 2002-03 level. Pressures on justice system resources are shaped by demand on the system.For example, the number of open cases in party-to-state tribunals reached a record 330,000 in early 2026, driven largely by rapid growth in the number of appeals.As a result, average waiting times have risen substantially: asylum and immigration appeals were taking 61 weeks to resolve in early 2026, compared with 23 weeks in 2013, while social security appeals (predominantly for disability benefit applications) were taking 35 weeks, compared with 18 weeks in 2013.These delaysin part a result of increasingly stretched resources -appear to reflect rising demand more than a recent deterioration in the productivity of tribunals.3. Productivity, management and organisation can, however, have large effects on outcomes in the justice system, helping to determine how effectively justice institutions convert existing resources into results.We provide three examples.In the Crown Court, sitting days increased by 32% between 2019 and 2024, but case disposals rose by only 20%, which helps explain why backlogs continued to grow despite increased court capacity.In policing, differences in the characteristics and operational practices of Borough Commanders explain around one-quarter of the variation in crimes solved per officer across London police divisions.Finally, in prisons, independent inspections reduced violence by around 12 incidents per 1,000 prisoners per month in the 15 months following an inspection, without requiring an increase in staffing or expenditure.Instead, inspections appear to work by changing how existing resources and practices are managed.

10.1920/re.ifs.2026.4729.abstractZh:
关键见解：
