1. 司法部在2025-26年度的日常预算为118亿英镑，是司法系统财政资源的重要来源。该预算在2010年代初大幅减少，近年来有所恢复。2007-08年度至2016-17年度期间，这一预算实际减少了33%，而各部门日常支出的总减少幅度仅为3%。自2016-17年度起，司法部的支出开始恢复，到2025-26年度，日常预算实际水平比2002-03年度的水平低2.4%。当前计划显示，从2025-26年度到2028-29年度，司法系统日常资金的年均增长约为1.8%，高于各部门总体支出的年均1.2%增长率。最近的增加预计将抵消2010年代初的支出减少，但2025-26年度的人均支出仍比2002-03年度的水平低17%。对司法系统资源的需求决定了压力的方向。例如，2026年初，党派与州级法庭的未决案件数量达到了创纪录的330,000件，这主要是由于上诉案件数量的迅速增加所致。因此，平均等待时间显著上升：2026年初，庇护和移民上诉的解决时间达到了61周，而2013年仅为23周；社会保障上诉（主要是残疾福利申请）的解决时间则达到了35周，而2013年仅为18周。这些延迟部分是由于资源日益紧张造成的，似乎反映了需求的增加，而非法庭生产力的近期下降。  
3.然而，生产力、管理和组织方式对司法系统的结果有着显著的影响，有助于决定司法机构如何将现有资源转化为实际成果。我们举三个例子来说明。在刑事法庭，从2019年到2024年间，开庭天数增加了32%，但案件处理量仅增加了20%，这解释了为何尽管法庭的容量增加了，案件积压情况仍然持续存在。在警务方面，伦敦各警察部门中，各区指挥官的特征和运作方式的不同，解释了每名警察处理的犯罪数量差异的约四分之一。最后，在监狱领域，独立检查在检查后的15个月内，使每1000名囚犯中的暴力事件减少了约12起，而无需增加人员配置或支出。相反，检查似乎通过改变现有资源和管理方式来发挥作用。

abstract.text: This paper examines a general class of inferential problems in semiparametric and nonparametric models defined by conditional moment restrictions. We construct tests for the hypothesis that at least one element of the identified set satisfies a conjectured (Banach space) "equality" and/or (a Banach lattice) "inequality" constraint. Our procedure is applicable to identified and partially identified models, and is shown to control the level, and under some conditions the size, asymptotically uniformly in an appropriate class of distributions. The critical values are obtained by building a strong approximation to the statistic and then bootstrapping a (conservatively) relaxed form of the statistic. Sufficient conditions are provided, including strong approximations using Koltchinskii's coupling. Leading important special cases encompassed by the framework we study include: (i) Tests of shape restrictions for infinite dimensional parameters; (ii) Confidence regions for functionals that impose shape restrictions on the underlying parameter; (iii) Inference for functionals in semiparametric and nonparametric models defined by conditional moment (in)equalities; and (iv) Uniform inference in possibly nonlinear and severely ill-posed problems.

10.1920/wp.cem.2015.5915.abstractZh: 本文研究了一种由条件矩约束定义的半参数和非参数模型中的推理问题。我们构建了检验假设的方法，即识别集合中至少有一个元素满足所假设的（巴拿赫空间）“等式”约束和/或（巴拿赫格子）“不等式”约束。我们的方法适用于已识别和部分识别的模型，并证明在适当的分布类中，能够渐近均匀地控制检验水平，某些条件下还能控制检验样本大小。临界值是通过对统计量进行强逼近，然后采用保守地放宽形式的统计量进行自助法得到的。我们提供了充分条件，包括使用Koltchinskii耦合方法进行强逼近。我们研究的框架涵盖以下重要特殊情况：(i) 对无限维参数的形状约束进行检验；(ii) 对施加形状约束的泛函的置信区域进行估计；(iii) 对由条件矩不等式定义的半参数和非参数模型中的泛函进行推断；以及(iv) 在可能非线性和严重不适定问题中进行均匀推断。

abstract.text: Advances in the study of partial identification allow applied researchers to learn about parameters of interest without making assumptions needed to guarantee point identification. We discuss the roles that assumptions and data play in partial identification analysis, with the goal of providing information to applied researchers that can help them employ these methods in practice. To this end, we present a sample of econometric models that have been used in a variety of recent applications where parameters of interest are partially identified, highlighting common features and themes across these papers. In addition, in order to help illustrate the combined roles of data and assumptions, we present numerical illustrations for a particular application, the joint determination of wages and labor supply. Finally we discuss the benefits and challenges of using partially identifying models in empirical work and point to possible avenues of future research.

10.1920/wp.cem.2015.6415.abstractZh: 在部分识别研究方面的进展使得应用研究人员能够在不做假设以保证点识别的情况下，了解感兴趣的参数。我们讨论了假设和数据在部分识别分析中的作用，旨在为应用研究人员提供信息，帮助他们在实际工作中运用这些方法。为此，我们展示了一组在最近的应用中被使用的计量经济模型样本，这些模型中的参数被部分识别，同时强调了这些论文中的共同特征和主题。此外，为了帮助说明数据和假设的结合作用，我们为一个特定应用——工资和劳动力供给的联合确定——提供了数值示例。最后，我们讨论了在实证工作中使用部分识别模型的好处和挑战，并指出了未来研究的可能方向。

abstract.text: This paper surveys some of the recent literature on inference in partially identified models. After reviewing some basic concepts, including the definition of a partially identified model and the identified set, we turn our attention to the construction of confidence regions in partially identified settings. In our discussion, we emphasize the importance of requiring confidence regions to be uniformly consistent in level over relevant classes of distributions. Due to space limitations, our survey is mainly limited to the class of partially identified models in which the identified set is characterized by a finite number of moment inequalities or the closely related class of partially identified models in which the identified set is a function of a such a set. The latter class of models most commonly arise when interest focuses on a subvector of a vectorvalued parameter, whose values are limited by a finite number of moment inequalities. We then rapidly review some important parts of the broader literature on inference in partially identified models and conclude by providing some thoughts on fruitful directions for future research.

10.1920/wp.cem.2016.0516.abstractZh: 本文综述了关于部分识别模型中的推断方法的一些最新研究。在回顾了一些基本概念之后，包括部分识别模型的定义以及识别集的概念，我们接着讨论了在部分识别环境下构建置信区间的方法。在讨论中，我们强调了要求置信区间在相关分布类别上保持一致性的重要性。由于篇幅限制，我们的综述主要限于那些识别集由有限数量的矩不等式所表征的部分识别模型类别，以及那些识别集是这些集合的函数的部分识别模型类别。后一类模型通常出现在人们关注向量值参数的某个子向量时，该子向量的值受到有限数量的矩不等式的约束。随后，我们快速回顾了关于部分识别模型中的推断方法的一些重要研究内容，并最后提出了一些关于未来研究方向的思考。

abstract.text: Advances in the study of partial identification allow applied researchers to learn about parameters of interest without making assumptions needed to guarantee point identification. We discuss the roles that assumptions and data play in partial identification analysis, with the goal of providing information to applied researchers that can help them employ these methods in practice. To this end, we present a sample of econometric models that have been used in a variety of recent applications where parameters of interest are partially identified, highlighting common features and themes across these papers. In addition, in order to help illustrate the combined roles of data and assumptions, we present numerical illustrations for a particular application, the joint determination of wages and labor supply. Finally we discuss the benefits and challenges of using partially identifying models in empirical work and point to possible avenues of future research.

10.1920/wp.cem.2016.4516.abstractZh: 在部分识别研究方面的进展使得应用研究人员能够在不做假设以保证点识别的情况下，了解感兴趣的参数。我们讨论了假设和数据在部分识别分析中的作用，旨在为应用研究人员提供信息，帮助他们在实际工作中运用这些方法。为此，我们展示了一组在最近的应用中被使用的计量经济模型样本，这些模型中的参数被部分识别，同时强调了这些论文中的共同特征和主题。此外，为了帮助说明数据和假设的结合作用，我们为一个特定应用——工资和劳动力供给的联合确定——提供了数值示例。最后，我们讨论了在实证工作中使用部分识别模型的好处和挑战，并指出了未来研究的可能方向。

abstract.text: This paper is concerned with learning decision makers' (DMs) preferences using data on observed choices from a fi nite set of risky alternatives with monetary outcomes. We propose a discrete choice model with unobserved heterogeneity in consideration sets (the collection of alternatives considered by DMs) and unobserved heterogeneity in standard risk aversion. In this framework, stochastic choice is driven both by different rankings of alternatives induced by unobserved heterogeneity in risk preferences and by different sets of alternatives considered. We obtain sufficient conditions for seminonparametric point identi fication of both the distribution of unobserved heterogeneity in preferences and the distribution of consideration sets. Our method yields an estimator that is easy to compute and that can be used in markets with a large number of alternatives. We apply our method to a dataset on property insurance purchases. We fi nd that although households are on average strongly risk averse, they consider lower coverages more frequently than higher coverages. Finally, we estimate the monetary losses associated with limited consideration in our application.

10.1920/wp.cem.2019.0819.abstractZh: 本文关注于利用关于有限风险选择集合中的观测选择数据来推断决策者的偏好。我们提出了一个离散选择模型，该模型考虑了决策者考虑选择集合的未观测异质性以及标准风险厌恶的未观测异质性。在这个框架下，随机选择受到风险偏好未观测异质性以及考虑选择集合差异所引发的替代方案排名差异的共同影响。我们得出了关于偏好未观测异质性的分布和决策者考虑选择集合分布的双半参数点识别的充分条件。我们的方法提供了一种易于计算的估计量，适用于具有大量选择的市场。我们将该方法应用于财产保险购买的数据集，发现尽管家庭平均而言具有强烈的风险厌恶倾向，但他们更频繁地考虑较低保额而非较高保额。最后，我们在应用中估计了有限考虑所导致的货币损失。

abstract.text: This paper is concerned with learning decision makers’ preferences using data on observed choices from a ﬁnite set of risky alternatives. We propose a discrete choice model with unobserved heterogeneity in consideration sets and in standard risk aversion. We obtain suﬃcient conditions for the model’s semi-nonparametric point identiﬁcation, including in cases where consideration depends on preferences and on some of the exogenous variables. Our method yields an estimator that is easy to compute and is applicable in markets with large choice sets. We illustrate its properties using a dataset on property insurance purchases.

10.1920/wp.cem.2020.2820.abstractZh: 本文关注如何利用关于有限风险选择集合的观察数据来学习决策者的偏好。我们提出了一个离散选择模型，该模型考虑了选择集合的标准风险厌恶特性中的未观测异质性。我们得出了该模型半非参数点识别的充分条件，包括选择集合依赖于偏好以及某些外生变量的情况。我们的方法提供了一种易于计算的估计量，适用于具有大量选择集合的市场。我们通过一个关于房产保险购买的数据集来说明该方法的特性。

abstract.text: Consideration set models relax the assumption that consumers are aware of all available options. Thus far, identification arguments for these models have relied either on auxiliary data on what options were considered or on instruments excluded from consideration or utility. In a discrete choice framework subsuming logit, probit and random coefficients models, we prove that utility and consideration set probabilities can be separately identified without these data intensive methods. In full-consideration models, choice probabilities satisfy a symmetry property analogous to Slutsky symmetry in continuous choice models. This symmetry breaks down in consideration set models when changes in characteristics perturb consideration, and we show that consideration probabilities are constructively identified from the resulting asymmetries. In a lab experiment, we recover preferences and consideration probabilities using only data on which items were ultimately chosen, and we apply the model to study hotel choices on Expedia.com and insurance choices in Medicare Part D.

10.1920/wp.ifs.2017.1709.abstractZh: 考虑集模型放宽了消费者知晓所有可用选项的假设。迄今为止，对这些模型的识别论证依赖于关于哪些选项被考虑的辅助数据，或者依赖于被排除在考虑范围之外的工具变量或效用变量。在包含逻辑模型、概率模型以及随机系数模型的离散选择框架中，我们证明了无需这些数据密集型方法即可分别识别效用和考虑集概率。在完全考虑模型中，选择概率满足一种类似于连续选择模型中Slutsky对称性的性质。然而，在考虑集模型中，当特征的变化影响考虑集时，这种对称性就会失效。我们展示了可以从由此产生的不对称性中构建性地识别考虑概率。在实验室实验中，我们仅使用最终选择哪些项目的数据就能恢复偏好和考虑概率，并将该模型应用于研究Expedia.com上的酒店选择和Medicare Part D中的保险选择。

abstract.text: We examine how the effects of incentivizing individuals to use healthcare depend on the capacity of the health system. We study a conditional cash transfer program (JSY) in India that paid women to give birth in medical facilities. We find that JSY doubled the number of deliveries for which the average facility was responsible. In areas with below-median capacity, JSY increased perinatal mortality. Adverse effects spilled over onto rates of childhood vaccinations suggesting a diversion of resources from routine services. Our results indicate that health-system capacity is of first-order importance in determining whether demand-side policies are beneficial or harmful.

10.1920/wp.ifs.2020.520.abstractZh: 我们研究了激励个人使用医疗保健的效果如何取决于卫生系统的能力。我们研究了印度的一项有条件现金转移计划（JSY），该计划向在医疗机构分娩的妇女支付报酬。我们发现，JSY使由普通医疗机构负责的分娩数量增加了两倍。在卫生系统能力低于平均水平的地方，JSY导致了围产期死亡率的上升。这种负面影响还波及到了儿童疫苗接种率，表明资源从常规服务中转移到了其他方面。我们的研究结果表明，卫生系统的能力在决定需求侧政策是有益还是有害方面起着至关重要的作用。

abstract.text: We study the housing market response to a national disclosure policy that mandated the prominent display of energy efficiency information at listing.The policy altered the timing and prominence of information that was already available on request, providing a sharp test of whether the design of disclosure matters independently of its content.Using the near-universe of housing transactions in England and Wales with a flexible generalized difference-in-differences specification, we estimate willingness-to-pay premiums for more energy-efficient properties of 1-3% nationally and up to 6.5% in London.Information salience is a key channel: buyers respond to the efficiency rating made prominent at listing, but not to detailed energy information in the same certificate, equally available before and after.Observed premiums exceed the present value of energy savings, pointing to an investment component alongside consumption value.Disclosure design reshapes equilibrium valuation in a major asset market, with direct implications for climate policy.

10.1920/wp.ifs.2026.3226.abstractZh: 我们研究了住房市场对一项国家披露政策的反应，该政策要求 listings 中显著展示能源效率信息。该政策改变了已可请求的现有信息的时机和显著性，从而提供了一个重要的测试，以验证披露设计是否独立于其内容而具有意义。利用英格兰和威尔士近乎全面的住房交易数据，并采用灵活的广义差异-差异模型，我们估计了更节能房产的支付意愿溢价，全国范围内为1-3%，伦敦为高达6.5%。信息显著性是一个关键渠道：买家对 listings 中突出的效率评级作出反应，但对同一证书中的详细能源信息则没有同样的反应，这些信息在政策前后都是可获得的。观察到的溢价超过了能源节省的现值，这表明除了消费价值之外，披露设计还重塑了主要资产市场的均衡估值，并对气候政策产生了直接影响。

abstract.text: We study how replacing bureaucrats' discretion with algorithmic assessment affects the accuracy, equity, and public acceptance of tax decisions.Using Senegal's first digital property tax census in the capital, we experimentally vary reliance on bureaucrats versus algorithms to value properties, and compare results to benchmark values provided by real estate assessors.Algorithms significantly improve accuracy and both horizontal and vertical tax equity, with fully rule-based systems outperforming hybrid methods.Performance gaps reflect bureaucrats' limited knowledge rather than collusion.Conditional on liability, taxpayers are indifferent to algorithmic decisions, making algorithms a promising tool to expand the tax base without political backlash.

10.1920/wp.ifs.2026.3426.abstractZh: 我们研究了用算法评估取代官僚自由裁量权对税收决策的准确性、公平性和公众接受度的影响。以塞内加尔首都首次进行的数字财产税普查为例，我们通过实验方式对比了依赖官僚与算法来评估财产价值的效果，并将结果与房地产评估机构提供的基准值进行比较。算法显著提高了税收决策的准确性和横向及纵向的公平性，完全基于规则的系统优于混合方法。性能差距反映了官僚知识的局限性，而非他们之间的勾结。在责任范围确定的情况下，纳税人对算法决策并无异议，这表明算法是一种有望扩大税收基础且不会引起政治反弹的工具。

abstract.text: Context. Private providers play a central role in shaping prices and quality in the long-term care sector, a market characterized by widespread intersectoral competition and relatively light regulation. Yet it remains unclear whether competition from non-profit (NP) providers affects market outcomes differently than competition among private for-profit (FP) providers. In France, FP nursing homes account for about a quarter of available places although their presence varies significantly across local markets. This study examines how competition from NP providers affects accommodation prices and service quality in FP nursing homes. Method. We combine data from a national survey of 935 FP facilities, representing 53% of the sector, with administrative claims data, from 2014 to 2019, used to construct a set of quality indicators. To measure intersectoral competition, we develop a market power index that captures the competitive position of each FP provider within its local market. The index accounts for both the total nursing home supply and the share of private FP facilities within one-hour drive. To address the potential endogeneity of FP market power, we estimate instrumental variable (IV) models. Results. The results suggest that FP nursing homes facing weaker competition from NP providers charge significantly higher accommodation prices despite having similar level of staffing and building quality, while their outcome quality is lower. Conclusion. These findings suggest that competition from the non-profit sector plays an important role in constraining prices and sustaining quality in the for-profit nursing home market.

10.21203/rs.3.rs-11646746/v1.abstractZh:
背景：在长期护理领域，私人提供者对于价格和质量的塑造起着核心作用。该市场具有广泛的跨行业竞争特征，且监管相对宽松。然而，非营利性提供者之间的竞争是否会对市场结果产生与私人营利性提供者之间的竞争不同的影响，目前仍不清楚。在法国，私人营利性护理院占可用床位数量的约四分之一，但其存在情况在不同地区存在显著差异。本研究探讨了非营利性提供者之间的竞争如何影响私人营利性护理院的住宿价格和服务质量。

方法：我们结合了一项针对935家私人营利性护理院的国家调查数据，这些数据代表了该行业的53%，以及2014至2019年的行政索赔数据，以构建一套质量指标。为了衡量跨行业竞争，我们开发了一个市场力量指数，该指数能够反映每个私人营利性护理院在其本地市场中的竞争地位。该指数同时考虑了整个护理院供应情况以及私人营利性护理院在一小时车程范围内的比例。为了应对私人营利性护理院市场力量潜在的内生性问题，我们采用了工具变量模型进行估计。

结果：研究结果表明，尽管私人营利性护理院的员工配置和建筑质量相似，但面临较弱的非营利性提供者竞争时，它们的住宿价格明显更高，而其服务质量则较低。

结论：这些发现表明，非营利性部门在限制价格和维护私人营利性护理院市场质量方面发挥着重要作用。

abstract.text: BACKGROUND We investigated the effect of hospital delivery volume and travel time on maternal postpartum health service use in Norway. METHODS We conducted a population-based study including women giving birth from 2008 to 2021. Exposures were (1) annual delivery volume at the observed delivery hospital and travel time by car from the municipality center to the observed delivery hospital, and (2) expected delivery volume and expected travel time based on hospital catchment patterns. The primary outcome was maternal postpartum health service use. We used pseudo–maximum likelihood Poisson regression with adjustment for maternal characteristics, timing of birth, and pre-pregnancy health service use; within-woman analyses used fixed effects. RESULTS The study included 792,330 childbirths by 492,080 women. In the first approach, higher hospital volume (2000 vs. 500 births/year) was associated with 15% more days of GP contacts with a psychiatric diagnosis code (RR 1.15, 95% CI 1.05–1.26). Longer travel time (120-min vs. 30-min) was associated with a 20% longer delivery admission (RR 1.20, 95% CI 1.12–1.28), 5% more days of GP contact (RR 1.05, 95% CI 1.03–1.07), and 10% more days of GP contacts for conversation therapy (RR 1.10, 95% CI 1.01–1.20). In the within-woman analysis, these associations largely disappeared, except for a 13–19% increase in out-of-hours GP contacts at higher volume hospitals. CONCLUSIONS We found little evidence of a causal effect of hospital volume or travel time on overall postpartum health service use. Associations in conventional analyses may reflect residual confounding.

10.21203/rs.3.rs-8796064/v1.abstractZh:
背景：我们研究了医院分娩量和出行时间对挪威产妇产后健康服务使用的影响。  
方法：我们进行了一项基于人群的研究，涉及2008至2021年间分娩的女性。研究因素包括（1）观察中的医院年度分娩量以及从市镇中心到医院的车程时间；（2）基于医院服务区域模式预测的预期分娩量和预期出行时间。主要研究结果是产妇产后健康服务的使用情况。我们使用伪最大似然泊松回归模型，并调整了产妇特征、分娩时间以及孕前健康服务使用情况；在个体内部分析中使用了固定效应模型。  
结果：研究共涉及792,330次分娩，涉及492,080名女性。在第一种分析方法中，较高的医院分娩量（每年2000次与500次分娩相比）与GP咨询天数增加15%相关，其中涉及精神科诊断代码的情况占15%（RR 1.15，95% CI 1.05–1.26）。较长的出行时间（120分钟 vs. 30分钟）与分娩入院天数增加20%相关，GP咨询天数增加5%（RR 1.05，95% CI 1.03–1.07），以及谈话治疗咨询天数增加10%（RR 1.10，95% CI 1.01–1.20）。在个体内部分析中，这些关联大多消失了，除了在较高分娩量的医院，非工作时间GP咨询次数增加了13–19%。  
结论：我们发现，医院分娩量或出行时间对产妇产后健康服务使用的总体影响很小。传统分析中的关联可能反映了残留的混杂因素。

abstract.text: Responding to the rise of hydraulic fracturing (HF) and risks to water quality, U.S. states mandated disclosure for HF wells. We study whether and how such targeting of corporate externalities with transparency regulation reduces environmental impact. We examine salt concentrations considered HF signatures and find significant reductions in surface water impact between 9-17%, mostly along the intensive margin. Consistent with these findings, we document improvements in operator practices, including fewer wastewater spills. We unpack the transparency mechanism and show that transparency regulation enables social movements and increases public pressure, which in turn drives the documented changes in practices and water quality.

10.2139/ssrn.4171246.abstractZh: 面对水力压裂技术的兴起以及对水质的影响，美国各州强制要求对水力压裂井进行信息披露。我们研究通过透明度监管来针对企业的外部性，是否以及如何减少环境影响。我们考察了被视为水力压裂标志的盐浓度，发现地表水影响的减少幅度在9%到17%之间，这一变化主要出现在水力压裂活动较为密集的地区。与这些发现一致的是，我们观察到操作者的行为有所改善，包括废水泄漏事件的减少。我们进一步分析了透明度机制的作用，发现透明度监管能够推动社会运动，并增加公众压力，从而促使操作行为和水质方面的变化。

abstract.text: Accreditation is widely used in regulated health care markets and is typically viewed as an information device that mitigates asymmetric information and improves patient choice. In many institutional settings, however, accreditation also determines eligibility for insured reimbursement and network participation, thereby conditioning access to the principal source of demand. This paper studies the implications of that eligibility function. In a model with heterogeneous provider quality and heterogeneous patient risk, where higher-risk patients derive greater marginal benefit from higherquality care and adverse outcomes are often irreversible, conditioning access to insured patients on accreditation status changes the rule governing provider survival. When accreditation is not strictly rank-preserving in outcome-relevant treatment quality, survival need not be monotone in clinical effectiveness over the range in which eligibility is binding: higher-quality but non-accredited providers may exit, while accredited providers with lower treatment quality remain active. The analysis shows that this substitution of eligibility-based selection for outcome-based selection weakens risk-quality sorting and can reduce aggregate health production even under fully rational beliefs and informational improvement. Competitive pressure expands the region in which accreditation determines survival, and regulatory stringency may generate non-monotonic welfare effects when accreditation imperfectly tracks treatment effectiveness. The results highlight that accreditation policy in health care affects not only information and average quality, but the process of market selection and patient allocation that underlies health outcomes.

10.2139/ssrn.6337281.abstractZh: 认证在受监管的医疗保健市场中被广泛使用，通常被视为一种减少信息不对称并改善患者选择的信息工具。然而，在许多机构环境中，认证还决定了获得保险报销和加入医疗网络的资格，从而影响了主要需求来源的获取。本文研究了这一资格机制的影响。在一个具有不同医疗服务提供者质量和不同患者风险的模型中，高风险患者从更高质量的医疗服务中获得更大的边际收益，而不良后果往往是不可逆的。将获得保险患者的资格与认证状态挂钩，会改变医疗服务提供者生存的规则。当认证在结果相关的治疗质量方面不严格保持排名时，生存机制在资格生效的范围内不必是单调的：高质量但未被认证的医疗服务提供者可能会退出市场，而质量较低但被认证的医疗服务提供者则仍会保持活跃。分析表明，这种基于资格的选择替代基于结果的选拔机制会削弱风险与质量的排序，即使在完全理性的信念和信息改善的情况下，也可能降低整体健康产出。竞争压力扩大了认证决定生存范围的范围，而严格的监管可能会在认证不完全反映治疗效果时产生非单调的福利效应。结果表明，医疗保健领域的认证政策不仅影响信息和平均质量，还影响市场选择和患者分配的过程，而这些过程又是健康结果的基础。

abstract.text: This study tests whether competitive pressure improves operational efficiency by examining On-Time Performance (OTP) in the context of Italy’s High Speed Rail (HSR) liberalization. In light of the distinction between the public train operations (Trenitalia/NTV-Italo) and the rail infrastructure entity (RFI), we build panel of Trenitalia OTP using infrastructure punctuality statistics and measure competition intensity by the entry of NTV-Italo’s. Using a multi-periodevent-study design encompassing entry of the competitor and OTP outcomes from 2020 to 2025, we find no robust improvement in the incumbent’s OTP when competitive pressure increases. The analysis indicates that competitive entry, by itself, is not associated with systematic changes in observed delay outcomes.

10.2139/ssrn.6444159.abstractZh: 本研究通过考察意大利高速铁路自由化背景下的准点率，来测试竞争压力是否能够提高运营效率。鉴于公共铁路运营部门（Trenitalia/NTV-Italo）与铁路基础设施实体（RFI）之间的区别，我们基于基础设施准点统计数据构建了Trenitalia的准点率数据，并通过NTV-Italo的进入情况来衡量竞争强度。通过采用多时期事件研究设计，涵盖从2020年到2025年竞争者的进入及准点率变化，我们发现当竞争压力增加时，现有企业的准点率并未出现显著改善。分析表明，单纯的竞争进入并未导致观察到的延误情况出现系统性变化。

abstract.text: Clinical trial publications are the primary channel through which drug-efficacy evidence reaches physicians, shaping prescribing decisions and patient outcomes. To bolster credibility, pharmaceutical firms outsource trials to independent investigators. Yet the majority of these trials still include embargo clauses granting sponsors manuscriptreview and publication-delay rights. We frame the embargo as a real option that grants firms disclosure discretion when results disappoint. Linking over 18,000 U.S. clinical trials to peer-reviewed publications, we show embargo adoption concentrates where option value is highest-when fewer co-sponsors reduce contracting frictions, larger enrollment facilitates statistical power for specification search, and adverse results would cause larger market-value losses (Phase 3 trials). Our core finding concerns statistical reporting: embargoed trials are 60% more likely than non-embargoed trials to report primary outcomes at a significance coined by the FDA as "very statistically persuasive" (p < 0.0001)-a level which can qualify their drug for approval without additional replication. Such "very persuasive" significance is moderated by the number of primary outcomes tested in the trial, consistent with selective outcome reporting, and does not appear in non-embargoed trials. Furthermore, among marginally insignificant trials, embargoed studies also show 33 percentage points more positive spin in published abstracts, eliminating 82% of the negative tone associated with marginally significance for non-embargoed trials. We document stratified sophistication: top-tier journals and the FDA penalize embargo-enabled manipulation, whereas lower-tier journals and capital markets do not, allowing manipulated findings to flow into the medical literature that guides prescribing and patient care.

10.2139/ssrn.6485602.abstractZh: 临床试验的出版物是药物疗效证据传递给医生的主要渠道，对处方决策和患者结果有着重要影响。为了增强可信度，制药公司通常会将试验外包给独立的研究人员。然而，大多数这些试验仍然包含保密条款，允许赞助方在结果令人失望时选择是否审查论文并延迟发表。我们将保密条款视为一种实际选择，当结果令人失望时，赞助方可以自行决定是否披露信息。通过关联超过18,000项美国临床试验与同行评审的出版物，我们发现保密条款的实施主要集中在选项价值最高的领域——当较少的联合赞助方减少合同摩擦时，更大的样本量有助于统计功效的提升，而不良结果将导致更大的市场价值损失（针对第三阶段试验）。我们的核心发现涉及统计报告：与未保密的试验相比，保密的试验报告主要结果的可能性高出60%，这些结果达到FDA认为的“非常具有统计说服力”的水平（p < 0.0001）——这一水平足以使药物获得批准而无需进一步验证。这种“非常具有说服力”的显著性水平受到试验中测试的主要结果数量的影响，这与选择性结果报告的情况一致，而在未保密的试验中则不会出现这种情况。此外，在那些结果略显不显著的情况下，保密的研究在发表的摘要中表现出33个百分点的积极倾向，消除了未保密试验中与结果略显不显著相关的82%的负面语气。我们还发现，顶级期刊和FDA对保密条件下的操纵行为予以惩罚，而较低级别的期刊和资本市场则不会这样做，这使得被操纵的研究结果能够进入医学文献，从而影响处方和患者护理的决策。

abstract.text: We investigate the impact of monetary policy on the growth and financing expectations of euro area SMEs. Using firm-level data from the ECB’s Survey on Access to Finance of Enterprises (SAFE) from 2009 to 2024, we distinguish between conventional interest rate adjustments and unconventional measures. While conventional tightening consistently dampens expectations regarding turnover and credit, unconventional easing elicits ambiguous responses, consistent with a signalling channel where interventions are interpreted as indicators of future macroeconomic distress. Heterogeneity analysis reveals that firm size, credit history, and borrowing constraints significantly moderate these effects. We find that the interest rate and inflation expectation channels dominate transmission, whereas the bank-lending channel plays a subordinate role. These results suggest that the signalling effects of unconventional policy may dampen its efficacy for constrained firms.

10.2139/ssrn.6531532.abstractZh: 我们研究了货币政策对欧元区中小企业增长和融资预期的影响。利用欧洲央行企业融资调查数据，从2009年到2024年，我们区分了常规利率调整和非常规措施。虽然常规紧缩措施始终会抑制企业关于营业额和信贷的预期，而非常规宽松措施则引发复杂的反应，这与信号传递机制相符，即干预措施被解读为未来宏观经济困境的指标。异质性分析显示，企业规模、信贷历史和借款限制显著缓和了这些效应。我们发现，利率和通胀预期的影响最为显著，而银行借贷渠道则处于次要地位。这些结果表明，非常规政策的信号传递效应可能会削弱其对受限企业的有效性。

abstract.text: Despite intense competition among mortgage lenders, borrowers continue to face elevated rate spreads and substantial price dispersion. We argue that realtor–loan-officer referral networks are a key source of lender market power: by steering homebuyers toward a limited set of loan officers, these networks restrict effective borrower choice even in otherwise competitive markets. Using a novel dataset linking 78,706 realtors to 101,316 loan officers in 41 states, we document that such networks are both pervasive and highly concentrated: 85% of realtors direct over 40% of their clients to fewer than four loan officers. Strikingly, the lender concentration among realtors persists and even increases in markets with more lenders, suggesting that referrals constrain choices regardless of market structure. IV estimates indicate that borrowers working with referred loan officers pay 18.4 basis points higher interest rates, equivalent to $2,585 in upfront costs for the average loan of \$306k. The referral premium is nearly three times as high for Hispanic borrowers as for White borrowers, and is systematically higher for Black borrowers and financially constrained households. On average, referral lending raises rate spreads by 36.1% and explains half of the (residual) standard deviation of rate spreads after controlling for lender, market, and time fixed effects. We identify two mechanisms: referrals reduce borrowers' search intensity for lenders, and referred loan officers exercise pricing power relative to other officers within the same lending institution. Efficiency arguments (faster processing) and mediation of denial risks don't fully justify the referral premium. Our findings reveal referral networks as a hidden source of market power, imposing substantial financial costs and raising equity concerns for borrowers.

10.2139/ssrn.6625458.abstractZh: 尽管抵押贷款机构之间存在激烈的竞争，借款人仍然面临较高的利率差和显著的价格差异。我们认为，房地产经纪人与贷款专员之间的推荐网络是贷款机构市场力量的重要来源：通过引导购房者选择有限的贷款专员，这些网络即使在竞争激烈的市场中也限制了借款人的有效选择。通过一项新颖的数据集，我们将78,706名房地产经纪人与41个州的101,316名贷款专员联系起来，我们发现这种推荐网络既普遍又高度集中：85%的房地产经纪人将其超过40%的客户推荐给不到四名贷款专员。值得注意的是，贷款机构的集中程度在房地产经纪人之间仍然存在，甚至在贷款机构更多的市场中这种集中程度还会增加，这表明推荐行为无论市场结构如何都会限制选择。实证分析表明，与推荐贷款专员合作的借款人支付的利率高出18.4个基点，相当于平均30.6万美元贷款时额外的2,585美元成本。对于西班牙裔借款人而言，推荐带来的额外成本几乎是白人借款人的三倍，而对于黑人借款人和经济条件较差的家庭来说，推荐带来的额外成本则更高。平均而言，推荐贷款行为使利率差增加了36.1%，并解释了在控制贷款机构、市场和时间效应后利率差剩余标准差的一半。我们发现了两种机制：推荐行为减少了借款人的贷款搜索强度，而推荐给贷款专员的贷款专员相对于同一贷款机构内的其他专员具有定价权。效率优势（更快的处理速度）和缓解拒绝风险的作用并不能完全解释推荐带来的额外成本。我们的研究结果揭示了推荐网络作为市场力量的隐藏来源，给借款人带来了巨大的财务成本，并引发了股权方面的担忧。

abstract.text: Annual giving programs face a recurring customer-facing operations challenge: how to allocate limited outreach capacity across donors and channels when outreach efforts differ in cost, scalability, and effectiveness. This problem cannot be solved by predicting donation levels alone, because donors with high expected giving are not necessarily those whose contributions are most responsive to outreach. We develop a Bayesian framework for annual giving operations that distinguishes donor responsiveness from donor value. Building on the Cragg model, the framework separates participation and donation-amount decisions, accommodates many true zeros and highly skewed positive contributions, allows outreach effects to vary across donors, channels, and time, and accounts for endogenous outreach assignment. We apply the framework to donorlevel annual giving records from a major U.S. public university foundation over an 18-year period. The framework reveals substantial heterogeneity in donor-level responsiveness and shows that donor value and outreach responsiveness are related but distinct. Compared with a benchmark Cragg model, our framework improves predictive accuracy, particularly for donors who receive more outreach and those with irregular giving patterns. In fixed-budget simulations, an optimized allocation policy guided by estimated donor responsiveness generates at least $300,000 more in total expected donations, roughly a 12% improvement, than benchmark policies based on prior year giving or predicted donor value. The study contributes to nonprofit operations by showing how recurring outreach operations can prioritize limited contact resources based on responsiveness rather than expected giving alone.

10.2139/ssrn.6851118.abstractZh: 年度捐赠计划面临着一个常见的运营挑战：如何在捐赠者和渠道之间分配有限的推广资源，因为不同渠道在成本、可扩展性和效果上存在差异。这个问题不能仅通过预测捐赠水平来解决，因为预期捐赠额高的捐赠者并不一定是对推广反应最积极的捐赠者。我们开发了一个贝叶斯框架来应对年度捐赠运营问题，该框架将捐赠者的响应性与价值区分开来。基于Cragg模型，该框架将参与决策与捐赠金额决策分开，能够处理许多零值和高偏态的正贡献，允许推广效果在捐赠者、渠道和时间上有所不同，并考虑了推广分配的内生性。我们将该框架应用于美国一所大型公立大学基金会18年间的捐赠记录。该框架揭示了捐赠者响应性的显著异质性，并表明捐赠者的价值和响应性是相互关联但有所区别的两个概念。与基于往年捐赠或预测捐赠价值的基准Cragg模型相比，我们的框架提高了预测准确性，特别是对于接受更多推广的捐赠者和那些捐赠模式不规则的捐赠者。在固定预算的模拟中，根据估计的捐赠者响应性进行优化分配政策，至少能带来额外30万美元的总预期捐赠额，大约提高了12%，而基于往年捐赠或预测捐赠价值的基准政策则没有这样的效果。这项研究为非营利组织的运营提供了启示，表明如何通过响应性而非单纯预期捐赠来优先分配有限的接触资源。

abstract.text: Empirical work on adverse selection often represents equilibrium through demand and average-cost curves for a single contract. This paper extends that approach to markets with finitely many contracts. I define a price-taking equilibrium for such markets, prove existence, and show that the equilibrium conditions can be written as a finite complementarity system. This equilibrium generically gives the same predictions as the equilibrium notion of Azevedo and Gottlieb (2017). The paper then shows why such a benchmark is useful outside the standard model of vertically differentiated contracts. In simple Hotelling-style examples, Nash, Riley, and Miyazaki-Wilson-Spence equilibria may not exist. Miyazaki-Wilson-Spence equilibria may not exist even in settings with Nash equilibria. Dynamic withdrawal games may also support allocations that are not selected by any of these static concepts.

10.2139/ssrn.6880905.abstractZh: 关于逆向选择问题的实证研究通常是通过单个合同的供需曲线和平均成本曲线来表征均衡状态的。本文将这种方法扩展到具有有限多个合同的市场中。我为这类市场定义了一个接受价格均衡状态，证明了这种均衡的存在性，并表明均衡条件可以表述为一个有限互补系统。这种均衡通常能够给出与Azevedo和Gottlieb（2017年）提出的均衡概念相同的预测结果。本文还探讨了为什么这样的基准在垂直差异化合同的标准模型之外仍然具有实用性。在简单的Hotelling式例子中，Nash均衡、Riley均衡以及Miyazaki-Wilson-Spence均衡可能并不存在。即使在存在Nash均衡的情况下，Miyazaki-Wilson-Spence均衡也可能不存在。动态撤资博弈也可能支持那些不被这些静态概念所选择的分配方案。

abstract.text: The US is projected to face a shortage of 100,000 critical health care workers by 2028 because of domestic training capacity limitations and caps on work visas. I exploit random variation in the receipt of new H-1B visas via lotteries to study how highly skilled foreign workers affect domestic labor markets and firm production functions. I link the universe of cap-subject H-1B employers to rich administrative data for Medicare-certified nursing homes, including payroll and claims data. Immediately following the lottery news, prior to the worker's arrival, winning nursing homes: (1) win 2 H-1B registrations, (2) reduce employment by 7 full-time equivalent workers, mostly among lower-skilled nurses such as CNAs, and (3) reduce patient volume (output) by 5.8 percent. In further analysis, I show that facilities initially free up capacity by turning away low-complexity patients before shifting production toward high-complexity patients after the high-skilled H-1B worker arrives. These results are consistent with a transition to specialized, higher-margin care provided by the H-1B worker.

10.2139/ssrn.6885321.abstractZh: 预计到2028年，美国将面临10万名关键医疗工作者的短缺问题，这主要是由于国内培训能力的限制以及工作签证的限制。我利用H-1B签证发放中的随机性变化来研究高技能外国工人如何影响国内劳动力市场和企业生产函数。我将H-1B签证持有者的雇主与包含薪资和索赔数据的Medicare认证护理院的数据联系起来。在抽签结果公布后，在工人到来之前，中奖的护理院会：(1) 获得2份H-1B签证；(2) 减少7名全职员工的就业，这些员工主要是低技能护士，如护理助手；(3) 患者的数量（产出）减少5.8%。进一步分析表明，这些护理院最初会腾出资源，通过拒绝处理低复杂度患者，然后在高技能H-1B工人到来后转向处理高复杂度患者。这些结果与H-1B工人带来的专业化、高利润护理服务的转变是一致的。

abstract.text: This study investigates how the staggered enactment of pay transparency laws (PTLs) affects employee-related corporate misconduct using a stacked difference-in-differences approach. We find that PTLs significantly reduce corporate wrongdoing, with results robust across alternative measures and model specifications. Cross-sectional analyses show that the effect is stronger in firms with poorer employee conditions, such as low employee satisfaction, high turnover, and large CEO–staff pay gaps, where underlying issues are more likely to be exposed once transparency is introduced. Importantly, the effect is pronounced in settings with stronger employee power and institutional support, including higher bargaining power, greater social capital, and more protective wage policies. These findings suggest that PTLs operate primarily by increasing the visibility of potential violations and enabling employees and stakeholders to act on this information.

10.2139/ssrn.6910463.abstractZh: 本研究通过堆叠差异-差异方法，探讨了薪酬透明度法案的分阶段实施对与企业相关的不当行为的影响。研究发现，薪酬透明度法案显著减少了企业不当行为，且这一效果在不同衡量指标和模型设定下均具有稳定性。横截面分析表明，在员工条件较差的企业中，这种效果更为明显，例如员工满意度低、员工流动率高以及首席执行官与员工之间的薪酬差距较大。在这些情况下，一旦引入透明度，潜在违规行为更容易被揭露。值得注意的是，在员工权力较强且机构支持较充分的情况下，这种效果更为显著，包括更高的谈判能力、更大的社会资本以及更严格的工资政策。这些发现表明，薪酬透明度法案主要通过提高潜在违规行为的可见性，使员工和利益相关者能够依据这些信息采取行动来发挥作用。

abstract.text: Large language models (LLMs) are rapidly diffusing into text and information intensive work. However, their impacts on labor market may differ from traditional automation because LLM outputs are stochastic and require human supervision. Theoretically, this paper incorporates endogenous supervision into canonical task-based model and empirically tests its effect on firm-level labor demand, using a large-scale panel of Chinese online recruitment data. Results indicate that higher LLM exposure is associated with lower hiring, especially for cognitive labor. However, this displacement effect is moderated by an occupation’s supervision requirements; the interaction between LLM and supervision exposure is robustly positive, and can even drive net hiring expansion in certain settings. Heterogeneity analyses reveal significant organizational and institutional complementarities. Large firms exhibit stronger cognitive displacement, while the supervisionmoderation effect is more pronounced in regions with robust legal and market institutions. Consequently, our findings suggest that steering LLM diffusion toward inclusive labor augmentation requires complementary investments in operational supervision skills and supportive institutional infrastructure.

10.2139/ssrn.6986775.abstractZh: 大型语言模型正在迅速应用于文本处理和信息密集型工作。然而，它们对劳动力市场的影响可能与传统自动化有所不同，因为大型语言模型的输出是随机的，需要人工监督。理论上，本文将内生监督纳入了传统的基于任务的模型中，并通过大规模的中国在线招聘数据实证检验了其对企业级劳动力需求的影响。研究结果表明，较高的大型语言模型使用率与较低的招聘量相关，尤其是在认知型劳动力方面。不过，这种替代效应受到职业监督要求的调节；大型语言模型与监督使用率之间的交互作用具有显著的正向影响，甚至在某些情况下还能推动净招聘量的增加。异质性分析显示，存在显著的组织和制度互补性。大型企业在认知型劳动力的替代效应方面表现更为明显，而在法律和市场制度健全的地区，监督调节效应更为显著。因此，我们的研究结果表明，要将大型语言模型的应用引导至包容性劳动力提升的方向，就需要对运营监督技能以及支持性制度基础设施进行互补性投资。

abstract.text: Centralized procurement is designed to lower input prices by pooling demand across downstream providers. Whether these price reductions translate into lower spending for final users, however, is unclear when procurement covers only one component of a product bundle and does not fully specify the product's post-award quality. In this paper, we study this question in the context of China's National Volume-Based Procurement (NVBP) reform, a national government-run group purchasing program for pharmaceuticals. Using a difference-indifferences design, we analyze a unique patient-visit-level panel of outpatient visits from multiple hospitals in a Chinese province. We find that NVBP reduces patients' spending on the contracted core drugs by 10.1%, yet patients' total medical expenditure does not decline by a statistically or economically meaningful amount. We identify two channels that help explain this limited pass-through. First, providers expand the quantity of non-procured auxiliary prescriptions, consistent with downstream agents shifting toward the margins that remain outside the procurement contract and retain positive markups. Second, patients visit hospitals more frequently and experience more active adjustment of their core-drug regimens, with more core-drug items changed between consecutive visits and more items new to their prescription histories, consistent with an upstream quality response under price-and-volume auctions with limited post-award quality monitoring. We further show that savings concentrate among patients with low historical visit frequency and among those treated in non-tertiary hospitals located in the provincial capital. Taken together, our findings suggest that centralized procurement design should not focus on price reductions alone. When the buyer contracts on only part of a treatment bundle and is not the final user, realized savings depend on both upstream quality incentives and downstream substitution toward non-contracted margins.

10.2139/ssrn.7107838.abstractZh: 集中采购旨在通过整合下游供应商的需求来降低投入成本。然而，当采购仅涵盖产品组合中的一个组成部分，且未完全指定产品的交付后质量时，这些价格降低是否会导致最终用户的支出减少，这一点并不清楚。在本文中，我们在中国国家批量采购改革背景下研究了这个问题。国家批量采购是中国政府主导的药品集中采购计划。采用差异-差异设计，我们分析了中国某省多家医院的门诊数据。研究发现，国家批量采购使患者签约核心药物的支出减少了10.1%，但患者的总医疗费用并没有出现统计学或经济上显著的下降。我们发现了两个有助于解释这种有限传递效应的渠道。首先，供应商增加了非集中采购辅助处方的数量，这与下游代理商转向采购合同范围之外仍保持较高加价的利润空间相一致。其次，患者更频繁地就诊，并更积极地调整核心药物的使用方案，在连续就诊之间更换更多的核心药物，以及出现更多新药物，这与价格与数量拍卖下的上游质量响应相一致，而交付后的质量监控较为有限。我们进一步表明，节省的成本主要集中在历史就诊频率较低的患者，以及位于省会城市的非三级医院的患者身上。综合来看，我们的研究结果表明，集中采购设计不应仅关注价格降低问题。当买家仅订购了某个服务包的一部分，且并非最终用户时，实际节省的成本取决于上游的质量激励以及下游对非订购部分的替代选择。

abstract.text: This study investigates how the staggered enactment of pay transparency laws (PTLs) affects wage and hour violations using a stacked difference-in-differences approach. We find that PTLs significantly reduce corporate wrongdoing, with results robust across alternative measures and model specifications. Cross-sectional analyses show that the effect is stronger in firms with poorer employee conditions, such as low employee satisfaction, high turnover, and large CEO–staff pay gaps, where underlying issues are more likely to be exposed once transparency is introduced. Importantly, the effect is pronounced in settings with stronger employee power and institutional support, including higher bargaining power, greater social capital, and more protective wage policies. These findings suggest that PTLs operate primarily by increasing the visibility of potential violations and enabling employees and stakeholders to act on this information.

10.2139/ssrn.7231445.abstractZh: 本研究通过堆叠差异-差异方法，探讨了薪酬透明度法案的分阶段实施对工资和工时违规行为的影響。研究发现，薪酬透明度法案显著减少了企业违规行为，且这一结果在不同模型和测量指标中均具有稳定性。横截面分析表明，在员工条件较差的企业中，这种效应更为明显，例如员工满意度低、员工流动率高以及首席执行官与员工之间的薪酬差距较大。在这些情况下，一旦引入透明度，潜在违规行为更容易被揭露。值得注意的是，在员工权力较大且制度支持较强的情况下，这种效应更为显著，包括更高的谈判能力、更大的社会资本以及更完善的工资政策。这些研究结果表明，薪酬透明度法案主要通过提高潜在违规行为的可见性，使员工和利益相关者能够依据这些信息采取行动来发挥作用。

abstract.text: Many safety-net programs deliver in-kind benefits through private providers, and program design determines who participates and at what price. We study landlord participation and pricing decisions in the U.S. Housing Choice Voucher program, linking voucher administrative data to national rental listings and to a new panel of the program's rent ceilings. We show that landlords are more likely to participate and to explicitly target voucher holders in high-poverty neighborhoods and that they adjust rents substantially toward the program's rent ceiling between listing and contracting. We estimate a model of landlord behavior and show that these price adjustments sustain participation. Participation is costly, markups below the ceiling offset part of the cost, and concessions above it reveal landlords' willingness to pay for the program's payment guarantee. Reforms paying landlords only where the ceiling binds deliver more voucher leases per dollar than unconditional transfers, and targeted ceiling increases expand neighborhood access most cost-effectively.

10.2139/ssrn.7261300.abstractZh: 许多安全网项目通过私人供应商提供实物福利，项目设计决定了谁可以参与以及价格如何确定。我们研究了美国住房选择券项目中的房东参与情况及定价决策，将券款管理数据与国家租赁信息以及该项目的租金上限数据相结合。我们发现，房东更有可能参与，并且会在高贫困社区中明确针对券款持有者；在租赁和签约期间，房东会将租金大幅调整至项目规定的租金上限。我们建立了房东行为的模型，并表明这些价格调整有助于维持参与率。参与是有成本的，低于上限的加价可以抵消部分成本，而高于上限的让步则表明房东愿意为项目的支付担保支付费用。只有在租金上限区域向房东支付费用的改革方式，比无条件转移方式能带来更高的券款租赁数量；而有针对性的租金上限调整则能以最经济的方式扩大社区的可及性。

abstract.text: Multihospital system affiliation is widely pursued to improve efficiency and coordination, yet its patient-facing consequences remain unclear. This study examines how multihospital system affiliation affects patient experience and whether these effects depend on cross-organizational electronic health record (EHR) alignment. We assemble a longitudinal panel combining hospital affiliation histories, EHR vendor information, and Google reviews for nearly all U.S. general acute-care hospitals from 2011 to 2024. Using a quasi-experimental design that exploits variation in affiliation timing, we find that multihospital system affiliation---a hospital's initial transition from standalone to system-affiliated status---is associated with a 9.2% decline in average ratings, largely driven by an increase in the lowest ratings and a decline in the highest ratings. We further show that while affiliation is associated with increased adoption of the parent system's primary EHR vendor at newly affiliated hospitals, EHR misalignment persists for a significant number of systems, and the decline in patient experience is concentrated among hospitals that remain misaligned with the system's primary EHR vendor post-affiliation, with the effect becoming stronger the longer the misalignment persists. Topic modeling of the lowest star reviews indicates that post-affiliation dissatisfaction centers on billing and payment issues, consistent with coordination frictions from incomplete digital integration rather than clinical care deficiencies. By linking organizational integration, EHR standardization, and patient-facing outcomes, we demonstrate that the benefits of system affiliation depend on whether affiliated hospitals operate on a common EHR system and suggest that consolidating ownership without harmonizing EHR systems limits the coordination gains expected from affiliation.

10.2139/ssrn.7299619.abstractZh: 多医院系统关联被广泛采用以提高效率和协调性，但其对患者体验的影响仍不明确。本研究探讨了多医院系统关联如何影响患者体验，以及这些影响是否取决于跨组织的电子健康记录（EHR）的整合程度。我们收集了2011年至2024年间几乎所有美国普通急性护理医院的多医院系统关联历史、EHR供应商信息以及谷歌评价数据，构建了一个纵向面板数据。通过采用准实验设计，利用关联时间的差异，我们发现，当医院从独立状态转变为多医院系统关联状态时，平均评分会下降9.2%，这主要是由于最低评分的增加和最高评分的下降所致。进一步研究表明，虽然关联程度与新建关联医院采用母系统的主流EHR供应商的情况有关，但仍有相当数量的系统存在EHR不整合问题，患者体验的下降主要集中在那些在关联后仍然与系统主流EHR供应商不整合的医院，且这种影响随着不整合时间的延长而加剧。对最低评分评价进行主题建模分析表明，关联后的不满主要集中在计费与支付问题上，这与数字整合不完全导致的协调障碍有关，而非临床护理方面的缺陷。通过整合组织整合、电子健康记录标准化以及面向患者的治疗效果，我们证明了系统关联的益处取决于关联医院是否使用相同的电子健康记录系统。研究指出，在不协调电子健康记录系统的情况下进行资产整合，会限制从系统关联中预期的协同效应。

abstract.text: We ask whether ownership affects provider performance when patients cannot choose providers and providers cannot choose patients. In Slovakia's emergency medical services, a centralized dispatch system sends the nearest available ambulance of the required type irrespective of its operator, making ownership quasi-random within narrowly defined locations. Across 2.7 million dispatches between 2020 and 2025, patients attended by public ambulances are approximately 4.5 % more likely to die before reaching a hospital than comparable patients attended by private providers - roughly 280 additional deaths per year - while non-profit providers are statistically indistinguishable from private firms. The estimate is stable across spatial resolutions from 250 metres to the municipality, robust to restricting the sample to areas where both provider types operate, to excluding calls the dispatcher had classified as arrest or apnea before assignment, and to firm-level heterogeneity within ownership groups. The gap is concentrated in urgent and critical cases, among physician-staffed crews, and outside cities. Private units also arrive faster, and the effect is largest in the years preceding the national tender through which base locations are reallocated, consistent with a response to competitive incentives and suggesting that ownership effects depend on the contractual environment in which providers operate.

10.2139/ssrn.7412267.abstractZh: 我们探讨了在患者无法选择医疗服务提供者以及医疗服务提供者无法选择患者的情况下，所有权是否会影响医疗服务提供者的表现。在斯洛伐克的紧急医疗服务中，一个集中的调度系统会发送最近的、符合要求的救护车，而不考虑其运营方。因此，在特定的区域内，所有权呈现了近乎随机的状态。在2020年至2025年间，共有270万次调度记录显示，由公共救护车接治的患者在到达医院前死亡的概率比由私人医疗服务提供者接治的患者高出约4.5%，每年额外增加了约280例死亡。不过，非营利性医疗服务提供者与私人企业之间的统计差异并不明显。这一估计在从250米到市级的多种空间分辨率下都保持稳定，即使将样本限制在两种类型的医疗服务提供者都存在的区域，或者排除调度员在分配前将呼叫分类为逮捕或呼吸暂停的呼叫，结果仍然稳定。此外，不同所有权群体内部的公司差异也并未影响这一结论。这种差距主要出现在紧急和危重病例中，由医生组成的医疗团队中，以及城市以外的地区。私人医疗机构的响应速度也更快，这种影响在通过国家招标重新分配基础位置的前几年最为明显，这与对竞争激励的反应一致，表明所有权的影响取决于医疗服务提供者所处的合同环境。

abstract.text: This paper asks two questions. Which institutional characteristics are associated with stronger or weaker campus speech climates? And do institutions take corrective action when they are publicly ranked near the bottom? A university faces two costs of restricting speech: a legal cost that binds only public institutions, and a reputational cost is paid when its climate is publicly observed and private institutions also bear this cost. The evidence comes from five waves of the FIRE College Free Speech Rankings, 1,112 institution-waves covering 257 colleges from 2022 to 2026, merged with IPEDS. On the first question, being a public institution is the strongest institutional correlate of a strong speech climate among a plethora of institutional characteristics such as size, selectivity, wealth, religious affiliation and student ideology. On the second, institutions do respond, and the response grows with how conspicuous the bad rank was. Those placed in the bottom quintile of a wave are four times as likely than the best-ranked quintile to upgrade FIRE's written speech-code rating in the next wave as the low ranking causes reputational damage. Private institutions respond at least as strongly as public ones. Reputational accountability therefore reaches institutions the First Amendment does not. This suggests that broader and more salient disclosure is a market-based alternative to government regulation of campus speech.

10.2139/ssrn.7418658.abstractZh: 本文提出了两个问题：哪些制度特征与更优或更差的校园言论环境相关？当某些机构被公开排名时，它们是否会采取纠正措施？大学在限制言论方面面临两种成本：一种法律成本仅适用于公共机构，另一种声誉成本则体现在其言论环境被公开后，私人机构也需要承担这一成本。这些数据来自五次FIRE大学言论排名调查，共涵盖2022年至2026年间257所学院的1,112个机构样本，并结合了IPEDS的数据。对于第一个问题，作为公共机构是众多制度特征中与良好言论环境最相关的因素，这些特征包括规模、选择性、财富、宗教归属以及学生意识形态等。对于第二个问题，机构确实会做出反应，而且这种反应随着排名的显著性增加而增强。在某一轮排名中处于最低五分之一的机构，在下一次排名中提升FIRE书面言论等级的可能性是排名最高的五分之一机构的四倍，因为较低的排名会导致声誉损害。私人机构对此的反应至少与公共机构一样强烈。因此，声誉责任实际上会影响到那些受第一修正案保护的机构。这表明，更广泛的、更显著的披露方式可以成为政府监管校园言论的替代方案。

abstract.text: Regulators cannot examine every financial adviser, so they need simple rules that turn public information into monitoring priorities. Using 2.7 million adviser-year observations, we study whether an adviser's current firm improves targeting beyond the adviser's own record. We develop a dynamic observed-state model that links adviser histories, firm assignment, new public-record risk, and employment transitions. We estimate the four state-contingent disclosure hazards freely. The estimates yield a strict ordering: prior records define broad risk tiers, while record-intensive firms identify higher-risk advisers within each tier. This ordering motivates a prospective monitoring rule that preserves priority by prior-record count and uses firm context only within a count tier. At a fixed 5 percent budget, the contextual rule captures 4.28 percent more subsequent disclosures than a record-count rule. Across the two headline outcomes, matching its capture would require the record-count rule to expand capacity by 7.4 to 9.9 percent. At the scale of FINRA's Member Supervision budget, this expansion corresponds to a $42-$57 million annual supervisory-capacity equivalent under proportional scaling.

10.2139/ssrn.7427659.abstractZh: 监管机构无法审查每一位金融顾问，因此他们需要一些简单的规则，将公开信息转化为监控优先级。我们利用270万份顾问年度观察数据，研究顾问当前所在公司的表现是否优于其个人过往记录。我们开发了一个动态观察状态模型，将顾问的历史记录、公司分配、新的公开记录风险以及就业转换等因素联系起来。我们自由估计了四种与状态相关的披露风险。这些估计结果呈现出一种严格的排序：过往记录定义了广泛的风险等级，而记录密集型公司则能够识别出每个等级中风险较高的顾问。这种排序促使我们提出一种未来的监控规则，该规则通过过往记录数量来保持优先级，并且仅在记录数量等级内考虑公司背景。在固定的5%预算下，这种基于上下文的规则能够捕捉到比基于记录数量的规则多4.28%的后续披露信息。在这两个主要指标上，要使该规则发挥作用，需要增加7.4%到9.9%的监管能力。在FINRA会员监管预算的规模下，这种扩展相当于每年增加4200万到5700万美元的监管能力。

abstract.text: Governments increasingly release large administrative datasets, but these data cannot support research until operational codes are translated into meaningful constructs. We study this problem in the 2026 U.S. government release of provider-level Medicaid spending, which contains 238 million records and $994.7 billion in provider-attributable payments from 2018 to 2024. The standard available taxonomy leaves nearly half of these dollars unclassified. The missing territory includes major Medicaid services such as personal care, community behavioral health, and home-and community-based long-term services. Available labeled data come largely from Medicare-covered codes and exclude many of the Medicaid-specific categories that dominate this gap, which limits supervised classifiers trained on those labels. We develop CLAIM (Classification via LLM with Auditable Iterative Mapping), a generative AI measurement infrastructure that uses a large language model (LLM) to bring institutional knowledge into the measurement process while keeping its judgments auditable. CLAIM combines a purpose-built and versioned Medicaid Service Taxonomy, explicit abstention when a code's meaning is uncertain, complete provenance logs, and a prespecified human-expert audit with versioned correction. We classify the 3,200 highest-spend codes, covering 99.81% of analysis-set dollars. The audit confirmed 94.6% of substantively classified sampled codes, representing 98.7% of sampled dollars, and audit-based extrapolation estimates residual misclassification at 0.29% of dollars, with 2.5% under a conservative sensitivity calculation. A known-shock validation shows the measured categories reproduce the expected pattern of utilization disruption during the April 2020 COVID-19 lockdown. The measurement layer enables a national service-level census of provider-attributable Medicaid spending, event-study evidence on service-specific utilization changes around the Medicaid unwinding, and a transparent provider-integrity screen. More broadly, the study shows how generative AI can serve as a governed research instrument when administrative data are public but the measurement infrastructure needed to study them is incomplete.

10.2139/ssrn.7431598.abstractZh: 各国政府越来越多地发布大量的行政数据集，但这些数据在将操作代码转化为有意义的结构之前，无法用于研究。我们研究了2026年美国政府发布的医疗服务提供者级别支出数据，该数据包含2.38亿条记录，以及2018年至2024年间价值9947亿美元的医疗服务提供者相关支付金额。现有的分类体系几乎让一半的支付金额未被分类。缺失的类别包括个人护理、社区行为健康服务以及基于家庭和社区的长期服务等主要医疗服务。现有的标注数据主要来自医疗保险覆盖的代码，但排除了许多主导这些缺失类别的医疗服务特定类别，这限制了基于这些标注数据训练的监督分类器的性能。我们开发了CLAIM（通过大型语言模型进行可审计的迭代映射分类）这一生成式人工智能测量基础设施，它利用大型语言模型将机构知识融入测量过程，同时确保其判断结果可审计。CLAIM结合了专门构建的、带有版本控制的医疗服务分类体系、在代码含义不确定时的明确排除、完整的来源日志，以及预先指定的由人类专家进行的审计和带有版本控制的修正。我们对3,200个支出最高的代码进行了分类，涵盖了99.81%的分析数据集金额。审计确认了94.6%的实质性分类样本代码，这些代码代表了98.7%的样本金额；基于审计的外推估计显示，剩余的错误分类金额占金额的0.29%，而在保守的敏感性计算中，错误分类金额占2.5%。已知的冲击验证表明，测量出的类别能够再现2020年4月COVID-19封锁期间预期的利用中断模式。该测量层能够实现对医疗服务提供者相关医疗补助支出的全国范围服务级普查，收集关于医疗补助政策撤销后特定医疗服务使用情况的事件研究数据，并提供透明的提供者诚信筛查功能。更广泛地说，这项研究展示了当行政数据公开但用于研究的测量基础设施尚不完整时，生成式人工智能如何作为一种受控的研究工具发挥作用。

abstract.text: Charitable care provides free and discounted hospital access for millions of uninsured Americans. Using cross-state spillovers from insurance access expansions, we estimate charity care's costs and document an excess crowd-out of insured patients. A model of competitive hospital resource allocations reveals that limits on discrimination in emergency care induce hospitals facing greater charitable demand to reallocate resources to scheduled care. Compensating hospitals for charitable care raises patient surplus, with most gains accruing to the insured. Patient-optimal hospital compensation is zero when welfare counts only charitable-care patients, but rises to Medicaid-comparable levels when accounting for externalities to the insured.

10.2139/ssrn.7549958.abstractZh: 慈善医疗为数百万没有保险的美国公民提供免费或优惠的医疗服务。通过利用保险服务扩展带来的跨州影响，我们估算了慈善医疗的成本，并发现保险患者的需求被过度挤出。通过模拟竞争性医院资源分配模型，我们发现，对急诊医疗服务中歧视行为的限制促使面临更多慈善需求医院的资源重新分配到常规医疗服务上。对慈善医疗进行补偿会增加患者的剩余需求，而大部分收益都归保险患者所有。当仅考虑慈善医疗患者的福利时，医院对患者的补偿最优值为零；但当考虑到对保险患者的外部性影响时，补偿水平则上升至与医疗补助计划相当的水平。

abstract.text: Governments communicate risk through coarse categories. I show that when private behavior generates spillovers, a coarse but truthful risk disclosure can strictly dominate detailed disclosure, even for fully rational individuals. Coarseness is a second-best policy instrument: expanding the high-risk category draws additional individuals into private action that protects others. I apply this framework to Oregon's 2022 Wildfire Risk Map, which assigned each of the state's two million parcels to one of five risk categories and drew intense backlash from owners disputing its accuracy. I first show that Oregon's free model predicts held-out fires about as well as the leading proprietary alternatives. The map's coarse categories embed a trade-off between false alarms and misses, which I recover from the boundary of the high-risk category: over the two decades of fires the state could observe, catching one additional fire costs roughly twenty-five flagged parcels that do not burn. Given external estimates of adaptation costs and effectiveness, this permissive boundary is consistent with a planner who internalizes spillovers. Moving this boundary traces the set of maps that planners with different preferences over false alarms and misses would have drawn.

10.2139/ssrn.7565278.abstractZh: 政府通过粗略的分类来传达风险信息。我指出，当私人行为产生溢出效应时，即使对于完全理性的个体来说，粗略但真实的风险披露也能严格优于详细的披露。粗略分类是一种次优的政策工具：扩大高风险类别可以将更多个体纳入私人行动，从而保护其他人。我将这一框架应用于俄勒冈州2022年的野火风险地图，该地图将州内两百万块土地划分为五个风险类别，但这一做法引发了业主们的强烈反对，他们质疑该地图的准确性。首先，我证明俄勒冈州的免费模型在预测野火发生情况方面与主流的专业模型相当。该地图的粗略分类体现了误报与漏报之间的权衡，这一权衡可以从高风险类别的边界中得出：在观测到的二十年时间里，每多发现一处野火，大约会损失二十五块未发生火灾的土地。考虑到外部对适应成本和效果的评价，这种宽松的边界与将溢出效应内部化的规划者所采用的策略是一致的。调整这一边界可以描绘出不同偏好下的规划者会绘制出的地图。

abstract.text: We investigate the impact of trade liberalization on hospital operations, quality, and community access to healthcare. Consistent with the decline in manufacturing employment following trade shocks---and thus a loss of employer-sponsored health insurance among residents in affected communities---we document a reduction in the intake of privately-insured patients at local hospitals. This decline in privately-insured admissions, which typically provide the highest reimbursement rates for hospital services, has a substantial negative impact on hospital finances. Moreover, hospitals in manufacturing-dependent areas are more likely to close or merge with other hospitals and experience a significant decline in quality of care. At the same time, we observe a rise in healthcare insurance premiums in affected areas, indicating that local hospitals raise prices for patient services to improve their financial situations. The effects are more pronounced for hospitals that relied more on private insurance reimbursements and in areas experiencing greater outmigration and firm closure following trade liberalization. Our findings highlight an overlooked effect of trade liberalization---community access to healthcare---and illustrate the extent to which the healthcare system relies on reimbursements from private insurance.

10.2139/ssrn.7567578.abstractZh: 我们研究了贸易自由化对医院运营、医疗质量以及社区医疗服务的可及性影响。与贸易冲击导致制造业就业减少——从而影响到受影响社区的居民失去雇主提供的健康保险——相一致，我们发现当地医院的私人保险患者数量有所减少。这些私人保险患者通常能够获得最高的医院服务报销率，但这种减少对医院财务产生了显著的负面影响。此外，依赖制造业的地区，医院更有可能关闭或合并，医疗质量也会显著下降。同时，我们观察到受影响地区的医疗保险费用有所上升，这表明当地医院为了改善财务状况，提高了患者服务的价格。对于那些更依赖私人保险报销的医院，以及在贸易自由化后人口外流和医院关闭较为严重的地区，这种影响更为明显。我们的研究结果凸显了贸易自由化带来的一个被忽视的影响——社区对医疗服务的可及性——并说明了医疗系统在多大程度上依赖私人保险报销。

abstract.text: Social insurance often relies on third-party gatekeepers to certify eligibility, but planners cannot easily verify whether those certifications are accurate. We study this problem in the market for medical sick leave using the universe of sick leave certificates in Chile from 2018-2022 (about 22 million records). We estimate how a sharp increase in enforcement changes behavior on both the supply side (physicians) and the demand side (workers). We combine matched difference-indifferences and regression discontinuity in time on physicians, and a design that addresses non-random patient exposure. Enforcement produces a large and persistent drop in issuance among the highest-issuing physicians, with smaller spillovers to similar non-sanctioned physicians. Workers who were more exposed to these physicians reduce sick-leave use, but the final effects are smaller than the supply contraction, consistent with imperfect substitution on the worker side across providers. Workplace networks strengthen these effects, suggesting that information and access to substitute certifiers are channeled through coworkers. The findings show how substitution and spillovers shape the ultimate impact of monitoring policies.

10.2139/ssrn.7578898.abstractZh: 社会保险通常依赖第三方认证机构来确认资格，但规划者难以轻易验证这些认证的准确性。我们研究了这一问题，以智利2018年至2022年的病假证明数据为基础（约2200万条记录），分析了执法力度加强对病假申请者以及病假需求方行为的影响。我们通过匹配差异-无差异分析和时间回归 discontinuity方法，对医生群体进行了分析，并采用了一种针对非随机患者暴露的设计。研究发现，执法力度加强导致高发放病假证明的医生群体的发放量大幅下降，而对其他未受制裁的医生群体的影响则较小。那些与这些医生有较多接触的员工减少了病假使用，但最终效果仍小于供应端的收缩，这与员工在医疗服务提供者之间存在不完全替代性相符。工作场所网络进一步强化了这些效应，表明信息和替代认证渠道是通过同事传递的。研究结果揭示了替代性和溢出效应如何塑造监管政策的最终影响。

abstract.text: In many markets for public goods and services, consumers are not the actors who allocate resources to providers, weakening the feedback loops that ordinarily discipline lowquality providers. Performance disclosure is a common policy response, but its effects depend on how providers respond strategically. We study this question in charitable giving, where donors fund public goods for beneficiaries and provider efficiency is difficult to observe. In a pre-registered framed field experiment, real-world charity managers make incentivized decisions to enter fundraising competitions against a rival serving the same cause. We vary relative efficiency, whether the charity reaches donors before or alongside the rival, and whether donors observe efficiency. Disclosure strengthens market discipline in one dimension: managers are more willing to compete when their charity is more efficient than the rival and less willing to compete when it is less efficient. Yet disclosure also gives low-efficiency charities an incentive to reach donors before unfavorable comparisons occur. Transparency can therefore alter the form of competition rather than simply restore discipline, with potential consequences for the efficiency of public good provision.

10.2139/ssrn.7708598.abstractZh: 在许多公共产品和服务市场中，消费者并非资源的分配者，这削弱了通常用来约束低质量提供者的反馈机制。绩效披露是一种常见的政策响应，但其效果取决于提供者的战略反应。我们研究了慈善捐赠领域的情况，在这种情况下，捐赠者为受益人提供公共服务，而提供者的效率难以观察。在一个预先注册的实地实验中，真实的慈善管理者会做出激励性决策，以参加针对同一目标的竞争对手的筹款竞赛。我们改变了相对效率，即慈善机构是在竞争对手之前还是同时与他们竞争，以及捐赠者是否能够观察到效率。信息披露在某一维度上增强了市场纪律：当慈善机构比竞争对手更高效时，管理者更愿意竞争；而当其效率较低时，则不太愿意竞争。然而，信息披露也给了效率较低的慈善机构一个机会，让他们在不利的比较发生之前就接触捐赠者。因此，透明度可以改变竞争的形式，而不仅仅是恢复纪律性，这可能会对公共服务的提供效率产生重要影响。

abstract.text: O artigo retraça a afirmação do Insper como instituição de ensino e pesquisa não apenas no campo dos economistas, mas também como uma escola do poder, engajada em construir uma cultura de referência ampla para o Estado brasileiro. Baseado em entrevistas semiestruturadas e análise documental, o artigo reconstitui três momentos desse processo: (i) a passagem de uma faculdade profissional especializada nos mercados financeiros para uma instituição com pretensão de excelência acadêmica internacional e relevância política nacional; (ii) o desenvolvimento de interpretações sobre a formação nacional, que se valem do neoinstitucionalismo para elaborar uma narrativa englobando passado remoto (colonização, nacional-desenvolvimentismo, etc.) e presente imediato (Partido dos Trabalhadores, Jornadas de Junho de 2013, etc.); e (iii) a construção de dispositivos de autolimitação e, logo em seguida, de direção do Estado brasileiro, respectivamente as regras macroeconômicas de disciplina fiscal e as técnicas microeconômicas de avaliação de impacto e de desenho de políticas públicas. Desse modo, argumenta-se que o Insper tem exercido um papel decisivo no deslocamento da ciência econômica para além de sua jurisdição disciplinar própria (política econômica), em direção à afirmação de um saber total sobre os problemas nacionais e, a partir daí, à construção dos instrumentos de ação pública para neles intervir (razão de Estado).

10.21669/tomo.v45.25161.abstractZh: 本文回顾了Insper作为一所教学与研究机构的发展历程，它不仅在经济学领域具有影响力，更被视为一种权力机构，致力于为巴西国家打造一种广泛的参考文化。通过半结构化访谈和文献分析，本文再现了这一过程的三个阶段：(i) 从一家专注于金融市场专业的职业学院，转变为一个具有国际学术卓越性和国家政治影响力的机构；(ii) 对国家形成过程的解释，这些解释借助新制度主义理论，将遥远的过去（殖民化、国家发展主义等）与当前的现实（工党、2013年六月运动等）联系起来；(iii) 构建自我限制机制，以及指导巴西国家的机制，分别是财政纪律的宏观经济规则，以及评估影响和政策制定的微观经济技术。因此，本文认为Insper在将经济学研究拓展出其原有的学科领域（经济政策），向构建关于国家问题的全面知识，进而为干预这些问题的公共行动提供工具方面，发挥了决定性的作用。

abstract.text: Many modern organizations use knowledge hierarchies, where frontline workers try to resolve tasks and pass those they cannot resolve to experts. But the implications of this organization of expertise are not well understood, especially if firm revenues depend on who resolves each task or the firm generates downstream externalities. We study a knowledge hierarchy (KH) using 500,000 patient cases from an online primary care firm, linked to outcomes and costs across Sweden's healthcare system. We use variation in assignment arising from temporary doctor congestion, controlling for date-by-three-hour windows and flexible case characteristics. Within the KH, nurses resolve 70% of cases and pass the remainder to doctors. Relative to doctor-only care, the KH modestly increases external primary care and ED visits but has no adverse effects on hospitalizations, earnings losses, or mortality. Although the mean effect of KH on systemwide (firm plus downstream) production costs is small, this masks substantial heterogeneity. Compared to using only doctors, the savings from the firm's selective use of the KH equal 1.6% of online primary care costs. However, our main finding is that reassigning cases between the direct-to-doctor and KH routes within 15-minute windows to minimize systemwide production costs would save 6.8% of online primary care costs.

10.21953/researchonline.lse.ac.uk.001417.abstractZh: 许多现代组织采用知识层级结构，即一线员工负责处理任务，无法解决的任务则交由专家处理。但这种专业知识组织的机制其影响尚不完全清楚，尤其是当企业的收入取决于谁来处理每项任务，或者企业产生下游外部性时。我们研究了一个知识层级结构，使用了来自一家在线初级保健公司的500,000个患者案例，这些案例与瑞典医疗系统的结果和成本相关联。我们考虑了由于医生临时短缺导致的任务分配变化，并控制了时间窗口和病例的灵活特性。在知识层级结构中，护士负责处理70%的病例，其余任务则交给医生处理。与仅由医生处理的情况相比，知识层级结构略微增加了初级保健服务和急诊就诊的数量，但并未对住院率、收入损失或死亡率产生负面影响。尽管知识层级结构对系统整体（包括企业及下游环节）生产成本的平均影响较小，但这掩盖了显著的异质性。与仅依赖医生处理相比，企业选择性使用知识层级结构可节省1.6%的在线初级保健成本。然而，我们的主要发现是，在15分钟的时间窗口内重新分配病例，以最小化系统整体的生产成本，可以节省6.8%的在线初级保健成本。

abstract.text: Objetivo: avaliar se a reformulação dos contratos de gestão da atenção primária à saúde na cidade de São Paulo, iniciada em 2015, que uniformizou os instrumentos contratuais e introduziu indicadores de produção associados a penalidades financeiras, esteve associada ao aumento da produção médica por profissional. Método: estudo quantitativo com dados anuais de 2008 a 2024. As unidades tratadas foram as áreas de abrangência dos contratos de gestão na cidade de São Paulo, e as unidades de controle, outros municípios do estado de São Paulo, selecionados após um filtro inicial e ponderados por Entropy Balancing. Em seguida, estimou-se um modelo ponderado de diferença-em-diferenças. Resultados: após a reformulação contratual, o modelo estimou um aumento médio estatisticamente significativo de 416,6 consultas médicas anuais por profissional (para base SIA/SUS) e de 364,5 consultas médicas anuais por profissional (para base combinada SIA/SUS e SISAB) nas áreas tratadas. Conclusão: os resultados indicam associação positiva entre a reformulação dos contratos de gestão e a produção médica por profissional. A evidência, contudo, refere-se apenas à produção assistencial médica, não permitindo inferir efeitos sobre qualidade, resolutividade ou resultados de saúde.

10.23900/2359-1552v15n12-22-2026.abstractZh: 目的：评估2015年开始在圣保罗市对初级卫生管理合同进行改革后，该改革是否导致每位医生的人均医疗产出增加。改革措施包括统一合同工具，引入与财务处罚相关的产出指标。方法：采用定量研究方法，数据来自2008至2024年的年度记录。研究对象为圣保罗市受管理合同覆盖的区域，控制组为圣保罗州的其他市镇，通过初步筛选和熵平衡法进行加权处理。随后，采用加权差异模型进行建模。结果：改革后，模型估计每位医生的人均医疗产出分别增加了416.6次（以SIA/SUS为基础）和364.5次（以SIA/SUS和SISAB为基础）。结论：结果表明，合同改革与每位医生的人均医疗产出之间存在正相关关系。不过，这些结果仅涉及医疗产出，无法推断对医疗质量、解决率或健康结果的影响。

abstract.text: Healthcare organizations are under raising pressure to improve organizational performance through innovation as a reaction to rising costs, technological advancements, and growing societal expectations regarding the quality and accessibility of care. Although innovation is a key component of healthcare reforms and management discourse, there are still conflicting empirical results about the relationship between innovation and organizational performance, especially when contrasting public and private healthcare institutions. This discrepancy implies that the relationship between innovation and performance is heavily context-dependent and influenced by institutional factors that haven’t gotten much rigorous study. This study, which is based on bibliometric and systematic literature review (B-SLR), looks at how political context and bureaucracy influence the connection between organizational performance and innovation in public and private healthcare organizations. The paper synthesizes peer-reviewed research on bureaucracy, political influence, performance results, and innovation management in healthcare organizations. The review finds patterns in the relationship between various forms of innovation and performance outcomes under various macro settings by doing a thematic analysis of literature. According to the analysis, bureaucratic and political considerations significantly impact the effectiveness of innovation, associated with better performance. Better results and more effective delivery service are the results of stronger governance (transparency, cogent policy, and coordinated decision-making). By incorporating political and bureaucratic aspects into the innovation–performance discussion in healthcare, this research adds to the body of literature. The paper highlights the weaknesses in research on innovation and performance in the public vs. private healthcare sector and suggests new areas of research.

10.2478/picbe-2026-0073.abstractZh: 医疗组织正面临通过创新来提高组织绩效的压力，这是应对不断上升的成本、技术进步以及社会对护理质量和可及性要求的提高所采取的应对措施。尽管创新是医疗改革和管理讨论中的关键组成部分，但关于创新与组织绩效之间关系的实证研究结果仍存在分歧，尤其是在比较公共和私人医疗机构时。这种差异表明，创新与绩效之间的关系在很大程度上取决于具体情境，并受到尚未得到充分研究的制度因素的影响。本研究基于文献计量学和系统文献综述的方法，探讨了政治环境和官僚主义如何影响公共和私人医疗组织中的组织绩效与创新之间的联系。本文综合了关于官僚制度、政治影响、绩效结果以及医疗组织创新管理的同行评审研究。通过文献的主题分析，研究发现，在不同宏观环境下，各种形式的创新与绩效结果之间存在一定的关联。分析表明，官僚和政治因素对创新的有效性有着显著的影响，而有效的创新则与更好的绩效相关。更优的结果和更有效的服务交付是更强治理（透明度、合理的政策和协调一致的决策）的结果。通过将政治和官僚因素纳入医疗领域创新与绩效的讨论中，本研究为相关文献增添了新的内容。该论文指出了公共与私人医疗保健领域在创新与绩效研究方面的不足，并提出了新的研究方向。

abstract.text: This dissertation comprises three chapters on health and measurement in rural north India, with a shared focus on selection, reporting, and causal inference. Chapters 1 and 2 estimate the effect of delivery at public versus private health facilities on neonatal mortality in two large north Indian states, where public facilities charge less and serve poorer patients than private facilities yet births in public facilities survive at substantially higher rates. Chapter 1 addresses selection using two complementary approaches: the slope of village-level neonatal mortality with respect to the public–private birth share, which would be zero under pure selection, and a spatial discontinuity in mortality at district borders that exogenously shifts public use for otherwise-similar nearby births. Public facilities reduce newborn death by over 25 per thousand births, and the gap is consistent with fee-for-service incentives in private facilities that reward interventions following separation of mothers and newborns; closing the gap would prevent over 37,000 infant deaths each year. Chapter 2 exploits variation over time in local public ambulance prevalence as an instrument for public-facility birth in a fixed-effects design, and estimates a local average treatment effect consistent with the estimates from Chapter 1. Together, the chapters imply that the private sector mis-provides natal care relative to the public sector in this market. Chapter 3, with Sangita Vyas, asks how genuine behavior change can be distinguished from reporting bias in evaluations relying on self-reported outcomes, using the Swachh Bharat Mission as the case. The association between child height and reported open defecation flattens after the program, more so where the program was implemented more intensely, and not in urban areas where the program did less. Under weak conditions these patterns imply post-program under-reporting; under stronger conditions, half or more of rural Indian households still defecate in the open, compared with 26 percent who self-report doing so.

10.26153/tsw/64369.abstractZh: 本论文包含三个章节，分别探讨印度北部农村地区的健康与测量问题，重点关注选择、报告与因果推断方面。第1章和第2章分别研究了公共与私人医疗机构在新生儿死亡率方面的影响，研究对象为印度北部两个大型州。公共医疗机构的收费较低，服务对象多为贫困患者，但公共医疗机构的新生儿存活率明显更高。第1章采用两种互补的方法来分析选择问题：一是分析村庄层面新生儿死亡率与公共与私人医疗机构比例之间的关系，在纯选择假设下，这一比例应为零；二是分析地区边界处死亡率的空间差异，这种差异会促使公共医疗机构为类似情况下的新生儿提供医疗服务。研究发现，公共医疗机构使新生儿死亡率降低了25‰以上，这一差异与私人医疗机构的付费服务激励措施有关，后者通过奖励母亲与新生儿分离后的干预措施来降低死亡率。缩小这一差距每年可避免超过37,000名婴儿死亡。第2章利用当地公共救护车普及率随时间变化的数据，作为公共医疗机构服务的工具，并估计了与第1章一致的局部平均处理效应。这些研究共同表明，在这一市场中，私营部门在提供新生儿护理方面相对不足。第3章由Sangita Vyas撰写，探讨了在依赖自我报告结果的评估中，如何区分真实的行为改变与报告偏差，以印度清洁使命为例进行了研究。在项目实施后，儿童身高与公开排便行为之间的关联有所减弱，尤其是在实施力度较大的地区更为明显。而在实施力度较小的城市地区，这一关联则没有明显减弱。在条件较差的情况下，这些现象表明项目实施后存在报告数据不足的情况；而在条件较好的情况下，仍有半数或更多的印度农村家庭在户外排便，而自我报告有此行为的比例仅为26%。

abstract.text: We study an intervention that reduced cesarean deliveries among low-risk first-time mothers, using California birth records linked to earnings data. Exposed mothers were 8% less likely to have a c-section, with no adverse health effects. We find suggestive evidence that they were more likely to return to their pre-birth employer and had higher within-firm earnings rankings in the quarter postbirth. These labor market gains fade over time. However, mothers who had a second child were less likely to have a c-section or preterm delivery, suggesting our estimated effects from avoiding a first c-section may be lower bounds on total gains.

10.3368/jhr.1025-14609r2.abstractZh: 我们研究了一项减少低风险首次分娩母亲进行剖宫产率的干预措施，该研究使用了与收入数据相关的加州出生记录。接受干预的母亲进行剖宫产的概率降低了8%，且未出现不良健康影响。我们发现，这些母亲更有可能回到分娩前的雇主处工作，并且在分娩后的一个季度内，她们在公司的收入排名有所提升。然而，这些劳动力市场上的收益会随着时间而消失。不过，有第二个孩子的母亲进行剖宫产或早产的概率更低，这表明我们估计的避免因首次剖宫产而带来的总收益可能只是下限。

abstract.text: How climate change affects human welfare depends not only on what food systems produce but on what individuals eat once food is on the table. Using three-day dietary recalls from the China Health and Nutrition Survey matched to county weather in the same three-day window, we show that short-run departures from comfort temperature raise the fat share of energy intake and the probability of a diet whose fat share exceeds the WHO threshold. Heat and cold raise the fat share through opposite margins, though the cold response is smaller and less precisely estimated. Under heat, total energy, carbohydrate, and protein intake fall, while absolute fat intake does not change detectably, so the fat share rises as a composition effect, even as total calories decline. Under cold, absolute fat intake appears to rise more than other macronutrients, an intake effect. A macronutrient decomposition is therefore essential: identical movements in total calories mask very different movements in diet quality, a distinction that calorie- or index-based measures cannot deliver. The responses align with physiological appetite regulation, though our design cannot separate physiology from other demand-side channels. Effects are larger for rural and lower-income households but smaller for those that own cooling and heating appliances. We read individual diet as a behavioral input to health capital through which temperature, and adaptive capacity, shape nutritional inequality.

10.3386/w34609.abstractZh: 气候变化对人类福利的影响不仅取决于食物系统的生产情况，还取决于人们在食物上桌后所摄入的食物种类。我们通过将中国健康和营养调查中的三天饮食记录与同一时间段内的县级天气数据进行匹配，发现短期内偏离舒适温度会导致能量摄入中脂肪的比例上升，以及导致脂肪比例超过世界卫生组织阈值的饮食概率增加。高温和低温通过相反的方式影响脂肪比例，不过低温下的反应较小且估计不够准确。在高温环境下，总能量、碳水化合物和蛋白质的摄入量都会下降，而绝对脂肪摄入量没有明显变化，因此脂肪比例作为成分效应上升，即使总热量下降。在低温环境下，绝对脂肪摄入量似乎比其他宏量营养素增加得更多，这是一种摄入量效应。因此，对宏量营养素进行分解是必要的：总热量的相同变化掩盖了饮食质量上的巨大差异，而基于热量或指数的衡量方法无法揭示这种差异。这些反应与生理食欲调节相一致，尽管我们的设计无法将生理因素与其他需求侧渠道区分开来。对于农村和低收入家庭来说，这种影响更为显著，而对于拥有制冷和供暖设备的人来说，这种影响则较小。我们将个人饮食视为对健康资本的行为性输入，通过这种输入，温度以及适应能力可以影响营养不平等。

abstract.text: Broadband internet has become a critical component of U.S. infrastructure, but policymakers are increasingly concerned that the widespread adoption of this technology has adversely affected adolescent mental health. To test this hypothesis, we use 2009–2019 National and State Youth Risk Behavior Survey data and leverage the nationwide rollout of broadband internet. First, we show that adolescents in states with greater broadband internet access reported spending more time online. Next, we find that a one-standard-deviation increase in broadband internet access was associated with a 9.3–16.5-percent increase in adolescent suicide ideation. While we document increases in suicide ideation for both girls and boys, the results are most pronounced for adolescent girls. Exploring potential mechanisms, we show that greater broadband internet access was associated with increases in cyberbullying and body dissatisfaction among adolescent girls and a reduction in the likelihood that adolescent boys reported getting an adequate amount of sleep.

10.3386/w34614.abstractZh: 宽带互联网已成为美国基础设施的重要组成部分，但政策制定者越来越担心这种技术的广泛采用对青少年心理健康产生了负面影响。为了验证这一假设，我们使用了2009年至2019年的全国性和州级青少年风险行为调查数据，并利用了宽带互联网的全国推广效应。首先，我们发现宽带互联网接入程度较高的州的青少年在线时间更长。其次，我们发现宽带互联网接入程度增加一个标准差，青少年自杀念头的发生率增加了9.3%至16.5%。虽然我们发现女孩和男孩的自杀念头都有所增加，但这一效应在少女中更为明显。通过探讨潜在机制，我们发现宽带互联网接入程度的增加与少女网络欺凌和身体不满感的增加有关，而男孩则减少了获得充足睡眠的可能性。

abstract.text: We use population-wide administrative data from Denmark and an event-study design spanning nearly two decades to examine the impact of having a parent with dementia on adult children’s labor market, physical health, and mental health outcomes. We find no meaningful effects on labor supply, earnings, or physical health care use. In contrast, mental health care use increases substantially, driven by daughters, beginning five years before a parent’s dementia-related death, peaking around the time of death, and converging to the counterfactual trend over seven years. Results suggest that robust long-term care policy can largely insulate adult children economically from parental dementia, but mental health spillovers persist, spurring nearly a decade of elevated use.

10.3386/w34635.abstractZh: 我们利用了丹麦的全国人口数据以及一项持续近二十年的事件研究设计，来探讨父母患有痴呆症对成年子女劳动力市场、身体健康和心理健康状况的影响。研究发现，父母患有痴呆症并未对子女的劳动力供给、收入或身体健康护理使用产生显著影响。相反，由于女儿的影响，心理健康护理的使用显著增加，这一趋势在父母因痴呆症去世前五年就开始出现，在去世时达到高峰，并在七年后趋于恢复到无痴呆症时的水平。研究结果表明，强有力的长期护理政策可以在经济上有效隔离成年子女与父母患痴呆症之间的影响，但心理健康方面的溢出效应仍然存在，导致子女在长达近十年的时间内持续增加心理健康护理的使用。

abstract.text: Substance use is a well-established driver of intimate partner violence (IPV), with drug-related incidents posing persistent challenges for both public health and criminal justice systems. We examine how expanding access to substance use treatment (SUT) services affects IPV in the United States by leveraging variation in the opening and closing of treatment facilities at the county level. Using administrative data on IPV incidents from the National Incident-Based Reporting System at the agency level from 1998 to 2019 combined with county-level records on treatment facility information, we implement a continuous difference-in-differences research design. Our results show that adding three SUT facilities—the average annual increase per county over the sample period—reduces drug-involved IPV by about 1.5–1.7 percent. Staggered event-study analyses confirm parallel outcome trends, across treated and non-treated counties, prior to net facility openings and lend support to a causal interpretation of the estimates. Related evidence from SUT admissions drawn from the Treatment Episode Data Set (TEDS) shows that new centers significantly raise treatment entry, particularly among men, consistent with reduced perpetration driving the observed decline in IPV exposure. Our findings highlight the role of health services infrastructure in shaping violence-related outcomes and underscore the broader public safety benefits of investment in treatment access.

10.3386/w34642.abstractZh: 物质使用是亲密伴侣暴力的重要诱因，与毒品相关的事件对公共卫生和刑事司法系统都构成了持续挑战。本研究通过利用县级治疗设施的开业和关闭时间差异，探讨扩大物质使用治疗服务对美国亲密伴侣暴力的影响。我们结合1998至2019年间基于机构的国家事件报告系统中的亲密伴侣暴力事件行政数据，以及县级治疗设施信息记录，采用连续差异-差异研究设计。研究结果显示，在样本期间，每个县平均每年增加三个物质使用治疗设施，可使涉及毒品的亲密伴侣暴力事件减少约1.5%至1.7%。分阶段事件分析证实，在设施开放之前，接受治疗的县和非治疗县的暴力事件趋势一致，这支持了估计结果的因果解释。来自治疗事件数据集的相关证据表明，新的治疗中心显著增加了治疗机会，尤其是在男性中，这与减少暴力行为的观点一致，从而解释了观察到的亲密伴侣暴力事件减少现象。我们的研究结果强调了卫生服务基础设施在塑造暴力相关结果中的作用，并凸显了在治疗服务方面进行投资对公共安全带来的更广泛益处。

abstract.text: Direct-to-consumer advertising is pervasive in US healthcare markets, but little evidence exists on the effects of advertising by hospitals, second only to drug manufacturers in medical marketing. Advertising may help facilities increase market share by stealing existing patients, expand the market for hospital care, or do both. Regardless, it has important public finance implications due to the large sums of taxpayer funds spent by federal and state governments to subsidize hospital operations and finance care through public insurance programs.
