This paper provides the first causal evidence, to our knowledge, on the market expansion effects of hospital advertising. To obtain causal estimates, we leverage the fact that spikes in political advertising significantly crowd out hospital advertising in the same market, motivating an instrumental variables design. Using claims data on the universe of Traditional Medicare beneficiaries, we find that advertising expands aggregate patient volume and spending on inpatient care – though to a modest degree (implied elasticities of 0.06 and 0.05, respectively). Although the overall effect of advertising on hospital outpatient care is muted, for-profit hospitals obtain higher outpatient Medicare volume and revenue with greater advertising. Across both care settings, therefore, Medicare spending increases with hospital advertising.

10.3386/w34657.abstractZh: 直接面向消费者的广告在美国医疗保健市场中非常普遍，但关于医院广告效果的研究却很少，其影响力仅次于药品制造商在医疗营销领域的表现。广告可能有助于医疗机构通过吸引现有患者来增加市场份额，或者同时实现这两点。不过，由于联邦和州政府花费大量资金来补贴医院运营并通过公共保险计划为医疗提供资金，因此这一行为对公共财政有着重要的影响。本文首次提供了关于医院广告对市场扩展效果的因果证据。为了获得这些因果估计，我们利用了政治广告的激增会显著挤占同一市场中的医院广告这一事实，从而设计了工具变量模型。通过对传统医疗保险受益人相关的数据进行分析，我们发现广告确实增加了患者数量和住院治疗的支出——尽管增幅较为温和（相应的弹性系数分别为0.06和0.05）。虽然广告对医院门诊服务的整体影响较小，但营利性医院通过更多的广告能够获得更多的医疗保险门诊业务量和收入。因此，在两种医疗环境中，医疗保险支出都随着医院广告的增加而上升。

abstract.text: Existing evidence suggests that wealth may decline before dementia onset, but the mechanisms underlying these reductions are poorly understood. Using longitudinal data from the Health and Retirement Study, we compare household finance trajectories for individuals who later develop dementia and those who do not. We find that wealth divergence between the two groups is not explained by reduced earnings, higher healthcare spending, intentional “spend-down” to qualify for Medicaid coverage, state-dependent utility, or reverse causation by which wealth declines cause dementia. Instead, our results point to impaired financial decision-making beginning about six years prior to clinically recognizable dementia.

10.3386/w34659.abstractZh: 现有证据表明，在痴呆症发病之前，财富可能会减少，但这些减少背后的机制尚不清楚。我们利用“健康与退休研究”的纵向数据，比较了后来患上痴呆症的个体与未患痴呆症的个体的家庭财务轨迹。我们发现，两组之间的财富差异并非由收入减少、医疗支出增加、为获得医疗补助而故意减少开支、州际效用差异，或是财富减少导致痴呆症等反向因果关系所解释。相反，我们的研究结果指出，在临床上可识别的痴呆症出现前约六年，人们的财务决策能力就已经开始受损。

abstract.text: We deployed large language model (LLM) decision support for health workers at two outpatient clinics in Nigeria. For each patient, health workers drafted care plans that were optionally revised after LLM feedback. We compared unassisted and assisted plans using blinded randomized assessments by on-site physicians who evaluated and treated the same patients, as well as results from laboratory tests for common conditions. Academic physicians performed blinded retrospective reviews of a subset of notes. In response to LLM feedback, health workers changed their prescribing for more than half of the patients and reported high satisfaction with the recommendations, and retrospective academic reviewers rated LLM-assisted plans more favorably. However, on-site physicians observed little to no improvement in diagnostic alignment or treatment decisions. Laboratory testing showed mixed effects of LLM-assistance, which removed negative tests for malaria but added them for urinary tract infection and anemia, with no significant increase in the detection rates for the tested conditions.

10.3386/w34660.abstractZh: 我们在尼日利亚的两家门诊诊所为医护人员部署了大型语言模型（LLM）决策支持系统。对于每位患者，医护人员会起草护理计划，并在获得LLM反馈后选择性地进行修改。我们通过现场医生进行的盲法随机评估，比较了无辅助和有辅助的护理计划。这些医生负责评估和治疗相同的患者，并分析了常见疾病的实验室检测结果。学术医生对部分记录进行了盲法回顾性审查。根据LLM的反馈，医护人员对超过一半患者的用药方案进行了调整，并且对建议表示高度满意。回顾性学术评审者认为，LLM辅助的护理计划更为有效。然而，现场医生观察到在诊断准确性或治疗决策方面几乎没有改善。实验室检测结果显示，LLM辅助对检测结果产生了混合影响：虽然消除了疟疾的阴性结果，但增加了尿路感染和贫血的阳性结果，且这些疾病的检测率并未显著增加。

abstract.text: The arrival of GLP-1 medications has been described as one of the most important health care innovations in recent years. We provide large-scale quasi-experimental evidence on their real-world impacts by exploiting variation in the eventual prescribing propensities of patients’ pre-existing primary care providers. Using a panel intent-to-treat design, we compare outcomes for 1.4 million diabetic or obese veterans based on their 2018 provider’s eventual propensity to adopt GLP-1s, leveraging comprehensive electronic health records and biomarker data from the Veterans Health Administration, a setting with minimal insurance attrition and low-cost access to these drugs. Patients whose providers become higher propensity adopters experience substantial improvements in glycemic control and clinically meaningful weight loss; our treatment-on-the-treated estimates closely match estimates from clinical trials. Despite these metabolic benefits, we find no statistically significant average effects on emergency department utilization, mental health and substance use outcomes, or non–GLP-1 medical spending through 2024. However, quantile regression results show heterogeneous effects, with spending declining at lower quantiles and rising at higher quantiles for patients of higher-propensity adopters.

10.3386/w34667.abstractZh: GLP-1药物的问世被视作近年来最重要的医疗保健创新之一。我们通过利用患者现有初级保健提供者的最终处方倾向差异，提供了关于其实际影响的大规模准实验证据。采用面板意向治疗设计，我们对比了140万糖尿病或肥胖退伍军人的结果，这些患者根据2018年其提供者的最终采用GLP-1的倾向进行了分析，数据来源于退伍军人健康管理局的综合性电子健康记录和生物标志物数据。这些数据的收集环境具有较低的保险流失率和低成本获取药物的优势。那些提供者成为更高倾向采用GLP-1患者的患者在血糖控制方面取得了显著改善，并且体重减轻具有临床意义；我们的治疗对治疗的效果估计与临床试验的结果非常接近。尽管这些代谢方面的益处存在，但我们发现，在2024年之前，这些药物对急诊部门使用率、心理健康和物质使用状况，以及非GLP-1类药物的支出并没有统计学上的显著影响。然而，分位数回归结果显示出不同的效果，对于倾向较高的患者，较低的分位数对应的支出下降，而较高分位数对应的支出上升。

abstract.text: Cannabis is the most used illicit drug in the United States. Though cannabis possession and consumption are prohibited federally, states are increasingly implementing laws that legalize this substance, initially for medical and, more recently, for recreational use. We study the impact of recreational cannabis laws on child maltreatment reports. To do so, we employ difference-in-differences and event-study methods to analyze administrative data on child maltreatment reports as well as child injury-related deaths 2010-2022. We find that recent efforts to legalize cannabis for recreational consumption have not led to an increase in child maltreatment reports and may reduce particularly severe maltreatment.

10.3386/w34673.abstractZh: 大麻是美国使用最广泛的非法药物。尽管联邦层面禁止持有和吸食大麻，但各州越来越多地实施将大麻合法化的法律，最初是为了医疗目的，最近则是为了娱乐用途。我们研究了娱乐性大麻法律对儿童虐待报告的影响。为此，我们采用了差异-差异分析和事件研究方法，分析了2010年至2022年间有关儿童虐待报告以及儿童伤害相关死亡数据的行政数据。研究发现，最近将大麻合法化为娱乐用途的努力并未导致儿童虐待报告的增加，反而可能减少特别严重的虐待行为。

abstract.text: We find that public preschools are a gateway to health care services. Low-income children born before their state’s public preschool entry cutoff date—who can start preschool younger than those born after—are more likely to receive speech-language pathology, occupational or physical therapy, mental health, hearing or vision, and dental services, both inside and outside of school. The increased preventive dental care at age three is followed by a reduced likelihood of restorative dental care at older ages, suggesting the increase in services is welfare-improving.

10.3386/w34677.abstractZh: 我们发现，公立幼儿园是获得医疗保健服务的途径。在州内公立幼儿园入学截止日期之前出生的低收入儿童，比之后出生的儿童更早开始接受学前教育，他们更有可能获得言语语言病理学、职业或物理治疗、心理健康、听力或视力以及牙科服务，这些服务既包括校内服务，也包括校外服务。在三岁时进行更多的预防性牙科护理之后，较大年龄时进行修复性牙科护理的可能性会降低，这表明这些服务的增加有助于改善福利。

abstract.text: GLP-1 receptor agonists improve treatment for diabetes, obesity, and cardiovascular disease, but their high prices create fiscal pressure for insurers. GLP-1 spending may overstate net costs because health improvements reduce downstream health spending. We use insurance claims to estimate GLP-1 cost offsets using a staggered adoption design. Over a five-year follow-up, GLP-1 drugs do not reduce downstream medical spending and actually lead to a small increase, largely via increased outpatient care. Offsets are similar across baseline health sub-populations. However, cost increases for semaglutide—a later-generation GLP-1 that is more effective—are smaller and statistically indistinguishable from zero.

10.3386/w34678.abstractZh: GLP-1受体激动剂能够改善糖尿病、肥胖症和心血管疾病的治疗，但其高昂的价格给保险公司带来了财政压力。由于健康改善会降低后续的健康支出，GLP-1相关支出的净成本可能被高估。我们通过保险理赔数据，采用分阶段采用的设计来估算GLP-1的成本抵消效果。在五年的随访中，GLP-1药物并未减少后续医疗支出，反而导致医疗支出略有增加，这主要得益于门诊护理的增加。不同健康亚群体的成本抵消效果相似。然而，对于第二代GLP-1激动剂——Semaglutide来说，其成本增加幅度较小，且在统计上与零无显著差异。

abstract.text: A large literature has documented widespread variation in health care spending per capita across areas of the United States without correspondingly better health outcomes. Recent work has used mover designs to estimate the causal impact of place on both health care spending and mortality. In this paper, we investigate whether places that increase health care spending also tend to be places that increase health. We find that they do not and discuss the implications.

10.3386/w34682.abstractZh: 大量文献记录了美国不同地区人均医疗保健支出的广泛差异，但这些地区并没有相应的更好的健康结果。最近的研究使用移动设计方法来估计地点对医疗保健支出和死亡率的因果影响。在本文中，我们探讨了那些增加医疗保健支出的地区是否也倾向于改善健康状况。我们发现并非如此，并讨论了这一发现的意义。

abstract.text: Efforts to move care out of hospitals and into the community face a hard constraint: while most medications can be delivered anywhere, diagnosis is still mostly trapped inside the formal health system—clinics, hospitals, and the people and machines inside them. This is especially binding in low- and middle-income countries due to distance, cost, and limited health system capacity. Low-cost data collection devices (e.g., handheld electrocardiograms (ECGs), retinal cameras) are promising, but do not solve the bottleneck: their outputs still require expert interpretation. Artificial intelligence (AI) could turn these raw signals into actionable outputs at scale, but most medical AI is trained in high-income settings and deteriorates in different populations and settings. We assemble a new dataset in rural Tamil Nadu, India that links low-cost device signals to hospital-grade reference testing. We use it to build a proof-of-concept screening tool: an algorithm that predicts the result of a hospital-based reference-standard test (regional wall motion abnormality on echocardiography), using only data from a handheld ECG device (cost: $60). This would allow targeting of secondary prevention medications—high-dose statins, antiplatelet agents, and beta blockers—proven to be cost-effective in both high- and low-resource settings. We evaluate predictive performance and cost-effectiveness of such screening, benchmarking against common clinical risk scores (including the American Heart Association 10-year risk score). In a held-out test set, our model identifies subgroups with rates high enough to make screening very cost-effective: the top 2.5% have a 9.3% rate of evidence consistent with prior heart attack—about six times the base rate—delivering benefits at US$1,999 per life-year saved. The model also flags high-yield patients who would be missed by standard clinical scores, underscoring the limits of transporting Western-derived risk tools to low- and middle-income settings. To enable extensions to other conditions in the dataset, we make all data freely available for research.

10.3386/w34690.abstractZh: 将护理从医院转移到社区的努力面临一个严峻的制约：虽然大多数药物可以在任何地方提供，但诊断仍然主要局限于正式的医疗系统——诊所、医院以及其中的人员和设备。在低收入和中等收入国家，由于距离、成本以及医疗系统的局限性，这一限制尤为明显。低成本的数据收集设备（例如手持心电图仪、视网膜摄像头）具有潜力，但并不能解决瓶颈问题：这些设备的输出仍然需要专家进行解读。人工智能可以将这些原始信号转化为可操作的输出，但大多数医疗人工智能都是在高收入环境中训练的，在不同人群和环境中表现会下降。我们在印度泰米尔纳德邦的农村地区收集了一个新的数据集，将低成本设备的信号与医院级别的参考测试联系起来。我们利用这个数据集构建了一个概念验证筛查工具：一种算法，仅使用手持心电图仪的数据（成本：60美元）来预测基于医院的参考标准测试的结果（例如超声心动图中的区域壁运动异常）。这将使得针对二级预防药物——高剂量他汀类药物、抗血小板药物和β阻滞剂——进行筛查成为可能，这些药物在资源匮乏和富裕的环境中都被证明具有成本效益。我们评估了这种筛查的预测性能和成本效益，并与常见的临床风险评分（包括美国心脏协会的10年风险评分）进行了对比。在保留的测试集中，我们的模型识别出具有足够高比例的子群体，使得筛查具有非常高的成本效益：前2.5%的群体中有9.3%的病例符合既往心脏病发作的证据，这一比例约为基准率的六倍，每节省一个生命年所带来的收益为1,999美元。该模型还能够识别出那些被标准临床评分遗漏的高收益患者，这凸显了将西方衍生风险评估工具应用于低收入和中等收入国家的局限性。为了便于对数据集中的其他病症进行扩展研究，我们免费提供了所有数据。

abstract.text: Patient cost-sharing is used as a tool to limit over-utilization of insured healthcare services in almost all high-income countries. We study its distributional consequences in the context of a publicly-funded universal health insurance system, where consumers (as tax-payers) are residual claimants on insurer spending. We highlight the distinction between consumers' elasticity of demand for healthcare services—which moderates how cost-sharing rules affect healthcare utilization—and their baseline level of demand—which moderates how cost-sharing rules affect out-of-pocket costs. Using detailed administrative data on the Norwegian national health insurance scheme, we study a 2010 policy change that raised the age threshold for cost-sharing exemption, thereby increasing patient cost-sharing substantially for adolescents. We find that females and native-born Norwegians have higher average utilization and thus have more at stake financially from cost-sharing, but are relatively less responsive to cost-sharing. In contrast, lower-income individuals as well as individuals with a chronic health condition have both higher average healthcare utilization as well as higher responsiveness. Cost-sharing therefore places a larger burden on these groups both in terms of the financial cost of out-of-pocket spending and in terms of reduced quantities of healthcare used.

10.3386/w34700.abstractZh: 在几乎所有高收入国家，患者费用分担被用作限制保险医疗服务过度使用的工具。我们研究了在公共资助的全民健康保险体系下，这一政策的分配后果。在这种体系中，消费者（作为纳税人）是保险公司支出的剩余索赔人。我们强调了消费者对医疗服务的需求弹性与他们的基本需求水平之间的区别——前者调节了费用分担规则对医疗使用的影响，而后者则调节了费用分担规则对自付费用的影响。利用挪威国家健康保险计划的详细行政数据，我们研究了2010年的一项政策变化，该变化提高了费用分担豁免的年龄门槛，从而大幅增加了青少年的患者费用分担。我们发现，女性以及土生土长的挪威人平均医疗使用率更高，因此在财务上面临更大的负担，但对费用分担的响应相对较弱。相比之下，低收入人群以及患有慢性健康状况的人群，其平均医疗使用率更高，对费用分担的响应也更强。因此，费用分担对这些群体的影响更大，不仅体现在自付费用的财务成本上，还体现在医疗使用的减少上。

abstract.text: Nearly eight million Americans use Medicaid home and community-based services (HCBS) to support long-term services and supports for people with disabilities. Recent legislative changes to Medicaid will require states to make difficult choices about how best to meet these long-term services and supports needs. This paper first characterizes the unique goals of HCBS, which differ from those of traditional medical care services, and the state-federal financing and administrative structure of HCBS. Next, based on a review of the literature and input from a panel of experts in HCBS policy and research, we summarize existing evidence and knowledge gaps regarding the quality and cost implications of HCBS at the federal, state, and direct service provision levels. Based on gaps in the evidence, we propose a research agenda related to state-federal incentives, state program choices regarding HCBS financing and delivery models, and the settings and supports for direct service provision. Finally, we describe existing and novel data sources and other opportunities that could accelerate research to fill these evidence gaps and support states and others in designing, implementing, and delivering sustainable, high-quality HCBS.

10.3386/w34701.abstractZh: 近八百万美国公民使用医疗补助计划中的家庭与社区基础服务，以支持残疾人士的长期服务与支持。最近对医疗补助计划的立法变更要求各州在如何最好地满足这些长期服务与支持需求方面做出艰难抉择。本文首先阐述了家庭与社区基础服务的独特目标，这些目标与传统医疗服务有所不同，同时介绍了该服务的州与联邦层面的资金筹措及行政架构。随后，通过文献综述以及来自家庭与社区基础服务政策与研究领域的专家意见，我们总结了关于该服务在联邦、州及直接服务提供层面上的质量与成本影响的现有证据及知识空白。基于这些证据空白，我们提出了一项研究议程，涉及州与联邦层面的激励措施、各州在资金筹措与服务提供模式上的选择，以及直接服务提供所需的支持环境。最后，我们描述了现有的及新的数据来源，以及能够加速研究以填补这些证据空白的机会，从而帮助各州及其他地区设计、实施并提供可持续、高质量的家庭与社区基础服务。

abstract.text: We outline a research agenda for behavioral development economics that seeks to understand the role of psychological channels in: (i) impeding individuals' ability to climb out of poverty, and (ii) shaping the organization of production, functioning of markets, and role of informal institutions in developing countries. We apply a missing markets lens to rationalize why tools, products and services that help individuals overcome their biases will be under-supplied by the market and why behavioral biases can have large impacts in steady state, even among highly experienced agents. We argue that these biases are especially likely to matter for the field of development because core features of poverty---proximity to subsistence, high volatility, market failures, weak formal institutions, and reliance on social ties---amplify the impact of psychological constraints. We organize our review around a core set of psychological constructs: self-control, cognitive constraints, self-beliefs, mental health, and social norms. For each construct, we highlight places where there is only a proof of concept versus evidence of meaningful impacts, and the resultant implications for future research. We also highlight where social capital can be deployed to mitigate the impacts of missing markets. The field research to date has only begun to scratch the surface in document how psychological mechanisms affect behavior and decision-making, and substantial scope remains for future work to determine whether these constraints play a first-order role in shaping poverty.

10.3386/w34753.abstractZh: 我们为行为发展经济学的研究议程提出了一些建议，旨在理解以下方面中心理渠道的作用：(i) 阻碍个人摆脱贫困的能力；(ii) 影响生产组织、市场运作以及非正式机构在发展中国家的作用。我们运用“市场缺失”的视角来解释为什么能够帮助个人克服偏见的工具、产品和服务会被市场供应不足，以及为什么即使在经验丰富的人群中，行为偏见也会在稳态下产生重大影响。我们认为，这些偏见在发展领域尤其重要，因为贫困的核心特征——接近生存线、高波动性、市场失灵、薄弱的正式制度以及依赖社会纽带——会加剧心理约束的影响。我们围绕一系列核心心理概念进行了综述：自我控制、认知约束、自我信念、心理健康和社会规范。对于每个概念，我们指出了概念验证与实质性影响的证据之间的差距，以及这对未来研究的意义。我们还探讨了如何利用社会资本来减轻市场缺失带来的影响。迄今为止，实地研究仅初步揭示了心理机制如何影响行为和决策，未来仍有大量工作需要确定这些约束是否在塑造贫困中起着首要作用。

abstract.text: We examine how Medicaid expansion under the Affordable Care Act reshaped federal transfer inflows to counties using state Medicaid expansions between 2014 and 2017. We show that the ACA expansion increased federal Medicaid transfers by $361 per capita in expansion counties. Using our estimates, we forecast that non-expansion counties would gain $554 per capita if they expanded Medicaid. These transfers flow to counties with lower tax capacity and lower gross income. Our findings suggest that Medicaid expansion was a health policy intervention that also functioned as a budgetary mechanism reshaping federal to local transfers and fiscal smoothing across U.S. counties.

10.3386/w34758.abstractZh: 我们研究了《平价医疗法案》下的医疗补助扩展如何改变了联邦资金向各县的转移情况，通过对比2014年至2017年间各州的医疗补助扩展政策进行了分析。研究表明，《平价医疗法案》的扩展使扩展县的联邦医疗补助资金人均增加了361美元。根据我们的估算，如果非扩展县也实施医疗补助扩展，它们将人均获得554美元的额外资金。这些资金主要流向了税收能力较低、总收入较少的县。我们的研究结果表明，医疗补助扩展不仅是一种卫生政策干预措施，同时也是一种预算机制，能够调整联邦资金向地方政府的转移，并有助于美国各县的财政平衡。

abstract.text: Health care costs in the U.S. have grown dramatically over the past several decades, with one possible cause being physicians providing unnecessary services out of fear of being sued for malpractice – a phenomenon known as “defensive medicine”. States responded by enacting different types of tort reforms. This paper reviews the literature on the effects of these tort reforms on outcomes related to malpractice risk, quantity and quality of health care services, overall utilization and expenditures, physician supply, and patient affordability. We use Google Scholar to identify papers that fall into this scope and use either associational or quasi-experimental quantitative methods. The preponderance of evidence points towards non-economic damage caps reducing malpractice risk, quantity of services (aside from diagnostics and obstetrics), and overall health care utilization and expenditures while increasing physician supply and not having detrimental effects on patient outcomes. In general, the effects of other types of tort reforms are less clear. The literature would benefit from further research utilizing recent methodological advances related to combining machine learning with causal inference and eliminating bias from heterogeneous treatment effects in staggered-treatment-time models.

10.3386/w34764.abstractZh: 过去几十年间，美国的医疗保健成本急剧上升，其中一个可能的原因是医生出于对医疗事故诉讼的恐惧而提供不必要的服务，这种现象被称为“防御性医疗”。各州对此作出反应，实施了不同类型的侵权法改革。本文回顾了这些侵权法改革对医疗事故风险、医疗服务的数量和质量、整体利用和支出、医生供应以及患者负担等方面的影响。我们通过Google Scholar筛选出符合研究范围的论文，并采用关联性或准实验性定量研究方法。大量证据表明，非经济损害上限可以降低医疗事故风险、减少服务数量（除诊断学和产科外），并增加整体医疗保健利用和支出，同时增加医生供应，且不会对患者结果产生负面影响。总体而言，其他类型的侵权法改革效果尚不明确。相关文献需要进一步研究，利用最近的方法论进展，如将机器学习与因果推断相结合，并消除分阶段处理模型中异质处理效应的偏差。

abstract.text: We study the causal effect of women's education on their wages, non-wage job amenities, and spillovers to children. Using a regression discontinuity at the school entry birthdate cutoff, we find that women born just before the cutoff are more likely to complete some college, and experience multi-dimensional career gains that grow over the life cycle: greater employment and earnings, as well as more professional and higher-status jobs, more socially meaningful work, and better working conditions. Children’s early-life health and prenatal inputs improve in tandem with career improvements, consistent with professional advances spurring—not hindering—infant investments. Career gains are concentrated in jobs that require exactly some college, the same schooling margin shifted by the cutoff, which indicates that increased post-secondary education is the primary channel for these effects. Together, the results show that women's college attendance generates large career returns—from both wages and amenities—that strengthen over time and produce meaningful benefits for children.

10.3386/w34767.abstractZh: 我们研究了女性教育对其工资、非工资工作便利性及对子女影响的因果效应。通过在学校入学出生日期这一关键时间点进行回归 discontinuity分析，我们发现，在出生日期临界点之前出生的女性更有可能完成某些大学教育，并且会经历贯穿整个生命周期的多维度职业提升：更高的就业率和收入，以及更专业、更高地位的工作岗位，更有社会意义的工作，以及更好的工作条件。随着职业发展的提升，儿童早期的健康状况及产前投入也会同步改善，这与职业进步促进而非阻碍婴儿发展的观点一致。职业提升主要集中在那些需要一定大学学历的工作上，同样的受教育程度差异在出生日期临界点之后有所变化，这表明增加高等教育是这些效应的主要途径。综合来看，女性接受大学教育能够带来长期的职业回报——包括工资和便利性的提升——这些回报随着时间的推移而增强，并为子女带来实质性的益处。

abstract.text: We study how teacher "value added" should inform optimal teacher-assignment policy.Our welfare-theoretic framework illustrates (1) how theoretically optimal assignments leverage variation in teachers' impacts both across student types and across different outcomes, and (2) how empirically optimal assignments trade off improved targeting from estimating richer student heterogeneity against a growing winner's curse.In practice, optimal assignments use limited student types (only lagged achievement) and multiple outcomes (not just math).Even after correcting for policy overfitting, assignments raise average present-value earnings by $3,000 and increase lower-achieving students' earnings by 66-142% more than benchmark policies using homogeneous effects, single-subject heterogeneity, or teacher deselection.

10.3386/w34768.abstractZh: 我们研究教师的“附加值”应如何指导最优的教师分配政策。我们的福利理论框架说明了：(1)理论上最优的分配方案如何利用教师对学生类型及不同结果的影响差异；(2)实证上最优的分配方案如何在提高对学生异质性的估计精度与“赢者诅咒”之间做出权衡。在实践中，最优的分配方案仅使用有限的学生类型（仅基于滞后成绩）和多个结果（不仅仅是数学成绩）。即使经过政策过度拟合的校正，这些分配方案平均使当前价值收益增加3000美元，并使成绩较低的学生收益比使用同质效应、单一主体异质性或教师选择退出政策的基准政策高出66-142%。

abstract.text: Taller people earn more, especially in low- and middle-income countries. We present among the first evidence of this phenomenon in Africa, using longitudinal microdata on a cohort of middle-aged Kenyan adults. We document a substantial height/earnings premium: controlling for gender, age, and other socio-demographics, monthly earnings increase by 1.07% per centimeter (or 2.72% per inch). Nearly half this effect can be explained by differences in cognition, measured from an unusually rich battery containing 27 modules. Additional shares of the premium can be attributed to measures of physical strength and non-cognitive ability. In contrast to prior work, we find little role for occupational sorting: conditional on cognitive and non-cognitive ability, taller people do not appear more likely to work in higher paid sectors. Leveraging repeated measures of height and an instrumental variables specification, we find suggestive evidence that measurement error may be attenuating the estimated relationship.

10.3386/w34769.abstractZh: 身材较高的人收入更高，尤其是在低收入和中等收入国家。我们首次在非洲提供了这一现象的证据，使用了关于肯尼亚中年成年人的纵向微观数据。我们发现身高与收入之间存在显著的正相关关系：在控制性别、年龄和其他社会人口学特征后，每月收入每增加1厘米（或每英寸2.72%）就会增加1.07%。这一效应中近一半可以归因于认知能力的差异，这些差异是通过包含27个模块的异常丰富的测量工具来衡量的。此外，部分效应还可以归因于体力和非认知能力。与以往的研究不同，我们发现职业选择对收入的影响很小：在考虑认知和非认知能力的情况下，身材较高的人并不更有可能从事高薪职业。通过重复测量身高和工具变量分析，我们发现测量误差可能会削弱这一关系。

abstract.text: Mental illness exacts a heavy toll on the US healthcare system and strains general hospitals and their emergency departments. We study how psychiatric inpatient facility entry impacts the local hospital industry. We find that referrals, including from the legal system, are redirected to the specialized facilities––leaving general hospitals with approximately 60% fewer psychiatric admissions. General hospitals also discharge 50% more patients to psychiatric facilities and substitute away from high-skill psychiatric labor––consistent with specialization and market segmentation. Emergency department volumes do not change but care does. However, community-based crime, overdose deaths, and suicides do not decline in the short-run.

10.3386/w34772.abstractZh: 精神疾病给美国的医疗系统带来了沉重的负担，也加剧了普通医院及其急诊部门的压力。我们研究了精神病患者进入住院设施的情况对当地医院行业的影响。研究发现，包括来自法律系统的转介在内，患者都被引导至专业设施——这使得普通医院的 psychiatric 入院人数减少了约60%。同时，普通医院向 psychiatric 设施出院的患者增加了50%，并且替代了高技能的精神病医生的工作——这与专业化和市场细分的趋势一致。急诊部门的就诊量没有变化，但所提供的医疗服务却发生了变化。然而，短期内，社区内的犯罪率、过量死亡和自杀率并没有下降。

abstract.text: Governments rely on private firms to provide public goods and services. Although competition among these firms reduces prices and the costs of procurement, it has an ambiguous effect on fraud: competition can both dissipate the rents that attracted fraudulent firms to the market while at the same time reducing margins to the point where legitimate firms no longer remain viable. We study this tradeoff in the government’s procurement of durable medical equipment. Following Medicare’s switch from regulated prices to competitive bidding, we find that fraudulent firms’ cost advantage allowed them to gain market share as legitimate firms exited the market.

10.3386/w34802.abstractZh: 政府依赖私人企业来提供公共产品和服务。虽然这些企业之间的竞争会降低价格和采购成本，但这一竞争对欺诈行为的影响却具有两面性：一方面，竞争可以消除吸引欺诈企业进入市场的租金；另一方面，竞争又会降低企业的利润率，以至于合法企业难以维持生存。我们研究了政府在采购耐用医疗设备时的这种权衡关系。根据医疗保险制度从管制价格转向竞争性招标的改革，我们发现欺诈企业凭借成本优势获得了市场份额，而合法企业则被迫退出市场。

abstract.text: With the goal of curbing electronic nicotine delivery systems (ENDS) use among youths, 40 states and the District of Columbia have adopted restrictions on nicotine vaping at elementary and secondary (K-12) schools. This study is the first to estimate the effect of K-12 school vaping restrictions (SVRs) on ENDS use among youth. Using data from several nationally representative data sources and a generalized difference-in-differences approach, we find little evidence that school indoor vaping restrictions reduce youth ENDS use. With 95% confidence, we can rule out SVR-induced youth vaping declines of more than 3.5%. Descriptive evidence suggests that students may respond to SVRs by substituting to smaller vaping devices and vaping in school locations that are less easily detectable by school employees (e.g., bathrooms and locker rooms). In contrast, we find that comprehensive vaping restrictions covering school campuses, workplaces, restaurants, and drinking establishments are associated with a 1.5-2.6 percentage-point reduction in teen nicotine vaping. This result is concentrated on the initiation margin of use and is consistent with the hypothesis that broader place-based restrictions increase the costs of youth ENDS use.

10.3386/w34805.abstractZh: 为了限制青少年使用电子尼古丁输送系统，40个州和哥伦比亚特区对小学和中学的尼古丁电子烟使用实施了限制。本研究首次评估了K-12学校电子烟限制对青少年使用电子尼古丁输送系统的影响。通过利用多个具有全国代表性的数据来源，并采用广义差异估计方法，我们发现学校室内电子烟限制对减少青少年使用电子尼古丁输送系统的效果甚微。我们有95%的置信度可以排除因学校限制而导致青少年电子烟使用减少超过3.5%的可能性。描述性证据表明，学生可能会通过改用较小的电子烟设备，以及在学校员工难以察觉的地点（如洗手间和更衣室）进行电子烟使用来应对这些限制。相比之下，我们发现涵盖学校校园、工作场所、餐馆和饮酒场所的全面电子烟限制与青少年尼古丁电子烟使用减少1.5-2.6个百分点有关。这一结果主要集中在使用的起始阶段，与更广泛的场所限制会增加青少年使用电子尼古丁输送系统的成本这一假设一致。

abstract.text: In an RCT with college students in Chennai (N=340), we test how modest financial incentives and personalized feedback affect the uptake and targeting (by symptom severity) of free therapy. Despite 56% of students screening positive for at least mild depression or anxiety, only 3% in the control group took up therapy. A small cash incentive increased appointments by 9 percentage points (p = 0.06) on average without substantially affecting targeting. Personalized feedback and recommendations based on a mental health screening tool significantly improved targeting while keeping overall take-up largely unchanged. Combining these two treatments achieved both higher take-up and improved targeting, by increasing appointments among symptomatic individuals by 21 pp (p < 0.01) without affecting uptake by asymptomatic individuals. These findings suggest that low-cost incentives coupled with screening information can effectively increase uptake while allocating limited mental health care resources to those with greater need.

10.3386/w34819.abstractZh: 在一项针对钦奈大学生的随机对照试验中（样本量340人），我们研究了适度的经济激励和个性化反馈如何影响免费疗法的接受率和针对症状严重程度的目标定位。尽管56%的学生至少被检测出有轻度抑郁或焦虑症状，但对照组中只有3%的人接受了治疗。小额现金激励使预约次数平均增加了9个百分点（p = 0.06），但并未显著影响目标定位。基于心理健康筛查工具的个性化反馈和建议显著提高了目标定位的准确性，同时整体接受率基本保持不变。结合这两种干预措施，不仅提高了接受率，还改善了目标定位，使有症状个体的预约次数增加了21个百分点（p < 0.01），而无症状个体的接受率并未受到影响。这些发现表明，低成本激励结合筛查信息可以有效提高接受率，同时将有限的心理健康资源分配给需求更大的人群。

abstract.text: We conducted a within-subject laboratory experiment in which participants decided whether to experience physical discomfort for charity, with or without additional personal compensation. Acceptance decreased with greater discomfort and increased with both larger charitable donations and personal payments. We show that private monetary incentives and prosocial benefits interact in a less-than-additive way: personal compensation raises participation but attenuates the marginal impact of charitable donations, making the combined impact of private and social rewards smaller than the sum of their separate effects. We also find suggestive evidence that the sequencing of compensated and uncompensated choices may change the responsiveness to charitable benefits. Overall, our results indicate that context, especially the presence (and timing) of private rewards, can affect the relationship between incentives and prosocial behavior.

10.3386/w34822.abstractZh: 我们进行了一项被试内实验室实验，参与者需要决定是否为了慈善事业而承受身体上的不适，同时可以选择是否获得额外的个人补偿。随着不适感的增加，参与者接受慈善活动的意愿下降；而随着慈善捐款金额的增加以及个人补偿的获得，参与者接受慈善活动的意愿则上升。我们发现，私人金钱激励与亲社会利益之间的相互作用并非呈相加关系：个人补偿虽然提高了参与意愿，但减弱了慈善捐款的边际影响，使得私人奖励与社会奖励的综合效应小于它们各自单独效应的总和。我们还发现了一些有启发性的证据，表明补偿性选择与非补偿性选择的顺序可能会改变人们对慈善福利的响应程度。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，情境因素，尤其是私人奖励的存在及其时机，能够影响激励因素与亲社会行为之间的关系。

abstract.text: This paper tests whether the arrival of mass media triggers a decline in fertility, a central prediction of modernization theory. Using a field experiment, we vary exposure to mass media and its content in a quarter of Burkina Faso. We provide radios to 1,600 women without previous access to mass media. Half live in status quo areas and half in areas where the local radio station was randomly selected to air a science-based family planning campaign. Contrary to modernization theory and previous literature, gaining access to status quo mass media decreases contraception use by 14 percent and reinforces traditional gender norms. In contrast, receiving a radio in campaign areas boosts contraception use by 16 percent. The campaign also led to a 9 percent reduction in births and a 0.3 standard deviation increase in reported welfare. Reduced belief in misinformation rather than shifts in attitudes and preferences drives the result.

10.3386/w34829.abstractZh: 本文旨在检验大众媒体的普及是否会导致生育率的下降，这是现代化理论的核心预测之一。通过实地实验，我们在布基纳法索的某四分之一地区改变了民众接触大众媒体的机会及其内容。我们为1,600名此前未接触过大众媒体的女性提供了收音机。其中一半人居住在现状地区，另一半人则居住在当地广播电台随机选取进行科学避孕宣传的地区。与现代化理论及以往的研究结果相反，在现状地区获得大众媒体传播的信息会使避孕使用率降低14%，并强化传统的性别规范。而在宣传地区，收音机的普及则使避孕使用率提高了16%。该宣传活动还导致出生率降低了9%，并提升了0.3个标准差的福利水平。结果表明，减少了对错误信息相信的程度，而非态度或偏好的改变，才是导致这一结果的关键因素。

abstract.text: The implementation of the North American Free Trade Agreement (NAFTA) in 1994 resulted in a great restructuring in industry composition in the US, with substantial heterogeneity across local areas. In this paper, we investigate the effects of NAFTA on the mortality rates of the working-age population. We implement event studies and difference-in-difference analyses to examine dynamic changes in mortality rates in different years relative to NAFTA and in areas with differential exposure to NAFTA. Comparing areas with high versus low trade exposure measures, we find a 2.1 percent rise in the mortality rate of those aged 25-55. A back-of-the-envelope calculation suggests a 7.3 percent rise in mortality for the treated population, who lost their job due to NAFTA. Further analyses using a wide range of alternative data sources suggest that reductions in income-employment, reductions in wealth, increases in disability, decreases in health insurance coverage, decreases in private health insurance, and a higher likelihood of reliance on presumably lower quality public insurance as candidate mechanisms.

10.3386/w34840.abstractZh: 1994年《北美自由贸易协定》的实施导致美国产业结构发生了重大重组，不同地区的产业构成存在显著差异。本文研究了《北美自由贸易协定》对劳动年龄人口死亡率的影响。我们通过事件研究和差异差异分析，考察了与《北美自由贸易协定》相关的年份以及受《北美自由贸易协定》影响程度不同的地区，死亡率的动态变化。比较贸易影响程度较高的地区与较低的地区，我们发现25-55岁人群的死亡率上升了2.1%。粗略计算表明，因《北美自由贸易协定》而失去工作的群体，其死亡率上升了7.3%。进一步使用多种替代数据来源的分析表明，收入与就业减少、财富减少、残疾率上升、健康保险覆盖率下降、私人健康保险减少，以及更可能依赖质量较低的公共保险，都是导致死亡率上升的机制。

abstract.text: Work-related burnout and stress-related sickness absence have become increasingly prevalent, but evidence on which workplace features shape workers’ mental health remains limited. Using population-level Swedish register data covering all lower- and upper-secondary teachers from 2006–2024, we show that schools serving more disadvantaged students exhibit substantially higher rates of sickness absence, particularly for stress-related diagnoses. Exploiting within-teacher variation across student cohorts, we separate sorting from exposure and find that a one standard deviation increase in student disadvantage raises overall and stress-related sick leave by 3.6% and 8.7%, respectively. Survey evidence indicates that these effects operate through classroom conditions rather than workload or organizational differences. The findings establish client composition as a distinct and policy-relevant determinant of worker health in contact-intensive occupations.

10.3386/w34841.abstractZh: 与工作相关的倦怠和与压力相关的病假缺席现象日益普遍，但关于哪些工作场所特征会影响员工心理健康的研究仍然有限。我们利用2006年至2024年间瑞典全国登记数据，对所有初中和高中教师进行了研究。结果显示，服务弱势学生的学校中，与压力相关的病假缺席率明显更高。通过分析不同学生群体中的教师差异，我们发现学生弱势程度的增加会导致整体病假和与压力相关的病假分别增加3.6%和8.7%。调查数据表明，这些影响是通过课堂环境而非工作量或组织差异来发挥作用的。研究结果表明，学生群体构成是接触密集型职业中影响员工健康的独立且重要的因素。

abstract.text: We estimate the mortality effects of local labor market exposure to NAFTA and compare them to the mortality effects of other U.S. local labor market contractions. Areas more exposed to NAFTA experienced sustained increases in mortality over the subsequent 15 years. Mortality increases occurred for all broad demographic groups, but were especially pronounced among working-age men. Extending the analysis to other economic contractions, we show that mortality consequences depend critically on which sectors bear the losses: declines in manufacturing employment increase local area mortality, while declines in non-manufacturing employment reduce it.

10.3386/w34855.abstractZh: 我们估算了当地劳动力市场接触北美自由贸易协定的死亡率影响，并将其与其他美国局部劳动力市场收缩的死亡率影响进行了比较。那些更受北美自由贸易协定影响的地区，在随后的15年中死亡率持续上升。所有广泛的人口群体都出现了死亡率上升的情况，但在工作年龄男性中尤为明显。将分析扩展到其他经济收缩情况，我们发现死亡率后果的关键在于哪些行业遭受损失：制造业就业减少会增加当地地区的死亡率，而非制造业就业减少则会降低死亡率。

abstract.text: Geopolitical tensions, supply-chain concerns and policy risk have moved to the forefront of the pharmaceutical industry. This paper develops a real options valuation model of drug R&D that captures sequential clinical investment with technical failure, stochastic costs, uncertain cash flows, and optimal abandonment. We incorporate two regulatory shocks: a reduction in effective exclusivity period and a price-control shock that reduces net cash flows. Calibrating to an incremental CNS program, we find that project value at initiation is highly right-skewed: the mean is USD 69.6m but the median is negative, so expected value is driven by rare high-upside outcomes. Regulatory risk mainly compresses this upside. Both reductions in effective exclusivity and price-based interventions substantially weaken investment incentives, even when they occur with moderate probability. Value is strongly convex in exclusivity length, with the final years carrying the highest marginal value. We introduce iso-value maps that summarize how time-based and price-based policies substitute in their impact on project valuation, to clarify the trade-offs inherent in regulatory design: losing two years of exclusivity is comparable to roughly a 30% cash-flow contraction. Using a standard revenue-to-R&D elasticity, these valuation effects imply a 10% to 25% long-run contraction in investment. The framework provides a transparent mapping from policy design to project value and investment incentives.

10.3386/w34863.abstractZh: 地缘政治紧张局势、供应链问题以及政策风险已经成为制药行业面临的首要问题。本文提出了一种药物研发的真实期权估值模型，该模型能够捕捉到技术失败、随机成本、不确定的现金流以及最优放弃等连续性的临床投资情况。我们纳入了两种监管冲击：有效独占期的缩短以及降低净现金流的价格控制冲击。通过对一个中等规模的中枢神经系统项目进行校准，我们发现项目启动时的价值具有高度右偏分布：平均值为6960万美元，但中位数为负，因此预期价值主要由罕见的高收益结果驱动。监管风险主要压缩了这种高收益。无论是有效独占期的缩短还是基于价格的政策干预，都会大幅削弱投资激励，即使这些风险发生的概率适中。项目的价值在独占期长度上呈强烈凸性，最后几年的边际价值最高。我们引入了等值图，以总结基于时间和基于价格的政策对项目估值的影响，从而明确监管设计中固有的权衡：失去两年的独占权相当于现金流减少约30%。根据标准的收入与研发弹性关系，这些估值效应意味着长期投资将减少10%到25%。该框架提供了从政策设计到项目价值及投资激励的透明映射。

abstract.text: Modern smartphones present new threats to road safety beyond talking and texting, but the real-world effects are difficult to study. One way to causally assess the impact of smartphones on road safety is to identify arbitrarily timed events during which smartphone-related distraction may exogenously increase – i.e., a situation that relies not on plausibly random variation in who uses smartphones while driving, but when smartphones are used. We investigated the impact of smartphones on road safety by examining traffic fatalities on days when smartphone use likely surges: the release of major music albums. Using event study analysis, we show that music streaming – an indicator for smartphone use, where streaming most often occurs – sharply increases, by nearly 40%, on dates of major music album releases, while U.S. traffic fatalities increase by nearly 15% on those same days. Mobile device use while driving is a known safety issue, but today’s smartphones present new and greater opportunities for driver distraction. Our study indicates how features of these phones may have important impacts on distracted driving and traffic fatalities.

10.3386/w34866.abstractZh: 现代智能手机除了用于通话和发短信之外，还带来了新的道路安全威胁，但这些威胁的实际影响难以研究。一种因果评估智能手机对道路安全影响的方法，是识别那些因使用智能手机而可能导致分心的事件——即，这种情况并非依赖于使用智能手机的随机性，而是取决于使用智能手机的时间。我们通过研究在大型音乐专辑发布日这种智能手机使用量可能激增的日期，来探讨智能手机对道路安全的影响。通过事件研究分析，我们发现，在大型音乐专辑发布日，音乐流媒体服务的使用量会显著增加，接近40%，而美国道路上的死亡人数也会在同样的日子里增加近15%。在驾驶时使用移动设备是一个已知的安全问题，但今天的智能手机为驾驶员分心提供了新的、更大的机会。我们的研究表明，这些手机的功能可能对分心驾驶和道路死亡人数产生重要影响。

abstract.text: We examine how the Affordable Care Act (ACA) altered the insurance consequences of involuntary job loss. Using matched event-study models with longitudinal survey data, we estimate the causal effects of displacement on insurance coverage before and after implementation of the ACA’s main provisions. Prior to 2014, job loss reduced coverage by approximately 16 percentage points, with losses persisting for more than a year. After the ACA, declines are smaller—about 10 percentage points—and recovery is faster. Gains reflect higher baseline public coverage and reduced post-displacement losses, with the largest improvements among middle income workers previously most exposed to coverage disruptions.

10.3386/w34874.abstractZh: 我们研究了《平价医疗法案》如何改变了非自愿失业对保险的影响。通过结合纵向调查数据的匹配事件研究模型，我们估算了在《平价医疗法案》主要条款实施前后，失业对保险覆盖率的因果效应。在2014年之前，失业导致保险覆盖率下降约16个百分点，且这种下降持续超过一年。在《平价医疗法案》实施后，下降幅度较小，约为10个百分点，且恢复速度更快。保险覆盖率的提升反映了更高的公共保险基础以及失业后的损失减少，其中中等收入工人受到的改善最大，因为这些群体此前最容易受到保险覆盖中断的影响。

abstract.text: We study how personalized information affects household responses to environmental risk. Using data from residential air quality monitors, we exploit the timing of monitor installation and high-frequency fine particulate matter (PM₂.₅) readings to identify responses to new information about indoor pollution risk. We find that indoor PM₂.₅ concentrations decline by 2.5 μg/m³ over the 12 weeks following installation, conditional on contemporaneous outdoor pollution, with effects significantly larger among households with high initial indoor pollution. The indoor-outdoor pollution gradient declines over time, indicating that households become increasingly effective at mitigating exposure when marginal health damages are highest. Using machine learning techniques to infer cooking activity and air purifier adoption, we show that households respond primarily through durable defensive investments rather than reductions in pollution-generating behavior, with back-of-the-envelope calculations implying positive net benefits. Our results suggest that personalized monitoring transforms air pollution from an external threat to avoid into an internal risk that households can control.

10.3386/w34875.abstractZh: 我们研究了个性化信息如何影响家庭对环境风险的应对。通过住宅空气质量监测数据，我们利用监测设备的安装时间以及高频细颗粒物（PM₂.₅）的监测数据，来识别家庭对室内污染风险新信息的反应。研究发现，在同时具备室外污染的情况下，安装监测设备后的12周内，室内PM₂.₅浓度下降了2.5微克/立方米，而在初始室内污染较高的家庭中，这种影响更为显著。室内与室外污染之间的梯度随时间逐渐减弱，这表明当边际健康损害最大时，家庭在减轻污染暴露方面变得更加有效。通过机器学习技术来推断家庭烹饪活动和空气净化器的使用情况，我们发现家庭主要通过长期性的防御性投资来应对污染问题，而非减少产生污染的行为，而简单的计算表明这种投资带来了正的净效益。我们的研究结果表明，个性化监测将空气污染从需要避免的外部威胁转变为家庭可以控制的内部风险。

abstract.text: Youths who vape nicotine rarely make in-person purchases of e-cigarettes from a vendor but instead rely on alternative methods to obtain electronic nicotine delivery system (ENDS) products. This study is the first to explore whether the informal social market and online purchasing options help to insulate youths from e-cigarette taxation. Using data from the State Youth Risk Behavior Surveillance Surveys, we find that ENDS taxation reduces both the likelihood of teens obtaining ENDS products through direct in-person retail purchases as well as the likelihood of relying on informal social sources for e-cigarettes such as borrowing vaping devices from friends or third-party purchases. Auxiliary analyses from the Population Assessment of Tobacco and Health are generally consistent with these findings and suggest that impacts are concentrated on the initiation margin; higher ENDS taxes deter youths initiating through direct retail purchases as well as through the social market. For older teens ages 18 and older, however, we find that informal social sources may attenuate the impacts of e-cigarette taxes. Finally, we detect some evidence that ENDS taxes increases the likelihood that teenagers shift to online sources to obtain e-cigarettes.

10.3386/w34880.abstractZh: 使用电子烟来摄入尼古丁的年轻人很少亲自从销售商那里购买电子烟，而是依赖其他方式来获取电子尼古丁输送系统产品。本研究首次探讨了非正式社交市场和在线购买渠道是否有助于使年轻人免受电子烟税的影响。根据《州青少年风险行为监测调查》的数据，我们发现电子烟税降低了青少年通过直接零售购买获取电子尼古丁输送系统产品的可能性，同时也减少了他们依赖非正式社交渠道获取电子烟的可能性，例如向朋友借用电子烟设备或通过第三方渠道购买。来自《烟草与健康人口评估》的辅助分析结果与这些发现一致，表明影响主要集中在初始阶段；较高的电子烟税会抑制青少年通过直接零售购买以及社交渠道获取电子烟的行为。然而，对于18岁及以上的青少年来说，非正式社交渠道可能会减轻电子烟税的影响。最后，我们发现电子烟税确实增加了青少年通过在线渠道获取电子烟的可能性。

abstract.text: Intimate partner violence remains one of the most serious threats to women's safety worldwide, yet existing evidence on the effectiveness of large-scale institutional protection systems is limited and mixed. This paper evaluates the impact of Violence Prevention and Monitoring Centers on intimate partner violence (IPV) against women in Türkiye. Exploiting the staggered rollout of centers across provinces, we find that the opening of a center reduces female homicides, particularly those perpetrated by intimate partners, by approximately 20 percent. Complementary survey evidence shows that the opening of a center also reduces women's self-reported exposure to physical IPV by 20 percent, with larger effects among younger and less-educated women. Exploring potential mechanisms, we find that centers primarily reduce violence by lowering barriers to help-seeking and improving coordination across police, legal, and social services: following the opening of a center, women become more likely to seek support from women's organizations and social services, while direct applications to prosecutors decline. We find no evidence of effects on gender attitudes, labor market outcomes, relationship status, marriage market outcomes, or mental health, suggesting violence reductions operate through improved access to protection rather than changes in norms or economic independence. The estimated effects are stronger in provinces with more gender-progressive norms and stronger institutional capacity, highlighting the importance of complementary social and institutional environments.

10.3386/w34886.abstractZh: 亲密伴侣暴力仍然是全球女性安全面临的最严重威胁之一，然而关于大规模制度性保护系统有效性的现有证据有限且存在争议。本文评估了暴力预防与监测中心对土耳其针对女性的亲密伴侣暴力的影响。通过分析各省份中心实施的节奏，我们发现中心的开办可使女性被亲密伴侣杀害的事件减少约20%。补充的调查研究表明，中心的开办还使女性自我报告的身体暴力暴露程度降低20%，且年轻和受教育程度较低的女性受到的影响更大。通过探讨潜在机制，我们发现这些中心主要通过降低寻求帮助的障碍以及加强警方、法律和社会服务之间的协作来减少暴力行为：中心成立后，女性更有可能向妇女组织和社会服务机构寻求支持，而直接向检察官求助的情况则有所减少。我们没有发现对性别态度、劳动力市场结果、关系状况、婚姻市场结果或心理健康产生影响的证据，这表明暴力的减少是通过改善保护途径实现的，而非通过规范变化或经济独立来实现。在性别观念更进步且制度能力更强的省份，这些影响的估计值更为显著，这凸显了社会与制度环境的互补性的重要性。

abstract.text: We study how decisions made by organ procurement organizations (OPOs)-non-profits that coordinate organ recovery from deceased donors-affect the availability of organs for transplant in the United States.We develop a structural econometric model of a pivotal OPO decision: whether to approach a potential donor's family to request authorization for donation.Our model conceptualizes this decision in two parts.The OPO first estimates the probabilities of two downstream outcomes: authorization (i.e., family consent) and transplant (i.e., whether the donated organs would be successfully transplanted).It then applies a cost-benefit decision rule that maps these estimates to an approach decision.Our model separately identifies the OPO's beliefs (i.e., probability estimates), its preferences (i.e., costs / benefits), and the true probabilities of authorization and transplant.We apply our model to a dataset of 35,856 potential donors referred to four OPOs between 2016 and 2021.We find that OPOs missed a substantial number of donation opportunities, recovering organs from only 39% of transplantable donors.Of these missed opportunities, an estimated 16% resulted from conservative preferences, 12% from miscalibrated beliefs, and the remaining 72% from family declines.We conduct a detailed counterfactual policy evaluation to identify impactful and actionable changes to OPO decisions.We find that drastically increasing approach rates would allow OPOs to recover organs from 43% more donors, creating over $100 million in additional annual societal benefit.

10.3386/w34890.abstractZh: 我们研究了由器官采购组织（OPOs）做出的决策如何影响美国器官移植的可用性。这些组织是协调从已故捐赠者身上获取器官的非营利机构。我们建立了一个结构性的计量经济模型，用于分析一个关键的决策：是否向潜在捐赠者的家属征求同意进行捐赠。我们的模型将这一决策分为两个部分：首先，OPO需要估计两个下游结果的概率，即获得授权（即家属同意）和成功移植（即捐赠的器官能否成功移植）。然后，模型应用一种成本效益决策规则，将这些估计值转化为是否进行捐赠的决定。我们的模型分别确定了OPO的信念（即概率估计）、偏好（即成本/收益）以及授权和移植的真实概率。我们应用该模型分析了一个包含35,856名潜在捐赠者的数据集，这些数据在2016年至2021年间被四个OPO处理。研究发现，OPO错过了大量捐赠机会，仅从39%的可移植捐赠者身上获取了器官。在这些被错过的机会中，约16%是由于保守的偏好导致的，12%是由于对概率估计不准确，其余72%则是由于家属拒绝所致。我们进行了详细的反事实政策评估，以找出对OPO决策有实际影响的可实施改变。研究发现，如果大幅增加征求同意的频率，OPO可以从43%更多的捐赠者身上获取器官，从而每年为社会带来超过1亿美元的社会效益。

abstract.text: The large increase in remote work since 2020 has prompted concerns about adverse effects on population loneliness and mental health. We show that any such adverse effects were transitory, in a UK context. We use panel data from UKHLS and differences-in-differences estimators that flexibly control for a rich set of covariates to compare changes in key variables amongst two groups: those who worked in teleworkable occupations in 2019, and those who worked in non-teleworkable occupations in 2019. While the former experience large and persistent increases in their probability of working remotely compared to the latter, adverse relative changes in self-reported loneliness or adverse mental health symptoms during the pandemic had disappeared by the year 2023.

10.3386/w34914.abstractZh: 自2020年以来，远程工作的大幅增加引发了人们对人口孤独感和心理健康产生负面影响的担忧。我们的研究表明，在英国的背景下，这些负面影响都是暂时的。我们利用了英国健康与寿命调查的数据，并采用差异-差异估计方法，灵活控制了一系列相关变量，以比较两组关键变量的变化：2019年从事可远程工作的职业的人，以及2019年从事不可远程工作的职业的人。尽管前者在远程工作的概率上出现了较大且持续的增长，但在疫情期间，关于自我报告的孤独感或心理健康症状的负面变化在2023年已经消失。

abstract.text: Financial incentives are widely used to encourage beneficial behaviors, but their effectiveness may be limited by inattention and imperfect memory. We study this in a randomized trial of HIV medication adherence in Mozambique. Financial incentives alone increase adherence by 10.6 percentage points, while pairing incentives with reminders increases adherence by 24.3 percentage points. We develop a model in which inattention to daily adherence and imperfect memory of payment eligibility reduce incentive effectiveness and show that reminders mitigate both frictions. Detailed medication refill data support the model’s predictions. The results suggest combining incentives with reminders can substantially increase program effectiveness.

10.3386/w34917.abstractZh: 金融激励措施被广泛用于鼓励有益的行为，但其效果可能会因忽视和不完美的记忆而受到限制。我们在莫桑比克进行了一项关于HIV药物依从性的随机试验。单独使用金融激励措施可使依从性提高10.6个百分点，而将激励措施与提醒措施结合使用则可使依从性提高24.3个百分点。我们建立了一个模型，该模型表明对日常依从性的忽视以及对支付资格的不完美记忆会降低激励措施的效果，而提醒措施可以缓解这两种摩擦。详细的药物续药数据支持了该模型的预测。结果表明，将激励措施与提醒措施相结合可以显著提高项目的效果。

abstract.text: We estimate the market value of reproductive rights as capitalized into U.S. housing markets. We do so using a synthetic difference-in-differences design to evaluate the effects of total abortion bans following the 2022 Dobbs decision, and drawing on housing market indices from Zillow and vacancy rate data from the U.S. Census Bureau's Housing Vacancy Survey. The results indicate that total abortion bans reduced rents by an average of 2.2% from July 2022 through June 2025, with the effect reaching 4.0% in the most recent year. Over the same horizon, bans increased rental vacancy rates by an average of 1.1 percentage points, with the effect reaching 1.8 percentage points in the most recent year. Estimates for home values and homeowner vacancy rates are similar in magnitude but less precise.

10.3386/w34921.abstractZh: 我们估算了生殖权利的市场价值，并将其转化为美国住房市场的资本价值。我们采用合成差异-差异设计来评估2022年Dobbs裁决之后全面禁止堕胎的影响，并参考Zillow的住房市场指数以及美国人口普查局住房空置调查中的空置率数据。研究结果表明，从2022年7月至2025年6月，全面禁止堕胎导致租金平均下降2.2%，在最近的一年中这一影响达到了4.0%。在同一时期，禁令使租赁空置率平均上升了1.1个百分点，在最近的一年中这一影响达到了1.8个百分点。关于房屋价值和房主空置率的估算结果在幅度上相似，但精确度较低。

abstract.text: The United States relies primarily on private health insurance markets, yet these markets are highly concentrated and becoming more so over time. We document concentration across commercial, Medicare Advantage, and Medicaid markets. We then examine how asymmetric information—particularly adverse selection—interacts with market power to shape premiums, plan design, and consumer welfare. Empirical evidence confirms that insurer consolidation raises premiums. We discuss how antitrust enforcement, risk adjustment, regulation, and informational interventions shape competition and consumer welfare in these markets.

10.3386/w34928.abstractZh: 美国主要依赖私人健康保险市场，但这些市场高度集中，并且随着时间的推移这种集中程度会进一步加剧。我们记录了商业保险市场、Medicare Advantage市场和Medicaid市场的集中度。接着，我们探讨了信息不对称——尤其是逆向选择——如何与市场力量相互作用，从而影响保费、计划设计和消费者福利。实证证据表明，保险公司合并会导致保费上升。我们还讨论了反垄断执法、风险调整、监管以及信息干预如何在这些市场中塑造竞争和消费者福利。

abstract.text: Almost a quarter-billion calls are placed to 911 each year in the United States. A large share of them involve social problems, not crimes or emergencies---yet police are dispatched in response. This review traces how the 911 emergency system's institutional design shapes demand for police, who is excluded from or ill served by this system, and what alternatives exist, including nonemergency lines (with police response), government hotlines (211, 311, 988), civilian crisis teams, and community-based resources. Among the universe of municipal police departments with at least 100 sworn officers in 2020, covering 107 million US residents, police have absorbed broad social service functions, with the availability of formal alternatives restricted to the largest cities. The evidence suggests that the primacy of police reflects institutional reproduction more than public need. I propose priorities for future research.

10.3386/w34933.abstractZh: 在美国，每年有近四分之一亿次电话拨打911。其中很大一部分涉及社会问题，而非犯罪或紧急情况——然而警方仍会被派去处理这些电话。本文探讨了911紧急救援系统的制度设计如何影响了对警察的需求，以及警察如何被排除在该系统之外或受到不公正的对待。同时，文章还探讨了其他替代方案，包括非紧急求助热线（如211、311、988）、政府热线、民间危机处理团队以及社区资源等。在2020年，有至少100名警员的市政警察部门共有107百万美国居民，这些警察部门承担了广泛的社会服务职能，而正式替代方案仅在最大城市中存在。证据表明，警察的主导地位更多反映了制度的再生产，而非公众的实际需求。本文提出了未来研究的优先方向。

abstract.text: The use of federal anti-fraud laws to address unnecessary medical care is controversial. Targeted providers frequently argue that, in their judgment, the treatment in question was appropriate. We examine the effects of anti-fraud litigation against hospitals for over-admitting patients from the emergency department, using 100% Medicare claims for 2005-2019 and a design based on the staggered rollout of these lawsuits. We find that anti-fraud lawsuits reduced admission rates by 3.6 percentage points without increasing mortality rates. We estimate five-year savings to Medicare of $1.3 billion. Our results suggest that anti-fraud enforcement can be successful in reducing costly, unnecessary care.

10.3386/w34938.abstractZh: 使用联邦反欺诈法律来应对不必要的医疗护理存在争议。目标医疗机构经常辩称，他们认为所涉及的治疗是适当的。我们研究了针对医院过度收治急诊病人的反欺诈诉讼的影响，使用了2005-2019年的100%医疗保险索赔数据，并采用了基于这些诉讼分阶段实施的方案。我们发现，反欺诈诉讼使入院率降低了3.6个百分点，而死亡率并未上升。我们估计，这给医疗保险带来了13亿美元的年度节省。我们的结果表明，反欺诈执法可以在减少昂贵且不必要的医疗护理方面取得成功。

abstract.text: We document state variation in Medicaid coverage for obesity-indicated GLP-1 medications over time, and use a stacked difference-in-differences design to estimate the effects of coverage on utilization and net-of-rebate spending. Nine quarters out, coverage increases prescriptions for obesity-indicated GLP-1 medications by 0.82 per 100 enrollee-months (SE = 0.10). Coverage had no effect on GLP-1 prescribing for diabetes or cardiovascular indications, suggesting that off-label prescribing of diabetes formulations for obesity is not very common in the Medicaid program. The expansions do not appear to affect consumer spending at major online GLP-1 compounding firms, which suggests that the utilization response in our main analysis reflects new utilization rather than crowd-out. We find that coverage increases net-of-rebate Medicaid spending by $751.6 per 100 enrollee-months (SE = $92.0), compared to $986.9 in gross reimbursements—manufacturer rebates reduce the state’s net spending by approximately 24 percent. Across the 17 states that ever covered obesity-indicated GLP-1 medications by mid 2025, coverage increased Medicaid net spending by around $2.68 billion per year. Extending Medicaid coverage in the remaining states would generate a further $3.63 billion in annual net spending.

10.3386/w34949.abstractZh: 我们记录了随时间变化的州级Medicaid对肥胖症相关GLP-1药物的覆盖情况，并使用堆叠差异-差异设计来估计覆盖情况对用药需求和净报销支出的影响。在九个季度中，覆盖情况使肥胖症相关GLP-1药物的处方量增加了0.82份/100参保人月（标准误为0.10）。覆盖情况对糖尿病或心血管疾病的GLP-1处方没有影响，这表明在Medicaid计划中，糖尿病药物用于肥胖症的超说明书使用并不常见。这些扩展措施似乎并未影响主要在线GLP-1制药公司的消费者支出，这表明我们主要分析中的使用反应反映了新的使用情况，而非替代其他药物。我们发现，覆盖情况使净报销后的Medicaid支出增加了751.6美元/100参保人月（标准误为92.0美元），而总报销金额为986.9美元——制造商的报销减少了州级净支出约24%。在截至2025年中期曾经对肥胖症相关GLP-1药物进行覆盖的17个州中，覆盖情况使Medicaid净支出每年增加了约2.68亿美元。在剩余的州扩大Medicaid覆盖范围，还将产生额外的3.63亿美元年度净支出。

abstract.text: We describe competition in the physician market, focusing on how entry barriers and substitution possibilities have changed in recent decades. Regulatory caps on medical school seats and residency slots—especially for high-paying specialties—continue to ration entry, generate high returns for those who gain these slots, and direct the most academically accomplished trainees toward lucrative fields. But trained physicians increasingly compete with nurse practitioners, physician assistants, and other mid-level practitioners in the market for patients. Training of these substitutes has expanded far more rapidly than physician supply. We present key facts about the physician pipeline, a conceptual framework linking specialty earnings to entry barriers, and describe the rise of mid-level providers. These facts mean that effective competition policy in physician markets must look beyond conventional concentration measures and focus on the institutions and laws that govern who can provide medical care.

10.3386/w34955.abstractZh: 我们描述了医生市场的竞争情况，重点关注近几十年来进入壁垒和替代可能性如何变化。对医学院学位和住院医师职位的监管限制——尤其是针对高薪专业的限制——继续限制进入机会，为获得这些职位的人带来高回报，并引导那些学术表现最出色的培训人员选择利润丰厚的领域。然而，经过培训的医生越来越多地与护士执业者、医师助理以及其他中级医疗从业者竞争患者资源。这些替代者的培训速度远远快于医生供应量的增长。我们提供了关于医生人才储备的关键信息，构建了一个概念框架，将专业收入与进入壁垒联系起来，并描述了中级医疗提供者的崛起。这些事实表明，在医生市场中实施有效的竞争政策必须超越传统的集中度衡量标准，而应关注那些决定谁能提供医疗服务的制度和法律。

abstract.text: We compare physician incomes using tax data from the United States, Canada, Sweden, and the Netherlands. Physicians are concentrated in the top percentiles of the income distribution in all four countries, especially in the United States and certain specialties. Physician incomes are highest in the United States, and a decomposition shows that this mainly reflects differences in overall income distributions, rather than physicians’ locations in those distributions. This suggests that broader labor market differences, and thus physicians’ outside options, drive absolute incomes. Shifting US physicians’ incomes to match relative positions in other countries’ distributions would only marginally reduce healthcare spending.

10.3386/w34956.abstractZh: 我们通过来自美国、加拿大、瑞典和荷兰的税收数据来比较医生的收入。在所有四个国家中，医生都集中在收入分布的较高百分位数，尤其是在美国和某些专业领域。美国的医生收入最高，而深入分析表明，这主要反映了整体收入分布的差异，而非医生在收入分布中的位置。这表明，更广泛的劳动力市场差异，以及医生的其他选择，决定了他们的绝对收入。将美国医生的收入调整到其他国家收入分布的相应位置，只会略微减少医疗保健支出。

abstract.text: Lethal firearm ownership is deeply polarizing in the United States. We show that beneath this polarization, owners and non-owners share a common objective — safety — but disagree sharply about whether lethal firearms achieve it. Using an original survey of more than 5,400 respondents combined with randomized experiments, we document that owners feel safe and confident with firearms, while non-owners on balance feel less safe around them and perceive large private costs and social harms. Demand for lethal firearms is nonetheless potentially large and growing: one-third of non-owners express interest in acquiring one — these individuals report the lowest day-to-day safety — while very few owners would consider reducing their holdings. Persuading owners to relinquish firearms without any replacement appears unrealistic; the more tractable margins may be safe storage and non-lethal substitution for additional purchases. We organize these patterns through a framework centered on a perceived safety possibilities frontier (SPF) — the safety outcomes a household believes achievable with different combinations of lethal and non-lethal tools. Households may differ in firearm demand because they face different risk environments, weigh protective benefits against harms differently, or hold different beliefs about the frontier. Our descriptive evidence points to heterogeneous beliefs as important drivers, suggesting that levers such as information could shift the perceived frontier. These patterns motivate three experimental treatments: one on the private legal/medical costs of lethal firearm ownership, and two on a non-lethal firearm (NLFA), with and without a conservative pundit’s endorsement. The private-cost treatment increases concern about harms among all respondents and support for safe storage policies, and modestly raises stated willingness to keep lethal firearms locked. NLFA treatments raise willingness to pay for an NLFA, to keep lethal firearms locked, and support for incapacitating over lethal firearms and for policies encouraging NLFAs. These effects are largely persistent. Importantly, NLFA information does not increase willingness to reduce lethal firearm ownership but does increase willingness to store lethal firearms safely. Our results suggest that many owners perceive the SPF differently from nonowners, neglecting harms or less-lethal alternatives, yet remain open to such tools. Overall, individuals share a common goal — safety — yet disagree about the means. Although these disagreements appear entrenched, people remain receptive to alternatives that might command broader agreement.

10.3386/w34962.abstractZh: 在美国，致命枪支的持有问题引发了严重的两极分化。我们发现，在这两极分化之下，枪支拥有者与非拥有者有着共同的目标——安全，但他们对致命枪支是否能实现安全这一目标存在严重分歧。通过对5400多名受访者进行的调查以及随机实验，我们发现枪支拥有者感到自己在使用枪支时安全且自信，而非拥有者则总体上认为周围的环境不够安全，并且认为私人成本和社会危害很大。尽管如此，对致命枪支的需求仍然可能很大且还在增长：三分之一的非拥有者表示有兴趣购买一支致命枪支——这些个体报告的日常安全水平最低——而很少有拥有者会考虑减少自己的枪支持有量。说服拥有者放弃枪支而不提供替代方案似乎不现实；更可行的解决方案可能是将枪支妥善存放，或者购买非致命替代品。我们通过一个以感知安全可能性边界为框架来组织这些模式——即家庭认为不同组合的致命与非致命工具能够实现的安全结果。家庭在枪支需求上的差异可能是因为他们面临不同的风险环境，对保护利益的权衡不同，或者对安全边界的看法不同。我们的描述性证据表明，不同的信念是重要的驱动因素，这表明诸如信息这样的手段可以改变人们感知的安全边界。这些模式促使我们提出了三种实验性解决方案：一种针对致命枪支拥有的私人法律/医疗费用，另外两种则针对非致命枪支，包括有和没有保守专家支持的方案。私人成本处理方案增加了所有受访者对危害的担忧，并提升了人们对安全储存政策的支持，同时略微提高了人们将致命枪支锁起来的意愿。非致命枪支信息处理方案则提升了人们为非致命枪支支付费用、将致命枪支锁起来的意愿，以及支持使枪支失去杀伤能力而非致命性的政策。这些效应在很大程度上是持久的。重要的是，非致命枪支信息处理方案并未增加减少致命枪支所有权的意愿，但确实增加了安全储存致命枪支的意愿。我们的研究结果表明，许多枪支拥有者与非拥有者对安全处理方案的看法不同，他们可能忽视了危害或选择较不致命的替代方案，但仍然愿意采用这些工具。总体而言，人们有着共同的目标——安全，但在实现目标的手段上存在分歧。尽管这些分歧似乎根深蒂固，但人们仍然愿意接受可能获得更广泛共识的替代方案。

abstract.text: Recent studies of Ivy-Plus institutions suggest that standardized test scores (SAT/ACT) are far better predictors of college success than high school grade point average (HS-GPA), prompting a return to the requirement that test scores be submitted for admission at elite colleges. We ask whether re-establishing the SAT requirement for admission at a large urban public university system would improve the predictability of academic outcomes. Using administrative data for the 2010-2019 first-year cohorts, we update earlier work of students from public universities as to the relative predictive power of HSGPA and SAT scores on first-year outcomes and graduation rates. Contrary to findings at elite private institutions, we find that HSGPA is the dominant predictor of academic success in this public system. A one-standard-deviation increase in HSGPA is four to six times more predictive of six-year graduation than a comparable increase in SAT scores. Out-of-sample forecasts for the post-COVID period (2020–2024) confirm that test-optional models relying only on HSGPA experience relatively little loss in predictive accuracy compared to models that include test scores. We conclude that HSGPA remains the most reliable signal of degree completion at broad-access public universities.

10.3386/w34975.abstractZh: 最近对顶尖院校的研究表明，标准化考试成绩（如SAT/ACT）是预测大学成功与否的更好指标，而非高中成绩平均分（HS-GPA）。这促使人们重新要求精英院校在录取时提交考试成绩。我们探讨在大型城市公立大学系统中重新实施SAT考试成绩作为录取条件的做法是否能够提高学术成果的可预测性。通过2010-2019年一年级学生的行政数据，我们更新了关于公立大学学生中HS-GPA和SAT考试成绩对一年级学生学业成果及毕业率的相对预测能力的研究结果。与精英私立院校的情况不同，我们发现在该公立系统中，HS-GPA是学业成功的主要预测指标。HS-GPA提高一个标准差，其预测六年毕业率的能力是SAT成绩相应提高时的四到六倍。对后疫情时期（2020-2024年）的预测表明，仅依赖HS-GPA的模型在预测准确性方面与包含考试成绩的模型相比损失较小。我们得出结论，在大众化公立大学中，HS-GPA仍然是衡量学生毕业情况的最可靠指标。

abstract.text: The U.S. hospital sector expanded rapidly in the 1950s and 1960s, largely due to construction subsidies provided under federal legislation known as the Hill-Burton Act. This paper examines the impact of Hill-Burton grants on maternity care access and infant health. We find that grants for public hospitals significantly reduced out-of-hospital births and infant mortality, particularly among non-white populations. In contrast, grants for private non-profit hospitals had no measurable effects on out-of-hospital births or infant mortality.

10.3386/w34976.abstractZh: 美国在20世纪50年代和60年代，医院行业迅速扩张，这主要得益于联邦《希尔-伯顿法案》提供的建设补贴。本文探讨了《希尔-伯顿法案》对孕产妇护理和婴儿健康的影响。研究发现，对公立医院的补贴显著减少了医院外分娩和婴儿死亡率，尤其是在非白人人群中。相比之下，对私立非营利医院的补贴对医院外分娩和婴儿死亡率几乎没有影响。

abstract.text: In 2010, China accounted for less than 8% of global clinical trials; by 2020, it had surpassed the U.S. in annual registered clinical trial volume. To study this transformation, we compile a comprehensive, synchronized database spanning the pharmaceutical drug development supply chain: global data on scientific publications, clinical trials, and drug development milestones, combined with data on drug sales and government policies in China over the same period. We provide evidence that China’s National Reimbursement Drug List (NRDL) reform dramatically expanded the effective market size for innovative drugs and contributed to the country’s rise in biomedical innovation. We document a sharp increase in both the quantity (86%) and novelty of Chinese drug trials post-reform relative to U.S. trials, with similar patterns relative to Europe. This growth is concentrated in reform-exposed disease categories, first- or best-in-class drugs, and domestic firms. A decomposition exercise reveals that the NRDL reform accounts for 59% of the growth in oncology trial activity, comparable to the combined contribution of upstream knowledge accumulation and talent flows (21%) and venture capital investment (19%), while other government policies play a minor role. Finally, dynamic gains from induced innovation exceed the reform’s static gains in consumer access to innovative drugs by threefold, underscoring the importance of accounting for the reform’s long-run effects on innovation incentives beyond near-term improvements in drug affordability.

10.3386/w34977.abstractZh: 2010年，中国的全球临床试验数量占全球的不到8%；到2020年，中国的年度注册临床试验数量已超越美国。为了研究这一转变，我们编制了一个涵盖药品开发供应链的全面、同步的数据库：包括全球科学出版物、临床试验和药品开发里程碑的数据，以及同期中国的药品销售和政府政策数据。我们的研究表明，中国的国家报销药品清单改革显著扩大了创新药品的有效市场规模，并促进了该国在生物医学创新方面的进步。我们记录到，与美国的临床试验相比，中国的临床试验在数量（86%）和新颖性方面都有显著增长，欧洲的情况也类似。这种增长主要集中在改革后出现的疾病类别、首款或最佳水平的药品以及国内企业身上。进一步分析显示，国家报销药品清单改革对肿瘤学临床试验活动的增长贡献了59%，与上游知识积累和人才流动（21%）以及风险投资（19%）的贡献相当，而其他政府政策的作用则较小。最后，由创新带来的动态收益是改革在消费者获得创新药品方面的静态收益的三倍，这凸显了考虑改革对创新激励的长期影响的重要性，而不仅仅是短期内药品可负担性的改善。

abstract.text: Paid leave policies are designed to help workers balance work with caregiving responsibilities, yet research has focused predominantly on parental leave while the literature on non-parental caregiving leave remains nascent. This chapter reviews the evidence on the impacts of paid family leave (PFL) and paid sick leave (PSL) policies, with a focus on non-childbirth-related caregiving. We begin with an overview of the prevalence and challenges of informal caregiving in the US and internationally, followed by a description of the current paid caregiving leave policy landscape. We then review evidence on the impact of these policies on leave take-up, labor market outcomes, caregiver health and well-being, employer outcomes, and utilization of formal care. We find that paid leave policies have successfully increased leave take-up and that PFL improves labor market outcomes for workers with caregiving responsibilities, without adversely affecting employers. There is also some suggestive evidence of improvements in caregivers’ mental health. We additionally provide an update of the paid parental leave literature since it was last reviewed by Rossin-Slater (2018), describing the latest evidence on maternal health, child health and development, parental labor market outcomes, and employer outcomes. We conclude by identifying key gaps in the literature, including the lack of research on the outcomes of (non-child) care recipients, limited evidence on employer responses, and the underexplored role of PSL in supporting caregiving needs.

10.3386/w34997.abstractZh: 带薪休假政策旨在帮助劳动者在工作和照顾责任之间取得平衡。然而，相关研究主要集中在育儿休假上，而非育儿以外的照顾休假方面的研究仍然较为匮乏。本章回顾了带薪家庭休假和带薪病假政策的影响，重点关注与分娩无关的照顾工作。我们首先概述了美国及国际范围内非正式照顾工作的普遍性和挑战，然后描述了当前带薪照顾休假政策的情况。接着，我们回顾了这些政策对休假参与度、劳动力市场结果、照顾者健康和福祉、雇主结果以及正式照顾服务利用情况的影响。研究发现，带薪休假政策成功地提高了休假参与度，而且带薪家庭休假能够改善有照顾责任的劳动者的劳动力市场结果，同时不会给雇主带来负面影响。此外，还有一些迹象表明，带薪休假有助于照顾者的心理健康。我们还更新了自Rossin-Slater（2018年）上次回顾以来关于带薪育儿休假的研究，介绍了关于母亲健康、儿童健康与发展、父母劳动力市场结果以及雇主结果的最新研究。最后，我们指出了文献中的关键空白，包括缺乏关于非儿童照顾者结果的研究、关于雇主反应的研究有限，以及带薪病假在支持照顾需求方面的作用尚未得到充分探讨。

abstract.text: Special education serves more than one in seven U.S. students yet its causal impact remains understudied. Using longitudinal data from Massachusetts, Indiana, and Connecticut, we estimate the effect of individualized supports with an event-study design that tracks achievement around initial classification. Students’ scores decline prior to placement and rise sharply afterward, yielding a consistent V-shaped pattern. Within three years, achievement is 0.2–0.4σ higher than counterfactual trends imply. Gains are similar across disability categories and subgroups, are not driven by testing accommodations, and remain under conservative assumptions. Individualized supports substantially increase learning productivity.

10.3386/w34998.abstractZh: 特殊教育服务于美国超过七分之一的学生，但其实际影响仍未被充分研究。我们利用马萨诸塞州、印第安纳州和康涅狄格州的纵向数据，通过事件研究设计来估算个性化支持的效果，该设计追踪了学生从初次分类后的表现变化。学生的成绩在安置前有所下降，之后则急剧上升，呈现出一致的V形趋势。在三年内，学生的成绩比反事实趋势所预测的高出0.2至0.4个标准差。这种提升在不同残疾类别和子群体中都是相似的，并非由考试调整所驱动，并且在保守的假设下仍然显著。个性化支持显著提高了学生的学习效率。

abstract.text: Genetics confer 2–3-fold higher obesity risk through inherited mechanisms affecting appetite and metabolism, with pathways particularly modifiable during the first 1,000 days of life. We leverage the end of UK sugar rationing in September 1953, a sharp discontinuity in early-life sugar exposure by conception date, to examine whether sugar restriction mitigates genetically determined obesity risk using UK Biobank data linking an obesity polygenic index with adiposity phenotypes. Without rationing, high genetic risk individuals had triple the obesity prevalence of low-risk counterparts. Restriction through age two narrowed this disparity by 40%, operating through visceral rather than general adiposity, and was concentrated among high-risk adults with above-median adiposity levels. Early nutritional environments can alter inherited obesity trajectories, pointing to targeted early-life interventions to reduce genetically determined health inequalities.

10.3386/w35005.abstractZh: 遗传因素通过影响食欲和代谢的机制，使肥胖风险增加2-3倍，而这些机制在生命的前1000天内尤为可改变。我们利用1953年9月英国糖 rationing结束这一时间点，即从受孕日期到生命早期糖摄入的显著中断，来研究糖限制是否能够减轻由基因决定的肥胖风险。通过英国生物银行的数据，我们将肥胖多基因指数与脂肪量表型联系起来进行研究。在没有糖 rationing的情况下，高遗传风险个体的肥胖患病率是低遗传风险个体的三倍。在2岁之前实施糖限制可以将这种差异缩小40%，且这种影响主要作用于内脏脂肪而非总体脂肪量，这种限制主要集中在脂肪量高于中位水平的高风险成年人中。早期的营养环境可以改变遗传性的肥胖轨迹，这表明有必要在生命早期采取有针对性的干预措施，以减少由基因决定的健康不平等。

abstract.text: Despite intense competition among mortgage lenders, borrowers face elevated mortgage rates and substantial price dispersion.We argue that realtor-loan-officer referral networks are a key source of lender market power: by steering homebuyers toward a limited set of loan officers, they restrict borrower choice even in otherwise competitive markets.Linking 91,988 realtors to 123,749 loan officers in 40 states, we document that such networks are pervasive and highly concentrated: 79% of realtors direct over 40% of their clients to just four loan officers, despite having on average 176 loan officers in the market.Strikingly, this concentration persists and even increases in markets with more lenders, suggesting that referrals constrain choice regardless of market structure.Controlling for borrower characteristics and lender choices, IV estimates suggest borrowers using referred loan officers pay 17.7 basis points more, equivalent to $2,712 in upfront costs at the average loan of $333K.The premium is more than twice as large for first-time home buyers, highlighting the role of experience and financial sophistication.A second identification strategy exploits the 2023 CFPB enforcement order against Freedom Mortgage, which terminated a set of paid referral relationships.Exploiting entirely different variation, this design confirms that referral lending raises borrowing costs, with a larger premium among the paid relationships the order disrupted.Two mechanisms operate: referrals reduce borrowers' search intensity across lenders, and they insulate individual loan officers from competition within their own institution, allowing referred officers to charge higher rate spreads than their colleagues.Neither faster processing time nor reduced denial risk justifies the premium.Our findings reveal referral networks as a hidden source of market power in the lending market, imposing substantial financial costs and raising equity concerns for borrowers.

10.3386/w35015.abstractZh: 尽管抵押贷款机构之间存在激烈的竞争，借款人仍面临较高的抵押贷款利率和巨大的价格差异。我们认为，房地产经纪人-贷款官员推荐网络是贷款机构市场力量的关键来源：通过引导购房者选择有限的贷款官员，这些网络即使在竞争激烈的市场中也限制了借款人的选择。我们联系了40个州的91,988名房地产经纪人和123,749名贷款官员，发现这种推荐网络普遍存在且高度集中：79%的房地产经纪人将其超过40%的客户推荐给仅四名贷款官员，而他们平均在市场上拥有176名贷款官员。值得注意的是，这种集中现象在贷款机构更多的市场中仍然存在，甚至有所加剧，这表明推荐行为无论市场结构如何都会限制选择。在控制借款人特征和贷款机构选择后，IV估计表明，使用推荐贷款官员的借款人需要支付17.7个基点的额外费用，相当于在平均33.3万美元的贷款金额下增加2,712美元的前期成本。对于首次购房者来说，这一溢价更是高达两倍，这凸显了经验和财务精明的重要性。第二种识别策略利用了2023年联邦住房金融局针对Freedom Mortgage的执法命令，该命令终止了一组有偿推荐关系。通过利用完全不同的变量，这一设计证实了推荐贷款行为会增加借贷成本，在受该命令影响的有偿关系中，这一溢价更为显著。两种机制在起作用：推荐行为减少了借款人的贷款机构搜索强度，并且使个别贷款官员在其机构内部免受竞争，从而允许推荐官员收取比同行更高的利率差。无论是更快的处理时间还是降低拒绝风险都无法解释这一溢价。我们的研究结果揭示了推荐网络作为一种隐藏的力量。在贷款市场中，市场力量的滥用会给借款人带来巨大的财务成本，并引发股权方面的担忧。

abstract.text: Using data on applicants to Dutch medical schools and their older relatives (i.e., parents, aunts, and uncles ages 60+), we estimate the effect of personal access to medical expertise on vaccine hesitancy. Leveraging variation in lottery outcomes that determine admission to medical schools, we find that having a physician in the family increases the likelihood of complying with government recommendations that anyone over the age of 59 receive a second booster dose of a COVID-19 vaccine. Our estimated effects are strongest for having a female physician in the family, suggesting important gender-based differences in how medical expertise is communicated.

10.3386/w35019.abstractZh: 通过研究荷兰医学院的申请者及其年长亲属（即60岁以上的父母、姑姑和叔叔）的数据，我们评估了个人接触医疗专业知识对疫苗犹豫态度的影响。利用决定医学院录取结果的随机结果差异，我们发现家庭中有一位医生会增加人们遵循政府建议、让59岁以上人群接种第二剂新冠疫苗的可能性。我们的估计结果显示，家庭中有一位女性医生时，这种影响最为显著，这表明在医疗专业知识的传播方式上存在重要的性别差异。

abstract.text: We study how situational fluctuations in cognitive capacity shape behavior in high-stakes, real-time decision-making. Drawing on recent advances in behavioral economics that revolve around inattention, cognition and complexity, we show that cognitive load influences how physicians in emergency departments allocate mental effort and attention when making diagnostic and treatment decisions. We use quasi-random variation in patient-physician pairings, along with granular electronic medical record and audit-log data from many clinical interactions, to show that, under higher cognitive load, physicians substitute mental deliberation with more numerous but less precise diagnostic actions. Specifically, we document that higher load (i) increases the total number of orders of diagnostic tests (ii) reduces the use of targeted, but more uncommon tests (iii) increases the use of common tests and (iv) increases uncertainty in diagnostic beliefs. Cognitive load impacts downstream inpatient admission from the emergency department: a physician in the highest cognitive load decile increases admissions by 28% relative to the same physician in the lowest cognitive load decile, for the exact same kind of patient. These results offer novel field-based evidence on the dynamics of attention and belief formation, and shed light on how cognitive constraints shape diagnostic behavior in complex, real-world environments.

10.3386/w35034.abstractZh: 我们研究了认知能力的情境波动如何影响高风险、实时决策中的行为。基于行为经济学领域关于注意力、认知和复杂性的最新研究进展，我们发现认知负荷会影响急诊科医生在做出诊断和治疗决策时如何分配心理努力和注意力。我们通过患者与医生配对关系的准随机变化，以及来自许多临床互动的详细电子病历和审计日志数据，发现在高认知负荷下，医生会用更多但精度较低的诊断措施来替代深思熟虑的决策。具体来说，我们发现更高的认知负荷会导致：(i) 诊断测试的总数量增加；(ii) 使用针对性但较为罕见的测试减少；(iii) 使用常见测试的频率增加；(iv) 诊断判断的不确定性增加。认知负荷还会影响从急诊科到住院治疗的流程：在认知负荷最高的医生中，与认知负荷最低的医生相比，相同类型的患者住院率会高出28%。这些结果提供了关于注意力与信念形成动态的新颖实地证据，并揭示了认知限制如何塑造复杂现实环境中的诊断行为。

abstract.text: We provide evidence of strategic transfer pricing by vertically integrated health care firms in response to insurer profit regulations. Insurers increased prices at vertically integrated pharmacies by 9.5% following the introduction of caps on insurer profits in Medicare Part D. We detect larger price increases by insurers that were at greatest risk of exceeding the allowable profit level. More than one-fifth of these higher prices were borne by the federal government. Our analysis illustrates that vertically integrated firms can evade profit regulation by “tunneling” profits to unregulated subsidiaries, undermining regulatory intent and increasing health care spending.

10.3386/w35043.abstractZh: 我们提供了证据，表明垂直整合的医疗保健公司通过战略转移定价来应对保险公司的利润监管。在Medicare Part D中引入保险公司利润上限后，保险公司的价格提高了9.5%。我们发现，那些面临超过允许利润水平最大风险的保险公司，其价格涨幅更大。这些更高价格中有超过五分之一是由联邦政府承担的。我们的分析表明，垂直整合的公司可以通过将利润转移到未受监管的子公司来规避利润监管，从而破坏监管意图并增加医疗保健支出。

abstract.text: A growing body of economic research explores the impacts of U.S. e-cigarette regulations on consumer tobacco choices, but less is known about e-cigarette regulation in China, the world’s largest tobacco market. We study China’s ban of flavored e-cigarettes. The ban of all flavors in e-cigarettes other than tobacco was part of a comprehensive package of regulatory policies adopted in 2022. We collected stated preference data through two discrete choice experiments conducted in 2021 and 2023, with about 600 subjects each. All subjects were adult current smokers. In the experiments, subjects made hypothetical choices between cigarettes, e-cigarettes, and quitting. Product prices and the attributes of e-cigarettes were experimentally varied, allowing us to identify the impact of flavor availability on stated preferences. We use the data to estimate conditional logit models and to predict the impact of the flavor ban and other policies. The empirical results suggest that a ban of flavored e-cigarettes decreases stated preferences for e-cigarettes but also has the unintended consequence to increase stated preferences for cigarettes. Despite the predicted decrease in e-cigarette choices, the predicted choice share of flavored e-cigarettes when they are illegal but loosely enforced is 53% of the predicted share when legal. This large illegal share is consistent with anecdotal evidence and with the evidence from our 2023 background survey that flavored e-cigarettes remain popular after the ban although fewer vapers reported getting their e-cigarettes from specialty or general retailers.

10.3386/w35048.abstractZh: 越来越多的经济研究探讨了美国电子香烟法规对消费者烟草选择的影响，但关于中国这个世界上最大的烟草市场的电子香烟法规，了解甚少。我们研究了中国对含味电子香烟的禁令。除了烟草味之外，禁止所有含味电子香烟的规定是2022年采取的一系列监管政策的一部分。我们通过2021年和2023年进行的两次离散选择实验收集了表达偏好数据，每次实验约有600名参与者，所有参与者均为成年吸烟者。在实验中，参与者需要在香烟、电子香烟和戒烟之间做出假设选择。实验过程中，电子香烟的产品价格和属性进行了实验性的变化，这使我们能够确定口味可用性对表达偏好的影响。我们利用这些数据估计条件Logit模型，并预测口味禁令及其他政策的影响。实证结果表明，对含味电子香烟的禁令降低了人们对电子香烟的表达偏好，但无意中增加了人们对香烟的表达偏好。尽管预计电子香烟的选择会减少，但当含味电子香烟被禁止但执行不严格时，其预期选择份额为53%，而合法时的预期选择份额则较低。这一较大的非法选择份额与传闻证据以及我们在2023年的背景调查结果一致，即尽管含味电子香烟在禁令后仍然受欢迎，但报告从专业或普通零售商购买电子香烟的人相对较少。

abstract.text: This paper estimates the economic value to the United States of eliminating cancer mortality over a 35-year horizon beginning in 2030, which would eliminate 30.7 million cancer deaths with a total mortality burden of 380 million life-years. We quantify the economic value of this substantial reduction in cancer mortality by incorporating the monetized value of increased longevity. To value the longevity gains in monetary terms, we utilize the valuations used by the U.S. federal government in its cost-benefit evaluations of regulations. Eliminating cancer mortality generates $197 trillion in economic benefits over 35 years, corresponding to approximately $16,282 per American per year, or $41,684 per American household per year. If cancer elimination is viewed as an R&D investment, it yields an enormous internal rate of return, ranging from 570% to 1,024%, based on benchmarked R&D costs. In addition, we perform a sensitivity analysis by varying the elimination durations and the degree of success, using the benchmark case scenario in which cancer mortality is reduced by 80 percent over a 20-year transition. This achieves about 70 percent of the total economic value of full elimination above, corresponding to aggregate benefits of about $134 trillion, or approximately $11,112 per person per year.
