10.3386/w35052.abstractZh: 本文估算了从2030年开始的35年内消除癌症死亡对美国的经济价值。这将减少3070万例癌症死亡，总生命年损失为3.8亿年。我们通过将寿命延长的货币价值纳入计算，来量化这种大幅减少癌症死亡的经济价值。为了用货币形式评估寿命延长的收益，我们采用了美国联邦政府在法规成本效益评估中使用的估值方法。消除癌症死亡在35年内将产生197万亿美元的经济效益，相当于每个美国人每年约16,282美元，或每个美国家庭每年约41,684美元。如果将癌症消除视为一项研发投资，其内部收益率将达到570%至1,024%之间，基于基准的研发成本计算。此外，我们还进行了敏感性分析，通过改变消除癌症死亡的期限和成功程度，使用癌症死亡在20年内减少80%的基准情景。这相当于上述总经济价值的约70%，总收益约为134万亿美元，或每人每年约11,112美元。

abstract.text: An aging US population has raised important questions regarding the organization, delivery, and funding of long-term services and supports (LTSS), prompting many state Medicaid programs to shift from fee-for-service to managed care models for LTSS delivery. We analyze the effects of transitioning to managed LTSS (MLTSS) on health outcomes among dual-eligible Medicare-Medicaid beneficiaries aged 65 and older in Florida and New York. Using Medicare claims data and a differences-in-differences design leveraging county-by-county MLTSS rollouts, we find that MLTSS leads to a 4.2 percent increase in hospitalizations in Florida, but no significant change in New York. Analysis of preventive care suggests that declining flu vaccination rates in Florida may have contributed to increased hospitalizations from respiratory causes. These findings highlight important differences in MLTSS effects across states and underscore the value of Medicare data for measuring health effects in the dual-eligible population.

10.3386/w35055.abstractZh: 美国人口老龄化问题引发了关于长期服务和支持的组织、提供和资金安排的重要问题，这促使许多州的医疗补助计划从按服务收费模式转向管理式护理模式。我们分析了在佛罗里达州和纽约州，65岁及以上的双重资格Medicare-医疗补助受益人转向管理式长期服务支持后，健康结果的变化。通过利用Medicare索赔数据和按县划分的管理式长期服务支持实施情况的差异分析，我们发现佛罗里达州的住院率增加了4.2%，而纽约州则没有显著变化。对预防保健的分析表明，佛罗里达州流感疫苗接种率的下降可能是导致呼吸系统原因导致的住院率增加的一个因素。这些发现突显了各州在管理式长期服务支持效果上的重要差异，并强调了Medicare数据在衡量双重资格人群健康影响方面的价值。

abstract.text: The poverty–mental health gradient varies substantially across populations, far more than sampling variation alone would predict. We treat this heterogeneity as a primary object of empirical interest. Using data collected four years after the 2005 Great Pakistan Earthquake from 126 villages spanning 0–75 km from the activated fault line, we show that in unaffected populations there is no correlation between consumption poverty and mental health. By contrast, among those nearest the fault, mental health improves by 0.12 standard deviations per log unit of consumption, while the relationship is a precise zero beyond 20 km. This gradient is robust to alternative distance thresholds, sample splits, and binary mental health measures, and is not mediated by acute household trauma. These results suggest that mass adversity can activate the poverty–mental health gradient, helping explain heterogeneity in the broader literature.

10.3386/w35060.abstractZh: 贫困与心理健康之间的关系在不同人群中差异显著，这种差异远远超出了单纯抽样变异所能预测的范围。我们将这种异质性视为实证研究的主要对象。通过研究2005年巴基斯坦大地震后四年收集的数据，我们发现未受影响的群体中没有消费贫困与心理健康之间的相关性。相比之下，在距离地震断层线最近的群体中，每增加一个对数单位的消费，心理健康状况会改善0.12个标准差，而在距离20公里以外的地方，这种关系则完全不存在。这种关系不受其他距离阈值、样本分割方式以及二元心理健康测量方法的影响，并且也不受急性家庭创伤的影响。这些结果表明，大规模逆境可以激活贫困与心理健康之间的关系，这有助于解释相关文献中的异质性现象。

abstract.text: In many low- and middle-income countries, consumers access education and health services in environments characterized by substantial provider choice. In these settings, a dense landscape of fee-charging private providers has emerged, often located near public facilities and competing for the same clientele. We refer to these environments as human capital markets. This chapter begins by documenting that such markets are now pervasive. We present empirical evidence that human capital markets share many features with conventional product markets: households choose among a wide range of public and private providers with heterogeneous attributes, and providers respond strategically to policy interventions and competitive pressures. We then assess the extent to which canonical models from industrial organization can account for observed behavior, highlighting both their insights and their limitations. Next, we examine the key ways in which human capital markets depart from standard product-market benchmarks—most notably that education and health are both consumption goods and investments, and that quality is often difficult to observe—and review empirical and conceptual approaches developed to address these features. We conclude by outlining the major unresolved questions and promising directions for future research.

10.3386/w35061.abstractZh: 在许多低收入和中等收入国家，消费者在具有丰富选择的环境中获得教育和医疗服务。在这种环境下，出现了大量的收费私人提供者，他们通常位于公共设施附近，并争夺相同的客户群体。我们将这些环境称为人力资本市场。本章首先指出，这类市场现在已经普遍存在。我们提供了实证证据，表明人力资本市场具有许多与传统产品市场相同的特征：家庭在众多具有不同属性的公共和私人提供者中进行选择，而提供者也会对政策干预和竞争压力作出战略反应。接着，我们评估了产业组织理论中的经典模型在解释观察到的行为方面的有效性，同时指出了它们的优点和局限性。随后，我们探讨了人力资本市场与传统产品市场标准之间的关键差异——最显著的是，教育和健康既是消费品也是投资品，而且质量往往难以衡量——并回顾了针对这些特征开发的实证和概念性研究方法。最后，我们总结了主要未解决的问题以及未来研究的方向。

abstract.text: The incidence of severe maternal morbidity (SMM) in the U.S. has been rising among mothers over time, with especially pronounced increases among Black mothers. In this paper, we examine why this might be happening. Previous literature takes a limited-scope approach by focusing on select variables as determinants of SMM. We take a broader approach and evaluate the contributions of a large set of variables over a long time span to let the data inform us what factors may be most influential in determining SMM. We use inpatient data from 1998-2019 to see how maternal, hospital, and county-level characteristics may be associated with both the rising trends and the racial disparity in SMM. Decomposition methods show that the observed characteristics explain very little of the overall variation of SMM, but account for a substantial share of the Black-White SMM gap. Medical and pregnancy-related comorbid conditions are the largest drivers of the observed variations. The associational findings indicate that focusing on patients with comorbid conditions and delving more deeply into the features of hospital environments may help researchers identify policy-relevant drivers of SMM and SMM disparities.

10.3386/w35062.abstractZh: 在美国，严重孕产妇发病率（SMM）在母亲群体中的发生率随时间呈上升趋势，尤其是黑人母亲的发病率增幅更为显著。本文旨在探讨这一现象发生的原因。以往的研究多采用有限范围的方法，仅关注某些变量作为SMM的决定因素。我们采用更为广泛的方法，评估大量变量的长期影响，以了解哪些因素可能对SMM的确定具有最大影响力。我们利用了1998至2019年的住院数据，研究母亲、医院和县级特征如何与SMM的上升趋势及种族差异相关联。分解方法显示，这些观察到的特征对SMM的整体变化解释度很低，但占到了黑人与白人之间SMM差距的很大一部分。医疗和妊娠相关的合并症是引起这些变异的最大驱动因素。研究结果表明，关注有合并症的患者，并更深入地研究医院环境的特点，有助于研究人员识别与SMM及其差异相关的政策驱动因素。

abstract.text: This study leverages exogenous variation from a secondary school stipend program for female students in rural Bangladesh to estimate the causal effect of maternal education on early childhood development. Using data from the 2019 Bangladesh Multiple Indicator Cluster Survey, we find that the five years of stipend eligibility increase mothers' schooling by about one year. Instrumental variable estimates show that an additional year of maternal education improves early childhood development scores by 0.5 points on a scale of 0-10, with gains in overall developmental readiness (7.5 percentage points) and in the literacy–numeracy (7.7 percentage points) and physical (1.9 percentage points) domains. The results are robust across specifications. We also estimate the effects of maternal education on potential mechanisms, including children's nutrition, home learning environment, parenting practices, and use of early childhood education and care. The findings show that improvements in maternal education increase weight-for-age Z-scores, reduce stunting, improve the probability of having toys from shops, and increase the likelihood of an adult household member playing with the child. The positive effects of maternal education on children's developmental outcomes imply the importance of investment in improving educational attainment, particularly for females in low- and middle-income countries.

10.3386/w35075.abstractZh: 本研究利用孟加拉国农村地区一项针对女学生的津贴计划中的外部变量，来估计母亲教育水平对幼儿发展的因果效应。通过2019年孟加拉国多指标集群调查的数据分析发现，五年的津贴资格使母亲的受教育年限增加约一年。工具变量估计结果显示，母亲多接受一年的教育会使幼儿的发育得分在0-10的评分中提高0.5分，其中整体发育准备度提高了7.5个百分点，识字与计算能力提高了7.7个百分点，身体发展能力提高了1.9个百分点。这些结果在不同模型设定下均具有稳定性。我们还研究了母亲教育水平对潜在机制的影响，包括儿童营养、家庭学习环境、育儿方式以及早期教育和保育的使用情况。研究发现，母亲教育水平的提高有助于提升儿童按年龄计算的体重指数，减少发育迟缓现象，增加儿童从商店购买玩具的可能性，并增加家中成年成员陪伴儿童玩耍的机会。母亲教育对儿童发展结果的积极影响表明，投资于提高教育水平的重要性，尤其是在低收入和中等收入国家，对女性而言尤为突出。

abstract.text: We examine the financial consequences of the 2007 California Fair Pricing Law, which places a price ceiling on hospital bills for financially vulnerable individuals. Using cross-sectional variation in exposure to the law, proxied by county-level uninsured rates, we estimate its impact on individual financial outcomes. We find that the law reduces the likelihood of incurring non-medical debt in collections and the number of non-medical accounts in collections. In addition, we find evidence that credit scores increased and suggestive evidence that the number of delinquent accounts decreased for individuals in more exposed counties. Our results suggest hospital billing regulations can improve targeted individuals’ financial outcomes.

10.3386/w35080.abstractZh: 我们研究了2007年加州公平定价法案的财务后果，该法案为经济困难的人群设定了医院账单的价格上限。通过以县级无保险率为指标来衡量法律实施后的差异，我们评估了该法案对个体财务结果的影响。研究发现，该法案降低了个人因债务催收而承担非医疗债务的可能性，以及处于催收中的非医疗账户数量。此外，我们还发现，在更易受到法律影响的县中，个人的信用评分有所提高，且逾期账户数量也有所减少。我们的结果表明，医院计费规定能够改善特定群体的财务状况。

abstract.text: We examine how annuities affect longevity using administrative payout data on approximately 600,000 Chilean retirees from 2004 to 2022. To address selection into annuitization, we exploit the fact that annuity sales vary with recent market returns, a pattern consistent with extrapolative beliefs. We find that the decision to annuitize—instrumented by recent market returns—substantially reduces mortality at five- and ten-year horizons. Further analyses indicate that annuities reduce mortality by shielding retirees from income volatility and investment-related stress. Complementary survey evidence suggests that annuitants invest more in health and report lower disability rates.

10.3386/w35082.abstractZh: 我们研究了年金如何影响寿命，使用了2004年至2022年间约60万智利退休人员的行政支付数据。为了分析选择年金的原因，我们注意到年金销售与近期市场表现相关，这一模式与人们的预期推断一致。我们发现，基于近期市场表现做出的年金选择，在五年和十年时间范围内显著降低了死亡率。进一步分析表明，年金通过保护退休人员免受收入波动和投资相关压力的影响，从而降低了死亡率。补充的调查证据表明，领取年金的退休人员在健康方面的投资更多，且残疾率更低。

abstract.text: We investigate how the gender mix of expert teams affects performance in a high-stakes setting: childbirth. Using data on 2.5 million births, we exploit the quasi-exogenous assignment of patients to two-member obstetrician teams (Lead–Assisting), and find that: (i) female-only teams achieve the best maternal outcomes, whereas male-only teams have the worst; and (ii) female-led mixed-gender teams perform worse than male-led ones. Specifically, severe maternal complications are 15.8% higher in male-only teams and 7.1-10.8% higher in mixed-gender teams compared to female-only teams. These patterns cannot be explained by patient risk, endogenous team formation, or physician preferences for discretionary practices like C-sections. Instead, gender mix directly affects team decisions and performance, likely through gender norms — a mechanism supported by two findings. First, gender mix affects how closely team decisions reflect member preferences, with female-only teams being especially skilled at this process, possibly due to more collaborative decision-making. Second, gender mix affects team resilience, with female-led mixed gender teams performing especially poorly under challenging conditions (e.g., limited team familiarity), possibly because female leaders invert traditional gender norms. We also document other notable patterns: female-only teams not only achieve the lowest complication rates for Black women, but are also the only team type to have no racial disparity in maternal outcomes. Overall, this study provides new insights into gender dynamics in expert teams, informing managerial efforts to support effective collaboration in increasingly diverse workplaces.

10.3386/w35084.abstractZh: 我们研究了专家团队的性别混合如何影响高风险环境下的表现，例如分娩。通过利用250万例分娩的数据，我们发现： (i) 仅由女性组成的团队能够实现最佳的母婴结果，而仅由男性组成的团队则表现最差； (ii) 由女性领导的混合性别团队的表现不如由男性领导的团队。具体而言，与仅由女性组成的团队相比，仅由男性组成的团队出现严重的母婴并发症的概率高出15.8%，而混合性别团队则高出7.1-10.8%。这些现象无法用患者风险、团队形成的内生性或医生对如剖腹产等自由裁量行为的偏好来解释。相反，性别混合直接影响了团队的决策和表现，这可能是由于性别规范的作用——这一机制得到了两项研究的支持。首先，性别混合影响了团队决策如何反映成员偏好，仅由女性组成的团队在这方面尤为擅长，这可能是由于她们更倾向于协作决策。其次，性别混合影响了团队的韧性，由女性领导的混合性别团队在面临挑战性条件时表现尤为不佳，这可能是因为女性领导者打破了传统的性别规范。我们还发现了其他值得注意的现象：仅由女性组成的团队不仅为黑人女性提供了最低的并发症率，而且也是唯一一种在母婴结果上没有种族差异的团队类型。总体而言，这项研究为专家团队中的性别动态提供了新的见解，有助于管理者在日益多元化的工作场所中支持有效的协作。

abstract.text: Incomplete performance metrics distort incentives. Exploiting the staggered roll-out of China’s national air monitoring network, we document a pollutant substitution effect: PM₂.₅ fell significantly, yet O₃ surged. We trace this to strategic behavior: facing binding PM₂.₅ targets, local governments prioritized abatement of particulate precursors while neglecting ozone precursors. Critically, this was not a benign trade-off. Although the policy reduced PM₂.₅-attributed deaths, the policy-induced O₃ surge increased O₃-attributed mortality and reduced biodiversity (measured by bird abundance). Conservative estimates suggest these costs reduced the policy’s net benefits by approximately 23.8%. Our findings highlight the hidden social costs of narrow performance targeting.

10.3386/w35087.abstractZh: 不完整的绩效指标会扭曲激励机制。通过利用中国国家空气质量监测网络的逐步实施，我们发现了一个污染物替代效应：PM₂.₅显著下降，而O₃却急剧上升。我们将其归因于策略性行为：面对强制性的PM₂.₅目标，地方政府优先削减颗粒物前体物的排放，而忽视了臭氧前体物的治理。关键的是，这种权衡并非简单的利弊取舍。尽管该政策减少了因PM₂.₅导致的死亡人数，但政策引发的O₃浓度上升却增加了因O₃导致的死亡人数，并降低了生物多样性（以鸟类数量衡量）。保守估计表明，这些成本使该政策的净效益减少了约23.8%。我们的研究结果凸显了狭隘绩效目标设定的隐性社会成本。

abstract.text: In 2018, the Virginia Department of Health implemented the Contraceptive Access Initiative (CAI) to increase access to long-acting reversible contraceptives (LARCs). We use encounter-level data on contraceptive choice in participating CAI clinics and county-level natality data from 2014--2021 to estimate relative changes in LARC take-up and childbearing rates before and after the CAI. Difference-in-differences estimates indicate that the CAI reduced birth rates in participating counties by approximately 3 percent, or less than half of the effect size of other similar, state-level programs. We show that this smaller effect is likely due to existing high LARC take-up and contraceptive substitution.

10.3386/w35108.abstractZh: 2018年，弗吉尼亚州卫生部实施了“避孕获取计划”（CAI），旨在提高长效可逆避孕措施的使用率。我们利用参与该计划的诊所的避孕选择数据，以及2014至2021年的县级人口数据，来估算在CAI实施前后长效避孕措施的使用率和生育率的变化。差异估计结果显示，CAI使参与县的出生率降低了约3%，这一效果不到其他类似州级项目的效果的一半。我们认为，这种较小的效果可能是由于当地已经存在较高的长效避孕措施使用率以及避孕替代行为所致。

abstract.text: With large gains in life expectancy, the population share of disability due to cognitive decline and dementia has substantially increased. Many older adults in the United States leave the workforce well before age 65. Correlational evidence suggests that leaving the workforce before retirement age could accelerate the pace of cognitive decline. We offer causal evidence, using HRS data for the United States, exploiting plausibly exogenous shifts in labor demand in local labor markets as a Bartik instrument for employment variation across these markets. We find substantial declines over time in cognitive scores stemming from negative labor demand shocks. These findings are concentrated among men aged 51 to 64, whose employment decisions and outcomes may be more sensitive to local labor market conditions than are these decisions or outcomes for women or for older men. Our evidence extends past work focusing narrowly on the retirement age window and provides further support to the notion that working to older ages may delay age-related cognitive decline.

10.3386/w35117.abstractZh: 随着预期寿命的大幅提高，因认知衰退和痴呆症导致的残疾人口比例也显著上升。在美国，许多老年人早在65岁之前就离开了工作岗位。相关研究表明，在退休年龄之前离开工作岗位可能会加速认知衰退的进程。我们利用美国的HRS数据，通过利用当地劳动力市场劳动力需求的合理外生变化作为就业变化的工具，提供了因果证据。我们发现，由于劳动力需求的负面冲击，认知评分随时间显著下降。这些发现主要集中在51至64岁的男性中，他们的就业决策和结果可能比女性或年长男性更受当地劳动力市场状况的影响。我们的研究结果超越了以往仅关注退休年龄窗口的研究，进一步支持了在更晚的年龄继续工作可能会延缓与年龄相关的认知衰退的观点。

abstract.text: Rapid growth of wind energy plays a key role in global efforts to reduce carbon emissions, yet public concerns persist about its potential health effects, particularly through noise exposure. While some studies and media reports suggest that wind turbines may contribute to sleep disturbances, anxiety, and even suicide, existing evidence remains limited and inconclusive. This study combines geolocated data on turbines from the U.S. Wind Turbine Database with longitudinal survey data on over 120,000 households (2011–2023) and consumer purchasing records to assess whether proximity to wind turbines affects mental and physical health. We examine a wide range of outcomes, including depression, anxiety, sleep disorders, headaches, and use of sleep aids and painkillers. Comparing households before and after nearby turbine installations, we find no detectable adverse health effects from turbine exposure at typical exposure distances. While we cannot rule out small effects, our confidence intervals exclude moderate-to-large impacts, suggesting that fears about substantial health impacts are not borne out in population-level data. Other disamenities such as noise, shadow flicker, and visual intrusion may still affect quality of life even absent measurable health impacts.

10.3386/w35131.abstractZh: 风能的快速增长在全球减少碳排放的努力中发挥着关键作用，但公众对风能可能带来的健康影响仍持担忧态度，尤其是噪音暴露问题。虽然一些研究和媒体报道指出，风力涡轮机可能导致睡眠障碍、焦虑甚至自杀，但现有证据仍然有限且结论不一。本研究结合了美国风力涡轮机数据库中的涡轮机位置数据，以及2011至2023年间超过12万户家庭的纵向调查数据和消费者购买记录，以评估靠近风力涡轮机是否会影响心理健康和身体健康。我们考察了包括抑郁、焦虑、睡眠障碍、头痛以及使用睡眠辅助药物和止痛药等一系列结果。通过比较涡轮机安装前后家庭的状况，我们发现在典型的暴露距离下，涡轮机暴露并未导致明显的健康不良影响。虽然我们无法排除小范围的影响，但我们的置信区间排除了中等到大规模的影响，这表明在人群层面的数据中，关于重大健康影响的担忧并未得到证实。其他不利影响，如噪音、阴影闪烁和视觉干扰，即使没有可测量的健康影响，也可能影响生活质量。

abstract.text: Schools across the U.S. have sharply restricted student use of phones during the school day. We evaluate one type of restriction—lockable phone pouches—using nationwide data combining a large-scale teacher survey, GPS pings, standardized test scores, and school administrative records, along with sales records from the largest pouch provider. Using a staggered difference-in-differences design, we find that pouch adoption substantially reduces phone use as measured by GPS pings and teacher reports. In the first year after adoption, disciplinary incidents increase, and we find suggestive evidence that student subjective well-being falls, consistent with short-term disruption. However, disciplinary effects fade, while the estimated effects on well-being appear to recover and become positive in later years. For academic achievement, average effects on test scores are consistently close to zero. High schools see modest positive effects, particularly in math, while middle schools see small negative effects. We find little evidence of effects on school attendance and no clear evidence of improvements in self-reported classroom attention or perceived online bullying.

10.3386/w35132.abstractZh: 美国各地的学校都严格限制了学生在上课期间使用手机。我们评估了一种限制措施——可锁定的手机袋，通过结合大规模教师调查、GPS定位数据、标准化测试成绩以及学校行政记录，再加上最大规模手机袋供应商的销售数据，对这一现象进行了研究。采用分阶段差异设计，我们发现手机袋的使用显著减少了通过GPS定位和教师报告所测量的手机使用行为。在手机袋引入后的第一年，纪律问题有所增加，并且有证据表明学生的主观幸福感下降，这与短期内的干扰是一致的。然而，这些纪律问题的影响逐渐减弱，而对学生幸福感的影响则似乎在后续年份中恢复并变得积极。在学术成绩方面，对测试成绩的平均影响几乎为零。高中在数学成绩上看到了适度的积极影响，而初中则出现了轻微的负面影响。我们发现，手机袋对出勤率的影响很小，也没有明确的证据表明学生的课堂注意力或在线欺凌感知有所改善。

abstract.text: Medicaid is one of the largest public programs in the United States — providing health insurance to over 75 million low-income Americans — and over three quarters of its enrollees receive care via private “managed care” insurers. In this summary article, we make three central points about the economics of contracting out Medicaid to private insurers. First, the empirical evidence on Medicaid privatization is mixed: contracting out has not meaningfully reduced public costs or improved quality of care. Second, we propose a framework, which we call “procured competition,” to describe the unique structure of Medicaid managed care as a hybrid of public procurement and regulated competition. Third, we discuss the key policy levers across procurement, competition, and consumer choice in this model. Throughout, we highlight open research questions, arguing that the enormous variation in how states design these programs — combined with limited evidence on what works — represents a promising area for high-impact scholarship.

10.3386/w35146.abstractZh: 医疗补助是美国最大的公共项目之一，为超过7500万低收入美国人提供健康保险。超过四分之三的参保者通过私人“管理式护理”保险公司获得医疗服务。在这篇总结文章中，我们提出了关于将医疗补助外包给私人保险公司的三个核心观点。首先，关于医疗补助私有化的实证证据并不一致：外包并没有显著降低公共成本或提高护理质量。其次，我们提出了一种称为“采购竞争”的框架，来描述医疗补助管理式护理的独特结构，这是一种公共采购与监管竞争的结合体。第三，我们讨论了这一模型中涉及采购、竞争和消费者选择的关键政策因素。在整个文章中，我们强调了开放的研究问题，认为各州在设计这些项目时的巨大差异，加上关于有效方法的有限证据，为具有高影响力的学术研究提供了一个有前景的领域。

abstract.text: I study hiring under uncertainty when firms can either hold permanent labor as a buffer or hire from a spot market after demand is realized. I build a model where the spot market is endogenously determined such that when one firm relies more on spot labor, it thickens the market that other firms use as well. Individual firms do not internalize that contribution, so the competitive equilibrium involves too much buffering. I evaluate the model in the market for registered nurses using the universe of daily time sheet records from skilled nursing facilities. The data support the model’s general equilibrium predictions. Markets with thicker agency markets have less rationing conditional on total nursing hours, and compressed upper tails of permanent staffing with higher overall hours in the lower part of the distribution. Estimating a facility-level newsvendor model with heterogeneous spot market frictions and rationing costs I find that the nursing labor market was more efficient post-COVID, there are substantial welfare gains from bringing frictions down to those of the most efficient markets, and that the marginal external benefit for a firm that participates in the spot market instead of hiring an employee as buffer averages 12 percent of wages. This labor market underprovides flexibility because the value of availability is not fully priced.

10.3386/w35148.abstractZh: 我研究了在不确定性下的招聘问题，即企业可以选择保留永久员工作为缓冲，或者在需求确定后从现货市场招聘。我构建了一个模型，其中现货市场是由内生因素决定的，即当一家企业更依赖现货劳动力时，其他企业使用的市场也会变得更加拥挤。单个企业并不考虑这种贡献，因此竞争均衡会导致过多的缓冲库存。我使用注册护士市场的日常时间记录数据来评估该模型，这些数据支持了模型的一般均衡预测。在代理市场更拥挤的市场中，总护理小时数的分配更为宽松，永久员工的上限被压缩，而分布较低部分的整体小时数则更高。通过估计一个包含异质现货市场摩擦和分配成本的设施级报童模型，我发现后疫情时代的护理劳动力市场更为高效，将摩擦降低到最高效市场的水平可以带来显著的福利收益，而且企业参与现货市场而非雇佣员工作为缓冲的边际外部收益平均为工资的12%。这个劳动力市场提供的灵活性不足，因为可用性的价值并未得到充分定价。

abstract.text: Cadaveric organ shortages leave thousands without life-saving transplants each year. Countries differ in using opt-in (informed consent) or opt-out (presumed consent) systems for donor registration. Using newly assembled cross-country panel data and an event-study design, this paper provides evidence that presumed-consent laws increase organ donation only when strictly enforced and family veto power is limited; weak opt-out regimes show negligible or even negative effects. A theoretical signaling model provides a plausible mechanism when opt-in or opt-out yields more donations, emphasizing the roles of donation propensity, signaling costs, and the family’s ability to overturn defaults. A large laboratory experiment further tests these mechanisms, showing that opt-in generally produces equal or higher donation rates unless signaling is costly and family veto power is minimal. The results underscore that defaults alone rarely increase donations unless paired with strong institutional enforcement.

10.3386/w35169.abstractZh: 每年，尸体器官短缺导致数千人无法获得救命的移植手术。不同国家在捐赠者登记方面采用不同的制度，有的采用知情同意制，有的则采用默认同意制。本文利用新收集的国家间面板数据以及事件研究设计，发现只有当默认同意制度严格执行且家庭否决权受到限制时，该制度才会增加器官捐赠数量；而较弱的默认同意制度则几乎没有或甚至会产生负面影响。理论信号模型为这一现象提供了合理的解释，表明在知情同意制或默认同意制下，除非信号传递成本高昂且家庭否决权极低，否则通常不会导致捐赠数量的增加。实验结果强调，仅靠默认同意制度很少能增加捐赠数量，除非配合强有力的制度执行。

abstract.text: We examine how Medicare affects health care utilization for those who age in with a more narrow health insurance network by studying veterans enrolled in the Veterans Health Administration (VA). Given the limited geographic density of VA hospitals, we posit that Medicare expands the insurance network for VA enrollees. Using regression discontinuity methods, we find that veterans' inpatient hospitalization rate increases by approximately 3.3 percent at 65. Further, there are large reallocations across health insurance payers. Individuals increasingly use Medicare for hospitalizations once it becomes available, while VA, commercial, and other federal insurance programs are used less. We also find substantial reallocations among individuals that gain access to hospitals closer to their homes and among those who visit the hospital for more postponeable medical procedures. However, we do not find evidence that the average quality rating of the hospital selected at 65 changes nor do we find evidence that VA hospital wait times affect the move to Medicare; rather, individuals choose hospitals that are relatively closer. Lastly, our results suggest that Medicare may compete with other federal programs to provide health care for select populations, such as veterans.

10.3386/w35173.abstractZh: 我们研究了医疗保险如何影响那些在较窄的保险网络内生活的老年人的医疗保健利用情况，研究对象是参加退伍军人健康管理局服务的退伍军人。鉴于退伍军人健康管理局医院的地理分布较为有限，我们认为医疗保险会扩大该机构参保者的保险网络。通过回归 discontinuity 方法分析发现，65 岁的退伍军人住院率增加了约 3.3%。此外，保险支付方之间的分配出现了较大变化：一旦医疗保险可用，人们更倾向于使用它进行住院治疗，而退伍军人健康管理局、商业保险以及其他联邦保险项目的使用频率则较低。我们还发现，那些能够更方便地获得医院服务的个体，以及那些选择进行较迟进行的医疗程序的个体，其保险支付方式的分配也发生了显著变化。然而，我们没有发现 65 岁时所选医院的平均质量评分发生变化，也没有发现退伍军人健康管理局医院的等待时间会影响人们转向医疗保险的选择；相反，人们更倾向于选择距离自己家较近的医院。最后，我们的研究结果表明，医疗保险可能会与其他联邦项目竞争，为特定人群提供医疗保健服务，比如退伍军人。

abstract.text: This paper examines the causal effects of school smartphone bans on the mental health of youth in the US. Many states have rushed to adopt school bans on smartphones with limited evidence on how these bans impact students. To provide causal evidence of the effects of these bans, I rely on synthetic difference-in-differences models and data from the National Survey of Children’s Health (NSCH) from 2016 to 2025. These data are collected in every state and include about 11,500 children aged 14 to 17 annually. In the fall of 2025 21 states enforced a school phone ban. These bans are either bell-to-bell or instructional-time-only. Because there is limited post-period data the results are preliminary evidence only. The effects of bans on screen time outside of school indicate that there is no substitution of lost screen time during school hours to after school hours. These early results provide no evidence that the school ban policy improved student mental health. Future studies with additional years of data are needed to increase power and to estimate the longer-term effects of school bans on youth mental health.

10.3386/w35181.abstractZh: 本文探讨了学校禁止学生使用智能手机对美国青少年心理健康的影响。许多州迅速实施了学校智能手机禁令，但关于这些禁令对学生的影响，现有证据有限。为了提供这些禁令影响的因果证据，我采用了合成差异-差异模型，并参考了2016年至2025年的《全国儿童健康调查》数据。这些数据在每个州都有收集，每年涉及约11,500名14至17岁的儿童。截至2025年秋季，有21个州实施了学校手机禁令，这些禁令要么在整个学校期间禁止，要么仅限教学时间。由于后期数据有限，这些结果仅属于初步证据。禁令对校外屏幕使用时间的影响表明，学生在学校时间内的屏幕使用时间并未被替代。这些初步结果并未表明学校禁令政策改善了学生的心理健康。未来需要更多年份的数据来增强研究效力，并评估学校禁令对青少年心理健康长期影响。

abstract.text: California’s Senate Bill 328 is the first statewide mandate on school start times. Using difference-in-differences designs across four data sources, we find that the mandate increased the share of students sleeping at least 8 hours by 13%; mental health effects point toward improvement but are imprecise. High schools in counties with earlier pre-policy start times gained 1.7–1.8 percentage points in the share meeting state standards in math, English, and science, largest among Hispanic students. Suggestive evidence shows adolescents’ sports participation fell and shifted later; parents arrived at work later and were more likely to be at work after 4 p.m.

10.3386/w35184.abstractZh: 加利福尼亚州的参议院法案328是首个针对学校开始时间的地方性法规。通过结合四个数据来源的差异比较分析，我们发现该法规使学生至少睡眠8小时的比例增加了13%；心理健康方面的效果表明有所改善，但数据并不精确。在政策实施前开始时间较早的县，高中学生在数学、英语和科学方面的达标率提高了1.7至1.8个百分点，其中西班牙裔学生的提升幅度最大。有迹象表明，青少年的体育参与减少了，活动时间也推迟了；家长的上班时间也推迟了，下午4点之后工作的可能性也增加了。

abstract.text: Large Language Models (LLMs) are trained on a prodigious corpus of human writing and may reveal human preferences over characteristics of life courses, such as income, longevity, and working conditions. We present OpenAI's GPT-5.4 and a broadly representative sample of Americans with pairs of life stories and ask them to choose the life they would prefer for themselves. A person's choice is better predicted by the LLM's choice than by another person’s choice over the same stories, and LLM valuations of several life attributes are similar to those derived from human responses. Our results suggest that LLM responses offer a scalable and cost-effective complement to existing methods for studying human preferences.

10.3386/w35185.abstractZh: 大型语言模型（LLM）是在庞大的人类写作语料库上训练的，它们能够揭示人类对于生活特征的偏好，例如收入、寿命和工作条件等。我们介绍了OpenAI的GPT-5.4模型，并选取了具有代表性的一对美国人的生活故事样本，让这些模型为他们自己选择一种理想的生活状态。与另一个人对相同故事的选择相比，LLM的选择更能准确预测一个人的选择。此外，LLM对多个生活特征的评估结果与人类的反应相似。我们的研究结果表明，LLM的回答为研究人类偏好提供了一种可扩展且成本效益高的方法。

abstract.text: Adjustment frictions can cause the long-run effects of social insurance reforms to differ from their short-run effects. Using pre-committed extensions of event study specifications applied previously for short-run analyses, we test the hypothesis that the Affordable Care Act’s (ACA) impacts on insurance coverage and employment would increase following the substantial churn generated by the COVID-19 pandemic. Contrary to the hypothesis, the ACA’s impacts remained stable through the pandemic. Long-run effects on employment and employer coverage were modest and much smaller than initially projected. Our study illustrates how partially pre-committed designs can yield informative long-run estimates while limiting specification search.

10.3386/w35190.abstractZh: 调整摩擦可能导致社会保险改革的长期效应与短期效应存在差异。我们利用先前用于短期分析的预先承诺扩展事件研究模型，检验了《平价医疗法案》对保险覆盖率和就业的影响在COVID-19大流行导致的人员大规模流动后是否会增强的假设。与假设相反，该法案对保险覆盖率和就业的影响在疫情期间保持稳定。对就业和雇主保险覆盖率的长期影响较为温和，远小于最初的预测。我们的研究表明，部分预先承诺的设计可以在限制模型选择的同时，提供有洞察力的长期估计结果。

abstract.text: This paper uses Medicaid claims data from 2017-2021 to measure racial/ethnic disparities in mid-life mortality rates among low-income adults with disabilities receiving Supplemental Security Income (SSI). We find that American Indian and Alaska Native and White SSI recipients have the highest age-adjusted mid-life mortality rates (2.85% and 2.48%, respectively), followed by Black and Hispanic recipients (2.18% and 1.82%), and then Asian recipients (1.53%). We also find differences in diagnosed chronic conditions, “despair-related” conditions, substance use disorders, and disabling conditions by race/ethnicity. Controlling for these differences attenuates the White-Hispanic, White-Asian, and AIAN-White mortality gaps; however, differences in clinical diagnoses by race do not diminish the White-Black mortality gap. Our results show that within a socioeconomically vulnerable population, Black adults have lower mid-life mortality rates than Whites.

10.3386/w35193.abstractZh: 本文利用2017至2021年的Medicaid索赔数据，测量了低收入残疾成年人中，不同种族/族裔群体在中年死亡率上的差异。研究发现，美洲原住民、阿拉斯加原住民和白人SSI领取者中年死亡率最高，分别为2.85%和2.48%；黑人及西班牙裔领取者的中年死亡率分别为2.18%和1.82%；亚洲领取者的中年死亡率则为1.53%。此外，不同种族/族裔在慢性疾病的诊断、与绝望相关的状况、物质使用障碍以及致残状况方面也存在差异。控制这些差异后，白人与西班牙裔、白人与亚洲人以及美洲原住民与白人的死亡率差距有所缩小；然而，不同种族的临床诊断差异并未缩小白人与黑人的死亡率差距。研究结果表明，在 socioeconomically脆弱的人群中，黑人的中年死亡率低于白人。

abstract.text: In this article, we exploit the recent, rapid diffusion of the use of GLP-1 drugs among individuals with diabetes to measure the effect of the use of these drugs on mental health, self-rated health, employment, and marriage. The documented large weight loss from GLP-1 use may plausibly affect these outcomes and evidence of these broader impacts of GLP-1 use is necessary to evaluate their full value. Estimates are obtained using a longitudinal (within-person) regression approach. Results indicate that GLP-1 use is not meaningfully associated with mental health, self-rated health, employment, and marriage. Overall, our analysis adds new evidence about how GLP-1 use is affecting the lives of individuals with diabetes.

10.3386/w35198.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们利用了糖尿病患者中GLP-1药物使用的迅速普及现象，来研究这些药物对心理健康、自我健康评估、就业和婚姻状况的影响。有记录显示，使用GLP-1会导致显著的体重减轻，这可能会对这些结果产生影响。为了全面评估GLP-1使用的这些更广泛影响，有必要进一步研究这些证据。研究采用了纵向（个体内）回归分析方法。结果表明，使用GLP-1与心理健康、自我健康评估、就业和婚姻状况之间没有显著关联。总体而言，我们的分析为了解GLP-1使用对糖尿病患者生活的影响提供了新的证据。

abstract.text: Whether medical innovation affects racial health disparities remains an open question. We explore the effect of surfactant replacement therapy (SRT), a breakthrough treatment for premature infants with respiratory disorders, on the Black-White neonatal mortality gap. Using non-respiratory mortality as a counterfactual outcome, we find that both Blacks and Whites benefited from the introduction of SRT in 1989, but White neonates experienced larger reductions in mortality. By 1993, SRT had reduced respiratory-related mortality among White neonates by 46 percent, compared to 30 percent for Black neonates. Neither socioeconomic status nor distance to the nearest neonatal intensive care unit explain these results.

10.3386/w35210.abstractZh: 医学创新是否会影响种族健康差异仍是一个未解之谜。我们探讨了表面活性物质替代疗法对早产儿呼吸障碍的影响，该疗法是治疗这一问题的突破性方法。以非呼吸性死亡作为反事实结果，我们发现1989年表面活性物质替代疗法的引入对黑人和白人新生儿都产生了积极影响，但白人新生儿的死亡率下降幅度更大。到1993年，表面活性物质替代疗法使白人新生儿的呼吸相关死亡率降低了46%，而黑人新生儿则降低了30%。无论是社会经济地位还是距离最近的新生儿重症监护病房的距离，都无法解释这些结果。

abstract.text: This paper measures and analyzes management practices in the Kenyan health care sector, drawing on a nationally representative survey and linked administrative data. The paper adapts the World Management Survey to measure management quality in primary health care facilities and hospitals, surveying 429 primary health care facilities and 73 hospitals. Primary health care facilities are the primary point of contact for most patients, providing treatment for common infectious diseases and chronic conditions, as well as services related to maternal and child health. Management quality is low on average, and the distribution is highly compressed. The analysis uses administrative data to test the association between the management quality and performance of primary health care facilities, measured by outpatient attendance, during a period of disruption that included the COVID-19 pandemic and a public health workers’ strike. Overall attendance fell during this period. Private facilities experienced a smaller decline than public facilities, consistent with substitution during the strike. Within the private sector, better-managed facilities showed greater resilience, driven primarily by operations management. These results underscore the role of management quality in strengthening facility-level resilience and the complementarity of public and private sectors in absorbing healthcare shocks.

10.3386/w35223.abstractZh: 本文通过一项具有全国代表性的调查及相关的行政数据，对肯尼亚医疗保健领域的管理实践进行了测量与分析。研究采用了世界管理调查的方法来衡量初级医疗保健设施和医院的治理质量，共调查了429个初级医疗保健设施和73家医院。初级医疗保健设施是大多数患者的主要接触点，提供常见传染病和慢性疾病的治疗，以及与母婴健康相关的服务。治理质量整体水平较低，且分布极为集中。分析利用行政数据来检验治理质量与初级医疗保健设施绩效之间的关系，绩效指标包括门诊就诊量。在包括COVID-19大流行和公共卫生工作者罢工在内的动荡时期，整体就诊量有所下降。私营机构的下降幅度小于公共机构，这与罢工期间私营机构的替代效应一致。在私营部门内部，管理较好的机构表现出更强的韧性，这主要得益于运营管理的提升。这些结果强调了治理质量在增强机构韧性方面的作用，以及公共部门和私营部门在应对医疗冲击时的互补性。

abstract.text: In 2024, medical spending as a share of GDP was 15% below forecasts made in 2010 and only marginally higher than in 2010. Relative to expectations, the savings were nearly $1 trillion in 2024. In light of this prolonged period of slower growth, we ask the question: has the United States bent the health care cost curve? We start with a model of medical spending that incorporates both the development of new technologies and the equilibrium use of those technologies. Technology development and incentives around its use may add to or subtract from spending growth. We then examine the drivers of the spending slowdown empirically. We attribute slower medical spending growth to five factors: the development of technologies that simultaneously improve health and lower cost; long-run supply elasticities that exceed short-run elasticities; improvements in population health; reimbursement changes that reduce demand and make demand more price elastic; and reductions in the rate of price increases, likely driven by some of these same demand factors. Because these cost slowing mechanisms are expanding over time, we conclude that the United States has bent the health care cost curve, though not as much as it could be or will need to be bent.

10.3386/w35231.abstractZh: 在2024年，医疗支出占GDP的比例比2010年的预测低15%，仅略高于2010年的水平。与预期相比，2024年的节省金额接近1万亿美元。鉴于这一持续较慢的增长趋势，我们不禁要问：美国是否已经使医疗保健成本曲线发生了弯曲？我们从一个包含新技术发展及其均衡应用的医疗支出模型出发。技术发展的进展及其应用方面的激励措施可能会增加或减少支出增长。随后，我们通过实证分析探讨了支出放缓的驱动因素。我们认为，医疗支出增长放缓的原因包括五个因素：同时改善健康状况且成本降低的技术发展；长期供给弹性高于短期弹性；人口健康状况的改善；报销政策的改变导致需求减少并使需求对价格更加敏感；以及价格上涨率的降低，这很可能是由同样的驱动因素所推动的。由于这些降低成本的机制随着时间的推移而不断扩展，我们得出结论：美国确实使医疗保健成本曲线发生了弯曲，但弯曲的程度并没有达到可能或实际需要的程度。

abstract.text: One way to measure the efficiency of the Affordable Care Act (ACA) is the extent to which gains in publicly supported health insurance reduced uninsured rates. Using data from the 2008–2024 American Community Survey, we examine time trends in rates of uninsured, public insurance coverage, and employer-sponsored insurance (ESI) by groups defined by the ratio of income to the Federal Poverty Line (FPL). We obtain estimates of associations between changes in public coverage and changes in uninsured and ESI exploiting state-by-year variation in ACA implementation. Importantly, we estimate the total effect of the ACA—including both the Medicaid expansion and Marketplace coverage—on uninsured and ESI rates. For adults in households below 150% of the federal poverty level (FPL), increases in public insurance coverage were associated with one-for-one decrease in uninsured and no change in ESI. For adults with incomes between 151%–400% FPL, each percentage point increase in public coverage was associated with about a 0.6 percentage point decrease in uninsured and a 0.4 decrease, or crowd out, in ESI. Crowd-out was larger among groups with higher pre-ACA ESI rates such as parents and married adults. Using variation from the Medicaid expansion alone to evaluate the ACA’s effect on ESI leads to overstating crowd-out among low-income adults (below 150% FPL) and understating crowd-out among higher-income adults (above 250% FPL). Our findings suggest that policies intended to subsidize health insurance of higher income groups, for example, the enhanced premium subsidies, are far less efficient than policies intended to further expand public insurance to low-income groups, for example, in non-expansion states.

10.3386/w35263.abstractZh: 衡量《平价医疗法案》效率的一种方法是，公共支持的医疗保险带来的收益在多大程度上降低了无保险人口的比例。我们利用2008-2024年美国社区调查的数据，按收入与联邦贫困线的比例划分的群体，研究了无保险人口比例、公共保险覆盖率和雇主赞助保险的变化趋势。通过利用各州实施《平价医疗法案》的时间差异，我们得出了公共保险覆盖变化与无保险人口和雇主赞助保险变化之间的关联。重要的是，我们估算了《平价医疗法案》的总体影响——包括医疗补助扩展和市场保险覆盖——对无保险人口和雇主赞助保险率的影响。对于家庭收入低于联邦贫困线150%的成年人，公共保险覆盖率的提高与无保险人口的相应减少以及雇主赞助保险率的不变有关。对于收入在151%-400%联邦贫困线之间的成年人，公共保险覆盖率每提高一个百分点，无保险人口率大约会下降0.6个百分点，雇主赞助保险率则会下降0.4个百分点，甚至出现被挤出市场的情况。在被《平价医疗法案》影响较大的群体，如父母和已婚成年人中，这种被挤出市场的情况更为明显。仅通过医疗补助扩展的变化来评估《平价医疗法案》对雇主赞助保险的影响，会导致高估低收入成年人（收入低于150%联邦贫困线）被挤出的情况，而低估了高收入成年人（收入高于250%联邦贫困线）被挤出的情况。我们的研究结果表明，旨在为高收入群体提供医疗保险补贴的政策，例如增强型保费补贴，其效率远低于旨在进一步扩展公共保险到低收入群体的政策，例如在未实施扩展政策的州。

abstract.text: At the COVID-19 pandemic's onset, the federal government enacted substantial changes impacting both the revenues and expenditures connected to states' Medicaid programs through a pair of provisions in the March 2020 Families First Coronavirus Response Act. These included a 6.2 percentage point increase in states' Federal Medical Assistance Percentages (FMAP), which raised states' revenues, contingent on adherence to a continuous coverage requirement. The latter provision raised expenditures by preventing the disenrollment of individuals whose eligibility would otherwise have lapsed due to changes in income or other eligibility-relevant circumstances. While these provisions were ex-ante expected to result in expenditures and costs of similar magnitudes, the ex-post realizations remain unquantified. Nationwide, we estimate that states’ share of the continuous coverage provision's costs was $139.2 billion, which is roughly $11.0 billion less than the revenues states received, in aggregate, through increased FMAPs. Revenues and costs varied substantially across states, however, with costs exceeding revenues by as much as $594 per capita, and revenues exceeding costs by as much as $838 per capita. The baseline parameters governing the federal government's share of states' Medicaid expenditures emerge as a key driver of the extent to which the continuous coverage requirement can be viewed as an unfunded federal mandate.

10.3386/w35268.abstractZh: 在COVID-19疫情爆发时，联邦政府通过2020年3月的《家庭优先冠状病毒应对法案》中的两项条款，对与各州医疗补助计划相关的收入和支出进行了重大调整。这些条款包括将各州的联邦医疗援助比例提高6.2个百分点，从而增加了各州的收入，但前提是各州必须遵守持续覆盖的要求。后一项条款通过防止因收入变化或其他相关情况导致资格失效的参保人员退出计划，从而增加了支出。虽然这些条款在事前预计会导致类似的支出和成本，但事后的实际结果尚未量化。全国范围内，我们估计各州在持续覆盖条款下的支出为1392亿美元，这比各州通过增加的联邦医疗援助比例获得的收入少了约110亿美元。然而，各州的收入和支出差异很大，有些州的成本超过收入达每人594美元，而有些州的收入超过成本达每人838美元。联邦政府在各州医疗补助支出中的份额，成为决定持续覆盖要求能否被视为未资助的联邦强制规定的重要因素。

abstract.text: How harmful is stigma in the “real world”? Answers are elusive because stigma is difficult to measure in observational data, and isolating its effects requires exogenous variation in stigma without variation in the stigmatized trait. This study addresses these challenges by focusing on a widespread form of stigma — weight stigma — in the high-stakes setting of inpatient healthcare. BMI categories are displayed prominently to providers in electronic medical records, and obesity is heavily stigmatized socially. Thus, at the "obese" cutoff, stigma may shift discretely while the underlying trait (BMI) does not. Using a regression discontinuity design that exploits this institutional feature, I find a discontinuous increase in in-hospital mortality at this cutoff, though patient health does not change. Two patterns suggest stigma-based discrimination as the mechanism. First, just-obese patients receive less diagnostic effort than almost-obese patients. Second, a physician-validated LLM identifies at the cutoff a rise in stigmatizing language in clinical notes — specifically, language that imposes moral judgment, undermines patient credibility, and stereotypes patients — among the most stigmatizing providers, who also drive the mortality result. Overall, these results suggest that stigma is a powerful social force with potentially life-or-death consequences.

10.3386/w35277.abstractZh: “现实世界”中的污名有多大的危害？这个问题的答案难以确定，因为污名在观察性数据中难以测量，而要分离出污名的影响，需要存在不受污名化特征变化影响的外部变量。本研究通过关注一种普遍存在的污名——体重污名——在住院医疗这一高风险环境中的情况，来应对这些挑战。电子病历中通常会将BMI分类清晰地展示给医护人员，而肥胖在社会上受到严重的污名化对待。因此，在“肥胖”的临界值处，污名可能会独立变化，而潜在的肥胖特征本身则不会发生变化。利用这种制度特征，通过回归不连续设计的方法，我发现在这个临界值处，住院死亡率会突然增加，尽管患者的健康状况并没有改变。两种现象表明，基于污名的歧视是造成这种变化的机制。首先，仅仅肥胖的患者比几乎肥胖的患者得到的诊断关注要少。其次，经过医生验证的大型语言模型发现，在临界值处，临床记录中的污名化语言会有所增加——特别是那些带有道德评判、削弱患者可信度以及对病人进行刻板印象化的语言——这些语言的使用者往往也是导致死亡结果的因素。总体而言，这些结果表明，污名是一种强大的社会力量，可能带来生死攸关的后果。

abstract.text: How much fraud is there in Medicare and who commits it? We provide an answer for Medicare home health, a setting widely considered especially rife with fraud. We define a home health agency (HHA) as fraudulent if it was prosecuted by a federal strike force. Combining Medicare claims data on all HHAs with hand-collected prosecution records from the nine federal judicial districts where strike forces operated between 2009 and 2013, we train a machine learning model to predict, out of sample, the probability that each HHA in the remaining 85 districts would have been prosecuted had a strike force been present. We estimate that in 2008, 3.4% of Medicare home health spending — about $520 million — was billed by fraudulent HHAs. The strike forces were well-targeted: their nine districts contained only 40% of home health spending but 65% of fraudulent spending. Fraudulent HHAs display intuitive characteristics: they are more likely to rely on extremely high-volume referring physicians, to exhibit unusually uniform patterns of care, and to serve healthier-than-average patients.

10.3386/w35280.abstractZh: 在医疗保险体系中，存在多少欺诈行为？谁在实施这些欺诈行为呢？我们对医疗保险家庭健康服务领域进行了研究，这一领域普遍被认为存在严重的欺诈现象。我们将那些被联邦打击力量起诉的家庭健康服务机构定义为欺诈机构。通过结合所有家庭健康服务机构的医疗保险索赔数据，以及2009年至2013年间九个联邦司法区打击力量实施的起诉记录，我们训练了一个机器学习模型，用于预测在剩余的85个司法区中，如果有打击力量存在，每个家庭健康服务机构被起诉的概率。我们估计，在2008年，有3.4%的医疗保险家庭健康服务支出——约5.2亿美元——是由欺诈性家庭健康服务机构开具的账单。打击力量针对的对象非常明确：他们的九个司法区仅占家庭健康服务支出的40%，但却占到了65%的欺诈支出。欺诈性家庭健康服务机构具有一些明显的特征：它们更可能依赖数量极多的推荐医生，表现出异常一致的护理模式，并且服务的患者通常比平均水平更健康。

abstract.text: We study the role of public risk-sharing in markets where firms face substantial cost uncertainty, focusing on public reinsurance in health insurance. We develop a model where insurers internalize cost uncertainty through risk charges that raise effective marginal costs, and create a role for reinsurance. Public reinsurance lowers both expected costs and cost volatility, particularly for smaller insurers, reducing prices and enhancing competition. Using an event study of staggered state-level reinsurance programs, we show that public reinsurance leads insurers to lower prices and private reinsurance purchases, benefiting financially constrained insurers the most. Structural estimates indicate that risk charges account for a substantial share of the premium-cost wedge, and highlight public reinsurance's comparative advantage over premium subsidies by providing risk protection and enhancing competition. Our results underscore the importance of accounting for firms' risk exposure in policy design and provide a general framework for understanding public risk-sharing policies.

10.3386/w35282.abstractZh: 我们研究了在企业面临重大成本不确定性市场中，公共风险分担的作用，重点关注健康保险领域的公共再保险。我们建立了一个模型，其中保险公司通过风险费用将成本不确定性内部化，从而提升实际边际成本，并为再保险提供了作用空间。公共再保险能够降低预期成本和成本波动性，尤其是对小型保险公司而言，从而降低价格并增强竞争。通过对分阶段实施的国家级再保险项目的事件研究，我们发现公共再保险促使保险公司降低价格并增加私人再保险购买，对财务受限的保险公司最为有利。结构估计表明，风险费用占据了保费成本差异的很大一部分，并凸显了公共再保险相对于保费补贴的比较优势，因为它提供了风险保护并增强了竞争。我们的研究结果强调了在政策设计中考虑企业风险暴露的重要性，并为理解公共风险分担政策提供了一个通用框架。

abstract.text: Since the 1974 Safe Drinking Water Act, the U.S. has spent $2 trillion to provide safe drinking water, yet drinking water for 10–20 percent of Americans violates standards. We study trends, causes, and consequences of U.S. drinking water pollution, using 266 million readings on 1,250 pollutants over decades that we obtained from 48 states via dozens of Freedom of Information Act and associated requests. We link pollution to administrative Medicare data on older Americans' health outcomes. Three findings emerge. First, U.S. drinking water pollution has declined rapidly; the share of readings exceeding current health standards fell by half from 2003–2019. Unregulated pollutants declined more slowly. Low-income areas have higher pollution; Black and Hispanic communities have more complex patterns. Second, loans provided by the Safe Drinking Water Act to water systems reduce pollution. At the estimated average loan cost-effectiveness, these loans could eliminate pollution above health standards for $46 annually per person. Third, these loans reduce mortality rates of older Americans. Although fiscal federalism cautions against federal funding of local public goods with few inter-jurisdictional externalities like drinking water, we estimate large benefits from Safe Drinking Water Act loans.

10.3386/w35288.abstractZh: 自1974年《安全饮用水法》实施以来，美国已投入2万亿美元用于提供安全饮用水，然而仍有10%至20%的美国人饮用不符合标准的饮用水。本研究通过收集来自48个州的1.25亿个污染物的数据，利用数十份《信息自由法案》相关请求获取了这些数据，分析了美国饮用水污染的趋势、原因及后果。我们将污染数据与老年美国人健康状况的行政数据进行了关联分析。研究发现有以下三个要点：首先，美国饮用水污染水平迅速下降；超过当前健康标准的检测数据比例在2003年至2019年间减少了近一半。未受监管的污染物污染程度下降速度较慢。低收入地区的污染程度较高；黑人和西班牙裔社区则存在更复杂的污染模式。其次，《安全饮用水法》为供水系统提供的贷款有助于减少污染。根据估算的平均贷款成本效益，这些贷款每年可为每人节省46美元的污染成本。第三，这些贷款降低了老年美国人的死亡率。尽管财政联邦主义反对联邦政府为缺乏跨司法管辖区外部性的地方公共产品提供资金，但我们估计《安全饮用水法》贷款带来了巨大的效益。

abstract.text: This paper estimates the causal effect of height on adolescents’ body image, encompassing self-perceptions of weight, the accuracy of those perceptions, and weight-management aspirations. Using data from the National Longitudinal Survey of Youth 1997 (NLSY97), we leverage within-individual variation in height during adolescence and condition on body mass index (BMI) to isolate the effects of height on body image outcomes. We find that taller adolescents are more likely to perceive themselves as overweight, even holding BMI constant, and are less likely to underestimate their weight category. However, the direction of misclassification diverges by gender: taller boys are more likely to correctly assess their weight category, while taller girls are more likely to overestimate it. These perception shifts translate into behavioral responses for girls but not for boys. A one-inch increase in height raises the probability that a girl reports wanting to lose weight by 3.0 percentage points (6.2 percent), with effects concentrated among girls in the normal weight range. Taken together, these findings establish height as a salient determinant of body image in adolescence, operating independently of body mass.

10.3386/w35293.abstractZh: 本文估计了身高对青少年身体形象的因果效应，包括他们对体重的自我认知、这些认知的准确性以及体重管理愿望。利用1997年青少年纵向调查的数据，我们利用了青少年时期个体身高差异的影响，并基于体重指数（BMI）来分离身高对身体形象结果的影响。我们发现，即使BMI保持不变，较高的青少年也更有可能认为自己超重，并且不太可能低估自己的体重类别。然而，错误分类的方向因性别而异：较高的男孩更有可能正确评估自己的体重类别，而较高的女孩则更有可能高估自己的体重类别。这些认知变化会转化为女孩的行为反应，而男孩则不会如此。身高增加一英寸，女孩报告想要减肥的概率增加了3.0个百分点（6.2%），这种影响主要集中在正常体重范围内的女孩身上。总的来说，这些发现表明身高是青少年身体形象的一个重要决定因素，其影响与体重无关。

abstract.text: GLP-1 therapies for obesity promise substantial health improvements, but little is known about how their benefits vary across socioeconomic and demographic groups. Using a nationally representative microsimulation model of US adults and Shapely-value decomposition, we estimate the lifetime health and economic benefits of GLP-1 treatment and examine how those gains vary across individuals. The largest differences emerge across education. Individuals with less than a high school education experience experience roughly 14% higher gains in lifetime net social value, 16-17% larger improvements in discounted generalized risk- and severity-adjusted life-years (GRASA-QALYs), and 20% greater increases in life expectancy relative to the cohort mean, whereas individuals with college degrees experience gains 15-27% below the mean across these outcomes. Black and Hispanic individuals also tend to experience larger improvements in health outcomes and social value than White individuals, including larger gains in GRASA-QALYs and life expectancy and larger reductions in diabetes risk and duration. Females likewise experience larger predicted treatment gains than men. These patterns are consistent with the idea that the largest gains arise among populations facing greater socioeconomic constraints in sustaining behavioral weight control. GLP-1 innovation may therefore mitigate inequality in obesity-related disease and survival, advancing equity in population health.

10.3386/w35296.abstractZh: GLP-1疗法在肥胖治疗方面具有显著的健康改善潜力，但关于其效益在不同社会经济和人口群体中的差异尚不明确。通过采用全国代表性微模拟模型以及Shapely价值分解方法，我们估算了GLP-1治疗的终身健康和经济效益，并研究了这些收益在不同个体之间的差异。教育程度差异是造成差异的主要因素之一。受教育程度低于高中水平的个体，其终身净社会价值的收益大约高出14%，折现广义风险与严重性调整生命年（GRASA-QALYs）的改善幅度高出16-17%，预期寿命也相对高于群体平均水平；而拥有大学学位的个体在这些方面的收益则低于平均水平15-27%。黑人和西班牙裔个体在健康结果和社会价值方面的改善幅度也大于白人个体，包括GRASA-QALYs和预期寿命的更大提升，以及糖尿病风险和持续时间的显著减少。女性同样表现出比男性更高的治疗收益。这些模式与这样一个观点一致：在面临更大社会经济限制以维持行为性体重控制的人群中，GLP-1疗法的收益最为显著。因此，GLP-1创新可能有助于缓解与肥胖相关的疾病和生存不平等问题，从而推动人群健康的公平发展。

abstract.text: After substantial growth in the 1990s and 2000s, enrollment in the U.S. Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI) program has been declining since 2013. We use detailed administrative data to quantify the contributions of various factors to trends in SSDI enrollment, focusing especially on the decline in the 2010s. A statistical decomposition suggests that the vast majority of the decline in SSDI enrollment since 2013 is attributable to declines in application rates—and, to a lesser extent, award rates—within demographic groups. There is very little contribution from changes over time in demographic characteristics, eligibility, or exit from SSDI. The decline in SSDI enrollment rates is disproportionately driven by low-to-middle-skilled men who, over time, have become less likely to apply for SSDI and more likely to work. Consistent with this descriptive evidence, we present results from a causal analysis suggesting that improved labor market opportunity for less-skilled men is a key explanation for the decline in SSDI enrollment. We also investigate several other popular hypotheses for the decline in SSDI applications, including lower award rates at the appeals level, and find evidence at odds with them.

10.3386/w35300.abstractZh: 在1990年代和2000年代实现大幅增长之后，美国社会保障残疾保险计划的参保人数自2013年起开始下降。我们利用详细的行政数据来量化各种因素对参保人数趋势的影响，特别关注2010年代出现的下降情况。统计分解表明，自2013年以来，参保人数下降的绝大部分原因可归因于各人口群体申请率的下降——而在较小程度上，也是裁决率的下降。人口特征、资格要求或退出社会保障残疾保险计划的变化对参保人数的下降贡献甚微。参保人数下降的主要推动力是低至中等技能水平的男性，随着时间的推移，这些男性申请社会保障残疾保险的可能性降低，而工作的可能性则增加。与这一描述性证据一致，我们的因果分析结果表明，为低技能男性提供更好的劳动力市场机会是参保人数下降的关键原因。我们还调查了其他几个关于社会保障残疾保险申请人数下降的流行假设，包括在上诉阶段的裁决率较低，并发现了与这些假设相悖的证据。

abstract.text: This is the first study to estimate the impact of sports gambling legalization on food sufficiency using the staggered implementation of state laws between 2021-2023. By analyzing Google searches for online sportsbooks and legal wagers, we show that interest in sports gambling increases sharply following legalization. Applying an imputation-based difference-in-differences design to biweekly Household Pulse Survey (HPS) data, we find that legalized sports gambling reduces household food sufficiency by 2.1 percent among working-age adults without a college degree, which translates to a 10.5 percent decline among active bettors. This effect is cyclical, persisting for three-to-five months during NFL seasons. Additionally, the declines in food sufficiency are larger among households with adults aged 25-44 and racial/ethnic minorities. Using additional data from the HPS, Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System and Current Population Survey, our exploration of mechanisms suggests that the negative effects on food sufficiency operate through financial distress rather than changes in mental health or labor supply. A back-of-the-envelope calculation indicates that legalization of sports gambling in nine states resulted in an additional 284,000 food-insufficient households and $130.2 million in excess healthcare expenditures annually.

10.3386/w35305.abstractZh: 这是第一项研究，通过2021年至2023年间分阶段实施州法律，来估算体育赌博合法化对食物充足性的影响。通过分析关于在线体育博彩和合法投注的谷歌搜索数据，我们发现合法化后人们对体育赌博的兴趣急剧增加。通过采用基于插补的差分进化设计，对每两周一次的住户调查数据进行分析，我们发现，在没有大学学位的工作年龄成年人中，合法化的体育赌博使食物充足性减少了2.1%，对于活跃的赌徒来说，这一比例更是达到了10.5%。这种影响具有周期性，在NFL赛季期间会持续三到五个月。此外，食物充足性下降幅度在25-44岁成年人以及种族/族裔少数群体家庭中更为明显。通过利用住户调查、行为风险因素监测系统和当前人口调查等额外数据，我们的机制分析表明，对食物充足性的负面影响是通过财务困境而非心理健康或劳动力供应变化来实现的。粗略计算表明，在九个州实施体育赌博合法化后，每年新增了284,000个食物不足的家庭，并导致额外的1.302亿美元医疗保健支出。

abstract.text: We study labor-market polarization by developing a framework with heterogeneous consumers, non-homothetic preferences, and endogenous labor supply a la Roy (1951). Because income-elastic sectors are intensive in high- and low-skilled occupations, shocks that raise either the average or the dispersion of income across households shift relative labor demand toward these occupations, generating an income channel to polarization. We quantify this channel by comparing the effect of shocks that affect the distribution of household income in our model and in a version with homothetic preferences in which the income distribution does not affect sectoral composition. The income channel is sizable: it explains 42% and 210% of the increases in the relative wages of high- and low-skill workers observed between 1980 and 2016, and 26% and 51% of the increase in their hours-worked shares. A quarter of its effect operates through income dispersion, highlighting the importance of departing from representative-consumer frameworks in non-homothetic environments.

10.3386/w35315.abstractZh: 我们通过构建一个包含异质消费者、非同态偏好以及内生劳动供给的框架来研究劳动力市场两极分化问题，这一框架借鉴了Roy（1951）的理论。由于收入弹性较高的行业需要高技能和低技能劳动者，任何导致家庭收入平均水平或分布变化的冲击都会使相对劳动需求向这些职业倾斜，从而形成一种收入驱动的极化效应。我们通过比较模型中家庭收入分布变化的影响与具有同态偏好版本的模型中的影响，来量化这一效应。同态偏好版本的模型中，收入分布不会影响行业构成。这一收入驱动的极化效应相当显著：在1980年至2016年间，它分别解释了高技能和低技能劳动者相对工资变化的42%和210%，以及他们工作时间比例变化的26%和51%。其效应有四分之一是通过收入分布变化来实现的，这凸显了在非同态环境下采用非代表性消费者框架的重要性。

abstract.text: I study medical liability when artificial intelligence acts as a doctor rather than as a passive clinical tool. The central object is the legally usable medical record: the inputs, logs, warnings, prescriptions, follow-up instructions, and outcomes on which courts, contracts, insurers, and regulators can condition responsibility. I show that AI medical liability is an institutional design problem under imperfect legal information. If the record separates AI-controllable error from patient nonadherence and natural disease progression, high-powered AI-fault liability implements the standard accident-law ideal. If the record is coarse, the first best may be infeasible: the same transfer that disciplines the AI also insures the patient's hidden action. With joint causation, the relevant object is a marginal-responsibility score rather than a posterior cause label. I characterize the feasible set of liability incentives generated by the record and show when the optimal rule is no liability, strict liability, negligence, a safe harbor, comparative fault, or a continuous warranty. I then study algorithmic defensive design, through which AI developers can design not only medical recommendations but also the record on which future liability depends. Adoption, learning, enterprise liability, insurance, no-fault compensation, and regulation enter as ways to change the record, the liable entity, or the financing of compensation. The framework yields conditional implications rather than a one-size-fits-all rule.

10.3386/w35321.abstractZh: 我研究的是人工智能作为医生而非被动临床工具时的医疗责任问题。核心研究对象是法律上可使用的医疗记录：这些记录包含了输入数据、日志、警告、处方、后续指导以及结果，这些要素可以被法院、合同、保险公司和监管机构用来判断责任归属。我发现，在不完善的法律信息环境下，人工智能医疗责任实际上是一个制度设计问题。如果医疗记录能够区分由人工智能导致的错误与患者的不遵医嘱以及自然疾病的发展过程，那么高强度的人工智能责任机制就能实现标准事故法理想。但如果记录过于粗糙，那么最优方案可能难以实现：同样的管理机制可能会保护患者的隐藏行为。在共同因果关系的背景下，相关的责任评分而非具体的原因标签更为重要。我描述了由医疗记录产生的可行责任激励方案，并探讨了最优规则可能是无责任、严格责任、过失责任、安全港、比较过错或持续保证。随后，我研究了算法防御设计，通过这种方式，人工智能开发者不仅可以设计医疗建议，还可以设计未来责任所依赖的医疗记录。采用、学习、企业责任、保险、无过错赔偿以及监管等方式都可以改变医疗记录、责任主体或赔偿机制。该框架提供了条件性的影响，而非一刀切的规则。

abstract.text: Risk adjustment is a payment mechanism, not only a prediction problem. I extend optimal risk adjustment to dynamic insurance markets in which plans capture future residuals from persistent risk. Under an efficiency criterion, payments should reflect expected profits and losses over the enrollee relationship on margins plans control, not only one-year spending predictions. A finite-cell model separates selection, health production, and manipulable measurement. The framework implies that annual recalculation can tax prevention, high-R² prediction can reduce welfare, and lagged claims anchors are useful only with gaming safeguards.

10.3386/w35325.abstractZh: 风险调整是一种支付机制，而不仅仅是预测问题。我将最优风险调整扩展到了动态保险市场，在这些市场中，计划能够捕捉到由持续风险带来的未来收益。根据效率标准，支付应反映被保险人在整个保险关系期间预期的利润和损失，而不仅仅是一年内的支出预测。有限单元模型将选择、健康产出和可操纵的测量结果分开考虑。该框架表明，年度重新计算可能会抑制预防行为，高R²预测可能会降低福利，而滞后索赔的锚定措施只有在有游戏保障的情况下才有用。

abstract.text: Latin America's momentous fertility transition is now in the domain of history, allowing a cohort perspective on the decline of completed fertility. Using census microdata from 17 Latin American countries, we track female birth cohorts from the 1920s to the 1970s by subnational region to document the extent to which cohort fertility decline coincided with other demographic and socioeconomic processes. Across cohorts within subnational regions, children ever born fell one-for-one with mortality decline. Expansions in urbanization, multigenerational living, women's and husbands' education, women's employment, and the non-agricultural sector all predicted declines in ever-born and surviving fertility, but women's education and sectoral composition were the dominant forces after covariate adjustment. Fertility decline was not systematically linked with improvements in children's outcomes, including school enrollment, literacy, primary completion, and non-employment. These cohort facts challenge theories of fertility decline centered on women's work and children's education but support others emphasizing women's education.

10.3386/w35326.abstractZh: 拉丁美洲重要的生育率转变现已成为历史的一部分，我们可以从群体视角来观察生育率的下降。通过利用17个拉丁美洲国家的普查微观数据，我们追踪了从20世纪20年代到70年代的女性生育群体，并记录了生育率下降与其他人口和社会经济过程之间的关联程度。在各个子区域内的不同生育群体中，出生儿童的数量与死亡率的下降呈一一对应关系。城市化程度的提高、多代同堂的生活方式、女性与男性的教育水平、女性的就业状况以及非农业部门的就业情况，都预示着出生儿童和存活儿童数量的减少。但在进行协变量调整后，女性的教育和行业构成成为主导因素。生育率的下降并未与儿童的生活状况改善有系统性关联，包括入学率、识字率、小学毕业率以及非就业状况等。这些群体数据挑战了以女性工作和儿童教育为中心的生育率下降理论，但支持了强调女性教育的理论。

abstract.text: We estimate the effect of total abortion bans enacted after Dobbs v. Jackson Women's Health on sexual behavior. Using synthetic and standard difference-in-differences designs, we analyze gonorrhea rates and over-the-counter contraceptive purchases as indicators of sexual activity and contraceptive use. We find that total abortion bans reduced gonorrhea rates by 21% among the population aged 15–44 and increased condom purchases by 5.4%. County-level analyses suggest the response reflects awareness of state policy rather than changes in travel distance to providers. These findings are consistent with a framework in which abortion restrictions increase the perceived cost of unprotected sex, inducing more cautious behavior.

10.3386/w35333.abstractZh: 我们估计了Dobbs v. Jackson Women's Health案之后实施的总性堕胎禁令对性行为的影响。通过合成设计和标准差异-差异设计，我们分析了淋病发病率和非处方避孕品的购买情况，作为性行为和避孕使用的指标。研究发现，在15-44岁的人群中，总性堕胎禁令使淋病发病率降低了21%，同时使避孕套的购买量增加了5.4%。县级层面的分析表明，这种反应反映了对州政策的认知，而非前往医疗服务提供者的距离变化。这些发现与一种框架一致，即堕胎限制会增加无保护性行为 perceived成本，从而导致更加谨慎的行为。

abstract.text: We study how the opioid epidemic shaped local population dynamics in the United States. Exploiting variation in exposure that stems from Purdue Pharma's targeted marketing of OxyContin to high-cancer-mortality areas, we find that more exposed commuting zones experienced lower population growth. By 2020, a one-standard-deviation increase in exposure reduced population growth among individuals aged 18 to 64 by 2.4 percentage points. Direct mortality from drug-induced deaths made only a limited contribution to these changes. Instead, population losses were primarily driven by migratory responses: exposure increased out-migration rates, especially among college-educated individuals. These responses are consistent with the opioid epidemic operating as a disamenity shock, deteriorating local quality of life. Working in the opposite direction, we also document a rise in fertility rates that, by 2020, partially counteracts these population losses. Our findings show that the opioid epidemic reshaped local demographic composition and contributed to the long-run divergence in population dynamics across U.S. commuting zones.

10.3386/w35340.abstractZh: 我们研究了阿片类药物危机如何影响了美国各通勤区的当地人口动态。通过研究普渡制药公司针对高癌症死亡率地区定向推广奥施康定所带来的暴露差异，我们发现暴露程度较高的通勤区人口增长率较低。到2020年，暴露程度增加一个标准差，会使18至64岁人群的人口增长率降低2.4个百分点。药物引起的直接死亡对这些变化的影响有限，人口减少主要是由迁移反应所驱动的：暴露程度增加导致外出迁移率上升，尤其是在受过大学教育的人群中。这些反应与阿片类药物危机作为一种负面冲击、导致当地生活质量下降的观点一致。相反地，我们也发现生育率有所上升，到2020年，生育率的上升部分抵消了这些人口减少的影响。我们的研究结果表明，阿片类药物危机重塑了当地的人口结构，并导致了美国各通勤区人口动态的长期差异。

abstract.text: Rising elderly life expectancy is a well-known source of fiscal pressure on Social Security and Medicare – but how have declining mortality and morbidity affected the two programs’ relative finances? Using nearly three decades of Medicare Current Beneficiary Survey data (1992-2019), we estimate that these demographic changes raised expected lifetime Social Security spending by over twice as much as expected lifetime Medicare spending: 14% compared to 6%. The slower growth of elderly lifetime health care spending than annuity spending reflects two features of how longevity has increased: the additional 2.4 years of remaining life expectancy were entirely healthy – free of physical or cognitive limitations – while the expected amount of time spent with severe health limitations fell by about 30%, reducing expected lifetime nursing-home and home-health use. We then write down a stylized life-cycle model of a risk-averse retiree facing stochastic mortality and health to illuminate the key forces that affect the optimal allocation of a fixed amount of public funds across Medicare and Social Security.

10.3386/w35346.abstractZh: 老年人预期寿命的延长是社会保障和医疗保险面临财政压力的一个众所周知的原因——但死亡率和发病率的下降如何影响了这两个项目的相对财务状况呢？通过利用近三十年的医疗保险当前受益人调查数据（1992-2019年），我们估计这些人口统计变化使得预期寿命内的社会保障支出增加了两倍以上：14%对比6%。老年人预期寿命内的医疗保健支出增长放缓，反映了寿命延长的两个特点：额外的2.4年预期寿命都是健康的，没有身体或认知上的限制；而因严重健康限制而需要护理的时间则减少了约30%，从而减少了预期寿命内对养老院和家庭医疗服务的需求。随后，我们构建了一个简化的生命周期模型，该模型描述了一个风险厌恶的退休人员面对随机死亡和健康状况的情况，以揭示影响公共资金在医疗保险和社会保障之间最优分配的关键因素。

abstract.text: We analyze how social-planner insurers split cost-sharing between consumers and firms (e.g. patients and doctors, or drivers and car mechanics). With no contracting frictions, firm cost-sharing can replace consumer cost-sharing other than “visit copays.” Optimal firm contracts depend on the marginal rate of substitution between consumer and firm cost-sharing. For Medicare physician services, paying physicians more up front but less as spending increases reduces risk for both patients and providers; in our calibration, net benefits are twice those from eliminating Medigap externality. For prescription drugs, a dollar of physician paperwork costs is 45–110 times more impactful than a dollar of consumer cost-sharing.

10.3386/w35352.abstractZh: 我们分析了社会规划保险公司如何分配消费者与企业的成本分担（例如，患者与医生，或司机与汽车修理工）。在没有契约摩擦的情况下，企业的成本分担可以替代消费者的成本分担，除了“就诊自付费用”之外。最优的企业契约取决于消费者与企业的成本分担之间的边际替代率。对于医疗保险中的医生服务，预先向医生支付更多费用，但随着支出增加支付减少，可以降低患者和提供者的风险；在我们的校准中，净收益是消除Medigap外部性的两倍。对于处方药，医生处理文书工作的每1美元成本，其影响是消费者成本分担每1美元成本的45到110倍。

abstract.text: Alternative care delivery models may offer benefits to patients and providers, but adoption often remains low. We study whether brief narrative testimonials shift willingness to attend virtual shared medical appointments (SMAs), a relatively little-used care format in which 5-15 patients with a shared non-urgent health condition meet simultaneously with a clinician. Using a pre-registered field experiment with over 4,000 women aged 45–60 in the UK, we randomly assigned participants to view only standard descriptive information about menopause appointment options (the control group) or to receive testimonials about SMAs from either previous patients or a clinician (treatment groups). Testimonials more than doubled the share of women choosing an SMA: when appointments were offered with a 6-8 week wait, 11% of the control group chose an SMA compared to 26% in the peer testimonials arm and 24% in the clinician testimonials arm. Shorter waiting times further increase uptake. When the SMA wait was reduced to one week, the share of women ever choosing an SMA rose by 14-19 percentage points across arms, reaching nearly 40% in the testimonial groups. Treatment effects are systematically larger among women with greater information-processing capacity: university education, higher baseline menopause knowledge, and broader information-seeking. Our findings suggest that women’s reluctance to choose SMAs is driven primarily by demand-side barriers, including unfamiliarity and uncertainty about their benefits, rather than deep-seated aversion to group-based care. Testimonials appear sufficient to meaningfully reduce these barriers.

10.3386/w35357.abstractZh: 替代的护理模式可能为患者和医疗服务提供者带来好处，但采用率往往仍然较低。我们研究了简短的叙事性推荐是否能提高人们参加虚拟共享医疗预约的意愿。这种护理方式相对少见，5-15名患有非紧急健康问题的患者可以同时与临床医生会面。通过一项在英国进行的预注册实地实验，我们让参与者随机选择观看关于更年期预约选项的标准描述性信息（对照组），或者接收来自之前患者或临床医生的关于虚拟共享医疗预约的推荐。结果显示，接受推荐的女性选择虚拟共享医疗预约的比例增加了两倍：当预约等待时间为6-8周时，对照组中有11%的女性选择虚拟共享医疗预约，而在接受推荐组中这一比例达到了26%，在接受临床医生推荐组中则达到了24%。更短的等待时间进一步增加了使用虚拟共享医疗预约的意愿。当预约等待时间缩短到一周时，无论哪种组，选择虚拟共享医疗预约的女性比例均上升了14-19个百分点，在接受推荐组的女性中这一比例接近40%。在信息处理能力较强的女性中，这种治疗效果更为显著：她们通常拥有大学教育背景、较高的更年期相关知识以及更广泛的信息获取渠道。我们的研究结果表明，女性不愿选择虚拟共享医疗预约主要受到需求方面的障碍影响，包括对这种护理方式的不熟悉和不确定性，而非对群体护理的根深蒂固的厌恶。因此，推荐信息似乎足以有效降低这些障碍。

abstract.text: Health care reforms are often enacted before implementation, creating uncertainty that can shape firms’ decisions. We examine how Medicare Part D affected the retail pharmacy industry using 2000-2009 establishment-level data, leveraging the fact that Part D disproportionately affected counties with larger elderly populations. Consistent with predictions from a conceptual model in which pre-implementation uncertainty discourages entry and lower post-implementation margins prevent full recovery, we find that Part D was associated with a 5-percent reduction in pharmacies, driven by fewer openings rather than more closures. We also find suggestive evidence that reduced pharmacy access dampened Part D’s mortality benefits.

10.3386/w35380.abstractZh: 医疗改革通常在实施前就已制定，这种不确定性可能会影响公司的决策。我们利用2000-2009年的机构级数据，研究了医疗保险D部分如何影响零售药店行业，利用D部分对老年人口较多的县影响较大的事实。与概念模型的预测一致，即实施前的不确定性抑制了进入，而实施后较低的利润率阻止了完全恢复，我们发现D部分与药店数量减少5%有关，这是由于新开药店减少而非关闭药店增多所驱动的。我们还发现了一些暗示性证据，表明减少药店的可及性减弱了D部分的降低死亡率的好处。

abstract.text: Vision problems are prevalent among Medicare beneficiaries, with the majority having treatable conditions including uncorrected refractive error and cataracts. However, traditional Medicare does not cover routine eye exams or eyeglasses, and Medicare Advantage supplemental vision benefits often include low annual limits. We examine the effects of Medicaid routine vision benefits among adults dually eligible for Medicare and Medicaid, a population with high rates of vision impairment, morbidity, and disability. Using 2002-2019 Medicare Current Beneficiary Survey data and a difference-in-differences design, we estimate that Medicaid routine vision benefits increase past-year eye exams, eyeglasses purchases, and Medicaid spending on eyeglasses while reducing out-of-pocket spending. We also find suggestive evidence of spillovers to Medicare Advantage spending on eyeglasses, consistent with Medicaid routine vision coverage inducing additional eyeglasses purchases among Medicare Advantage enrollees with supplemental vision benefits, although estimates are modest.

10.3386/w35384.abstractZh: 视力问题在医疗保险受益人中普遍存在，大多数人患有可治疗的疾病，包括未矫正的屈光不正和白内障。然而，传统的医疗保险不包括常规眼科检查或眼镜，而医疗保险优势补充视力福利通常包括低年度限额。我们研究了医疗补助计划对同时符合医疗保险和医疗补助资格的成年人的常规视力福利的影响，这是一个视力障碍、发病率和残疾率很高的人群。利用2002-2019年医疗保险当前受益人调查数据和差异-差异设计，我们估计医疗补助常规视力福利增加了过去一年的眼科检查、眼镜购买和医疗补助在眼镜上的支出，同时减少了自掏腰包的支出。我们还发现了对医疗保险优势在眼镜上的支出的暗示性证据，这与医疗补助常规视力覆盖诱导具有补充视力福利的医疗保险优势参保者额外购买眼镜是一致的，尽管估计值是适度的。

abstract.text: GLP-1 medications generate large weight loss and may also alter social and economic outcomes. Using the Understanding America Study, I compare women starting GLP-1s for weight loss with matched women who would like to start a GLP-1 but have not. Single women’s marriage/cohabitation rates rise by 29 percentage points and employment among baseline non-employed women rises 27 percentage points after six or more quarters. Existing partnerships do not dissolve, and already-employed women show no upward job mobility. The pattern suggests that part of the female obesity penalty operates at new-match formation rather than only through health or incumbent productivity.

10.3386/w35387.abstractZh: GLP-1类药物能产生显著的减重效果，还可能改变社会和经济结果。利用美国理解研究，我比较了开始使用GLP-1药物减重的女性与匹配的希望开始使用GLP-1但尚未开始的女性。单身女性的结婚/同居率上升了29个百分点，基线时未就业女性的就业率上升了27个百分点，这发生在六个或更多季度之后。现有的伴侣关系没有解散，而已就业的女性没有显示出向上的职业流动。这种模式表明，女性肥胖惩罚的一部分是在新匹配形成时发挥作用，而不仅仅是通过健康或现有生产力。

abstract.text: We study the relationship between health and social status in China using genealogical data from the 14th to 19th centuries. The data covers broad segments of the population linking husbands, wives, and sons, allowing us to examine whether status was associated with survival not only for adult men but also across households and generations. In a sample centered on the early 1700s, the typical lifespan of married men is 52, but varies widely. High-status men have a 22 percent higher probability of living past 50 than low-status men, resulting in a lifespan advantage of seven years. High status is also associated with significant survival advantages for wives and children. The lifespan premium of the wife of a high-status man over the wife of a commoner exceeds 10 years, and the chance that the son of a high-status man dies before reaching 10 years is less than half that of a low-status man’s son. Up to the 17th century the lifespan advantage is largely confined to those with top status, while the health-status gradient across all status levels emerges during the 18th century. The findings provide new evidence on health-status inequality in a less-studied setting, and suggest that health-status inequality is usefully analyzed from a family and intergenerational perspective.

10.3386/w35396.abstractZh: 我们利用14至19世纪的家谱数据研究了中国健康与社会地位之间的关系。这些数据涵盖了广泛的人口群体，连接了丈夫、妻子和儿子，使我们能够检验地位不仅与成年男性的生存有关，而且跨越家庭和世代。在以18世纪初为中心的样本中，已婚男性的平均寿命为52岁，但差异很大。高地位男性活过50岁的概率比低地位男性高出22%，导致寿命优势为7年。高地位也与妻子和儿童的重大生存优势相关。高地位男性的妻子比平民的妻子寿命优势超过10年，而高地位男性的儿子在10岁前死亡的几率不到低地位男性儿子的一半。直到17世纪，寿命优势主要限于那些地位最高的个体，而18世纪则出现了跨越所有地位层次的健康-地位梯度。这些发现为较少研究的环境中的健康-地位不平等提供了新的证据，并表明从家庭和代际角度分析健康-地位不平等是有益的。

abstract.text: How does a person’s own learning experience affect their ability to learn from others? We conduct a field experiment on chlorination in Pakistan, where randomized “learning-arm” households use a tool to track their children’s diarrhea before and after chlorine distribution. Learning-arm households with learning-arm neighbors chlorinate significantly more one year after the withdrawal of the tool, with children’s health improving by 0.08 SD relative to all other households receiving chlorine. Neither learning households without learning-arm neighbors, nor non-learning households with learning-arm neighbors, exhibit sustained behavior change, results which have significant implications for intervention and evaluation design.

10.3386/w35410.abstractZh: 一个人的自身学习经历如何影响他们从他人那里学习的能力？我们在巴基斯坦进行了一项关于氯化处理的实地实验，其中随机分配的“学习组”家庭使用工具跟踪他们孩子在氯分发前后的腹泻情况。在工具撤回一年后，拥有学习组邻居的学习组家庭明显更多地进行氯化处理，与所有其他接受氯的家庭相比，他们孩子的健康状况提高了0.08个标准差。既没有学习组邻居的学习组家庭，也没有非学习组家庭拥有学习组邻居的家庭，展现出持续的行为改变，这些结果对于干预和评估设计具有重要的启示。

abstract.text: Large cities worldwide have adopted congestion pricing to reduce urban traffic, with well-documented benefits for travel speeds, accident rates, and air quality. This paper identifies a novel external benefit: faster emergency medical service (EMS) response times. We provide the first evidence on how the congestion pricing program in New York City – the first comprehensive cordon-based congestion pricing system in the U.S. that was implemented on January 5th, 2025 – affects EMS performance. Exploiting the sharp geographic boundary of New York City’s congestion relief zone at 60th Street and a difference-in-discontinuities design, we first document substantial changes in traffic and mobility near the boundary: vehicular traffic declines by roughly 18 to 21 percent, accompanied by increases in pedestrian and bicycle activity. Consistent with these first-stage mechanisms, we find that congestion pricing improves EMS performance, reducing total travel times by 63–70 seconds (approximately 5–6 percent). Effects emerged quickly and show little evidence of displacement to adjacent areas. A concurrent FDNY directive requiring transport to the nearest hospital confounds standard difference-in-differences estimates but not our boundary-based design. These findings suggest that cost-benefit analyses of congestion pricing systematically understate net social benefits by omitting emergency response improvements.

10.3386/w35414.abstractZh: 全球范围内的大型城市已经采用拥挤收费来减少城市交通，对于出行速度、事故率和空气质量的益处已有充分记录。本文识别了一种新的外部效益：急救服务（EMS）响应时间更快。我们提供了首个证据，说明纽约市的拥挤收费计划——美国首个全面实施的区域收费式拥挤收费系统，于2025年1月5日实施——如何影响EMS的表现。利用纽约市拥挤缓解区域在60街的明显地理边界和差异中的不连续设计，我们首先记录了边界附近交通和流动性的显著变化：车辆交通量下降了大约18%至21%，同时行人和自行车活动增加。与这些第一阶段机制一致，我们发现拥挤收费改善了EMS的表现，将总出行时间减少了63至70秒（约5-6%）。这些效应迅速显现，并且几乎没有证据表明转移到相邻区域。同时，FDNY的一项指令要求将患者送往最近的医院，这混淆了标准的双重差分估计，但并未影响我们基于边界的设计。这些发现表明，拥挤收费的成本效益分析系统性地低估了净社会效益，因为它忽略了紧急响应改善。

abstract.text: Environmental decisions often impact health, yet morbidity valuation remains challenging, with current approaches like cost-of-illness (COI) measures and Quality-Adjusted Life Years failing to reflect individuals’ willingness to pay to avoid adverse health states. This paper introduces a novel framework for valuing morbidity across health conditions, deriving willingness-to-pay (WTP) estimates using widely available preference weights and a baseline condition with known WTP. Our analysis reveals WTP estimates significantly exceeding commonly used COI measures, indicating undervaluation of health states in policy evaluations. Sensitivity analyses highlight variations consistent with those for the value of statistical life, underscoring the method's robustness. This framework offers a practical tool for integrating morbidity into analyses of environmental policy.

10.3386/w35420.abstractZh: 环境决策常常影响健康，但患病损失估值依然充满挑战，当前的方法如疾病成本法（COI）和质量调整生命年未能反映个体为避免不利健康状况而支付的意愿。本文引入了一个新颖的框架，用于跨健康状况估值患病损失，利用广泛可获得的偏好权重和一个已知支付意愿的基线状况来推导支付意愿（WTP）估计值。我们的分析揭示了WTP估计值显著超过常用的COI措施，表明政策评估中对健康状况的低估。敏感性分析突出了与统计生命价值一致的变化，强调了该方法的稳健性。这一框架提供了一个实用的工具，用于将患病损失整合到环境政策分析中。

abstract.text: Vehicle inspections—commonly known as smog and safety checks—are often delegated to private agents, much like other quality certification markets. When these agents compete, they face incentives to misreport quality—especially when consumers do not internalize the external costs of misreporting. Theory and evidence from Chile’s concentrated vehicle-inspection markets suggest that these incentives are significant: misreporting emerges as soon as competition is introduced. We find that delegating each market to a single agent proves effective in reducing approval rates, without compromising service quality or the ex-ante competition for the market, while delivering substantial and permanent reductions in vehicle emissions.

10.3386/w35422.abstractZh: 车辆检查——通常被称为尾气与安全检测——通常委托给私人机构，就像其他质量认证市场一样。当这些机构竞争时，他们面临虚报质量的动机——特别是当消费者没有内化虚报的外部成本时。来自智利集中的车辆检查市场的理论和证据表明，这些动机是显著的：一旦引入竞争，虚报行为就会出现。我们发现，将每个市场委托给单一机构可以有效地降低通过率，同时不影响服务质量或市场的事前竞争，同时实现车辆排放的大幅且永久性减少。

abstract.text: We examine the importance of hospital quality, patient selection, and congestion in affecting equilibrium health outcomes, using Covid-19 pandemic data. Our main outcome is mortality, controlling for unobserved selection with distance instruments. Intensive care unit strain increased hospital mortality: without congestion, deaths would fall 9.6%. Patients value hospitals with high baseline quality, but their choices did not reflect capacity strain information. Equilibrium counterfactuals show that if patients were informed about capacity strain and believed quality signals were more precise, deaths would drop 3.8%. However, using more precise information but not accounting for congestion would cause Covid-19 deaths to rise 3.8%.

10.3386/w35426.abstractZh: 我们利用新冠疫情数据，研究了医院质量、患者选择和拥挤对均衡健康结果的影响，主要结果指标是死亡率，通过距离工具变量控制了未观察到的选择。重症监护室的拥挤增加了医院死亡率：如果没有拥挤，死亡人数将减少9.6%。患者重视基线质量高的医院，但他们的选择并未反映容量压力信息。均衡反事实分析表明，如果患者被告知容量压力，并相信质量信号更加精确，死亡人数将下降3.8%。然而，使用更精确的信息但不考虑到拥挤将导致新冠死亡人数增加3.8%。

abstract.text: We study the effect of drug decriminalization on overdose mortality using Oregon's Measure 110 and Washington's Blake decision. Synthetic-control estimates show that both decriminalization regimes sharply reduced drug arrests and were followed by sustained increases in overdose mortality relative to matched counterfactuals. The estimates imply approximately 1,186 excess deaths in Oregon and 1,895 in Washington from 2021 through 2023. We also revisit the role of fentanyl supply shocks. A fentanyl-share control may partly capture enforcement-driven declines in non-fentanyl NFLIS reports, while alternative fentanyl measures leave positive overdose effects.

10.3386/w35427.abstractZh: 我们利用俄勒冈州的第110号措施和华盛顿州的布莱克决定来研究毒品非刑事化对药物过量死亡的影响。合成控制估计显示，这两种非刑事化制度都大幅减少了毒品逮捕，并随之而来的是与匹配的反事实情况相比，药物过量死亡持续增加。这些估计意味着从2021年到2023年，俄勒冈州大约有1,186例超额死亡，华盛顿州有1,895例。我们还重新审视了芬太尼供应冲击的作用。芬太尼占比控制变量可能部分捕捉了执法驱动的非芬太尼NFLIS报告的下降，而其他芬太尼措施则留下了正面的药物过量效应。
