abstract.text: This study explores the effects of COVID-19 school closures on labor market outcomes of Canadian parents of school-aged children. Using newly collected data on grade-level-specific school closures across 141 Canadian cities along with individual-level panel data from the Labour Force Survey, difference-in-differences estimates provide robust evidence that restrictions on in-person schooling reduced employment among partnered mothers of school-aged children by approximately 2 percentage points. For fathers, labor supply adjustments are much weaker and concentrated on single fathers. Finally, auxiliary analyses using administrative tax records provide suggestive evidence that school closures increased public benefit receipt among single parents.

10.3386/w35432.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了COVID-19学校关闭对加拿大学龄儿童父母劳动力市场结果的影响。利用新收集的覆盖141个加拿大城市的年级特定学校关闭数据以及来自劳动力调查的个体层面面板数据，双重差分估计提供了强有力的证据，表明对面对面学校教育的限制使有伴侣的学龄儿童母亲的就业率降低了约2个百分点。对于父亲而言，劳动力供应调整要弱得多，且主要集中在单身父亲身上。最后，使用行政税务记录进行的辅助分析提供了暗示性证据，表明学校关闭增加了单身父母的公共福利领取。

abstract.text: This paper examines the choice between public and private healthcare systems among elderly veterans, who are dually eligible to obtain care through the publicly operated Veterans Health Administration (VA) and through private providers financed by Medicare. We analyze health system choice among veterans who move across areas with differing rates of VA utilization to quantify the relative importance of individual-specific factors (e.g., preferences, income, health) and place-specific factors (e.g., local access, quality, and convenience). Our estimates indicate that 50–60% of geographic variation in VA use is attributable to demand-side individual factors, with the remainder explained by place-based factors. We also document important heterogeneity across types of care, with place-based factors playing a larger role for inpatient and emergency care than for outpatient and primary care. Additional analysis suggests that the supply-side features emphasized in recent legislation—distance to VA facilities and wait times—explain only a small share of estimated place effects. These findings highlight the importance of individual factors in health system choice and have implications for policies aimed at reducing geographic disparities in VA utilization.

10.3386/w35440.abstractZh: 本文研究了老年退伍军人在公共和私人医疗系统之间的选择，他们有资格通过公共运营的退伍军人健康管理局（VA）和由医疗保险资助的私人提供者获得护理。我们分析了在不同VA使用率地区迁移的退伍军人中的健康系统选择，以量化个体特定因素（例如，偏好、收入、健康）和地点特定因素（例如，当地获取、质量和便利性）的相对重要性。我们的估计表明，地理差异中VA使用量的50-60%归因于需求侧个体因素，其余由基于地点的因素解释。我们还记录了不同类型护理中的重要异质性，基于地点的因素在住院和急诊护理中的作用比门诊和初级护理更大。额外的分析表明，最近立法强调的供给侧特征——到VA设施的距离和等待时间——只解释了估计地点效应的一小部分。这些发现强调了个体因素在健康系统选择中的重要性，并对旨在减少VA使用地理差异的政策具有启示。

abstract.text: I study insurance markets in which scalable prediction, like AI, designs residual risk rather than merely classifies fixed risk. A complete-contracting benchmark shows that if prevention is observable, contractible, competitively supplied, and fully priced, it does not matter whether consumers, insurers, or vendors supply it. Adverse selection breaks such irrelevance. When high-risk consumers are more "AI-treatable," efficient prevention makes low-risk contracts attractive to them. A contract intended for low-risk consumers faces a risk-design trilemma: separate, prevent efficiently, or avoid cross-subsidy, but not all three. The result extends Rothschild-Stiglitz from distorted coverage to distorted risk-control technology and offers market design insights of AI in insurance markets.

10.3386/w35444.abstractZh: 我研究了可扩展预测（如人工智能）设计剩余风险而不仅仅是分类固定风险的保险市场。一个完全契约的基准表明，如果预防措施是可观察的、可契约化的、竞争性供应的，并且完全定价，那么无论是消费者、保险公司还是供应商提供预防措施都无关紧要。逆向选择打破了这种无关紧要。当高风险消费者更“易于AI治疗”时，有效的预防措施使得低风险合同对他们具有吸引力。一个针对低风险消费者的合同面临一个风险设计三难困境：分离、有效预防或避免交叉补贴，但不能同时做到这三点。这一结果将罗斯柴尔德-斯蒂格利茨模型从扭曲的覆盖扩展到扭曲的风险控制技术，并提供了人工智能在保险市场中市场设计的洞见。

abstract.text: The federal government appropriated $189.5 billion in pandemic aid to school districts through the Elementary and Secondary School Emergency Relief (ESSER) fund. We evaluate their impact on schools with district poverty shares near 5%, where a threshold-driven increase in funds enables us to implement a difference-in-discontinuities design. Federal funds were passed on to residents through reductions in local revenue collections, including property taxes, and did not result in increased per-pupil expenditures by school districts. We find no evidence that additional funds mitigated the declines in test scores. We provide suggestive evidence that political engagement, especially from parents, increased in districts that qualified for additional funds. This combination of engagement and reduced taxation may explain the greater enrollment and faster reopening we observe in such districts.

10.3386/w35447.abstractZh: 联邦政府通过小学和中学紧急救助（ESSER）基金向学区拨款1895亿美元作为疫情援助。我们评估了这些资金对贫困比例接近5%的学区的影响，其中由于资金门槛的提高，我们得以实施差异中的不连续设计。联邦资金通过减少地方收入收集，包括财产税，传递给了居民，并且没有导致学区增加每个学生的支出。我们没有发现额外资金缓解了考试成绩下降的证据。我们提供了暗示性的证据，表明在获得额外资金资格的学区，政治参与度，尤其是来自家长的参与度有所增加。这种参与度的提高和税收的减少可能解释了我们在这些学区观察到的更大的入学人数和更快的重新开放。

abstract.text: We investigate the short- and long-run impacts of unexpected mortality on psychosocial health in the context of a large-scale high-mortality natural disaster, the 2004 Indian Ocean earthquake and tsunami. The effects of the tsunami-related mortality measured at the community level are contrasted with the effects of individual-specific loss of close kin using population-representative longitudinal survey data from the Study of the Tsunami Aftermath and Recovery. In the short-run, two years post-tsunami, both community and individual-level mortality exposures are significant predictors of elevated depression and post-traumatic stress symtoms. In the longer-run, ten years post-tsunami, individual-level exposures are slightly attenuated but remain significant predictors of both psychosocial health measures; in contrast, community-level mortality predicts post-traumatic stress but not depression symptoms. Mortality is linked to smaller household sizes in the short- and long-run and to less social support in the long-run, although the latter effect differs substantially for males and females. The estimates adjust for other tsunami exposure measures and, in the individual-level analyses, we compare people living in the same community at the time of the tsunami who were exposed to the same community-level mortality rate.

10.3386/w35462.abstractZh: 我们研究了在大规模高死亡率自然灾害——2004年印度洋地震和海啸的背景下，意外死亡对心理社会健康的短期和长期影响。我们使用代表性人口的纵向调查数据，即海啸后果和恢复研究的数据，对比了社区层面的海啸相关死亡影响与个体特定近亲丧失的影响。在短期，即海啸发生后两年，社区和个体层面的死亡暴露都是预测抑郁症状和创伤后应激症状升高的显著因素。在长期，即海啸发生后十年，个体层面的暴露略有减弱，但仍然是预测两种心理社会健康指标的显著因素；相比之下，社区层面的死亡预测了创伤后应激症状而非抑郁症状。死亡与短期和长期内更小的家庭规模以及长期内更少的社会支持相关联，尽管后者对男性和女性的影响差异很大。这些估计调整了其他海啸暴露措施，并且在个体层面的分析中，我们比较了海啸发生时居住在同一社区、暴露于相同社区死亡率的人们。

abstract.text: U.S. life expectancy stagnated and declined in the 2010s despite continued growth in real per capita income. We use Preston curves to characterize this pattern as a change in the relationship between income and longevity. Using state-level data from 1980 to 2019 and county-level data from 2000 to 2019, we estimate population-weighted Preston curves relating life expectancy to logged real per capita income. From 1980 to 2010, U.S. states followed the classic Preston curve pattern: rising income was accompanied by rising life expectancy. Counties followed the same pattern from 2000 to 2010. From 2010 to 2019, however, states and counties continued to become richer while life expectancy stagnated or declined. The curves shifted right without shifting up and became steeper, indicating decoupling and divergence: increases in aggregate resources over time no longer produced broad longevity gains, and, in any given year, inequality in life expectancy by income grew. These patterns are robust to alternative temporal anchors around the Great Recession and to substituting education for income. They also appear across sex and racial groups. County-level decompositions are broadly consistent with arguments that longevity has fallen due to widely shared exposures to social deterioration, which may account for the Preston curve reversal. Collectively, we show that the recent U.S. mortality crisis reveals a weakening—and growing inequality—in the conversion of aggregate resources into longevity gains. We conclude that the recent U.S. mortality crisis could be understood not only as a story about particular causes of death, but also as a weakening of institutional and social translation.

10.3386/w35470.abstractZh: 尽管实际人均收入持续增长，但美国在2010年代的预期寿命却停滞不前甚至下降。我们使用普雷斯顿曲线来描述这种模式，即收入与长寿之间的关系发生了变化。利用1980年至2019年的州级数据和2000年至2019年的县级数据，我们估算了将预期寿命与实际人均收入对数关联起来的人口加权普雷斯顿曲线。从1980年到2010年，美国各州遵循了经典的普雷斯顿曲线模式：收入的增长伴随着预期寿命的增长。从2000年到2010年，县级也遵循了相同的模式。然而，从2010年到2019年，各州和县继续变得更加富裕，而预期寿命却停滞不前或下降。曲线向右移动而没有向上移动，并变得更陡峭，表明脱钩和发散：随着时间的推移，总体资源的增加不再产生广泛的长寿收益，而在任何给定年份，按收入划分的预期寿命不平等增长。这些模式对于大衰退前后的替代时间锚点以及用教育替代收入都是稳健的。它们也出现在性别和种族群体中。县级分解与以下论点大体一致：由于广泛暴露于社会恶化，长寿已经下降，这可能解释了普雷斯顿曲线的逆转。总体而言，我们表明，美国近期的死亡危机揭示了将总体资源转化为长寿收益的能力减弱以及不平等的增长。我们得出结论，美国近期的死亡危机不仅可以理解为特定死亡原因的故事，也可以理解为制度和社会转化能力的减弱。

abstract.text: Many previous studies have used cross-cohort comparisons and a focus on in utero exposure to document the lingering effects of the 1918 influenza pandemic on survivors’ outcomes later in life. A subset has examined impacts on old-age health and mortality, finding mixed results. This paper contributes to the literature by extending the analysis to evaluate early-life and childhood exposure to the pandemic on old-age longevity along with a set of candidate mechanisms. We employ Social Security Administration death records linked to the full-count 1940 census and employ event-study and difference-in-difference regressions to compare longevity of cohorts with different age-at-exposure who were born in cities with high versus low exposure based on 1918 influenza-related mortality. Our treatment-on-treated calculations suggest that cohorts with age-at-exposure of 3-8 and 9-11 experience 6.4 and 11.2 months reductions in old age longevity; importantly, we note that these cohorts are often used as “controls” in the broader literature. While our main analysis focuses on males due to data constraints, supplementary results suggest smaller and less precise effects for females. An analysis of census data suggests reductions in health, education and socioeconomic scores as potential mechanisms.

10.3386/w35471.abstractZh: 许多先前的研究通过跨队列比较和关注宫内暴露，记录了1918年流感大流行对幸存者后来生活中持续影响的证据。其中一部分研究了对老年健康和死亡率的影响，发现结果不一。本文通过扩展分析，评估了大流行早期生活和儿童时期暴露对老年寿命的影响，以及一系列可能的机制。我们利用社会保障管理局的死亡记录，与1940年的全数人口普查数据相链接，并采用事件研究和双重差分回归方法，比较了不同暴露年龄队列的寿命，这些队列出生在1918年流感相关死亡率高和低的城市。我们对处理组处理效应的计算表明，3-8岁和9-11岁暴露年龄的队列在老年寿命上分别减少了6.4个月和11.2个月；重要的是，我们注意到这些队列在更广泛的文献中经常被用作“对照组”。虽然我们的主要分析由于数据限制而集中在男性身上，但补充结果表明女性的影响较小且不够精确。对普查数据的分析表明，健康、教育和社会经济得分的降低可能是潜在的机制。

abstract.text: We estimate the causal impacts of GLP-1 treatment on labor market outcomes using linked Danish administrative data and a matched stacked difference-in-differences design. We compare patients who initiate GLP-1 treatment during the first two years of Semaglutide availability to observably similar patients who initiate four years later. We find that GLP-1 treatment reduces long-term sickness leave by 17.3%. We estimate total fiscal benefits of GLP-1 initiation of approximately 1.3–1.5% of annual labor income per employed individual. We do not detect statistically significant or economically meaningful impacts on income, labor force participation, or employment over four years.

10.3386/w35475.abstractZh: 我们利用丹麦的行政数据和匹配堆叠双重差分设计，估计GLP-1治疗对劳动力市场结果的因果影响。我们将在Semaglutide可用的前两年开始GLP-1治疗的患者与四年后开始治疗的可观察相似患者进行比较。我们发现GLP-1治疗使长期病假减少了17.3%。我们估计GLP-1治疗启动的总财政收益大约相当于每位就业个体年劳动力收入的1.3-1.5%。我们没有检测到对收入、劳动力参与或就业在四年内有统计学意义或经济意义的影响。

abstract.text: Health shocks are a major driver of retirement. However, the existing literature on this topic tends not to consider the marital context in which retirements occur. Using the 1992-2022 Health and Retirement Study and staggered difference-in-differences methods, we investigate how spousal health shocks impact retirement transitions. We also investigate whether these effects differ by gender and health insurance status. We consider multiple definitions of health shocks, including self-reported health declines, additional diagnoses, hospitalizations, increases in out-of-pocket medical spending, and functional deterioration. Our results suggest that the probability of retirement increases by 1.2 to 1.3 percentage points (12 to 13 percent) after a spouse’s new health condition diagnosis or hospitalization. These retirements tend to occur earlier than anticipated. They also tend to be concentrated among women and respondents with employment-based health plans that include retiree coverage for their spouse.

10.3386/w35477.abstractZh: 健康冲击是退休的主要驱动因素之一。然而，现有关于该主题的文献往往不考虑退休发生的婚内环境。利用1992-2022年健康与退休研究数据和交错双重差分方法，我们研究了配偶健康冲击对退休过渡的影响。我们还探讨了这些效应是否因性别和健康保险状况而异。我们考虑了健康冲击的多种定义，包括自报健康下降、额外诊断、住院、自付医疗费用增加和功能恶化。我们的结果显示，在配偶新健康状况诊断或住院后，退休的概率增加了1.2至1.3个百分点（12%至13%）。这些退休往往比预期更早发生。它们也往往集中在女性和拥有包括配偶退休人员医疗保障在内的就业相关健康保险计划的受访者中。

abstract.text: One way of examining how mental health has changed over time is to use information available in large national surveys. While these survey-based measures are valuable in principle, and have been widely employed in prior research, a number of challenges may limit their practical usefulness or require considerable care in their application. This study uses data on U.S. 18-64 year olds from five major household surveys over the period 1999-2019 to investigate three specific questions. First, do different measures or the same indicator from different data sets consistently show how mental distress has changed over time? Second, how does the performance of single-item measures compare to those of psychometrically validated screeners based on multiple questions? Third, what are the benefits or potential costs of using different functional forms of these measures? The answers to these questions are as follows: 1) the estimated trends vary, often dramatically, across measures and, for the same indicator, across data sets and, as a result, some proxies provide a misleading understanding of how mental health has changed over time; 2) the single-item measures do as well or better than those based on multiple questions; 3) no single functional form demonstrates clear superiority over the others. After demonstrating these points, lessons are elucidated for researchers attempting to use survey data to examine trends in mental health.

10.3386/w35480.abstractZh: 通过大型国家调查中可获得的信息来检视心理健康随时间的变化是一种方法。虽然这些基于调查的度量原则上很有价值，并且在以往的研究中得到了广泛应用，但一些挑战可能限制了它们的实际效用，或要求在应用时必须非常小心。本研究利用1999-2019年间五个主要家庭调查中关于美国18-64岁人群的数据，探讨三个具体问题。首先，不同的度量或不同数据集中的同一指标是否一致地显示出随时间变化的心理痛苦？其次，单项度量的表现与基于多个问题的心理测量学验证筛选工具相比如何？第三，使用这些度量的不同功能形式的好处或潜在成本是什么？这些问题的答案如下：1）估计的趋势在度量间，以及对于同一指标，在不同数据集间差异很大，因此，一些代理变量提供了对心理健康随时间变化的误导性理解；2）单项度量的表现与基于多个问题的度量一样好或更好；3）没有任何单一功能形式显示出明显优于其他形式。在展示这些要点后，为研究人员提供了使用调查数据来检视心理健康趋势的教训。

abstract.text: Buyers of complex goods and services often rely on the advice of expert intermediaries who are themselves imperfectly informed about the quality of the available options. How well do these intermediaries learn about that quality and act on it? We study this question in the setting of referrals from primary care physicians (PCPs) to specialists, using data on 4.5 million joint replacement surgeries for Medicare beneficiaries. We first document substantial heterogeneity in specialist quality and costs within geographic markets, and we present design-based evidence showing that PCPs adjust their referrals specifically based on the outcomes of their own patients. We then employ a structural learning model of PCP referral choices to quantify the losses from informational frictions and to simulate possible reallocations with improved information. Beyond learning, the model also accounts for limitations on possible reallocations due to habit persistence and capacity constraints. We find that about one-quarter of patients would be referred to a different specialist in the absence of informational frictions, with small but meaningful improvements in patient outcomes.

10.3386/w35486.abstractZh: 购买复杂商品和服务的消费者经常依赖专家中介的建议，而这些中介本身对可用选择的质量了解有限。这些中介对质量的了解程度如何，又是如何据此行动的？我们以初级保健医生（PCP）向专家转诊的情况为研究背景，使用450万例针对Medicare 受益者的关节置换手术数据来探讨这一问题。我们首先记录了在地理市场中专家质量和成本的显著异质性，并提出了基于设计的证据，表明PCP根据自己患者的结果调整转诊。然后，我们采用结构化的学习模型来量化信息摩擦造成的损失，并模拟在信息改善下可能的重新分配。除了学习之外，该模型还考虑了由于习惯持续性和能力限制而对可能的重新分配的限制。我们发现，在没有信息摩擦的情况下，大约四分之一的患者会被转诊给不同的专家，患者结果会有小幅但有意义的改善。

abstract.text: This paper explores how diagnostic thresholds and a written consent requirement affect decision making between patients and transplant surgeons regarding the use of deceased donor kidneys. Combining administrative data on the universe of organ donors and transplant recipients in the United States, we show that age-based discontinuities within the Expanded Criteria Donor system (ECD), which was in place from late 2002 to late 2014, led to 4.0 and 5.4 percentage point differences in the rates at which otherwise indistinguishable kidneys were discarded. A discontinuity within the subsequent presentation of the Kidney Donor Profile Index (KDPI) led to a 2.6 percentage point difference. We present evidence that diagnostic thresholds have nuanced effects on decision making and information acquisition; procurement biopsy rates, for example, rose substantially at the ECD system’s age-based discontinuities. We further show that written consent requirements triggered within the ECD and KDPI labeling systems substantially reduced the number of potential recipients to whom kidneys were offered prior to being discarded. This channel can explain the majority of the increased rate at which “High-KDPI” kidneys are discarded under the current system.

10.3386/w35489.abstractZh: 本文探讨了诊断阈值和书面同意要求如何影响患者和移植外科医生之间关于使用已故捐献者肾脏的决策。结合美国所有器官捐献者和移植接受者的行政数据，我们展示了2002年末至2014年末实施的扩大标准捐献者（ECD）体系中基于年龄的不连续性，导致在其他方面无法区分的肾脏被丢弃的比率出现了4.0和5.4个百分点的差异。在随后呈现的肾脏捐献者档案指数（KDPI）中的不连续性导致了2.6个百分点的差异。我们提供的证据表明，诊断阈值对决策制定和信息获取有着微妙的影响；例如，在ECD体系基于年龄的不连续性处，获取活检的比率显著上升。我们进一步表明，在ECD和KDPI标签体系中触发的书面同意要求大幅减少了在肾脏被丢弃前向潜在接受者提供肾脏的数量。这一渠道可以解释在当前体系下“高KDPI”肾脏被丢弃的比率增加的大部分原因。

abstract.text: When a new technology promises large private benefits but may impose social costs that markets do not price, demand need not reveal how citizens want it governed. We examine this using a nationally representative U.S. survey experiment (N=5,556) on human enhancement technologies (HET). The experiment randomizes benefit domain, mechanism, heritability, purpose, and risk across vignettes; for each respondent’s assigned vignette, we elicit stated adoption, preferred regulation, and ethical and societal concerns. Overall, about 53% would adopt. Framing the technology as enhancing rather than restorative lowers adoption by about five percentage points, as much as a severe side-effect profile. About 28% would not adopt at any benefit. This refusal is driven overwhelmingly by the enhancing framing rather than by risk, consistent with a non-compensatory constraint for a substantial subgroup. Most who would adopt still favor strict regulation, and most who would never adopt do not wish to forbid others from doing so. Productivity enhancement generates the most ethical concern of any attribute but attracts the least regulation, and respondents favor subsidizing rather than taxing its adoption, consistent with a concern about access rather than safety. Private demand is therefore an unreliable guide to the governance citizens want, and the divergence we document provides a basis for regulators seeking to align the direction of technical change with societal values and priorities.

10.3386/w35495.abstractZh: 当一项新技术承诺带来巨大的私人利益，但可能强加市场无法定价的社会成本时，需求并不揭示公民希望如何对其进行治理。我们利用一个全国代表性的美国调查实验（N=5556）来检验这一点，该实验关注人类增强技术（HET）。实验在情景描述中随机化了效益领域、机制、遗传性、目的和风险；对于每位受访者分配的情景描述，我们征询了声明的采纳意愿、偏好的监管以及伦理和社会关切。总体而言，约53%的人会选择采纳。将技术框架定位为增强型而非修复型，会降低约五个百分点的采纳率，与严重的副作用概况相当。约28%的人无论如何都不会采纳。这种拒绝主要由增强型框架而非风险驱动，与一个相当大的子群体的非补偿性约束一致。大多数愿意采纳的人仍然倾向于严格的监管，而大多数永远不会采纳的人不希望禁止他人这样做。在所有属性中，生产力增强引发了最多的伦理关切，但吸引了最少的监管，受访者倾向于补贴而非征税其采纳，与对获取而非安全的关切一致。因此，私人需求是不可靠的指引，公民希望的治理方向，我们记录的分歧为寻求将技术变革方向与社会价值观和优先事项对齐的监管者提供了依据。

abstract.text: Physicians in the U.S. military health care system are quasi-randomly assigned to combat deployments, leading to gaps of varying durations in their clinical practice. We leverage this unique setting to provide novel causal evidence on skill depreciation (forgetting) and learning-by-doing among physicians. We find robust evidence that readmission rates increase by 48% in the first two months after a surgeon returns from a deployment. However, surgeons return to baseline performance within 6 months of resuming practice. In contrast, obstetricians maintain elevated cesarean section rates for up to 9 months, implying a deeper change in clinical judgment. Finally, we interpret these patterns through the lens of a learning model and estimate learning-by-doing rates for surgeons and obstetricians. A doubling of recent procedure volume reduces readmission and C-section rates by 17% and 11% for surgeons and obstetricians, respectively.

10.3386/w35502.abstractZh: 美国军事医疗保健系统中的医生被准随机分配到战斗部署中，导致他们在临床实践中出现不同持续时间的空档。我们利用这一独特的环境，为医生的技能折旧（遗忘）和“干中学”提供了新的因果证据。我们发现有力的证据表明，外科医生从部署返回后，在前两个月内再入院率增加了48%。然而，外科医生在恢复实践后的6个月内恢复到基线表现。相比之下，产科医生在长达9个月内维持较高的剖宫产率，意味着临床判断发生了更深层次的变化。最后，我们通过学习模型的视角解释这些模式，并估计外科医生和产科医生的“干中学”比率。最近手术量的翻倍降低了外科医生和产科医生的再入院率和剖宫产率，分别为17%和11%。

abstract.text: This paper examines the long-term effects of early-life exposure to county health departments (CHDs), a public health initiative aimed at providing affordable healthcare access to disadvantaged and underserved areas during the early decades of the 20th century, on later-life longevity. We employ Social Security Administration death records linked with the 1940 census and implement a difference-in-differences estimation strategy to compare the longevity of individuals exposed at different ages to the county-specific year of CHD establishment. We find that exposure to a CHD opening in the county of birth during fetal development and early years of life is associated with a 1-4-month increase in longevity. We observe considerable heterogeneity in the results, such that the effects are more concentrated among non-white individuals and individuals with lower-educated parents. Contemporaneous fertility and infant mortality data suggest reductions in infant mortality rates and increases in birth rates following CHD openings. Additionally, we find significant improvements in educational attainment, socioeconomic status, and income in early adulthood. We argue that enhancements in the fetal environment, improved fetal survival, and better early life health capital resulting from CHD exposure contribute to improvements in human capital during adulthood, with potential implications for later-life longevity.

10.3386/w35533.abstractZh: 本文研究了20世纪初旨在为弱势和未得到充分服务的地区提供可负担的医疗保健服务的公共卫生计划——县级卫生部门（CHDs）——对个体晚年寿命的长期影响。我们利用社会保障管理局的死亡记录与1940年人口普查数据，采用双重差分估计策略，比较不同年龄暴露于CHDs建立年份的个体寿命。我们发现，在出生县的胎儿发育期和生命早期暴露于CHDs的开设与寿命增加1-4个月相关。我们观察到结果中存在相当大的异质性，即这些效应在非白人个体和受教育程度较低的父母所生的个体中更为集中。同期的生育和婴儿死亡率数据显示，CHDs开设后婴儿死亡率降低，出生率增加。此外，我们还发现在成年早期教育成就、社会经济地位和收入有显著改善。我们认为，由于CHDs暴露导致的胎儿环境改善、胎儿存活率提高以及早期生活健康资本的改善，有助于成年期间人力资本的提升，可能对晚年寿命有潜在影响。

abstract.text: Financial incentives may encourage vaccination, but their cost-effectiveness depends on targeting patients who are most responsive. We conducted a randomized controlled trial with 57,579 adult patients in an integrated health system during the 2021–2022 influenza season. Patients with an upcoming appointment were randomized to a no-contact control, a simple reminder, a $1 cash incentive, or a scratch-off lottery ticket incentive worth up to $5,000. Any active intervention increased vaccination at the scheduled appointment by 2 percentage points (an 8% increase over the control mean) and by 1.5 percentage points over the full influenza season. The three active arms did not differ significantly, indicating that small financial incentives provided no additional benefit beyond a reminder. Using electronic health records and area-level characteristics, we used causal forests to estimate conditional average treatment effects. Predicted responsiveness varied substantially: patients in the top quartile were 3–4 times more likely to respond to incentives than those in the bottom quartile, whereas reminder effects were relatively homogeneous. These findings suggest that low-cost reminders can increase influenza vaccination, while machine-learning methods can help identify patients most responsive to small financial incentives.

10.3386/w35537.abstractZh: 财政激励可能鼓励接种疫苗，但其成本效益取决于对最易响应的患者进行针对性激励。我们在2021-2022年流感季节期间，对一个综合健康系统中的57,579名成年患者进行了随机对照试验。即将有预约的患者被随机分配到无接触对照组、简单提醒组、1美元现金激励组或价值高达5000美元的即开型彩票激励组。任何积极的干预措施都将预定预约时的接种率提高了2个百分点（比控制组均值增加了8%），在整个流感季节中提高了1.5个百分点。三个积极干预组之间没有显著差异，表明小额财政激励并没有比提醒提供额外的好处。我们利用电子健康记录和地区级特征，使用因果森林估计条件平均处理效应。预测的响应性差异很大：处于顶部四分之一的患者对激励的响应可能性是底部四分之一患者的3-4倍，而提醒效果相对均匀。这些发现表明，低成本的提醒可以增加流感疫苗接种，而机器学习方法可以帮助识别对小额财政激励最敏感的患者。

abstract.text: Unnecessary treatment reflects a gap between what patients believe about their health and their true condition; people often seek and consume care for diseases they suspect, but do not know that actually have. The value a patient places on testing therefore depends on their priors about being sick, and when those beliefs are biased, the resulting testing rate might be sub-optimal and leave welfare on the table. We study diagnosis-contingent incentive contracts, which tie treatment incentives to diagnostic results. For malaria, the contract subsidizes rapid diagnostic tests (RDTs) and antimalarials (ACTs) only for patients who test positive. In a cluster-randomized experiment across 140 Kenyan pharmacies, both patient subsidies and provider incentives roughly tripled testing and sharply reduced unnecessary ACT purchases among test-negative patients, working through distinct channels: patient subsidies through lower prices, provider incentives through information and advice. A model of patient choice implies these contracts raise social welfare well above their cost. Estimating the model structurally, we find that because patients substantially overestimate their infection risk, loading incentives onto diagnosis-contingent treatment discounts delivers four times the welfare gains of free testing programs.

10.3386/w35543.abstractZh: 不必要的治疗反映了患者对其健康状况的信念与实际情况之间的差距；人们经常寻求并消费他们怀疑自己患有的疾病的治疗，但实际上并不知道自己是否真的患有这些疾病。因此，患者对检测的价值取决于他们对生病的先验信念，当这些信念存在偏差时，由此产生的检测率可能是次优的，并且会留下未被利用的福利。我们研究了与诊断结果挂钩的激励合同，这些合同将治疗激励与诊断结果联系起来。对于疟疾，该合同只为检测呈阳性的患者补贴快速诊断检测（RDT）和抗疟药物（ACT）。在肯尼亚140家药店进行的群组随机实验中，患者补贴和供应商激励使检测率大致增加了三倍，并显著减少了检测阴性患者不必要的ACT购买，这些效果通过不同的渠道发挥作用：患者补贴通过降低价格，供应商激励通过提供信息和建议。患者选择模型意味着这些合同将社会福利提高到了远高于其成本的水平。通过结构性估计该模型，我们发现由于患者大幅高估了他们的感染风险，将激励加载到基于诊断的治疗方案折扣上，其福利收益是免费检测计划的四倍。

abstract.text: Clarity of responsibility is an essential element of political accountability. We develop a rational model of Bayesian updating in the presence of ambiguous attribution and we test its predictions using an original survey. We show that respondents’ partisanship, assessment of public healthcare quality, and beliefs over which layer of government is responsible for healthcare are correlated as predicted: good-assessment voters attribute responsibility to the layer governed by their preferred party, while bad-assessment voters blame the layer governed by the party they dislike. These partisan patterns of credit and blame, often interpreted as evidence of motivated reasoning or partisan bias, can thus arise from rational Bayesian updating under attribution ambiguity. No such partisan patterns exist where the same party is in charge of regional and central government. A survey experiment in which we inform subjects of the official quality of healthcare has them update in the predicted, partisan, direction. Model and empirical results show that partisan priors are extremely hard to dislodge when attribution is ambiguous.

10.3386/w35550.abstractZh: 责任明确性是政治问责制的一个基本要素。我们构建了一个在模糊归因情况下贝叶斯更新的理性模型，并使用一项原创调查来测试其预测。我们发现，受访者的党派身份、对公共医疗质量的评估以及对哪一层政府负责医疗保健的信念，如预测所示是相关的：对医疗质量评价高的选民将责任归咎于他们偏好的政党所控制的政府层级，而评价低的选民则将责任归咎于他们不喜欢的政党所控制的政府层级。这些党派性的赞誉和指责模式，通常被解释为动机推理或党派偏见的证据，因此可能源于在归因模糊性下的理性贝叶斯更新。在同一个政党同时控制区域和中央政府的情况下，不存在这样的党派模式。我们进行的一项调查实验中，当告知受访者官方医疗质量时，他们按照预测的党派方向更新信念。模型和实证结果表明，在归因模糊时，党派先验信念极难被动摇。

abstract.text: We use U.S. nationally representative longitudinal data to estimate the effects of cognitive and behavioral impairments in childhood on health in adulthood. We focus on work-limiting health conditions and fair or poor self-rated health but also consider adequacy of sleep, body weight, and health behaviors (use of various substances and preventive health care) as potential pathways. In household fixed effects models, we find that both impairments are strongly associated with having a work-limiting health condition in adulthood; specifically, cognitive impairments increase the probability of a work-limiting condition by 70% and behavioral impairments increase the probability by 60%. Individuals with cognitive impairments in childhood are 43% more likely to report being in fair or poor health in adulthood compared to individuals without cognitive impairments. The effects of cognitive impairments on health do not appear to operate through insufficient sleep, obesity, or health behaviors. Individuals with childhood behavioral impairments are no more likely to report being in fair or poor health but are more likely to get insufficient sleep and to be obese, compared to individuals without behavioral impairments, suggesting that insufficient sleep and obesity could potentially lie on the pathway from behavioral impairments in childhood to work-limiting health conditions in adulthood.

10.3386/w35566.abstractZh: 我们利用美国全国代表性的纵向数据来估计儿童时期认知和行为障碍对成年后健康的影响。我们重点关注限制工作的健康条件和自认为健康水平一般或较差的情况，同时也考虑睡眠充足性、体重和健康行为（使用各种物质和预防性健康护理）作为潜在的途径。在家庭固定效应模型中，我们发现这两种障碍都与成年后限制工作的健康条件强烈相关；具体来说，认知障碍使限制工作的条件的概率增加了70%，而行为障碍使这一概率增加了60%。与没有认知障碍的个体相比，儿童时期有认知障碍的个体在成年后报告自认为健康水平一般或较差的可能性高43%。认知障碍对健康的影响似乎并不通过睡眠不足、肥胖或健康行为来发挥作用。与没有行为障碍的个体相比，儿童时期有行为障碍的个体在成年后报告自认为健康水平一般或较差的可能性并不更高，但他们更有可能睡眠不足和肥胖，这表明睡眠不足和肥胖可能潜在地位于从儿童时期的行为障碍到成年后限制工作的健康条件的路径上。

abstract.text: How should payers balance fiscal sustainability with access to transformative medical technology? We study Louisiana’s 2019 Medicaid subscription model for hepatitis C (HCV), the first example of a U.S. state employing a two-part tariff to secure unlimited access to curative medicines. Using a differences-in-differences design comparing spending on beneficiaries with HCV to those with diabetes or HIV, we find that treatment volume tripled, medical spending fell, and new HCV diagnoses declined 23 percent. The state’s $37 million in incremental spending on antivirals generated $266 million in five-year savings. Innovative financing models can generate health benefits and near-term savings for payers.

10.3386/w35583.abstractZh: 支付方应如何平衡财政可持续性与获取变革性医疗技术之间的矛盾？我们研究了2019年路易斯安那州针对丙型肝炎（HCV）的医疗补助订阅模式，这是美国州政府首次采用两段式收费以确保对治愈性药物的无限访问。通过比较HCV患者与糖尿病或HIV患者的支出，使用双重差分设计，我们发现治疗量增加了三倍，医疗支出下降，新的HCV诊断减少了23%。该州在抗病毒药物上的额外支出3700万美元，在五年内节省了2.66亿美元。创新的融资模式可以为支付方带来健康效益和近期节省。

abstract.text: This study examines the persistence of fertility-related health problems across generations within the same family, and the utilization of assisted reproductive technologies (ART). Using comprehensive Swedish registry data, we document significant intergenerational transmission of fertility difficulties for both daughters and sons, independent of parental socioeconomic status. Daughters whose parents reported such problems are 2.6 percentage points, or 19.4 percent, more likely to experience fertility problems themselves. Sons whose parents reported fertility difficulties experience a 1.7 percentage point, or 13.5 percent, increase. These associations persist across alternative measures and samples. Comparing biological and adopted children raised in the same households, we find that this phenomenon is unlikely to be driven by family awareness of fertility issues, pointing to biological and other factors that biological children share with their parents but adopted children do not. Medical technology works equally well for those who use it, and we find no significant association between the success of advanced fertility treatments and parental backgrounds. However, past generations’ fertility difficulties are associated both with higher medical expenses and with social costs such as increased likelihood of divorce.

10.3386/w35585.abstractZh: 本研究考察了同一家庭内不同代际之间生育相关问题的持续性，以及辅助生殖技术（ART）的使用情况。利用瑞典全面的注册数据，我们记录了生育困难在女儿和儿子之间显著的代际传递现象，这一现象独立于父母的社会经济地位。父母报告存在此类问题的女儿，自身经历生育问题的可能性高出2.6个百分点，即增加了19.4%。父母报告生育困难的儿子，其经历生育问题的可能性增加了1.7个百分点，即增加了13.5%。这些关联在不同的度量和样本中持续存在。比较在相同家庭中抚养的亲生和领养子女，我们发现这一现象不太可能由家庭对生育问题的认知所驱动，这指向了生物学因素以及其他亲生子女与父母共有而领养子女没有的因素。医疗技术对使用者同样有效，我们发现先进的生育治疗成功率与父母背景之间没有显著关联。然而，前代的生育困难与更高的医疗费用和社会成本相关，例如离婚的可能性增加。

abstract.text: We examine how prenatal exposure to air pollution interacts with gender-biased parental investments to shape long-run cognitive performance. Using nationally representative survey data from China, we show that fetal PM2.5 exposure significantly reduces cognitive ability for women, particularly among those with brothers. Our evidence suggests that the family investment channel operates primarily through education rather than health, with gender-biased educational resource allocation compounding negative outcomes for females. Specifically, conditional on the same level of fetal PM2.5 exposure, females receive less homework assistance from their families and attain lower levels of education.

10.3386/w35591.abstractZh: 我们研究了产前暴露于空气污染如何与基于性别的家长投资相互作用，从而影响长期的认知表现。利用中国全国代表性的调查数据，我们发现胎儿期PM2.5暴露显著降低了女性的认知能力，特别是在有兄弟的女性中。我们的证据表明，家庭投资渠道主要通过教育而非健康运作，基于性别的教育资源分配加剧了女性的负面结果。具体来说，在胎儿期PM2.5暴露水平相同的情况下，女性从家庭中获得的作业帮助较少，教育水平也较低。

abstract.text: This paper examines the impact of the National Suicide Hotline Designation Act, which introduced the universal 988 calling code and earmarked federal funding to suicide crisis call centers in July 2022. We use a difference-in-differences design that leverages pre-existing cross-state variation in crisis line capacity gaps, measured by the number of pre-988 calls routed to a state but not answered in-state. The rollout substantially improved crisis line operations in states with larger baseline capacity gaps: these states answered more calls in-state and increased their in-state answer rates. However, these operational gains did not translate into detectable reductions in suicide mortality. The mortality estimates are precise enough to rule out even modest short-run reductions. We also find no statistically significant improvements in broader population mental health outcomes. These findings suggest that expanding crisis line capacity alone may be insufficient to reduce suicide deaths.

10.3386/w35601.abstractZh: 本文考察了《国家自杀热线指定法案》的影响，该法案于2022年7月引入了统一的988呼叫代码，并为自杀危机呼叫中心预留了联邦资金。我们采用了双重差分设计，利用危机线路容量缺口的跨州变化，以988之前的呼叫被路由到一个州但在州内未被接听的数量来衡量。这一推广显著改善了基线容量缺口较大的州的危机线路运营：这些州在州内接听了更多的电话，并提高了州内的接听率。然而，这些运营上的收益并没有转化为可检测的自杀死亡率降低。死亡率的估计足够精确，可以排除即使是适度的短期降低。我们还发现，在更广泛的人口心理健康结果方面没有统计学上显著的改善。这些发现表明，仅扩大危机线路容量可能不足以减少自杀死亡。

abstract.text: By age 17, a quarter of U.S. students have experienced a peer suicide. Using linked administrative data from South Carolina and a matched difference-in-differences design, we find that exposure to a peer's self-harm death increases the probability of a self-harm diagnosis by nearly 50% and both the incidence and frequency of mental health visits. Effects on care use and criminal behavior are concentrated among white boys, and responses diverge by prior mental health history: students without a prior diagnosis increase felony offending rather than care-seeking. Deaths from assault and transportation accidents produce no comparable rise in self-harm, consistent with contagion.

10.3386/w35603.abstractZh: 到17岁时，四分之一的美国学生经历了同伴自杀。利用南卡罗来纳州的关联行政数据和匹配的双重差分设计，我们发现暴露于同伴自伤死亡事件中，会使得自伤诊断的概率增加近50%，同时心理健康状况就诊的发生率和频率也有所增加。对医疗使用和犯罪行为的影响主要集中在白人男孩中，且根据先前的心理健康状况，反应有所不同：没有先前诊断的学生更倾向于增加重罪犯罪而不是寻求医疗帮助。来自袭击和交通事故的死亡并没有导致自伤行为的类似增加，这与传染效应一致。

abstract.text: In this paper, we compare supplemental Medicare insurance coverage among people with probable dementia (PWPD) and matched controls, before and after onset. This retrospective secondary data analysis of insurance coverage changes using propensity score weights and the 2000-2016 Health and Retirement Study (HRS). The sample consists of 3,001 Medicare-enrolled adults age 65 and older with PWPD, and 14,055 controls. Probable dementia is assessed with the Langa-Weir approach and interviewer assessments for proxy interviews. Four years before onset, PWPD become more likely to have Medicare without supplemental coverage (2.97 percentage points; p=0.0016) than matched controls. This reflects the net effect of PWPD being less likely to have Medicare Advantage or traditional Medicare with supplemental coverage, and more likely to have Medicaid. Two years before onset, PWPD were more likely to be Medicaid-eligible (4.95 percentage points, p<0.001), but take-up rates were comparable. Enrollment assistance may improve supplemental coverage for PWPD around dementia onset, potentially increasing financial access to care.

10.3386/w35606.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们比较了可能患有痴呆症（PWPD）的人群与匹配对照组在发病前后的补充医疗保险覆盖情况。这项利用倾向得分权重和2000-2016年健康与退休研究（HRS）数据进行的保险覆盖变化的回顾性次级数据分析。样本包括3001名65岁及以上已注册Medicare的PWPD成年人，以及14055名对照组。通过Langa-Weir方法和代理访谈的访谈者评估来评估可能的痴呆症。在发病前四年，与匹配对照组相比，PWPD更有可能拥有无补充覆盖的Medicare（2.97个百分点；p=0.0016）。这反映了PWPD不太可能拥有Medicare优势或带有补充覆盖的传统Medicare，而更有可能拥有Medicaid。在发病前两年，PWPD更有可能符合Medicaid资格（4.95个百分点，p<0.001），但申领率是可比的。注册援助可能会改善PWPD在痴呆症发病前后的补充覆盖，潜在地增加获得护理的财务途径。

abstract.text: Theories of outsourcing often presume that private firms are more efficient producers of goods and services, but that contracting frictions mean that firms do not internalize the government's objective function. But perhaps, for some tasks, the government can actually be more productively efficient? We study this question through an experiment in Chennai, India, where the government randomly selected neighborhoods to have property tax assessments determined by private firms contracted by the government, rather than government tax inspectors. We show that inspections by government tax inspectors yielded almost double the increase in tax revenue as those done by private firms. They were also more accurate, as judged by comparing new assessments to independent assessments done by third-party surveyors we hired. Difficulties contracting with the government discouraged many competent firms from bidding. Perhaps as a result, government inspectors had higher skills and put in more effort than the workers at the private firms. Importantly, the government inspectors also had more authority to enter properties, which may be hard to transfer even to higher quality firms. The results suggest that the limits to government outsourcing may go beyond multitasking issues.

10.3386/w35610.abstractZh: 外包理论通常假定私营企业是更高效的商品和服务生产者，但由于合同摩擦，企业无法完全内化政府的目标函数。但是，对于某些任务，政府实际上可能更有生产效率吗？我们通过在印度金奈进行的一项实验来研究这个问题，政府随机选择一些社区，让政府签约的私营企业而非政府税务检查员来确定财产税评估。我们发现，政府税务检查员的检查使税收收入增加了近一倍，相比之下，私营企业所做的检查增加的税收收入较少。通过将新的评估与我们聘请的第三方调查员进行的独立评估进行比较，我们判断政府税务检查员的评估也更为准确。与政府签约的困难使得许多有能力的企业不愿投标。可能因此，政府检查员拥有更高的技能，并且比私营企业的员工投入了更多的努力。重要的是，政府检查员还拥有更大的权力进入财产，这种权力可能很难甚至转移到更高质量的企业。结果表明，政府外包的局限性可能超出了多任务处理问题。

abstract.text: Ten states implemented Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) Food Restriction Waivers to restrict purchases of sugary beverages with SNAP funds for the first time in program history in 2026. We estimate the short-run impact of these waivers using a new panel dataset of household beverage purchases. For the average SNAP household, these waivers decrease soda purchases by 13 percent with persistent effects for up to two months after implementation. For inframarginal SNAP households, these waivers decrease soda purchases by 18.5 percent. These findings are inconsistent with the predictions of traditional demand theory and suggest that behavioral models incorporating mental accounting and labeling better characterize consumer responses to SNAP purchase restrictions.

10.3386/w35613.abstractZh: 2026年，十个州首次在历史上实施了补充营养援助计划（SNAP）食品限制豁免，限制使用SNAP资金购买含糖饮料。我们利用一个新的家庭饮料购买面板数据集，估计这些豁免对短期影响。对于平均SNAP家庭而言，这些豁免使苏打水购买量减少了13%，并且在实施后长达两个月内持续产生影响。对于非边际SNAP家庭，这些豁免使苏打水购买量减少了18.5%。这些发现与传统需求理论的预测不一致，表明纳入心理会计和标签行为的模型能更好地描述消费者对SNAP购买限制的反应。

abstract.text: Involvement with the child welfare system varies dramatically across places. While some of this variation may reflect differences in underlying maltreatment risk, it may also result from differences in institutional responses to similar circumstances. To disentangle these explanations, we study Michigan public school data linked to Child Protective Services reports from 2017–2024. School-level reporting rates range from virtually none to more than half of students reported between kindergarten and fifth grade. We estimate school-specific reporting tendencies using value-added methods and document substantial variation in reporting behavior after accounting for differences in student risk. Using student movers, we show that these estimates are forecast-unbiased. Our estimates imply that school-specific reporting practices account for roughly 40 percent of the variation in reporting rates across schools. We then estimate a structural model that decomposes reporting practices into diagnostic skill and preferences. Differences in skill explain more than twice as much variation as differences in preferences, and higher-reporting schools tend to be more skilled at identifying high-risk cases. Counterfactual simulations imply that improving detection skill would yield significant welfare gains, while recent policy proposals aimed at reducing or equalizing reporting rates generally lower welfare by increasing the number of high-risk cases that go unreported.

10.3386/w35619.abstractZh: 儿童福利系统的参与度在不同地区之间存在巨大差异。这种差异可能反映了潜在虐待风险的差异，也可能是对类似情况的制度反应差异所致。为了区分这些解释，我们研究了2017至2024年间密歇根公立学校数据与儿童保护服务报告的关联。学校级别的报告率从几乎没有到超过一半的学生在幼儿园至五年级之间被报告不等。我们使用增值方法估计学校特定的报告倾向，并在考虑学生风险差异后记录报告行为的显著变化。利用转学生数据，我们展示了这些估计值是无预测偏差的。我们的估计表明，学校特定的报告实践占学校间报告率变化的大约40%。然后我们估计了一个结构模型，将报告实践分解为诊断技能和偏好。技能差异解释的变化是偏好差异的两倍多，报告率较高的学校在识别高风险案例方面往往更为熟练。反事实模拟意味着提高检测技能将带来显著的福利收益，而最近旨在减少或均衡报告率的政策提议通常会通过增加未被报告的高风险案例数量来降低福利。

abstract.text: We provide evidence of fraudulent diagnostic misreporting leading to spending on unnecessary medical care and show that it is strongly associated with provider profit motivation and weak prosocial preferences. Using incognito standardized patients (SP) presenting identical acute malaria symptoms as real walk-in clients to private providers in Kenya, we observe diagnostic and treatment decisions under controlled conditions with externally verified disease status. Because the SPs were confirmed to be malaria-negative, any reported positive diagnosis is a false positive by construction. Providers ordered malaria tests in 81% of the SP encounters. Conditional on administering a malaria test, providers report false positive results in 30% of encounters, substantially exceeding the approximately 3-5% false positive rates reported for the same malaria tests in diagnostic accuracy studies. This occurs despite near-perfect knowledge of appropriate diagnostic protocols. We link this behavior to provider preferences measured using a real-stakes, modified dictator game. While ordering a test is uncorrelated with preferences, the top 25% most profit-motivated providers report 16 percentage point (pp) more false positives and sell 20 pp more antimalarial drugs than more altruistic providers, conditional on ordering a malaria test. Misreporting is accompanied by selective concealment of diagnostic evidence from patients.

10.3386/w35627.abstractZh: 我们提供了欺诈性诊断错报导致不必要医疗支出的证据，并表明这与提供者追求利润的动机和较弱的亲社会偏好强烈相关。我们使用伪装成标准病人（SP）的个体，他们向肯尼亚的私人提供者呈现与真实患者相同的急性疟疾症状，在控制条件下观察诊断和治疗决策，并有外部验证的疾病状态。由于SPs被确认为疟疾阴性，任何报告的阳性诊断都是构造上的假阳性。在81%的SP接触中，提供者订购了疟疾测试。在进行疟疾测试的条件下，提供者在30%的接触中报告假阳性结果，大大超过了同一疟疾测试在诊断准确性研究中报告的大约3-5%的假阳性率。尽管对适当的诊断程序有着近乎完美的了解，这种情况还是发生了。我们将这种行为与使用真实风险、修改后的独裁者游戏测量的提供者偏好联系起来。虽然订购测试与偏好无关，但最以利润为动机的前25%的提供者在订购疟疾测试的条件下，报告的假阳性比更具有利他心的提供者多16个百分点（pp），并且多销售了20pp的抗疟药物。错报伴随着选择性地向患者隐瞒诊断证据。

abstract.text: This paper examines how selection into medicine in the United States influences physician practice styles. We exploit macroeconomic conditions at the time of medical school application as an exogenous shock to the applicant pool and find that labor market downturns in other prestigious fields increase applications to medical school and shift the composition of matriculating cohorts toward students from non–pre-medical backgrounds. Strikingly, these low–outside-option cohorts practice medicine differently decades later. Conditional on experience, specialty, and outcome year, recession-cohort physicians bill Medicare more per beneficiary despite seeing healthier patients—particularly on discretionary, revenue-generating services—and sort into practice settings with higher-powered financial incentives. The additional spending does not produce detectable improvements in patient health. Taken together, our findings point to stronger financial motivation among those drawn into medicine when outside options are weak and suggest that medical school admissions screen imperfectly on the attributes that ultimately shape how physicians practice.

10.3386/w35631.abstractZh: 本文研究了在美国选择医学专业如何影响医生的执业风格。我们利用医学院申请时期的宏观经济状况作为一个外生冲击来影响申请者池，并发现其他声望领域中的劳动力市场低迷增加了对医学院的申请，并将入学群体的构成转向非预医学背景的学生。引人注目的是，这些在外部选择较少的群体在几十年后的医学实践中有所不同。在控制经验、专业和结果年份的条件下，经济衰退时期的医生群体尽管面对的患者健康状况更好，但每位受益人的医疗保险账单却更多——特别是在自由裁量、创收的服务上——并选择进入具有更强财务激励的执业环境。额外的支出并没有带来患者健康可检测的改善。总体而言，我们的发现指出，在外部选择较弱时被吸引进入医学领域的人具有更强的财务动机，并表明医学院的招生在最终塑造医生执业方式的特征上筛选得并不完美。

abstract.text: Survival analysis methods are often used to predict the time until the onset of an event in settings when the true time-to-event (TTE) may be censored during training. Such approaches typically assume uncensored data are representative of censored data and that the probability of censoring conditioned on the covariates remains constant over time, i.e., there is no censoring distribution shift. However, both assumptions can fail in practice when censoring results from interventions targeted to individuals with particular comorbidities or genetic markers (such as prophylactic surgery when predicting time to cancer onset, or scheduled cesarean delivery and induction when predicting time to spontaneous labor) and changes in clinical policies alter which individuals are targeted for these interventions over time. To address this, we propose a new approach, cluster-weighted inference of time-to event (CWITE), that remains accurate when these assumptions do not hold. Unlike existing approaches that ignore times-to-censoring (TTC) or treat them only as a lower bound of the TTE, CWITE leverages the insight that a subset of censored individuals are likely censored close to their true TTEs, and uses a novel mechanism to learn from such individuals. On the task of predicting time to spontaneous labor using real-world data, CWITE improves TTE accuracy for individuals similar to censored training data (mean absolute error: 6.50 days, 95% CI: [5.55, 7.40] vs. 7.82 days, [6.82, 8.82]) while maintaining comparable performance for those similar to uncensored training data (6.50 days, [5.54, 7.61] vs. 6.63 days, [5.67,7.69]). Our results demonstrate that incorporating more specific supervision from censored training data can significantly improve TTE predictions in settings with limited overlap and censoring distribution shift, challenges common in real-world clinical data. Code to implement CWITE and reproduce all experiments in the paper is available at https://github.com/MLD3/CWITE.

10.3386/w35643.abstractZh: 生存分析方法通常用于预测事件发生前的时间，在训练期间真实的时间至事件（TTE）可能被审查的情况下。这些方法通常假设未审查的数据代表了被审查的数据，并且基于协变量的审查概率随时间保持不变，即不存在审查分布的偏移。然而，在实践中，当审查结果来自针对具有特定合并症或遗传标记的个体的干预措施（例如，在预测癌症发生时间时的预防性手术，或在预测自发劳动时间时的预定剖宫产和引产）时，以及临床政策的变化改变了这些干预措施针对的个体时，这两种假设都可能失败。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种新的方法，即时间至事件的聚类加权推断（CWITE），即使在这些假设不成立时也能保持准确性。与现有方法不同，现有方法忽略了审查至时间（TTC）或仅将其视为TTE的下限，CWITE利用了一个洞见，即一部分被审查的个体可能在接近他们真实的TTE时被审查，并且使用一种新颖的机制来从这些个体中学习。在利用真实世界数据预测自发劳动时间的任务中，CWITE提高了与被审查训练数据相似个体的TTE准确性（平均绝对误差：6.50天，95% CI：[5.55, 7.40] vs. 7.82天，[6.82, 8.82]），同时保持了与未审查训练数据相似个体相当的性能（6.50天，[5.54, 7.61] vs. 6.63天，[5.67,7.69]）。我们的结果表明，在有限重叠和审查分布偏移的情况下，纳入来自被审查训练数据的更具体的监督可以显著提高TTE预测的准确性，这些挑战在真实世界的临床数据中很常见。实现CWITE并重现论文中所有实验的代码可在 https://github.com/MLD3/CWITE 获得。

abstract.text: The diffusion of technological innovation depends on incentives, regulations, and firms’ strategic behaviors. We study these intersections within cardiac procedure markets following Medicare’s expansion of non-hospital facility options for treatment, enabled by clinical advancements. State-level regulations restrain federal pro-competition policy. Where market entry occurs, business stealing is concentrated among the lowest cost treatment settings, rather than high-cost hospitals––increasing Medicare spending by approximately $2.5 million. Medicare policy also generates externalities for untargeted procedures and other payers, except when hospitals and physicians are vertically integrated. Federal rulemaking interacts with and is mitigated by complex market dynamics––including in potentially unanticipated ways.

10.3386/w35645.abstractZh: 技术革新的传播取决于激励机制、法规和公司的战略行为。我们研究了在心脏手术市场中，这些因素的交叉影响，特别是在Medicare扩大非医院设施治疗选择后，由于临床进步而成为可能。州级法规限制了联邦促进竞争的政策。在市场进入发生的地方，业务窃取集中在成本最低的治疗环境中，而不是高成本的医院——这增加了大约250万美元的Medicare支出。Medicare政策还为未针对的程序和其他支付者产生了外部性，除非医院和医生是垂直整合的。联邦规则制定与复杂的市场动态相互作用，并以潜在未预料的方式得到缓解。

abstract.text: Buprenorphine prescribing for opioid use disorder remains far below the scale of the overdose crisis. We estimate the causal effect of county-level synthetic opioid overdose mortality shocks on the volume of buprenorphine treatment delivered, exploiting the staggered geographic diffusion of synthetic opioids from 2013 to 2023. Linking IQVIA Longitudinal Prescription Claims to National Vital Statistics System mortality records, we implement a difference-in-differences estimator with propensity score matching under three complementary exposure measures. Treatment volume increases significantly under all three definitions, with no evidence of differential pre-trends; point estimates for buprenorphine prescribing rates range from 5 to 17 percent of pre-treatment means, emerge within one to two quarters, and grow monotonically thereafter. Our design does not separately identify changes in patient demand and provider behavior, but the increase in unique prescribers is consistent with a provider-side response. The response is concentrated among advanced practice providers, Medicaid patients, and counties with pre-existing buprenorphine infrastructure; counties with little baseline prescribing show no response. Local mortality information acts as a determinant of treatment volume, with effects comparable in magnitude to major legislative interventions aimed at expanding treatment, but appear only where prescribing capacity already exists.

10.3386/w35648.abstractZh: 用于阿片类药物使用障碍的丁丙诺啡处方量远远低于过量危机的规模。我们估计县级合成阿片类药物过量死亡冲击对丁丙诺啡治疗量的影响，利用2013年至2023年合成阿片类药物地理扩散的交错模式。我们将IQVIA纵向处方索赔数据与国家生命统计系统死亡记录相链接，实施了三种互补暴露措施下的倾向得分匹配双重差分估计器。在所有三种定义下，治疗量均显著增加，没有差异性预趋势的证据；丁丙诺啡处方率的点估计值从5%到17%不等，治疗前均值，在一到两个季度内出现，并在此之后单调增长。我们的设计不能单独识别患者需求和提供者行为的变化，但独特处方者数量的增加与提供者方面的反应一致。反应集中在高级实践提供者、医疗补助患者和已有丁丙诺啡基础设施的县；几乎没有基线处方的县没有反应。当地的死亡信息作为治疗量的一个决定因素，其影响大小与旨在扩大治疗范围的主要立法干预措施相当，但仅在已有处方能力的地方出现。

abstract.text: One of the most comprehensive fiscal policies to improve diet was adopted by the Navajo Nation; the Healthy Diné Nation Act (HDNA) of 2014-15 consists of two parts: 1) an exemption from sales tax for healthy foods and beverages; and 2) a tax increase on unhealthy foods and beverages. Together, they create a price wedge of 7-8% between healthy and unhealthy foods. We estimate difference-in-difference models and event studies that estimate the effect of the HDNA on a variety of health conditions relating to diet and weight for newborns and mothers which are recorded in birth certificate data. We find no evidence that the HDNA improved these outcomes; our estimates are precise enough to rule out improvements in gestational diabetes as large as those reported for U.S. city SSB taxes. Possible explanations for the null results include incomplete retailer implementation and cross-border shopping.

10.3386/w35662.abstractZh: 纳瓦霍民族采用了最全面的财政政策来改善饮食状况之一；2014-15年的《健康迪内民族法案》包含两部分：1）对健康食品和饮料免征销售税；2）对不健康的食品和饮料征收更高的税。这两项规定共同在健康和不健康食品之间形成了7-8%的价格差异。我们通过差异模型分析和事件研究，评估了《健康迪内民族法案》对新生儿和母亲与饮食和体重相关的各种健康状况的影响，这些数据记录在出生证明中。我们发现，《健康迪内民族法案》并未改善这些结果；我们的估计足够精确，可以排除妊娠糖尿病方面的改善效果，其程度与美国城市SSB税带来的改善相当。对于这些无显著结果的解释，可能包括零售商实施不完全以及跨境购物等因素。

abstract.text: Health technology assessment bodies and policymakers have grappled with the issue of whose preferences – the general healthy population or the patient population – should be incorporated into traditional cost-effectiveness analysis. This debate arises because healthy individuals and patients often value the same health state differently, and cost-effectiveness will undervalue health-related quality of life (HRQoL) for individuals with chronic illness or disability because it cannot account for adaptation. Prospect theory (PT) provides a framework that permits adaptation since it assumes individuals evaluate outcomes relative to a reference point. We estimate utility over HRQoL in a PT framework in a nationally representative U.S. population and compare directly with utility estimates in an EU framework from the same population. Consistent with previous studies in the monetary and health domains, we find evidence of probability weighting bias and loss aversion over health. Using the PT utility estimates, we demonstrate how PT can be incorporated into healthcare value assessment and present the resulting implications for medical decision making.

10.3386/w35666.abstractZh: 健康技术评估机构和政策制定者一直在探讨：在传统的成本效益分析中，应该将谁的偏好纳入考量——是普通健康人群还是患者群体。这一争论的出现是因为健康个体和患者往往对相同的健康状态有着不同的价值评估，而成本效益分析可能会低估患有慢性疾病或残疾的个体的健康相关生活质量（HRQoL），因为它无法考虑到适应性因素。前景理论提供了一个框架，允许对适应性因素进行考虑，因为它假设个体会根据一个参考点来评估结果。我们在全国代表性美国人群中，使用前景理论框架对HRQoL的效用进行了估算，并直接与同一人群在欧盟框架下的效用估算进行了比较。与之前在货币和健康领域的研究一致，我们发现存在概率加权偏差和对健康方面的损失厌恶现象。利用前景理论效用估算结果，我们展示了如何将前景理论纳入医疗价值评估中，并提出了对医疗决策的影响。

abstract.text: The Affordable Care Act, the largest US welfare reform since 1965, banned health insurance underwriting and rejections based on pre-existing conditions and introduced large premium subsidies for low- to middle-income individuals. Yet how many people the ban made better off, and how its effects varied by health risk, remain unknown—because data on who was rejected before the reform have been lacking. Using a proprietary dataset of pre-ACA insurance applications and underwriting decisions, we document, model, and estimate the reform's heterogeneous effects by age, income, and health risk. We find its benefits were concentrated among low-income, high-risk, or over-50 individuals.

10.3386/w35692.abstractZh: 《平价医疗法案》是1965年以来美国规模最大的福利改革，该法案禁止基于既往健康状况进行健康保险承保和拒保，并为低收入至中等收入人群提供了大量保费补贴。然而，这项改革让多少人受益，以及其效果如何因健康风险而异，目前仍不清楚——因为改革前被拒保者的相关数据一直缺乏。我们利用一项关于改革前保险申请和承保决策的专有数据集，记录了、建模并估算了改革在不同年龄、收入和健康风险方面的异质性影响。我们发现，该改革带来的好处主要集中在低收入、高风险或50岁以上的人群中。

abstract.text: Transportation is a major source of greenhouse gas and air pollution emissions worldwide, with most automobile pollution coming from vehicles older than 10 years. Yet, many policies discourage the removal of older vehicles from the fleet, with potential consequences for pollution and public health. This paper examines an equity-motivated anti-scrappage policy in Brazil using a border-pair design that exploits state variation in the age thresholds for vehicle ownership tax exemptions. Using municipality-level vehicle registration data from 2013-2020, we find that lower exemption age thresholds increase the average fleet age by up to one year, as they encourage owners to retain vehicles until they qualify for tax exemptions. Using fleet- and satellite-based estimates of pollution and administrative health data, we show that these policies increase on-road CO2 emissions per capita by up to 23% and PM2.5 concentrations by 4%, while deteriorating infant health outcomes. Leveraging state reforms that raised exemption ages, we find evidence that incumbents face greater electoral penalties wherever a greater share of the vehicle fleet re-enters the tax base, consistent with a “political environmental trap.” Within an MVPF framework, we find that lowering the exemption age by five years generates a net welfare loss of $0.78 for every $1 of forgone government revenue.

10.3386/w35713.abstractZh: 交通运输是全球温室气体和空气污染排放的主要来源，其中大部分汽车污染来自使用年限超过10年的车辆。然而，许多政策并不鼓励淘汰这些老旧车辆，这可能会对污染和公共健康产生负面影响。本文以巴西为例，探讨了一种以公平为目标的反报废政策，该政策利用边界对设计来考察各州在车辆所有权免税年龄阈值上的差异。通过2013-2020年的市级车辆登记数据，我们发现较低的免税年龄阈值会使车队的平均年龄增加一年，因为这些政策鼓励车主保留车辆直至符合免税条件。利用基于车队和卫星的污染数据以及行政健康数据，我们发现这些政策使人均道路二氧化碳排放量增加了23%，PM2.5浓度增加了4%，同时导致婴儿健康状况恶化。通过利用提高免税年龄的州级改革措施，我们发现，当更多车辆重新纳入税收体系时，现有企业面临更大的选举风险，这与“政治环境陷阱”理论相符。在MVPF框架内，我们发现将免税年龄降低五年，每放弃1美元的政府收入，会导致0.78美元的净福利损失。

abstract.text: The No Surprises Act (NSA) capped patients' liability for surprise bills and established federal final-offer arbitration for insurer–provider payment disputes. Linking arbitration records to the national longitudinal provider-insurer network panel and plan design data in the ACA marketplace, we find that the NSA reduced provider network participation in the specialties and states most affected by the reform, contrary to the standard prediction that removing balance billing makes network participation more attractive. The decline is consistent with arbitration strengthening providers' outside option: arbitration is high-volume and provider-favorable, with awards well above the statutory benchmark; and network participation declines after provider groups' first favorable arbitration outcomes. Suggestive evidence indicates that insurers more exposed to arbitration raise premiums. These results reveal an unintended consequence of the NSA: the law's direct consumer protections may be accompanied by narrower networks and higher premiums.

10.3386/w35717.abstractZh: 《无意外费用法案》（NSA）限制了患者因意外费用而产生的责任，并建立了联邦最终仲裁机制来处理保险公司与医疗服务提供者之间的支付纠纷。通过将仲裁记录与《平价医疗法案》市场中的全国纵向医疗服务提供者-保险公司网络以及计划设计数据联系起来，我们发现，与通常的预测相反，NSA导致受改革影响最严重的专业领域和州的医疗服务提供者参与网络的情况减少。这一趋势表明，仲裁增强了提供者的外部选择：仲裁案件数量众多且对提供者有利，仲裁裁决金额远高于法定标准；而在提供者团体首次获得有利的仲裁结果后，其参与网络的情况反而有所减少。有证据表明，更频繁地接受仲裁的保险公司可能会提高保费。这些结果揭示了NSA的一个意外后果：该法律对消费者的直接保护可能伴随着网络范围的缩小和保费的上调。

abstract.text: Pre-analysis plans (PAPs) can improve research reproducibility by reducing researchers’ degrees of freedom, but their value depends on adherence. We argue that large language models (LLMs) can provide an efficient, scalable, and systematic way for authors and reviewers to assess adherence to PAPs. In an application to our own research, an LLM systematically identifies precommitted design choices, evaluates deviations, and diagnoses gaps in pre-specification, substantially reducing the human labor required for these tasks. However, variability in audit output across LLMs underscores the continued importance of human judgment. We discuss implications for best practices in AI-assisted PAP auditing.

10.3386/w35719.abstractZh: 预分析计划（PAPs）可以通过减少研究者的自由度来提高研究的可重复性，但其价值取决于遵守情况。我们认为，大型语言模型（LLMs）可以为作者和审稿人提供一种高效、可扩展且系统化的方式来评估遵守PAPs的情况。在我们自己的研究应用中，LLM能够系统地识别预先确定的设计选择、评估偏差，并诊断预规格化中的缺陷，从而大幅减少这些任务所需的人工劳动。然而，不同LLM在审计输出上的差异表明，人类判断的重要性仍然持续存在。我们讨论了在AI辅助PAP审计中的最佳实践。

abstract.text: We examine whether expanded legal access to the contraceptive pill for minors generated health benefits for subsequent generations. We use data from the restricted-use Natality files from 1970-2020, linking mothers to the level of access to the pill in their state and year of birth and the extent to which their mothers could access the pill as minors. Our results show that children whose mothers were born after expanded access to the pill as minors had better birth outcomes, with gains concentrated among Black families. Among affected births, legalization increased birth weight by 12-16 grams and reduced incidence of low birth weight by 2.7-3.4 percent. These magnitudes have economic significance, corresponding to approximately $113.8–$115.3 million in medical cost savings, measured in 2025 dollars, for the 2000 Black birth cohort alone. Our mechanism analysis points to a postponement of early childbearing by the generation directly affected by legal access to the pill as minors whose daughters subsequently attained higher levels of education, used more prenatal care, and had longer birth spacing. Taken together, our results suggest that reproductive health policy can generate multigenerational benefits and contribute to reductions in racial disparities in early-life health.

10.3386/w35722.abstractZh: 我们研究了对未成年人扩大避孕药的合法获取是否对后续世代产生了健康益处。我们使用1970-2020年的限制使用生育数据，将母亲与她们所在州和出生年份的避孕药获取情况联系起来，以及她们在未成年时期能够获取避孕药的程度。研究结果表明，那些母亲在未成年人时期就能获得避孕药的家庭所生育的子女出生结果更好，这种益处主要集中在黑人家庭。在受影响的出生案例中，合法化使出生体重增加了12-16克，并将低出生体重的发生率降低了2.7-3.4%。这些数值具有经济意义，仅针对2000年出生的黑人群体，在2025年的货币价值下，相当于节省了约1.138亿至1.153亿美元的医疗费用。我们的机制分析表明，直接受到未成年人时期避孕药合法获取影响的一代，其女儿在获得更高教育水平、更多产前护理以及更长的生育间隔后，生育年龄会推迟。综合来看，我们的研究结果表明，生殖健康政策能够产生多代人的益处，并有助于减少早期生命阶段的种族健康差异。

abstract.text: With the growth of sales of e-cigarettes and other alternative nicotine products, governments face the new challenge of crafting public health messages that provide information to consumers about these less risky but not risk-free products. Bayesian learning serves as the theoretical framework for our analysis of how smokers form their perceptions of the risks of e-cigarettes based on the risks of smoking. This paper consists of two parts. First, we conduct a cross-country descriptive analysis of government messaging and smokers’ perceptions of e-cigarette risks. We study a diverse group of eight countries: Australia, China, Indonesia, Japan, Malaysia, Sweden, the U.K. and the U.S. We find that public health messages range widely across the countries. In online cross-country surveys of adult smokers, on average perceptions of e-cigarette risks are associated with their perceptions of the risk of smoking and with their countries’ messaging. Notably, in all eight countries many smokers incorrectly believe that e-cigarettes are relatively more harmful than smoking and over-estimate the absolute risks of e-cigarettes. In the second part of our study, we report the results of online randomized experiments that compare the effects of different e-cigarette risk messaging about an outbreak of lung injuries (given the acronym EVALI). The U.K. public health message about the low risk of e-cigarettes relative to smoking reduced smokers’ incorrect risk perceptions, while the U.S. public health message increased incorrect risk perceptions.

10.3386/w35724.abstractZh: 随着电子香烟及其他替代性尼古丁产品的销量增长，政府面临着一个新的挑战，即需要制定公共卫生信息，向消费者提供关于这些风险较低但并非无风险的产品的信息。贝叶斯学习理论为我们分析吸烟者如何基于吸烟的风险来形成对电子香烟风险的认知提供了框架。本文分为两部分。首先，我们对不同国家的政府宣传信息以及吸烟者对电子香烟风险的认知进行了描述性分析。我们研究了八个国家的数据：澳大利亚、中国、印度尼西亚、日本、马来西亚、瑞典、英国和美国。我们发现，各国的公共卫生信息存在很大差异。在对成年吸烟者的在线跨国调查中，对电子香烟风险的认知通常与他们对吸烟风险的认知以及所在国家的宣传信息有关。值得注意的是，在所有八个国家中，许多吸烟者错误地认为电子香烟比吸烟更有害，并高估了电子香烟的绝对风险。在研究的第二部分，我们报告了在线随机实验的结果，这些实验比较了不同电子香烟风险宣传信息对肺损伤事件的影响（该事件被称为EVALI）。英国的公共卫生信息表明电子香烟的风险相对较低，这减少了吸烟者对电子香烟风险的错误认知，而美国的公共卫生信息则增加了这种错误认知。

abstract.text: We study the aggregate and heterogeneous effects of a front-of-package labeling policy implemented in Chile. We find that consumers reduced their sugar and caloric intake by 9% and 6%, respectively. On the demand side, labels prompt consumers to substitute within categories rather than switching between categories. Within-category responses are more pronounced when labels provide new information. On the supply side, we observe bunching at regulatory thresholds, with substantial heterogeneity across categories, consistent with differing costs of product reformulation. We conclude that considering policy-response heterogeneity is key for effective policy design.

10.3386/w35737.abstractZh: 我们研究了智利实施的食品包装正面标签政策对总量及异质性效应的影响。研究发现，消费者的糖分摄入量和热量摄入量分别下降了9%和6%。在需求侧，标签促使消费者在同一品类内部进行替代，而非跨品类转换；当标签提供新信息时，品类内部的反应更为显著。在供给侧，我们观察到产品在监管阈值处出现聚束现象，且不同品类之间存在显著异质性，这与产品重新配方的成本差异相一致。我们得出的结论是，考虑政策反应的异质性对于有效的政策设计至关重要。

abstract.text: We examine how information affects the choice between Social Security Disability Insurance (DI) and Old-Age Insurance (OAI) benefits for people between 62 and full retirement age. We find that receiving an initial Social Security statement, which provides recipients with personalized estimated benefit amounts available from DI and OAI, increases the probability of applying for both programs among those with a work-limiting health condition or a low work ability index, and this response is concentrated among people who are further from full retirement age. The increase in DI applications is split between applications for DI only and applications for both programs.

10.3386/w35748.abstractZh: 我们研究了信息如何影响 62 岁至完全退休年龄之间人群在社会保障残疾保险（DI）与老年保险（OAI）待遇之间的选择。我们发现，收到初始社会保障声明——该声明向领取人提供 DI 与 OAI 的个性化预估待遇金额——会提高存在工作限制性健康状况或工作能力指数较低者同时申请两项待遇的概率，且这一反应集中在距离完全退休年龄更远的人群中。DI 申请的增加部分体现为仅申请 DI，部分体现为同时申请两项待遇。

abstract.text: While recent research has provided evidence that the Medicaid expansions of the Affordable Care Act (ACA) reduced mortality, there is no evidence on the effect of the Affordable Care Act (ACA) net of the Medicaid expansions on mortality. This is an important gap in knowledge because the ACA significantly increased health insurance coverage in non-expansion states. In this article, we exploit the large increase in health insurance coverage brought forth by the ACA to examine the effect of the ACA and Medicaid expansions on mortality. Unlike prior studies that relied solely on geographic variation in Medicaid expansions to estimate the net effect of the expansion, we use a novel empirical approach that allows us to investigate the effect of the ACA net of Medicaid expansion on mortality, the incremental effect of the Medicaid expansion, and the overall effect of the ACA including Medicaid expansion. We use longitudinal data from the NHIS Linked Mortality Files (LMF) and a nationally representative sample of 40 to 58-year-olds combined with a difference-in-differences and a difference-in-differences-in-differences research design to obtain estimates of the effect of the ACA on mortality. We find no evidence that the Medicaid expansions had a beneficial effect on mortality but do find that the ACA net of Medicaid expansion reduced mortality.

10.3386/w35751.abstractZh: 近期研究已提供证据表明，《平价医疗法案》（ACA）的 Medicaid 扩面降低了死亡率，但尚无证据考察 ACA 剔除 Medicaid 扩面后的净效应对死亡率的影响。这一知识空白至关重要，因为 ACA 在尚未扩面的州同样显著提升了健康保险覆盖率。本文利用 ACA 带来的健康保险覆盖率大幅提升，考察 ACA 及 Medicaid 扩面对死亡率的影响。与以往仅依赖 Medicaid 扩面的地理差异来估计扩面净效应的研究不同，我们采用一种新颖的实证方法，从而能够分别识别 ACA 剔除 Medicaid 扩面后的净效应、Medicaid 扩面的增量效应，以及 ACA 包含 Medicaid 扩面在内的总体效应。我们使用 NHIS 关联死亡档案（LMF）的纵向数据，结合全国代表性的 40 至 58 岁样本，并运用双重差分及三重差分研究设计，估计 ACA 对死亡率的影响。我们发现，没有证据表明 Medicaid 扩面对死亡率产生了有益效应，但 ACA 剔除 Medicaid 扩面后的净效应确实降低了死亡率。

abstract.text: Spectrum repacking auctions can restore feasibility along two margins: retiring a station via buyout or relaxing a pairwise engineering restriction. I represent stations as vertices in a network and interference restrictions as edges between them, and so station buyouts delete vertices and engineering waivers relax edges. This paper shows that buying out any one station can reduce the number of channels needed, even though relaxing any single interference restriction cannot. The smallest feasible number of channels is k . For every k>=4, I show that there is a network in which removing any station saves one channel, while relaxing any single pairwise restriction does not. This main result follows directly from Dirac’s half-century-old conjecture on vertex-critical graphs, whose chromatic number falls after any vertex is removed. By constructing the missing counterexample at k=4 and combining it with earlier results for k>=5, I show that at every k>=4, some k-vertex-critical graph has no critical edge, resolving Dirac's conjecture. Market designers auditing feasibility link-by-link systematically can mistake combinatorial complementarity for remedy failure, overlooking station buyouts that unlock the clearing target.

10.3386/w35757.abstractZh: 频谱重新打包拍卖可沿两个边际恢复可行性：通过买断淘汰台站，或放宽成对工程限制。我将台站表示为网络中的顶点，干扰限制表示为顶点之间的边，因此台站买断对应删除顶点，工程豁免对应放宽边。本文表明，买断任意单个台站可减少所需频道数量，而放宽任意单一干扰限制则做不到。最小可行频道数为 k。对于任意 k≥4，我证明存在一种网络：删除任意台站均可节省一个频道，而放宽任意单一成对限制则不能。这一主要结果直接源于狄拉克（Dirac）半个世纪前关于顶点临界图的猜想——其染色数在删除任意顶点后下降。通过构造 k=4 时缺失的反例，并将其与 k≥5 的早期结果相结合，我证明对于任意 k≥4，某个 k-顶点临界图不存在临界边，从而解决了狄拉克猜想。逐链路审计可行性的市场设计者可能将组合互补性误判为补救措施失效，从而忽视能够解锁清算目标的台站买断。

abstract.text: We study how firms’ orientation toward employee well-being shapes the health of their workers. Because this orientation is not directly observable, we measure it from the language Danish firms use in their public disclosures, applying language models to construct a firm-level well-being salience score. We link this score to population-wide administrative registers of health and sickness absence over 2013–2022, and exploit workers’ mobility between firms to estimate how workers respond to a change in the salience of their employer. We find an asymmetry: workers who move to higher-salience firms take substantially more sickness absence, while their use of health care does not change. Because worsening health would raise both, the absence response suggests a behavioral change rather than deteriorating health. Broadly, our results show that firms shape not only worker health but how workers act on it, and that the language of routine corporate disclosure can reveal economically meaningful features of the workplace that administrative data leave unrecorded.

10.3386/w35760.abstractZh: 我们研究企业对员工福祉的重视程度如何影响员工健康。由于这种重视程度无法直接观测，我们利用丹麦企业在公开披露文件中的语言表述，通过语言模型构建企业层面的福祉关注度（well-being salience）指标。我们将该指标与2013—2022年覆盖全人口的行政健康登记数据和病假数据相链接，并利用员工在不同企业间的流动，估计员工如何对其雇主福祉关注度的变化作出反应。我们发现一种非对称性：流向福祉关注度更高企业的员工，其病假显著增加，而医疗服务使用并未发生变化。由于健康状况恶化会同时推高两者，病假反应表明这是一种行为变化，而非健康恶化。总体而言，我们的结果表明，企业不仅塑造员工健康，还影响员工如何就健康采取行动；而常规企业披露文件中的语言能够揭示行政数据未能记录的、具有经济意义的工作场所特征。

abstract.text: We study the value of informal care from a spouse and how access to such care shapes optimal insurance coverage for long-term care. Using Medicare claims and a novel spousal crosswalk, we examine how the sudden incapacitation of a spouse affects their partner's use of formal care. A spouse's health shock increases their partner's probability of a nursing-home stay by 30%. We document significant negative health effects for the partner, but provide evidence that their increase in nursing-home stays is largely driven by substitution from informal care to formal care. When their partners are incapacitated, Medicare recipients become less sensitive to the price of formal care, consistent with a higher valuation of that care and reduced moral hazard. We develop a framework to interpret these findings. The framework translates differences in the level and price elasticity of demand for formal care into a lower-bound estimate of the value of informal care provided by a spouse. It also suggests that optimal insurance for long-term care should be designed at the household level with more generous coverage for those who do not have access to informal care.

10.3386/w35784.abstractZh: 我们研究配偶提供的非正式护理的价值，以及获得此类护理的机会如何影响长期护理的最优保险覆盖。利用 Medicare 理赔数据和新构建的配偶配对数据，我们考察配偶突然失能如何影响其伴侣对正式护理的使用。配偶的健康冲击使其伴侣入住护理院的概率提高 30%。我们记录了伴侣自身健康状况显著恶化的证据，但同时表明其护理院入住率的上升主要源于非正式护理向正式护理的替代。当伴侣失能时，Medicare 受益人对正式护理价格的敏感度下降，这与该护理估值提高以及道德风险降低相一致。我们构建了一个分析框架以解释上述发现。该框架将正式护理需求水平与价格弹性的差异转化为配偶非正式护理价值的下限估计，并表明长期护理的最优保险应在家庭层面进行设计，对无法获得非正式护理的人群提供更慷慨的保障。

abstract.text: Remote work is often touted as a way for disabled and older workers to remain in the labour market. Post-Covid, the incidence of remote work has increased in the UK. Following Bloom et al. (2026), we test the effects of remote work on employment for these two groups using the pandemic’s increase in work from home rates as a quasi-experiment. We compare occupations with high growth in work from home (WFH) to those with lower growth in work from home, with growth rates measured among the non-disabled or younger. We then instrument using pre-pandemic remote work scores from Dingle and Neiman (2020). We find significant evidence that rising WFH increases employment of disabled and older workers in the UK. We additionally find decreases in commute time and wages for both groups, but no effect on hours worked.

10.3386/w35791.abstractZh: 远程办公常被宣扬为残疾劳动者与年长劳动者继续留在劳动力市场的一种途径。新冠疫情后，英国远程办公的发生率有所上升。借鉴 Bloom 等（2026）的研究，我们以疫情期间居家办公（WFH）比例的上升作为准实验，检验远程办公对这两类群体就业的影响。我们将居家办公增长较快的职业与增长较慢的职业进行比较，其中增长率以非残疾群体或年轻群体为基准进行测算，并以 Dingle 和 Neiman（2020）提供的疫情前远程办公指数作为工具变量。我们发现，英国居家办公比例的上升显著促进了残疾劳动者与年长劳动者的就业。此外，我们还发现这两类群体的通勤时间有所缩短、工资有所下降，但工作时长未受影响。

abstract.text: A large literature examines the economic and health returns to college education. We extend this literature by studying the upward intergenerational effects of children’s education on parental mortality. We exploit Korea’s 1993 Higher Education Reform, which we estimate raised college completion by 13 percentage points among eldest children in the 1974–1983 birth cohorts relative to the prior 10-year cohort. Using data from the Korean Longitudinal Study of Aging, reduced-form estimates indicate a 27% (s.e.=10%) reduction in mortality among parents whose oldest child was in the reform-affected cohort. Because the reform affected college completion but not other education levels or quality, we use it as an instrumental variable (IV) for child college completion. IV estimates indicate a 20% (s.e.=7%) reduction in parental mortality for children induced to complete college by the reform. These parents received greater financial support and contact from their children and had lower smoking and higher physical activity, although these mechanisms explain only a small share of the mortality benefit. Effects were larger for parents of daughters in reduced-form analyses, although IV estimates did not differ significantly by child gender. Future research should further investigate the mechanisms through which children’s college education affects parental mortality.

10.3386/w35792.abstractZh: 大量文献考察了大学教育的经济回报与健康回报。本文将这一研究拓展至子女教育对父母死亡率的向上代际效应。我们利用韩国1993年高等教育改革进行估计，该改革使1974—1983年出生队列中长子/长女的大学完成率相对于此前10年队列提高了13个百分点。基于韩国老龄化纵向研究（Korean Longitudinal Study of Aging）数据的简化式估计表明，最年长子女处于受改革影响队列的父母，其死亡率下降了27%（标准误=10%）。由于该改革仅影响大学完成率，而不影响其他教育层次或教育质量，我们将其作为子女大学完成率的工具变量（IV）。工具变量估计显示，因改革而诱导完成大学的子女，其父母死亡率下降20%（标准误=7%）。这些父母获得了子女更多的经济支持与生活联络，且吸烟率更低、体育活动更多，尽管这些机制仅能解释死亡率收益中的很小一部分。简化式分析中，女儿的效应更大，但工具变量估计并未因子女性别而呈现显著差异。未来研究应进一步探究子女大学教育影响父母死亡率的机制。

abstract.text: Medical guidelines translate clinical evidence into treatment rules, but the evidence may identify treatment benefits more clearly than harms. We study anticoagulation for atrial fibrillation, combining randomized trials with Veterans Health Administration data. Trial evidence reveals substantial heterogeneity in stroke-prevention benefits but does not reliably identify how treatment-induced bleeding harms vary across patients. In the target population, patients with larger predicted stroke benefits also have higher untreated bleeding risk, making this ambiguity consequential. We evaluate existing guidelines and develop maximin and minimax-regret treatment rules robust to alternative harm structures. At a benchmark preventing 50% of preventable strokes, robust rules induce 33-41% fewer bleeds than random treatment and outperform existing guidelines. Finite-sample uncertainty generates noticeable instability in fine patient rankings but little instability in treatment assignments or welfare. Physician performance and the relationship between guideline adherence and skill also depend substantially on assumptions about how treatment-induced bleeding harms vary across patients.

10.3386/w35798.abstractZh: 医学指南将临床证据转化为治疗规则，但证据对治疗收益的识别往往比对伤害的识别更为清晰。本文以心房颤动患者的抗凝治疗为研究对象，结合随机试验与退伍军人健康管理局数据进行分析。试验证据显示，卒中预防收益存在显著的个体异质性，但未能可靠识别治疗所致出血伤害在不同患者间的变异情况。在目标人群中，预测卒中预防收益较大的患者同时具有更高的未治疗出血风险，这使得上述模糊性具有重要实际影响。本文评估了现有指南，并构建了在替代伤害结构下具有稳健性的极大极小（maximin）与最小化最大遗憾（minimax-regret）治疗规则。在预防50%可预防卒中的基准情形下，稳健规则较随机治疗可减少33%至41%的出血事件，且优于现有指南。有限样本不确定性对精细的患者排序产生显著的不稳定性，但对治疗决策或福利水平的影响甚微。此外，医生绩效以及指南依从性与医术水平之间的关系，也在很大程度上依赖于关于治疗所致出血伤害如何随患者特征变化的假设。

abstract.text: What caused the historically unique volatility in American homicides since 2019, driven by gun homicides? While there is no shortage of candidate explanations, a coherent understanding has been elusive because of the widely held view that gun violence, like other crimes, stems from a rational weighing of benefits and costs as in Becker (1968). This model does a generally poor job of explaining recent trends in homicide. Behavioral economics helps explain what the Becker model cannot. This view starts with the fact that most shootings don’t further some larger goal like robbery or gang wars over drug turf (“instrumental violence”); they’re arguments settled with guns (“expressive violence”). Why do arguments start or escalate? The behavioral model points to automatic cognition that is fast, effortless but sometimes prone to error. The pandemic increased automaticity by increasing distress – a cognitive “bandwidth tax.” Recent homicide trends, driven by changes in expressive violence, are mirrored by similar trends for deaths from drug overdose, car crashes, and suicide (especially for Black Americans, the group most affected by violence) – “deaths of decision-making.” Also relevant is a large rise and fall in gun carrying, which might partially stem from Becker-like mechanisms: Large changes in handgun sales and police stops, both of which may also have been affected by the killing of George Floyd. Since American gun violence is mostly arguments with guns, no wonder homicide trends are due mostly to changes in the number of arguments and the odds a given argument had a gun present.

10.3386/w35827.abstractZh: 2019年以来美国凶杀案的历史性波动由枪支凶杀所驱动，其成因何在？尽管不乏候选解释，但连贯的理解一直难以形成，原因在于广泛持有的观点认为枪支暴力与其他犯罪一样，源于对收益与成本的理性权衡，正如Becker（1968）的模型所示。该模型在解释近期凶杀趋势方面总体表现欠佳。行为经济学有助于解释Becker模型无法说明的现象。这一视角首先基于如下事实：大多数枪击事件并非服务于抢劫或帮派争夺毒品地盘等更大目标（"工具性暴力"），而是以枪支了结的争执（"表达性暴力"）。争执为何发生或升级？行为模型指向自动认知——快速、省力但有时易于出错的认知过程。疫情通过加剧心理困扰增加了自动性，形成一种认知"带宽税"。近期由表达性暴力变化所驱动的凶杀趋势，与药物过量死亡、车祸死亡及自杀死亡（尤其是对受暴力影响最深的美国黑人群体）的类似趋势相互映照——这些可称为"决策之死"。枪支携带的大幅升降亦与此相关，这部分可能源于类Becker机制：手枪销量与警察截停的大幅变化，二者均可能受到George Floyd事件的影响。鉴于美国枪支暴力多为持枪争执，凶杀趋势主要源于争执数量的变化及特定争执中有枪在场的概率变化，也就不足为奇了。

abstract.text: Alcohol use, transactional sex, and gambling carry significant health and economic consequences. We conducted a randomized controlled trial in Kenya to assess whether these behaviors could be altered with a savings intervention that provided lottery-based interest, goal-setting support, and savings reminders. Over 24 months, the intervention increased formal savings and assets, financed primarily by lower spending on alcohol, transactional sex, and gambling. It also reduced hazardous drinking by 26 percent and intimate partner violence by 15 percent. HIV/STI incidence declined by 8 percent, though this was not statistically significant. Savings interventions can simultaneously boost financial security and change health behavior.

10.3386/w35833.abstractZh: 饮酒、交易性行为和赌博均带来显著的健康与经济后果。我们在肯尼亚开展了一项随机对照试验，评估提供基于彩票的利息、目标设定支持和储蓄提醒的储蓄干预能否改变上述行为。在 24 个月期间，该干预提高了正规储蓄和资产水平，资金主要来自酒精、交易性行为和赌博支出的减少。干预同时使危险饮酒行为降低 26%，亲密伴侣暴力减少 15%。HIV/STI 发生率下降 8%，但该结果在统计上不显著。储蓄干预能够同时增进财务安全并改变健康行为。

abstract.text: We provide evidence on the extent to which food assistance affects spending on sugary items by studying the Pandemic Electronic Benefit Transfer (P-EBT) program, which provided funds to families of children who lost access to free and reduced-price school meals due to COVID-19 pandemic school closures.
