abstract.text: Customs data reveal the heterogeneity and granularity of relationships among buyers and sellers, showing how more exports to a destination break down into more firms selling there and more buyers per exporter. We develop a quantitative general equilibrium model of firm‐to‐firm matching that builds on this insight to separate the roles of iceberg costs and matching frictions in gravity. In the cross section, we find matching frictions as important as iceberg costs in impeding trade, and more sensitive to distance. Because domestic and imported intermediates compete directly with labor in performing production tasks, our model also fits the heterogeneity of labor shares across French producers. Applying the framework to the 2004 expansion of the European Union, reduced iceberg costs and reduced matching frictions contributed equally to the increase in French exports to the new members. While workers benefited overall, those competing most directly with imports gained less, even losing in some countries entering the EU.

10.3982/ecta20506.abstractZh: 海关数据揭示了买卖双方关系的异质性与细颗粒度，展示了对某一目的地的出口增长如何分解为更多企业在该地销售以及每个出口商拥有更多买方。我们基于这一洞见构建了一个企业间匹配的定量一般均衡模型，以分离冰山成本与匹配摩擦在引力方程中的作用。在横截面上，我们发现匹配摩擦在阻碍贸易方面与冰山成本同样重要，且对距离更为敏感。由于国内和进口中间品在生产任务中与劳动力直接竞争，我们的模型也拟合了法国生产商之间劳动份额的异质性。将该框架应用于2004年欧盟扩张，冰山成本下降与匹配摩擦减少对法国对新成员国出口的增长贡献相同。尽管劳动者整体受益，但与进口竞争最直接的劳动者获益较少，在某些加入欧盟的国家甚至出现损失。

abstract.text: Weak environmental regulation has global consequences. When domestic regulation fails, the international community can target emitters with trade policy. I develop a dynamic empirical framework for evaluating trade policy as a substitute for domestic regulation, and I apply the framework to the market for palm oil, a major driver of deforestation and global CO 2 emissions. Relative to business as usual, a domestic production tax of 50% reduces CO 2 emissions by 7.4 Gt from 1988 to 2016, amounting to 0.26 Gt annually. Coordinated, committed import tariffs of similar magnitude reduce emissions by 5.4 Gt over the same period. The cost of these import tariffs is only $15 per ton of CO 2 , even accounting for compensating transfers that recognize welfare losses for producing countries. Without coordination and commitment, import tariffs have more limited effects. Alternative policies include domestic export taxes, which are fiscally appealing independent of emission concerns, and a carbon border adjustment mechanism, which encourages domestic regulation.

10.3982/ecta20608.abstractZh: 薄弱的环境监管会产生全球性后果。当国内监管失灵时，国际社会可以通过贸易政策针对排放者。我构建了一个动态实证框架，用于评估贸易政策作为国内监管替代手段的效果，并将该框架应用于棕榈油市场——棕榈油是森林砍伐和全球二氧化碳排放的主要驱动因素。与照常经营相比，50% 的国内生产税在 1988 年至 2016 年间使二氧化碳排放减少 7.4 Gt，年均减少 0.26 Gt。规模相近的协调且有承诺的进口关税在同一时期使排放减少 5.4 Gt。即使考虑到承认生产国福利损失的补偿性转移支付，这些进口关税的成本也仅为每吨二氧化碳 15 美元。若无协调与承诺，进口关税的效果则较为有限。替代政策包括国内出口税——无论是否出于排放关切，其在财政上都具吸引力——以及碳边境调节机制，后者会鼓励国内监管。

abstract.text: This paper examines how drug diversion influences the prescribing practices of physicians and the equilibrium health impacts of prescription medications. Focusing on the case of prescription opioids, a commonly prescribed and frequently diverted medication at the heart of the worst drug crisis in U.S. history, I design and estimate a model of physician behavior in the presence of a secondary market with patient search. To access prescription opioids for medical purposes or misuse, patients search over physicians on the legal primary market or turn to an illegal secondary market. Physicians, who care both about their impact on population health and their revenue from office visits, take into account the possibility that patients might resell their prescriptions on the secondary market when prescribing. The model demonstrates that the potential for diversion will tend to make strict physicians more hesitant in their prescribing while leading lenient prescribers to loosen their prescription thresholds, thereby exacerbating prescribing differences between more and less lenient physicians. Estimates reveal that the presence of a secondary market induces most physicians to be more careful in their prescribing, which brings prescriptions closer to their optimal level, but also causes harm through the reallocation of prescriptions for abuse.

10.3982/ecta20884.abstractZh: 本文考察毒品转移如何影响医生的处方行为以及处方药物的均衡健康影响。本文以处方阿片类药物为研究对象——这类药物被广泛开具且经常被转移，处于美国历史上最严重的毒品危机的核心——设计并估计了一个存在带有患者搜寻的二级市场时的医生行为模型。为获得用于医疗目的或滥用的处方阿片类药物，患者会在合法的初级市场上搜寻医生，或转向非法的二级市场。医生既关心其对人群健康的影响，也关心其来自门诊的收入，在开具处方时会考虑患者可能在二级市场上转售其处方的可能性。模型表明，转移的可能性往往会使严格的医生在开处方时更加犹豫，同时导致宽松的处方者放松其处方阈值，从而加剧较严格与较宽松医生之间的处方差异。估计结果显示，二级市场的存在促使大多数医生在开处方时更加谨慎，这使处方更接近其最优水平，但也通过将处方重新配置于滥用而造成损害。

abstract.text: This paper studies how the risk of hold‐up affects procurement. I use data on the universe of solar power auctions in India. The Indian context allows clean estimates of counterparty risk, because solar plants set up in the same states, by the same firms, are procured in auctions intermediated by either risky states themselves or the trusted central government. I find that the counterparty risk of an average state increases solar prices by 10%. This risk premium sharply reduces investment, because demand for green energy is elastic. Contract intermediation by the central government eliminates the counterparty risk premium.

10.3982/ecta21084.abstractZh: 本文研究敲竹杠风险如何影响采购。我使用印度太阳能拍卖全样本数据。印度这一背景使得能够干净地估计交易对手风险，因为在同一邦、由同一企业建设的太阳能电站，其采购通过由有风险的邦政府本身或受信任的中央政府作为中介的拍卖进行。我发现，平均而言，一个邦的交易对手风险使太阳能价格上升10%。这一风险溢价大幅降低投资，因为绿色能源需求富有弹性。由中央政府进行合同中介可消除交易对手风险溢价。

abstract.text: We analyze marital matching on income using an extremely rich Dutch data set containing all income tax files over seven years. We develop a novel methodology that directly extends previous contributions to allow for highly flexible matching patterns. Investigating all marriages that took place between 2013 and 2019, we find that marital patterns are particularly intriguing. While a majority of couples match assortatively, a small but significant minority display negative assortative matching. We also show that standard approaches, which consider all married couples using current incomes (as opposed to pre‐marriage incomes used in our approach), may generate misleading conclusions.

10.3982/ecta21097.abstractZh: 我们利用一个包含七年全部所得税档案的极为丰富的荷兰数据集，分析基于收入的婚姻匹配。我们提出一种新方法，直接拓展了既有研究，以允许高度灵活的匹配模式。考察2013年至2019年间缔结的所有婚姻后，我们发现婚姻匹配模式尤为引人关注。尽管多数夫妇表现为同型匹配，但一个规模较小却显著的少数群体呈现负向同型匹配。我们还表明，采用当前收入（而非我们方法所使用的婚前收入）来考察所有已婚夫妇的标准方法，可能得出误导性结论。

abstract.text: We estimate long‐run elasticities of substitution between intermediate inputs for Indian manufacturing plants. India's trade liberalization in the early 1990s provides an ideal natural policy experiment, with permanent and heterogeneous tariff reductions inducing changes in relative prices which we use for identification. We find a high degree of substitutability at the plant‐level between 8 broad categories of material inputs, significantly above the Cobb–Douglas benchmark of 1. In contrast, when considering shorter time horizons or more transitory shocks to relative prices, we find evidence of much lower elasticities. Using our long‐run elasticities in a quantitative model, we find that misallocation of intermediate inputs causes a reduction in aggregate output of 29%–3.5 times larger relative to a standard calibration with complementary inputs.

10.3982/ecta21141.abstractZh: 我们估算了印度制造工厂中间投入之间的长期替代弹性。20世纪90年代初印度的贸易自由化提供了一个理想的天然政策实验，永久性和异质性的关税减免导致了相对价格的变化，我们利用这些变化进行识别分析。我们发现，在工厂层面，8大类材料投入之间存在高度的可替代性，这一比例显著高于Cobb–Douglas基准值1。相比之下，当考虑较短的时间范围或对相对价格的更短暂冲击时，我们发现替代弹性要低得多。通过在定量模型中运用这些长期替代弹性，我们发现中间投入的错配会导致总产出减少29%到3.5倍，这一影响比使用互补投入进行标准校准时更为显著。

abstract.text: We develop an optimal policy assignment rule that integrates two distinctive approaches commonly used in economics—targeting by observables and targeting through self‐selection . Our method can be used with experimental or quasi‐experimental data to identify who should be treated, be untreated, and self‐select to achieve a policymaker's objective. Applying this method to a randomized controlled trial on a residential energy rebate program, we find that targeting that optimally exploits both observable data and self‐selection outperforms conventional targeting. We use the Local Average Treatment Effect (LATE) framework (Imbens and Angrist (1994)) to investigate the mechanism in our approach. By estimating several key LATEs based on the random variation created by our experiment, we demonstrate how our method allows policymakers to identify whose self‐selection would be valuable and harmful to social welfare.

10.3982/ecta21180.abstractZh: 我们提出一种最优政策指派规则，该规则整合了经济学中常用的两种不同方法——基于可观测特征的目标定位与通过自我选择实现的目标定位。我们的方法可用于实验或准实验数据，以识别谁应接受处理、谁不应接受处理以及谁应自我选择，从而实现政策制定者的目标。将该方法应用于一项关于居民能源返利计划的随机对照试验，我们发现，同时最优利用可观测数据和自我选择的目标定位优于传统目标定位。我们使用局部平均处理效应（LATE）框架（Imbens and Angrist（1994））来考察我们方法中的机制。通过基于实验所产生的随机变异估计若干关键 LATE，我们展示了我们的方法如何使政策制定者识别出哪些人的自我选择对社会福利有价值、哪些人的自我选择对社会福利有害。

abstract.text: This paper studies security design by bidders with dispersed information about a common‐value investment opportunity. Among a broad set of securities, bidders offer debt financing—the flattest securities. A first reason is that debt mitigates bidders' exposure to the winner's curse when there are two bidders. Second, the entrepreneur either has an informational advantage initially or gains one by inferring from the bids, and is more likely to select debt offers when optimistic about the project. While a bidder's choice of security also has a signaling effect, this effect is dominated by the winner's curse and informed‐selection effects, and does not affect the equilibrium outcome. These results contrast sharply with security design by a monopolistic investor, as well as with DeMarzo, Kremer, and Skrzypacz's (2005) results under private‐value competition. The entrepreneur's ability to commit to an ordered set of securities does not improve revenue.

10.3982/ecta21366.abstractZh: 本文研究竞标者在关于某一共同价值投资机会上拥有分散信息时的证券设计。在一大类证券中，竞标者提供债务融资——即最平坦的证券。第一个原因是，当存在两个竞标者时，债务能够缓解竞标者面临的赢家诅咒风险。第二，企业家最初要么具有信息优势，要么通过从出价中推断而获得信息优势，并且在对项目持乐观态度时更可能选择债务报价。尽管竞标者对证券的选择也具有信号效应，但该效应被赢家诅咒效应和知情选择效应所主导，并且不影响均衡结果。这些结果与垄断投资者的证券设计形成鲜明对比，也与 DeMarzo、Kremer 和 Skrzypacz（2005）在私人价值竞争下的结果形成鲜明对比。企业家承诺一组有序证券的能力并不能提高收入。

abstract.text: Many events and policies (treatments) occur at specific spatial locations, with researchers interested in their effects on nearby units. I approach the spatial treatment setting from an experimental perspective: What ideal experiment would we design to estimate the causal effects of spatial treatments? This perspective motivates a comparison between units near realized treatment locations and units near counterfactual (unrealized) candidate locations, which differs from current empirical practice. I derive design‐based standard errors that are straightforward to compute. For observational data, I propose machine learning methods to find counterfactual candidate locations when observable characteristics, rather than potential outcomes, determine treatment probabilities. To accommodate methods for high‐dimensional data in the theory, I extend a double machine learning result to the design‐based framework with spatial correlations. I apply the proposed methods to study the causal effects of grocery stores on foot traffic to nearby businesses during COVID‐19 shelter‐in‐place policies, finding a large positive effect at very short distances, with no effect at larger distances.

10.3982/ecta21571.abstractZh: 许多事件和政策（干预）发生在特定的空间位置，研究者关注其对邻近单元的影响。我从实验设计的视角来处理空间干预设定：为估计空间干预的因果效应，我们会设计怎样的理想实验？这一视角促使我们将已实现干预位置附近的单元与反事实（未实现）候选位置附近的单元进行比较，这与当前实证做法不同。我推导了易于计算的基于设计的标准误。对于观测数据，当可观测特征而非潜在结果决定干预概率时，我提出机器学习方法来寻找反事实候选位置。为在理论中容纳高维数据方法，我将双重机器学习的一个结果推广到具有空间相关性的基于设计的框架。我将所提方法应用于研究COVID-19居家令期间杂货店对附近商家客流量的因果效应，发现在极短距离上存在较大的正效应，而在较大距离上没有效应。

abstract.text: This paper illustrates and addresses weak identification in the correlated random coefficient (CRC) model that Suri (2011) uses to study agricultural technology adoption. Using the publicly available data set, which differs slightly from the version used in Suri (2011), we obtain different point estimates for the paper's main CRC model. To understand why these differences are as large as they are, we recast the CRC model as a more general random coefficient model in which the returns to hybrid adoption are restricted to be linear in comparative advantage. This reveals that the key structural parameter in the CRC model ( ϕ ), which governs the relationship between baseline productivity and the returns to adoption, is prone to a weak‐identification problem. We then propose a procedure to conduct weak‐identification robust inference on ϕ using test inversion. Our weak‐identification robust confidence intervals contain the original Suri (2011) point estimates, which suggests that the difference in results may be attributable to a combination of minor data differences and weak identification.

10.3982/ecta21760.abstractZh: 本文阐述了Suri（2011）在研究农业技术采纳问题时所使用的相关随机系数模型中的弱识别问题。利用公开可用的数据集，该数据集与Suri（2011）使用的版本略有不同，我们获得了该模型的主要点估计值。为了理解这些差异为何如此之大，我们将相关随机系数模型重新表述为更一般的随机系数模型，在该模型中，混合技术的采纳回报被限制为与比较优势成线性关系。这表明，相关随机系数模型中的关键结构参数（ϕ）容易出现弱识别问题，该参数决定了基线生产力与采纳回报之间的关系。随后，我们提出了一种利用测试反演方法进行弱识别稳健推断的算法。我们的弱识别稳健置信区间包含了Suri（2011）的原始点估计值，这表明结果差异可能源于轻微的数据差异和弱识别问题。

abstract.text: Apprenticeships play a key role in enabling successful school‐to‐work transitions in many countries, but in the presence of imperfect information, the specificity of this type of training may entail important costs for those working outside their training fields. I study this issue in one of the most prominent training settings, the German apprenticeship system. Using administrative data and a broad occupational classification, I find that 40% of individuals work in occupations different from their training. I estimate the cost of mismatch using vacancy instruments and extend methodological approaches in high‐dimensional selection settings. Lacking training in one's occupation entails an average wage penalty of 14%, the equivalent of two years of work experience. The penalty increases with the task distance between training and occupation. My findings suggest that retraining is crucial to mitigate the adverse consequences from imperfect information in specialized training settings.

10.3982/ecta21835.abstractZh: 学徒制在许多国家是帮助青年成功实现从学校到工作过渡的重要机制，但在信息不完全的情况下，这类培训的专业性可能会给那些在所学领域之外工作的人带来显著成本。本文在最典型的培训制度之一——德国学徒制——中研究这一问题。利用行政数据和宽口径职业分类，我发现40%的个体从事与所受培训不同的职业。我使用空缺岗位工具变量估计错配成本，并拓展了高维选择情形下的方法。在所从事职业中缺乏相关培训，平均带来14%的工资惩罚，相当于两年工作经验的回报。该惩罚随培训与职业之间任务距离的增大而上升。我的发现表明，再培训对于缓解专业化培训环境中信息不完全所带来的不利后果至关重要。

abstract.text: This paper explores the impact of information design on the auctioneer's revenue in the U.S. offshore oil/gas lease auctions where, post‐auction, the winner decides whether to explore the auctioned tract and must pay the government a royalty on its production value. I first document that there is a positive correlation between the exploration rate and publicly observed losing bids. This suggests that the winning bidder uses the rivals' bids to infer their private information about the tract's potential. I then characterize the equilibrium bidding strategy when the auctioneer designs and commits to how to reveal information on losing bids to the winning bidder. Counterfactual exercises reveal that alternative bid disclosure policies significantly improve auctioneer revenue.

10.3982/ecta21839.abstractZh: 本文考察信息设计如何影响美国海上油气租赁拍卖中拍卖方的收入。在该拍卖中，拍卖结束后，中标者决定是否勘探所拍卖的地块，并须就其产值向政府支付权利金。我首先记录到，勘探率与公开观测到的未中标出价之间存在正相关。这表明，中标者利用竞争对手的出价来推断其关于该地块潜力的私人信息。随后，我刻画了当拍卖方设计并承诺如何向中标者披露未中标出价信息时的均衡出价策略。反事实模拟表明，替代性的出价披露政策显著提高了拍卖方收入。

abstract.text: We apply a revealed preference approach to administrative data from Washington to show that constraints on work hours are widespread: Workers have limited discretion over hours at a given employer, and there is substantial mismatch of workers who prefer long hours to employers that provide short hours. Voluntary job transitions imply a ratio of the marginal rate of substitution of earnings for hours to the wage rate of 0.5–0.6 for prime‐age workers. The average absolute deviation between observed and optimal hours is about 15%, and low‐wage workers face particularly acute constraints on hours. On average, observed hours tend to be less than preferred levels, and workers would require a 12% higher wage with their current employer to be as well off as with an employer offering ideal hours. These findings suggest that hour constraints are an equilibrium feature of the labor market because long‐hour jobs are costly to employers.

10.3982/ecta21849.abstractZh: 我们利用华盛顿州行政数据，采用显示性偏好方法表明，工作时间约束普遍存在：劳动者在给定雇主处对工作时间的自主决定权有限，且偏好长工作时间的劳动者与提供短工作时间的雇主之间存在显著错配。自愿工作转换意味着，对于黄金年龄劳动者，收入对工作时间的边际替代率与工资率之比为 0.5—0.6。观测工作时间与最优工作时间之间的平均绝对偏差约为 15%，低工资劳动者面临的工作时间约束尤为严重。平均而言，观测工作时间往往低于偏好水平，劳动者需要在其当前雇主处获得高出 12% 的工资，才能与在提供理想工作时间的雇主处工作一样好。这些发现表明，工作时间约束是劳动力市场的一个均衡特征，因为长工作时间岗位对雇主而言成本较高。

abstract.text: This paper studies the economic effects of rural‐urban migration on Brazilian cities. Using a shift‐share IV design, we show that, over a decade, drought‐induced immigration reduces informality, has no effect on unemployment, and increases the number of formal firms and jobs. Downward formal wage adjustments play a key role, as these long‐run effects are weaker in regions with stronger wage rigidity. In the short run, when wage rigidity is strongest, we replicate the informality‐increasing effects documented in the literature. We develop and estimate a model of firm dynamics and informality that rationalizes these results. The counterfactuals reveal that, in the short run, the informal sector absorbs the expanding labor force and acts as a “stepping‐stone” to formality for firms and workers. In the long run, however, it reduces the aggregate benefits from immigration by allowing the least productive firms to survive.

10.3982/ecta21854.abstractZh: 本文研究乡城迁移对巴西城市的经济影响。采用移动份额工具变量设计，我们表明，在十年间，干旱引致的移民降低了非正规性，对失业没有影响，并增加了正规企业数量和正规就业岗位数量。正规工资向下调整发挥了关键作用，因为在工资刚性较强的地区，这些长期效应较弱。在短期内，当工资刚性最强时，我们复现了文献中记录的非正规性上升效应。我们构建并估计了一个企业动态与非正规性的模型，以对这些结果作出合理解释。反事实分析表明，在短期内，非正规部门吸收了扩张的劳动力，并为企业与劳动者充当通向正规化的“踏脚石”。然而在长期内，它通过让生产率最低的企业得以存续，降低了移民带来的总量收益。

abstract.text: Personalizing policies can theoretically increase their effectiveness. However, personalization is difficult when individual types are unobservable and the preferences of policymakers and individuals are not aligned, which could cause individuals to misreport their type. Mechanism design offers a strategy to overcome this issue: offer an “incentive‐compatible” menu of policy choices designed to induce participants to select the variant intended for their type. Using a field experiment that personalized incentives for exercise among 6,800 adults with diabetes and hypertension in urban India, we show that personalizing with an incentive‐compatible choice menu substantially improves program performance, increasing the treatment effect of incentives on exercise by 80% without increasing incentive costs relative to a one‐size‐fits‐all benchmark. Offering choice achieves similar performance to personalizing with an extensive set of observable variables, but without the same data requirements.

10.3982/ecta21926.abstractZh: 个性化政策在理论上可以提高其有效性。然而，当个体类型不可观测且政策制定者与个体的偏好并不一致时，个性化便难以实现，因为这可能导致个体虚报自身类型。机制设计提供了一种克服该问题的策略：提供一份“激励相容”的政策选择菜单，旨在引导参与者选择为其类型所设计的方案。我们利用一项在印度城市 6,800 名患有糖尿病和高血压的成年人中开展的、对运动激励进行个性化的田野实验表明，借助激励相容的选择菜单进行个性化，能够显著改善项目表现，相对于“一刀切”基准，使激励对运动的处理效应提高 80%，且不增加激励成本。提供选择所达到的效果与利用大量可观测变量进行个性化相近，但所需数据要求更低。

abstract.text: A buyer and seller bargain in continuous time over a good. Bargainers can be rational or committed to some fixed price. A rational buyer has a private value and outside option. If the set of buyer values and commitment types is rich and the probability of commitment vanishes, outcomes are partially consistent with the Coase conjecture: the seller chooses a price below the maximum of the lowest outside option and half the lowest value; the buyer immediately accepts or takes his outside option.

10.3982/ecta22022.abstractZh: 买方与卖方在连续时间内就一种商品进行议价。议价者可以是理性的，也可以坚持某个固定价格。理性买方拥有私人价值和外部选项。如果买方价值与承诺类型的集合足够丰富，且承诺类型的概率趋于零，则结果与科斯猜想部分一致：卖方选择的价格低于最低外部选项与最低价值一半二者中的最大值；买方立即接受或选择其外部选项。

abstract.text: We investigate work as informal redistribution, leveraging field experiments and firm‐level survey data from Kampala, Uganda. Employers and workers consistently choose redistribution through work over cash transfers, revealing a willingness to pay for work. By randomizing work tasks—some designed to have zero marginal product—we find that production value does not explain these choices: employers pay for zero‐value work. These patterns are also inconsistent with other relational benefits, such as social image concerns or networking. Instead, motivations are normative. Experimental evidence reveals an internalized norm for redistribution through work rooted in incentive arguments on the demand side—as employers stop requiring work only when workers have verifiable emergencies—and in reciprocity and dignity from earning on the supply side. The norm shapes both the organization and measurement of production: failing to account for redistribution through work makes firms appear significantly larger and less productive than they are.

10.3982/ecta22079.abstractZh: 我们研究了工作作为一种非正式的再分配方式，通过乌干达坎帕拉的实地实验和企业层面的调查数据进行了研究。雇主和工人始终选择通过工作而非现金转移来进行再分配，这表明他们愿意为工作付出代价。通过随机分配工作任务——其中一些任务边际产品为零——我们发现，生产价值并不能解释这些选择：雇主为这些零价值的工作支付报酬。这些模式与其他关系性利益也不一致，比如社会形象或人脉关系的考虑。相反，这些动机是规范性的。实验证据显示，通过工作进行再分配的内在规范源于需求方面的激励论点——即雇主只有在工人有可验证的紧急情况时才要求工作——以及供应方面的互惠性和尊严感。这种规范影响了生产和组织的衡量方式：如果不考虑通过工作进行的再分配，企业就会显得规模更大、生产力更低。

abstract.text: I document that the right tail of the firm size distribution systematically thickens with economic development. To rationalize this fact, I develop a parsimonious idea search model in which both aggregate growth and the firm size distribution are endogenously determined. The model features an asymptotic balanced growth path along which Gibrat's law holds at each date, and the right tail of the firm size distribution thickens monotonically toward Zipf's law. The model also implies that policies favoring large firms can improve welfare by better utilizing the diffusion externalities arising from idea search.

10.3982/ecta22110.abstractZh: 我记录了企业规模分布的右尾随经济发展而系统性变厚。为解释这一事实，我构建了一个简约的思想搜索模型，其中总量增长与企业规模分布均为内生决定。该模型具有一条渐近平衡增长路径，沿该路径吉布拉特定律在每个时点均成立，且企业规模分布的右尾单调地趋近于齐普夫定律。该模型还意味着，偏向大企业的政策可以通过更好地利用思想搜索所产生的扩散外部性来提高福利。

abstract.text: We derive a novel decomposition of the Gini coefficient into within‐ and between‐group inequality terms that sum to the aggregate Gini coefficient. This decomposition is derived from a set of axioms that ensure desirable behavior for the within‐ and between‐group inequality terms. The decomposition of the Gini coefficient is unique given our axioms, easy to compute, and can be interpreted geometrically.

10.3982/ecta22145.abstractZh: 我们推导出基尼系数的一种新分解，将其分解为组内不平等与组间不平等两项，且两项之和等于总体基尼系数。该分解由一组公理推导得出，这些公理确保组内不平等项与组间不平等项具有合意的性质。在给定我们的公理下，基尼系数的该分解是唯一的，易于计算，并可从几何上加以解释。

abstract.text: Internal labor markets are increasingly important for matching workers to jobs within organizations. We present evidence from a randomized trial that compares matching workers to jobs using the deferred acceptance (DA) algorithm to the traditional manager‐directed matching process. Our setting is the U.S. Army's internal labor market, which matches over 14,000 officers to units annually. We find that DA reduces administrative burden and increases match quality as measured by reduced justified envy, increased truthful preference reporting, and officers' and units' preferences over their matches. The overall impact of DA on officer retention and performance in the two years after officers started their new jobs is limited by strategic preference coordination between officers and units. However, DA leads to significant improvements in officer retention and promotions in markets with inexperienced managers. Our findings suggest that cross‐market communication between agents in internal labor markets can attenuate the benefits of strategyproof matching algorithms.

10.3982/ecta22160.abstractZh: 内部劳动力市场在将劳动者与组织内岗位进行匹配方面日益重要。我们提供了一项随机试验的证据，该试验比较了使用延迟接受（DA）算法将劳动者与岗位匹配和传统的管理者主导匹配过程。我们的研究场景是美国陆军的内部劳动力市场，该市场每年将超过14,000名军官与单位进行匹配。我们发现，DA减轻了行政负担，并提高了匹配质量，衡量指标包括合理化嫉妒减少、真实偏好报告增加，以及军官和单位对其匹配结果的偏好。DA对军官在新岗位开始后两年内的留任和绩效的总体影响，受到军官与单位之间策略性偏好协调的限制。然而，在管理者经验不足的市场中，DA显著改善了军官留任和晋升。我们的发现表明，内部劳动力市场中经济主体之间的跨市场沟通可能削弱策略防伪匹配算法的收益。

abstract.text: Extreme value processes feature in any economic model in which agents receive a number of draws from some distribution of values and we examine the behavior of the maximum value in the limit as the number of draws becomes large. This paper asks: Do the average outcomes of such processes change when different agents receive a different number of draws? To answer this, we allow the number of draws an agent receives from the underlying distribution of values (e.g., productivities, ideas, or utility shocks) to be given by a search technology , which reflects heterogeneity in the expected number of draws across different types of agents. We derive a new class of extreme value distributions that generalizes the three standard distributions (Fréchet, Gumbel, Weibull) by incorporating heterogeneity across agents. We generalize a result from Gabaix, Laibson, Li, Li, Resnick, and de Vries (2016) regarding extreme value outcomes and consider applications to aggregate productivity, markups, and social networks.

10.3982/ecta22276.abstractZh: 极值过程在任何经济模型中都具有重要意义，其中个体会从某个价值分布中接收一定次数的抽样。本文研究当抽样次数趋于无穷大时，最大值的行为变化。本文提出的问题是：当不同个体接收的抽样次数不同时，这类过程的平均结果是否会发生变化？为了回答这个问题，我们允许个体从基础价值分布中接收的抽样次数由一种搜索技术决定，这反映了不同类型个体预期抽样次数的异质性。我们推导出了一种新的极值分布类，该分布通过结合不同个体的异质性，对三种标准分布（Fréchet、Gumbel、Weibull）进行了推广。我们还推广了Gabaix、Laibson、Li、Li、Resnick和de Vries在2016年提出的关于极值结果的结果，并将其应用于总体生产率、加价和社会网络等领域。

abstract.text: This paper investigates concerns that vertically integrated platforms like Amazon steer demand toward their own offers via algorithmic prominence, potentially harming consumers. On Amazon, for each product, the Buybox prominence algorithm selects one seller to feature, influencing which offers consumers consider. Using novel Amazon sales and Buybox (prominence) data, we estimate a structural model capturing the effects of such algorithmic prominence on consumer choices, seller pricing, and entry. We find that the platform can indeed steer demand as 95% of consumers consider only the Buybox offer. The Buybox is highly price‐elastic (−21), but skews toward Amazon's own offers, which are featured as frequently as observably similar offers priced 5% cheaper. Still, as consumers prefer these offers, this skew does not amount to self‐preferencing in the sense of harming consumers: consumer surplus is roughly maximized at the estimated Amazon Buybox advantage, which balances higher prices against showing consumers their preferred offers.

10.3982/ecta22288.abstractZh: 本文探讨了像亚马逊这样的垂直整合平台通过算法优势将需求引导至自身产品的问题，这可能对消费者造成伤害。在亚马逊平台上，对于每个产品，Buybox优势算法会选择一个卖家进行推荐，从而影响消费者所考虑的优惠信息。利用亚马逊的销售数据和Buybox数据，我们构建了一个结构模型，以分析这种算法优势对消费者选择、卖家定价以及市场进入的影响。研究发现，平台确实能够引导需求，因为95%的消费者仅考虑Buybox中的优惠信息。Buybox的价格弹性很高（−21），但消费者更倾向于选择亚马逊自身的产品，因为这些产品被频繁推荐，且价格比其他类似产品低5%。尽管如此，由于消费者更喜欢这些产品，这种偏好并不等同于对消费者的伤害：消费者剩余在估计的亚马逊Buybox优势点处达到最大，这既平衡了较高的价格，又让消费者看到他们更喜欢的优惠信息。

abstract.text: We develop a dynamic structural model of patent screening incorporating incentives, intrinsic motivation, and multiround negotiation. We use natural language processing to create a measure of patent distance, which together with detailed data on examiner decisions, enables us to estimate the model and study strategic decisions by applicants and examiners. Using the estimated model, we quantify the effectiveness of the U.S. Patent Office and evaluate counterfactual policy reforms. We find that patent screening is moderately effective, given the existing standards for patentability. Examiners exhibit substantial intrinsic motivation that strongly improves screening quality. We quantify the annual social costs of patent screening at $15.38bn, equivalent to 5% of total private sector R&D in the U.S. and show that reforms limiting the number of rounds of negotiation significantly reduce social costs.

10.3982/ecta22363.abstractZh: 我们构建了一个专利审查的动态结构模型，纳入激励、内在动机与多轮谈判。我们使用自然语言处理构建专利距离的度量，并结合审查员决策的详细数据，使我们能够估计该模型并研究申请人与审查员的策略性决策。利用估计得到的模型，我们量化美国专利局的有效性并评估反事实政策改革。我们发现，在现行可专利性标准下，专利审查具有中等程度的效果。审查员表现出显著的内在动机，这大幅提高了审查质量。我们量化专利审查的年度社会成本为 153.8 亿美元，相当于美国私营部门 R&D 总投入的 5%，并表明限制谈判轮数的改革会显著降低社会成本。

abstract.text: Shrinkage methods are frequently used to improve the precision of least squares estimators of fixed effects. However, widely used shrinkage estimators guarantee improved precision only under strong distributional assumptions. I develop an estimator for the fixed effects that obtains the best possible mean squared error within a class of shrinkage estimators. This class includes conventional shrinkage estimators and the optimality does not require distributional assumptions. The estimator has an intuitive form and is easy to implement. Moreover, the fixed effects are allowed to vary with time and to be serially correlated, in which case the shrinkage optimally incorporates the underlying correlation structure. I also provide a method to forecast fixed effects one period ahead in this setting.

10.3982/ecta22386.abstractZh: 收缩方法常被用于提高固定效应最小二乘估计量的精度。然而，广泛使用的收缩估计量只有在较强的分布假设下才能保证精度改进。本文为固定效应开发了一个估计量，该估计量在一类收缩估计量中实现了尽可能最优的均方误差。这一类包括传统收缩估计量，且最优性不要求分布假设。该估计量形式直观且易于实施。此外，固定效应允许随时间变化并存在序列相关，在此情形下收缩最优地纳入了潜在的相关结构。本文还提供了一种在该设定下提前一期预测固定效应的方法。

abstract.text: We construct a dynamic integrated assessment model of climate and the economy with very high geographic resolution. Migration is free within, but not allowed across, countries. The model parameterization uses a wealth of data, including the distribution of output, population, energy sources and use, and estimates of the local damages from climate change. It implies very large geographic dispersion in damages from warming. We conduct three kinds of policy experiments. In one, we note that a modest, uniform carbon tax limits global warming and damages around the world substantially. In a second experiment, we let the poorest countries not tax carbon, while the rest compensate by setting higher taxes; the efficiency losses are large. In a final experiment, we find that fast green technology growth alone is a poor substitute for carbon taxes, whether globally available or not.

10.3982/ecta22451.abstractZh: 我们构建了一个具有极高地理分辨率的气候与经济动态综合评估模型。迁移在国内自由进行，但不允许跨国迁移。模型参数化使用了大量数据，包括产出、人口、能源来源与使用的分布，以及气候变化本地损害的估计值。模型意味着气候变暖所致损害在地理上存在极大差异。我们进行了三类政策实验。在第一类实验中，我们指出，适度且统一的碳税能够大幅限制全球变暖及其在世界各地造成的损害。在第二类实验中，我们让最贫穷的国家不对碳征税，而其余国家通过设定更高税率来补偿；效率损失很大。在最后一类实验中，我们发现，快速的绿色技术增长本身无论是否在全球范围内可得，都是碳税的不良替代品。

abstract.text: We propose a novel optimal transport‐based version of the Generalized Method of Moment (GMM). Instead of handling overidentification by reweighting the data to satisfy the moment conditions (as in Generalized Empirical Likelihood methods), this method proceeds by allowing for errors in the variables of the least mean‐square magnitude necessary to simultaneously satisfy all moment conditions. This approach, based on the notions of optimal transport and Wasserstein metric, aims to address the problem of assigning a logical interpretation to GMM results even when overidentification tests reject the null, a situation that cannot always be avoided in applications. We illustrate the method by revisiting Duranton, Morrow and Turner's (2014) study of the relationship between a city's exports and the extent of its transportation infrastructure. Our results corroborate theirs under weaker assumptions and provide insight into the error structure of the variables.

10.3982/ecta22486.abstractZh: 我们提出一种基于最优传输的广义矩方法（GMM）新版本。该方法不通过重新加权数据以满足矩条件来处理过度识别问题（如广义经验似然方法所做的那样），而是允许变量中存在误差，并使这些误差的均方幅度最小，以同时满足所有矩条件。这一方法基于最优传输和 Wasserstein 度量的概念，旨在解决即使在过度识别检验拒绝原假设时仍为 GMM 结果赋予逻辑解释的问题——这种情况在应用中并不总能避免。我们通过重新审视 Duranton、Morrow 和 Turner（2014）关于城市出口与其交通基础设施规模之间关系的研究来说明该方法。我们的结果在更弱的假设下印证了他们的结论，并有助于理解变量的误差结构。

abstract.text: We investigate how formularies used by pharmacy benefit managers (PBMs) affect equilibrium manufacturer rebates for branded drugs through tiering and exclusion. We develop a theoretical model of multidimensional contracting in which a PBM negotiates with drug manufacturers over menus of formulary‐contingent rebates and chooses a formulary. We then estimate consumer demand responses to tier placement for statins using claims data from Princeton University, a large employer contracting with a single PBM to offer prescription drug coverage to its employees. Combining the theoretical model with demand estimates and observed list prices, we quantify how allowing for differential tier placement and exclusion affect equilibrium rebates. Our predictions are consistent with available aggregate rebate data, and we find that allowing a PBM to place branded drugs on preferred‐ and non‐preferred tiers can substantially increase negotiated rebate payments.

10.3982/ecta22488.abstractZh: 我们研究了药房福利管理公司所使用的处方格式如何通过分层和排除机制影响品牌药物的均衡回扣。我们建立了一个多维契约理论模型，其中药房福利管理公司与药品制造商就基于处方格式的回扣方案进行谈判，并选择相应的处方格式。随后，我们利用普林斯顿大学提供的索赔数据来估计消费者对他汀类药物分层安排的响应。普林斯顿大学是一个大型雇主，与单一药房福利管理公司合作，为其员工提供处方药覆盖服务。通过结合理论模型、需求估计数据和实际标价数据，我们量化了不同分层安排和排除机制对均衡回扣的影响。我们的预测与现有的综合回扣数据一致，我们发现允许药房福利管理公司将品牌药物分配到优先和非优先层级，可以显著提高谈判回扣金额。

abstract.text: We develop a comprehensive framework to evaluate policy interventions aimed at curbing false news dissemination on social media. Using a randomized experiment on Twitter and X during the 2022 and 2024 U.S. elections, we assess priming for misinformation awareness, fact‐checking, confirmation clicks, and content consideration prompts. Priming proves most effective in reducing false‐news sharing while preserving true news dissemination. We build and structurally estimate a model of sharing, motivated by partisan persuasion, partisan signaling, and reputational concerns. We identify three channels through which policies influence sharing: (i) updating perceived veracity and partisanship of content, (ii) raising salience of reputation, and (iii) increasing engagement costs. Differences in the effects of policies are explained by the salience and cost channels. Content‐neutral priming is best at enhancing salience of reputation at minimal cost and almost as effective as fact‐checking in updating veracity. Salience channel is stronger when users encounter uncontroversially true content.

10.3982/ecta22524.abstractZh: 我们构建了一个综合框架，用于评估旨在遏制社交媒体上虚假新闻传播的政策干预。利用2022年和2024年美国选举期间在Twitter和X上进行的一项随机实验，我们评估了错误信息意识启动、事实核查、确认性点击以及内容考量提示等干预措施。启动干预在减少虚假新闻分享方面最为有效，同时保留了真实新闻的传播。我们构建并结构估计了一个分享模型，其动机来自党派说服、党派信号传递和声誉关切。我们识别出政策影响分享的三条渠道：（i）更新对内容真实性和党派性的感知，（ii）提高声誉的显著性，以及（iii）增加参与成本。政策效果的差异可由显著性和成本渠道来解释。内容中性的启动干预在以最小成本增强声誉显著性方面效果最佳，且在更新真实性感知方面几乎与事实核查同样有效。当用户接触到无争议的真实内容时，显著性渠道更强。

abstract.text: This paper develops a macroeconomic model that combines an incomplete‐markets overlapping‐generations economy with a job ladder featuring sequential wage bargaining, endogenous search effort of employed and non‐employed workers, and differences in match quality. With these ingredients, our model provides a joint microfoundation for the three main inputs in aggregate production: capital, employment, and labor efficiency. The calibrated model offers a good fit to the empirical age profiles of search activity, job‐finding rates, wages, and savings. We use the model to analyze the impact of tax and transfer policies for labor market dynamics and aggregate economic activity via capital, employment, and labor efficiency channels. Lower unemployment benefits and a less progressive tax schedule bring about welfare losses for a newborn worker which are mainly driven by higher consumption risk and costlier search effort; both policies have differential effects along the age, income, and wealth dimensions.

10.3982/ecta22542.abstractZh: 本文构建了一个宏观经济模型，将不完全市场世代交叠经济与包含序贯工资谈判、就业与非就业劳动者内生搜寻努力以及匹配质量差异的岗位阶梯相结合。借助这些要素，我们的模型为总量生产中的三个主要投入——资本、就业和劳动效率——提供了统一的微观基础。校准后的模型能够较好地拟合搜寻活动、求职率、工资和储蓄的年龄经验剖面。我们运用该模型，通过资本、就业和劳动效率渠道，分析税收与转移支付政策对劳动力市场动态和总量经济活动的影响。降低失业保险金和降低累进性的税制会给新进入劳动力市场的劳动者带来福利损失，这些损失主要由更高的消费风险和更昂贵的搜寻努力所驱动；这两项政策在年龄、收入和财富维度上均具有差异化效应。

abstract.text: Multivariate linear regression and randomization‐based inference are two essential methods in statistics and econometrics. Nevertheless, the problem of producing a randomized test for the value of a single regression coefficient that is exactly valid when errors are exchangeable, and which is asymptotically valid for the best linear predictor, has remained elusive. In this paper, we produce a test that is exactly valid with exchangeable errors and which allows for general covariate designs; covariates may be continuous as well as discrete and may be correlated. The test is asymptotically valid when the errors are not exchangeable, in particular in the presence of conditional heteroskedasticity.

10.3982/ecta22545.abstractZh: 多变量线性回归和基于随机化的推断是统计学和计量经济学中的两种重要方法。然而，当误差可交换时，如何构造一个对于单个回归系数的值具有精确有效性的随机化检验，并且对于最佳线性预测器而言具有渐近有效性，这一难题一直难以解决。在本文中，我们提出了一种检验方法，该方法在误差可交换的情况下具有精确有效性，并且适用于各种协变量设计；协变量可以是连续的，也可以是离散的，并且可能存在相关性。当误差不可交换时，特别是在存在条件异方差性的情况下，该检验仍然具有渐近有效性。

abstract.text: This paper studies the labor market impacts of firm accommodation decisions after workplace disability and assesses implications for the design of firm subsidies. We leverage a workers' compensation (WC) program in Oregon that provides wage subsidies to firms for accommodating workers with workplace disabilities. Leveraging rich administrative data and a policy change to the wage subsidy, we show that accommodation rates respond to the subsidy rate and that receipt of accommodation leads to a significant increase in employment and earnings a year later. To explore welfare implications, we develop and estimate a frictional labor market model of accommodation as a form of human capital investment. Worker turnover and imperfect experience rating in WC lead to underaccommodation and inefficient labor market outcomes after workplace disability. Counterfactual simulations show that subsidizing accommodation not only improves long‐run labor market outcomes of workers experiencing work‐related disability but also yields welfare gains for most workers.

10.3982/ecta22565.abstractZh: 本文研究工作场所残疾发生后企业提供便利决策对劳动力市场的影响，并评估其对企业补贴设计的含义。我们利用俄勒冈州一项工伤补偿（WC）项目，该项目向为工作场所残疾劳动者提供便利的企业发放工资补贴。借助丰富的行政数据和一次工资补贴政策变动，我们表明便利提供率会对补贴率作出反应，且获得便利会使一年后的就业和收入显著增加。为探讨福利含义，我们构建并估计了一个将便利视为人力资本投资形式的摩擦性劳动力市场模型。劳动者流动和WC中不完善的经验费率导致工作场所残疾后便利提供不足和劳动力市场结果无效率。反事实模拟表明，对便利提供进行补贴不仅改善了经历工作相关残疾的劳动者的长期劳动力市场结果，还为大多数劳动者带来福利收益。

abstract.text: We provide sufficient conditions for equilibrium existence in first‐price auctions with private values that accommodate non quasi‐linear utilities and value‐distributions that contain atoms and exhibit positive or negative correlation. These conditions show that equilibrium existence often turns on properties of a single statistic of the joint distribution of values, namely, the minimum value in the support of the high‐value distribution (the mHV). We also show that modifying the standard tie‐breaking rule only at the mHV is enough to guarantee equilibrium existence without our sufficient conditions. Our results also apply to Bertrand price competition when each firm's constant marginal cost is private information.

10.3982/ecta22570.abstractZh: 我们给出了私人价值首价拍卖中均衡存在的充分条件，这些条件允许非拟线性效用以及包含原子并呈现正相关或负相关的价值分布。这些条件表明，均衡存在往往取决于价值联合分布的一个单一统计量的性质，即高价值分布支撑中的最小值（mHV）。我们还表明，仅在高价值分布支撑中的最小值处修改标准平局规则，就足以在无需我们的充分条件的情况下保证均衡存在。当每家企业的不变边际成本为私人信息时，我们的结果也适用于伯特兰价格竞争。

abstract.text: We cast the problem of communicating scientific uncertainty as one of reporting a posterior distribution on an unknown parameter to an audience of Bayesian decision‐makers. We establish novel bounds on the audience's regret when the analyst reports an approximation to a posterior that the audience treats as exact. Under a palatable restriction on the audience's decision problems, the bounds take an especially convenient form. Under a further restriction on the audience's priors, a bootstrap distribution can be used as a stand‐in posterior. We propose a practical recipe for checking whether a conventional statistical report (say, a normal parameterized by a point estimate and standard error) is a good approximation, and for improving the report if it is not. We illustrate our proposals using the articles in the 2021 American Economic Review that use a bootstrap for inference.

10.3982/ecta22613.abstractZh: 我们将科学不确定性的沟通问题设定为：向作为贝叶斯决策者的受众报告未知参数的后验分布。我们建立了新的界，用于刻画当分析者报告的是后验分布的近似值、而受众将其视为精确值时受众所承受的后悔。在对受众决策问题的一项合理限制下，这些界呈现出特别便利的形式。在对受众先验的进一步限制下，自助分布（bootstrap distribution）可作为后验分布的替代。我们提出一套实用方法，用于检验常规统计报告（例如由点估计和标准误参数化的正态分布）是否为良好近似，并在其并非良好近似时改进该报告。我们利用2021年《American Economic Review》中使用自助法进行推断的文章来说明我们的建议。

abstract.text: Macroeconomic outcomes depend on the distribution of markups across firms and over time, making firm‐level markup estimates key for macroeconomic analysis. Methods to obtain these estimates require data on the prices that firms charge. Firm‐level data with wide coverage, however, primarily come from financial statements, which lack information on prices. We use an analytical framework to show that trends in markups over time or the dispersion of markups across firms can still be well‐measured with such data. Measuring the average level of the markup does require pricing data, and we propose a consistent estimator for such settings. We validate the analytical results using simulations of a quantitative macroeconomic model and offer supporting evidence from firm‐level administrative production and pricing data. Our analysis supports the use of financial data to measure trends in aggregate markups.

10.3982/ecta22733.abstractZh: 宏观经济结果取决于加成率在企业间以及时间上的分布，因此企业层面的加成率估计对宏观经济分析至关重要。获取这些估计的方法需要企业所收取价格的数据。然而，覆盖面广泛的企业层面数据主要来自财务报表，而财务报表缺乏价格信息。我们运用一个分析框架表明，加成率随时间的趋势或加成率在企业间的离散度，仍可用此类数据得到良好测度。测度加成率的平均水平确实需要定价数据，我们针对此类情形提出了一个一致的估计量。我们通过一个定量宏观经济模型的模拟验证了分析结果，并提供了来自企业层面行政生产与定价数据的支持性证据。我们的分析支持使用财务数据来测度总体加成率的趋势。

abstract.text: Gaussian empirical Bayes methods usually maintain a precision independence assumption: The unknown parameters of interest are independent from the known standard errors of the estimates. This assumption is often theoretically questionable and empirically rejected. This paper proposes to model the conditional distribution of the parameter given the standard errors as a flexibly parameterized location‐scale family of distributions, leading to a family of methods that we call close . The close framework unifies and generalizes several proposals under precision dependence. We argue that the most flexible member of the close family is a minimalist and computationally efficient default for accounting for precision dependence. We analyze this method and show that it is competitive in terms of the regret of subsequent decision rules. Empirically, using close leads to sizable gains for selecting high‐mobility Census tracts.

10.3982/ecta22935.abstractZh: 高斯经验贝叶斯方法通常维持一个精度独立性假设：待估的未知参数与已知的估计标准误相互独立。这一假设在理论上常常值得怀疑，在经验上也遭到拒绝。本文提出将参数在给定标准误下的条件分布建模为一个灵活参数化的位置—尺度分布族，由此得到一族我们称为 close 的方法。close 框架统一并推广了精度依赖下的若干方案。我们认为，close 族中最灵活的成员是处理精度依赖的一种极简且计算高效的默认方法。我们分析了该方法，并表明其在后续决策规则的遗憾值方面具有竞争力。在经验上，使用 close 在选择高流动性普查 tract 方面带来了可观的收益。

abstract.text: How can we extract theoretical insights from machine learning algorithms? We take a familiar lesson: researchers often turn intuition into theoretical insight by constructing “anomalies”—specific examples highlighting hypothesized flaws in a theory, such as the Allais paradox. We develop procedures that replace researchers' intuitions with predictive algorithms: given a predictive algorithm and a theory, our procedures automatically generate anomalies for that theory. We illustrate our procedures by generating anomalies for expected utility theory. Based on a neural network that accurately predicts lottery choices, we recover known anomalies for expected utility theory and discover novel ones. In incentivized experiments, subjects violate expected utility theory on these algorithmically generated anomalies at rates similar to the Allais paradox and common ratio effect.

10.3982/ecta22958.abstractZh: 我们如何从机器学习算法中提取理论洞见？我们可以借鉴一个常见的例子：研究人员通常通过构建“异常现象”来将直觉转化为理论洞见——这些异常现象是突出理论中存在缺陷的具体例子，例如Allais悖论。我们开发了一些程序，用预测算法替代研究人员的直觉：给定一个预测算法和一个理论，我们的程序会自动为该理论生成异常现象。我们通过为期望效用理论生成异常现象来说明这些程序。基于一个能够准确预测彩票选择的神经网络，我们发现了期望效用理论中的已知异常现象，并发现了新的异常现象。在激励实验中，受试者在这些算法生成的异常现象上违反期望效用理论的比例与Allais悖论和常见比率效应相似。

abstract.text: Studies on agricultural technology adoption often focus on one input, practice, or package, which is analytically useful, but may overlook the complexities involved with multidimensional learning needed for a lot of agricultural decisions. In Kenya, we study farmers' dynamic learning (from oneself and others) and adoption decisions over six seasons after randomly inviting them to participate in agronomic research trials, comparing different combinations of inputs during three consecutive seasons. As a response to the trials, adoption increases steadily despite the absence of positive profits multiple seasons after exposure to the trials. Know‐how increases rapidly and faster for high skill farmers who experiment the most, at the cost of making new mistakes. The findings are consistent with a theoretical model with multidimensionality of input and practice decisions and differential learning from one's own experience by skills, where complementarities imply that adoption of an input requires finding how to re‐optimize other dimensions, which adds to the cost of adoption.

10.3982/ecta22974.abstractZh: 关于农业技术采纳的研究往往聚焦于单一投入、单一做法或单一技术组合，这在分析上有其用处，但可能忽视了许多农业决策所需的多维学习所涉及的复杂性。在肯尼亚，我们研究了农民在六个种植季中的动态学习（向自身经验学习和向他人学习）与采纳决策：我们随机邀请农民参加农艺研究试验，并在连续三个种植季中比较不同的投入组合。作为对试验的响应，尽管在接触试验后的多个种植季中并未出现正利润，采纳率仍稳步上升。技能水平高的农民试验最多，其诀窍知识增长迅速且快于他人，但代价是犯下新的错误。这些发现与一个理论模型相一致：该模型包含投入与做法决策的多维性，以及不同技能者从自身经验中学习的差异；其中，互补性意味着采纳某一投入需要找到如何重新优化其他维度的方法，这增加了采纳成本。

abstract.text: The U.S. Supreme Court's 2010 decision in Citizens United v. Federal Election Commission deregulated campaign finance, enabling the rise of a new political action committee (the Super PAC) with broad freedom to raise and spend money. This led to an unprecedented surge in spending in primary and general elections. To evaluate the impact of Super PACs, I estimate a multistage model of political competition using data from U.S. Congressional elections between 2010 and 2020. I find that Super PAC spending by both sides prompts offsetting responses, resulting in limited net equilibrium effects. However, by amplifying the role of donors, Super PACs still have the potential to reshape the electoral landscape.

10.3982/ecta22979.abstractZh: 美国最高法院2010年在Citizens United诉联邦选举委员会案中的裁决放松了竞选财务监管，促成了新型政治行动委员会（Super PAC）的兴起，使其在筹款和支出方面拥有广泛自由。这导致初选和大选中的支出出现前所未有的激增。为评估Super PAC的影响，我使用2010年至2020年美国国会选举数据估计了一个多阶段政治竞争模型。我发现，两方的Super PAC支出都会引发相互抵消的反应，导致净均衡效应有限。然而，通过放大捐赠者的作用，Super PAC仍有可能重塑选举格局。

abstract.text: We consider a dynamic buyer–seller interaction. Instead of the buyer's valuation, it is the frequency with which he needs to trade that is the buyer's private information. The difference matters. With commitment, full surplus extraction is possible, for instance via limited‐time offers. Without commitment, ratcheting is mitigated, as not buying is not necessarily a sign of strength. Because time is informative, the seller learns and may adjust her behavior over time. When finding a suitable alternative seller is easy, she starts with a pooling offer before permanently switching to a screening offer. When finding a suitable alternative seller takes time, she starts with a pooling offer before occasionally experimenting with separating offers.

10.3982/ecta23049.abstractZh: 我们考虑一个动态的买方—卖方互动。买方的私人信息不是其估值，而是其需要进行交易的频率。这一区别至关重要。在承诺情形下，可以实现全部剩余提取，例如通过限时报价。在没有承诺的情形下，棘轮效应得到缓解，因为不购买并不必然是强势的信号。由于时间具有信息含量，卖方会学习并可能随时间调整其行为。当找到合适替代卖方较为容易时，她先提供混同报价，随后永久转向筛选报价。当找到合适替代卖方需要时间时，她先提供混同报价，随后偶尔尝试分离报价。

abstract.text: This paper studies how governments intervene in agricultural markets to reshape the economic consequences of climate extremes. We construct a global dataset of agricultural policies and extreme heat exposure by country and crop since 1980. Extreme heat shocks to domestic production lead to policies that assist consumers by lowering domestic food prices. This effect is persistent, primarily implemented via border policies, and stronger during election years. Shocks to foreign production induce the opposite response: policies that assist producers by raising prices. These findings can be rationalized by a model in which governments use agricultural policy to redistribute among domestic interest groups. Our estimates imply that policy responses shield domestic consumers, while exacerbating losses for domestic producers and foreign consumers. Policy responses have regressive consequences globally, disproportionately harming poor and heat‐exposed countries.

10.3982/ecta23125.abstractZh: 本文研究政府如何干预农产品市场以重塑气候极端事件的经济后果。我们构建了自1980年以来按国家和作物划分的农业政策与极端高温暴露的全球数据集。对国内生产的极端高温冲击会引致旨在通过降低国内食品价格来帮助消费者的政策。这一效应具有持续性，主要通过边境政策实施，且在选举年份更强。对国外生产的冲击则引致相反的反应：通过提高价格来帮助生产者的政策。这些发现可以由一个模型加以合理解释，在该模型中，政府利用农业政策在国内利益集团之间进行再分配。我们的估计表明，政策反应保护了国内消费者，同时加剧了国内生产者和国外消费者的损失。政策反应在全球范围内具有累退性后果，对贫穷国家和高温暴露国家的损害尤为严重。

abstract.text: We study instrumental variables models characterized by: (i) Unobserved heterogeneity consisting of potential outcomes and response types that describe how the instrument determines treatment choice; (ii) Conditional independence of the instrument and the unobserved heterogeneity; and (iii) Convex restrictions on the distribution of unobserved heterogeneity. We show certain causal parameters are identified in these models if and only if a version of the kappa of Abadie (2003) exists. Our identification results are constructive in yielding estimating moment conditions. Focusing on a leading special case, we develop asymptotically normal estimators based on a doubly robust version of these moment conditions.

10.3982/ecta23174.abstractZh: 我们研究满足以下特征的工具变量模型：(i) 由潜在结果和响应类型构成的不可观测异质性，其中响应类型刻画工具变量如何决定处理选择；(ii) 工具变量与不可观测异质性之间的条件独立性；(iii) 对不可观测异质性分布的凸约束。我们证明，在这些模型中，某些因果参数可被识别，当且仅当存在 Abadie（2003）的 kappa 的某一版本。我们的识别结果是构造性的，可给出估计矩条件。聚焦于一个主要的特例，我们基于这些矩条件的双重稳健版本，构建了渐近正态估计量。

abstract.text: We study the lifecycle dynamics of wealth inequality using 1993–2019 Norwegian administrative panel data on wealth and income. Employing a novel budget‐constraint approach, we decompose the excess wealth of the top 0.1% households relative to the median between ages 45 and 64 into higher saving rates (36%), inheritances (31%), returns (28%), and labor income (5%). One‐quarter of the wealthiest—the “New Money”—start with negative wealth on average but accumulate rapidly through high labor income and exceptionally high saving rates and returns. The “Old Money” inherit substantial wealth and grow it through above‐average though more modest saving and returns. We use these dynamic facts to evaluate five standard wealth inequality models. Although these models match cross‐sectional wealth concentration, they fail to reproduce the distinct dynamics of New and Old Money. A heterogeneous entrepreneurship model with decreasing returns to scale technology and nonhomothetic preferences is consistent with the observed dynamics.

10.3982/ecta23194.abstractZh: 我们研究了1993年至2019年挪威行政面板数据中关于财富和收入的生命周期动态变化。采用一种新颖的预算约束方法，我们将最富有的0.1%家庭在45至64岁之间的超额财富分解为较高的储蓄率（36%）、继承所得（31%）、投资回报（28%）以及劳动收入（5%）。最富有的群体中的四分之一——即“新富人”——最初财富为负，但通过较高的劳动收入和异常高的储蓄率及投资回报迅速积累财富。“老富人”则通过高于平均水平的储蓄率和投资回报继承并增长财富。我们利用这些动态特征来评估五种标准的财富不平等模型。尽管这些模型能够反映跨截面上的财富集中情况，但它们无法再现“新富人”和“老富人”之间的独特动态特征。一个具有递减规模报酬技术和非同质偏好异质创业模型与观察到的动态特征是一致的。

abstract.text: Governments use their countries' economic strength from financial and trade relationships to achieve geopolitical and economic goals. We provide a model of the sources of geoeconomic power and how it is wielded. The source of this power is the ability of a hegemonic country to coordinate threats across disparate economic relationships as a means of enforcement on foreign entities. The hegemon wields this power to demand costly actions out of the targeted entities, including mark‐ups, import restrictions, tariffs, and political concessions. The hegemon uses its power to change targeted entities' activities to manipulate the global equilibrium in its favor and increase its power. A sector is strategic either in helping the hegemon form threats or in manipulating the world equilibrium via input‐output amplification. The hegemon acts a global enforcer, thus adding value to the world economy, but destroys value by distorting the equilibrium in its favor.

10.3982/ecta23206.abstractZh: 政府利用本国在金融和贸易关系中的经济实力来实现地缘政治与经济目标。我们构建了一个模型，刻画地缘经济权力的来源及其运用方式。这种权力的来源在于，霸权国家能够跨越彼此不同的经济关系来协调威胁，以此作为对外国实体实施强制执行的手段。霸权国运用这一权力要求目标实体采取代价高昂的行动，包括加价、进口限制、关税和政治让步。霸权国利用其权力改变目标实体的活动，以操纵全球均衡使之有利于自身，并增强自身权力。一个部门之所以具有战略性，要么是因为它有助于霸权国形成威胁，要么是因为它通过投入—产出放大效应操纵世界均衡。霸权国充当全球强制执行者，从而为世界经济增加价值，但通过扭曲均衡使之有利于自身而破坏价值。

abstract.text: Random Priority is a popular mechanism used to allocate a set of objects to a set of agents without the use of monetary transfers. Random Priority is appealing because it satisfies desirable efficiency, fairness, and incentive properties. Is it the only mechanism with these properties? We answer this long‐standing question in the positive: Random Priority is the unique mechanism that is Pareto efficient, symmetric, and obviously strategy‐proof.

10.3982/ecta23230.abstractZh: 随机优先机制是一种常用的机制，用于在不使用货币转移的情况下将一组对象分配给一组经济主体。随机优先机制之所以有吸引力，是因为它满足理想的效率、公平和激励性质。它是否是唯一具备这些性质的机制？我们对这一长期存在的问题给出肯定回答：随机优先机制是唯一同时满足帕累托有效、对称和显然策略-proof的机制。

abstract.text: We propose a framework for making Bayesian parametric models robust to local misspecification. Suppose in a baseline parametric model, a parameter of interest has an interpretation in an encompassing semiparametric model. Bayesian and maximum likelihood estimators are generally biased under local misspecification. We propose to augment the baseline likelihood by a multiplicative factor that involves scores for the baseline model, the efficient scores for the encompassing semiparametric model, and an auxiliary parameter that has the same dimension as the parameter of interest. We show that the marginal posterior for the parameter of interest in the augmented model is asymptotically normal with mean equal to the semiparametrically efficient estimator and variance equal to the semiparametric efficiency bound. The suggested augmentation robustifies the baseline parametric model to local misspecification, while preserving the appeal of Bayesian inference. We develop an MCMC algorithm for the augmented model and illustrate the approach in applications.

10.3982/ecta23242.abstractZh: 我们提出一个使贝叶斯参数模型对局部错误设定具有稳健性的框架。假设在一个基准参数模型中，一个感兴趣的参数在一个涵盖半参数模型中具有解释。贝叶斯估计量和最大似然估计量在局部错误设定下通常是有偏的。我们提出通过一个乘性因子来增广基准似然，该因子涉及基准模型的得分、涵盖半参数模型的有效得分，以及一个与感兴趣参数具有相同维度的辅助参数。我们证明，增广模型中感兴趣参数的边际后验是渐近正态的，其均值等于半参数有效估计量，方差等于半参数有效性界。所建议的增广使基准参数模型对局部错误设定具有稳健性，同时保留贝叶斯推断的吸引力。我们为增广模型开发了一种 MCMC 算法，并在应用中说明了该方法。

abstract.text: Evidence from the laboratory and the field has uncovered both underreaction and overreaction to new information. We provide new experimental evidence on the underlying mechanisms of under‐ and overreaction by comparing how people make inferences and revise forecasts in the same information environment. Participants underreact to signals when inferring about underlying states, but overreact to the same signals when revising forecasts about future outcomes—a phenomenon we term “the inference‐forecast gap.” We show that this gap is largely driven by different simplifying heuristics used in the two tasks. Additional treatments suggest that the choice of heuristics is affected by the similarity between statistics in the information environment and the statistic elicited by the belief‐updating problem.

10.3982/ecta23334.abstractZh: 来自实验室和田野的证据均发现，人们对新信息既存在反应不足，也存在反应过度。我们通过比较人们在同一信息环境中如何进行推断和修正预测，为反应不足与反应过度的内在机制提供了新的实验证据。参与者在推断潜在状态时对信号反应不足，但在修正对未来结果的预测时对相同信号反应过度——我们将这一现象称为“推断—预测缺口”。我们表明，这一缺口在很大程度上由两种任务中所使用的不同简化启发式所驱动。额外的干预实验表明，启发式的选择受到信息环境中的统计量与信念更新问题所引出的统计量之间相似性的影响。

abstract.text: We consider impulse response inference in a locally misspecified vector autoregression (VAR) model. The conventional local projection (LP) confidence interval has correct coverage even when the misspecification is so large that it can be detected with probability approaching 1. This result follows from a “double robustness” property analogous to that of popular partially linear regression estimators. By contrast, the conventional VAR confidence interval with short‐to‐moderate lag length can severely undercover for misspecification that is small, difficult to detect statistically, and cannot be ruled out based on economic theory. The VAR confidence interval has robust coverage if, and only if, the lag length is so large that the interval is as wide as the LP interval.

10.3982/ecta23345.abstractZh: 我们考虑局部错误设定的向量自回归（VAR）模型中的脉冲响应推断。即使错误设定大到能以趋于 1 的概率被检测出来，传统局部投影（LP）置信区间仍具有正确的覆盖概率。这一结果源于一种“双重稳健”性质，类似于流行的部分线性回归估计量的相应性质。相比之下，当错误设定较小、在统计上难以检测且无法依据经济理论排除时，滞后阶数较短至中等的传统 VAR 置信区间可能严重覆盖不足。VAR 置信区间具有稳健覆盖概率，当且仅当滞后阶数大到使该区间与 LP 区间一样宽。

abstract.text: Unlike gender or race, class background is rarely a focus of research on career progression, or of DEI efforts in elite occupations. Should it be? In this paper, we document a large class gap in career progression in one occupation—U.S. tenure‐track academia—using parental education to proxy for class background. First‐generation college graduates are 10% less likely to be tenured at an R1, are tenured at institutions ranked 11% lower, earn 3% less, and report 5% lower job satisfaction, than their former PhD classmates (from the same institution and field) with a parent with a non‐PhD graduate degree. Neither selection out of academia nor different preferences explain this gap; differential research productivity also plays little role. Instead, likely drivers are differences in cultural and social capital. We also find a class gap in career progression for PhDs who work in industry, suggesting this phenomenon generalizes outside academia.

10.3982/ecta23358.abstractZh: 与性别或种族不同，阶层背景很少成为职业发展研究的焦点，也很少成为精英职业中 DEI 工作的重点。它应当成为焦点吗？本文以父母受教育程度作为阶层背景的代理变量，记录了美国终身轨学术界这一职业中职业发展的巨大阶层差距。与父母一方拥有非博士研究生学位的昔日博士同学（来自同一机构和同一领域）相比，第一代大学毕业生在 R1 高校获得终身教职的可能性低 10%，获得终身教职的机构排名低 11%，收入低 3%，工作满意度低 5%。无论是退出学术界的选择性，还是不同的偏好，都无法解释这一差距；研究生产率的差异也作用甚微。相反，可能的驱动因素是文化资本和社会资本的差异。我们还发现，在产业界工作的博士同样存在职业发展的阶层差距，这表明该现象可能推广至学术界之外。

abstract.text: Consider a repeated interaction where it is unknown which of various stage games will be played each period. This framework separates the basic logic of intertemporal incentives from the requirement that any given strategy profile yields a well‐defined payoff vector. A natural solution concept is ex post perfect equilibrium: strategies must form a subgame‐perfect equilibrium for any realization of the sequence of stage games. When there is one long‐run player and others are short‐run, and public randomization is available, we can adapt the standard recursive approach to determine the maximum feasible gap between reward and punishment for the long‐run player. This allows us to identify which actions can be played in equilibrium and, assuming perfect monitoring, to fully characterize what outcome paths can arise. With multiple long‐run players or no public randomization, the approach fails; a diagnostic of this failure is that optimal penal codes may no longer exist.

10.3982/ecta23373.abstractZh: 考虑一个重复互动情形，其中每一期将进行多种阶段博弈中的哪一种并不为参与人所知。该框架将跨期激励的基本逻辑与“任一给定策略组合都产生定义良好的支付向量”这一要求区分开来。一个自然的解概念是事后完美均衡：策略必须对阶段博弈序列的任意实现构成子博弈完美均衡。当存在一个长期参与人、其余为短期参与人且可获得公共随机化时，我们可以调整标准的递归方法，以确定长期参与人可获得的奖励与惩罚之间最大可行差距。这使我们能够识别哪些行动可以在均衡中被实施，并在完美监督假设下完整刻画可能出现的结果路径。当存在多个长期参与人或没有公共随机化时，该方法失效；这种失效的一个诊断特征是，最优惩罚码可能不再存在。

abstract.text: We study the problem of a partisan gerrymanderer who assigns voters to equipopulous districts to maximize his party's expected seat share. The designer faces both aggregate, district‐level uncertainty (how many votes his party will receive) and idiosyncratic, voter‐level uncertainty (which voters will vote for his party). Segregate‐pair districting , where weaker districts contain one type of voter, while stronger districts contain two, is optimal for the gerrymanderer. The optimal form of segregate‐pair districting depends on the designer's popularity and the relative amounts of aggregate and idiosyncratic uncertainty. When idiosyncratic uncertainty dominates, a designer with majority support pairs all voters, while a designer with minority support segregates opposing voters and pairs more favorable voters; these plans resemble uniform districting and “packing‐and‐cracking,” respectively. When aggregate uncertainty dominates, the designer segregates moderate voters and pairs extreme voters; this “matching slices” plan has received some attention in the literature. Estimating the model using precinct‐level returns from recent U.S. House elections shows that, in practice, idiosyncratic uncertainty dominates. We discuss implications for redistricting reform, political polarization, and detecting gerrymandering. Methodologically, we exploit a formal connection between gerrymandering—partitioning voters into districts—and information design—partitioning states of the world into signals.

10.3982/ecta23609.abstractZh: 我们研究一个党派性不公正划分选区者的问题：该设计者将选民分配到人口相等的选区中，以最大化其所在政党的预期席位份额。设计者同时面临总量层面、选区层面的不确定性（其政党将获得多少选票）以及个体层面、选民层面的不确定性（哪些选民会投票支持其政党）。分离—配对式选区划分——即较弱选区包含一类选民，而较强选区包含两类选民——对于不公正划分选区者而言是最优的。分离—配对式选区划分的最优形式取决于设计者的受欢迎程度以及总量不确定性与个体特异性不确定性的相对大小。当个体特异性不确定性占主导时，拥有多数支持的设计者会将所有选民配对，而拥有少数支持的设计者则会将反对派选民分离，并将更有利的选民配对；这些方案分别类似于统一选区划分和“打包—拆散”。当总量不确定性占主导时，设计者会将温和选民分离，并将极端选民配对；这种“匹配切片”方案在文献中已受到一定关注。利用近期美国众议院选举的选区级投票结果对该模型进行估计表明，在实践中个体特异性不确定性占主导。我们讨论了对选区重划改革、政治极化以及识别不公正划分选区的启示。在方法上，我们利用了不公正划分选区——将选民划分为选区——与信息设计——将世界状态划分为信号——之间的形式联系。

abstract.text: A multi‐product monopolist faces a buyer who is privately informed about his valuations for the goods. As is well known, optimal mechanisms are in general complicated, while simple mechanisms—such as pure bundling or separate sales—can be far from optimal and do not admit clear‐cut comparisons. We show that this changes if the monopolist has sufficiently precise information about the buyer's valuations: Now, pure bundling always outperforms separate sales; moreover, there is a sense in which pure bundling performs essentially as well as the optimal mechanism. To formalize this, we characterize how fast the corresponding revenues converge to the first‐best revenue as the monopolist's information grows precise: Pure bundling achieves the same convergence rate to the first‐best as optimal mechanisms; in contrast, the convergence rate under separate sales is suboptimal.

10.3982/ecta23622.abstractZh: 一个多产品垄断者面对一名对其商品估值拥有私人信息的买方。众所周知，最优机制一般而言较为复杂，而简单机制——例如纯捆绑销售或分开销售——可能远非最优，且二者之间无法进行明确比较。我们表明，如果垄断者拥有关于买方估值的足够精确的信息，这一情形会发生变化：此时，纯捆绑销售总是优于分开销售；此外，在某种意义上，纯捆绑销售的表现在本质上与最优机制一样好。为将这一点形式化，我们刻画了随着垄断者信息变得更为精确，相应收入以多快的速度收敛至第一最优收入：纯捆绑销售达到与最优机制相同的向第一最优收敛的速度；相比之下，分开销售下的收敛速度则是次优的。

abstract.text: In sequential games, the set of paths consistent with rationality and forward‐induction reasoning may change nonmonotonically when adding transparent restrictions on players' beliefs. Yet, we prove that—in an incomplete‐information environment—predictions become sharper when the restrictions only concern initial beliefs about types. Thus, strong rationalizability for games with payoff uncertainty characterizes the path predictions of forward‐induction reasoning across all possible restrictions on players' hierarchies of exogenous beliefs. With this, we can solve an open problem: the implementation of social choice functions through sequential mechanisms under forward‐induction reasoning—which considerably expands the realm of implementable functions compared with simultaneous mechanisms (Müller (2016))—is indeed robust in the sense of Bergemann and Morris (2009).

10.3982/ecta23709.abstractZh: 在序贯博弈中，当对参与人信念施加透明限制时，与理性和前向归纳推理相一致的路径集合可能会非单调地变化。然而，我们证明，在不完全信息环境中，当这些限制仅涉及关于类型的初始信念时，预测会变得更加精确。因此，对于存在支付不确定性的博弈，强可理性化刻画了前向归纳推理在所有可能的外生信念层级限制下的路径预测。据此，我们可以解决一个开放问题：在前向归纳推理下通过序贯机制实施社会选择函数——与同时机制相比，这大大扩展了可实施函数的范围（Müller（2016））——确实在 Bergemann 和 Morris（2009）的意义上是稳健的。

abstract.text: Certain extremum estimators have asymptotic distributions that are non‐Gaussian, yet characterizable as the distribution of the arg max of a Gaussian process. This paper presents high‐level sufficient conditions under which such asymptotic distributions admit a continuous distribution function. The plausibility of the sufficient conditions is demonstrated by verifying them in three examples, namely, maximum score estimation, empirical risk minimization, and threshold regression estimation. In turn, the continuity result buttresses several recently proposed inference procedures whose validity seems to require a result of the kind established herein. A notable feature of the high‐level assumptions is that one of them is designed to enable us to employ the Cameron–Martin theorem. In a leading special case, the assumption in question is demonstrably weak and appears to be close to minimal.

10.3982/ecta23862.abstractZh: 某些极值估计量具有非高斯渐近分布，但其分布可刻画为高斯过程arg max的分布。本文给出了一组高层充分条件，在这些条件下此类渐近分布具有连续分布函数。通过在最大得分估计、经验风险最小化和阈值回归估计三个例子中加以验证，说明了这些充分条件的合理性。进而，该连续性结果为若干近期提出的推断程序提供了支撑，这些程序的有效性似乎需要本文所建立的那类结果。这些高层假设的一个显著特征是，其中一项假设的设计目的是使我们能够运用Cameron–Martin定理。在一个主要的特殊情形中，该假设可被证明是较弱的，且似乎接近最小条件。

abstract.text: How costly is inflation to workers? Answers to this question have focused on the path of real wages during inflationary periods. We argue that workers must take costly actions (“conflict”) to have nominal wages catch up with inflation, meaning there are welfare costs even if real wages do not fall as inflation rises. We study a menu‐cost style model, where workers choose whether to engage in conflict with employers to secure a wage increase. We show that, following a rise in inflation, wage catch‐up resulting from more frequent conflict does not raise welfare. Instead, the impact of inflation on worker welfare is determined by what we call “wage erosion”—how inflation would lower real wages if workers' conflict decisions did not respond to inflation. As a result, using observed wage growth to measure worker welfare understates the costs of inflation. We conduct a survey showing that workers are willing to sacrifice around 1.75% of their wages to avoid conflict. Calibrating the model to survey data, we find that incorporating conflict significantly raises the costs of inflation for workers.

10.3982/ecta23874.abstractZh: 通货膨胀对劳动者而言成本有多高？对这一问题的回答主要集中于通胀期间实际工资的路径。我们认为，劳动者必须采取有成本的行动（“冲突”）才能让名义工资赶上通胀，这意味着即使实际工资并未随通胀上升而下降，也存在福利成本。我们研究一个菜单成本式模型，其中劳动者选择是否与雇主发生冲突以确保工资上涨。我们表明，在通胀上升之后，由更频繁冲突带来的工资追赶并不会提高福利。相反，通胀对劳动者福利的影响取决于我们所称的“工资侵蚀”——即如果劳动者的冲突决策不对通胀作出反应，通胀将如何降低实际工资。因此，用观测到的工资增长来衡量劳动者福利会低估通胀的成本。我们开展了一项调查，显示劳动者愿意牺牲约1.75%的工资以避免冲突。将模型校准至调查数据，我们发现纳入冲突会显著提高通胀对劳动者的成本。

abstract.text: We study causal inference with high‐dimensional covariates, observed with various types of heteroscedastic noise. Our main assumption is that the true covariates are low rank, which we empirically evaluate with plots and interpret as approximate repeated measurements. This assumption delivers semiparametric inference on the causal parameter, as precisely as if the true covariates were available. A methodological contribution is to introduce an error‐in‐variable balancing weight for estimation and inference on cross‐sectional causal parameters with heterogeneous effects.

10.3982/ecta23897.abstractZh: 我们研究高维协变量的因果推断，这些协变量以各类异方差噪声形式被观测到。我们的主要假设是真实协变量为低秩，我们通过图形对其进行经验评估，并将其解释为近似重复测量。该假设使得对因果参数的半参数推断能够达到与真实协变量可得时同样精确的程度。方法上的贡献在于引入一种变量误差平衡权重，用于对具有异质效应的横截面因果参数进行估计与推断。

abstract.text: This paper proposes a framework and solution concept for repeated coalitional behavior. We model history‐dependent schemes that use continuation promises and punishments to deter coalitions from blocking. We evaluate the effectiveness of these schemes with and without transferable utility, and apply the framework to study the implications of wage transparency in labor markets.

10.3982/ecta23921.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个针对重复联合行为的框架与解决方案概念。我们模拟了依赖历史的方案，这些方案利用持续承诺和惩罚来阻止联盟进行阻挠行为。我们评估了这些方案在有无可转移效用情况下的有效性，并将该框架应用于研究工资透明度在劳动力市场中的影响。

abstract.text: Standard optimal capital tax theory abstracts from modeling asset prices, making it unsuitable for thinking about capital gains and wealth taxation. We study optimal redistributive taxation in an environment with asset‐price movements, adopting the modern finance view that asset prices fluctuate not only because of changing cash flows, but also due to other factors (“discount rates”). We show that a combination of realization‐based capital gains and cash flow taxes implements the optimal allocation regardless of the source of asset‐price fluctuations. Moreover, the capital gains tax avoids distortions in portfolio choice (the so‐called lock‐in effect) by targeting total net trades rather than gains from selling individual assets. These results stand in contrast to the classic Haig–Simons comprehensive income tax concept as well as recent proposals for wealth or accrual‐based capital gains taxes.

10.3982/ecta24013.abstractZh: 标准最优资本税理论从资产价格建模的角度出发，因此不适合用于思考资本收益和财富税的问题。我们研究了在资产价格变动环境下的最优再分配税收问题，采用现代金融观点，认为资产价格波动不仅是由于现金流的变化，还受到其他因素的影响（“折现率”）。我们证明，结合基于实现的资本收益税和现金流税，无论资产价格波动的来源如何，都能实现最优的资源配置。此外，资本收益税通过针对总净交易而非单个资产出售的收益，避免了投资组合选择中的扭曲（所谓的锁定效应）。这些结果与经典的Haig–Simons综合收入税概念以及近期提出的基于财富或应计制的资本收益税提案形成对比。

abstract.text: In the context of one‐to‐one matching markets, we study myopic‐farsighted stable sets , which are internally and externally stable when myopic agents consider immediate payoffs from their deviations, while farsighted agents anticipate counter‐deviations and consider final payoffs. We constructively prove the existence of a (rational expectations) myopic‐farsighted stable set, in which farsighted agents receive a single payoff while myopic agents may receive multiple payoffs. Our existence result extends to settings with enforcing coalitions of arbitrary size, yielding coalitional myopic‐farsighted stable sets , and to settings where not all members of an enforcing coalition must strictly gain, yielding myopic‐farsighted weakly stable sets . When all farsighted agents have unit demand, our results also extend to many‐to‐one matching markets. As a key corollary, we provide a foundation for the efficiency‐adjusted deferred acceptance algorithm by showing that its outcome constitutes a singleton myopic‐farsighted stable set when one side is farsighted and the other is myopic.

10.3982/ecta24060.abstractZh: 在一对一匹配市场的情境中，我们研究短视-远见稳定集：当短视经济主体只考虑其偏离带来的即时收益，而远见经济主体预期反偏离并考虑最终收益时，该稳定集在内部和外部均稳定。我们以构造性方式证明（理性预期）短视-远见稳定集的存在性，其中远见经济主体获得单一收益，而短视经济主体可能获得多重收益。我们的存在性结果可推广至具有任意规模执行联盟的设定，得到联盟短视-远见稳定集；也可推广至执行联盟并非所有成员都必须严格获益的设定，得到短视-远见弱稳定集。当所有远见经济主体均具有单位需求时，我们的结果还可推广至多对一匹配市场。作为一个关键推论，我们为效率调整的延迟接受算法提供了基础，证明当一方为远见型、另一方为短视型时，该算法的结果构成一个单点短视-远见稳定集。

abstract.text: Biopharmaceuticals advance health and economic growth. Unlike central bargaining abroad, the United States uses private firms, pharmacy benefit managers (PBMs), to manage medicine access and spending. Yet, PBMs' roles in advancing efficiency are understudied. Ho and Lee model PBMs' use of tiered formularies, lists of covered medicines, without the use of proprietary data on the price concessions drug makers offer for preferred placement. They find PBMs' use of tiered formularies generate significant payor savings through competition. Complementing Ho and Lee, Feng and Maini (2024) model how patient demand inertia limits PBMs' ability to extract price concessions from drug makers which consequently erodes the efficacy gains of PBM formularies. Conti, Frandsen, Powell, and Rebitzer (2021) model formulary auctions where PBM size drives payor savings, but also spurs endogenously set high list prices, reducing patient access. Future economic research should focus on PBM market entry and vertical integration, pharmacy steering, and effects on innovation.

10.3982/ecta24210.abstractZh: 生物制药促进了健康与经济增长。与国外中央谈判不同，美国通过私人企业——药品福利管理公司（PBMs）来管理药品获取和支出。然而，PBMs在提高效率方面的作用尚未得到充分研究。Ho和Lee通过模型分析，发现PBMs使用分层处方单和药品覆盖清单，但并未使用制药商为优先排名所提供的价格让步数据。他们发现，PBMs使用分层处方单通过竞争方式显著降低了支付者的成本。Feng和Maini（2024）则进一步研究，指出患者需求惰性限制了PBMs从制药商处获取价格让步的能力，从而削弱了PBM处方单带来的效益。Conti、Frandsen、Powell和Rebitzer（2021）则通过模型分析，发现PBM的规模不仅推动了支付者的成本节约，还导致了高价药品清单的出现，进一步限制了患者的用药机会。未来的经济研究应关注PBM市场的进入与垂直整合、药品指导政策，以及这些政策对创新的影响。

abstract.text: When estimating the effects of treatments defined by complex formulas, researchers often use simple functions of exogenous shocks as instruments. A leading example is “simulated instruments” for public policy eligibility, which capture variation in state‐level policy generosity. We show how more powerful instruments can be constructed by incorporating heterogeneous shock exposure while using a recentering procedure to avoid bias. We characterize the asymptotically efficient instruments in this class and propose an algorithm for constructing feasible approximations to them. Compared to a simulated instrument approach, our approach yields a 44% smaller standard error on the private insurance crowd‐out effect of Medicaid enrollment from the 2014 Affordable Care Act expansions.

10.3982/ecta24250.abstractZh: 在估计由复杂公式定义的处理效应的过程中，研究人员常常使用外生冲击的简单函数作为工具变量。一个典型的例子是“模拟工具变量”，用于衡量公共政策的可行性与否，这些工具变量能够捕捉到州级政策宽严的变化。我们展示了如何通过结合异质性的冲击暴露，并采用重新中心化程序来避免偏差，从而构建更强大的工具变量。我们描述了这类渐近有效工具变量的特性，并提出了一种构建其可行近似版本的算法。与模拟工具变量方法相比，我们的方法使得2014年《平价医疗法案》扩张对私人保险市场挤出效应的标准误差减少了44%。

abstract.text: Recent advances have substantially improved our ability to predict disease risk with genetic data. In response, many countries have banned insurers from using genetic data, despite concerns about adverse selection. This paper measures adverse selection in a market where insurers can underwrite only on nongenetic information while consumers also have access to genetic information. We do so by combining methods from quantitative genetics, selection measures from economic theory, and genetic and electronic health record data on nearly 500,000 individuals in the UK Biobank. We focus on the critical illness insurance market and consider scenarios in which consumers have access to current or expected future genetic prediction technology. We find noticeable levels of selection with current prediction technology, and potentially crippling selection with expected future technology.

10.3982/ecta24284.abstractZh: 近期进展显著提升了我们利用遗传数据预测疾病风险的能力。对此，许多国家已禁止保险公司使用遗传数据，尽管存在对逆向选择的担忧。本文在一个保险公司只能依据非遗传信息进行承保、而消费者同时可以获得遗传信息的市场中，测度逆向选择。为此，我们结合了数量遗传学方法、经济理论中的选择度量，以及英国生物样本库（UK Biobank）中近50万人的遗传与电子健康记录数据。我们聚焦重大疾病保险市场，并考察消费者能够获得当前或预期未来遗传预测技术的各种情景。我们发现，在当前预测技术下存在明显的选择，而在预期未来技术下则可能出现具有潜在破坏性的选择。

abstract.text: Tirole (1985) studied an overlapping generations model with capital accumulation and showed that the emergence of asset bubbles solves the capital over‐accumulation problem. His Proposition 1(c) claims that if the dividend growth rate is above the bubbleless interest rate (the steady‐state interest rate in the economy without the asset) but below the population growth rate, then bubbles are necessary in the sense that there exists no bubbleless equilibrium but there exists a unique bubbly equilibrium. We show that this result (as stated) is incorrect by presenting an example economy that satisfies all assumptions of Proposition 1(c) but its unique equilibrium is bubbleless. We also restore Proposition 1(c) under the additional assumptions that initial capital is sufficiently large and dividends are sufficiently small. We show through examples that these conditions are essential.

10.3982/ecta24365.abstractZh: Tirole在1985年研究了一个包含资本积累的多代模型，并指出资产泡沫的出现可以解决资本过度积累的问题。他的命题1(c)指出，如果股息增长率高于无泡沫利率（即没有资产时的稳态利率），但低于人口增长率，那么存在资产泡沫是必要的，因为不存在无泡沫的均衡，但存在唯一的含泡沫均衡。我们通过一个满足命题1(c)所有假设的经济模型来证明这一结论是错误的，该模型的唯一均衡是无泡沫的。我们还在额外的假设下恢复了命题1(c)的正确性，即初始资本足够大且股息足够小。通过实例表明，这些条件是非常重要的。

abstract.text: Long‐lived agents interact repeatedly in a social network. In each period, each agent observes a private signal, chooses an action, and then observes the actions of her neighbors. We show that the learning rate of the slowest‐learning agent is capped by a constant that depends only on the distribution of the most informative private signal, but not on the number of agents, the network structure, correlations between the private signals, or the agents' strategies. For equilibrium learning with rational agents, the same result bounds the learning rate of every agent in any equilibrium under a broad class of conditions. The result is driven by an information‐theoretic tradeoff between optimal action choices and information revelation.

10.3982/ecta24769.abstractZh: 长期存在的个体在社交网络中反复互动。在每个时期，每个个体都会观察一个私人信号，选择一种行动，然后观察邻居的行动。我们证明，学习速度最慢的个体的学习速率受到一个仅取决于最具信息量的私人信号分布的限制，而与该个体数量、网络结构、私人信号之间的相关性或个体的策略无关。对于具有理性行为的个体而言，在广泛的条件下，每个个体的学习速率都受到同样的限制。这一结果是由最优行动选择与信息揭示之间的信息论权衡所驱动的。

abstract.text: Background: Despite efforts to expand health insurance in low- and middle-income countries, uptake remains low. Poor quality of care, especially in public facilities, is often cited as a barrier to health insurance enrolment but limited empirical evidence exists. Aim: We examine whether the quality of antenatal care (ANC) influences women's enrolment in health insurance programmes in Namibia. Setting: In Namibia, insurance uptake is modest but growing, and health facility density and ANC quality vary regionally. Methods: We link Namibia's 2009 Service Provision Assessment (SPA), a census of all health facilities, with the 2013 Demographic and Health Survey (DHS). Using geospatial data, we construct a cluster-level ANC quality index covering structural readiness, process adherence and client experience. Multivariate regressions estimate the association between ANC quality and insurance uptake, adjusting for socioeconomic and demographic factors. Results: We find no statistically significant association between ANC quality and insurance uptake nationally. However, the relationship varies by region: in areas with low health facility density (south), higher ANC quality is marginally associated with increased insurance uptake, while no significant association is found in regions with greater facility density (north). Indicators of wealth and education consistently predict higher enrolment, regardless of ANC quality. Conclusion: Improving ANC quality is essential for health outcomes but, on its own, is unlikely to drive insurance uptake nationally. Quality appears more influential in underserved regions, while socioeconomic inequalities dominate enrolment patterns. Contribution: This study expands scarce low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) evidence on quality and insurance demand, applies a novel geospatially linked ANC quality index using a facility census and highlights the need to tailor insurance expansion strategies to subnational contexts of socioeconomic inequality and service access.

10.4102/jphia.v17i1.1431.abstractZh: 背景：尽管在低收入和中等收入国家努力扩大医疗保险覆盖，但覆盖率仍然较低。护理质量差，尤其是在公共设施中，常被认为是阻碍医疗保险参保的因素，但相关的实证证据有限。目的：我们研究产前护理质量是否影响纳米比亚妇女参保医疗保险计划的情况。研究地点：在纳米比亚，医疗保险的普及程度虽然较低，但正在增长，而医疗机构的密度和产前护理质量因地区而异。方法：我们将纳米比亚2009年的医疗服务评估数据与2013年的人口与健康调查数据联系起来。利用地理空间数据，我们构建了一个涵盖结构准备、流程遵守和客户体验的产前护理质量指数。通过多元回归分析，我们评估了产前护理质量与保险参保率之间的关系，并调整了社会经济和人口因素的影响。结果：我们发现，全国范围内产前护理质量与保险参保率之间没有显著的统计关联。然而，这种关系因地区而异：在医疗机构密度较低的地区（南部），较高的产前护理质量与较高的保险参保率有轻微关联，而在医疗机构密度较高的地区（北部），则没有发现显著的关联。财富和教育水平等指标始终能预测较高的参保率，无论产前护理质量如何。结论：提高产前护理质量对健康结果至关重要，但单独来看，不太可能推动全国范围内的保险参保率。在服务不足的地区，质量的影响更为显著，而社会经济不平等则主导了参保模式。贡献：本研究扩展了关于低收入和中等收入国家（LMICs）保险需求质量的文献，采用基于设施普查的新型地理空间关联的健康保险质量指数，并强调了需要根据地方层面的社会经济不平等和服务获取情况来制定保险扩展策略。
