abstract.text: When estimating the effects of treatments defined by complex formulas, researchers often use simple functions of exogenous shocks as instruments.A leading example is "simulated instruments" for public policy eligibility, which capture variation in state-level policy generosity.We show how more powerful instruments can be constructed by incorporating heterogeneous shock exposure while using a recentering procedure to avoid bias.We characterize the asymptotically efficient instruments in this class and propose an algorithm for constructing feasible approximations to them.Compared to a simulated instrument approach, our approach yields a 44% smaller standard error on the private insurance crowd-out effect of Medicaid enrollment from the 2014 Affordable Care Act expansions.

10.47004/wp.cem.2026.0326.abstractZh: 在估计由复杂公式定义的处理效应的过程中，研究人员经常使用外生冲击的简单函数作为工具变量。一个典型的例子是“模拟工具变量”，用于衡量公共政策的可行性与否，这些工具变量能够捕捉到州级政策宽松程度的变化。我们展示了如何通过结合异质性的冲击暴露，并采用重新中心化程序来避免偏差，从而构建更强大的工具变量。我们描述了这类渐近有效工具变量，并提出了一种构建其可行近似值的算法。与模拟工具变量方法相比，我们的方法使得2014年《平价医疗法案》扩展对私人保险覆盖影响的标准误差减少了44%。

abstract.text: Rising medical costs have become a global healthcare concern and Malaysian private healthcare sector is not immune from this challenge. One area of concern is the relationship between providers and payers in the private healthcare sector. Rising healthcare costs have intensified commercial tensions over reimbursement discounts, provider-panel access and management of insured patients. The recent report of the Malaysian Parliament’s Public Accounts Committee recorded concerns that hospitals may face demands for substantial discounts and possible removal from provider panels when those demands are not accepted. At the same time, stakeholders remain uncertain whether collective dispute-resolution and cost-control measures comply with the Competition Act 2010. This article examines how the Competition Act 2010 applies to provider-payer arrangements in Malaysian private healthcare sector. The article combines doctrinal legal research and regulatory gap analysis with documentary evidence from Malaysia and a focused comparative analysis of the Netherlands, Australia and the United Kingdom. Three main findings emerge. The analysis shows that genuine bilateral negotiations and selective contracting are not inherently anti-competitive and may help control healthcare costs. However, closer scrutiny is required where a dominant payer imposes exclusionary or discriminatory terms. In relation to collective agreements, coordination among competing hospitals or insurers may infringe competition law especially where it concerns future prices, common discount levels or shared trading conditions. Apart from that, the allegation of payer pressure requires a proper assessment of market definition, dominance, competitive harm and objective justifications. The analysis also finds that Malaysia lacks a healthcare-specific framework for supervised information exchange and competition-compliant dispute resolution. Accordingly, the article proposes a framework based on a MyCC market review, sector-specific guideline, objective panel and top rules and independent data governance.

10.47772/ijriss.2026.100700773.abstractZh: 不断上升的医疗费用已成为全球医疗保健领域的一个问题，马来西亚的私人医疗保健行业也不例外。其中一个值得关注的领域是私人医疗保健行业中的医疗服务提供者与支付方之间的关系。不断上涨的医疗保健成本加剧了关于报销折扣、医疗服务提供者名单管理以及被保险患者管理方面的商业竞争。马来西亚议会公共账目委员会最近的报告指出，医院可能会面临大幅折扣的要求，甚至可能被排除在医疗服务提供者名单之外，如果这些要求不被接受的话。与此同时，利益相关者仍然不确定集体纠纷解决和成本控制措施是否符合2010年《竞争法》。本文探讨了2010年《竞争法》在马来西亚私人医疗保健行业中的医疗服务提供者-支付方安排方面的适用情况。文章结合了法律理论和监管空白分析，并参考了马来西亚的文献证据，同时进行了荷兰、澳大利亚和英国的比较分析。研究得出三个主要结论：分析表明，真正的双边谈判和选择性合同安排并不必然具有反竞争性质，并且可能有助于控制医疗保健成本。然而，当主导支付方提出排他性或歧视性条款时，就需要进行更严格的审查。关于集体协议，竞争医院或保险公司之间的协调可能会违反竞争法，尤其是在涉及未来价格、共同折扣水平或共享交易条件的情况下。此外，关于支付方施加压力的指控需要正确评估市场定义、主导地位、竞争损害以及客观理由。分析还发现，马来西亚缺乏针对医疗领域监督信息交换以及符合竞争规则的争议解决的专门框架。因此，本文提出了一个基于马来西亚关贸局市场评估、行业特定指南、客观评审小组以及最高规则与独立数据治理的框架。

abstract.text: How do cost shocks pass through to prices in markets with price dispersion? We decompose the problem into two layers. In the competition layer, consumers' consideration sets determine equilibrium distributions of normalized margins. In the curvature layer, demand elasticity maps these margins into prices and pass-through rates. We prove the pricing game is strategically equivalent to a game over normalized margins, so equilibrium margin distributions are invariant to demand and costs. This separation yields closed-form pass-through formulas at each quantile of the price distribution, robust bounds across demand specifications, and sharp comparative statics linking market structure to incidence.

10.48550/arxiv.2601.17964.abstractZh: 成本冲击如何在具有价格离散性的市场中传递至价格？我们将这个问题分解为两个层次。在竞争层次上，消费者的考虑集决定了标准化边际的均衡分布。在曲率层次上，需求弹性将这些边际映射为价格，并计算出传递率。我们证明定价博弈在策略上等同于标准化边际的博弈，因此均衡边际分布对需求和成本是不变的。这种分离方法得出了价格分布每个分位数的封闭形式传递公式，为不同需求特征提供了稳健的界限，并建立了市场结构与实际发生情况的精确比较静态关系。

abstract.text: Tweedie's formula, which under Gaussian noise expresses the posterior mean of a latent variable directly from the observed-data density, is a cornerstone of empirical Bayes and measurement-error analysis. No general theory, however, explains when analogous identities hold, how they are structured, or how to derive them for non-Gaussian noise and for posterior functionals other than the mean. This paper develops such a framework for additive-noise models. I characterize when conditional expectations of an unobserved latent variable, given the observed signal, admit direct expressions in terms of the observed density -- identities I call \emph{Tweedie representations} -- and show that they are governed by a linear map, the \emph{Tweedie functional}. Under general conditions, I prove that this functional exists, is unique, and is continuous. I provide a constructive method for its computation based on Fourier analysis: the functional is obtained by extending the inverse Fourier transform of an explicit tempered distribution. The theory yields posterior-mean formulas for non-Gaussian noise and provides new representations for nonlinear posterior functionals. Applications include Laplace mechanisms in differential privacy and heteroskedastic Gaussian sequence models in compound decision problems.

10.48550/arxiv.2604.14486.abstractZh: Tweedie公式在高斯噪声下能够直接从观测数据密度中推导出潜变量后的均值，这是经验贝叶斯和测量误差分析的基石。然而，目前还没有普遍的理论来解释这类恒等式何时成立、其结构如何，以及如何为非高斯噪声和除均值之外的后验函数推导这些恒等式。本文为加性噪声模型发展了一个这样的框架。我描述了在给定观测信号的情况下，未观测潜变量的条件期望如何可以直接用观测密度来表示——我将这些恒等式称为“Tweedie表示”——并证明它们由一个线性映射控制，即“Tweedie函数”。在一般条件下，我证明了该函数存在、唯一且连续。我提供了一种基于傅里叶分析的计算方法：通过扩展显式温和分布的逆傅里叶变换来获得该函数。该理论为非高斯噪声提供了后验均值公式，并为非线性后验函数提供了新的表示方式。应用包括微分隐私中的拉普拉斯机制以及复合决策问题中的异方差高斯序列模型。

abstract.text: There is a largely overlooked assumption underlying stochastic choice theory: menus are assigned exogenously, as if by a hidden randomized controlled trial. This assumption is not innocuous, because in many real-world settings menus are assigned endogenously according to the decision makers' preferences. This paper studies Random Utility Model under menu endogeneity and shows that any seemingly anomalous choice behavior can be generated by a population of rational decision makers with heterogeneous preferences facing endogenously assigned menus. To address this problem, I propose a new causal estimand: the probability that an alternative would be chosen from a given menu if that menu were presented to the entire population. I then characterize sharp bounds on this estimand using observed menu and choice frequencies. In addition, I show that when choices are observed across multiple markets with different preference distributions and a common menu-assignment rule, the causal estimands from those markets and the menu assignment rule are uniquely identified.

10.48550/arxiv.2607.08218.abstractZh: 在随机选择理论背后存在一个被严重忽视的假设：菜单的分配是外生的，就像通过一项隐藏的随机对照试验一样。这个假设并非无足轻重，因为在许多现实场景中，菜单的分配是内生的，取决于决策者的偏好。本文研究了在菜单内生性条件下的随机效用模型，并表明任何看似异常的选择行为都可以由一群具有不同偏好的理性决策者在面对内生分配的菜单时产生。为了解决这个问题，我提出了一种新的因果估计量：如果某个菜单被呈现给整个群体，那么选择该菜单中的某个选项的概率。然后，我利用观察到的菜单选择和选择频率来对这种估计量进行精确界定。此外，我还表明，当在不同偏好分布和共同菜单分配规则的多个市场中观察到选择行为时，这些市场的因果估计量和菜单分配规则是可以唯一确定的。

abstract.text: Generative AI is fast becoming the first place people turn for expert advice. The advice it provides can be directional rather than neutral, shaped in part by the choices of its designers and regulators. When clients consult AI before meeting an expert, they carry this directional advice into a relationship that once rested on the expert's judgment alone. We study its consequences in healthcare through a large-scale preregistered field experiment at a Chinese hospital, where we randomize patients' access to an AI chatbot before their outpatient visit. Examination of the conversation logs shows that the chatbot routinely cautions against the use of medications, especially Traditional Chinese Medicine and antibiotics, while issuing clean recommendations for diagnostic testing, consistent with the liability-driven guardrails encoded in AI training. This directionality propagates into clinical practice. Prescription rates decline among treated patients while diagnostic testing increases, and these effects are more pronounced among physicians who are receptive to patient input and those with more intensive prescribing styles. Beyond shifting healthcare utilization, survey results show that AI access reduces patient compliance and satisfaction, shifting the balance of authority between patients and physicians.

10.48550/arxiv.2607.08706.abstractZh: 生成式人工智能正迅速成为人们寻求专家建议的首选途径。它提供的建议往往具有方向性而非中立性，这在某种程度上受到其设计者和监管机构的决策影响。当患者在咨询专家之前先使用人工智能时，他们会将这种带有方向性的建议带入与专家的关系中，而原本这种关系完全依赖于专家的判断。我们通过在中国一家医院进行的大规模预注册实地实验来研究这一现象在医疗保健领域的后果。实验中，患者在门诊就诊前被随机分配使用人工智能聊天机器人。通过对对话记录的分析发现，聊天机器人通常会提醒患者避免使用某些药物，尤其是中药和抗生素，同时也会提出与诊断测试相关的建议，这与人工智能训练中所编码的责任导向性约束是一致的。这种方向性影响到了临床实践：接受治疗的患者处方率下降，而诊断测试的使用频率增加，且这种影响在那些愿意听取患者意见以及处方方式较为严格的医生身上更为明显。除了改变医疗利用方式外，调查结果显示，人工智能的使用降低了患者的依从性和满意度，从而改变了患者与医生之间的权力平衡。

abstract.text: Competing firms increasingly delegate market decisions to algorithms supplied by the same third-party providers. We study whether a shared algorithm leads competitors to internalise one another's profits, using data from the Australian National Electricity Market, where batteries' bids are observed at 5-minute frequency and can be linked to an autobidding provider. Bids constructed by the same provider co-move, and do so more strongly after a disclosure reform made the scarcity state easier to observe: the same information that steers batteries towards efficient arbitrage also synchronises the bids of competitors who share a provider. To separate co-movement from joint profit maximisation, we perform a conduct test by estimating each battery's dynamic value of stored energy and reclearing the market under counterfactual bids. We find that batteries forgo profitable dispatch in the evening peak when it would lower the profit of same-provider batteries owned by rival firms. The estimated conduct parameter is close to one. But this effect arises only where a provider's share of near-margin battery capacity exceeds roughly 30%. The identified conduct costs consumers an annualised $5.5 million given the battery fleet from 2025, and concentration analysis based on ownership would treat these batteries as independent competitors and miss the impact of shared autobidding software.

10.48550/arxiv.2607.13002.abstractZh: 竞争企业越来越多地将市场决策委托给同一第三方供应商提供的算法。我们研究了一个共享算法是否会促使竞争对手内部化彼此的利润，使用的是澳大利亚国家电力市场的数据。在该市场中，电池的出价以5分钟的频率被记录，并且可以与自动出价供应商联系起来。由同一供应商构建的出价会共同移动，并且在披露改革后这种共同移动更为明显——这一改革使得稀缺状态更容易被观察到。同样的信息不仅引导电池进行高效套利，还使共享同一供应商的竞争对手的出价同步。为了将共同移动与联合利润最大化区分开来，我们通过估计每个电池存储能量的动态价值，并在反事实出价下重新计算市场来进行行为测试。我们发现，当在晚间高峰时段进行电池调度时，电池会放弃有利可图的调度，因为这样做会降低竞争对手拥有的同一供应商电池的利润。估计的行为参数接近1。但这一效应仅出现在供应商的接近边际电池容量占比超过30%的情况下。根据2025年的电池车队情况，这种行为成本使得消费者每年损失550万美元。基于所有权进行的集中分析会将这些电池视为独立的竞争对手，从而忽略共享自动出价软件的影响。

abstract.text: Limited dependent variable models are central to empirical economics, but likelihood-based inference is infeasible when likelihoods involve high-dimensional integration over latent variables. This paper proposes Stochastically Estimated Gradient Ascent (SEGA), a scalable estimation approach for limited dependent variable models. Using Fisher's identity, SEGA replaces the intractable likelihood score with an unbiased augmented data score evaluated at a single conditional draw of the latent variables, and embeds this score in a stochastic gradient ascent algorithm. With sufficiently many iterations, we show that SEGA is asymptotically equivalent to the infeasible maximum likelihood estimator. A variance estimator based on Fisher's and Louis' identities is proposed that allows inference to proceed in the usual manner. Applications to brand choice and household demand demonstrate the usefulness of SEGA for conducting inference in large-scale discrete choice and censored demand models.

10.48550/arxiv.2608.13851.abstractZh: 有限依赖变量模型是实证经济学中的核心内容，但当似然函数涉及对潜在变量的高维积分时，基于似然的推断方法变得不可行。本文提出了随机估计梯度上升法（SEGA），这是一种适用于有限依赖变量模型的可扩展估计方法。利用费舍尔恒等式，SEGA用在一个条件抽样中评估的无偏增广数据得分来替代难以处理的似然得分，并将该得分嵌入到随机梯度上升算法中。通过足够多的迭代，我们证明SEGA在渐近意义上等同于不可行的最大似然估计量。文中还提出了一种基于费舍尔和路易斯恒等式的方差估计方法，使得推断过程能够以常规方式继续进行。通过品牌选择和家庭需求的应用案例，证明了SEGA在大规模离散选择和截尾需求模型中的推断能力。

abstract.text: The von Neumann-Morgenstern axioms are uncontroversial desiderata for individual decision-making. We say that a bargaining solution is rational if it can be interpreted as the most preferred alternatives under these axioms. Yet, neither the Nash nor the Kalai-Smorodinsky bargaining solution is rational in this sense. We formalize two consequences of rationality, namely that one can neither be strictly better off nor strictly worse off from randomizing over different actions. These two axioms, together with other standard axioms, characterize the relative utilitarian bargaining solution. We then implement this bargaining solution in sub-game perfect equilibrium.

10.48550/arxiv.2609.19932.abstractZh: 冯·诺伊曼-莫根施特恩公理是个体决策中无可争议的理想目标。我们说，如果一种讨价还价解决方案可以被解释为在这些公理下最理想的替代方案，那么这种解决方案就是理性的。然而，无论是纳什解还是卡莱-斯莫罗丁斯基解，都无法从这个意义上说是有理性的。我们将理性的两个后果形式化：即一个人通过随机选择不同的行动，既不会变得绝对更优，也不会变得绝对更差。这两个公理，加上其他标准公理，共同构成了相对功利主义讨价还价解决方案的特征。随后，我们将这种讨价还价解决方案应用于子游戏完美均衡中。

abstract.text: In many statistical settings, the available data and maintained assumptions do not suffice to uniquely identify the model parameters of interest. In such cases, one can only identify sets which are guaranteed to contain the true parameters. These are often characterized through linear programs that optimize over models compatible with the observed data. These programs can be infinite-dimensional in the optimizer and the number of constraints. We provide a unified way to characterize and solve such optimization problems by phrasing them as optimal transport problems on path spaces. This allows us to regularize the problem with an entropy penalty, recasting it as a multi-marginal entropic optimal transport problem, which can be solved efficiently via Sinkhorn iterations. In addition, it allows us to establish convergence of the regularized value to the sharpest bound, derive consistency rates for a plug-in estimator, and obtain asymptotic distribution for approximate bounds. The method is general and accommodates settings ranging from instrumental variable models with continuous variables to welfare estimation in heterogeneous demand models. We verify the statistical and computational properties in simulations and provide an application to demand estimation.

10.48550/arxiv.2609.40156.abstractZh: 在许多统计场景中，现有的数据和所维持的假设不足以唯一确定感兴趣的模型参数。在这种情况下，我们只能识别出那些必定包含真实参数的集合。这些集合通常通过线性规划来表征，该规划针对与观测数据兼容的模型进行优化。这些规划在优化器和约束数量上可能是无限维的。我们提供了一种统一的方法来表征和解决这类优化问题，即将其表述为路径空间上的最优运输问题。这使我们能够使用熵惩罚来正则化问题，将其重新表述为多边际熵最优运输问题，并通过Sinkhorn迭代方法高效求解。此外，该方法还允许我们确定正则化值的收敛性，推导插入估计量的一致性速率，并获得近似界限的渐近分布。该方法具有通用性，适用于从具有连续变量的工具变量模型到异质需求模型中的福利估计等多种场景。我们通过模拟验证了该方法的统计和计算特性，并提供了一个应用于需求估计的例子。

abstract.text: Despite their practical significance, modern AI systems pose significant societal risks, including toxicity, malicious use, and misinformation. Their mitigation depends not only on technical feasibility but also on the incentives of firms that develop and deploy these systems. We show how profit maximization shapes safety investment in an AI supply chain with an upstream LLM provider and several competing downstream firms. In our game-theoretic model, we derive the market-driven level of safety investment and compare it with the levels that maximize industry profit and market welfare. We find that downstream competition generally induces downstream firms to invest more in safety than the industry-profit-optimal level. By contrast, the upstream provider may underinvest relative to these benchmarks because it is not fully compensated for the surplus from safety investments. Finally, we analyze how different regulatory interventions affect the participants' incentives and profits, and the resulting levels of model safety.

10.48550/arxiv.2610.21607.abstractZh: 尽管现代人工智能系统具有实际意义，但它们也带来了重大的社会风险，包括技术滥用、恶意使用以及错误信息传播。应对这些风险的措施不仅取决于技术可行性，还取决于开发和应用这些系统的企业的动机。我们研究了在包含上游大语言模型提供商和多个竞争下游企业的AI供应链中，利润最大化如何影响安全投资。在我们的博弈论模型中，我们推导出了市场驱动的安全投资水平，并将其与最大化行业利润和市场福利的水平进行了比较。研究发现，下游竞争通常会促使下游企业增加安全投资，超过行业利润最优水平。相比之下，上游提供商可能会因未能充分获得安全投资带来的收益而投资不足。最后，我们分析了不同的监管干预措施如何影响参与者的动机和利润，以及由此导致的模型安全水平。

abstract.text: I use AI-assisted replication to assess the empirical importance of negative weights in two-way fixed effects (TWFE) estimation, analyzing 1,430 staggered-adoption specifications from 116 economics papers. TWFE estimates are highly correlated with modern difference-in-differences estimates, with sign reversals in 12.0-14.9% of comparisons and greater precision for TWFE. Hierarchical models accounting for estimation noise imply estimand correlations of 91-97% and a 0.7-2.4% probability of a statistically significant TWFE estimate opposing the modern estimand's sign. These findings suggest negative weights may be a less serious problem in practice and illustrate how AI can support systematic, large-scale empirical assessments of new econometric methods.

10.48550/arxiv.2610.39995.abstractZh: 我使用人工智能辅助的复制方法来评估双向固定效应估计中负权重的重要性，分析了116篇经济学论文中的1,430个分阶段采纳的模型。双向固定效应估计与现代差异-差异估计高度相关，在12.0-14.9%的对比中符号发生反转，且双向固定效应估计的精度更高。考虑估计噪声的层次模型表明，估计值之间的相关性为91-97%，并且双向固定效应估计与现代估计值符号相反的概率仅为0.7-2.4%。这些发现表明，负权重在实践中的问题可能并不严重，并展示了人工智能如何支持对新计量经济方法的系统性、大规模实证评估。

abstract.text: Empirical researchers are often interested in the relative causal impact of individuals or institutions such as teachers, schools, hospitals, or neighborhoods. Regression-based estimates of such unit-specific parameters are often noisy; empirical Bayes (eB) methods can help isolate the signal from the estimation noise. This article provides an overview of eB methodology, showing how eB shrinkage can improve compound decisions---such as selecting individuals with the highest causal impacts---even when the working model motivating the shrinkage is misspecified. Not all analyses benefit from eB shrinkage, however, and we discuss which types of causal summaries are best estimated directly and how to do so robustly. We illustrate practical takeaways with a running analysis of public elementary and middle school value-added.

10.48550/arxiv.2611.21230.abstractZh: 实证研究人员通常对个体或机构（如教师、学校、医院或社区）的相对因果影响感兴趣。基于回归的此类单位特定参数估计往往存在噪声；实证贝叶斯（eB）方法可以帮助分离信号与估计噪声。本文概述了eB方法，展示了eB收缩如何改善复合决策——例如选择具有最高因果影响的个体——即使促使收缩的工作模型存在错误设定。然而，并非所有分析都能从eB收缩中受益，我们讨论了哪些类型的因果总结最适合直接估计，以及如何稳健地实现这一点。我们通过对公立小学和中学增值数据的持续分析来说明实际应用成果。

abstract.text: reedom is not possessed. It is crossed." This essay does not define all freedom. It isolates its live, constituent form: the event in which a person appears as the author of the move that makes a new possibility practicable in a maille. Person, subject, and functioning are kept apart: you are always a person; you are not always a subject; mostly, you function. Freedom is compatible with a complete causality of conditions, because causality describes the genesis of the move while freedom names what it reconfigures. Three marks identify a free crossing. And the grammar yields a political concept, dead freedom: rights legally intact in mailles that no move crosses anymore, by procedural closure or by expressive dissolution. Fourth of seven essays laying out the grammar of an ontology of passage: how local worlds live, hold, and die.

10.5281/zenodo.22083283.abstractZh: “自由并非被拥有，而是被跨越。”这篇论文并未定义所有形式的自由，而是将其抽象为一种存在形态：即一个人作为行动的主体，使得新的可能性在空间中得以实现。人、主体与行为被区分开来：你始终是一个人；你并不总是主体；大多数时候，你只是进行行为。自由与条件的完整因果关系相兼容，因为因果关系描述了行为的起源，而自由则指明了行为所重新配置的内容。三个标志标志着自由的跨越。而语法则衍生出一个政治概念——死去的自由：在不再被任何行为跨越的空间中，权利在法律上仍然有效，这种有效性通过程序性的闭合或表达性的消解得以维持。这是七篇论文中的第四篇，它们阐述了关于“跨越”的本体论的语法：局部世界如何生存、维持以及消亡。

abstract.text: The gauge chooses the place of the wound; the pressure sets its size." Why do evaluation reforms all fail the same way? Goodhart explains why a measure dies; he does not explain why the next one dies the same. Capture comes first: a measure from above makes the value below undepositable. Then the pressure law, by which inherited bite sets the quantity of damage, which a gauge reform only displaces or converts. Then the remedy: loosen, by the threshold, by abundance, or by time; or damp when you cannot loosen. And the instrument, finally: new failures among safe actors, the loosening signal hardest to imitate. Two empirical cases, one prediction signed in advance, a formal appendix with its breaking conditions. Third of seven essays laying out the grammar of an ontology of passage: how local worlds live, hold, and die.

10.5281/zenodo.22083354.abstractZh: “指标决定了伤口的位置；压力则决定了其大小。”为什么评估改革总是以相同的方式失败呢？古德哈特解释了为什么一个指标会失效，但他并没有解释为什么下一个指标也会以同样的方式失效。首先是控制问题：来自上方的指标使得下方的价值变得不可依赖。然后是压力法则，通过这种法则，继承下来的“咬合力”决定了损害的程度，而指标改革只能取代或转化这种力量。接着是补救措施：通过阈值、丰度或时间来放松；或者在没有办法放松时采取缓解措施。最后，是工具问题：在可靠的参与者中，新的指标更容易导致失败，因为放松信号最难模仿。两个实证案例，一个预先预测的结果，以及一个包含其失效条件的正式附录。这七篇论文中的第三篇，阐述了过渡 Ontology 的语法：局部世界如何生存、维持和消亡。

abstract.text: Nurse engagement is an important factor in improving the quality of health services, patient safety, and hospital performance. The level of nurse engagement can differ between public and private hospitals due to differences in organizational characteristics, management systems, work culture, and leadership styles. This study aims to explore strategies for increasing nurse engagement based on the context of both types of hospitals. The study uses a qualitative approach with data collection techniques through literature review and observation. Data analysis was conducted through the stages of data reduction, data presentation, and conclusion drawing. The results show differences in the level of nurse engagement between government and private hospitals. Government hospital nurses have high engagement indicators in productivity, ownership, loyalty, vigor, and absorption, while private hospital nurses excel in career development and dedication. Perceived organizational support, self-efficacy, and servant leadership had a positive and significant effect on nurse engagement in both types of hospitals, both partially and simultaneously. However, the difference in the effect of each variable partially was not significant between the two hospitals. This study recommends the formulation of strategies to increase engagement through socialization programs, organizational support and self-efficacy training, and strengthening servant leadership.

10.55324/enrichment.v3i10.595.abstractZh: 护士的参与是提高医疗服务质量、患者安全以及医院绩效的重要因素。由于组织特性、管理系统、工作文化和领导风格的差异，公立医院与私立医院在护士参与程度方面可能存在差异。本研究旨在探讨基于两种类型医院背景的护士参与度提升策略。研究采用定性研究方法，通过文献回顾和观察收集数据。数据分析过程包括数据简化、数据呈现以及结论推导三个阶段。研究结果显示，公立医院与私立医院在护士参与程度上存在差异：公立医院的护士在生产力、归属感、忠诚度、积极性以及吸收能力方面具有较高的参与指标，而私立医院的护士则在职业发展和个人奉献方面表现出色。感知到的组织支持、自我效能感以及服务型领导对两种类型医院的护士参与度都有积极且显著的影响，但这些影响在不同程度上存在差异。本研究建议通过社交活动、组织支持和自我效能感培训，以及加强服务型领导等方式，制定策略以提升护士的参与度。

abstract.text: We propose a theoretical explanation for concentration trends and rising costs in hospital markets. Our explanation is based on the notion of hospitals as two-sided platforms that facilitate interactions between doctors and patients. We model a healthcare market in which two horizontally differentiated hospitals compete for doctors on one side of the market and for patients on the other. Even in the absence of any ex ante asymmetries, we show that the combination of hospital-insurer price bargaining and sufficiently strong cross-group network effects can lead to highly asymmetric equilibrium outcomes with strong market concentration and large price differences, which are features common to many U.S. hospital markets. We also analyse the effects of two different cost-reducing price regulation policies and show that patients are better off with price cap regulation than with a uniform administered price that achieves the same cost reduction.

10.65864/3jccljy7j9.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种理论解释，用于解释医院市场的集中趋势和成本上升现象。我们的解释基于将医院视为双向平台的观点，这种平台促进了医生和患者之间的互动。我们模拟了一个医疗市场，在这个市场中，两家水平差异化的医院在市场的这一侧争夺医生资源，在另一侧争夺患者资源。即使在没有任何先验不对称性的情况下，我们也发现，医院与保险公司的价格谈判以及足够强大的跨群体网络效应，可以导致高度不对称的市场均衡结果，表现为市场集中度高且价格差异大，这些特征在许多美国医院市场中都很常见。我们还分析了两种不同降低成本的定价政策的影响，并发现，采用价格上限管制比采用实现相同成本降低的统一价格管制，更能让患者受益。

abstract.text: This paper studies the management and performance of local government institutions. We conducted a management survey providing an anatomy of management practices employed in a representative sample of municipal administrations in Germany. We find that municipalities differ widely in their use of management practices. Hence, while more heavily regulated than private firms, municipalities retain considerable leeway in their choice of management practices, with some utilizing this leeway while others do not. We then study the link between management and performance. We provide a broad set of indicators that, taken together, are informative regarding municipalities’ performance relative to their (legally stipulated, but elusive) goal of promoting the well-being of their citizens. Using a management score as a measure of structured management (Bloom et al., 2019), we find systematic and robust evidence for a positive and economically significant relationship between municipalities’ management score and their performance. The same holds when considering instead a novel specific performance measure, the number of services provided online. Finally, using unsupervised machine learning (LDA) allows to classify municipalities’ management style as either “administered” or “actively managed”. We find that the latter style is associated with superior performance, but it is only used infrequently.

10.65864/8egbjjam48.abstractZh: 本文研究了地方政府机构的管理与绩效问题。我们开展了一项管理调查，对德国部分市政管理部门的管理实践进行了分析。研究发现，不同市政部门在管理实践的使用上存在显著差异。尽管受到比私营企业更严格的监管，但市政部门在管理实践的选择上仍拥有相当大的灵活性，有些部门利用了这一灵活性，而另一些则没有。接下来，我们探讨了管理方式与绩效之间的关系。我们提供了一组广泛的指标，这些指标综合起来能够反映市政部门相对于其（法律上有规定但难以实现的目标）即促进公民福祉的绩效情况。通过采用管理得分作为结构化管理的衡量标准（Bloom等人，2019年），我们发现市政部门的管理得分与其绩效之间存在系统且显著的正相关关系。当使用新的具体绩效指标——在线服务数量时，这一关系依然成立。最后，通过无监督机器学习（LDA）方法，我们将市政部门的管理风格分为“管理型”和“主动管理型”。研究发现，后者与更好的绩效相关，但使用频率较低。

abstract.text: We estimate the labor market effects of Italy's statutory priority to work from home (WFH) for parents of children under age twelve. Using population-wide administrative data and a sharp regression discontinuity design, we find that eligibility raises mothers' annual earnings by 1.6-2.3 percent in high-WFH-intensity firms, alongside increases in paid days and weeks. Mothers in low-WFH-intensity firms and fathers in general show no detectable effects. The estimates have an intention-to-treat interpretation and persist beyond the pandemic. Placebo tests show no effects before the pandemic, in firms that never adopted WFH, or among manual workers, consistent with a WFH mechanism.

10.65864/9y8k62unct.abstractZh: 我们估算了意大利对父母在家工作的法定优先政策对劳动力市场的效应，这些父母的孩子年龄未满十二岁。通过利用全人口范围的行政数据以及严格的回归不连续设计，我们发现，在高比例家庭在家工作的企业中，有资格在家工作的母亲年收入会增加1.6%至2.3%，同时她们的工作天数和周数也会增加。而在低比例家庭在家工作的企业和一般父亲中，并未观察到明显的影响。这些估计结果具有“治疗性”解释，并且即使在疫情结束后仍然持续存在。安慰剂测试显示，在疫情之前，以及在从未采用在家工作政策的企业和手工劳动者中，并未观察到任何效应，这与在家工作机制的存在是一致的。

abstract.text: In the last two decades European policy makers have sought to increase the use of market mechanisms in the delivery of healthcare. These reforms introduce competition and choice into previously heavily constrained environments. This leads to a set of interesting economic issues that have been addressed in a range of papers, both theoretical and empirical. This paper examines whether this popular reform model has resulted in improvements in outcomes for patients and/or taxpayers. It synthesises the existing economic analyses, highlights what is known and what is not, and signals potential next steps for economic research.

10.65864/ov26u2idxy.abstractZh: 在过去的二十年里，欧洲的政策制定者努力增加市场机制在医疗保健提供中的使用。这些改革将竞争和选择引入到此前受到严格限制的环境中。这引发了一系列有趣的经济问题，这些问题已在理论研究和实证研究中得到探讨。本文探讨了这种流行的改革模式是否改善了患者和/或纳税人的状况。文章综合了现有的经济分析，指出了已知和未知的信息，并指出了经济研究的潜在下一步方向。

abstract.text: How flexible are multinational production networks when assembly technologies are specialized and costly to reconfigure? Using data on the global automotive industry from 2000-2023, I document that production is organized around discrete process technologies (platforms) that constrain where each product can be assembled. Exploiting the 2011 Tohoku earthquake as a quasi-natural experiment, I show that platform compatibility limits firms’ ability to reallocate production after local shocks. Firms overcome this constraint by licensing technologies to each other. I develop and estimate a structural model of multinational production with discrete technology choice and inter-firm licensing. Models abstracting from production technologies overstate the reallocation induced by tariffs and understate the price incidence borne by the tariffing country’s consumers. The model also allows to study policies restricting access to technologies: these can trigger more reallocation than a broad tariff war, with costs concentrated on the firms and locations bound by the affected technologies.

10.65864/vc4p7u3q02.abstractZh: 当组装技术具有专业性且重新配置成本高昂时，跨国生产网络能有多大的灵活性？通过利用2000年至2023年全球汽车工业的数据，我发现生产是围绕离散的工艺技术（平台）来组织的，这限制了每个产品的组装地点。以2011年东北地震作为准自然实验，我表明平台兼容性限制了企业在局部冲击后重新分配生产的能力。企业通过向彼此授权技术来克服这一限制。我开发并估计了一个包含离散技术选择和企业间授权结构的跨国生产模型。忽略生产技术因素的模型高估了关税引起的重新分配，而低估了受关税影响国家的消费者所承担的价格负担。该模型还允许研究限制技术获取的政策：这些政策可能引发的重新分配比广泛的关税战争更为严重，其成本集中在受技术影响的企业和地区。

abstract.text: Many modern organizations use knowledge hierarchies, where frontline workers try to resolve tasks and pass those they cannot resolve to experts. But the implications of this organization of expertise are not well understood, especially if firm revenues depend on who resolves each task or the firm generates downstream externalities. We study a knowledge hierarchy (KH) using 500,000 patient cases from an online primary care firm, linked to outcomes and costs across Sweden's healthcare system. We use variation in assignment arising from temporary doctor congestion, controlling for date-by-three-hour windows and flexible case characteristics. Within the KH, nurses resolve 70% of cases and pass the remainder to doctors. Relative to doctor-only care, the KH modestly increases external primary care and ED visits but has no adverse effects on hospitalizations, earnings losses, or mortality. Although the mean effect of KH on systemwide (firm plus downstream) production costs is small, this masks substantial heterogeneity. Compared to using only doctors, the savings from the firm's selective use of the KH equal 1.6% of online primary care costs. However, our main finding is that reassigning cases between the direct-to-doctor and KH routes within 15-minute windows to minimize systemwide production costs would save 6.8% of online primary care costs.

10.65864/z76w4aal90.abstractZh: 许多现代组织采用知识层级结构，即一线员工负责处理任务，无法解决的任务则交由专家处理。但这种专业知识组织的机制其影响尚不完全清楚，尤其是当企业的收入取决于谁来处理每项任务，或者企业产生下游外部性时。我们研究了一个知识层级结构，使用了来自一家在线初级保健公司的500,000个患者案例，这些案例与瑞典医疗系统的结果和成本相关联。我们考虑了由于医生临时短缺导致的任务分配变化，并控制了时间窗口和病例的灵活特性。在知识层级结构中，护士负责处理70%的病例，其余任务则交给医生处理。与仅由医生处理的情况相比，知识层级结构略微增加了初级保健服务和急诊就诊的数量，但并未对住院率、收入损失或死亡率产生负面影响。尽管知识层级结构对系统整体（包括企业及下游环节）生产成本的平均影响较小，但这掩盖了显著的异质性。与仅依赖医生处理相比，企业选择性使用知识层级结构可节省1.6%的在线初级保健成本。然而，我们的主要发现是，在15分钟的时间窗口内重新分配病例，以最小化系统整体的生产成本，可以节省6.8%的在线初级保健成本。

abstract.text: We propose a model of consideration and choice that uses search data to flexibly estimate co-search patterns for every pair of products. Using simulations, we show that estimating co-search flexibly rather than modeling the drivers of consideration comes at a modest cost in precision but guards against misspecification. The method is therefore particularly valuable in online markets, where the drivers of consideration — such as webpage layout or product recommendations — are often unobserved. Relative to using purchase data alone, search data substantially improves the precision of cross-price elasticity estimates, because products that are searched together tend to be close substitutes and because browsing data is far more abundant than purchases. We apply our approach to data from an online retailer and find that most products have a small set of close substitutes and that accounting for substitution patterns when setting prices raises the retailer's average mark-up from 36.5% to 47.5% and increases its profits.

10.65864/zia1f68ta8.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个考虑与选择的模型，该模型利用搜索数据来灵活估计每对产品的共同搜索模式。通过模拟实验，我们发现，与建模考虑因素的驱动因素相比，灵活估计共同搜索模式在精确度上花费较少，但能避免误设模型的风险。因此，该方法在在线市场中尤为有价值，因为考虑因素的驱动因素——如网页布局或产品推荐——往往难以观测。与仅使用购买数据相比，搜索数据显著提高了交叉价格弹性估计的精确度，因为共同被搜索到的产品往往属于近似替代品，而且浏览数据比购买数据更为丰富。我们对一家在线零售商的数据进行了应用分析，发现大多数产品都有少数近似替代品，因此在定价时考虑替代模式可以将零售商的平均加价从36.5%提高到47.5%，同时增加其利润。

abstract.text: Understanding health care sector productivity is critical, as health spending accounts for about 17% of U.S. GDP. Despite the significance of the health care sector, official statistics may substantially understate productivity growth in this key sector by failing to capture improvements in medical technology and the quality of treatment. The Health Care Satellite Account (HCSA), developed by the U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis, helps to address this gap by measuring health care spending by condition, enabling a more meaningful measurement of the sector. In this paper, we present a simple framework that demonstrates how the HCSA can be combined with population health data to adjust prices and health care output to better reflect improvements in medical care technology. Importantly, we measure output as the marginal health gains from medical care rather than the number of services provided, consistent with recommendations by National Research Council (2011). Our approach approximates more comprehensive methodologies, offering an accessible tool for adjusting output and productivity estimates to reflect health gains. Our findings suggest that quality-adjusted productivity growth in health care is substantial but masked in existing official statistics, suggesting a downward bias in productivity of about 1.5 percentage points per year. Due to uncertainty of parameters related to the value of health and underlying population health, the potential bias has a wide range from 0 to over 5.0 percentage points per year. We also estimate that the cost per quality-adjusted life year gained may exceed $80,000, underscoring the economic trade-offs inherent in medical care spending. Productivity gains are potentially larger in other high-income countries where life expectancy gains exceed those of the U.S., while spending has grown more slowly. However, accurately determining the productivity of the health sectors across countries involves disentangling changes in underlying population health from improvements in medical care.

10.66137/qafk3387.abstractZh: 了解医疗保健行业的生产力至关重要，因为医疗保健支出约占美国GDP的17%。尽管医疗保健行业的重要性不言而喻，但官方统计数据可能严重低估了该行业的生产力增长，因为未能反映医疗技术和治疗质量的提升。由美国经济分析局开发的医疗保健卫星账户（HCSA）通过按疾病状况衡量医疗保健支出，有助于弥补这一不足，从而更精确地衡量该行业的表现。在本文中，我们提出了一个简单的框架，说明如何将HCSA与人口健康数据相结合，以调整价格和医疗保健产出，更好地反映医疗技术的改进。重要的是，我们将产出定义为医疗护理带来的边际健康收益，而不是提供的服务数量，这与国家研究委员会（2011年）的建议一致。我们的方法近似于更全面的方法论，提供了一个易于使用的工具，用于调整产出和生产力估计，以反映健康收益的改善。我们的研究结果表明，医疗保健的质量调整生产力增长是显著的，但在现有的官方统计数据中被掩盖了，这表明生产力每年可能存在约1.5个百分点的低估。由于与医疗保健价值和基础人口健康相关的参数存在不确定性，这种潜在偏差的范围从0到超过5.0个百分点不等。我们还估计，每获得一个质量调整的生命年所需的成本可能超过80,000美元，这凸显了医疗支出中固有的经济权衡。在其他高收入国家，生产力的提升可能更为显著，因为这些国家的预期寿命提升幅度超过了美国，而消费增长则较为缓慢。然而，准确评估各国卫生领域的生产力，需要区分人口健康状况的变化与医疗服务的改善。

abstract.text: Frontier efficiency methods are widely used to measure healthcare productivity, but results vary greatly because of methodological heterogeneity. There is limited consensus on input-output variable selection, and differences in DEA orientation, returns-to-scale assumptions, case-mix adjustment, and quality incorporation complicate cross-study interpretation. Methods: Following PRISMA guidance, we screened 509 records on public hospital efficiency and included 60 empirical hospital DEA studies. Extracted data covered inputs, outputs, model orientation, returns to scale, DEA variants, case-mix adjustment, quality measures, and sensitivity analyses. Results: DEA was the dominant frontier method. Reported efficiency scores were highly conditional on model specification, commonly ranging from 73% to 97% across studies. In the authors' extraction, most studies used input-oriented models (36/60, 60.0%) and either VRS or CRS/VRS comparisons (42/60, 70.0%). Core inputs were staff (56/60, 93.3%) and beds (50/60, 83.3%), while core outputs were inpatient volume (54/60, 90.0%) and outpatient volume (48/60, 80.0%). Case-mix adjustment was present in 21 studies (35.0%). Quality was directly incorporated into the DEA model in only 5 studies (8.3%) and considered either directly or in parallel in 15 studies (25.0%). Conclusion: Frontier efficiency analysis is useful for benchmarking but is highly sensitive to specification choices. Robust input-output selection, justified orientation and scale assumptions, and explicit case-mix and quality safeguards are essential for valid comparisons and responsible policy use.

10.69588/mjer.v30i19.5062.abstractZh: 前沿效率方法被广泛用于衡量医疗保健的生产力，但由于方法学上的异质性，结果差异很大。关于投入产出变量的选择存在有限的共识，而DEA取向、规模报酬假设、病例混合调整以及质量纳入方面的差异使得跨研究间的解释变得复杂。方法：遵循PRISMA指南，我们筛选了509份关于公立医院效率的记录，并纳入了60项实证医院DEA研究。提取的数据涵盖了投入、产出、模型取向、规模报酬、DEA变体、病例混合调整、质量指标以及敏感性分析等内容。结果：DEA是主导的前沿方法。报告的效率得分很大程度上取决于模型设定，通常在不同研究中介于73%到97%之间。根据作者的提取数据，大多数研究使用了投入导向模型（36/60，60.0%），并且采用了VRS或CRS/VRS比较方法（42/60，70.0%）。核心投入包括人员（56/60，93.3%）和床位（50/60，83.3%），而核心产出则包括住院人数（54/60，90.0%）和门诊人数（48/60，80.0%）。21项研究采用了病例混合调整（35.0%）。只有5项研究直接将质量纳入DEA模型（8.3%），而15项研究则同时考虑了病例混合和调整质量因素（25.0%）。结论：前沿效率分析对于基准测试很有用，但模型设定选择对结果影响很大。稳健的投入产出选择、合理的取向和规模假设，以及明确的病例混合和质量控制措施，对于有效的比较和负责任的政策应用至关重要。

abstract.text: Background: Improved quality of care is fundamental for reducing patient mortality and building sustainable health systems. Currently, there is a lack of research on the role of hospital management in improving the quality of care and health outcomes, particularly in low-income settings. Methods: We examined associations between hospital management practices and neonatal quality of care in Malawi. We adapted the World Management Survey tool to measure 28 management practices across five domains - delivery of clinical care in the neonatal unit, human resource management, target setting, finances, and governance. In April 2022, we administered the tool to five clinical and administrative managers in each of the 36 central and first-level referral hospitals (n = 180 interviews). Further, we calculated a hospital-level management score (1 - poor, 5 - excellent) and linked these data to records of 20 831 neonatal admissions (February-July 2022). Our primary outcome was in-hospital neonatal mortality, and secondary outcomes included 14 clinical quality indicators. We examined associations between hospital-level management scores and individual-level patient outcomes using a multilevel mixed-effects Poisson regression. Results: The mean hospital-level management score across the 36 hospitals was 3.35 (standard deviation = 0.4). Among 20 831 neonatal admissions, 2590 (12.4%; 95% confidence interval (CI) = 11.9-12.8) died, representing a mortality rate of 27.2 deaths per 1000 person-days. We found no relationship between the management score and in-hospital neonatal mortality (adjusted incidence rate ratio per unit increase in the score = 1.08; 95% CI = 0.81-1.44). Five management domains were not associated with mortality, and we found limited evidence that management practice scores were positively associated with quality of clinical care. Conclusions: This study presents novel, national evidence on the association between hospital management practices and neonatal mortality in a low-income country, with complementary data on quality of clinical care. We found no evidence that hospital management practices were associated with neonatal mortality and limited evidence of an association with the quality of clinical care. Rigorous impact evaluations of targeted management interventions, with embedded process evaluations, could address potential confounders and help understand how and under what circumstances management improvements could translate into better quality of care.

10.7189/jogh.16.04054.abstractZh: 背景：提高护理质量对于降低患者死亡率和建立可持续的卫生系统至关重要。目前，关于医院管理在改善护理质量和健康结果方面的作用的研究尚不足，尤其是在低收入地区。方法：我们研究了马拉维医院管理实践与新生儿护理质量之间的关联。我们采用了《世界管理调查》工具，对五个领域的28种管理实践进行了测量，包括新生儿科室的临床护理、人力资源管理、目标设定、财务管理和治理。2022年4月，我们对36家中央级和一级转诊医院的5名临床和行政管理人员进行了调查，共进行了180次访谈。此外，我们还计算了一个医院级管理评分（1-差，5-优），并将这些数据与20,831例新生儿入院记录（2022年2月至7月）进行了关联。我们的主要结果是院内新生儿死亡率，次要结果包括14个临床质量指标。我们使用多水平混合效应泊松回归模型，研究了医院级管理评分与个体患者结果之间的关联。结果：36家医院的平均医院级管理评分为3.35（标准差为0.4）。在20,831例新生儿入院中，有2590例（12.4%；95%置信区间=11.9-12.8）死亡，相当于每1000人日有27.2例死亡。我们没有发现管理评分与院内新生儿死亡率之间存在关联（调整后的发病率比每增加一个评分单位=1.08；95%置信区间=0.81-1.44）。五个管理领域与死亡率无关联，我们发现管理实践得分与临床护理质量呈正相关。结论：本研究提供了关于低收入国家医院管理实践与新生儿死亡率之间关联的新颖全国性证据，并补充了有关临床护理质量的数据。我们没有发现医院管理实践与新生儿死亡率之间存在关联，也仅有限证据表明其与临床护理质量之间存在关联。通过严格的目标管理干预措施评估，并结合过程评估，可以消除潜在的混杂因素，并有助于了解在何种情况下管理改进能够转化为更好的护理质量。

abstract.text: This thesis analyses the effects of various structural and organisational characteristics of specialist neonatal units on the clinical and economic outcomes of infants treated within them. Data are utilised from the National Neonatal Research Database (NNRD) which is extracted from the electronic patient records of all infants admitted to the vast majority of neonatal units in England over the period 2006-13 along with national healthcare expenditure and demographic data. Firstly, I examine the effects of neonatal unit volume and designation on infant clinical outcomes. In 2003, neonatal units in England and Wales were re-organised into networks to facilitate access to high level and volume neonatal units for the sickest infants as infants treated in these units had previous been shown to be at less risk of adverse outcomes. No previous studies have examined the effects of neonatal unit volume and designation in such a networked setting. Secondly, I estimate the effect of neonatal healthcare expenditure on the risk of mortality, and in so doing determine the cost-effectiveness of neonatal healthcare. Thirdly, I analyse the effect of nurse to patient ratios in neonatal intensive care on the risk of mortality, recent evidence has demonstrated that neonatal units are often understaffed with respect to clinical guidelines, yet little is known about the consequences of this on infant clinical outcomes. Finally, I explore the effect of local economic conditions at the time of conception on infant health at birth. The number of admissions to neonatal specialist healthcare units has increased in recent years to approximately 10% of all live births. Understanding the mechanisms underlying this increase is important both for healthcare capacity planning and also development of policies aimed at improving infant health at birth. The results in this thesis support policies aimed at increasing the proportion of infants born in hospitals with high volume neonatal units along with an increased provision of resources for neonatal healthcare.

10.82444/warw.33689524.abstractZh: 本论文分析了专业新生儿病房的各种结构和组织特征对其收治婴儿的临床和经济效果的影响。数据来源于国家新生儿研究数据库（NNRD），该数据库从2006-13年期间英格兰绝大多数新生儿病房的电子患者记录中提取，同时包含了国家医疗支出和人口统计数据。首先，我研究了新生儿病房规模与类型对婴儿临床效果的影响。2003年，英格兰和威尔士的新生儿病房被重新组织成网络，以便为病情最严重的婴儿提供高水平且规模较大的新生儿病房治疗，因为先前的研究表明，在这些病房治疗的婴儿出现不良结果的风险较低。此前没有研究在如此网络化的环境下探讨新生儿病房规模与类型的影响。其次，我估算了新生儿医疗支出对死亡风险的影响，并据此评估了新生儿医疗服务的成本效益。第三，我分析了新生儿重症监护室中护士与患者比例对死亡风险的影响。最新证据表明，新生儿病房往往存在人员不足的问题，这与临床指南的要求不符，但关于这一问题对婴儿临床效果的影响，目前了解甚少。最后，我探讨了受孕时当地经济条件对婴儿出生时的健康状况的影响。近年来，新生儿专业医疗单位的收治比例已上升至所有活产婴儿的约10%。了解这一增长背后的机制对于医疗能力规划以及制定旨在改善婴儿出生时的健康政策至关重要。本论文的研究结果支持以下政策：增加在具有高容量新生儿护理单位的医院出生的婴儿比例，同时增加新生儿医疗保健的资源投入。

abstract.text: Health systems in advanced economies are facing a set of major issues: first, a rapid population aging, which raises long-term expenditure and chronic care needs, coupled with a severe de-growth in fertility trend; second, the existence resource constraints that challenge the sustainability of care. In order to tackle such challenges, rigorous empirical evidence is required on both sides of the healthcare market, the demand and supply one. The present dissertation attempts at fitting into the empirical health economics debate, by centering on both dimensions: first on the demand-side -how individuals adjust health and reproductive behaviors when macro shocks challenge their budget constraints and/or alter their ordinary behaviors-, then on the supply one - as in, how institutions produce and diffuse medical knowledge under diverse funding and incentive schemes. Chapter 1 studies the demand side by examining how the COVID-19 job-suspension and furloughing policy, which suddenly shifted time allocation and both social and economic security in 2020, affected the abortion patterns of Italian women. By leveraging cross-municipal variation in the share of workers suspended (and furloughed) from “non-essential” activities within a difference-in-differences framework, the chapter makes use of administrative data to document that municipalities in the upper tail of the suspension distribution experienced a short-lived \emph{increase} in abortion rates of roughly one-tenth of the average quarterly rate, despite an overall lockdown-induced decline. The effect is primarily driven by areas with higher industrial furloughing and by married women, out of the labor force, who have already mothered one or two children; by contrast, pregnancies culminating in live births nine months later show no differential change. These patterns hint to within-couple channels and economic uncertainty rather than supply restrictions of services as the main drivers. Chapter 2 turns to the supply side and asks how different research incentive regimes shape medical knowledge production within a major private Italian hospital. Exploiting a number of various difference-in-differences strategies around two sequential policy changes-the introduction of a performance-based Management-By-Objectives (MBO) bonus scheme, explicitly rewarding publications, and the designation of the entity as a research-accredited institute, thus unlocking dedicated public research funding- the chapter shows that the MBO, on its own, did not raise output among non-academic clinicians, whereas IRCCS recognition substantially boosted the publication rates of academic, more research-oriented physicians; meaningful gains appear for non-academics only when both policies unfold for them. The analysis also displays the absence of effects on cross-group co-authorship, with heterogenous consequences on citations and research quality. This highlights that broad, stable research funding outperforms narrow performance pay in this context, although less-academic oriented researchers may value quality over quantity in collaborations and publications. Taken together, the two essays show how macro shocks and institutional design jointly shape reproductive health outcomes and the production of medical innovation: understanding unintended fertility responses is essential for policy makers in the context of demographic change, while getting research incentives and funding mechanisms right is paramount to better understand the productivity and diffusion of effective (and efficient) healthcare. In societies which are growing older, and demand burdens in the face of reduced fiscal space and varying labor market supply, the evidence collected here may highlight the relevance of policies able to both anticipate behavioral responses on the patient side in case of unexpected health shocks requiring sudden labor-market interventions, and ensure a sustained and mission-oriented funding strand for health providers/researchers.

10.83049/unicatt/publicatt/10807_331236.abstractZh: 先进经济体的卫生系统正面临一系列重大挑战：首先，人口迅速老龄化，这增加了长期支出和慢性护理需求，同时生育率也出现了严重下降；其次，资源限制问题对护理的可持续性构成了挑战。为了应对这些挑战，需要在医疗保健市场的供需两端都提供严谨的实证证据。本论文试图通过关注这两个方面来融入实证卫生经济学讨论：首先是在需求端——当宏观经济冲击挑战个体的预算限制或改变其常规行为时，个体如何调整健康与生育行为；其次是供给端——在不同的资金激励方案下，机构如何生产和传播医学知识。第一章通过研究2020年COVID-19疫情导致的岗位暂停和休假政策对意大利女性堕胎行为的影响，探讨了需求端的问题。该章利用跨市政的工人被暂停或休假的比例差异数据，发现处于暂停政策分布较高端的市政地区，堕胎率短暂上升了大约十分之一的平均季度率，尽管整体而言由于封锁措施导致堕胎率下降。这种效应主要受到工业领域工人被暂停的影响，以及那些已经生育了一两个孩子的已婚女性的影响；相比之下，九个月后自然分娩的妊娠则没有显示出差异。这些模式表明，夫妻之间的沟通和经济不确定性是主要驱动因素，而非服务供应的限制。第二章转向供应方面，探讨不同的研究激励制度如何影响意大利一家大型私立医院内的医学知识产出。通过采用多种差异-差异策略，针对两项连续政策变化进行分析——引入基于绩效的管理目标奖金制度，明确奖励发表成果，以及将该机构认定为研究认证机构，从而获得专门的公共研究资金——结果显示，仅实施管理目标奖金制度并未提高非学术临床医生的产出，而IRCCS的认可则显著提升了学术型、更注重研究的医生的发表率；只有当这两项政策同时实施时，非学术人员才获得了显著收益。分析还显示，这些政策对跨组合作无影响，对引用量和研究质量的影响也不一致。这表明，在这种情况之下，广泛而稳定的研究资金比狭隘的绩效奖励更为有效，尽管不太注重学术的研究人员可能更重视合作和发表成果的质量。总的来说，这两篇论文展示了宏观冲击和制度设计如何共同影响生殖健康成果和医学创新的产出：理解非预期的生育反应对于应对人口变化的政策制定者至关重要，而正确设计研究激励和资金机制则对于更好地理解有效（且高效）医疗服务的生产力和传播至关重要。在老龄化加剧的社会中，面对财政空间缩减和劳动力市场供应变化的情况下，所收集的证据可能凸显出一些政策的重要性。这些政策既能预测患者在突发健康危机时需要劳动力市场干预时的行为反应，又能为医疗服务提供者/研究人员提供持续且目标明确的资金支持。

abstract.text: Over the last decade a wave of U.S. states began reimbursing doula services through Medicaid, hoping to improve infant health and narrow stark racial gaps in birth outcomes. I evaluate these mandates using the staggered 2021-2024 rollout, a panel of 32.1 million births from CDC WONDER (2016-2024), and a newly assembled measure of the state doula workforce drawn from the national provider registry. Identification comes from the policy's timing rather than from comparing doula users to non-users, addressing the selection problem that limits the existing observational literature. On average I find no detectable effect on low birth weight (LBW). Consistent with the heterogeneity emphasized by Peet (2022) and the maternal-health-disparities literature, however, the effect concentrates among the group at greatest risk: Black mothers, for whom LBW falls by roughly half a percentage point (about 5% of the baseline) in the states with the longest exposure, with flat pre-trends and a coherent upward shift in the birth-weight distribution. The estimate is marginal once I use inference valid for few treated clusters, and the binding constraint is statistical power: most mandates took effect in 2024-2025, at or beyond the end of the data. A two-stage least squares analysis shows that coverage roughly doubles the doula workforce (first-stage F approximately 21-35), and that the induced increase in doula supply is associated with lower Black LBW, though imprecisely. I read the results as credible early evidence that doula mandates work where they have had time to operate and where the need is greatest, rather than as a finished causal claim.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.07770.abstractZh: 在过去的十年中，美国多个州开始通过医疗补助计划报销助产士服务，希望改善婴儿健康，缩小出生结果中的种族差距。我通过2021-2024年的分阶段实施情况、CDC WONDER数据库中的3210万例分娩数据，以及从全国助产士登记系统中新收集的数据来衡量这些政策的影响。识别结果基于政策的实施时间，而非比较助产士使用者与非使用者，从而解决了限制现有观察性研究的选择问题。平均来看，我发现这些政策对低出生体重的影响并不明显。然而，与Peet（2022年）强调的异质性以及孕产妇健康差异文献一致，这种影响主要集中在风险最高的群体中：在受影响时间最长的州，黑人母亲的低出生体重减少了大约0.5个百分点（约为基线的5%），且出生体重分布呈现出明显的上升趋势。当使用适用于少数受政策影响的群体的推断方法时，这一效应仍然较为微弱。统计上的限制因素是统计能力：大多数政策在2024-2025年生效，即数据收集结束之后。两阶段最小二乘法分析显示，助产士服务的覆盖率大约翻了一番（第一阶段F值约为21-35），而助产士供应的增加与黑人低出生体重的减少有关，尽管这种关联并不十分精确。我认为这些结果表明，助产士政策在能够发挥作用且需求最大的地区确实有效，而不是一个明确的因果结论。

abstract.text: Whether organisational separation of elective and emergency care improves physician productivity remains an open question. Most existing evidence relies on cross-sectional comparisons or volume-based outcomes that cannot isolate efficiency gains from input expansion or provider selection. In contrast, this paper exploits the staggered rollout of NHS England's surgical hub programme, a set of dedicated ring-fenced elective facilities introduced as part of its Elective Recovery Plan, to provide causal estimates of the effect of elective-emergency separation on physician productivity. Using this rollout to implement a heterogeneity-robust difference-in-differences design, we estimate the impact of hub adoption on physician productivity measured as cost-weighted elective output per unit of salary-weighted physician input. We find that hub adoption increases physician productivity by 14.5% relative to the no-hub counterfactual, accompanied by a 10-day (7.6%) reduction in average patient waiting times. The size of these gains depends on how completely elective care is insulated from emergency pathways. Standalone hubs situated on dedicated elective-only sites achieve relatively larger productivity gains than integrated hubs located within main acute hospital sites. Moreover, operating multiple hubs yields gains more than double the overall average, whereas a single hub shows no statistically significant effect. For health systems seeking to raise physician productivity and address elective backlogs, these findings suggest that how separation is implemented, not simply whether it is adopted, shapes the productivity gains it delivers.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.10380.abstractZh: 组织上将择期护理与紧急护理分开是否能够提高医生的工作效率，仍是一个未解决的问题。现有的大多数研究依赖于横断面比较或基于数量的结果分析，这些研究无法区分效率提升是由投入增加还是提供者选择带来的。相比之下，本文利用了NHS英格兰的手术中心计划分阶段实施的模式，该计划作为择期恢复计划的一部分，引入了一系列专门的择期护理设施，以此来评估择期护理与紧急护理分开对医生工作效率的影响。通过采用一种能够处理异质性的差异系数设计，我们估计了手术中心计划对医生工作效率的影响，具体表现为每单位工资加权投入所对应的成本加权择期护理产出。研究发现，与没有手术中心计划的情况相比，采用手术中心计划使医生的工作效率提高了14.5%，同时平均患者等待时间减少了10天（7.6%）。这些效益的大小取决于择期护理与紧急护理之间的隔离程度。位于专门择期护理设施上的独立手术中心计划能够实现相对更大的工作效率提升，而位于主要急诊医院内的综合手术中心计划则效果较差。此外，运营多个手术中心计划所带来的工作效率提升是平均水平的两倍多，而单一手术中心计划则没有统计学上的显著效果。对于希望提高医生工作效率并解决择期护理积压问题的医疗系统来说，这些发现表明，实施这种分离方式本身，而不仅仅是是否采用这种方式，才是决定工作效率提升的关键因素。

abstract.text: Moving from geographically fragmented to pooled waiting lists in deceased-donor organ transplantation can improve efficiency, but it raises concerns about regional fairness and participation incentives. This paper studies Pareto gains from such transitions in a multi-class queueing model with impatient agents, perishable items, and a tractable homogeneous compatibility friction. Unlike standard approaches that focus on static match quality or ignore regional incentives in dynamic settings, our analysis identifies dynamic risk pooling as the main source of Pareto improvements for regions: pooling reduces organ waste due to stochastic supply-demand fluctuations, temporal mismatches, and random compatibility outcomes. Although this dynamic surplus theoretically permits Pareto improvements, a purely utilitarian policy that treats all patients equally across regions often fails to deliver them when regions are asymmetric. In such cases, utilitarian redistribution extracts too many organs from high-supply regions and violates their participation constraints. To resolve this conflict, we show that the set of achievable utilities can be described by mixtures of static priority index policies. Building on this structure, we propose the Constrained Pareto Frontier Search (CPFS), a polynomial-time procedure that computes an approximately optimal allocation policy with arbitrarily small participation-constraint violations. The results suggest that, by adjusting priority indices to keep redistribution within the gains from pooled supply, demand, and compatibility risk, policymakers can attain global efficiency while preserving local participation incentives.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18147.abstractZh: 从地理上分散的等待名单转变为集中式的等待名单可以提高效率，但这也引发了关于地区公平性和参与激励的担忧。本文研究了在具有不耐烦代理人、易变质物品以及可处理的同质兼容性摩擦的多类排队模型中，这种转变所带来的帕累托收益。与那些专注于静态匹配质量或忽略动态环境下地区激励的标准方法不同，我们的分析指出，动态风险共享是地区间帕累托改进的主要来源：集中式等待名单可以减少由于随机供需波动、时间不匹配以及随机兼容性结果导致的器官浪费。尽管这种动态收益理论上允许帕累托改进，但一种纯粹以功利主义为目标的政策，如果对所有地区的患者一视同仁，往往无法在地区不对称的情况下实现帕累托改进。在这种情况下，功利主义再分配会从高供应地区获取过多的器官，从而违反这些地区的参与限制。为了解决这一冲突，我们展示了可实现的效用集可以通过静态优先级指数政策的混合来描述。基于这一结构，我们提出了约束帕累托边界搜索算法（CPFS），这是一种多项式时间算法，可以计算出一个近似最优的分配策略，同时允许极小的参与限制违规。结果表明，通过调整优先级指数，使再分配保持在集中式供应、需求和兼容性风险带来的收益范围内，政策制定者可以在保持当地参与激励的同时实现全球效率。

abstract.text: This paper estimates the causal effect of drug consumption room (DCR) openings on drug-related hospitalizations in Switzerland. I exploit the staggered introduction of DCRs across Swiss cities between 1998 and 2022, using individual-level hospital records and a difference-in-differences estimator. DCR openings reduce drug-related hospitalization rates by roughly 35\% within 5 km of a facility. The reduction is most pronounced for fatal outcomes, which fall by 35\% while narcotics poisoning hospitalizations rise by a comparable amount, consistent with DCRs converting potentially fatal overdoses into non-fatal hospitalizations. Mental and behavioral disorder hospitalizations decline by 32\% while estimates for Hepatitis and HIV are imprecise. The findings support the role of DCRs as an effective harm reduction strategy.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.27732.abstractZh: 本文估计了瑞士药物消费室开设对药物相关住院治疗的因果效应。我们利用1998年至2022年间瑞士各城市药物消费室逐步开设的时序数据，通过个体层面的医院记录及差异-差异估计方法进行分析。研究发现，在距离药物消费室5公里范围内，药物相关住院率降低了约35%。这一降低在致命病例中最为明显，致命病例减少了35%，而毒品中毒导致的住院人数则增加了相当数量，这与药物消费室将潜在致命的用药过量转化为非致命性住院治疗的作用一致。精神行为障碍导致的住院人数减少了32%，而肝炎和HIV相关住院率的估计结果则不够精确。这些发现支持了药物消费室作为有效危害减少策略的作用。

abstract.text: Lifestyle factors are an important health input, but estimating causal effects from observational data is challenging because take-up of health behaviors is non-random. This dissertation examines how this problem---sometimes referred to as selection or confounding---affects the reliability of observational estimates in nutritional epidemiology. In the first chapter, I show that changes in supplement take-up following new health research are accompanied by changes in selection on both observable and unobservable dimensions. Even after controlling for observable confounders, estimated associations between supplement use and health outcomes strengthen substantially during high-take-up periods. I provide evidence that this effect is driven by adopters: individuals who begin supplement use in response to changing guidance. In the second chapter, I leverage information on changes in observable confounders and individual behavior over time to control for residual selection bias. I find that selection on observables is not a reliable predictor of selection on unobservables, complicating bias correction and bounding exercises. Directly controlling for adopter status is more effective, highlighting the importance of identifying the source of variation being used for estimation. In the third chapter, I document that measurement error in self-reported food intake and physical activity data varies systematically across groups: the discrepancy between self-reported and monitor-recorded physical activity is larger for smokers and higher-BMI individuals. Calculated energy balance from self-reported data is nearly uncorrelated with implied energy balance, and exhibits a negative relationship: on average, individuals who report larger caloric deficits gain more weight over the next two years. I describe how this type of non-random measurement error can affect observational studies, not only on the effect of diet and exercise, but also other studies controlling for these variables as confounders. Taken together, these results demonstrate that selection bias in observational health research remains a serious concern, even in well-designed prospective cohort studies.

https://openalex.org/W7164252643.abstractZh: 生活方式因素是健康的重要影响因素，但从观察数据中估计因果效应却颇具挑战性，因为健康行为的采纳并非随机。本论文探讨了这一问题——有时被称为选择或混杂因素——如何影响营养流行病学中观察性估计的可靠性。在第一章中，我展示了随着新的健康研究出现，补充剂采纳的变化伴随着在可观察和不可观察维度上的选择变化。即使在控制了可观察的混杂因素后，补充剂使用与健康结果之间的关联在补充剂被广泛采纳的时期仍然显著增强。我有证据表明，这种效应是由采纳者驱动的：那些因指导变化而开始使用补充剂的个体。在第二章中，我利用关于可观察混杂因素和个体行为随时间变化的信息来控制剩余的选择偏差。我发现，可观察变量的选择并不能可靠地预测不可观察变量的选择，这增加了偏差校正和界限设定的复杂性。直接控制采纳者的状态更为有效，这凸显了识别用于估计的变异来源的重要性。在第三章中，我记录了自我报告的食物摄入量和体力活动数据的测量误差在不同群体中存在系统性差异：吸烟者和高BMI个体的自我报告体力活动与监测记录的数据之间的差异更大。从自我报告数据计算出的能量平衡与隐含的能量平衡几乎不相关，并且呈现出负相关关系：平均而言，报告较大热量缺口的个体在接下来的两年里会增重更多。我描述了这种非随机测量误差如何影响观察性研究，不仅涉及饮食和锻炼的影响，还包括那些将这些因素作为混杂变量的其他研究。总体而言，这些结果表明，即使在设计良好的前瞻性队列研究中，观察性健康研究中的选择偏差仍然是一个严重的问题。

abstract.text: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is increasingly integrated into the core of economic, technological, andorganizational systems, fundamentally altering how value is created, labor is distributed, andproductivity is optimized. From AI-assisted software development pipelines to data-driven decisionmaking in corporate operations, intelligent systems are emerging as key drivers of efficiency andinnovation across industries. Yet, these transformations prompt critical economic reflections: Whichhuman-led tasks can be responsibly automated? What are the measurable benefits and hidden costs ofdelegating functions to AI? And how can institutions maximize value generation while maintainingadaptability and accountability? DATAMACLEA’26 welcomes empirically grounded and forwardlooking contributions that investigate these questions through technical insight, sectoral analysis, andreal-world application.At the same time, the growing adoption of AI technologies across sectors is unlocking new forms ofeconomic efficiency, operational resilience, and scalable innovation. From intelligent documentationand simulation systems to decision-support tools and remote service platforms, AI-powered solutionsare enabling organizations to optimize processes, reduce resource waste, and enhance outcome quality.These tools not only assist professionals in managing complex tasks but also generate measurable valueat the institutional, national, and global levels. DATAMACLEA’26 encourages contributions thatexamine how such AI-enabled innovations reshape economic models, improve productivity, and drivevalue creation across diverse domains, including healthcare, software, education, finance, and beyond.

https://openalex.org/W7168330797.abstractZh: 人工智能（AI）正越来越多地融入经济、技术和组织的核心系统，从根本上改变了价值的创造方式、劳动力的分配以及生产效率的优化。从AI辅助的软件开发流程到企业运营中的数据驱动决策，智能系统正在成为各个行业效率和创新的关键驱动力。然而，这些变革也引发了一些重要的经济思考：哪些人类主导的任务可以负责任地实现自动化？将职能委托给AI所带来的可衡量效益和隐藏成本是什么？机构如何在保持适应性和责任性的同时最大化价值创造？DATAMACLEA’26欢迎通过技术洞察、行业分析和实际应用来探讨这些问题的实证性和前瞻性研究。同时，AI技术在各个领域的广泛应用正在解锁新的经济效率、运营韧性和可扩展的创新方式。从智能文档和模拟系统到决策支持工具和远程服务平台，由AI驱动的解决方案使组织能够优化流程、减少资源浪费并提高成果质量。这些工具不仅帮助专业人士处理复杂任务，还在机构、国家和全球层面产生可衡量的价值。DATAMACLEA’26鼓励研究这类AI驱动的创新如何重塑经济模式、提高生产力，并在包括医疗保健、软件、教育、金融等多个领域推动价值创造。

abstract.text: Dit proefschrift onderzoekt in hoeverre risicoverevening in gereguleerde zorgverzekeringsmarkten erin slaagt financiële prikkels tot risicoselectie te beperken en welke mogelijkheden bestaan om deze prikkels verder terug te dringen. De bevindingen laten zien dat, ondanks de grote ontwikkeling van risicovereveningsmodellen, ook in geavanceerde systemen zoals het Nederlandse nog belangrijke selectieprikkels bestaan. Het proefschrift laat zien dat deze prikkels breder moeten worden geëvalueerd dan alleen aan de hand van gemiddelde voorspelbare winsten en verliezen. Ook veranderingen in de gezondheidstoestand van verzekerden, de timing van compensatie en de onzekerheid rondom resterende financiële risico’s blijken van invloed op de aantrekkelijkheid van verschillende groepen verzekerden voor zorgverzekeraars. Daarmee worden nieuwe dimensies van selectieprikkels zichtbaar die in bestaande evaluaties grotendeels buiten beeld blijven. Daarnaast onderzoekt het proefschrift drie strategieën om selectieprikkels te verminderen. Verdere verfijning van risicoverevening kan de compensatie voor specifieke groepen verbeteren, maar blijkt onvoldoende om hardnekkige ondercompensaties volledig weg te nemen. Een zorgvuldig vormgegeven systeem van high-risk pooling kan deze prikkels aanzienlijk reduceren, terwijl belangrijke prikkels voor doelmatige zorginkoop behouden blijven. Ook de relatie tussen risicoverevening en premieregulering verdient heroverweging, aangezien een substantieel deel van de gewenste solidariteit reeds via risicoverevening wordt gerealiseerd. De centrale conclusie is dat het beperken van risicoselectie vraagt om een voortdurende combinatie van bredere evaluatie, verdere ontwikkeling van risicoverevening en aanvullende beleidsinstrumenten. Zo kan gereguleerde concurrentie beter bijdragen aan een zorgverzekeringsmarkt waarin solidariteit en doelmatigheid duurzaam met elkaar in evenwicht blijven.

https://openalex.org/W7204515092.abstractZh: 本论文研究在受监管的医疗保险市场中，风险对冲在多大程度上能够限制财务激励对风险选择的促进作用，以及有哪些方法可以进一步减少这些激励。研究结果表明，尽管风险对冲模型已经取得了巨大发展，但在像荷兰这样的先进体系中，重要的选择激励仍然存在。论文指出，这些激励需要被更广泛地评估，而不仅仅是基于平均可预测的收益和损失。此外，被保险人健康状况的变化、补偿的时间点以及剩余财务风险的不确定性，也会影响不同群体对医疗保险提供商的吸引力。这些新的选择激励维度在现有的评估中大多未被注意到。此外，论文还研究了三种减少选择激励的策略。进一步改进风险对冲可以改善特定群体的补偿情况，但不足以完全消除顽固性的补偿不足现象。一个精心设计的高风险汇集系统可以显著减少这些激励，同时保留对有效医疗服务采购的重要激励。风险对冲与保费监管之间的关系也需要重新考虑，因为已经通过风险对冲实现了相当一部分所需的团结性。核心结论是，限制风险选择需要持续结合更广泛的评估、进一步的发展风险对冲以及额外的政策工具。有规制的竞争能够更好地为医疗保险市场做出贡献，使团结与效率在市场中长期保持平衡。

abstract.text: This dissertation examines how organizational structure and health policy reforms affecthealthcare providers’ decision-making and the healthcare quality. The first chapter studies whether the gender composition of physician teams affects healthcare quality. Using patient-level data from the Florida State Inpatient Database, I examine outcomes for patients undergoing percutaneous coronary intervention and coronary artery bypass grafting– two procedures that require collaboration between a proceduralist (who performs the procedure) and an attending physician (who provides inpatient care). Exploiting within-proceduralist variation in team gender composition across emergency ad missions, I find that mixed-gender teams reduce in-hospital mortality by 0.35 percentage points, corresponding to a 15% reduction relative to the sample mean mortality rate. I find no evidence of increased medical resource utilization but provide suggestive evidence that the reduction in mortality might be driven by enhanced team productivity associated with gender diversity. These findings underscore the importance of gender composition in healthcare teams and highlight potential gains from promoting diversity in medical practice. The second chapter uses China’s experience with its Zero Markup Drug Policy (ZMDP)- a policy that eliminated the profit margin hospitals could earn on drug sales- to exam ine how healthcare providers responded to this financial shock. I exploit the variation in hospitals’ pre-policy dependency on drug profits to identify the causal impact of ZMDP. I find that the amount patients spent on drugs decreased by more than 50% on average, but that the amount patients spent on diagnostic procedures increased by a similar magnitude, suggesting that providers may have replaced expenditures on prescription drugs with ex penditures on diagnostic services. Despite these substantial changes in treatment patterns,I find no significant changes in health outcomes. Quantile and causal forest analysis suggests that providers achieved this result by concentrating treatment changes on healthier patients– suggesting a strategic reallocation of healthcare resources to preserve health out comes while mitigating revenue losses. The third chapter examines whether hospitals respond to the Hospital Readmissions Reduction Program (HRRP) by altering admission decisions when recently discharged pa tients return to the emergency department for acute care. Using patient-level inpatient and emergency department records from Florida between 2013 and 2017, I implement a regression discontinuity design based on the number of days since the last index discharge. I examine whether the probability of admission increases discontinuously once a patient returns after, rather than before, the 30-day post-discharge cutoff. In the pooled sample, I find little evidence of such a discontinuity. However, the heterogeneous analysis reveals positive discontinuities in admission probability among hospitals with greater Medicare de pendence and among hospitals that were not penalized in the first year of the HRRP, with effects concentrated in pneumonia and heart failure. These findings suggest that hospi tals’ responses to the HRRP are selective rather than uniform, varying with both financial incentives and the degree of clinical discretion across conditions.

https://openalex.org/W7214137677.abstractZh: 本论文探讨了组织结构与医疗政策改革如何影响医疗服务提供者的决策以及医疗质量。第一章研究医生团队的性别构成是否会影响医疗质量。我利用佛罗里达州住院数据库中的患者数据，对接受经皮冠状动脉介入治疗和冠状动脉旁路移植术的患者进行了分析——这两种手术需要手术医生与主治医生之间的协作。通过对比急诊和门诊手术中手术医生的性别构成差异，我发现混合性别的团队能够将院内死亡率降低0.35个百分点，相当于比样本平均死亡率降低了15%。我没有发现医疗资源利用增加的证据，但认为死亡率的降低可能源于性别多样性带来的团队生产力提升。这些发现强调了医疗团队中性别构成的重要性，并指出了促进医疗实践多样性的潜在收益。第二章以中国的零加成药品政策为例，该政策取消了医院在药品销售中获得的利润空间，以研究医疗服务提供者对此财务冲击的反应。我利用医院在政策实施前的药品利润依赖程度，来识别零加成药品政策的因果影响。我发现患者用于药物的支出平均减少了50%以上，而用于诊断程序的支出也增加了类似幅度，这表明医疗服务提供者可能将处方药的支出转移到了诊断服务上。尽管治疗模式发生了这些显著变化，但我并未发现健康结果有显著变化。分位数和因果森林分析表明，医疗服务提供者通过将治疗改变集中在更健康的患者身上来实现这一结果——这表明医疗资源的战略性重新分配有助于在减轻收入损失的同时保持健康结果。第三章探讨了医院是否通过改变最近出院患者再次入住急诊科进行急性护理的决策来应对医院再入院减少计划。利用2013年至2017年间佛罗里达州患者的住院和急诊记录，我采用了基于最后一次出院后天数数的回归不连续设计。我研究了患者在出院后30天截止日期之前或之后再次入住时，入院概率是否会出现不连续变化。在汇总样本中，我几乎没有发现这种不连续性的证据。然而，异质分析显示，在依赖Medicare较多的医院以及在第一年未受到惩罚的医院中，入院概率存在积极的不连续性，这种影响主要集中在肺炎和心力衰竭方面。这些发现表明，医院对HRRP的响应是选择性的，而非统一的，其变化取决于财务激励因素以及不同情况下的临床自主权。

abstract.text: Kelelahan kerja merupakan salah satu permasalahan yang dapat dialami perawat, terutama perawat ICU dan UGD yang menghadapi beban kerja tinggi dan sistem shift. Penelitian ini bertujuan mengetahui hubungan umur, jenis kelamin, indeks massa tubuh (IMT), status pernikahan, masa kerja, shift kerja, dukungan sosial, dan beban kerja dengan kelelahan kerja perawat di RSUD Toto Kabila. Penelitian menggunakan metode kuantitatif dengan desain korelasional. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan terdapat hubungan signifikan antara umur dengan kelelahan kerja (r=0,351) dengan keeratan rendah, jenis kelamin (r=0,971) dengan keeratan kuat, IMT (r=0,408) dengan keeratan sedang, status pernikahan (r=0,429) dengan keeratan sedang, shift kerja (r=0,788) dengan keeratan kuat, dan beban kerja (r=0,713) dengan keeratan kuat. Tidak terdapat hubungan signifikan antara masa kerja (r=0,008) dan dukungan sosial (r=0,005), dengan keeratan sangat rendah. Kesimpulan penelitian menunjukkan bahwa umur, jenis kelamin, IMT, status pernikahan, shift kerja, dan beban kerja berhubungan dengan kelelahan kerja, sedangkan masa kerja dan dukungan sosial tidak berhubungan secara signifikan. Hasil penelitian diharapkan menjadi bahan pertimbangan dalam upaya mengurangi kelelahan kerja perawat. nbsp;

https://openalex.org/W7219351672.abstractZh: 工作疲劳是护士面临的一个问题，尤其是那些在重症监护室和急诊室工作的护士，他们面临着高工作负荷和轮班制度。本研究的目的是了解年龄、性别、体重指数、婚姻状况、工作年限、轮班制度、社会支持与工作疲劳之间的关系，在Toto Kabila医院进行。研究采用定量研究方法，采用相关设计。研究结果表明，年龄与工作疲劳之间存在显著关系（r=0.351），性别关系则较弱（r=0.971），体重指数与关系中等（r=0.408），婚姻状况与关系中等（r=0.429），轮班制度与工作疲劳关系较强（r=0.788），工作负荷与工作疲劳关系也较强（r=0.713）。工作年限与社会支持之间不存在显著关系（r=0.008），社会支持与关系非常弱。研究结论表明，年龄、性别、体重指数、婚姻状况、轮班制度和工作负荷与工作疲劳有关，而工作年限和社会支持则不存在显著关系。研究结果有望为减少护士工作疲劳提供参考依据。

abstract.text: This article examines the economic mechanisms that shape the competitiveness of private and independent healthcare providers within the healthcare system of the United Kingdom, with particular emphasis on England. The analysis interprets the relationship between the National Health Service (NHS) and the independent sector not simply as competition between the public and private sectors, but as an interconnected system comprising publicly funded demand, patient choice, activity-based payments, transparency of quality and price information, provider regulation, and antitrust oversight. Based on the 2025 NHS–Independent Sector collaboration agreement, the 2026/27 NHS Payment Scheme, and mechanisms for ensuring transparency of information in the private healthcare market through the Private Healthcare Information Network (PHIN), the article identifies the key economic channels through which competition is fostered. For Uzbekistan, the study proposes the gradual establishment, within the state health insurance system, of a mechanism based on the following sequence: “accredited provider – unified base tariff – patient choice – payment for services delivered – quality coefficient – transparent rating.”

https://openalex.org/W7219405224.abstractZh: 本文探讨了塑造英国医疗体系内私营和独立医疗服务提供者竞争力的经济机制，特别关注英格兰的情况。分析将国家医疗服务体系（NHS）与独立部门之间的关系，不简单地视为公共部门和私营部门之间的竞争，而是一个相互关联的体系，包括公共资金支持的医疗服务需求、患者选择、基于活动的付费方式、质量和价格信息的透明度、医疗服务提供者的监管以及反垄断监督。基于2025年NHS与独立部门合作协议、2026/27年度NHS支付计划，以及通过私人医疗信息网络（PHIN）确保私人医疗市场信息透明度的机制，本文指出了促进竞争的关键经济渠道。对于乌兹别克斯坦而言，研究建议在国家健康保险体系内逐步建立一种基于以下顺序的机制：“认证提供者——统一基础费率——患者选择——服务交付的付费——质量系数——透明评级。”
